title: Page 285 of The History of Augusta (T)
content: history augusta nash, charles elventon1904published charles e. nash son, augusta, mainelocation original: private collection view thumbnails 7 pages document view image page 285 mrs. ballard's diary. 285 1789. october 1. company afternoon. mrs. hannah north, mrs. chever, mrs. weston cohors, mr. savage, informs mrs. foster sworn rape number men, among whome shocking, indeed. 2. called 4th h. morn, mrs. goff, travail. walkt davis, store; crost river went land horseback. arived 6th h. old mrs. goff returned boston 1h. p. tarried night. 3. mrs. goff's illness increast, shee safe delivered 11h. 30 m. morn, daughter. marm, mrs. bullen, mrs. ney, asistants. returned home 6, afternoon. find mr. ballard returned tower surveying yesterday. 4. josh sinclair brot us barrel herrin, smokt. 5. informed man drowned jones' eddy came passenger boston capt. howard. 6. thee sweap one mills got crank, neither tended night. 7. mitty devenport dined. joshua sinclare mr. richardson drank tea. 12 years since left oxford. 8. called 8th h. morn, mr. daw's hook, wife travail. regiment troop convened mr. shuball hinkley's land. 9. mrs. daw safe delivered 6th hour morn fine son, weighed 11 lbs. mrs. daw 32d woman putt bed since feb'y 5th. 10. rev'd mr. isaac foster removed vassalboro day. mr. ballard gone hook. mr. densmore's. mr. hatch went 11. day aneversary ordination rev'd isaac foster church flock town three years since. 12. called 12 o'clock, morn, john cuming's. arived 2; found wife safe delivered son, weighed 11 lbs, 5th son 7th child. esquire coney took breakfast informed woman winthrop fell fire burned degree shee soon expired; hallowell girl night 8th inst. fell fire, also, life expected. morning 8th inst. daniel savage's junior oldest son scolt much. 13. called 8th hour, morn, mrs. stone. shee safe delivered 5 p. m. daughter. 2d child; child weighed 3-4 lbs. october 7. submit davenport, twenty years age, daughter jonathan susanna (white) davenport, lived opposite side river ballard family. october 8. (1) william dorr (1757- 1840) first house stood known sheppard's point. son mentioned diarist joseph, elder brother john dorr (1799-1882) augusta. (see dorr family). (2) afterwards called hinkley's plains, composing territory hallowell cemetery. title page page iii page iv page 285 page 286 page 287 page 293 jump see page 'one rape. two stories.' martha ballard's story chapt. 16 see secondary sources 'archive' see documents relevant maine history 'archive' home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive

title: Page 286 of The History of Augusta (T)
content: history augusta nash, charles elventon1904published charles e. nash son, augusta, mainelocation original: private collection view thumbnails 7 pages document view image page 286 286 history augusta 1789. october 16. charles webber ataictching people's efects acount mr. foster owes 18. sunday. mrs. densmore delivered son 1h. morn. left cleverly returned 8th h. felt much fatagued; slept little since thursday night. 20. hear wife daniel savage, junior, departed life life yesterday morn interred afternoon. wm. hewen's son born 19th inst. 21. informed capt. reed cast away return europe. savage bolton wife taken warrant breaking sabath. 22. colonel north began build bridge pond. 25. snowed morn: ground covered depth 4 inches. 9. nathan haywood's wife winslow delivered daughter 26th inst. 30. rule ben chosen determine town hallowell giv rev'd mr. isaac foster reported day $112.10, colonel howard treasurer given note demand interest till paid. mr. foster gentlemen called return home. november 2. mr. ballard bot bais colonel howard waistcoat. 3. called 8th h. morn. see mrs. palmer hook. shee travail. 4. mrs. palmer safe delivered 5th hour, morn, son, weighed 10 lbs., sixth son 7th child. 5. mr. ballard set business surveying. 14. two men boy sleep fire night. mr. crage crost bridge load hay day. light north streams red extended almost whole hemisphere. 17. doctor coney called mr. desmore's vassalboro, wife travail. 19. informed mrs. densmore delivered morn expired second hour, morn. 20. remains mrs. densmore interred day. 24. mr. ballard returned home surveying; finisht job except planing. 25. joseph stackpole, daughter born. 28. manly left bound bridgwater 30. mr. ballard went hook needle mended. december 3. called ephraim cowen charles cleark's wife travail 2h. morn. shee sage delivered daughter (3d child, daughters) 4th hour. 5. ice run river. 7. called 10th h. evening, mrs. parmer travail; conducted river mr. petingil mr. ballard; former, wm. novermber 19. daughter abial lovejoy vassalboro sidney). title page page iii page iv page 285 page 286 page 287 page 293 jump see secondary sources 'archive' see documents relevant maine history 'archive' home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive

title: Page 287 of The History of Augusta (T)
content: history augusta nash, charles elventon1904published charles e. nash son, augusta, mainelocation original: private collection view thumbnails 7 pages document view image page 287 mrs. ballard's diary. 287 howard, samuel shaw acrost river; rode esqr. petengail's. mrs. parmer safe delivered 12 fine daughter, cleverly, except cold prevails universally. 1789. december 8. received butter esqr. petengail's lady pills shee david pattee's wife departed life 4th inst. child bed. shee left 12 children mourn loss. 10. birth samuel pierce's son. 11. rev'd mr. foster called says family unwell. 15. mr. ballard left home bound norridgewock. home. ice stopt fort western. people crost crick water. 16. people crost river cake ice swang round eddy, east side stopt point mr. weston's. 17. river open field. e. davis crost horse confineing two cannoes together. 18. mr. ballard returned canaan. 19. mr. hamlen seting glass. levy reuben moore purchase timber. 21. dolly set web work; drawn narrow harness. shee cutt drew wove. 22. ice moved fort. 25. ground covered snow two inches deep. 28. capt. weston canaan came help mr. ballard plan. 29. mr. ballard capt. weston went esquire coney's morn. 30. called 1 h. morn, see mrs. brooks travail. rode mr. pollard's landing; mr. ballard acompanied took horse back. walkt mr. brooks'; much fatagued; found lady deplorable situation, blessing providence put safe bed 3d h. living mother fine daughter. came home capt. hersey's. walkt acrost river got home safe. left mrs. vose nurs. 31. births hallowell, years, 1785. males, 17; females, 22. 1786. males, 24; females, 25. 1787. males, 20; females, 28. 1788. males, 17; females, 25. 1789. males, 27; females, 27. total 232. 31. deaths hallowell years, 1785. males, 4; females, 6. 1786. males, 4; females, 5. 1787. males, 9; females, 7. 1782. males, 7; females, 5. 1789. males, 3; females, 6. total. 56. 31. [1789]. put 14 women bed sons 24 daughters. 1790 males born hallowell, 23; females, 19. deaths, males, 10; females, 5. [1790] extracted 34 children towns, 20 males, females, 14 december 18. skowhegan. december 28. samuel weston (1757-1802), son joseph weston pioneer settler part original territory canaan skowhegan; farmer trader land surveyor forceful locally prominent man; one daughters married joseph baker, senior, mother henry knox baker (1806-1902), hallowell, joseph baker (1812-1883) augusta. title page page iii page iv page 285 page 286 page 287 page 293 jump see page 'one rape. two stories.' martha ballard's story chapt. 16 see secondary sources 'archive' see documents relevant maine history 'archive' home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive

title: Page 293 of The History of Augusta (T)
content: history augusta nash, charles elventon1904published charles e. nash son, augusta, mainelocation original: private collection view thumbnails 7 pages document view image page 293 mrs. ballard's diary. 293 1790. june 17. air. foster sleeps informs esquire hussey departed life yesterday, 7h. p. m. prison. 18. burial esquire hussey. 19. mr. ballard went hook meeting proprietors unity. calvin edson drowned river night; attempted cross nd supposed fell asleep fell board. 20. received letter brother barton 13th inst., informs dear sister debby davis departed life 8th, interred 10th. left husband seven children mourn loss. 21. mr. town mrs. barton went judge boman's office; took administration late husband's estate. mr. edson drowned 21st inst., taken morn. 22. mr. ballard went mr. carr's meeting chuse juriors. mr. carr mager goodin chose grand jury; capt. page andrew goodin petty, etc. 23. brother ebenezer's infant deceased day. july 4. mr. seth williams drank tea 5. capt. stackpool winslow] informs sherebiah town expired last evening, 11 12 hours; interred to-morrow; capt. allso informed mr. lues killed limb falling tree; man penobscott hanged himsef another boston shott 6. left home early, bound pownalboro; mr. ballard, allso. went board leut. pollard's boat; stopt pittstown; got mr. hatch's took lodgings coart's setting. went coart, afternoon. 11. sunday. pownalboro. went mr. hatche's meeting mr. kider's eastern river. 13. came coart house. saw melone receive punishment coart inflicted 8 hour morn; returned mr. hatche's. paid reckoning sett home. wrode mr. pollard's horse. dined mager smith's. called mr. bullin's mr. jackson's. arived home near sun sett. 18. old mr. pitts drank tea june 17. obed hussey lived east side river nearly opposite sheppard's point. april 6, 1789, town meeting approved road river near esquire hussey's house eastward across intervale foot hill, till comes near mr. andrew goodwin's barn, eastward county road." (town records, p. 78.) june 21. calvin edson, came cape cod 1781, last occupied farm afterwards owned allen lambard, present fifth ward. mr. edson first introduce twitch witch grass town; obtained half bushel seed massachusetts, thought valuable vitality, power resist frosts. edson "got something would winter kill." june 26. jonathan bowman, judge probate lincoln county, 1772 death 1804. july 13. flogged whipping post. july 18. seth pitts, senior. title: The Objections of Henry Sewall's seven objections to Rev. Isaac Foster (T) The Objections
content: henry sewall's seven objections rev. isaac foster oct. 4, 1786 image available objections objections doctrines held mr. foster, prepared presented capt. sewall, stated follows: article 1. holding gospel dispensation purchased death christ, order god might accept imperfect obedience creatures, instead perfect one law originally required. 2. denying adam created holy. holding capacity generate holiness series obedience. 3. denying total depravity human nature unregenerate state. holding extent, degree. asserting unregenerate persons moral power, ask, seek, strive, gospel sense; improve common grace obtain special grace. 4. denying doctrine absolute, unconditional election. holding election god's foresight faith good works creatures, discriminating ground title eternal life. 6. denying saint's final perseverance founded power faithfulness god. holding persevere virtue choice, asserting persons may apostatize good beginnings, pursued would lead saving grace. 7. holding heathen, destitute light gospel, really duty worship even though hold plurality deities. paul duty persecuting church, account scripture reproved conduct. transcribed north's history augusta pages 205-206, source stated copy hand writing h. sewall, signed benjamin pettingill, one elders church, several others." jump see objections north's history augusta 'archive' home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive

content: laurel thatcher ulrich gave speech accepting bancroft prize columbia university (april 3, 1991). bancroft one prestigious awards given written work history year. midwife's tale received many awards year published, including pulitzer prize.) martha's diary mine spent eight years studying diary martha moore ballard, eighteenth-century maine midwife. thinking could explain remembered diary. pretty miserable affair compared martha's--four ruled notebooks intermittent entries scattered fifteen years, went back read written surprised discover much told life martha. diary entry april 18, 1982 seems particularly fitting bancroft acceptance speech. summer interesting," began, adding husband, gael, going full-time parent househusband july august neh summer fellowship work martha ballard's diary." went comment recent publication first book. "good wives except short review ny times, silence. sort eery feeling. like good wives lot. mother likes gael likes neighbor] parker ayer finds worth reading. suppose ways celestial values. crave validation gushing reviews. bancroft prize would nice, honestly recollection ever thinking thing, let alone writing diary keeping dangerous activity. people often ask found martha ballard's diary. answer accident." gone maine state archives pursuing early court case interested ran documents mid-afternoon, since augusta, maine, long way durham, new hampshire, didn't want waste trip, decided stop adjoining state library look two diaries seen bibliography women's history. one turned ten-page typescript. martha's---two fat volumes bound homemade linen covers. found women's documents research good wives, awed sheer bulk faded ink difficult read, hour closing transcribed several pages, enough form base grant application gave summer fellowship. reading journals, surprised soon summer research idea book began form. weeks augusta, arranged diary microfilmed could continue work durham. july 17 1982, wrote: walking home unh library yesterday suddenly felt book diary. trick would write something accessible diary midwifery bastardy-- borrow metaphor mrs. ballard's world? giving life world substituting "illegitimate" book real book--hers. key sentence probably next one: project appeals writer." fortunately recognized early better story-teller editor, didn't patience humility spend years transcribing document massive one. also recognized, think, experience writing good wives allowed see things diary people might recognize. idea difficult would actually write book. don't suppose historical issues terribly complex," wrote, adding blithely, 150 page book--with maps photographs." august, gael holding things together home, working full-time library--reading negative microfilm--white black. wonder sometimes forgot diary entry august 5 begins: almost wrote 1782. least ankle deep mrs. ballard's book. spent full week reading microfilm filling data sheets. came library day, raining. knew would reading freshet rising mrs. ballard's world somehow become september gael went back teaching--and sharing responsibility rambunctious house. karl, mindy, nathan away school, though liked show weekends holidays several friends occasionally big black dog. thatcher 13 1982; amy 7. february 26, 1983, wrote: gets difficult write journal. semester five weeks gone. wild month been--snow days, flu, trying school 9 lecture 200 students. follow long discussion nancy chodorow's book reproduction mothering women's studies faculty discussing: must assume male dominance culture admit male dominance aspects culture controlled men? title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 18-29, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 18 29, 1785 18 6 clear pleast. went mr westons; walkd. 19 7 birth. tylars son. xx clear pleast. brother town dind enformd daugt hannah ye collik. mrs foster drank tea. james cowen james moore came conduct nathn tylars. arivd sun sett. put mrs tylar bed son 8 [oc] eving. tarrd night. 20 b clear pleast. returnd tylars. poll savage enformd ye death benn browns daft, nabby. mr burn brtr jesse hannh crage, [talk] north jona retrd sebestack; well 21 2 clear. mrs forbes bake. peggy babe hr. attended funeral benn browns daftr, nabby, deceast 19th inst, 4 years 1 day old. mr bald met select gentm isaac clearks. 22 3 snowd day. mr ballard gone bumbr hook makng raits. home day. poll savg finsht self pair hoes sowd sheet. 23 4 clear, cold blustring. mr ballard gan ye hook. 24 5 cloar cold. mr ballard returnd home night. unwell day. 25 6 clear cold. hannah dolly gone ys aftern. mr taylor, dr polly saml duttun junr dind home day. 26 7 clear, thawd little. mr ballard wrote warrants. home. hannah finsd ephes shirt. mr savage wm kennudy brougt wife home. 27 b clear. theophelus hamlin arivd oxford, recd letter fm br collins moore enforms ye death ebinz davis's wife. capt lambs wife charltn, solon cooks ebnz davis junrs wives died child bed; infants deceast also. enfms death old lady harris. 28 2 clear part ye day; rain haill [shnow]. went see woodward allins wife. saw mrs hardin 29 3 clear pleast. hannah went mr westons. old mrs batton home day. son ephrms birth day; aged six years. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 30-Apr. 8, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 30 april 8, 1785 30 4 storm snow; cold march. jono brt hay doctr coneys. ye storm contins. home day. 31 5 birth. welmans child. x datr. xx calld day go mr wellmans. ephm cowen went us far ye plain beyond esqr howards bridge, mett mesage enforming ye woman got safe bed. turnd returnd home. two falls; one way ye return. ye storm continues yet; snow levil ye top lower pain glass north window. travild rods snow almost high waist. stopt mr suels warmd. cowen got colo howards sleigh brought mr suels. got home 8 o clock. 1 6 snowd. makeing lee soap. home day. mr savage returnd wh hors carng sistr home. polly savag medecin hannah. sent allowotic tincture. 2 7 clear warm part ye day; raind noon. jono cowan gone attend funeral ebenz taylor departed life yesterday. home ys day. 3 b snow y morn, trees much loaded. raind noon. mr ballard went thomas sewils hear mr kinsman speak eving. mr savage supt home day. 4 2 snowd allmost day. mr ballard attendd town meeting. finnished one cyruss cotten hoes. home ys day. 5 3 raind ye morn, sun shind 01 [sic] morn. haild ye aftern. sun sett clear, raind hard eving. home ys day. began make soap. 6 4 clear pleast. biah town home ys day making soap knitting. 7 5 clear, fast day. mr mrs savage mrs [brod] lidia mc graw. home day. 8 6 cloudy part ye day. mrs foster poll savage enformd yt james scalt. home ys day. jono unwell night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 9-16, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 9 16, 1785 9 7 home day. mr thomas making soap. 10 b calld little past 12 morn mr edson, go wife travil. walkt ye brok thee point; drawn edson wm canady slead. river dangers arived safe divine protection. 11 2 birth. edsons children. two sons. x 4 20 morn, mrs edson deliverd son waid 7 1/2 lb 6 5 minnits another son wd 8 3/4 lb. left 10, mr ballard coming time. enformd ye death grand son john town, last thursday morn drank much spirit causd death hapend yester day 8 morn. return mr edsons, mrs weston cald nathan sick. tarried night. left ye child much better. 12 3 clear cold april. came home mr westons. cald mr pollards. jono gone son towns attend funeral son. went bed thinking childrens trouble, could compose sleep. 11 oclok evn, woodd allin cald went land colo norths; bad walking. card candle ye top burnt hill. 12 1 arivd allins much fataugd. 13 4 x birth. wd. allins daftr. xx clear. mrs allin deliverd dafter 4 morn. returnd home 11 o clock. receivd 6 shillings woodward allin part fee medicin shee took knap sleep ys afternoon. mr woodward mr forbes made prest calfs head. jono returnd towns. 14 5 clear cold apl. home. let john sahaw 1 oz salve; prs eight pence. 15 6 clear cold. went isaac savages see hannah, daftr. james georg boltons mr forbess. brothr moore mr hawes finished cyruss cotten hoes. 16 7 clear. capt savage lady isaac wife makeing soap. weiry night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 17-24, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 17 24, 1785 17 b clear plest. mr pollard, isaac savage polly enformd yt jono wimans wife deceasd last eving. 18 2 clear morn, raind little aftern. finishd making soap. home day. polly savage 19 3 clear part ye day, snowd night. combd flax. unwell night. 20 4 snowd raind. mr canady church getting logs brook. 21 5 clear cool april. unwell, taken cold causd pain neck sholder. colo howard, mr brooks doct colman enformd ye death leutt howard departed life yesterday. 22 6 [mr] turner wf mr westons. clear warm. mr ballard attendid funeral leut howard. corps brought sleigh ye river colo howards ye morng, ye funeral two o clock. mr westons, saw widdow drawn river six aftern ye sleigh drawn men. tarried mr westons night; took care jimmy. 23 7 clear. mr westons till dinner. mr weston returnd boston. got home 12 o clock, crost ye river ice. mrs pollard colo norths; drank tea. 24 b fee recvd. x calld 2 o clock ye morn go thee hook mrs blake travil. went winthrop road 4 miles, blakes near four miles. arivd sun rose, found mrs blake deliverd son help peter clearks wife. receivd 4 shilling trouble. returnd fosters hors back; thence walkd home attindid mr foster. much fatagud. calld isaac savages see hannah, dafter. returnd home 10 eving. return mr ballard found ye boome logs bords float. hamlin, robbins, cowin jonathan got bed went secure people pasd ice fort western day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 25-May 3, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 25 may 3, 1785 25 2 thee ice went river, backd water lower flour ye grist mill. ye jamm remoovd six o clok. theops cyrus tendid saw mill till three morn. 26 3 mrs foster dind. home day. jonathan hurt foot slab. mr bullins barn burnt yesterdy 11 o clok morn. 27 4 home. mr mrs forbes, peggy poly savage drank tea mr ballard gone colo howards mill repair hannah movd bed chamber. 28 5 clear. mr ballard gone ditoes. john pinkam herbs child thats unwell. ice runs river day. mr forbes made prest ladle. home day. 29 6 mr weston desird go hous, wife unwell. watkd mr ballard came eving; rode home. raind eving. 30 7 chilly. home. brother moore mr haws, mr forbes wife peggy, dind capt hatch, mr edson, also mrs savage, drank tea. three brooms mr smith. let 3:4d cash 1 lb coffee. saw mill stopt ye back water. great cry provision. vesils arived yet. ye ice run day. 1 b clear. ice runs day. heard son town mr lewis; well. home ys day. 2 2 clear cool. home. mr chamberlin mendid cyruss boys trousers. mr taylor dind 3 3 clear. capt nichols oxford friends well. hannah dolly went mr crages mr westons. benn brown drank tea us. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 4-14, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 4 14, 1785 4 4 clear, windy. capts howard smith came mr pollards eddy. home day. mr blackman sister ye westward. 5 5 clear. went doctr coneys water cyrus. paid ye doctrs bill sickness last decembr 9:6. return obliged call mr mc masters ascistance get ye rock. calld mr westons; found ill. tard night. 6 6 clear. mr westons. sloop came wife rode comfortable. mr ballard went bord capt smith, bought [flanl], returnd home. son town tard 7 7 cloudy chilly. home. capt nichols reubin moore drank tea mr williams tard night. polly savage brought yarn. 8 b cloud. home. mr williams went away morn. collins moore, mr davis thos mc keckny polly savage drank chocolat. 9 2 clear. hannah dolly washd scourd. old mr whealer dind. mr ballard gone settle wt mr gardner, pirkins moore building yr mill. weighd ye pork; wt 205 lb. 10 3 clear. mr straten hayward brought yr logs. home day. wm cowens wife 11 4 clear. town meeting. combd flax noone. home day. 12 5 clear. home. comd flax. yee gerls brewd. 13 6 clear. gardin fenced. mr foster comd flax. home day. 14 7 began make gardin. finisht combing flax. polly savage went mr westons, took home day. raind ys night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 25-Jun. 3, 1785 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 4-13, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 4 13, 1785 4 7 clear. mrs gardy went colon norths. hannah polly hamblin went unwell; home day. mr twing brought mr ballards breachs. 5 b clear. cald mr suels see wife; found unwell left comfortable middle day. found sister williams doctr barton calld danl boltons; poorly. 6 2 boltons. made pair trouses jimmy. 7 3 came boltons went mr edsons carry web weave. mr westons. 8 4 clear. mrs foster mend quilt. woodward allins wife home day. 9 5 birth. danl boltons dafter. x calld haste danniel boltons, wife travil. shee safely deliverd twelve o clok fine dafter. left comfortable returned home sun sett. fee paid. rains tonight. finishd 4th pair toe hoes. 10 6 cloudy. went mr pollards afternoone. mr hodges set boston. began mr ballard pair hoes woolin. 11 7 clear. finished mending quilt. girls went forbess. mr ballard returnd court; brought 2 quart basons 2 pint dito. home day. 12 b fammily went mr suels meting. cald isaac savages see hannah, unwell. 13 2 went mr churches suels esqr howards. mr witham wife son tarried polly taylor came night. polly hamblin went mr morning. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 14-23, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 14 23, 1785 14 3 clear. went mr savages see hannah. killd calf baked churnd. 15 4 clear. mrs bisby polly hannah crage receivd line daughter town rote answere finished 11 o clok eving. home day. 16 5 clear hott, shower noone. home day. mr ballard bought 1/2 barl pork tea kettle. thunders tonight. news brother moores saw mill consumed fire, also near 70 thousand good boards belonging georg brown. 17 6 rainy. home day. set cabbage plants. 18 7 rainy. home ys day. brewd spun [sash]. 19 b clear. attendd meeting ye meeting hous. went mr westons intermition. mr coney made prayer read sermon ye morn. mr babcok performd afternoon. 20 2 went mr ballard doct coneys see house raisd. james cowen came home us, tard night. 21 3 birth. bunker farwells dafter. x calld two o clok morn go bunker farwells; got sun rise. put mrs farwells bed 2 ye afternoon; returnd home eleven eveng. fit ye cramp fainting also. dolly got brought ye lavender revivd much. mr farwell gave 7s:4d performance. 22 4 unwell hearing son daugtr town unwell, venturd set see cyrus went left home 12 o clock. 23 5 still unwell. mr town wife better. cyrus set return home noone. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 24-Jul. 7, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 24 july 7, 1785 24 6 mr towns. mrs stagpool came see us. went ye river mist way returning home. mr lewis betsy town went seek length found ye way home, though fatagd. 25 7 went mrs town see mrs dexter. mrs straten 26 b went son dafter town mr stackpools. 27 2 went mrs straten mr town capt haywards. 28 3 mr towns day. betsy carried web mr crosbys. sally stackpole loes spencer 29 4 mr towns; washed. mr dexter 30 [5] ditoes. mr collar eunis stakpole 1 6 ditoes. mrs cragen, hail barton made us visit. betsy unwell. little rain ys afternoone. 2 7 clear morn hott; thunderd raind afternoone. son towns day. 3 b clear morn. mr pratt went son towns. mrs collar daughter mrs dexter also. nancy dors betsy went see mr thorn; sick. 4 2 clear, little cooler. went mr croggins daughter town shee faint turn 5 3 clear cool. mr town went fort hallifax attend town meating. mrs hayward dafters, straten haill mr towns; drank tea. day. 6 4 storm. mr towns. ironed finished pair wolon hoes self. 7 5 cloudy fore noon aftern also, much rain. mrs town went mr dexters, drank tea mr town gone take care sheribis colte. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 8-17, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 8 17, 1785 8 6 mrs town went mr stratens. colol brewer lady mr towns dore. shower. mr stratens boy sett us ye river. mr town gone cobecy. 9 7 clear, pleast morn. lucy well. mr town came home; brought news yt mr ballard gone casco cort evidence behalf emmerson. mr towns day, anaxious see home dificlt gone. 10 b lords day pleast. mr towns yet, lucy house yet. mr stackpole lady drank tea. sally dexter also. nathan howard paid betsy visit evening. 11 2 cloudy morn. son towns day. betsy went mr dexters stratens. lucy unwell. 12 3 clear warm. lucy unwell. towns yet. mr lues went river. betsy washd went mr dexters. shower night. feel well could wish. 13 4 clear morn. son towns day. mr dexter 14 5 clear. lucy, mrs craggin went capt hails. mrs dexter also. 15 6 clear. finisht futting pair hoes lucy began stokin self. went mr dexters mrs craggin, mrs haill mr luis went watch mr thorn departed life ye middle ye night. 16 7 rose morn day, cloudy. betsy sett plants. finisht ye [stokin]. thunder shower afternoone. betsy unwell]. 17 b clear. attended funeral old mr thorn. capt fillbrook made prayer ocasion. corps carried water interd. returnd grave esq. pettee mrs craggin. leut browns lady went son towns. mr dexter capt hale lady betsy went ye grave attend funeral mr thorn. mrs collar delivd last night dead child. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 10-17, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 10 17, 1785 10 7 birth. hodges dafter. fee receivd. x mrs hodges safely delivrd dafter 6/o clock ys morn. returnd home ten, left comfortable. hannah polly returnd mr towns. left ym well. cyrus conducted polly home brought cloath edsons. 11 b got ready go esqr howards raind put unwell aftern. mr woodward mr savige wife meeting. enformd yt mrs mc masters got bed child deceast, ye funeral tomorrow. cyruss birth day; aged 29 years. 12 2 went esqr howards take care alvin weeks polly briant sick feaver. capt nickols silas eddy oxford. calld mr chamberlins, wife travil ten eving. john comings come go benn whites winthrop could dismist. 13 3 birth. chamberlins x daftr. chamberlins day. shee deliverd six o/clok aftern dafter. left ten came home fatagud. home, mr ballard pits town. 14 4 chamberlins fosters. jonathan watch alvin weeks esqr howards. home. mr ballard came pits town 15 5 chamlns fosters. thunder rain night. alvin weeks departed life ye night. 16 6 attended funeral mr weeks, tarried esqrh night. took care polly suck. 17 7 came ye fort went chamberlins. dolly returnd son towns, left comfortable. mr ballard still sebestack. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 18-Oct. 7, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 18 october 7, 1785 18 b rainy. went chamberlins see babe. 19 2 went mrs fosters. brought home [sheets] mended. let polly barton 20 3 home day. mr oriah cleark wife 21 4 calld chamberlins see yr babe; heard mrs savage yt lucy unwell. 22 5 birth leightn son x calld mr leightons, wife travil. left home ten foren, arivd two aft. found safely delivd son, opperation performd solo leightons wife. 23 6 left mrs ltn comfortable. arivd home three noon. fatagud ye rid[en]. dolly brot cloath edsons. 24 7 cloudy day, began rain 9 eving. home day. bakd pumpkin pies. 25 b great rain freshit. mr savig chamb[len] eph cowen night. danel life tend [mill]. 26 2 sheribiah town came go mr dex[ters] sebestacook. left home four o/clock p.m. arivd little twelve. found mrs dexter ill thee mumps. fixt remedy shee mended soon. tarried son towns till october ye sixth, came home water attended capt hale shereb town. brought barl fish mr stratens us. daught towns babe unwell, [better]. 6 5 arivd home dexters. found clarrisa barton visit. 7 6 clear. went mr westons, found wife unwell. calld mr pollards. mrs hodges source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 8-17, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 8 17, 1785 8 7 went mr chamberlins see ye babe, prepard fig phisick returnd. danl robins brusd toe, painful. put poultis rufus ballard ys day. 9 b calld mr westons see wife, shee ill disentery. administerd clister gave eas came home eving. drest robinss foot better. 10 2 went mr chamberlins fore noon, mr westons aftern, found wife better. ye girls went eving. mr ballard gone mr [wheles]. 11 3 home day evng till nine calld great haste colo howards, wife five childn sick. saml bleeding gave ym great surprise. tarrd night. bille mending. bitsy wheeler sick esqr howards. 12 4 came colo howards. left ym sick. 13 5 home day, finishd mr ballards hoes. watcht ye fort ys night. 14 6 came ye fort aftern, went back night. took sleep fore part ye night. sit yl two mrs howards chamber. 15 7 came home towo aftern. luke barton dind. sent soap lucy mr [sheren] unwell. 16 b went colo howards, tard night watcht. mrs howard severe feaver fitt. 17 2 tard helpt moove ye sick, dres yr blisters &c; returnd home noone. dolly gone home hannah barton. shee returnd evng, brought parthena. mrs foster mrs brown broth moore thos smily mr ballard went ym view mill spott. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 18-Nov. 1, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 18 november 1, 1785 18 3] home day. dolly unwell. rose ye night take care 19 4 oct. home. dolly unwell. hannah polly washt. mr ballard went mr hersys fore n, hook aftern. wilm stone sent campfr. sent ounce tinct. 20 5 home. richard ridan wife capt nichols ys evng. mr ballard gone ye hook. home. mr salvns hatch wife came capt nichols bound ye westward. rubn moore, wilm mr eddy staid night. 21 6 birth. dexters dafter. eph town came day go mr dexters. left 7/o clock, arivd dexters 1 aftern; found wife ill. removd thee obstruction deliverd safe fine dafter ye middle ye night. stormd severely journey. 22 7 came dexters. raind. cald see polly dudley extreemly low sensless. dind doct bartons. got fort western dusk could cross ye river reason ye freshet. tard colon howards. kindly entertaind. family sick yet. 23 b came ye river got home safe, found dolly comfortable. mr hatch wife went raind hard left us. mr woodward wife dind shee staid night. 24 2 clear morn. mrs woodward dind crost thee crick go mr westons. mr hopkins mr stanley came order fraim ye mill. dolly ephm unwell. home day. thuntred raind night. 25 3 cloudy rainy. home, work house; children better. hannah ironed parthena dolly spun cotton. 26 4 home day. cyrus conducted parthena homeward far mr faughts. mr kidder wife slept mrs woodward went home colon howards, acompanied mr pollard. 27 5 clear, fine day. mr kidder went ye way home. mr brooks bread baked. mr hopkins stanly went away noone. hous work, home day. felt unwell ys evening. 28 6 left home three o clock pm, went far daviss store. calld colon howards asist mrs pollard bisby lay ye corps wife deceast. children yet sick. returnd home little sun set. 29 7 went ditos noone. wife interd ys aftern; larg number attended. tarried night watcht polly peggy. 30 b came home ye fort noone, attended worship aftern. mrs jesse koofe slept saml bullin epn cowen also. 31 2 x birth. capt springrs dafter. calld 10 o clock ye morn haste capt jobe springers wife travil, safe x delvd soone arival dafter. left ym comfortable x returnd night. birth 2 o clock. 1 3 birth. mr westns son. calld mrs westons 1 o/clock morn, shee labour; delivred son 7 ye morn. returnd home one aftern. left ym comfortable. mr hopkins stanley polly fletcher came nurs mrs weston. mr ballard ye courts committee roads ye river winthrop west ye country road east ward, laid source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 2-11, 1785 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 2 11, 1785 2 4 home day. raind exceeding powerfully ys night. 3 5 cloudy rainy. old mrs bolton mrs chamberlin aftern. home day. 4 6 mr westons, aftern. calld coln norths. mrs cox unwell gitting better. 5 7 home day. unwell, cough. 6 b clear day. attended worship aftern. sheribiah town night. unwell. 7 2 attended funeral peggy haward deceast yesterday. doct colman unwell. saml jack mending. polly hous. 8 3 home day; unwell. tried take swett last night could night went warm bed. drank hott brandy tody, swet little. 9 4 cloudy. feel little comfortable. rode mr pollards find self profited thereby. 10 5 home. mrs edson x 1 oz salv husband foot. coughed much night. 11 6 birth. x henry babcocks dafter born five morn. xx calld 5 o clock ys morn henry babcocks, wife travil. arivd day light; found put bed, operation performd mrs smith. mrs babcock found severe pain; complaints great shee desireous inquire ye cause. complyd found greatly ingered misshap. mrs smith alow yt shee sencible however viz mrs babks, distres severe apprehencive shee expiring. sent doct colman dr williams fortunately came prescribed remidies aford relief. left returnd home 10/pm. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 5, 1786 1 clear cold day. fammaly attended divine servis except ephm self. ye girls gone mr williams ys eving, cyrus also. mr pollard hall mr ballard gone mr pollards. 2 2 clear, cold day. home, mended shirt ephm. edmn allin wife girls washt. ye mill stopt reasn ye cold. hear mrs faught deceast. 3 3 mr bullin rachel faught came 9/o clok going attend funeral mrs faught. mr densmore calld see son unwell. began snow left home. calld see mrs north came home. shee sick. enformd ye death judg bowman pownalboro. tedious storm. 4 4 birth. blakes son. x. fee recievd. home till 7/o/clok eving calld james moore go john blakes wife travil. rode hors put safe bed son. snowd night. 5 5 came home acompanied mr moore. snows yt. feel fatagud. mr blake paid eight shillings. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 6 21, 1786 6 6 feel poorely. calld go mr chamberlins see babe. found much polly bisbee hamlin 7 7 cold day. home ys day. made 8 lb candles mr brooks 4-1/2 lb self. men brought hay ye meddow. dolly fell chamber hurt head. 8 clear, cold day. calld mr chamberlins see child, found ill. tarried night. set 9 2 mr ballard came brought home chamblns. mr mags came go mrs hatch. left hous 4/o clock aftern, arivd 8/in evng. 10 3 hatchs. sister wilams death chambs child. 11 4 sister went mr ferwels. 12 5 siesd pain ear. 13 6 ditoes. remain unwell. excessive cold. 14 7 ditoes. mrs williams went magges. 15 siesd collic. 16 2 dos. ye collic still. 17 3 siesd pain head. 18 4 unwell still. 19 5 hatches. feel better. 20 6 ditoes. mr williams went home. 21 7 moderate. began rain ys eving. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 12 19, 1786 12 clear, pleast day. still unwell, attend divine servis, famaly hannah woodward calld return home. shee slipt mudied cloaths much. dind roast spairrib. 13 2 clear, warm day. home ys day. mr ballard went doctr coneys ys morn. mr weston capt savage trying find whether mistake bord count. hannah dolly washt. mr searls rie order fm mr brods. 14 3 clear. home. mrs farly night. mr ballard henry babcoks. jerry babcok dind ephm cowen drest flax hear yt mr smith returnd. 15 4 clear warm. hodges drest flax comd 7 lb. home day. mr ballard went mr westons. 16 5 snowd ys morn raind aftern eving. mr ballard gone mr pollards meat ye meting hous committy, settle asa emerson. jont ys evinng. comd 8-3/4 lb flax day. 17 6 fine day. theoph polly hamlin came comd 7-1/2 lb flax. home day. 18 7 pleast. comd 6-1/2 lb flax. ice moovd ye river, jamd low mr brookss. 19 warm march. ye ice ye moove. breach discoverd ye dam ys morn. fammily attended devine servis except eph self. neighbor williams wife meeting, brooks davis also. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 20-26, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 20 26, 1786 20 2 clear warm. mrs foster came informd ye death susanna savage deceast last night. 21 3 snowd morn, cloudy day. river open people crost water fort western. corps susa savage interd 3 o/ three o/clok 45m pm mrs foster gone. 6 eving. jest receivd news ye death nathan runelss wife deceast ys morn. 22 4 home. ye girls washt. mr brooks drank tea us, mr foster also. enforms yt mr whiting winthrop dangerously sick. mr ballard mending ye dam. jono look loggs, came home unwell. poultist hand gave herb tea. remarkable apearance hemisphere light together streams read. 23 5 clear. home, mended ephms briches. mr ballard work ye saw mill. jono much better. boild linng warp. 24 6 home. mr ballard gone doct coneys till noone. mrs johnston came yongest child. polly hamlin went mr crages, returnd westward jese vasalboro. 25 7 clear. mr jonston came mr biges also. mr john st left home ys aftern, went mr cowens short webb wove. return calld densmoores, wife unwell. saw mill begn go ys day. 26 warm day. unwell ye fore noon. attended devine servis aftern calld colo norths desire see lady, shee unwell. returnd home went nr savages see dater hannah, shee unwell. hannah dolly gone neighr williamss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 27-Apr. 2, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 27 april 2, 1786 27 2 raind last night, snowd ys morn. [ye] dam broke ys morn. mr ballard brooks uneasyness. unwell. isaac savage breakfast phisick dafter hannah. ye northern light appears evinng. cyrus ephm ointing ye itch. 28 3 xx birth. eliab shaws son.xx frosty morn. finnisht kniting cyruss buskins, girls washt. calld eliab shaws half 5/o clock pm, wife travil, shee safely delivrd 6 7 son, 4th child. slept mr browks. 29 4 came home mr shaws 10h [morn]. mr cowen others brought loggs ye mill. went see polly hamlin, shee unwell. old mrs hardin sleeps 30 5 mrs hardin wnt mr ballard went attend town meeting. mr sual sent man attend hous hear mr pother speak. meeting went see mrs weston. shee unwell. rode hom, found mrss becke, lidia bisbee, polly hamlin polly adams ephm 7 years old ys day. 31 6 stormy day. mr ballard left home sebestakuk. mrs farly says famely sufering circumstances. cardid tow hannah dolly spin. 1 7 cloudy, cold day. thee ground frose. home carding tow. 2 began snow one o clok ys morn, tedious storm till 4 ys afternoon. mr ballard returnd. ye severest storm winter. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 3-12, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 3 12, 1786 3 2 clear cold. home. mr ballard returnd sebastacuk; informs son towns famely well except yr dafter patty. mrs straten put bed last week. town meeting town ys day. 4 3 clear day. home. breud. mr gillbreth came, helping pick mill. hannah dolly spunn tow. mr ballard reckoned james georg bolton. 5 4 clear, pleasant day. thee girls washt went mr bysbees. home ys day. mr ballard purchace loggs. 6 5 clear pleast, fast day. mrs weston doct coney also, dind. legg pork. mr ballard carried mrs weston home. home day. mr bisbe remoovd farm. 7 6 clear, snow fell last night. mrs wilms ys aftern. polly hamlin evinng. finisht cyruss gloves. home day. 8 7 clear cool. doubeld twisted tow yarn. susanna cowin brought home 13yds cloath shee wove mr burrows wido clearks son slept 9 clear, wind n.w. mr williams wife dind us. hannah dolly went home wh 10 2 clear, wind nw. mrs springer dind spun tow. 11 3 clear. spun tow brewd. yong mrs hardin drank tea. jono gon sebastakuc. mr ballard tended saw mill. 12 4 clear warm. went mr williamss. mrs pollard came home wt mr pollard supt mr savage, theoph polly also. began stockin fr mr balld. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 13-17, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 13 17, 1786 13 5 clear, pleast day. ye girls went mr westons. mr densmoore killd swine us wd 276 lb. spun thread. jono, danl life carrd bords brooks. jese work ys day. 14 6 clear pleast morn. mr voce work jese crage also. mrs williams faint turn. hannah went home home, spun thread. 15 7 clear. mr voce workd doubled thread. finisht brewing barril half beere. friend gardner sleeps yong men brought 57 loggs ye saw mill. mr ballard fell ye raft ye river. mr suell calld see wife, shee travill. mrs howard, mc master, voce bellchir assistants. 16 x birth thoms sualls son xxx clear pleast. mrs suell safe delivrd 3/o clok ys morn son. left comfortable returnd home 01/o clok; feele fatagued. attend divine servis. mr foster, yong gentleman stafford, ye state conneticut, performd. capt savages wife mrs fareley intermision. receivd fee july ye 1st mrs sewell. 17 2 loury day. mr ballard mr gardners put crank. mrs farley releaff. thee girls moovd beds stairs. thief whipt ye post stealing cloath fm mr ebenz farewell. home ys day. thee speckled cow calvd. today unwell, feel comfortable ys eving. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 18-24, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 18 24, 1786 18 3 birth. mr gillmans dafter. x rainy day. calld mr gillmans ye hook see wife travil, put safe bed 5 aftern fine dafter, ninth child. tarried night. receivd fee. 19 4 raind. returnd mr gillmans 11. dinner went mr westons colo norths. spalldings brot loggs ye crick let run polly savage credit 16 skeins spinng tow shee brot home day. 20 5 clear day. girls washing. mrs chamberlin georg boltons wife drank tea. mr hodges workd mr ballard dr coneys ys evening. danl went hook, brot home 6 galns rhum, 2 lb coffee, 5 lb sugar tobacco 1-1/4 bushl salt jos williams assisting wife travil last child. home ys day. 21 6 clear day. boild linning warp. calld mr bisbes see lidia sick ye disintary. lost shoe ye hors. 22 7 clear. esqr lovjoy dind oriah cleark son also. son town came polly hamlin betsy chever mr ballard mr pollards aftern. x. lent doct coney six pennywt half x x rhubarb x. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 25-29, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 25 29, 1786 25 3 rainy day. thee spalldings brogt loggs. 9 men dind besides family. sent 18 skeins tow chamberlins mr woodd. 26 4 clear. mr dexter nathan howard brought loggs us. calld winthp bill richardss wife, shee travil. arivd 5 o clok p.m. much fatagud. 27 5 birth wilm richards dafter. xx put mrs richards safe bed fine daughter 4 ys morn. left little break day. called see mrs branard unwell woodward allins wife low indeed. calld saml comings; rode hors saddle far fosters, walkd crages williams. dolly mr cragges. sent 21 skeins tow yn mrs chamln. benn brown wife bed much fatagud. 28 6 clear. mr ballard came home viewing land belonging mr pittss heirs. ye mills stopt going ye freshet. capt grant dind mr ned savages wife polly drank coffee son town sleeps 29 7 clear morn, raind aftern. mr dexter brot loggs. mr blanchard noah ye team workt mr williamss. wife aftern, drank coffee. rhubin moore sleeps ys night. informs ye death infant collins moors, twin month old. spun thread. light ye north evinng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 30-May 6, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 30 may 6, 1786 30 rainy day. ye revd mr foster preacht attend divine servis, went mrs westons interm. mrs suelle sent salv. sent 1/2 oz. polly hamlin sleeps ys night. 1 2 showry day. hannah gone help polly h.. town meeting. doct coney chosen represent ys town ye general cort; mr bullin grandjuren. mrs ellis informs yt mrs allin low. ye northern ligt appears ys eving. sent 32 skeins tow mrs chamberlin. mr butlin mr taylor dind 2 3 pleast. home. mr dexter son sleep dolly set three current bushes. 3 4 x birth. mr hoveys dafter.x calld 15 muinits 12 o/clok mrs hovey, shee travill safely deliverd 8 ys morn daughter, wt 10-1/2 lb. left comfortable; got home eleven. receivd 6/ shilling. due medisn 2/s. went see mrs suall afternn, found able houshold work. went bed early evening. ye girls washt scourd. 4 5 birth. mr norriss son. calld thee hook mrs norris, shee travil. put safe bed son 1/o clock aftern. returnd home four. mr cowen ephm setling wt mr ballard. due ballance 3/8. receivd 6/ mr norris, 2 remains due. mrs chamberlin sent cloath, 31-1/2 yards. polly savage brot home 7 skeins 5 knots tow yarn. 5 6 x birth. joseph fosters son. x calld 6/o clok mrs foster travil safely deliverd fine son 8-3/4 o clo[k] ys evining. returnd 2/. left mrs cowin lidia, aron billy sent hous, sleep ys night. 6 7 clear. mr ballard mr savagess. hannah gone mr fosters, children went home. danl boltons wife polly savage source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 7-11, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 7 11, 1786 7 rainy day. attind worship. mr hamlin directly ye westwd. brt letters broth collins one josiah kingsbury. dind fine legg cornd pork stufft green herbs gardin. rains part ys evinng. paid polly savage yt owd yesterd order capt davis answrd. 8 2 rainy day. polly hamlin mr reed peny blackman also, drank tea wh us. mr blanchard went georg browns. cyrus went ye hook barl flower. town mett gave ye revd mr foster call settle mr ballard went mr wm gardners monney due got none. home ys day. 9 3 clear day. bakd flour bread pumkin pies. broth moore mr hamlin mrs williams drank tea wh mr ballard nr savage went see farm. jono, cowen ye bobinss makeing fence savage boltons farm. noah work. home ys day. 10 4 clear day. went mr fosters, calld williamss. ye girls washt went see polly. jono ephm gone 66 loggs wh wt adrift. 11 5 birth. james moors son.x calld 4/o clok brian fletchers, wife unwell, got better women went home. old mrs fletcher went roberts aftern. calld hast james moors wife, travill. shee safe delivrd son 10 evinng. calld mrs norriss took cold, adminnistred something gave relief. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 12-17, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 12 17, 1786 12 6 came home attendid mr moor. receivd fee pay medecin. (arivd 4/ ys morn). mr ballard doct coneys makeing rates yesterd ys day. jono found loggs came home last evinng. sherebiah town slept polly hamlin ys day, eliphlt unwell. mill lies still ys night. 13 7 showers ys day. sheribh town killd veal us. lent side colo north, wt 28-3/4 lb. went mr crages williamss. eliphelet better, tending mill ys evinng. 14 pleast day. preaching town. mr hamlin dind hr. polly ye girls went mr williamss. mr brown, emerson 15 2 x birth. savage boltons son. x clear pleast. calld 11 o/clok savage boltons, shee wife travil. shee safe delivrd 3 aftern fine son. oxen attached drove away 7. walkt home. jonn swapt away hors mr sleeper. mr gillbreath sleeps mr ballard doctr coneys makeing rates. mr blanchard work us. rachel faulh ys day. ye girls washt bakt washt floars. 16 3 clear day. whitening cloath. home. hannah fell new hors. betsy chever hannah north 17 4 clear. mr blanchard sett north yarmoth, gillbreath home. old mr smyle mr william gardner, also polly hamlin sally peirce. home ys day. mr ballard 61 years age ys day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 18-24, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 18 24, 1786 18 5 clear day. brewd barll 1/2 beer. mrs coy jenny cool calld going see mother. mr crages shop raisd. home. wm gardner says lost [gunny]. mare varsalboro yesterday. 19 6 home. mrs williams thee girls went mr craggs. brot 3 pair shoes 6/ pr pair. mr ballard sowd flax went doctr coneys. 20 7 home. mr ballard benn brown junr furrowing. jono cowen gone help fammely river. james moore informs yt mrs norris unwell still. 21 cloudy. jono cowen hannah dolly went esqr petingels meeting. walked mr williamss, found ym well. mr smith 22 2 thee girls washt. helpt hous work. mr blanchard returnd fm yarmouth. mr wilms lee. little rain fell. mr savage came winthp, informs ye death widdow allin, daughter mr hopkins. 23 3 mr benn edwards 3 men charlton dind wrote broth waters mr ballard planted corn ys day. mare lent go varsalboro. 24 4 spun 14 knots thread. mr ballard went broth moores, heard yt doct barton removd winslow. mare returnd. mr toby sandage mr bisbee, polly sally drank tea source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 25-29, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 25 29, 1786 25 5 home, hous work spun thread. hannah unwell. mr ballard went hook. neighbour williams wife dolly went savage boltons needles. danniel robbins unwell night. 26 6 home, washt potatoes. polly savage isaac workt mr ballard went hook wh raft bords, 8000, put bord mr tobys vessel frait boston. tarried night. 27 7 home. eliphlit cleand seller. mr ballard came ye hook, went mr bullins. wm kannadies wife, paid owed polly h., b. peirce drank coffee. son town came sleeps ys night. danniel robbins unwell. made catnip tea. mr blakman asa mason sett crosing ye river; lost corn articles, savd drowning. james bolton took ym 28 raind ys forenoon. mr town dexter left aftern. polly sally, mr wil[nin] wife mr savage dind wh us. lethgo, davis, brooks, theo h., jesse burten ys day. home till 11 evn calld bed mr pattins. went foot brookss, water. 29 2 x birth. pattins dafter. put mrs pattin bed dafter 4 morn. came water far daviss store, walkt home. arivd :01: o clok morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 30-Jun. 3, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 30 june 3, 1786 30 3 raind. mr ballard paid blanchard due servis dismist breakfasted went ye mill began quarril jono made outcry gave self famely great surprise. sint mr ballard home savages. mr savage streeter came makeing pair trouses ephm. sherebiah town came hr ys aftern, sleeps mrs wodward calld going home ye hook. 31 4 election boston. unwell. sherebiah went bound sebastak. hannah dolly gone ys aftern see polly h. danl boltons wife, sally bolton polly savg ys day. mr ballard surveying road makeing plan. 1 5 breud barril half beer. planted 2 ears corn mrs hatch made present ephm. mr ballard went pollards. went nr williams. charls cleark paid 9/ due attending wife medicin. 2 6 birth. isaac cowens dafter.x calld ys morn 8/o clok isaac cowens see wife, arivd 1 pm. found safe delivd daughter, born betwixt six seven o clok. left 3. returnd home 7, much fatagud. 2 falls hors lamd polly sally came home. 3 7 hot. old mrs cowin dind. husband card jale debt. mr ballard gone cabese town meeting. maid sheet wed gardin. thunder shower. mr lee brooks mrs shaw. wm keenady see wife. lame go. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 9-13, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 9 13, 1786 9 6 clear cool. mrs foster wt home. mrs gardy came hr. mrs kenady martha drank tea. polly h. spun shoe thread. mr ballard pounalboro coart. 10 7 birth. x georg boltons son. x cool morn. calld 4/o clok georg boltons wife travil, put safe bed fine son 11 o clok. returnd home ys aftern. mrs gardy calld mr boltons. jenny coole drank tea. mr ballard came coart. 11 clear morn. mr brown went hast doct colman eldist son sick. went home 12 o clok see find ill. returnd home sun set, found sherebiah, betsy polly town james stacpool informd mr hathaway drowned last week taken interd day. ephm cowin came ys evinng work mr ballard one month. 12 2 raind ys morn. friends set cabesy, mr ballard pounalboro. spun shoe thread. mrs weston afternn, mr stickney also. mr parmer sebastacuk. dolly polly town eph boltons. 13 3 clear. howd beens cucumbers yard ye brook spun sh thread. took walk eph polly far mr williamss. dolly wed gardin. jono cowen set 400 plants bought mrs bolton. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 14-20, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 14 20, 1786 14 4 home. savage boltens wife polly savage polly hamlin girls washt. little isaac savage rode hors plough half ye day. 15 5 clear. home. mrs bisbee lidia went ye field. isaac savage coart. mrs chamberlin mrs clough. mr ballard went ye hook stors mr bonny brt boston. 1 barril pork, 1 rhum, 01 lb chocolot. eph went 16 6 clear. home. bakt flower bread mad soap. mr lee hannah workt polly hmln. dolly polly town went mr crages. mr foster brot pair shoes polly cyrus givs 17 7 rainy day. mr ballard lee settld lee gave note 11=13:7 ballance. home, hoad ye peas aftern. mrs bolton 1/2 lb tea plants. 18 birth. mr gordins dafter. x. receivd thing. cloudy forenn. calld 8 o/clok ys morn mr gordins, wife travil. found put bed old mrs fletcher dafter. calld mr willims return, found unwell. tarried till towards eving, left comfortable. mr lee evng polly hamlin. 19 2 home. mr chamberln workt uriah cleark wife son mrs wilms drank tea daniel robbins also. broth moore sent nails rhum. 20 3 mr ballard went ye hook. went williams. levy moore david smily informs sister barton dilivd son last sunday, twelvth child 5 son. briant fletcher arm broke fall tree. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 27-30, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 27 30, 1786 27 3 rainy day. mr ballard went ye hook. mr gill breath came helping dress ye mill. mr bullin informs yt ebn churchs wife delivd son daughter last weak. shere town sleeps informs john emry sabastacook much hurt saw mill, life expetd. likewise yt daughter town unwell got comfortable. 28 4 clear. mr ballard cowen workt ye road south girls washt went williamss. son town came mr holloway mended tea pot. gillbrh went mr cobb son came bed excpt self. borrowd quarter veal mr brook wt 15-1/2 lb. 29 5 clear. son town jonathan went cobese, returnd ys afternn. brot betsy informd yt young man fell ye streem almost drowned, revived. mrss brown farwel yt emrys leg like ganger. broth towns wife delivd ye 27 inst dafter ill, danger feaver. also yt ye wo fitch son young womn swetlands, bets tarr name, daft. 30 6 clear day. polly hamlin dind mr leighton, son town betsy. john shaw workt us isaace savage ye 3d. girls gone mr westons ys afternn. mrs williams towards eving. apple pies. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 1-5, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 1 5, 1786 1 7 clear day. mr ballard, son town, jono ephn cowen gone asist broth moore rais hous. girls went mr westons. polly hamlin came home ym, sleeps hr. mr sual paid 6/ attending wife travil last child. capt springer paid 4/ servis, remaind due. mr hollowy sleeps ys night. anavercery ye death dater dorothy. 2 hott day. son town, betsy polly left home. jono went wh dind veal hazlet. mr brooks, theops, polly hamln sally pre aftern. capt nichols directly oxford, informs friends well. daftr campbel 7th son. 3 2 clear. girls washt. mr ballard wint mr sualls forenn, town meating aftern. mrs copelin mrs hodges feel unwell. cowen moed ye gardin. pickt cotten. 4 3 cloudy day. mr ballard 12 men wrkd ye road ye hill north hous. mr smily dind. jono came home son towns, well. bakd quartr veal began spin cottne. jono brot home herrin fish fm towns. 5 4 clear. mr ballard workd home. went mr williamss. mrs page james slacpool sleeps anaversery death daugt martha deceast 1769 aged 8 years 2 months 28 days. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 16-22, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 16 22, 1786 16 clear, hott day. attended ye public worship aftern, bakt bisquits jono carry sea. polly hamlin mr collar also winslow. brot wife oldest daughter varsalboro see doct williams. 17 2 clear. wido foster oliver, epm stevens pamela barton dind mr stevens paid 6/8 attending wife travil ye 26 last february. went ys aftern see mrs copelin, met mr pollards, spent ye afternn mr ballard cowan went carry raft boards capt huskinss vesl. jonathan gone board bound boston. 18 3 began rain twelv, stormy aftern. ye girls spinng cottne. ye collic night. mr ballard pits town. 19 4 cloudy morn. polly hamln doctr barton breakfasted us. began hill corn. 20 5 clear. briant fletcher dind wido howard, mrs ferwell, mrs betsy polly howard afternn. went mr williamss sun sett. rains ys evinng. 21 6 clear hott. mrs coy breakfasted dind home, gatherd herbs. ye girls went mr williamss. heard sally fletcher unwell. mrs fletcher sent sheeps wool, 1-1/2 lb. 22 7 mr williamss ys day. polly fletchr sister sally. dolly came rode new side saddle brot home ys day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 23-27, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 23 27, 1786 23 hott day. attended divine servise aftern. mr foster delivird discoarce math 25/41ver, shour servis. mrs woodward nbr savage supt us. isaac cowen enformd ye death susanah sautbe deceast last weak. doct coney returnd ye rhubarb borrowd 1 penny wt 20 grains plus. lucy town one year old day. 24 2 clear warm. spun cleand ye seller. went mr porters wool got none, went savage boltons georges, infant, unwell hannah poisaned face leggs. 25 3 clear hott. bakt. polly fletchr bakt mrs williams. spun cottin. ye girls went pique blue berries. boiled fine linning warp, 32 skeins. 26 4 clear. revd mr foster dind spun cottne. went mr williamss. polly fletcher wint nursing receivd pair shoes 2/ mr beeman attending wife medisen, savage bolton 1-1/2 lb cottne servis done 27 5 clear. carded cottne cutt aulders maid sort fence part round yard mill pond, calld eliab shaws see children, sick ye canker rash. hannah north, tammy sally cox brot quarter lamb, wt 7-1/2 lb. polly bisbe adams day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 2-7, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 2 7, 1786 2 7 home. benjamin white brot pair flat irons, prs 6/, fee, 2/ remains, due remidies. dolly 14 years age day. parthena barton mr ballard mett ye select gentlemen mr pollards fore noon. 3 clear. calld capt savages see wife sett night. mr ballard went winthrop meeting. 4 2 came home capt savages. left comfortable. betsy thomas better. see mrs weston. mrs turner babe. mr ballard hook busins mr vaun. 5 3 rainy day. home. jonathan voialant. seasd feaver universally pained. put bed, applyd onions feet, gave tees promote sweting. set wt till 1/o/clok. 6 4 clear. jonothan much better. mr balrd gone ye hook. mr weston wife, mrs pollard coy, drank tea mr smyle sleeps hannah dolly mr westons, hanh polly hamlin. 7 5 clear. mr ballard gone ye hok surve[ying]. mrs porter ys afternn. mr jones ezekl leighton sleep made syrrup mrs weston. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 8-16, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 8 16, 1786 8 6 clear. gatherd biens. gillbrh dind mrs powers, cate scott hannh fuller drank coffee. wilm wife mrs bisbee lidia. 9 7 clear. gatherd seeds hous work. cyrus hannah went son towns. jones, winthrop, dind mr ballard came home night. 10 hott day. calld capt savages evinng, watcht. cyrus returnd towns. 11 2 cyrus 30 years old ys day. came home fort western. dolly washt. mr ballard surveying mr vaun, gone ys night. 12 3 rainy day. mr ballard came home. mr luis nathl low breakfasd dolly spun wool. 13 4 cloudy morn. calld see mrs foster, find unwell. bathd throat, drest blisters far coold. dolly unwell, returnd. bathd throat home still. mr ballard gone ye hook mr vauns business, returnd ys evinng. 14 5 clear. mr ballard gone ye hook mrs pollard mrs hodges drank coffee. clarisa barton sleeps jono unwell, sleeps bed ye fire. dolly unwell also. 15 6 clear. jono better. mr ballard doct coneys fore noon, making plan aftern. dolly clarisa went capt sualls. shee went home towards night. polly hamlin sleeps dolly. feel unwell. 16 7 clear. mr ballard ye hook. jono gon sandy river. jonathan wiman ye westwd. brot letters friends. polly went home. saml stephens wife winthp mill[]. mr wiman informs yt mr streater, preacher, lately departed life, left lg family. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 17-22, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 17 22, 1786 17 clear. calld see asa mason, foot wounded. drest returnd. calld see mr benn brown sick, youngest child unwell also. came home, wt see neighr williams, unwell. dollys throat soar yet. 18 2 cloudy day. mrs densmr came workt feel unwell, dolly also. mr ballard makeing plan. doct coney let half oz. harts horn 2 stiptic pouds, prs 1/. [tom jonsn] came see mr willms, spits blood. 19 3 rainy day. mrs densmore went mr westons sewing silk ys morn. shee went home evinng. went capt savages. mr ballard maid plan. 20 4 clear. came home aftern, found dolly better. polly taylor lucy porter doct coney mr browns, says poorly. mr ballard ye hook, carrid thee plann mr vaun, receivd pay. came home ys evinng. jono returnd sandy river, informs yt mrs eatons father deseast last wk interd sunday last. 21 5 clear. went see mr williams, poorly. mrs gardy came afternn. 22 6 clear. mrs gardy went dolly ascisted far crages. mr ballard turnd flax. ephm helpt. dolly workt polly h. afternn. cut sage, gave mr bullin mr usher /8 x worth salve. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 23-28, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 23 28, 1786 23 7 called early ys morn see lidia savage, ill. gave urin honney liquirsh put plaster stomach. went aftern, find relievd. went see neighr williams, find better. hear mr brown mending. 24 clear. home. jono unwell. gave portion rhuburb. killd chikin, made broth. sherbiah town came left ye famely well 25 2 clear. great frost ys morn. shere town went cobese, mr ballard joseph stacpools surveying. cyrus left home son towns 1/o clok. jono tended ye mill. unwell today. 26 3 clear warm. mr smyle mr ballard paid four dollars due butter last novemr ye 12 day. mr balld went land river. mr williams varsalboro mrs gardy sleeps polly hamln also. made syrrup mrs weston. cate williams milk. gillbreath sleeps 27 4 clear warm. mrs gardy went cyrus hannah came home. hear yt moses whites infant departed life ye 25th inst. 28 5 cloudy warm. went see mr brown, find low, exercised wh cough. shower evng. polly sally mr crage ye girls returnd mr bisbes ye rain. mr patten brot pair turnd pumps made mr cain. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 29-Oct. 2, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 29 october 2, 1786 29 6 x birth. x x ezra hodges son. xx clear. ye girls washt. mr ballard workt ye rode ye mill. mr vaun hous work sowd seeds. calld mr pollard 6/ pm mrs hodges. shee travil safe delvd fine son 11/. wint hast mrs brown travil, arivd midnit. 30 7 birth. georg browns son. mrs brown calld women safe delivrd noon son wd 11-1/4 lb. went dinner see capt savages wife, find able set returnd home half 6/pm. find mr williams wife went bed eight. 1 1 birth. daniel savig juners son. xx calld 3 ys morn daniel savages wife travil. shee safe deliverd two aftern son. left child cleverly arivd home 6/, went see mrs hodges, shee well could wish. calld see betsy chever well. returnd home 9. mr crage polly thoph evinng. 2 2 calld 6/ ys morn see mrs hodges, found ill. adminstred clister remedies gave relief. returnd hom 5/, found clars barton dolly shee went mr crages see hannah. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 3-9, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 3 9, 1786 3 3 clear. clarrisa went. jono came watching mr brown, says better; hannah watchng wh mrs hodges, shee better. went mr porters visit, mr longs. rhuben cowen 1 oz. salv self 1 oz. saml jackson, pay november 17, jackson paid salv. 4 4 home till 7/o clok calld benn browns see son nathanl. sett ys night. rested comfortable. raind. 5 5 rainy. came home mr browns. shee gave piece beef. brely family arivd camp last evinng. girls washing. mr foster two brothers aftern. polly sally mr ballard theohph setled acounts. 6 6 south wind rain. unwell. 7 7 birth.x mr porters son.xx unwell still. mrs brown sister higins isaac herdin 1 oz. burn salv, price 1/ pd. girls brueing scouring ye puter. saw mill gone ys day. calld mr porters wife half seven eving. shee travil put safe bed son half 9/o clok. tarried night. fee recievd. 8 clear. mr porters ys fore noon, attended divine servis aftern, agreeably entertaind discoarce delivrd revd john foster paxton. 9 2 clear. hous work foren, went lecter aftern. calld see mrs porter, find exercised wh pain feaver. came home see afairs. returnd see 1 0c ys evng. set left comfortable ys morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 10-15, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 10 15, 1786 10 3 clear day. came mr porters sun rise, mr westons, pollards, brookses. bt black handkercf dutchmn, case knives forks mr brooke. much labour perform ys day. sister williams came 1/o clok. jonn killd steer. cyrus went ye hook earthen ware. mr pollard gave dollar left man winthp. 11 4 clear pleast. revd isaac foster ordaind town. famely attended except self ephm. mr fuller, doct warren brother town supt gillbreath went home aftern. 12 5 clear pleast. shere town young mr howard breakfasted. mr bullin, hopkins wives, mrs emerson dind. mr ballard went mr pollards, ye girls mr westons. derias ballard came mother, left home two o/clok. 13 6 clear. eliab shaw workt us. mr brown dind mr davis came ye shingles. bled catt applid ye blood gave relief. doct lee mr ballard went capt suels. hannah makeing skirt. polly sally drank tea wh us. 14 7 clear. eliab shaw work, benr brown junr also. mr davis yt. jono capt pages, informd yt mr shepherd departed ys life ys morn. 9 years ys day since arivd john joness landing ye farm. 15 clear day. stayd home. davis hear yt, doct coney came see meeting, advisd go ye salt water. 9 years morn sinc went mr joness live. silas lee mr brookss, polly sleeps polly dudly sally ys evinng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 16-21, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 16 21, 1786 16 2 clear day. polly went home. mr davis went mr bullin. mr ballard takeing valluation. ye girls went home 12 o clok take leav polly hamlin, shee bound oxford. wrote letter deacon davis, 1 broth collins 1 sister waters, sent carried mr hamlin. bakt mr brooks bakt mins pies. ben brown workt 17 3 cloudy rain. benn brn timy woodwd work. mr ballard doct coneys makeing rates. mr hamlin polly left mr crages bound oxford. mr woodwd eat breakfst 18 4 clear. timy workt mr ballard doct coneys. mr woodward sleeps hr. 19 5 clear. mr ballard doct coneys. josh bullin rachel faught mrs brown calld sally peirce spin shoe thrd, drank tea. ye girls washt washt kitchen. piqut wool. benn day. tim 1/2 ye day. calld see mrs bent half 10 ys evinng. went water arivd 12o clok, found unwell. 20 6 mrs bents. shee continued poorly till noon. slept mrs wiman, mrs jackson wh mrs bent, rested better shee since shee unwell. 21 7 fine morn. left mrs bent, came home water bill wing charls cox. mrs williams bake, drank tea. benn timmy workt ys day yesterday. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, november 6 13, 1786 6 2 clear morn, cloudy afternn. came home mr springers. left cleverly arivd home 12 o clok. calld 2 pm mr woodwards see mr blakman unwell. came home 6. girls went mr westons. mr ballard went ye hook foren, revd mr fosters aftern. clarisa barton 7 3 mrs north foren. went far ye little brook mr ballard workt t meeting hous hill ye rhode. williams piqut mill, wife mr ballard danl robbins setled yr acounts came even. clarisa went home. 8 4 home. ye girls washt. mrs savage kitty mrs woodward seisd collic night, severe shock. hannah calld tend 9 5 weak free pain. girls gon mr porters ys evinng. cyrus went mr carrs cloath, carried corn. 10 6 cloudy rain. home. mr ballard dicy finisht husking corn. 11 7 clear pleasant. men finisht bringing thee corn. home mending hoes jonothan. 12 clear windy. famely attended worship except ephm self. hear mrs weston left boston yesterday meeting ys aftern. mr harriss son obedih deseaat yesterd. 13 2 x birth. isaac hardins son. x clear. calld see isaac hardings wife travil. shee safe delivrd 3 oclok pm son. remains obediah harris inter[d] aftern. stay hardins ys night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 14-23, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 14 23, 1786 14 3 clear morn. came home hardins 1 oclok, iminediately calld see mrs weston, shee unwell. aplyd blister, batht feet, put back plaster, returnd home evinng. left little easyer. left mrs hardin comfortable. shee helpt bed made. girls helpt mrs pollard quilt bed quilt. lidia bisbe noone. 15 4 snowd. jothn suall built stove mill. brother moor saml comings dind home, finisht makeing apron house work. pamila finisht spining woolin pease. 16 5 clear. home. mr woodward brot us swine wt 70 lb. wife carried jemmy weston home ys evinng. mr cobb son sleep mr ballard brt home 1 lb tea. 17 6 snowd. home. mr ballard wint ye hoock. mr lee hannah burnt thumb. scourd woolin yarn. 18 7 clear cold. mr ballard bankd ye hous. work house. bakt pumpkin pies. hannah spun thread. dicky went home. 19 betsy welch bn ys day. clear. mr ballard attended worship deacon emersons. crost ye river thee ice. rest famely staid home. eliphelit salve legg brusd. 20 2 snow fell ys day. doubled twisted 14 knotts thread. mr harris dind mr leighton sleeps. 21 3 clear. mended cyruss coat ephms trousers. mr ballard gott wood. dicky came 22 4 clear. mr ballard gone survay mr senter. betsy chever home. snowd night. 23 5 clear. went see mrs williams, breast soar. bunker ferwell saw hors fall river three times ye fort wharf. 4th attempt got river. snow fell night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 24-30, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 24 30, 1786 24 6 clear. hous work mending. benjamn branard dind mr ballard came home. cyrus carried 1 bushl wheat 1 indien meel mr carr. 25 7 clear. home mending cloths. mr ballard caried woolin yarns mrs edson weave cloath mr densmoors [make]. cold night. 26 birth. mr blakmans son. x bitter cold morn. rose day break, shaking fitt pain head. attend public worship. pamele staid home. calld see mrs blakman travil. left home sun sett, got much fatagud. found put safe bed mrs ellis, tarried night. mr blakman gave 6/8. 27 2 came home 11/ o clok. left cleaverly. went capt sualls thomas sualls revd mr fosters spent evinng esqr howards. mr ballard came yr accompany home. 28 3 exceeding cold windy. mr georg brown froos ears. put salve pamela 18 years old day. mending old garments. welches wife delivrd dafter 19th inst. mrs fletcher operator. 29 4 cold. finisht fingering mr ballards glovs, becky wiman sally peirce 30 5 snowd. home. mr ballard went doct coneys. dolly mr westons needles. patty savage married mr gordin winthrop day. saml brown dind source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 1-8, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 1 8, 1786 1 6 clear cold. mrs brown mrs hygin mr ballard went hear snells trial abuseing mr bullin high way. laid bonds. finisht futting pair hoes dyky. 2 7 clear day. mrs foster dind began leggin went mr westons. shee made settlement tradeing bookt, 2/1 due mr ballard done little toward fixing ye house. 3 clear day. attended divine servis. revd mr foster unable perform. deacon emerson officiated room. anne web nabe pollard evinning. 4 2 clear day. ye girls washt. poll savage home kniting. mr ballard went revd mr fosters, finds mending, lady unwell. mr hart winslow evng. 5 3 snow storm. home. pamela finisht makeing shift kni[t] hannah spun cotten. dolly hous work. 6 4 clear cold. mr ballard spent day capt sualls. home, finisht kniting ye first leggin mr ballards. densmoore brot mr ballards coat home. dicky trousers cutt 7 5 snowd. home kniting. informd ezra hodges gone left famely. known 8 6 clear part day. mr ballard went revd mr fosters. home. pamela finisht dickys alls. informd capt howard got safe ys river. cow loos town. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 9-15, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 9 15, 1786 9 7 cold day, snowd night. mr edson brought woolin cloath hom. mr maggs mrs brown dind killed swine wd 109 lb. mr ballard bt 3-3/4 lb candles mr weildon /40 pr pound. 10 severe storm snow. mr ballard went thee meating hous. revd mr foster came person, preaching. 11 2 clear cold day. excesive cold night. mr ballard spent evinning capt sualls, doct coney also. washing done day killd 6 fowls. 12 3 clear part ye day. snows 11 evinng. excesive cold till evinng. finisht knitting mr ballards leggins mended dickys stockings ephms trousers. hannah hous work, girls turning cotten sheets mending. 13 4 cloudy. weather moderated. home, fited ephms leggins. girls bakt pies. david learned supt dolly went mr westons got 1 lb butter, 2 oz ginger, 2 oz. spice, 1 oz. pepir. snow evening, raind morning. 14 5 clear. thanksgiving day. went meeting calld colon howards ascist mrs pollard lay son james. mrs betsy, polly jack sick. watcht. doct colman unwel. death james howard. 15 6 clear pleast. james howard interd aftern. returnd home evinng. went bed early, collik night, little rest. left polly mending. mrs betsy jack sick. mrs fairwel stays night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
