title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 16-21, 1786 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 16 21, 1786 16 7 clear pleasant till towards evinng. unwell, attended collick pain, able perform business. mr ballard gone meddow hay. ephm ye pond wood. husband got load hay, came home much fatagud. brusd shins crust blistered. hear esqr howard ill turn last night. 17 moderate foggy, raind evinng. took aloes, oprated. feel better. georg brown ys eveng, enforms sick colo howards. sickly time ys town. jack howard deceast. 18 2 ephm severe fitt. clear pleast. free collic pain. informd jacky howards death. went attend funeral, reason esqr howards taken ill, calld tarried till 9 o clok cyrus came informd yt ephm fitt. returnd home great hast led cyrus york. found little son revivd. left ye esqr comfortable, betsy also. 19 3 clear. ephm well usual. mr ballard cyrus piqut mill. home. begun epm stockin. hear esqr howard better, mrs betsy also. anevercary marriage 32 years since. 20 4 clear pleast. went see mrs porter. home eving. neighr savage wife brother supt 21 5 clear pleast. calld see moses pollard, unwell. saw sherebh town, sons family well. revd mr foster lady dind drank tea mrs weston. mr ballard mr fosters ys evinng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, december 22 30, 1786 22 6 clear day cloudy eving. home. mr ballard went hay, gone mr pollards ys evinng. moses better. snows 9 evinng. 23 7 clear day. snowd eving. capt page mr ballard went capt sualls. finisht ephms stockins. james weston carried going home. john church says son sick. mr porter came home ys day. 24 snowd noon. men went meeting. cold windy. self girls tarried home. 25 2 clear cold. home. mr ballard carried load wood mr pollards old hous revd mr foster. made four night caps. 26 3 clear day. lidia foster mr ballard mr woodwards, browns capt sewalls. home. 27 4 clear pleast. home knitting. parthena barton mr ballard carried load wood revd mr foster, remoovd mr sewalls day. 28 5 birth. mrs x bents son. x clear. calld see mrs weston, unwell. calld mr jacksons, mrs bent travil. child born arivd. put safe bed. set night. 29 6 returnd home 12/ o clok, find hannah unwell, throat sore. set till mid night. jacks brother sleeps mr ballard making slead. 30 7 cloudy. snowd night. went mr porters pollards. david arivd. mr ballard gone cutt wood mr foster. williams true dresing flax calld capt sualls wife travil, got 7 o clock evinng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 17-24, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 17 24, 1787 17 4 cloudy morn. see mr savages childn, find much levy moore mr smyle 18 5 clear cold. began make soap. revd mr foster going attend funeral nathanl runels child. desired go see lady child unwell; went. calld see mr hodges ballard came home found james eunice stackpool [echabod pitts] also. 19 6 clear cold. mr stackpool left aftern. mr savage calld lidia, mr brown wife left revivd. mr gillbreath 20 7 snowd cold. gillbreath helpt pique mill. cyrus unwell. home. mr ballard got wood went revd mr fosters. 21 cloudy ys foren, snowd aftern eving. ye girls staid home. mr savages children mending. gillbh yet. 22 2 cloudy cold day, clear eving. combd flax. gillbrth went mr alin 1/2 oz salv. salvina hatch sleeps mr ballard doct coney, girls mr crages. 23 3 clear morn, snowd aftern, eving. home kniting mrs fosters stockin. mr ballard doct coneys. two cragges keeping yr teem. 24 4 clear. went see mr savages child, tarried night. mr ballard came doct coneys, carried sled. finisht stockins. man woolwich sleept ys night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 25-29, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 25 29, 1787 25 5 clear cold. came home slead, fited things lidia savage; sent dolly mr ballard gone see thoms sewall converse concerning ills acused spreading revd mr foster, returnd satisfaction. 26 6 x. birth. nathan swettland son. x. calld nathan swettlands wife 1/o clok morn, found safe deliverd son 2. james hinkleys wife operator. returnd home ten noon. snows. receivd 6/ mr swettland trouble medicin. ys third child. calld dusk mr savages see lidia sick. set night, mrs chamberlin also. 27 7 cloudy snow. mrs savages al day. child little revivd. old mrs savage came watch. mr ballard mr pollards tryal case revd mr foster sewalls, ajournd till monday next 8/o clok. pamela hannah gone see sick child. 28 clear cold. attended devine servis went see lidia savage. mr brown wife mr faught wife also. 29 2 clear morn. went mrs brown hear ye trial capt sewall thomas sewall defameing ye revd mr isaac foster. found gilty find laid bonds. went see mrs foster cort source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 30-Feb. 5, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 30 february 5, 1787 30 3 clear pleast. calld see mr savages dafter, find low. set night. shee pukt considerable quantity phlegm seems revivd. 31 4 clear. came home noone. left brothers sister found son town informs little dafter unwell still, thee rest family well. 1 5 clear morn. son town went home. calld mr savages, gave lidia senna. snowd evinng. set night. 2 6 x birth. benn blaks dafter. x. clear. came home dolly went mr ballard unwell. jono dicky gone meddow. went bed 7 calld 10 go mrs blake travil. shee deliverd dafter half 11 evnn. tarried night. cold. 3 7 pleast. returnd mr blakes mr hewen, went directly mr savages. lidia expird half 1/o clok. pamela hannah came home 4. feel much fatagud. left mr ned savage wife 4 exceeding cold. revd mr moore preacht. self girls staid home. enoch crage polly taylor evinng. eph[e] tooth aik. 5 2 cold, snowd. attended funeral lidia savage. john better. mrs savage unwell. dolly went ye morning. deacon emerson maid prayer. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 6-14, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 6 14, 1787 6 3 clear cold. went see mrs shaw knitt pamelas stockin. mr ballard mr pollards. 7 4 clear, moderate. went carry filling sally bolton. revd mr foster mr ballard carried meet cyrus sause selves. dolly carried stockins home. 8 5 xx birth. james savages son. xx. calld half six morn james savages wife travil. shee safely deliverd six eving fine son, first child. severe cold, snowd night. tarried night. 9 6 clear. came home, rode slead. calld see mr porters infant, unwell, gave senna. 10 7 clear. calld see seth williamss youngest child georg browns children. calld porters, child better. 11 cloudy cold. dolly gone meeting. snowd little. mr runels wife ephm cowen supt rains fast night. 12 2 clear moderate. mr stackpool lady sleep mr brooks weston 13 3 clear. mr stackpool lady went capt sewall mrs foster also. mr ballard went lot, finds ellis treaspast. home kniling mittin. cyrus williamss. son towns little daughter better, rest family well. 14 4 cloudy, snowd sun sett. unwell, throat sore, went bed nine. calld half ten mr read see wife travil. raind fast went almost night. old mrs savage mrs stone attendants. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 15-21, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 15 21, 1787 15 5 x birth. mr reads son. x. mrs read deliverd son four morn. cleard pleasant. calld see mrs savage, find poorly. mrs shaw, shee remains low. returnd home half ten ys morn, receivd 6/ mr read fee. 2/ remains x due medicin. 16 6 clear. unwell. neigh savage wife evinng. 17 7 clear. mr ballard gone mr pollards meet capt sewall public business. mr lapham pitts town herbs wife unwell. 18 clear. went meeting aftern. mr floid brot note thanks wives delivry. calld see mr childs. mrs becky wiman tincture mr howard sebastacuk. 19 2 clear, pleasant morn. cloudy night, snowd little misted. mrs daylor husband unwell. old mrs whealor polly wall polly savage killed swine afternn. mr williams helping pique mill. mr howard went ephm cowen 20 3 snow storm. calld see mrs reed, unfitt go went. find exercised pain sore throat. returnd dusk, feel unwell. seen 52 years day. 21 4 clear cold. unwell. mr cumings drest 10 lb flax jonns acount. began linnen stockin lady foster. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 22-Mar. 2, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 22 march 2, 1787 22 5 clear cold. knitt day. dicky brot 21-1/4 yds cloath sally boltons shee wove 23 6 clear pleast. unwell, face painfull. eat haste puding water breakfast bean broth fr dinner, went bed 8. rested poorely. 24 7 x birth. elias taylors daughter. xx recieved nothing. clear pleast. calld sun rise go see elias taylors wife travil. met mesage informing shee safely delivd. returnd home feel comfortable days past. pamela dolly went see mrs foster, shee unwell. mr hersey eving. 25 cloudy snow. calld see joseph fosters wife daughter, find poorly. returnd found ephm lambd. 26 2 cloudy warm. revd mr foster says lady unwell. deacon emerson mr woodward also. mr ballard gett mr savage asist makeing kirb mr fosters well. home. 27 3 snow storm. mr ballard dicky went early git timber mr fosters well kirb, gott load wood. home kniting prepareing pills. girls washt. mr [read] wife mending. 28 4 cloudy, little snow. mr ballard mr fosters. combd 10 lb flax. pamila finisht skirt jackat. joseph foster 1-1/2 oz tinctr, /9d. carrid 20 pills mr childs. 1 5 cloudy, snow. mr ballard dicky workt revd mr foster. combd cyruses flax. knitt, girls spinning. 2 6 clear pleast. mr weston lady mr ballard dicky helping mr foster. dolly gone colo howards. hannah pamela mr porters. returnd ten o clok. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 3-10, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 3 10, 1787 3 7 clear morn. finisht mrs fosters [dress], helpt brue went see mrs williams aftern. shee paid 6/ attending birth daughter. snowd morng windy. 36th snow. 4 clear cool day. dind spair rib. dolly rode meeting ephm cowans hors. jono 24 years old day. 5 2 snowd part day. girls washt washt east room. anne web nabby pollard amos mr ballard dicky getting timber mr fosters well. fitted tow yn knit began stockin. 6 3 x birth. widow mary shepherds dafter. x. cold morn. calld see widow mary shepherd travil. left home five, put safe bed daughter 4 pm. returnd home 8 evinng. mr ballard mr stephens hook. snowd mr winslow moovd day passt mr hainses. 7 4 clear cool. went mr pollards doubled yarn. wife went revd mr fosters, mrs weston 8 5 clear pleast. jono ye girls sett winslow 9h 30m morn. revd mr foster lady dind esqr petingale asa williams also. informs wife delivrd dafter 1st inst. rufus ballard came 9 6 snow storm. capt suall mr ballard went home informs death capt howards dafter polly. 10 7 raind morn. capt suall mr ballard went mr woodwards see georg stone confind lameness. dicky set home go dads. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 21-30, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 21 30, 1787 21 4 clear. mr ballard mr clearks. home combing flax; 13 lb. 22 5 x birth. mr swetts dafter. x. observd day humiliation prayer. went house worship. calld mr swett ye conclution ye first prayer. went hook ice. put wife bed safe daughter slept mr duttens. 23 6 returnd home way mr hainss. snowd raind. snowd night also. 24 7 cloudy cold. went mrs westons afternn. mr brooks shew dislike informing mrs weston afairs hapened school. bought 1-1/2 yds linnen burtun 5/8 pr yd, paid cash. 1/4 yd cambk frank, paid 3/7 25 g clear cold. attended publick worship. mr williams wife ye evinning, eliphelit robins informd ye death anne webbs child. 26 2 ephm fit. clear cool. ephm fitt. doct coney calld see mr ballard mr pollards ye select gent men. 27 3 clear pleast. mr ballard capt sewall laying road mr duttens mill. mrs bisbee polly girls gone mr westons. home, knitt 28 4 clear pleast. revd mr foster home. mrs elis mrs chamberlin sherebiah town came last evinng, says bitsy recovering polly lucy rash. snowd ys evinng. 29 5 cloudy. danniel robbins came westward. mr voce remoovd mr emersons doct coalmans. mr ballard mr pollards public buisiness. home, finisht hannahs stockins. 30 6 clear part day, little snow. biah went polly taylor paid work shee last august, 8 days. old mrs wheeler mr ballard colo howards. home. ephraim eight years old day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 31 april 13, 1787 31 7 clear. mr ballard doct coneys. home. hannah cool sleeps danl robbins also. cyrus bot 1 lb tea. lidia aaron foster brot cyrus 15 eggs. 1 g clear pleast. attended public worship. mr westons intermision. mr savage dind 2 2 clear. mr ballard sons attended town meeting. hannah cool came work. nat taylor sleeps home, helpt dolly make shirt ephm. 3 3 clear cool. combd 11 lb flax. hannah pamela washt, ye work house spun 4 skeins tow. hanh cool dolly spn 5 skeins linng. mr ballard town meeting. 4 4 clear warm. combd 20 lb flax. revd mr foster killd swine, wt 160. danl robbins sleeps hr. 5 5 clear. combd 20 lb flax. mr ballard went mr herseys run line. saw mill went day night. 6 6 clear. mrs foster came spun linng. georg boltons wife 1 lb tow 1 lb hoggs lard. mr williams jono brot barril rhum hook. 7 7 clear warm. home. mrs foster yet. mr ballard fixing gardin fence, girls spun 21 skeins linning 28 tow ys weak. ice broke river opend ye criks mouth. 8 g clear warm. tarried home. booms opend loggs went ye crick. mr foster came help wife home morn. river opend. thunder shower began 11 evn. 9 2 cloudy. nathanl bragg salv, 1 oz. unwell. 10 3 clear. unwell. betsy chever cyrus brot desk pattins. anaversery john towns death. 11 4 clear. unwell. dolly hann cool washt. thee girls finisht ephm shirt. red cow calvd. 12 5 snowd. home kniting. mrs savage afternn. mr ballard river meeting choose malitia officrs. made choice mr porter, capt; john shaw, lieut; asa williams, ens. 13 6 cloudy. home. mr ballard mr bisbes. dolly mr voses. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 14-23, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 14 23, 1787 14 7 cool. spent ye day takeing care youngest calf. hannah cool dolly went mr pollards wind warp piece. mr ballard hook, bt 2/1 lb 1 lb sugar. 15 g clear cool. atend publick worship, unwell though better mr wade published rachel petingail. 16 2 clear. mr ballard gone winslow purchace loggs. went mr westons mr pollard. jono unwell. ephm cowen tending saw mill. 17 3 clear. mr ballard gone deacn emersons. doubleing twisting thread. girls washt. hannah lost shoe silver buckl saw mill. 18 4 clear. mr ballard run line mr stephenss. boiting yarn tending leech twisting thread. feel much fatagud. 19 5 cold. sherebiah town came ma go son towns, youngest child sick. mr wimans hors, arivd dark. child ill. 20 6 exceeding cold. gave lucy physic, operated well, drew blisters also. betsy sett till 1 o clok. 21 7 cold. came home. son town attended left lucy comfortable, got home dusk. found kinsman, hains learned, directly ward. friends well yet alive. capt heartwell, capt saml davis, leut benn davis mr danl phillips departed life, oxford. snow night. 22 g x birth. welmans son. x. calld mr welmans 9 ys morn, wife safe delivd 7 evn son. tarried night, watcht. capt savages wife raind ys evinng. 23 2 clear. came water, attended taylor hinkly. receivd 7 lb flax mr welman acount trouble march 31, 1785. men turnd bords [leemans]. woodward evinng. rebch wiman milk. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 24-May 2, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 24 may 2, 1787 24 3 clear. mr ballard ploughd gardin. mrs ellis home. 25 4 clear. home. mr ballard mr joseph foster reckoned. mrs williams peggy cool hannah cool went varsalboro yesterd returnd day. mr john taylor sons went 26 5 birth. nathan tylors dafter. xx. receivd nothing. calld 2 o clok nathan taylors wife travil, found dilivrd dafter. doct williams operator. rainy. tarried till morn sett foot, walkt bridg mr kenidays tylor came hors. rode home, arivd 7 much fatagud. jono saml dicky quarrel; shame capt nichols son jonathan morn going cobessicontee. 27 6 clear. unwell. mr ballard mr emersons makeing raites. mr heigns learned dind old mrs whelor also. polly savage evinng. benn brown wife 28 7 clear. began garden. mr ballard savages mending spade. ellis bisbee brot loggs. home. towns bisbees dind nathan howard brt loggs. 29 g cloudy rain. mr town howard went winslow. hannah cool went meeting. feel unwell. atend worship public. 30 2 cloudy, shower evinng. mrs bisbee polly old lady dind. went doct colmans mr learned mr stephens dind, old mr hardin also, informs lost best cow; heavy loss. pamela gone mr stephenss winthrop. 1 3 rain. home. mr ballard doct coneys. mr ingraham 1/2 bushl flax seed. mr leighton sleeps informs joseph ben fillbrokss hous burnt goods. 2 4 clear. home, combd 9 lb flax. mr ballard ploughd. haigns learned dind 103 lb 1/2 beef danl robbins. dolly went current bushes. polly fletcher, mrs harris wiman sally webb 1 lb fatt mrs porter. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 3-8, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 3 8, 1787 3 5 xx birth. charls cleark, second dafter. xx. fee receivd oct 18th, 1788. clear norn. calld 6/o clok morn charls clearks wife travil shee safe deliverd dafter one pm. returnd home 5. girls washt scoured. mr stephens brot pamela home. pork jonathan. 4 6 clear. combd 13 lb flax. mrs taylor bolton clarisa barton mr learned dind. cyrus bougt 17 lb veal mrs taylor. one johathans oxen fell dead savages gillson driveing caried load barrils mr wiman. 5 7 clear. combd 20 lb flax. mrs brown 1-1/2 bushel ashes. planted garlic seed. dolly sowd pees. pamela spunn skein linning weak winthrop. 6 g x birth. mr danys son x. clear warm. went meeting without cloak, went mr westons intermition. calld ye meting house go see mrs dany hook. put safe bed son, second child, 4 o clok. returnd water mr westons, walked home shower. james weston 3 years old day. vesel famelys unloading mr westons eddy. anderson taylor brot pair shoes mr welman fee asisting lady. 7 2 rainy. calld see mrs edson, shee unwell. left home 6 o clok morn, tarried night, mrs mc master mrs densmore also. went bed called 11 salmon catchd sain kenadys fishing place. 8 3 returnd 11 o clok morn. left mrs edson well shee quilling yarn sister weave. mr learned sally white dind mr welman sent piece salmon. hannah dolly, ephm patty attend school. pamela went mr crags. men turnd boards davis. town meeting yesterday. doct coney chosen represent town gen coart. mr carr delegate convention falmoth portland. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, may 8 14, 1787 8 3 returnd 11 o clok morn. left mrs edson well shee quilling yarn sister weave. mr learned sally white dind mr welman sent piece salmon. hannah dolly, ephm patty attend school. pamela went mr crags. men turnd boards davis. town meeting yesterday. doct coney chosen represent town gen coart. mr carr delegate convention falmoth portland. 9 4 birth. nathanl herseys 4th son. xx. clear morn. calld 9 o clok ys morn see mrs hersey, shee travil, safe deliverd fine son 1 pm. returnd home 5, find two mr learneds receivd fee six 8 pence mr hersey. mr thomas sewall made presant calve skin. haild raind one ys afternn. 10 5 rain. mr learned brother david went morn shingles. mrs porter mr ballard deacn emerson gone jabiz cowens. wrote letter brother collins one sister waters. 11 6 rainy day. home knitting. girls school. foster came work. nathan howard came aft wer bed. 12 7 xx birth. edsons dafter. xx. cloudy. calld see mrs edson travil, arivd 7 o clok morn. saw husband lying road kenadys lain. shee safe deliverd 8h 26m pm fine dafter. may god almighty bless help shun fathers wicked examples. heard son town. 13 g cloudy morn, returnd edsons. left comfortable, arivd home 5 ys morn. breakfasted went esqr howards see lady unwell. came meeting, afternn. pain head. 14 2 clear. girls washt went mrs westons. mrs savage dind capt savages lady dind also. went mrs howards heard esqrs death. esqr howard departed life suden change, well dead three hours. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 22-30, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 22 30, 1787 22 3 clear, cold morn. mr smiley went girls went school afternn. mrs densmoore, chamberlin savage lidia bisbee sleeps mr ballard planting potatoes. 23 4 clear. unwell. dolly went school forn. lidia bisbee polly drank tea mr ballard making fence. cyrus brot 2 lb butter. 24 5 clear. warpt webb 42 yds linnin. went mr williamss, wife better. mrs pollard evinng. mr hodges came last evinng. revd mr foster aftern. mr ballard fixing loome. 25 6 rainy fore noon. dorkis pollard warp piece. mr ballard fixing loom. hannah coll sett webb work. mrs voce says mrs pattin unwell. jonathan brot home 9 lb hard bread cost /5 pr lb. 26 7 clear. planted pepers, anis coriander. mr rich westward workt jonn afternn. polly bisbee combd 7-1/2 lb flax [4] 1/2 cyrus. 27 g clear. severe pain head. shower hail rain ys aftern. george coutch remains sick yett. desires prayers. nathan howard 28 2 clear. comfortable yesterday. mr ballard brot kittle savages. mr edy asistided boild linning warp, 55 skeins. girls gon mr crags. mr howard left ys morn. 29 3 clear. mr ballard carting dung, run ye cart thee road. calld mr belchers, wife unwell. mrs cumings church 30 4 rainy. thee south company met chuse ofisers. maid choice mr belcher yr captain; mr hersey, leut; mr church, ens. accepted. capt belchers still (election day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 31-Jun. 6, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 31 june 6, 1787 31 5 rainy, capt belchers. mrs voce mrs cumings night mrs belcher pooly. rose tend 1 6 birth. capt belchers dafler. xx. clear part day. mrs voce cumings went home. mrs belcher taken iller half 11 safe deliverd fine daughter 20 muinits 12 pm. returnd water, arivd home half 4. find well. received 6/ capt belcher reward. went see becky wiman, find craysy. 2 7 clear. quilld 7 skeins yarn. cyrus bot 2 lb butter. mr ballard brot home 14 lb cod fish. son town slept last night. went mr westons, bot xxxvi slay. son town 3 g clear morn, storm night. son town went fosters foot much sweld. poultised joseph fosters wife night. hannah capt porters. hannah cool mr williamss. philip norcroses wife deliverd dafter 31st may last. pamela pain head day. 4 2 rainy. mrs foster went away. hannah came mr portors. becky wiman better. mr ballard meet thee select men. home doubling yarn harnes. hannah cool got web 35-1/2 yds. 93 skeins yarn filld dolly run nail foot. mrs foster 10 pills 5 3 mr ballard laying rhod capt sewalls. home. dolly lame. 6 4 clear. mr ballard gone coart. mrss shaw ellis twin boys dind combing flax. girls strikeing harnis 36 coulering linning warp. becky wiman rode today. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 7-12, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 7 12, 1787 7 5 rainy. calld 4 o clok morn see stutely springers wife travil, day. shee unwell. 8 6 xxx birth stutely springers son. xx. clear. mrs springer grew ill 1 o clok ys morn. calld women safe deliverd 11 fine son. left comfortable returnd 3 pm. mrs bisbee lidia came home mrs voce bakeing. old mr cowen wife son drank tea georg couch departed life last wedns day eving. interd y s day. 9 7 clear part day, shower afternn. mr ballard came surveying wings. combd flax. nathan howard tarries night. hannah cool bot gown patron mr franks. georg couch interd afternoon fort. mrs voce betsy went board vesel bound boston morn. 10 g clear hott. attended public worship, went mrs howard see ibbe, shee sick.. mr fought clarisa barton dind danneil robbins unwell. mr howard went morn. mr williams wife mr hamlin drank tea 11 2 clear hott, shower night. went capt sewalls see child sick rash, find ill. mrs howards, dafter mending. calld capt porters, took 8/ isaac hardin left atending wife, 1/ articles 3 fanns. 12 3 clear. hannah cool warpt gouns went mr densmors goun cut mr ballard went hook arbetration. calld capt sewalls see child, find sick indeed. hear mr william gardner departed life yesterday. sett billy sewall night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 13-18, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 13 18, 1787 13 4 capt sewalls day. old mrs fletcher came came away. crost river boat, wind high. calld mr pollards, colo norths. lisy cosen unwell. mr williamss. sally peirce mr gardners remains interd day. 14 5 heard capt sewalls son dead, hear contradicted. went find low. sett night. wife sick. 15 6 left child. calld mrs howards dind. calld see mrs belcher pain side. sett till 11 o clok. shee easier. 16 7 mr belcher set boston, home. left mrs belcher better. came capt sewalls, find wife child ill. tarried night, watcht. thomas sewalls children rash, becky poorly. mrs woodward captns. 17 g clear. came home capt sewals, feel fitt go meeting. took fine nap. parthena barton mr faught. hear woman boston name polly trust came mr pollards pursuit john leir. shee pregnant hm. 18 2 rainy. set beet plants. mrs woodward capt sewals son departed life morn. mr leighton son, isaac, sleep girls went mr crages. mr porter winthrop last evining. mr ballard makeing [rates]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 19-23, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 19 23, 1787 19 3 clear. patty town sick, throat canker mr ballard girls went funeral capt sewals child. majr dutton lady came gillbreath, leighton son sleeps informd pamela barton publisht mr porter winthrop, widower. mrs reed day. hear thomas sewals son sick. 20 4 clear. mr hains learned came directly westward. brot letter broth collins informs friends well. mr ballard went mr badcocks. calld mrs howards see daughter lbbee siesd relaps rash. found mrs cumings returnd home. sally pierce today. patty better. seisd disentery night. 21 5 clear. unwell patty also. mr ballard gone collect raits. mrs pollard sent home 5 lb poark whh shee borrowed 12 april 1786. went mrs howards, watcht child. shee sick indeed. 22 6 ditoes. took care lbbee day. mrs woodward came capt savages wife watcht son dafter town came house, childn well. 23 7 lbbey howards death, departed life 4 oclok morn. came home mrs woodwd, savage laid corps. mrs savage, mrs williams mr ballard gone meeting concerning building school house. luke barton source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 24-28, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 24 28, 1787 24 g clear. son dafter town datr patty left us bound yr home. wind s. went meeting aftern. funeral ibbee howard attended. wind blew high cross river. went field meeting. mr hamlin mr benn porter winthrop pamela barton publisht. 25 2 rainy. mr ballard sett plants. quilld hannah cool. peggy came springers, enforms yt mrs lumber dangers ly sick lately, put bed son. foster went ys day. mr hovey brot 3 lb butr. 26 3 clear. mr ballard went vasalboro. leut browns wife, old mrs gardy mrs frich, capt savage wife girls went mr crages. mrs loes rhoda came home wh ym. 27 4 shower morn. isaac hardin came go see oldist son, sick rash; sweled ye neck. mrs harris, cowen foster returnd home 5 pm. mr ballard work high way. mr porter n. howard ys night. 28 5 x birth. ebanz hewins dafter. x clear. calld 3 o clok morn ebenz hewins wife travil. shee deliverd daughtr 7. went mr james pages, took walk lady improvements; beautiffull. mr hewen conducted home 2 pm, gave 6/ reward. mr howard takeing raft ye [boom], sleeps sherebiah town also. capt porters arand. thee girls =vis= hanh dolly, took ride mr bisbees acompanied james joseph burton. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 29-Jul. 5, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 29 july 5, 1787 29 6 clear. sherebiah town went pitts town. nathan howard went bord ye vesel boston. theophelus came farm. polly higins 2 oz salv, mother scalt feet. went thos sewals, calld wilms, mr pollards westons, watcht becky. shee sick. 30 7 mr sewalls day. came home eving. 1 g clear. ice intch thik yard south side ye hous morn. attended public worship; sermon preacht ye death lady howards daughter. pamela publisht. mr porter isaac leighton came work fors us ensueing week. day apointed brother collins moores joining wedlok mrs betsy chamberlin winchester. may connections happyness. 2 2 rainy morn. sally peirce bakt went see mrs savage, shees unwell. hannah coole gone mrs sewall. 3 3 shower. mr ballard went meeting church. mrs gardy came pain stomach. ephm went meeting hous catechizeing. mr hardin says child soar opend throat much better. 4 4 clear. independence america observd town. pamela went mr blacks, home. seth joseph williamss wives mr dudly, dr barton, mr leighton biah town sleep mrs harris young people hannah took webb loom, 40 yards. 5 5 clear. went mr savages sleigh, get one. went mrs pollards piece mr westons revd mr fosters. bogt apron patren pamela mr black, price 7/6. isaac went source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 6-14, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 6 14, 1787 6 6 clear. mrs tylor brot black child mr ballard went mr cars. procurd 1 bushel wheat. mr porter, joseph burton girlls went mr faughts. james stackpool betsy town came polly savage, sally peirce hannah cool unwell, throat sore. home. 7 7 clear. mr ballard gone church meeting. pamela hannah went mr densmors. betsy cut pollys gown. hannah cool remains unwell. sett wh till 11 o clok. 8 g clear. women tarried home fornn. mrss butrfield, cleark gordin intermition. attended afternn. hannah poorly yt. ephm went meeting last sabbath also. elihes getchel polly savage cryd first. 9 2 clear. went mr savages. mrs densmore came make gounds. peggy coole see hannah, remains poorly. mr ballard ye young men went asist raising mr childss house. 10 3 clear. mr ballard houghing corn. girls finished gounds. mrs densmore fited mine tried let 3 lb flax labour. betsy town finisht dollys. girls went mr crages. hannah cool better. 11 4 clear. mr chamberlin helpt mr ballard hough. well could wish day. girls bakt pumpkin pies. polly taylor thunder rain night. 12 5 x birth. willm stones son, first child. xx. cear. calld william stones wife travil 11 o clok morn. shee safe deld son 9 evn. returnd 11. mr porter pamela siting sister barton came day, water. heard man fell dead ye coart hous pounalboro yesterday. 13 6 clear. girls washt. hannah pain head. sally bakt. mr ballard gon ye hook. mrs tylor sister went see mrs williams. 14 7 clear. mrs tylor corn, peck. sister took walk far mr savages. hear john north sick. gidion unwell. gave hysop tea, put tow throat. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 15-21, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 15 21, 1787 15 g clear. famely went meeting self ephm, broak rash. sister bartons son much better. shee went mr faught bound home. 16 2 x birth. isaac savages dafter. x calld mr savages 1 o clok morn, wife travil safe dld 11 pm dafter, tho dangerous time. tarried till day light. thunder shower. 17 3 clear. mr faught says gidion barton well sister went morn. mr porter pamela left [sic] fathers visit. came home day light went bed. ephm better, went school. went mr savages aftern, shee comfortable. gillbreath sleeps mr [g cowen] business mr ballard. 18 4 cloudy cold ye season. mr ballard houghing potatoes. carrid mrs pollards sleigh home mr westons colo norths. find famely bed return. 19 5 clear. went deacon coneys ye docters, mr churches, capt belchers. mr ballard went vesel ye hook got corn. come home pamela returnd. shee joind wedlok mr porter yesterday. mrs church dilivd son last tusday morn 1 o clok 20 m. doct coney operator. jerymy baddoks wife ye night dafter. old mrs fletcher performd ofice midwife 20 6 clear. mr williams wife sally hr. mr barton betsy town pitts town mrs welch fornn. went mr savages, drest infant, find cleverly. mr densmoore advice son lambd fall brousd knee. sally peirce ys afternn. bakt rice pudings ys evinng. finisht mr ballards linng hoes 9 3/4 o clok. 21 7 clear. went see david densmoores knee. mr barton betsy town went settld pamela day. shee lost 1 months time, rather workt self since shee came 20 yd s cloth 2/8 pr yd 2:13:4 lawn apron 7:6 2 pair shoes 12/ leather makeing :17:1 paid mrs densmore cuting gown :6 credit labour 4:--:- detr 1/7 cash 1:7 source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 27 30, 1787 27 6 rainy. calld jos fosters see lidia, sick rash. came back mr pollards, went thence fort western; attended funeral pegy cool. georg browns. saw wives hand drest. returnd home ten eving. exceedingly fatagud. j.b. mrs sherman brot mr pollards harford winslow. mrs frich ys night. 28 7 cloudy. news yt lidia foster sick. mr pollards hors, went tarried ye day. came mr pollards thence revd mr foster see find sick rash. came mr brookss, got cold water root. cyrus went carid mr foster. sheld pees. mr ballard gn asist broth moore rais barn. 29 g clear pleast morn, cloudy aftern. cyrus went see lidia foster, finds exceeding ill. went see revd mr foster ill. mr emerson performd thee publick servis stead. mr ballard returnd brothers. brot hors jethro gardner. watcht. 30 2 clear pleast. hannah came mrs [fosters]. returnd, calld see mr foster; find mending. left lidia better also. dolly unwell. coln north returnd. doct colman enforms yt betsy stackpool drouned 28 inst ye river sebastacuk. may god sanctify ye instance us informd yt mr mc masters son daniel sick rash. mr williams bled poorly. mr ballard dolly unwell. batht feet gave herb tea. feel much fatagud self. ephm cowen ezekl leighton ys night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 31-Aug. 7, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 31 august 7, 1787 31 3 clear hott. cut hysop. hannah came mrs fosters. lidia better. mr ballard comfortable. dolly poorly. hear yt ye revd mr foster well yesterday. went ye field gatherd pees. 1 4 clear hott. bakt bread mr brooks, going ye westward. rode mrs fosters, billy daniel sick. lidia mending. revd mr foster got [wound]. 2 5 clear hott. hannah washt. clarisa barton felt unwell, home day. robins gon raft eljh daves. mr blake sent 6 lb chees /6 prlb. 3 6 clear hot. pulling flax. mr ballard savages hay. 4 7 clear morn. pulld flax till noon. severe shower hail thunder litning began half one, continud near 1 hour. hear broke 130 pains glass fort western. colon howard made prest 1 gal w rhum 2 lb sugar acount atendance famely sickness. peter kenny wounded legg bled excesivily. 5 g clear morn. mr hamlin breakfastd pills. calld 9 o clok mrs howards see james, sick ye canker rash; tarried night. 6 2 mrs howards watching son, went day. discoverd saw mill flames. men ye fort went found consumd together plank boards. tarried till evinng. left james exceeding dangerously ill. daughter hannah 18 years old day. mrs williams came home. hannah cool gott mrs norths web loome. mr ballard complains soar throat ys night. take mr gardners hors home. 7 3 clear. calld mrs howards morn see son, find low. went mrs howards see mrs williams, find unwell. hannah cool thence joseph fosters see sick children, find saray daniel ill. came home, went ye field got cold water root, calld mr kinydays see polly. ill canker, gave ye root gargled throat gave great ease; returnd home dark. mr ballard cobesy, throat soar. gargled tinctr, finds relief went bed comfortable. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 19-25, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 19 25, 1787 19 g mr hinkleys. shee remaind poorly till afternn, remedys means, shee got esyer. tarried night. 20 2 clear. mr hinkly brot mr westons. heard mrs claton childs departed life yesterdy yt shee thot expireing. went back mr hinkly far shee departed ys life 1 pm. ascisted lay infant laid arms. ye first instance ever saw ye first woman died child bed deliverd. came home dusk, find famely comfortable. hear three children expird winthrop last saterday night. daniel stayd mr cowens. 21 3 rainy day. home kniting. 22 4 atended funeral mrs claton infant. enformed mrs shaw doct coney calld see james howd, find low. mrs north also sick. thunder shower ys evinng. 23 5 birth. mr shaws dafter. x. sett visit joseph fosters children, met ephm cowen brookss barn. calld see dafters polly nabby sick rash, find ill; gave directions. calld mrs shaw ill time. put safe bed daughter 10 o clok ys evinng. shee finely. 24 6 birth. james hinkleys son. x. calld shaws james hinklys wife travil, put safe bed son 7 o clok ys morn. left well usual came mr shaws, receivd 6/8; received 6/8 mr hinkly also. came mr cowens, find dafters jedy ill. claton david came inn sandy river, people well arivd home 5 aftrnn. doct coneys wife delivrd dafter last evng 10 o clok. 25 7 went isaac savages ys morn, wife afternn, deby shaw allso. calld mr cowens. set night. men ye meddow. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 11-25, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 11 25, 1787 11 3 returnd mc msts. calld mr westons williamss polly savage foster came work yesterday. mr ballard mr pollards. cyrus 31 years old day. 12 4 cloudy. home, wound quills dolly. wove 5-1/2 yds. 13 5 clear. feel unwell. mr ballard gon ye hook, ye girls capt porters. jono brot colt cobesy. 14 6 cloudy rain. mr ballard gone varsalborough run lines mr carr. dolly finisht weaving mrs williamss cloath. unwell. mrs savage ys morn. 15 7 home till sun set, calld see andrew goodwins wife unwell. 16 g mr godws. shee better. 17 2 came home mr goodwins, left house. fanny cox rode behind mr ballard gon survey mr pitts. 18 3 x birth. x revd mr fosters son x xx. calld revd mr fosters lady travl. shee safe deld fine son 7 evnn. watcht. second child. 19 4 mr fosters. shee cleverly. 20 5 mr fosters. raind. joseph fosters wife watcht. 21 6 friday night. 22 7 calld joseph williamss see wife, unwell. mr foster gone hook. came home evinng, find famely helth. 23 g fited going meeting calld see mrs mc masters unwell. mrs cowen administred remedys doct coney prescribd. physic began operate. left returnd far mrs williamss, tarried till 10 evnng, shee exercisd much pain, got easier came home. 24 2 clear pleast. girls washing. mr balld makeing plan mr pittss land. mrs savage mrs brown drank tea 25 3 clear. mr ballard gone capt pages. help remove house. mr hains learnd left oxford 2 weaks ago, friends well except mother, langued situation brother collins informs letter dated sept 7, 1787. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 6-16, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 6 16, 1787 6 7 clear. mr hamlin till afternn, better]. went see mrs porter, unwell. canker ague head, better. calld see mr sanford, find low. mr ballard came home sincleirs. 7 g clear cool. attended public worship. mr bent two sons baptised, one name rufus, david jackson. jonathan gone river famely. 8 2 home. thee girls washt. mr ballard securd flax. mrs north capt coxs wife 9 3 went williamss settle hanh cool. came home, calld see mr sanford, find low. revd mr little maid prayer mr ballard gone sinclears. 10 4 clear pleast. diging roots forenn. calld see mr sanford afternn. watcht ys night. 11 5 mr pollards till evinning, find dolly lame. poultist foot sorril roasted. 12 6 clear pleast. dolly lame. hannah wove went see sanford, find low, apparently expireing. went thee revd mr fosters. came back mr pollards. gave sanfd teas, revivd spoke. left nine evinn. find dollys foot easier. cyrus returnd, well son towns. 13 7 clear. fiting wool cyruss shirt. mr weston potash fraim raisd. mr ballard returnd sinclears. dolly wove 4-1/4 yds. jono daniel gone watch mr sanford. 14 g clear pleast. revd mr foster preacht varsalboro. esqr lovjoys lady sick. mr ballard went see mr sanford, find little revivd. 15 2 home, piqut wool cyrus. girls washt. theophelus laid floar west chamber. mr bisbe mrs chamberlin betsys soar throat drest. aplied plaster. 16 3 snows briskly day. mrs porter came winthrop. finisht dollys linning stockins. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 17-24, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 17 24, 1787 17 4 clear. mrs porter left home. mr pollard sent see sanford. tarried watcht. low indeed. 18 5 clear. came home noon, left sanford alive. drest betsy chamberlins soar. foster unwell, face sweld. went see sanford evin, find much daniel savages wife sally peirce brot home 16 skeins linnin yn, ye spining whice satisfies ascisting mrs savage travl oct 1st 1786. 19 6 clear. gidion sanford departed life. mr weston wife nathan 20 7 clear. peggy fox came go see mrs foster, shee took cold, breast painful. mr foster better. attend funeral mr sanford went back mr fosters, helpt applied thing breast. mrs voce went bed ten, calld 11h 30m see mrs goodwin travil. arivd one. 21 g birth. andrr goodens daftr. xx. arivd mr goodns 1h noon, find safe deliverd fine dafter. lady cox operator. tarried till ten. sett home water, arivd noon. attind worship aftern. revd mr fosters son baptised, named nathanl. genny cool receivd handsom reward mr goodin. mrs voce carried 22 2 clear, home day. sally barton mr ballard went wails business. 23 3 clear pleast. sally yt. dorkes pollard warp piece worsted. finisht hannahs linning gloves. 24 4 clear pleast. mr vahn sally bartn left mr foster, savage brown mr hadon fell river. came shirt put till dried cloaths. hannah dolly went mr westons. mr ballard town meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 25-Nov. 2, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 25 november 2, 1787 25 5 x birth. john cumingss son. xx. clear pleast. calld go john [cumings] winthrop 6h 30m morn. went 6 miles, fall hors, receive much hurt. informd lady safe [delivd] son. returnd 7h 30m. doct barton famely way westwd. wish safe pasage. cyrus went help vesel. capt savages lady made prest 2 hand kerchiefs. parthena barton sleeps went see mrs voce ys evinning. capt nichols 26 6 clear. mr ballard went varsalbh, jonon epm also. makeing soap bucking cloath. polly bisbe hannah mc cakney revd mr foster today, unwell. 27 7 rain morn, wind n aftern. makeing soap, informd ye revd mr foster sick, sent doct williams. 28 g clear morn, shower aftern. attendd worship. deacon emerson performd. mr ballard went see mr foster eving, finds poorly. mr hamlin 29 2 cloudy, snow eving. bucking yarn knitting. hannah sewing. brot last potatoes. hear mr foster better. 30 3 clear. calld see mrs weston, find unwell. calld see revd mr foster, find ill. watcht raind evinng. 31 4 clear morn. left mr foster riseing sun. calld see mrs weston, shee still poorly. workt hard bucking cloath trying tallow. killd thee old cow day. shee 40 lb tallow, wt ye whole 430. doct coleman brot wife home. 1 5 clear. mr ballard hook. girls washt, foster wounded foot. mr hains learned sleeps here,informs friends well. 2 6 clear cold. house work visited mr foster mrs weston, find ym unwell. rode mr savages hors home. workt till 11 o clok. mr ballard took mr chaces oxen taxes day source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 3-14, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 3 14, 1787 3 7 clear. home, made mins pies. mr learned clarrisa barton here,two strangers also. 4 g clear. atend worship. went eving see mr foster, sett mr learned jonothan went brother moores. 5 2 x birth. wilm whites son. xx. clear pleast. came mr fosters. made 25 dozn candles. mrs voce hannah well usual, calld mid night go see wilm whites wife. unwell. seth williams see wife also travil. mrs white safe delivrd son ye asistance moses whites wife arivd. exceeding sick gone. 6 3 x birth. seth williamss child son xxx. came whites water mrs westons, calld see mrs north calld gave brandy, gave relief. bed ye day. mr lee theops bee laying flore ye east room. mr porter supt mr learned sleeps informed seth williams wife safe delivrd 7 o clok ys morn. shee son. 7 4 clear pleast. mr learned left bound home, wish prospers journey. 8 5 clear. son town came went arivd 8 o clok eving. mrs hannah emry 9 6 mr towns, mrs dexter luke barton betsy town maried yesterday. 10 7 son towns feel fatagud journy. old lady thorns funeral attended. 11 b son towns. peggy [ghoun] came 12 2 son towns. snow fell. 13 3 towns, helpt lucy. 14 4 towns, lucy delivrd dafter 4h 30m p.m. birth son towns dafter. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 15-24, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 15 24, 1787 15 5 towns, lucy comfortable ye infant well could wish. eunice stacpl nurs. 16 6 cloudy. returnd home towns, left well could expected. find famely well. rainy night. 17 7 clear pleast. went isaac savages got rie james savage left 3 pecks 5 qrts, went mr westons. 2 lb sugar, 1/4 lb tea, pint w. rhum. knit leggin. 18 g clear pleast. attended public worship, revd mr foster performd, one exercise reason weakness. 19 2 birth. mr beamans dafter. x x. clear. calld mrs beaman travil 9 o clok, shee safe delivd 12 daughter, left comfortable returned home 7 p.m. receivd 6/8. knitt mr westons leggin evinning. mr ballard mr pollards 20 3 cloudy. girls washt mrs taylor mrs bolton theops work knitt. 21 4 x. birth. bralys son. xx. cloudy rose candle light. theops layeing ye floar ye east room. calld see mrs braly travil safe deld 12 o clok seventh son 15th child. returnd home ys eving. rainy night. 22 5 rainy. finisht mr westons leggins. theos sealing ye east room. mr ballard jono agreed rebuild ye saw mill. 23 6 cloudy foren clear afternn. mr ballard jono mr daviss drawing writings mr silas lee. theops made fraim mr brookss desk. girls went see polly bisbe. mended stockins day. 24 7 clear. mending stockins. mr ballard surveying mr vahn. mrs voce dafter source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 2-10, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 2 10, 1787 2 g benn whites sister rebeckah travil tho unmarried. cloudy. 3 2 x. birth. becky whites dafter. xx mr whites, becky ill day, women safe deliverd ten evinng daughter shee declared seth partridg father tarried night. clear. 4 3 clear pleast. returnd mr whites fatagud, undrest since left home. calld nr savages see infant unwell. theops laid kitchen floar. 5 4 cloudy. went see savages infant, doct colman calld see also. docters. returnd dusk. boys mill pond, gash north fell helpt safe harm. 6 5 clear. calld see sally williams, eyes better. mr ballard mr barkers paid owed 7 6 clear morn, snowd aftern. mrs pollard came instruct dolly warp hand kerchiefs. mr broadstreet dind. hannah polly cool evinng. hear yt majr dutton sick. 8 7 clear morn. mrs pollard warp handkercfs. mr ballard sett loom went hook. mrs foster mrs brown drank tea thee girls unwell. 9 g clear pleast. attended public worship. river pasable fort western. hear mr duttun better. 10 2 clear. mr ballard gone brotr moores. mrs savage infant, doct williams see hear three men fell river day. snowd aftern. dolly sett web work. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 11-18, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 11 18, 1787 11 3 clear. mrs dorcas pollard warp pice. mrs savage went home. theops unwell, work. mr ballard came home. gillbreath sleeps 12 4 clear. mr ballard mr pollards business. hannah washt. mrs porter sally bisbe evinng. hannah fell stairs. epm cutt finger. dolly wove 2 handkechfs. 13 5 clear pleast. mr ballard deacn emersons makeing rates. went daviss, got 3 oz indigo. spent evinng mrs porters. capt sewall lady absent. eleason luce killd ye fall tree. 14 6 clear. calld see lucy porter unwell, boddy com much sweld. mrs mc night sleeps husband turnd dores shee says. 15 7 clear. went mrs porters, mrs pollard relievd child puting thee rectum, left easy. mrs mc nt went ys morn. clarisa barton going mr porters winthrop. dolly wove eighth handkerchief. informd daniel fairfield junr varsalboro departed life ye 12th inst jeremy halls wife 6th, shee town] town. finisht stockins evinng. 16 g clear pleast season. attended public worship. called see mrs porters daugt, find much better. hannah cool herbs mrs williams took cold. mrs ingerham informs mrs tolman delivd daft last weak. 17 2 clear. mr ballard mrs howards business mr pitts. quild dolly. shee wove three handkerchfs. mr warrin berwick sleeps 18 3 clear. mr ballard mr emersons makeing raits. home hous work quilling dolly. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 19-28, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 19 28, 1787 19 4 lowry day. mr ballard gone devision line revd mr fosters mr kenadys. home, pain head. dolly finisht weaving hand kerchiefs [16] theophls finisht sealing west roome. snows eving. [aniversary] marriag, 33 years. 20 5 cloudy, little snow. mr ballard gone mr pollards business. girls washt. mrs porter sent see daftr becky polly bisbe calld mr williamss. sallys eys sore yet. 21 6 cloudy snow. mr ballard deacon emersons makeing raits. home, informd mr beamans infant expired day, also mr charls weber bured child weak. death, mr beamans infant. 22 7 clear. went hook; majr duttuns, mrss hallowils, mr densmors, revd mr fosters mr westons. calld mrs porters williamss, children beter. theophilus maid book caiss put ye east room. 23 g clear. sett go meeting met thomas keny, calld see wife unwel. mr whites day. snowd night. 24 2 cloudy. mr whites yet, daft poorly. 25 3 cloudy. mrs kenny yet. shee better consent leav 26 4 clear. returnd home. left mrs kenny house. calld mr pollards, hear rachel faguht deliverd daught 22nt inst, wilm cowens wife son 23. mrs fletcher performd. mrs voce mr ballard mr pollards. 27 5 clear. mrs savage polly mrs welch warping hand kerchiefs. doct tupper took break fast 28 6 cloudy, snowd little. mr ballard went help moove house doct colman. home. dolly finisht weaving cyruss shirts. warpt putt piece lining wove one yard. shee began shirts thursday. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 29-31, 1787 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 29 31, 1787 29 7 cloudy snow. mr ballard went hook. receivd letter friend hains learned 19th inst, informing us death honoured mother, departed life short illness ye 4th inst; decease palsy. shee aged 72 years 27th july last, old stile. also informs yt sister deborah safe delivrd son friends health, acsident fire hapend night ye 5th inst oxbridg; hous consumd four persons, 2 aged 2 children. news death mother. 30 g xx. birth thomas kennys daught first child. xx. clear. attended divine servis, went mr westons intermision calld 7h evn see thomas kennys wife travil. broke ice eddy capt sewals. went thee water waist, got without asistance. mr kenny carried shoar arms. mounted hors, wett rode mr whites hast. find pateint ill. shee safe delivrd 10h 30m dafter cleverly. fell river. 31 2 clear. mr kenny conducted home. arivd 4h morn. made fire hett feet went bed lay till ten, rose feel much beter fears. mr ballard gon mr pollards. let mrs porter 10 skeins receivd 10-1/2 knots doubled 7 yn wt 10 oz, part coloured blue. year 1787, extracted 12 sons 15 daughters; calld 7 women deliverd arival. hallowell december 31, 1787 martha ballard diary doct stephen barton, famely, left hous bound boston octr 25th, 1787. hond mother moore deseast december 4 palsy. 1787 ended, happy mended. god grant may source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-29, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 29, 1788 19 7 clear day. snowd evinng. mr bullins wife daught dind, polly savage also. doct cony mr ballard gone colo norths. went mr williams. sent mrs densmore 14 pills hr son. death capt pages infant. 20 f stormy, snow hail. mr ballard jono went mr pollards. preaching. bad stiring. death mrs kenyday. 21 2 clear pleast. mr ballard colo norths. informd capt pages inft expird 19th inst interd day. home. 22 3 cloudy, snowd evinng. hear henry knowland sick. home, salted ye pork. seth pitts drest wounds. home. 23 4 snowd. home. finisht stockins; third pair winter. informd henery knowland expird morn interd tomorro. death henry knowland. home. 24 5 clear pleast. home. revd mr foster mr ballard went mr densmores. hannah washt. thee remains henry knowland interd. funeral, knowland 4h pm. 25 6 snowd. home. mr ballard post books. 26 7 clear. home. made saucages. mr ballard wood mr vaughns land cyrus. jono purchase yoak oxen mr jackson. informd john blake lost hous fire 14 inst jethro gardner 24th. fire. home ys 3 days. 27 f clear. mr ballard jono went meeting; rest famely home. 28 2 clear. capt savage mr ballard went deacon emersons prepare thing relief mr knowland, whose famely sick much distrest. home. 29 3 snowd till noon haild raind till near sun set. clear evinnt. home. james page mr jackson dind pedler sleeps home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 30-Feb. 6, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 30 february 6, 1788 30 4 clear pleast day. mr ballard sett 10h morn winslow, disapointed hors returnd. snowd eving. home. jono changd oxen hors ond first inst. home. 31 5 clear. mr ballard sett winslow. calld see mr weston ulser gathering throat, tarried watcht. informd ye death wilm kenadys wife sandy river. capt norcross maried mrs nancy hussey. mariag capt norcros. mr westons. 1 6 clear. returnd mr westons, better; sent doct williams. henry badcoks wife delivrd dat 17 januy. birth. mr westons. 2 7 clear. mr ballard returnd son towns, informs patty scolt bad infant remains low. rest ye famely well. home. 3 f clear warm. mr ballard, theops, jono, girls went meeting. hear mr weston better. raind night. home. 4 2 x. birth capt neys son. x. calld 1hm capt neys wife travil. shee safe deld fine son 4. returnd home 1 h pm. receivd 9 lb sugar 1 lb candles. left patient cleverly. second son seventh child. capt neys. 5 3 snowd blowd, cold. home. foster left westward. jono attemptd go meddow get informd andw goodins wife sick; sent doct williams. foster left 6 4 clear cold. capt savage wife, mr bullin deacn emerson dind mr ballard gone see jabiz cowen. dolly unwell cold. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 16-25, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 16 25, 1788 16 7 snowd day. mr ballard came home eving. ive home. 17 f clear. mr ballard attended public worship, rest us tarried home. 18 2 clear. mr ballard went varsalbo. home. peirly pollard came 19 3 clear. home. shereb town left well home. mr elis wife 20 4 windy. mr town left home. mrs stackpol went mrs goodins. 53 years old day. birthday. 21 5 clear pleasant. calld see jamy weston unwell. mrs belcher mrs betsy went sleigh ride. 22 6 clear cold. mrs lois harris mrs betsy chever mr savage wife spent eving us. son ephraim siesd fitt ten o clok; severe one. famely bed except self. cyrus calld went haste light. expected expireing use means, put feet warm water, pryd teeth part put salt water. came sences half hour, rested pritty well rest ye night. sett till two o clok. ephm fitt. ye 3d. first, decem 18 1784; ye 2d, march 26 1787. 23 7 clear. home. mr ballard came home. ephm well usual. 24 f clear. went meeting aftern. mr nason dat baptised ye name lidia. theophs 25 2 clear. mr ballard theophs went varsalboro. revd mr foster came see infant; coald. came home eleven o clok; walkd; much fatagud. jono girls gone ride sleigh. came home half aft 12. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, february 26 march 5, 1788 26 3 jono sett winslow. snows. cleard pleast 11. mr barton came go winslow. 27 4 clear. mr barton left house 9 morn; arivd 3 pm. find wife travil women calld. mrs spincer shee calld 10 mrs simson. cold. 28 5 x. birth luke bartons son. xx. clear cold. mrs barton safe deliverd son 1 morn cleverly. sherebiah unwell. tarried day. patty town unwell. forgave mrs barton fee attending 29 6 clear cold. mr barton conducted home. left well could expected. left towns 1 pm arivd 7. 1 7 clear cold. went mr westons. polly taylor went mr barton doct williams arm taken care mr weston made prest 2 lb sugar 1/4 tea. 2 e clear cold. went meeting calld 6h pm see mrs hovey travil; arivd 7. women collected directly. 3 2 x. birth mr hoveys son. xx. clear cold. mrs hovey safe deliverd fine son 1h morn. returnd home half 1h pm. left patient cleverly, babe well could wish. receivd 2 lb 10 oz butter 1 lb 15 oz cheese part fee. july 22 receivd remainder fee butter. 4 3 clear cold. betsy chever jono ye girls rode sleigh evning. mr fuller, winslow, sleeps informs sherebiah unwell yet, rest folks well. jono 25 years old day. 5 4 clear cold. mr jabez cowens house consumed fire morn. mr ballard came home eving. home; wound quills. mr cowens hous burnt. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 6-13, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 6 13, 1788 6 5 clear cold. james cofrin cutt wood door. home. polly savage washt paid flax ashes. 7 6 clear pleast. cofrin works son town came informs sherebiah little better; famely well. mrs barton cleverly. peirly meddow mr wade. hannah gone jos fosters get shoes made. colo howard old lady, mrss betsy polly, esqr pette, esqr farewel ladys mr town saml stackpool sleep home. snows eving. 8 7 clear pleast. doct colman lady mrs adkins visit. theopholus returnd penopscott. dollys shoes brot home. 9 e snow. sun shind part day. mr ballard attended public worship. strangers meeting. informd robert mc causlins wife low state health. 10 2 snowd little. polly savage came work mr ballard gon varsalbr. home. georg boltons wife hr. 11 3 clear warm. home; informd wife daniel branchs deliverd son yesterday. goodins made also daft. mr larance, wilm elis remoovd ys town also. birth. 12 4 clear warm. jono, james burton dats went winthrop. charls harris hands drest. gave salv; burnt attempting save house burning. childn went winthp. finisht lucys hoes. 13 5 cloudy part ye day. jono ye girls returnd; well mr porters. went capt porters eving. home; bakt. mr gilbreath sleeps capt sewall source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 14-22, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 14 22, 1788 14 6 cloudy, warm. mrs polly bisbe makeing gown hannah. gillbreath dresing mill. home. hous burnt new gloster lad 15 7 clear. home. mrs weston visit. mrs woodward calld. mr ballard came hom. broth moores son sherebiah sick. gillbreath left 16 e snow fell ye night. cloudy foren, clear aftn. sally white, patty goodin lucy ney noone. cyrus wint meeting. 17 2 clear. mr ballard went mr pollards make warant anual meeting. mrss cool gordin old mr cowin wife mr hardin dind jona daniel bolton went ye meddow. cafrin drest flax home. hannah unwell. danl robbins sleeps 18 3 clear. mr ballard sett varsalboro. home. hanh better. dolly got web carried betsy chevers cloath home. 6 [yards]-[3] 3/4 yd. 1 lb sugar, 1/4 lb tea mrs westons. began rain 11 evn. 19 4 rainy day. home carding tow. hannah spunn. polly home. cafrin drest flax day yesterdy. peirly left us last eving. little snow. 20 5 clear foren, cloudy shaury aft. betsy chever thread. spun weak yarn. jona brot 1/2 ton hay deacn emersons, unwell night. 21 6 clear. spun weaking yn. went see james weston. calld mr pollards, colo norths mr williamss. girls washt. mr cummins drest flax 22 7 clear. mr williams wife children hannah cool wilm emerson sleeps mr ballard came home much fatagud; brousd legg. home. colo north returnd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 23-28, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 23 28, 1788 23 e cloudy fore nn, rain aftern. self dats tarried home. joseph williams went doct williams docterd. hannah cool went nurs. joseph williams went doct williams.cyrus meetg. 24 2 clear morn. mr ballard sett varsalboro; jona wilm emerson winslow. mrs savage revd mr foster afternn, mr weston allso. cyrus went mr blakes bt rhum. made herb tea hannah stemd head hott herbs, gave relief. joseph foster 1 bushl jonas potatoes. snowd ys eving. 25 3 clear cold. mr woodward wife broke sleigh coming hill. went [sic] mr williamss see patty. shee swelling throat. 26 4 clear cool. home. hannah better, pain ear. dolly washt. mr cumings drest flax cyrus six lb butter mr reed. 6 lb 27 5 clear cold. calld mr benn bisbes, wife travil. left home 4h morn. went old mr bisbes, lidia unwell. 28 6 x. birth benn bisbes datr. xx. clear. mrs bisbe deliverd daught 2h morn cleverly. returnd home 10 fatagud. polly bisbe rode hors back. dat, hannah, much better. mr cumings david wall drying flax. raind night. mr bisbe detr fee medicin eight shillings. calld mr hains 4h aft. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 29-Apr. 3, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 29 april 3, 1788 29 7 birth mrs hains dafter. xx. clear windy. mr hains wife safe delivrd 5h morn datr; 10th child. left child comfortable; returnd home noone; receivd 6/. mr porter wintp dind mr ballard son towns yesterday; well. 30 e clear cool. self dats attend meeting. hannah unwell. went see patty williams, shee better, mrs porter son ephraim nine years old day. 31 2 clear pleast. mr ballard see school. brothr town says dat, hannah, better. polly savage work. home. wilm emerson hannah rode better. 1 3 clear warm. doubling twine mr fosters jane. calld capt sewalls, lady travil. walkt ye river safe. arivd 8h evng. gillbrh sleeps 2 4 birth capt henry sewalls daugt. xx. clear. mrs sewalls women calld shee safe deliverd 7h morn fine dat, cleverly. mrs pollard, voce crost ice. calld colo norths jos williamss. mrs voce rode hors mr chamberlins see betsy sick, alive. receivd 6/ capt sewall service moose garden noon. 3 5 clear. went mr chamberlins, found daugt betsy expird famely tears. asisted mrs woodward lay corps. came home; went mrs williamss, sally better. jona returnd. betsy chamberlin expird 9h ys morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 4-11, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 4 11, 1788 4 6 snow fore nn, rain aftern. sett attend funeral betsy chamberlain; met corps. dolly followd far colo norths. ice moovd could pass ye river. thee corps put metting house. returnd far mr williamss; spent ye aftern children unwell. corps betsy chamberlain lay ye meeting hous. 5 7 foggy. home. mr balrd laying road. remains betsy chamberlain interd 1h pm. jona ascisted. hannah mrs williamss. betsy chamberlins remains interd. 6 e cloudy. went meeting afternn. 4 feemales except self. river open people crost water; road muddy. river open, thee bridg wreckt. 7 2 clear. theis town mett vote governers; thee annual meeting also. parthena barton came visit. doubling twine yarn. 8 3 cloudy. parthena dolly went mr crages mr westons foren, shee went home aftern. twisting saine twime. joseph williams came home. thee bridg mended. 9 4 cloudy. twisting twine combing flax. doct coney opend soar patty williams throat. 10 5 clear. home; made 20 dz candles. hannah washt. mr ballard mr pollards business. 11 6 clear. calld day reason hannahs unwell. complaint pain left ear continued till aftern. shee feaver day faint turns. constantly nursing shee seems little easyer evinng. mr ballard gone wiscasett business. joseph williams gone ye docts hannah sick. accident wichcaset; mr jack brown shot thro back. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 12-19, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 12 19, 1788 12 7 clear. hannah much better. betsy chever made 28 doz candles; 6-1/2 lb tallow, cyruss. mr gillbreath came unwell. theophelus james burton also. 13 e clear. mr ballard came home wiscaset. self dats home. 14 2 clear. makeing soap. clarisa barton mr porter capt porters lady mrs childs made visit. snowd 9h evng. 15 3 rainy. mr gillbreath theophilus went mrs savage shee made settle ment acount spinning thee wolen wheal, sick 1 pair shoes medecin let children sick, evin acounts. lett 4 lb x flax x shee paid mrs savage settled. 16 4 clear. mr ballard gone varsalboro. revd mr foster home. clarisa went home. hannah rhode death mrs oakman. snowd. 17 5 cloudy. day observd fast prayer. attend worship afternn. went see revd mr fosters son, isaac, aflicted soars thought salt rhume; find poorly. hear capt saml oakmans lady expired travil yesterday. jona gone winslow mill timber. 18 6 rainy. home. mrs oakmans remains interd. 19 7 cloudy rain. home. mr ballard went ye hook. jona came home wins low timbers. well son towns. dolly unwell. jona brot timber winslow. theop varsalboro. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 20-26, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 20 26, 1788 20 e rainy part ye day. attended worship aftern, hannah also. people levy moore wm roberts meeting. 21 2 clear cold. home; finished makeing soap; barril. cleand 80 skeins tow yn. girls bakt brewd. mr ballard mr carr capt sewall lott land mr savage ownd. prised 16/ acre. home. 22 3 clear till towards evin, snowd. washt larg washing. polly savage helpt us. paid flax. son town sleeps children unwell. mr ballard ye hook. home. 23 4 snow foren, rain aftern. mr ballard gone doct coneys. son town luke barton sleep mr savage mr benn brown eving. dolly wound warpt drawd mrs williamss webb. home. combed flax cyrus jonathan. snowd. home. 24 5 cloudy. son town mr barton left home. mr ballard cabesy; bot cloath pair breaches. quilld 14 skeins yarn combd 10 lb flax. dolly wove 7-1/2 yds. mr lemuel cumings sleeps rain. home. 25 6 laury day. mr ballard hook. quilld dolly. shee wove 8-1/2 yds. mr cumings pownalboro returnd sleeps danl robins sleeps hr also. rain. home. 26 7 home. cleaning yarn quiling. dolly finisht piece 23-1/2 yd. capt nichols, reubin richd moore dind. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 27-May 3, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 27 may 3, 1788 27 e clear cool. attended worship. people meeting lately. calld see mr williams, thinks better. eliphalet robbins broke collar bone hurt arm. meeting. 28 2 rain. snow haill cold. mr voce work. cyrus got wood mr williams. thee girls washt. jona bot tea pott. home. 29 3 clear part ye day. knitt hannahs stockin. dolly spoold warp jona 24 skeins. mr voce samuel blake interd. departed life yesterday. 30 4 clear. home. dolly warpt drawd web. mr voce mr densmore brot mr ballards breeches home. 1 5 clear till eving rain. mr voce calld away noon attend coart thos sewall plantf revd mr foster defendt. mrs pollard instruct dolly weaving. home. danl rollins sleeps joseph fosters wife came home yesterday. revd mr fosters tryal action commenct thos sewall. home. 2 6 cloudy raind little. mr voce finisht bed rooms. jona danl robbins brot barril cyder hannah wove 1 yd cloath. home; wound quills knit hannahs stocking. ye cramp night; verysevere fit cramp. mr ballard dats wereup attending 3 7 clear. cleand bedsteads washt rooms. dorcas pollard warpt piece. david learned came fore nn. went see joseph fosters wife others. doct barton came evin, brot letters friends, one brot ballard; one broth colins; sisters barton waters also. josh fosters. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 4-10, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 4 10, 1788 4 e rainy day. mr ballard famely attended public worship. mr mathews broth sleep mr brooks judg howards wido published. beal polly savage also. 5 2 clear till n, thunder shour. mrs williams went poorly. town meeting. made choice doct coney represent us general ascembly. doct colmans lady sister jabish cowen workt 6 3 clear. mr ballard went brothr moores. jabe cowen workt till 3 o clok. favd company mrss betsy thomas, dorkes nabby pollard, hannah mc keknay hanh north. home. james burton wounded legg. 7 4 clear. home. girls washt. mr ballard came home. broth moores children sick. thankful croell departed life 4th day shee seizd putred feaver. james bolton mr green workt half ye day, halld thee mill timber ye door yard. 8 5 clear. mr josh foster brot wife shee feaver fitt home. hannah wove three yds wail cloath. polly cool theophelus publisht mrs sally rockit oxford. 9 6 cloudy; raind night. mr ballard went mr vahans. mr benn porter dind says wife poorly. home. hannah wove 3 yds. mrs savage brot home five skeins linning 4 tow. polly sent 16 skeins tow dolly. 10 7 cloudy rain. finisht jonas frok. hannah wove 3-1/2 yds. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 11-17, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 11 17, 1788 11 e rainy day. mr ballard cyrus attend meeting. well usual. andw goodins wife prayed mrs williams husband poorly. pamela porters dat born. 12 2 clear. home. mrs savage dolly went mr foots. clarisa leut hains learned came directly westwd. friends well. wife deld dagt 26 april. informd benn porters wife deld dat ye 10 inst cleverly. theops jona gone brotr moores. 13 3 clear morn; showers aftern. mr learned mr ballard went broth moores. went ye hook, colo duttons. lady low ye recovery. mrs hollowels, mr densmoors, revd mr foster, joseph fosters, mr westons joseph williamss. dats washt wove betsy chever mrs savage also. jona came home. hook joseph williamss. 14 4 clear pleast. mr williams sally day. hannah dolly went capt porters. home. mr smith, wall jabe cowen workt home. 15 5 clear. home. mr bald harrowd flax went mr vahans. let barley gave gardin seeds. mrs savage sett gardn roots gardn. polly bsb cate scott leut learned also. wall d. robbins sleep hannah finisht webb; 25 yds. mrs pollard sent 6 skeins ling yn ephm shee borrowd. home. 16 6 x. birth moses sewalls dat. x. clear. calld half 12h morn mrs sewall ye hook. shee ill; safe delivrd 5h pm fine daft cleverly. tarryd night; fee receivd. mr sewalls. 17 7 clear. returnd mr sewalls 10h morn. went see jos fosters wife find low. mr willms litl better. shiribiah town calld j. willmss. david pollard sett boat rips. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 18-22, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 18 22, 1788 18 e cloudy rain. attended worship ye forenn revd mr fosters aftern. oldest child unwell. calld see jos fosters wife. shee better josh williams seems mending. sally patty unwell. cyrus unwell. washt sick. calld mr wilmss. 19 2 cloudy cool. tend josh fosters wife. shee took puke; well could expected. calld mr williamss. poorly. mr ballard gone varsalboro. mr gillbh sleeps rain. ye girls mr westons. wrote broth collins moore jos fosters wilmss. 20 3 cloudy, raind ys eving. went see mr williamss famely. unwell. leut learned brot, david, dind mr ballard varsalboro laying road thro ye town. mr gillbh helpt cyrus dress mill. thunder rain ye night. wrote sisters barton waters. nr wms. 21 4 cloudy morn, clear aftern, rain thunder eving. mr learned left bound westwd. home. comd flax josh foster. mr benn brown sleeps wrote mother ballard. home alld. 22 5 cloudy rain. house work fore nn. calld see mrs sewall hook. shee exercised swelling left legg pain. dats washt. old mr coutch departed life 2h pm. calld mr williamss unwell. sally better. death old mr coutch. ye hook mr wilmss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 23-27, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 23 27, 1788 23 6 rainy day. combd flax josh foster foren. went mr wilms aftn. better. timm pages wife says mrs north unwell. made pills. left senna sally wilms. mr ws. 24 7 rainy day. felt unwell. mr ballard went esqr norths hear coart mr foster ye sewalls. jona went echabod pittss corn. mr childs craige planted point ye crick wh corn. remains old mr coutch interd. home. 25 e clear till 1/o clok pm, thunder rain. famely went meeting except epm self. went see mr wilms famely, unwell. mrs pollard mrs porter went bed 10, calld 11h evinn mr moses whites wife travil. walkt string piece ye bridg mr hoveys. ephm cowen publisht hannah savage.at wilmss. 26 2 x. birth mr moses whites dafter. x. clear. mrs white safe deliverd fine dat 9h morn. left home noone. calld mr herseys, mr pollards, colo norths capt porters mr williamss. sally sick. came home; find parthena barton left patients cleverly. parthena barton came work hannah wentfor hr wmss. 27 3 clear morn. calld see sally wilms sick. doct colman left medicin. calld see james weston; remains weak. came back; tarried night watcht. timy pages wife day. patty seems little better. raind ye evinng. watcht sally wilms. heard well son towns. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 28-31, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 28 31, 1788 28 4 election boston; rainy. mr ballard came mr williamss morn. left poorly. veal breakfast; first ys spring. took nap aftern. parthena dolly went see sally. cyrus went eving. shee remains sick indeed. capt porter returnd bstn. nathl brown drowned. 29 5 clear morn; little shower aftern. mr ballard committee road west side ye river. hook, colo saml duttun 3 pair hos 5/ pr pair; 2 combs, 1/ acount moses white thoms kenny. came back nr williams; tarried till eving. mrs voce watches sally sick. natl brown drowned last night near mr kenndys. mrss duttun mrs sewall mending. mr ebenz hail sleeps polly mending. 30 6 clear. home foren. roasted line veal. went mr wilmss one o clok. sally better. mrs wms poorly; one famely well. calld mr westons see james continues low. mrs north mrs densmore, anne webb came mr wms watcht. girls went mr crages. son town seen famely bed return. son town sleeps capt porter fitts last night. mr wilmss. 31 7 clear part ye day. calld hast see sally wilms. shee ill turn. mother faintd. thee child revivd. tarried day. doct emerson calld see rubd vinegar, gave clisters. tard night; parthenia also. son town went home. watcht mr willmss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 1-6, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 1 6, 1788 1 e x. birth capt porters dagt. x. clear day. calld capt porters lady travil 4h morn. shee safe deld fine dat 10 comfortable. taried till 3h pm; returnd took nap sleep. calld see sally; find much left mr williams better. hannah wh mrs williams thisday. mr wilmss. 2 2 clear. went mr williamss. sally better. went see mrs porter. receivd fee ye capt things store 7/. came back wms. sally ill turn. apprehensive near expireing. neighbs called revivals night. tarried night, dolly also, mr crages till 2h morn. hannah cools came faint poorly. mrs williams fitts. watcht mr williamss. 3 3 clear. sally revivd. doct advisd phisick; gave tarried till 3h pm. hannah hanh cool went away ys morn. hannah watcht mr willmss. 4 4 clear. mr ballard went pownalboro coart. went mr williamss poorly. mrs fletcher ingerham watch. came home wrote broth jona. ditos, mr wilmss. 5 5 clear warm. went nr williamss; find unwell; tarried night watcht. watcht. 6 6 clear hott. came home sun rize. sally much theops hamlin james burton sett oxford. rote broth collins moore. went mr wilmss aftnn. thought sally expireing. shee severe feaver fitt. parthena dolly watcht. tarried night. wrote broth collins moore went mr wilmss. watcht. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 7-10, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 7 10, 1788 7 7 clear. wilmss day. sally another ill turn. came home evining. left thos moore find girls cleand house, ephm brot wood mr willims thru twitihes. wilmss. 8 e clear morn, cloudy aftn. went nr wilmss, rode hors far mr chamberlins; dat, sally, ill day. shee severe fitts aftn night. tarrd, polly whealor also. natl brown taken interd. ditos. 9 2 rainy. calld home. hannah unwell. calld doct colman asistance; gave emetick operated kindly gave relief. parthena dolly washt. went mr ws 6h pm. put sally warm bath seemed give relief. returnd home 9h pm, find hannah cleverly. mr ballard colo duttuns, brot home stores. barril pork brot home yesterdy. calld polly wheeler mr wlmss lay corps ys dat, sally, expird eleven twelve ys evng. hannah unwell. sally wilms fitts day. shee expird 11h 30m. ditos. 10 3 clear. came mr wmss 10h morn; laid bed took knap. except cyrus, attended funeral sally williams. mrs wms fainted shee returnd home. mrs chamberlin anne webb tarry sheribiah son town sleep funeral sally williams 5h pm. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
