title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 11-16, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 11 16, 1788 11 4 clear. sheribiah town went bound boston. coln howards. made prest casse bottle wine. esqr adkins daughters coln norths, capt porters mr williamss. son town sleeps mr wilmss. 12 5 clear. son town went spoold yarn foren went see mrs foster james weston aft, find low indeed. capt porters inft unwell. calld see left senna manna. mr williamss famely poorely. calld son town went home. jono went sinclear. ditoes capt porter. 13 6 clear. helpt house forenn went mr williamss aft. shee took puke. tarried tended mrs becky, polly lidia bisbee mr williamss. 14 7 clear. wed garden fore nn. calld mr isaac clearks see mrs nancy. shee st. anthonys fire; pain much worried. calld see james weston mr williamss famely. seem som comfortable except james, low indeed. ditoes. 15 e clear cool. attended public worship; went mr westons meeting. james seems little comfortable; nr wilmss; poorly; wife unwell yet. patty much polly coole capt stickny mrs naby jackson publishd. 16 2 cloudy. wed flax calld mr westons. james near expireing. calld see mr williams, unwell; feet swell. shee little better. set mr westons. james alterd 10h evn. esqr lion betsy whelor also. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 27 july 1, 1788 27 6 clear warm. bakt. helpt house forenn, wed flax aftern. jona came home sun sett. polly savage noone. robbins sleeps 5 workmen. home. 28 7 clear morn. showers aftn. mrs welch 3 lb tow 2 lb 6 oz flax parthena. jos foster says wife well shee went see joseph williams; find much robbins went dolly put pease jona. six men work day. mr williamses. 29 e rainy day. home. revd mr foster absent; gone preach fairfield. mr densmore says infant unwell. speckled cow calvd morn. home. 30 2 cloudy. went see mrs foster mr williams fore noon; rode went mr chamberlins doct colmans aftnn. calld 5 mr b. browns. mr wilmss. eight men work. 1 3 x. birth mr benn browns son. xx. mrs brown safe deld 4 fine son. returnd 9h morn; left cleverly; receivd 6/ fee. sixth child 3d son. girls washing. daniel savage junr brot 7 lb sugar yesterday attending wife geting bed last child. six men work day. girls went mr williamss. gillbreath went yesterday. mr benn browns. 19 years thisday since death daft dorothy. six mento work ys dy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 2-7, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 2 7, 1788 2 4 cloudy. quilld hannah weave forenn went see mr wilms aftn. six men work ye frame. mr gillbth sleeps mr wilms. 3 5 cloudy showers thunder. gillbh left watch fosters. calld see willms. watcht, wmss. 4 6 cloudy. came fosters; left low. calld wmss; low also; went mr rheds, bt 5 lb butter 10-1/2 lb chees; helpt hous work rest day. jabish cowin helpt us water wood. six men yesterd ys day also. wmss. 5 7 loury day. five men work went see mr williams; remains much mr westons capt porters. mr thwing taken puke. mr lois tending 19 years day since death dagt martha. wmss. 6 e cloudy. self parthena dolly tarried home; roast veal dinner bakt pumpkin pies, mrs young sandy river mr savage wife drank tea see mrs foster; find low. mr williams much hear mrs hains mrs pullin like recover. home. son town yesterday, doct wilms capt haills child. 7 2 cloudy morn. raisd saw mill fraim. mr marshall thomas moore hurt; businiss ways done safety. vast concorse men children many disguisd licquor. young folks dance evng. disperst midnight. saw mill raisd. robt denisons wife dild daft mrs fletcher. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 8 11, 1788 8 3 heavy showers. mr ballard went pownalboro coart. informd mrs weston yt wife joseph foster expird morn 2 o clok. clarrisa barton left home attended mr scenter. went see mr williams tarried night. wilmss. mrs livermoore deld son doct coney 11 evng. death mrs foster. 9 4 cloudy. came home wilmss. nathan howard calld self dagts attended funeral mrs foster. colo nhs, capt porters, mr westons mr crages wilmss. mr thwing much distrest austma. mr gille patrige sleep ditoes, mrs foster interd. 10 5 cloudy showers. jona went coart. girls washt. cleaning seller. mrs taylor says polly low indeed. home. 11 6 clear warm. cleaning thee seller. capt savages lady mr edward savages also, went mr williamss capt porters. hannah wilmss. mr wms. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 12-15, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 12 15, 1788 12 7 clear hott forenn, shower heavy thunder aftn. rachel foot mrs welch. jona returnd coart. wilm howard winslow sleeps home. spent part day seeking red cow. cyrus true found calf drove ym home. hear norcross comin broth fell bord drowned pasage. home. hear coart criminals condemned revd mr foster lost case walker. 13 e clear. went mr ebenz taylors see dat, polly, weak low. mr ballard came home morn. mr jonah crossbee sleeps went mr taylors. 14 2 clear. mr ballard mr crosbee sett pownalboro 3h morn. mrs weston foren, mrs welch aftn. combd flax let mr welch 2 lb tow. shee 3 lb went see mr williams; find lower distrest breath. nr williamss. 15 3 calld theops hamlin 2h morn, wife james burton informd nr wilms wors. went tarried till aftern. left easier. dolly parthena went josh fosters; 7 young women came home hamlin wife burton sleep nr wilmss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 8-11, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 8 11, 1788 8 6 clear. mr weston calld went see mrs foster. shee well. came mrs williamss; child sick; fitts. mrs porter aftern. mrs pollard polly hinkly mr saml peirce stay attended home. revd mr fosters wido williams. patty fitts. 9 7 clear. went wido williams; child seisd 10 e fitts [8]h evn. 9 1/2 1 morn, easy till 9, fitts came 4 11hr, another continued 1h 30m. came home changd linning. ephm cowen intermition. mr goold, gentleman n. brantery, preacht went mrs wilmss, tarried night. patty exceeding ill. polly bisbe dat hanh watcht. wido wmss. mrs voce mrs harris watcht. detoes. mrs foot clarrisa barton 11 2 clear morn; showers aftern. wido wilmss day. thought child expireing. neighbours calld revivd. administred clysters prepard english mallows camamile, operated relaxed bowels. lift easy returnd home eving. hannah mrs westons, parthena dolly last satterday help quillt bed quilt. [guild] partrage came ditos. hear old mrs hutchens winthrop departed life sudenly day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 12-20, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 12 20, 1788 12 3 clear. went wdo wilmss. patty sleep 10h morn till eight evng; fitts came held night. mrs child watcht. dolly parthena slept thought child expireing ye night. wido wilmss. polly white polly hinkly 13 4 xx. birth mr fullers son. xx. clear. calld mrs williamss 2h 30m mr fullers lady travil. shee safe deld 1h pm son. returnd home 4 find mrs polly white shee slept last night. mr fuller paid 6/ fee, gave 5 bowls. extraidinary medisin. patty williamss fitts ditos. polly white left parthena 17years old day. 14 5 clear. went wido williams, tarried night. child ill. old mrs fletcher sally polly tillton detos. set 15 6 clear hott. came home 5thh, went sleep 8th wdos 1 pm, found mrs cumings patty expird 5h pm. put grave cloaths asistance mrs cumings mrs hanh mc kathny. mrs bullin mrs lois harris ditos. pally expird 5h pm. aged 8 months 17 days 10 hours old. 16 7 clear warm. killd veal. mr james page public business; informs wife unwell. attended funeral pally williamss interd ys evinng. widdow, mother surviveing branch famely. funeral patty williams. attendd 17 e rainy day. mr ballard nr savage old mr white mett meeting house. mr foster home. 18 2 clear. revd mr foster lady wido williams mrs lois harris dind us. mrs rheed mrs blakman calld mrs dorkis pollard warp piece. mrs savage says james unwell. jona pitts town pair shoes. home. 19 3 rainy day. went mr savages see james unwell. mother came warp 4 hand kerchiefs. mr ballard gone mr carrs meet select gentlemen. mr jeremy hall took sartifaket left 2/3. mr ballard return night. nr savages. 20 4 clear part ye day. mrs childs warp webb. mr ballard returnd, 10h evn. capt porter beat mr isaac savage abused much. home. capt porter faut nr savage. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 5-12, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 5 12, 1788 5 e x. birth thoms hinklys dagt. xx. mr hinklys; women calld 7h evn. shee safe delivd daugt 11 pm. tarried night. mr hinklys. 6 2 clear. went see mrs fuller child. calld see mrs bates; find better. returnd home 10h m. receivd 7/ mr hinkly magr stickneys 7/ suball hinklys acount. wido williams polly bisbe workt makeing hannah goun. hink[lys] fullers, mr batess mr westons. 7 3 clear. home, made baise coat piqut 1/2 lb wool. home. 8 4 rainy foren, clear aft. home, made 2 pockets hannah, mended cyruss stockins piqut wool mr ballard well usual. jotham smith cridt 1 m shingles. mr ballard bot side beef colo howard. home. smith brot shingles. 9 5 clear. home. mr ballard church meeting. mrs savage warpt piece girls gone hamlins. home. 10 6 cloudy. home. mr bald doct coneys. mr learned came betsy chever home. 11 7 rainy. home. girls made mins pumkin pies. mr ballard went varsalboro met select gent men mr pollards. calvin ballard sleeps home. 12 e x. birth mr isaac clearks son dagt. xx. clear pleast. attended public worsp, revd mr foster discoarst geness 33d 4th. mr gille went morn. girls went mr childs eving. elias crage hannah mc keckny cryed. calld haste 11h eving mr isaac clearks lady travil. shee safe delivd fine son daugt 12; likely well. receivd 12/ reward. meeting mr isaac clearks. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 13-22, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 13 22, 1788 13 2 clear pleast. returnd home mr clearks, left cleverly. mr clearks. 14 3 clear pleast. mrs williams home. mr ballard ephm went esqr huseys see [sic] muster. james stackpool thoms howard night, mr smyle also mr learned. home. 15 4 clear. went ye river far charls clearks. mr ballard mr pollards public business. young people daunce. receivd mr allin 3/ due medisin 5 lb chees cyrus /6 pr lb. mr brooks. little snow. 16 5 clear pleast. home. mr learned night. made diapor skirt hannah. home. 17 6 clear. attended preparetory lector; twelve persons except revd mr foster. theophel hamlin wife ys evnn. mr smyle left mr learned workt mill giers, sleeps lector. 18 7 cloudy. charls cleark brot 8 lb sugar attending wife may 3d 787. went see mr densmoores children unwell. left 20 pills, prs 1/. mr densmoores. 19 e clear cool. meeting; mr westons intermision. went mr hamlins eving. meeting hamlins. 20 2 clear. mr ballard went varsalbboro. went colo norths, receivd 3/ mr edsons acount attending wife travil may 12, 1787 salve. began rain evn. colo norths wido williamss. 21 3 rainy day. wrote sisler walers. mr gille home. wrote broth collins sister sally. 22 4 clear. went mr westons, lady lent x[/6]x. doct colmans one thousand shingles. number young ladys evinng. mr learned sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 23-31, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 23 31, 1788 23 5 hannah left home atended board capt agrey jona, accompanyd mr hains learned go boston; oxford. sent 4 m shingles, 1 crown 6 dollars half. may shee prosperous journey meet friends safty ye desire mammy. mrs hamlin gillbreath home. hannah left home 5h evin. 24 6 cloudy, shower thunder 1h pm. mr ballard went pitts town. girls spun cottne. carded home. gillbh helpt cyrus pick mill. home. 25 7 clear pleast. went mr wadwards neighbs, met nathanl runels informed yt capt agrey went home morn. men raising mill giers. went far mrs woodwds. 26 e cloudy. tarried home forenn, wrote brother jona moore; attended public worship aftn. wido williams sleeps rainy evng. thos haywad pain side. meeting. wrote brother jona moore. 27 2 cloudy. home. mr bullin clean wheat. parthena dolly went mr westons. evinng thunder shower. cyrus went carry letters mrs lois hinkly convey rochester falmath. home. 28 3 clear. wind nw. home. mr bullin cleaning wheat. old lady sleeps woodward allin paid 3/ reducting much due mr ballard coopar ware. home. wdwd allin here.eliab shaw left 1 m shingles burtun 29 4 clear cold. mrs merifue went home. ye girls washt. home. snowd. 30 5 clear cold. clarisa barton parthena gone mr porters winthrop. mr ballard town meeting. apointed counsel. home. wido williams sleeps wound quills footed ephms stockins. home. parthena gone winthrop. 31 6 clear. mrs williams day. mrs porter polly bisbe jona killd ox. home; house work. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 1-8, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 1 8, 1788 1 7 clear foren, cloudy rain aftn. jona killd ox. parthena came home. cleand tripe. home, house work quilld yn. dolly pair leathr shoes brot home. home. mr savage made present logerhead. 2 e clear pleast. stayed home. rest ye famely went meeting. doct whitaker performd. mr ballintine wife day sleep polly bisbe ys evng. home. 3 2 clear pleast. mr ballard went varsalboro. thomas haywod went away go home. home, tryd jonas tallow. home. death senter latter part night. 4 3 clear morn, cloudy aftn. mrs hamlin wound warpt peice mr carr informed mr [ziachers] senter departd life sudenlley yesterday. home, hous work. breud finisht trying jonas tallow. home. mr loee 5 4 clear pleast. girls washt washt ye floars. home, house work; feel weary. home. 6 5 clear pleast. home, house work feel much fataugd. girls gone mr crages. returnd; informd hannah fletcher sworn shee child joseph fellers. home. 7 6 cloudy chilly, raind eving. home. wido williams sleeps cyrus bot 1/2 bushel apples mr devnpts. home. jona got snuff. 8 7 cloudy. home; heard yt capt agry got boston last monday. parthena receivd letter mother oct 26th informing well sister nabby living. bakt mins pies today. home. wido wilms sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 9-14, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 9 14, 1788 9 3 snowd raind. boiling soap. mr ballard went meet select gent men. david learned sleeps polly whealer unwell. doct coney came see left remidies. wodwd allin work, came yester day. receivd 4 lb chocolat ephm cowen assisting wife ys 4th inst. home. snowd. 10 4 cloudy day, clear eving. home. broth moore, capt savage jonas cleark mr dyer capt mathews also. latter intoxecated, carried drolely evng, fell fire spillt soap, boiling, polly little easier. home. snowd. 11 5 clear. mr ballard went colo duttuns mill. broth moore david learned dind latr sleeps wido wilms polly bisbee home. home. 12 6 cloudy, raind eving. mr ballard went mr jacksons turnips. combd 12 lb flax mrs weston. betsy chever old mrs bolton home day. polly kept anything shee eat day. home. [7 lb] combd flax. 13 7 clear pleast. capt savages lady polly low, pukt shee takes. home. home. 14 e clear, cold. tarried home. colo howard came see polly whealor, brot sugar. shee gave order moses hastin wages due. doct colman also. brot bisquits. wido wilms charlotte cool eving. capt savage lady isaac savage, mr prescott supt home. mr foster preacht 1 corinth 11 1 vers. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 15-19, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 15 19, 1788 15 2 rainy foren, clear aft. mr ballard unwell. polly well shee doct coney calld see mrs hamlin warp web. girls wido willimss. charlotte evng. home. home. 16 3 cloudy moderate. dolly rode far mr westons carried polly. pain returnd hip aftn. mr ballard went hook. home, finisht mending mr ballards breaches. mr fillbrook night; says towns famely well. home. 17 4 cloudy snow. mr ballard went church meeting. home. polly poorly. mr james page dind informd mr benn branard departed life last night. home. news death mr branard. 18 5 clear cold. mr ballard attended town meeting. vote passt revd mr foster preach meeting hous anymore. mr brooks settle bakeing rate pleasd alow trouble 15/6 due home. girls washt. polly poorly. home. 2 years since ephm ye first fitt. mr benn branard interd day. 19 6 clear till aftn. polly whealor removd mr livermores. went shee much fatagud. mrs livermr seemed sorry shee brot used kind. annevversary mariage, 34 years. went mr livermores polly. john savage threw ephm ye ice abused snowd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 20-25, 1788 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 20 25, 1788 20 7 clear. mr ballard halling writeings. mending cyruss breaches. many people day. jona hook. girls baked. home. 21 e clear cold. mr ballard others went house worship suferd enter. went revd mr fosters, liberty mr thwing mr foster preach house; text geneses 3d chap 8th vers, mr ballard mr livermores evn. polly whealor low infant sick also. home. wido wilms sleeps mr crage married. wido wilms sleeps 22 2 clear cold. mr ballard gentlemen meeting house committee mett colo norths settle business. went mr livermores. polly decaying; infant unwell. wido williams came eving. girls washt washt room. mr page supt mr ballard wrote note eliphelet robbins daniel 10 dollars. went mr livermores. 23 3 snowd, morn cold. makeing candles, 23 doz. hear polly better. home. 24 4 clear cold. mr ballard went magr goodins. calld see polly whealor. shee better, infant home. danl bolton wife dind made mins pies. sleigh sett cuming hill abov house. home. stephen dudly winthrp frz hands night. 25 5 clear cold. mr ballard went doct coneys. home; finisht parthena pair stockins. shee dolly went mr hamlins, jona capt agrys. mr savage wife home. christmas. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 24, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 24, 1789 24 6 birth ebenz hewins dagt, receivd 8/. severe storm rain. calld 1 h pm mrs husseys ebenz hewen. crosst river boat, great sea going. got safe sott mr hewens. crost stream way fleeting loggs got safe wonderful goodness providence. proseeded journey. went beyond mr hainses larg tree blew roots caused hors spring back, life spared. great marvilous thy spareing mercies o god. assisted fallen tree mr hains. went soon came stream, bridg gone. mr hewin took rains, waided thro led hors asisted allmighty power. got safe thro arivd unhurt. mrs hewin safe delivd 10h evng dagt. went mrs husseys mr hewens. cloak burnt wareable. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, may 27 30, 1789 27 4 clear. doct coney williams came see dagt town, gave directions left medisins. opinion complaints bilious kind causes debilyty universal weakness, think shee recover proper atendance medicin. mr ebenz haills lady came carried dear babe home give suck. mrs sally stackpool watcht. lucy got rest. ditoes. great frost. ditoes, frost ys morn. 28 5 clear, frost ys morn. doct coney left bound home. gave lucy potion rhub sat wormwd. shee weak helpless yet, legg much swelld. shee complains pain right sholder. ditoes. doct coleman calld mr towns. 29 6 clear pleast. dagt seems little comfortable. parthena went see babe, finds well. capt haywoods lady yestr dy calld ys morn. feel much fatagud allmost ready faill, sett lucy part ye night; parthena othr part. ditoes. frost ys morn. 30 7 rain ye night ys morn. lucy little mending. parthena drew breast, got small matter milk. given bark snakrt yest d ys morn. shee complains pain right sholder. put baise waist coat bathd brandy applid blister arm. left 1h pm, arivd home 8th. find mr ballard lame left knee, rest famely well. also find capt norcroses lady sent present 1 lb tea 2 lb cotten. doct whitaker, mr foster esqr howard ditoes. frost ys morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 31-Jun. 2, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 31 june 2, 1789 31 d clear cold. doct whitaker preacht meeting house. mr ballard attended fore noone, lame oblidged ly bed aftn. clarrissa barton dolly shee attended worship aftn. pork veal greens dinner. esqr howard dind went see nr savage, mending. nr savages. polly wale came work weak insuing. frost ys morn. 1 2 clear. calld see polly savage. shee inflamation head throat sore. aplid blister arm returnd; went onto ye bed, unwell ramainder ye day. mr ballard went far mr walls see coalt, lost note past mr andrews. daniel robbins sleeps applyd poltis basswd manlys foot, sweld. nr savages. frost. mr ballard began plant. 2 3 clear cool. drest manlys wound, aplyd egg cataplasm scraped horn. feel little comfortable self. went street, calld mr savages. mending mr pollards, mrs blacks brest soar. mr westons, lady unwell. woman name robbins informs saw son town last lords day, mr richardsons dear inft. mrs grant taken giv suck, wife little revivd. mr savages, mr pollard mr westons, mr craggs. great frost ys morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 3-6, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 3 6, 1789 3 4 clear cool. home, wrote broth collins sist barton dagt hannah. jona brot home cod fish. home. wrote letters. 4 5 clear. home. mrs hamlin wrote sister waters. joseph town dind mr ezekiel page also. receivd letter parthena informs dagt gitting better. cyrus went doct coneys medicin home. wrote sist sally. 5 6 clear. jona went board capt getchel compy wh mr burton, bound boston. mr learned went hook mr waids, receivd 6/ attending wife travil april 4. unwell since returnd. went ye hook. 6 7 rain ys morn, cleard warm. luke barton john heartford took breakfst. sent bisquit, veal, codfish, eggs, apples, candles, earthen pott chamr pott, 1 gal molases. boild yn breued ys day. mr learned john bragg dind dolly carried polly savage pair cloath shoes. home. mr hodges brot 1 lb cotten due extract. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 7-12, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 7 12, 1789 7 d clear foren, warm. mr learned roast veal dinner. showers aftn evng. home. wall jabe saw night. home. hitty davis [deld] son. mrswinslow oprt. 8 2 clear morn, showers aftn thunder. mr learned took 4m 400 boards sleeps ys night. doct colmans mr pollards. mrs blacks breast like break. mr pollards doct colmans. 9 3 clear morn. mrs eunice hodskins mr learned doct whiteaker sleep home. revd mr foster removd mr thwings house joseph williams formerly livd. friend taber takeing spruce boards mill sherebah towns acount, ys eving. wrote dagt hannah mr learned deliverd 24/ carrie purchace things bostn. home, wrote dagt hannah. ephraim went school. benn porters wife 10 4 cloudy rain. dot whitaker left early, mr learned also 1h pm, later bound boston board capt agerys. dolly polly cleaning house day. home. mr learned left 11 5 rainy day. james springer anderson taylor tend mill ys night. home. 12 6 cloudy morn, clear aftn. daniel robbins marshfield came agustus ballard sally weber betsy brown polly pettingil allso. mr true mr savage tend one saw ys day night. luke barton informs yt dagt town much better. home cleand yn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 13-19, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 13 19, 1789 13 7 showers. home. dolly spoold warpt 38-1/2 yds. polly wall went home aftn. mr wall robbins tend ye mills ys night. 14 d clear, except shower. mr ballard went see george browns son georg, right thigh much swild. confind five weaks. polly wall came ys evning. georg browns. 15 2 clear cool. calld see mrs rheed. shee unwell 5 weaks, exercised flying pains. calld see mrs hamlin, shee unwell coald. mr true cut foot. dolly polly washt brued. mrs rheeds hamlins. 16 3 clear coole. dolly went away ys morn see sister town. john coutch brot 3 lb wool satisfies attending wife geting bed ye 6th feby last. ye hefer calvd. home. mrs [brown] savage 17 4 clear. home. mrs tarp, true wife, polly savage hannah wall home. 18 5 clear. dolly returnd son towns, informs sister left foot opend last monday. shee unable help self yet. sherebiah came home home. dolly returnd. 19 6 clear warm. old mrs bolton ephm wounded heel stone thrown nabby andrs cows. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 20-25, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 20 25, 1789 20 7 clear morn. calld riseing ye sun sarah white, shee travil forth child, yet unmarried. shee remaind ill thro ye day. sarah white. 21 d xx. birth sarah whites dagt. xx. shower ys morn, clear warm aftern. sarah white safe delivd dagt 9th h morn, returnd aftern attended father. find ephm lambe. returnd mr whites. 22 2 x. birth james savages dagt. x. clear morn, shower aftn. calld 8th hour morn see james savages wife. shee safe deliverd fine dagt 7 h pm. tarried night, receivd fee spining. mr savages. 23 3 shower ys morn. returnd home ye 6th hour, dresst ephms heel. seth juet foster made present blak silk hand kercf. mr ballard georg bolton went cobecy things jona sent boston. son town came infms wife mending. ditoes. 24 4 clear. son town left mr ballard seited give deposition concerning heard judg howard widdow say beef gave revd mr foster. gene lithgoes. 25 5 clear. mr ballard went pitts town. shere biah town made present pound wool. mrs edson wanted corn. dagt town mending. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 26-30, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 26 30, 1789 26 6 shower ys morn, clear aftn. doct whitaker quilling yarn combing flax. dolly weaving. dagt tryphena expired 20 years day since death. hott day continued thro sumer. home. anaversry dagt tryphenas death. 27 7 clear warm. mr saml cumings wife 7 lb butter went mr savages. polly brot cotten yn home, 10 double skeins. cyrus pitts town. agrys 2 vesels came hook, brot corn. mr savages. dolly got webb 35/yd. 28 d clear hott. attended worship public, mr jonston performd. capt stackpool calld doct colman meeting visit mr flint bartons son. mrs foot clarrissa mr savage wife also. cyrus corn grind day. meeting. 29 2 clear hott. went mr andrewss desire see son james, swelling right side. applied cataplasm made yolk egg, honey flower. went mr hamlins. polly savage warpt piece mrs woodward evn. mr andws hamlins. put yarn whiten. 30 3 clear. mr andrewss see son. doct williams opend soar ys aftn. mrs woodward sleeps mr flint bartons son expired yester day interd aftern. dittoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 1-9, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 1 9, 1789 1 4 home. clear weather. parthena returnd winslow, left dagt much comfortable. shee came water mr joseph town mr whealor. home. dagt dollys death 20 years since. 2 5 clear hott till evn, began rain 10. agustus ballard mamy ys day, mr foster lady allso. home. jesse bullin debe black sleep 3 6 clear warm. jesse bullin debe black took breakfast. mr robart crosby home tending yn whiten. home. 4 7 cloudy rain. hm. mr ballard planking ye seller. home. 5 d rainy. mr ballard attended worship. 20 years ys day since death dagt martha. severe thunder yd evng. home. 20 years sence dgt marhs death 6 2 rainy morn, clear aftn. girls washt, mended old callico goun. mr ballard went ye hook. home. ben porter 7 3 clear hott. girls washt house, tended ye yarn, well could wisht. lidia bisbe sick ye collic. mr ballard cyrus dresst ye mill. home. 8 4 clear hott. tended yn till 4 pm went see lidia bisbe sick billious disorder. vast concoarse people returnd home midnight, left doct coney clarrissa barton mr bisbes. 9 5 clear morn warm. mr ballard went pounalboro. gillbh danl robbins took breakft home, boild yn cloath. girls went mr hamlins. clarrissa tarries night. lidia bisbe departed ys life 7h 30m evn. bn home. lidia bisbe expird. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 4-12, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 4 12, 1789 4 3 x. birth stutely springers dagt. xx. cloudy rain. calld stutely springers wife travil ye 4th h morn. shee safe delivrd dagt 3 pm. returnd ye 7th h, left patient well could expected. find mrs burtun mr springers. 5 4 cloudy foren, clear aftn. went mr savages, mr ballard meddow. mr savages. 6 5 clear warm. went see danniel savages wife. shee little comfortable. dagt hannah 20 years old day. capt savages. 7 6 clear hott. home. dicky complains unwell. 8 7 clear hott. mrs cowen mr levy moore wife dind. mrs emerson dagt sleep mr white boston burten ys evn. home. home. 9 d clear hott. mrs emerson dagt mr bullin noone. burtun wife home. home. 10 2 clear except sprineling rain noon. went mrs emerson far mr crages, drank tea calld james moore see mrs shearborn unwell. tarried night, gave lady medisin. shee seemd mutch comfortable. left 2 h pm returnd home, find call go elswhere. mr crages mr sherborns. calld revd mr fosters. levy moore wife 11 3 clear. returnd sherbns. thee fire ragd mr jacksons, people went asist. sherborns. 12 4 clear hott. mrs shaw mrs emerson dagt sleep home. esqr lovjoy lady past home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 13-17, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 13 17, 1789 13 5 clear hott. parthena barton 17 years old ys day. home, quilld yn. mrs emerson left mr ballard ye meddow. home. 14 6 birth doct colmans son. fee receid. xx. x birth mr 15 7 allins dagt. xx. clear. cld 1h morn see mrs allin, find sick. calld thence doct colmans lady travil. shee calld women safe deld fine son ye 11th h. calld see mrs pond winthrop, find dificult sircumstance. applied remedies gave directions left medisin, left sun sett. came mr pollards ye 10th h even. dark rainy came boy hardins. conducted ye river mr mc farling. joseph foster mr allins, find ym well. lady siesd travil little day safe deld 8/th h morn fine dagt arivd safe home. gone home 35 hours. went bed took fine knap afternn. jon winthrop ys day. mr allins, doct colmans mr ponds, mr allins receivd 9/4 ye doctr reward service. mr allins. recievd fee novr 3d 1790 chees, /6 pr pound. 16 d cloudy little rain night. raind ye night. attended divine service aftern tho pain limbs reason great fatagues ye week past. went meeting. 17 2 cloudy morn. girls washing. mr parker home. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 24 28, 1789 24 5 clear pleast. mr voce, hook, cutt throat ys morn. mrs woodwd gave two pumpkins half. receivd letters; mr ballard one doct barton, one broth collins, hannah 1 doct waters, another fm hr aunt, parthena 2 fm hr parents informing well. home. gillbth hr. dolly went mr hamlins weav cyruss cloath. 25 6 foggy morn, clear ye middle ye day, cloudy evn. gillbreath helpt cyrus. pair new shoes brot home ys evn, made foster. home. 26 7 clear warm, day evin. light ye north. gatherd green peas beens ys day. revd mr foster home. 27 d clear foren, cloudy aftern. calld see genny coy unwell mr kennadys. shee freequently exercised pain ocationed obstructions. advised use particellar herbs &c. mr bartun wife evn. mr kennady. 28 2 x. birth mr shaws second dagt. xx. rainy night past morn. calld ye 4th hour go shaws hook. walkt far mr wsns, water. wet indead. found woman safe delivd help mrs cleark. tarried till evn tide came water far mr westons, walkt home ward crick. could pass, water much raisd. went back tarried mr westons. shaws hook. mrs shaw delivd dagt ye 3d hour. decemr 19th, mr shaw sent 1-1/2 lb chocolat 5 lb sugar reward trouble. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 29-Oct. 2, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 29 october 2, 1789 29 3 clear foren, cloudy aftn. came mr westons home ys morn. broth moore james moore also. saw mills go briskly. cyrus went board danes vesel brot wool. went second time got 14 [lb] pork jon dolly finisht weaving wool, 16 yds. took 23 skeins warp 25 filling. 6 lb pickt wool, cyrus, 8-1/2 lb. shee 4 days mr westons. 30 4 clear except lite shower aftern. went capt herseys, mr whites esqr husseys, 6 [lb] sheeps wool old lady go towards owe mr ballard. calld mr fosters door askt questions. mrs husseys. colo north interagated concerning conversation mrs foster concerning conduct. 1 5 clear except showers. company afternn. mrs hanh north, mrs chevers mrs weston cohors. mr savage informs mrs foster sworn rape number men among whome judge north. shocking indeed home. 2 6 rainy morn. calld ye 4th h morn mrs goff travil. walkt daviss store, crost ye river went land hors back, arivd ye 6th h. old mrs goff returnd boston 1 h pm. tarried ys night. mr goffs. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 3-7, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 3 7, 1789 3 7 x. birth john goffs dagt first child. xx. clear. mrs jackson mrs stickney went home. slept hour morn. mrss goffs illness increast shee safe delivrd 11h 30m morn dagt. marm, mrs bullin, mrs ney asistants. mrs jacson came back 1h pm. returnd home 6 aftn, find mr ballard returnd tower surveying yesterdy. mr bullin, west wd informs colo thompson, bilrica, buried child. mr burtin wife mr goffs. first grand child born. 4 d cloudy, wind se. home, pikt green peas gardin. josh sinclear brot us barril herrin, smokt. girls went mr hamlins evng, hannah tarries rainy night. home. 5 2 rainy day. combd 7 lb flax self 4 cyrus. mr ballard went capt coxes. hannah mr hamlins. polly savage drank tea. mr savage returnd jonas hors rode green. informd man drowned joness eddy, came pasengr boston capt howard. home. receivd 1/2 bushel rie capt hersey reward asisting lady. 6 3 rainy day. combd flax. mr ballard went esqr coneys town meeting. thee sweap one mills got thee crank neither ym tended ys night. home. 7 4 clear. mitty devenpord dind. josha sinclare mr richardson drank tea. finisht combing flax, 10 lb tear. girls washt. home. 12 years sence left oxford. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 8-12, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 8 12, 1789 8 5 clear pleast. calld ye 8h morn mr daws hook, wife travil. rigament troop convend mr shubull hinkleys land. tarried mrss daw till evn shee women. shee remaind ill thro ye night. mr daws. muster troops regament. 9 6 x. birth mr daws son, ye 4th. xx. clear foren, cloudy aftn. mrs daw safe deliverd ye 6th hour ys morn fine son weighd 11 lb. tarried till 4 pm, came mr densmores; tarried night. detoes. wife ye 32nt woman put bed since feby. 5th. 10 7 clear pleasant. went mr trues see genny coy, find comfortable; returnd home. mr hatch wife rufus ballard son town beck informs famely well mrs barton delivrd son ye 8th inst. revd mr isaac foster removd varsalboro ys day. mr ballard gone hook. mr densmoors trues. mr hatch went 11 d clear. chickens dinner. day aneversary ordination revd isaac foster church flock town three years since. home. 12 2 birth john cumings 5th son 7th child. xx. cloudy rain. calld 12 o clok morn john cumings. arivd 2, found wife safe delivrd son wd 11 lb., tarried till 6. came home alone, arivd 8, receivd 6/ butter chees trouble time. esqr coney took breakfast mr church dinner. mr ballard left home 3 pm business surveying. informed woman winthrop fell fire burnt degree shee soon expird, girl ye night ye 8th inst fell fire allso, life expected. morn ye 8 inst. mr danniel savages junr oldest son scolt much. john cumings, winthrop. woman namd perry, account accident winthrop hallowell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 11-17, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 11 17, 1789 11 4 clear pleasant. home picking wool. mrs burtin going mr hamlins. girls went eving. widdow ballard varsalboro informd mr richardson hurt sholder returnd home. mr braley sons makeng shingles. home. 12 5 clear pleast. mr richardson informs mr ballard well yesterday. home, quilld dolly. shee drew web ye slay wove 4 yds. robbins came home. 13 6 cloudy day, rain night. home, wound 15 skeins cotten yn quills. mr guile mr vahn also. colo north finisht ye bridg. home. raind evng. 14 7 clear pleasant. home, wound 16 skeins quills. two men boy sleep fire ys night. mr crage crosst ye bridg load hay ys day. light ye north, streams red; extended almost whole hemisphere. home. mr crage winthrop lost mills byfire ys night. 15 d clear pleasant day, cloudy eving. girls went savages. home. 16 2 cloudy. home, wound 18 skeins quills. hannah went mr woodwards. old lady bolton home. 17 3 clear pleasant. wound 4 skeins went see capt sewalls lady unwell. tarried night. doct coney calld mr densmores varsalboro, wife travil. capt sewalls. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 18-22, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 18 22, 1789 18 4 clear cold. mrs sewall well shee yesterday. went mr browns, thomases capt savages, find lefe unwell. tarried night, cold. capt sewalls neighbors. 19 5 cloudy cold. returnd home, calld mr browns, williamss, colo howards, doct colmans capt sewalls; lady comfortable. mr westons, shee unwell. found jons unwell. doct williams coney inform mrs densmore deliverd morn expird ye second hour morn. mr savage wife evng. hannah came home fm hamlins. home. esqr lovjoys dagt densmore deceast child bed. 20 6 clear pleasant. home, wound quills. girls went mr hamlins mrs burtun. jon unwell yet. informd yt mr ballard well yesterday. polly savage bakd home. remains mrs densmore interd ys day. 21 7 clear part ys day, rain night. jona unwell day. danniel robbins went aftern. home. dolly got web 46 yds 1/2. cut patrons shirts put suds whiten. home. jona sick. rain. 22 d rainy day. jon better. home. mr child home. rain. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 23-28, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 23 28, 1789 23 2 clear part ye day, chilly. home mending hoes. girls washt. sons unwell colds. jon staid ye hook ys night. home. 24 3 clear pleasant. mr ballard returnd home surveying, finisht job except planing. feel unwell self. bill asa wing brot letter mr ballard friend. savage boltons wife manly unwell, dolly also. home. 25 4 clear. jon butcherd beef us. stuteler springer paid asisting wife travil 4 last august. home. mr ballard mr wings. home. joseph stackpl dagt born. 26 5 clear foren, cloudy aftn. mr bald gone hook. mr hamlin wife going mr burtuns. dind roast beef. mr foot son took break fast famely seeme better yr coalds. home. 27 6 cloudy chilly. calld see neigr savage, find sick; famely unwell. feel unwell since returnd. mr savages. 28 7 cloudy. mr ballard went doctr coney see mr savage. manley left bound bridgwater. felt weak feeble ys day. home. manly left source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 29-Dec. 4, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 29 december 4, 1789 29 d cloudy. better. famely complaining. mr ballard see nr savage, remains ill famely little better. foster gone ye reach jon things, mr wall allso. home. rain ys night. 30 2 rainy day. mr ballard went hoock needle mended. home, able little work. bn home. 1 3 sun shind part ye day. went see mr savage (doct coney seems little easier. mr shaw wisht informd complaint mrs foster made mr ballard concerning colo norths behavior last august. mr savages. 2 4 cloudy till sun set, clear, pleasant evn. home. girls washt. foster returnd reach, unwell day. home. 3 5 x. birth charls clearks 3d dagt. xx. clear morn. calld epm cowen charls clearks wife travil 2 h morn. shee safe delivrd dagt 3d child, dagts), ye 4th hour. left cleaverly 8 conducted mr pollards. came mr blacks, wife child unwell. calld mr savages, find mending. arivd home 2 h pm. mr ballard gone ye hoock. charls clearks. 36th. gave fee sept 5th acount ye infirmity child fitts. 4 6 clear cool. went mr hamlins. elijah davis carried varsalboro officer. judgment given misconduct mrs foster. mr hamlins. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 5-8, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 5 8, 1789 5 7 clear cold. ice run river. home, made 20 dozn candles. officer went capt biges, apprehended warrant abusing mrs foster last summer. home. judg langdon 6 d snow morn, cloudy day. mr ballard went see mr savage, finds mending. home. foster little better. parthena hoarse yet. home. snow. 7 2 x. birth mrs parmers dagt. xx. cloudy rain. calld see mrs weston betsey sick desorder prevalent. came home ye evn. calld see mr savage, find mending. calld ye 10 h evn mrs parmer travil, conducted river mr petingl mr ballard, former wm howard saml shaw acrost ye river, rode esqr petingails. mrs parmer safe delivd 12 fine dagt cleverly, except cold prevails uneversally. mrs westons, savages esqr petengails. 37th birth. 8 3 clear pleasant. returnd home, feel fatagud. find famely much mrs palmer let 2 lb chocolate 2 lb butter. receivd butter esqr petengaills lady pills shee mr savage watk day. esqr lovjoy calld capt porter, mr burtun wives mr benn porter drank tea latter sleeps jona unwell since returnd winthrop. esqr [petingails] mr savages. david petties wife departed life ye 4th inst child bed. shee left 12 childn moarn loss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 9-15, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 9 15, 1789 9 4 clear. mr porter went mr savage jon unwell day. ill night past, feel weak. dolly went mr woodwards, girls bakt mins pies. home. 10 5 clear morn, cloudy aftn. mr ballard went winthrop. home. mr densmore cut ephm jack coat trousers. home. birth saml peirces son. 11 6 cloudy day, rain night. revd mr foster calld says famely unwell. mr ballard returnd winthrop. mr learned cyrus hoock. bot 1/2 yd cloath parthena. home, knitt hands jonas mitts began foot pair stockins mr ballard. home. rain. 12 7 snow haill, cold wind. home kniting. clear evng. home. snow fel. 13 d cloudy snow. mr savage wife mr pollard even. mr ballard went seek mare find jabish cowen sleeps home. little snow. 14 2 clear cold. home, mended 2 pair hoes cyrus. jabe workt foster got wood. mr ballard brot mare home went river ye fort. wilm peirce came dry flax. mr hamlin, burtun wives spent evining. home. receivd order capt davis 1/6 cash phillip norcrose. 15 3 clear foren, cloudy aftn, snowd evn. mr ballard left home bound norrigwalk. home. ice stopt fort westorn, people crost crick water. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 16-20, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 16 20, 1789 16 4 cloudy. people crost river cake ice swang round eddy east side stopt point mr westons. home mending stockins. mr cast stranger slept home. 17 5 cloudy rain. river open field. e. davis crost hors confineing two cannoes together. jona killd ox ys day purchased mr cast. home mending hoes pickt 1/2 lb cotten cyrus. home. mrs cumings rain. 18 6 cloudy rain. colo north examined conversation mrs foster concerning conduct towards last august. mr carr capt nichols levy rhubin moore dind mr woodward wife evn. let 1 lb cotten comeing worsted. mr ballard returnd canaan. home, carded 1/2 lb cotten. home. mrs [woodward] rain. 19 7 clear part day. mr hamlin seting class. levy reuben moore purchace timber. home, day take care dolly unwell. shee allmost fainted. shee much better draw web sarah bolton [home]. sally [b 35 years [to]day since marriage. 20 d cloudy. calld see james savages son unwell, little comfortable mrs woodward hear two mr braleys sons sick. mr ballard gone mr pollards. [mr] james sava[ges]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

[mr] james sava[ges]. 21 2 cloudy. mr ballard makeing plans. capt nichols, reuben levy moore dind home till eving, calld see nancy savage. girls washt. dolly sett web work, drawn narrow herness. shee cutt drew wove. mr savages. 22 3 clear pleasant. ice moovd fort. colo north went past varsalborough tryal. mr ballard sumond mr parker apear day house isaac foster, give evidence know concerning cause tried. home. mrs rheed home. mrs reed 23 4 cloudy day. mr ballard went varsalboro evidences cause common wealth joseph north esqr. charg north ye night augst 10 th broke house isaac foster night time ravisht wife foster. trial mrs foster apeard calm, sedate unmovd, standing strong atempts made throw aspercions carrecter. shee oath affirmd north broke open door house perpetrated crime rape ravishment, standing exerting selfe much strength would would [sic] admit admit [sic] of.my testemony mrs foster 19 august complaind shee shee [sic] receivd great abuses people unknown throwing stones house, striveing get ye lodg relating abuses worst shee met since mr fosters absence, shee hoped would quite kill could nothing wors unless killd shee also north abused wors person world shee believd best keep troubles selfe mutch shee could till husband returnd shee hopt wd soon. shee also complaind 25 remember day aright) norths treating wors person go woman besids wife, wife jellous relating chargs lais. shee seemd exceedingly troubled shee related tryals, aust question information descend particulars time, last time converst husband absent. also testified n last weak find diarey ye 18th inst), really believd mrs foster treated shee complains deny charg exhibeted also never least reason suspect virtue modesty. 28 inst calld mind mrs foster saying colo north positively unlawfull concourse another woman besides wife begd never mention person, told shee would expose perhaps ruen self shee told supposed enemy informer informer might miss receivd story relative fack. shee replyd father, mean guilty. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

foster night time ravisht wife foster. trial mrs foster apeard calm, sedate unmovd, standing strong atempts made throw aspercions carrecter. shee oath affirmd north broke open door house perpetrated crime rape ravishment, standing exerting selfe much strength would would [sic] admit admit [sic] of.my testemony mrs foster 19 august complaind shee shee [sic] receivd great abuses people unknown throwing stones house, striveing get ye lodg relating abuses worst shee met since mr fosters absence, shee hoped would quite kill could nothing wors unless killd shee also north abused wors person world shee believd best keep troubles selfe mutch shee could till husband returnd shee hopt wd soon. shee also complaind 25 remember day aright) norths treating wors person go woman besids wife, wife jellous relating chargs lais. shee seemd exceedingly troubled shee related tryals, aust question information descend particulars time, last time converst husband absent. also testified n last weak find diarey ye 18th inst), really believd mrs foster treated shee complains deny charg exhibeted also never least reason suspect virtue modesty. 28 inst calld mind mrs foster saying colo north positively unlawfull concourse another woman besides wife begd never mention person, told shee would expose perhaps ruen self shee told supposed enemy informer informer might miss receivd story relative fack. shee replyd father, mean guilty. 24 5 cloudy day. home. colo north returnd aftn. informd justises agreed cause laid sescions next jany. home. 25 6 clear pleasant christmas. ground covered snow two inches deep. home mending ephms trousers cuting raggs coverled. home. 26 7 clear day, cloudy evn. mr carr, page mr foster home mending ephm waist coat. home. 27 d snowd day, cold. cyrus went mr densmores ys evng. home. snow. 28 2 snowd foren. mr wall went far hardins returnd reason ye snow bad traveling. capt weston canaan came help mr ballard plan. home cutting raggs mending cloaths. girls spinning. dolly went savage boltons. home. snow. prev. page december 23 28, 1789 next page home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive browse search stories themes title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 29-31, 1789 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 29 31, 1789 29 3 snowd day. mr ballard capt weston went esqr coneys ys morn, breackfastd yr. joseph town dind home. Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-6, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 6, 1790 1 6 clear. home. mrs read mrs welch mr town kickt knee hors mr pollards. capt weston went dr coneys evn. home. 2 7 birth. robert runelss dagt. clear pleast. ground almost bair. mr town left rode hors. calld 3h pm robert runelss wife; shee safe delivrd dagt 5 left comfortable; walkt home. 10h evn returnd. rode capt westons hors little beyond mr browns; walkt remainder ye way. heard call help arivd. mr braley. birth 1st [asisted] year. 90. death mr sherbu[rn] 4h morn. 3 c clear pleasant. mr wimon snow took breakfast capt weston left bound home. informd joseph fletcher expird day. [home]. death joseph fletch[er] 11h morn. 4 2 cloudy moderate. foster ephm went ye meddow hay. mended winter goun put went mr savages. shee well shee could wish. mr savages. mr sherburn intird. 5 3 clear cold. went mr hamlins see child. siesd ill turn ys morn got cleverly mr ballard doct coneys evng. mr hamlins. mr fletcher interd. 6 4 clear cold. mr ballard returnd evn. capt sewalls ys day writings ye planns. home; finisht makeing bedticks. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 7-11, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 7 11, 1790 7 5 snow last night. clear day except little snow aft. clear evn. home doubleing yarn sewing. dolly finisht weaving web coats, 15-1/4, yesterday put piece savage bolton; day cotten warp. home. 8 6 snowd morn. cleard noon. mr ballard went meddow foster ephm, mr foots brot home 5 pecks wheat jobe springer left asisting wife travil novr 5, 1786. home; finisht makeing apron self sewd cotten shirts. son town came informs dear babe fell hand iron burnt face. sherebh little comfortable. home. elijah davis returnd fm boston. son town came luke barton cutt knee. 9 7 snowd day. hannah wove two ragg coverleds, finisht makeing cottne shift self. killd 5 chickens. mrs hannah thompson went past going mr williamss. home. 10 c clear cold. mr town went informd revd mr moore preacht ye hook ys day. mr savage, broth mr green evng. home. son town left 11 2 clear foren, cloudy aftn. snowd evn. home. girls washt scourd ye east bed rooms floars. capt nichols, reuben moore eley ballard dind mr ballard went ye hook; bot 12 lb butter, pepper ginger. sally white sent 6/ attending travil june 21st 1789. home, [scd]. isaac savage brot fire pan, tongs pokr; price 12/. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 12-17, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 12 17, 1790 12 3 clear blustering. coart setts hollowell. doct whiteaker son, esq lovjoy, revd mr foster mr david smyle sleep home. girls washt ye kitchen scourd puter. home. 13 4 clear morn. snow aft evn. doct whitaker, mr white, prescott smyle sleep nat whitaker came going bed. home. polly savage bakt home. 14 5 clear pleast. mr ballard side veal mr ebenz haills. doct whitaker son, mr foster, esq wood, preskott, porter, smyle, suball pitts, echobad pitts, white sleep home. home. 15 6 cloudy. mrs coal david flelchers wife dind doct, mr foster, preskott, pullin, smyle, white friend gardner sleep home. finisht shirt self. home. 16 7 snow. calld neigr savages see wife, shee unwell. mrs chamberlain mrs welch self tarried night. mr savages. 17 c clear pleast. came home breakfast. mr foster smyle went home. doct, mr ballard white meeting. went mr savages evn, wife afflicted pain teeth. doct mr white sleep dittoes. hallowell, march 21 st 1791 due ep h ballard settlement parthena barton /12/ 19th decem r sundry articles 1-16-2 credt 6 months work l6 pr yr 3= feby 15 th 1792 detr hatt made fitt ware :6: source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 18-25, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 18 25, 1790 18 2 cloudy, cold morn. moderate aftn. doct whitaker left mr balrd went prescotts. d. robbins brotr slept polly bisbe colo north fled judgment. home. home. coln north fled could found. 19 3 cloudy, snow rain. mr ballard returnd. mr foster, lovgy, langdn wood home. home. 20 4 clear cold. mrs cumings brot 6 yds cloth 6/ pr yd. paid 6/ cash 6/ hovey. joseph foster work betsy thomas phile petengel home. home. gaff paid 6/. birth[ 21 5 x birth. beamans dagt. xx clear cold. went mr beamans 11h morn. shee safe delivrd dagt ye 5th h evn. returnd 9; receivd 6/ reward. mr beamans. birth 2nt. 22 6 clear cold morn; moderate aft. mr savages. pollys babe unwell. finisht jona pair socks. oliver coburn killd tree evng. mr savages. coburns death. 23 7 clear cold. mr bolton took mare woods winterd. home. home. 24 c clear moderate. parthena went mr porters winthrop. home. ye mare came home. home. 25 2 clear morn, cloudy evn. parthena clarsa came foster epm went medo. home; mr ballard ye hook. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 26-Feb. 2, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 26 february 2, 1790 26 3 clear morn. cloudy snowd evn. went hook; bot mr arnals 3-1/2 yds made 7/6 yd, 2 skeins silk /6; paid 25/7. clarrisa went foots. jos foster work girls makeing hannah rappa. shee hurt foot fainted. epm new shoes. went ye hook. 27 4 snow storm. clarrissa came foots. home kniting. home. 28 5 clear pleasant. clarrissa went home; girls mr hamlins. home. 29 6 x birth. moses sewalls son. xx. clear cold. calld moses sewalls wife travil 1 h morn. shee delivrd 4 son. left cleverly dinner. receivd 1 lb chocolat 1/2 lb tea. paid 2/8 arnals store mr sewalls. birth 3d. 30 7 clear pleast. mr savages; finisht footing pair worsted hoes. mr savages. 31 c clear pleast. girls went savage boltons evn. mr fields came dr colmans house liv. home. 1 2 snow storm. shee unwell. girls went mr pollards. savages. 2 3 x birth. isaac savagess son. xx. clear. calld savages early ys morn. shee delivrd son 3 h evn. tarried night. doct whitaker son slept hors fell bank, men helpt mr savages. birth 4th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 5-9, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 5 9, 1790 5 6 clear pleasat. went bed 5h m took fine nap. dagts went mr bisbes aftern; returnd midnight. hors pestered mutch. mr boltons. 6 7 snowd fore n. calld see nancy savage. shee collic. administred oil clister gave relief. returnd 1h pm, went colo sewalls get lady make bonnet; mr crosbys store. bot 2-1/4 yds gause 1/10, 1 paper pins /9, 2 yds ribbin 2/5. informd mr redington luke bartons life expected. calld mr pollards. shee informs son towns famely well last wedensday. biah low indeed. mr savages see nancy. snowd. 7 c cloudy snow. calld savage bolton see wife exercised pain. went administerd remedies gave relief; returnd 2h pm. cyrus went parthena; brot home dusk. mr boltons. death mrs hart last evng. 8 2 snowd fore n. foster went mr woods hay. girls disapointed going winthrop made mrs black visit aftern. brother town sleeps home. informd luke barton alive ys morn speechless. saml john braly sleep home. brotr town sleeps ys night. 9 3 clear cold. broth town went capt fille brown mrs betsy chevers old mrs hart interd day. shee expird ye 8th inst. home. funeral. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 10-13, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 10 13, 1790 10 7 rainy day. home; feel much comfortable yn done late. jon returnd winslow. informs son town removd mr springs farm mrs barton livs well sherebiah much lately yt nathan haywood sick fiavour. benn porter ys day; famely well. home. 11 c rainy. calld see mrs cragg exceeding ill. shee taken 2 potions rhubarb thee bark allso since friday noon. phisic opperated till shee expird. tarried walcht. sett alone. shee began puke 4 h morn. mr craggs. 12 2 rainy. took little nap ys morn. doct coney calld; plainly told famely mrs cragg must die. shee acordingly expire 10 h evn lest struggle. mrs pollard self mrs voce put grave cloaths. mr pollard lady tarried night. mrs voce self allso. ditoes, wife expird. sally came giv infant suck. 13 3 clear pleasant. tarried mr craggs asisted able. dagt dolly washt judy huston allso. mr black mr bent sett night. corps coffind sett west room. purge smell ofensive. dittoes. tarried night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 17-21, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 17 21, 1790 17 7 clear pleasant. mr ballard gone measure road side mr craggs ye top ye hill north finisht pair hoes self. informd capt reed arivd larg quantity corn. river opend low mr livermores. mr jones crost pollards ferry hors 2 cows. ephm went mr woodwards gardin seeds. home. finisht stockins. river opend. death mrs sherburns child. 18 c clear morn. cloudy aftn, wind chilly. mr black pollard dolly came home mr hamlins; informs mr craggs inft well. home. 19 2 snowd showers day. home. girls washt, began pair stockins mended foster pair. mr pollard informd ye death widdow sherburns dagt child. allso hear old mr smith sick. revd isaac fosters 1st dagt born night. 20 3 cloudy till ye 11th h morn sun shone. mr ballard foster gone [sic] meeting ye proprietors town ship calld unity house mr carr. neigr savage informd revd isaac fosters lady safe delivd dagt last evng cleverly. home; feel unwell. cyrus borrowed 40 sleigh widdow coburn dolly weav pice benn porter. home. 21 4 rainy foren. cleard pleast ye 3 h pm. mr ballard bot two bushels corn meloy; gave 10/ cash. home. foster went eat anything ys day. samuel cumings junrs son drowned. home. saml smith sustenance father sick. death. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 1-4, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 1 4, 1790 1 7 clear pleasant. went see benn browns lady; find shee gone mr woodwards. went saw shee unwell; seems much dejected acount far distant parents friends. jona went morn home bound winslow. willim haywood doct coney ebenz haills dagt sick yester day. mr browns woodwards. mr ballard unwell. 2 c clear pleast morn. desired mr cragg go see infant; soar mouth. find like favourable. calld, returnd, mr craggs. polly bisbe betsy chever mr hamlins. mrs burtun went mrs craggs grave. mr hamlins mr craggs. 3 2 cloudy rain. mr ballard town meeting. daniel coney, esqr chosen represent ys town ye general coart. receivd letter brother jona apl ye 21st mr joseph white, informing famely well. jona came home, brot 50 loggs wilm haywood came mr haills children mending. home. receivd letter broth moore rochester apl 21, 1790. 4 3 clear. mr ballard went mr goodins seeds. haywood savage bolton went bring loggs. cyrus georg boltons cum help jon unwell. atempting swett seems reliev georg brot barril pork bents us. jon sick. sett nurs night. home. jona unwell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 1-7, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 1 7, 1790 1 3 raind ye day. dagts washt. home. esq coney saild boston ys aftn. home. 2 4 clear cool morn. went see mrs bisbee, find mending. ms becky unwell. sickly time among us. mr bisbes wrote brorcollns. 3 5 fine, clear pleasant day. home. mrs mash mrs page old lady informs shee extracted 756 childn ye coars practice. son town allso; informs wife childn exercised influenzy brother low. mrs bolton mrs brown home. mrs mash son town sowd beet seed. 4 6 clear. son town left aft breakfast. wrote sist waters brotr elijah sent mr hamlin sett oxford afternn. home. wrote brotr elijah sisr waters. 5 7 cloudy rain. dolly gone winthrop. home kniting helping carry chips ye gardin burn. home. 6 c x birth. magr stickneys dagt. xx. clear hott day. calld magr stickney half two ys morn. shee lady safe delivd dagt 5h evn. calld see mr ezekiel pages lady; find sick ye influenza. administred thing relief returnd mr jacksons 11. tarried night. took care patient. mr jacksons. birth 20th. receivd 6/. 7 2 dittoes. raind day. tarried ys night; watcht, patient exercised pain. ditos. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 16 21, 1790 16 4 clear. home. finisht fosters stockins, informd wounded self. mr burtun lady evng. suball pitts echobad pitts informs broth poorly wound. home. jonan taken warrant, bent voce allso. 17 5 clear. home. workt door yard. mr foster sleeps informs esqr hussey departed life yesterday 7 h pm. mr kingsbury mr burtuns. jona others tryal pulling westons old rack cost 24/. home. esqr hussey expird yesterday prisson. 18 6 clear. home. workt yard feel fatagud. mr ballard gone pitts town. wilm haywood informs sherebiah yet alive low. home. burial esqr hussey. 19 7 showers ye morn; clear rest day. workt ye garden. mrs woodward mrs reed made 10 dzn candles. mr ballard bot 2 yds cloath capt rodgers; price 15/ pr yd. home. 20 c clear cool. home. home. 21 2 clear. mr ballard went ye hook meeting proprietors unity. went mr hamlins fort. old lady howard low influenzy. colo sewalls. find son dagt town wido barton returnd. gillbreath 4 men washinton. david page work. calvin edson drowned river night. attempted cross supposd fell asleep fell board. fort western neigsr. edson drowned evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 27 30, 1790 27 c shourry day. mrs ellis son david went home morn. home. home. 28 2 cloudy. son dagt town sett capt herseys ys aftn, saw cloud arise; returnd smart shower. mr ballard went mr carrs meeting chuse juriers. mr carr magr goodin chose grand jury. capt page andw goodin petty &c. home. 29 3 cloudy morn. cleard 8h morn. childn left us bound home. dolly went mr ballard mr kingsbury went pitts town. went mr arnals store, bot 9 yds callimanco 2/pr yd. calld return mr hamlins. returnd oxford; wives sister came capt weston sleeps hr. receivd letters; 1 doct barton, 1 fm brh collins 1 fm sister waters mr hamlin. went hook. recvd letters oxford charlton. receivd 3/4 mrs walker part fee. 30 4 clear. mr ballard went wins low. wed garden went see mr savage. pain ear. laid 2 blisters, one neck 1 arm. wife came 9 evn, says much exercesed pain. mr savages. brothr ebenzr inft deceast day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 1-7, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 1 7, 1790 1 c clear. mr ballard thee girls attended worship,thee church chester hollowell receivd thee sacrament ye supper; many consented result late counsel could consent articles faith, mentioned church sind invited join receiving ordinance. home. mr emerson preacht town. 2 2 clear. home, houghd cabbages, cucumbers &c. mr lee mr dexter allso. son towns famely well. moses white sent 3 lb wool. home. 3 3 clear except small shower. mr lee settle mr ballard cyrus. knit fore n, ashing cabbages mr reed calld see wife. arivd sun sett. mrs woodwd, ingerham williams asistants. mr reeds. mr porter brot cyrus 16-1/2lb lamb. 4 4 x birth. mr reeds 2nd son. xx. clear. mrs reed safe delivd son second child, sons, sun rise. left inft cleverly returnd home 11h foren. went bed, slept till 2 pm went pulld flax. ditos. mrs reed sent ephm half chees, wd. 2-1/2 lb. birth 21. 5 5 clear except shower little sun sett. pulld flax. went twice see mrs welch unwell. thee girls helpt ye aftern. mrs welches. 6 6 clear part ye day, showers. pulld flax. girls helpt aftn. david page came work home. hannah 21 years old day. 7 7 clear. pulld flax foren, went see mrs [reed] aft, ill turn gott better. receivd letter broth davis june 14th. mr reeds. recd letter. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 8 13, 1790 8 c clear warm. parthena went mr foots, hannah went far mr bisbes calld see mrs woodwd sick measels. calld see mr isaac clearks lady seisd pukeing disintary attended severe pain stomach. gave annis seed decoction manna dissolvd wards 4 soap pills expelld thee wind, gave relief. mr clearks watcht lady. mrs jackson tarried allso. 9 2 clear warm. returnd home, left patient much comfortable. find son town return, famely well. doct williams son collins moore sleep dittoes. receivd 1/2_ ye medesin& time spent. 10 3 rainy foren, clear part aftn. doct wilms son, mr moore took breakfast dind went 3 h pm, hilld cabbages ye door gatherd 2 pails full pees helpt shell home. 11 4 clear. helpt hannah hous work fore n, houghd ye east gardin aftern. hannah washt floors scourd ye puter. home. 12 5 clear hott. wed gardin ye barn. cucumbers vines. cyrus went varsalboro. home. widdow ballard 13 6 clear. mrs weston shee went mr bisbes aftern. mr ballard hannah went lecter. mr performd. gatherd parsnip pepper grass seed. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 7-13, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 7 13, 1790 7 5 xx birth. capt husseys son. xx. clear. capt husseys lady safe deld son 11 h morn. returnd mr whites 4 pm, tarried night. left patients cleverly. mrs norcross left yesterday boston. new born inft wd 10 lb. capt husseys. birth 25th.first born. receivd 6/ may 10, 1791 sally hussey. 8 6 cloudy, rain night. mrs white sent women. night vis old mrss white, norcss, moses benn whites wives; jackson, stickney, coburn lidia, sister. slept night. [patient] ill. whites. 9 7 x birth. jere whites son. xx. cloudy rain foren. mrs white safe deld son 10 h morn. tarried till 4 pm went home water. feel much fatagud. informd mr hamlin burjis lost linning. dittos. birth 26th. firstborn. 10 c clear. mr ballard went meeting day. mr james page noon. loin lamb dinner. mr gillman tea. cold night. home. 11 2 clear. mr ballard mr pollards foren, mr james pages aftern. cyrus went mr craggs winthrop. selvester moore burjes sleep home. 12 3 clear. mr ballard came mr pages, left spectacles; went back calld see edsons infant extreamly ill; tarried watcht. mr kennadys. 13 4 clear. doct coney came see child, orderd blisters left senna drops. came noon, left child ill. cyrus near night. neighbours thot expireing. dittoes. dolly hannah rockwood source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 14-20, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 14 20, 1790 14 5 rainy. mr chamberlin calld see wound dagt polly right legg. dresst lint spirrit. wm haywood polly bisbe girls went mr burtuns. mr ballard ye hook propriators meeting. calld great hast see mrs hamlin fitt. walkt applyd vinagar lips, temples hands onions feet shee revivd. tarried night. mrs edsons inft expird last night. mr chamln see mrs hamlin fitt. death. 15 6 rainy till near night. returnd mr hamlins ys morn. left better tho weak. mr baker unity dind mr ballard made settlement receivd order ye proprietors collector due mr ballard. mrs edsons child interd ys aftern. mr hamlins. funeral mrs edsons child. hannah puting cyruss webb. 16 7 rainy morn, cleard aft n. mrs woodwd mrs brown dress polly chamberlins wound. carried ointment made mellolott. colo sewall evng. hannah began weave cyruss webb. mr chambns. 17 c clear. well could wish. attend public worship; mr ballard home. 18 2 clear. mr ballard mr brookss business. mr fellows unity sleeps home. finisht giting mustard seed. mr cragg woodward returnd westward. home. fellows 19 3 clear. mr ballard gone preambulate ye line hollowell varsalboro. went colo sewalls, tarried night. colo sewalls. 20 4 clear. dittoes mr brooks, capt belchers colo howards. mrs polly unwell. thoms sewalls wife mr brooks. night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 21-27, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 21 27, 1790 21 5 returnd. calld mr blacks dind. calld 9h evn mr snells, wife travil. mr winslow attended arivd 11. ditoes mr snells. 22 6 x birth. snells dagt. xx. cloudy part ye day. mrs snells ill thro day safe delivd 9h evn dagt, first child. mrs cox, bullin, blanchard, brown mrs winslow attendants. mr snells. birth 27th. 23 7 clear pleast. left mrs snell infant cleverly; receivd 6/ reward. calld capt husseys, made present waistcoat little son. calld colo sewalls colo howards. mrs polly better. got home noone, finisht pair mitts mr ballard. dittoes. returnd home. 24 c clear pleasant. mr page widdo coburn dind attend worship aftn, girls. mr ballard went thee hook evn. meeting. 25 2 cloudy. mr ballard went hook twice day. ebenz church mr fuller nathan dexter sleep parthenia receivd letter aunt barton; well. finisht mr ballard pair stockins. [home]. mr fuller winslow sleeps snowd evng. 26 3 rainy day. john peter jones capt hussey dind home. home. mr jones 27 4 clear cold, hard frost morn. thee ground remaind frose day. mr ballard, gillman thos stickney left ye 11h morn surveying tour seven mile brook, loting setlers lotts. home. mr ballard sett surveying. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 28-Nov. 3, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 28 november 3, 1790 28 5 cloudy, raind evng. home. helpt cutt take care beef, knitt brot 26 cabbages seller ye door; got beets carrots allso. hadlock executed day. home. hadlock executed. john trask expird. 29 6 clear pleasnt. home, well could wish. mrs woodwd drank tea home. 30 7 clear pleast. mrs hannah woodwd clarrissa barton went see mrs burtun. mrs shaw dagt returnd ye westwd. john trask interd. mr burtuns. 31 c clear pleast. attended worship aftn. mr jones two men sleep night. meeting. mr jones came 1 2 clear foren, cloudy aftn. mr jones left aftr dinner. men waited ye tide take boards mr williams informs yt taylors house fell morn, thro good providence one receivd hurt. famely removd house mr cottle livd. polly brot bed sled. gott cabbages seller, 50 heads. home. mr jones left raind night. 2 3 clear. home, helpt childn git 58 cabbages doore. knit mr brown dind home. 3 4 cloudy. home knitting. hannah dolly went help quillt bed quilt mrs burges. got returnd home late ye evng. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 4-9, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 4 9, 1790 4 5 rainy, cleard evng. saws go briskly. mr rawson workt jona. home. dolly got mrs boltons webb took ye loom 30 yds. home. 5 6 clear pleast. dugg parsnips. home, finisht hannah pair thread stockins. receivd 1/4 dollar pisterrene mr andrews, part attending wife ye 9th may last. 1/2 bshl wheat august, price 3/. /3-1/2 due home. 6 7 clear ye day. greatly alarmd morn fears yt little son drownd crossing mill pond. sent mr savages mistook directions went mr childss. mr jones day. man richardson sett rafft, got hicht rock returnd, tarries ye next tide. dolly made ephm pair trousers. mrs polly mc kethney judy hueston drank tea home. mr jones two men sandy river sleep alarmed ephm. 7 c clear cool. attended public worship. deacon coney made ye 1st prayer, esqr petingil ye last forenn. colo sewal ye 1st aft red doct dodridges discoarses, mr livermn last prayer, attended. polly bisbe came help us. meeting. richardson went rafft. 8 2 clear. girls quilted bed quillt. went mr craggs; spent evng. went mr westons, bot 3dz needles, 1-1/2 lb sugar. calld mr craggs savages. mr westons. polly bisbe 9 3 clear. home. girls quilted two quilts. hannah rockwood mrs benjamin helpt evng. bakt mins pumpkin pies. mrs porter home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 10-13, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 10 13, 1790 10 4 clear. girls neighbours help ym quilt bed quilt. 15tn ladies, began quillt 3h pm, finisht took y evn. 12 gentlemen took tea. danced little supper, behavd exceeding cleverly; returnd home ye 11th h. home. company. 11 5 clear cool. mr savage lady took breakfast borrowd mr browns hors went see polly taylor, find low. mrs jackson, brown, bolton pets kenny supt mr jackson gave 3/ polly taylor. informd hannah north sick. mr taylors. 12 6 cloudy day. calld colo sewall see lady labour. shee ill call assistance day. slept till 1h morn shee calld neighbours assistance. colo sewalls. 13 7 x birth. colo sewalls son. xx. clear butifull day. mrs sewall ill till 3 h pm shee thro divine asistance made living mother living son, 3rd child. mrs brooks, belcher, colman, pollard voce assisted us. went colo howard evng ask assistance polly taytor. colo sewall gave 6/8 reward, conducted ye river. calld mr craggs, informd hannah north thot expireing morn revived. mrs colman informd doct, husband, gave hannah dose callom calomel worms gave relief. went next day see mrs goodin took cold, brot sittuation shee arivd home found capt silva learned oxford. letters. dittoes. capt silva learnedof oxford sleeps brot letter fm broth collins, 1 fm. sister barton oct. 31. jon killd oxen. birth28th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 14-20, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 14 20, 1790 14 c cloudy. leut hains learned took breakfast brother left ye capt bound directly oxford. mrs betsey howard mrs colman sent things polly taytor; wine, sugar, apples, bread fine linning raggs. began rain 9 evn. home. capt learned left therewas meeting abisha cowens ys day. 15 2 cloudy foren, clear pleast aft. helpt ephm john savage git french turnips cabbages. knitt dolly finisht weaving cyruss cloath, wove mr hamlins; 8-1/2 yds. mrs woodwd informs hannah north mending weak indeed. home. raind. 16 3 cloudy, rain. home. mrs brown went past, informs hannah north weak shee faints take bed. ephm john moovd part ye fence. home. rain. 17 4 rainy day, snow. much put fewel. home, finisht pair linning stockins dolly began ephm pair woollinany. home. rain snow. 18 5 snow rain. mrs benjamin quilted bed quilt self girls mrs chamberlin helpt got ye first ye evng. home quilting. snowd raind. 19 6 rainy day. hoist gates prevent ye foundation ye bridg fleeting. made 11-1/2 dzn candles. borrowed 11 lb tallow jona. home. rain. 20 7 cloudy rain. clear ye evng. mr town famely well. home, finisht stocking ephm. sent voce tea sugar; wd send home. rain. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 1-8, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 1 8, 1790 1 4 clear pleasant. left patients cleverly returnd 11 hours morn. mr cowen let 3/4 lb tea 1 lb sugar. began foot pair hoes mrs pollard. set late work. mr cowens. 2 5 clear. home, finisht hoes began yesterday. spent part ye night halling cabages. many roting. home. 3 6 x birth. asa williamss dagt. xx. cold snowy day. calld ye 6th hour morn see mrs williams. shee safe delivrd 4th dagt 1 h pm, returnd home ye 6th evn. found mr ballard returnd tour surveying. began foot pair hoes mrs pollard. receivd 6/ reward. asa williamss. birth 31st. snow. 4 7 clear. home, finisht ye hoes began last evng. mr ballard bot guire paper. home. 5 c clear morn. mr savage aftn. home; cold day. home. 6 2 clear cold. mrs h. thomson informs mrs williams cleverly. home; knitt pair mitts ephm. ephm cowen sent 3/4 lb tea. home. parthena gone work mrs burtun. 7 3 clear cold. home, footed pair hoes patty mended hoes. home. funeral mr goodins child. 8 4 clear cold. home." implied] mr ballard planing. mr foster ephm went mr james hinkleys 4 sheep, ye first ownd 14 years. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 9-17, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 9 17, 1790 9 5 clear cold. home mending hoes. mr savage shod oxen. old mrs wheelor sleeps mr ballard makeing plann. home. 10 6 cloudy ye wind ye s. mending hoes. mrs wheeler left breakfast. doct whitaker son sleep mr ballard makeing plann. informd andw goodins youngest child expird ye 6th inst. home. dr whitaker 11 7 cloudy rain. mending hoes. mr ballard planing. ephm cowens informs wife well could wish. home. 12 c severe storm snow. cleard 6 evn. mr savage home. mr ballard went mr pollards carry plann conveyd capt weston canaan. juet foster left evng. home. snow. 13 2 snowd ye ye day. jona mr field butcherd 2 swine us. mr ballard ephm got wood. home mending cloaths. mr burtun sett hoops three tubs us. dolly almost fainted. home. snow. 14 3 cast part day, moderate. home mending hoes knitting. dolly faint turn eving, pain side. gave caster. home. birth d fletchers dagt. 15 4 clear pleast day, cold night. mr ballard ephm giting wood. finisht footing pair hoes ephm. mr gillman supt home. 16 5 snow storm. home cutting raggs coverled. mr ballard mending mill, cyrus picking mr fields helpt home. 17 6 clear cold. home. hannah gone watch polly mc kethney. dolly unwell. made peneroyal tea. saml fosters legg amputated aftn. home. old mrs prescotts arm cutt morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
