title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 18-23, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 18 23, 1790 18 7 x birth. benn browns dagt. xx. receivd fee novr 22nt 1791 turkeys. clear cold. dolly unwell, took soap pills, several faint turns. went see polly mc kethney, find low strength spirrits. doct colman let blood feet. calld ye 8th h evn hast see mrs brown. shee safe deld 9 h 30 m fine dagt, 7th child. mr brown absent. mrs woodwd self tarried night. mr craggs browns. birth 32nt. death polly taylor. 19 c clear cold. returnd mr browns 1 h pm. jona attended funeral polly taylor. [mr mrs] hamlin, burtun, patridg, hannh rockwood parthena supt mr browns. funeral. 20 2 clear forn, cloudy aft. mrs densmoore cutt gown. hannah finisht makeing dolly much shee pally mc kethney better. judy heuston fitts ys evng. home. mrs densmore 21 3 clear cold foren, snow aftn. went see ephm cowens wife james savages child. came back mr craggs. tarried watcht pally mckethney; brother john loes harris watcht. capt savagess, jamess mr craggs. 22 4 clear day, snowd night. came home aftn, sent evn dagt hannah watcht. polly restless, marm came mr craggs. mr craggs. 23 5 clear. mr craggs, tarried night. mrs jones sett pally rested better. doct williams thee last night. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 24-27, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 24 27, 1790 24 6 clear forn, cloudy aft. left polly 1 h pm comfortable. find dolly ye operatn phisick, waited feel fatagud. ditoes. snowd night. 25 7 cloudy cold. mr cragg calld see polly mc kethney. shee better. mrs voce came changd linning. find dolly ill return, blister painfull. mr putnam 7 mile brook took break fast snowd night. 26 c cloudy. dolly weak faint. helpt fainted. hannah complains pain head. mr hamlin medisin sally siesd pukeing purging. home. 27 2 clear. mr cragg calld see polly. shee seems better respects, blister ye left arm looks black. helpt remove one bed another returnd. dolly faint indeed till near night, shee seemed much comfortable, sett ye evng. calld 10 h evn see thee wife shuball wiesom. met difficulty ye way beyond mr burjeses. came back house, went us. arivd safe, tarried night. mr craggs wiesoms. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 28-31, 1790 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 28 31, 1790 28 3 birth. capt burjess dagt. clear cold. mr burjes calld wiesoms sun rise wife travil. shee safe deld dagt sun sett. tarried night, nece unwell, little son allso. [capt] burjeses. birth 33. 29 4 sun rose clear, snowd soon left patients comfortable. calld see sally hamlin hannah cragg; find ym better. polly mc kethney seems little better. arivd home 10 morn, find mr porter wife dolly better. hannahs face badly scolt expected. shee spilt boiling licour foot day scolt jane welch came go see mother. went. complaints pain head limbs. mr porter wife hannah went mr burtuns. ditoes. hamlins mr craggs mrs walches. mrs porter gave 1/2 lb wool. 30 5 x birth. shubal wiesoms son. xx. clear cold indeed. calld ye dawn day wiesoms, found wife suffering want help. shee deld son ye 8th h. inft feirfull wd expire revivd left mother child cleverly. arivd home 12/ o clok, went mr burjeses. gave wife medisin, walkt home. calld see polly mc kethney mending slowly wiesoms. birth 34. 31 6 clear cold. went mr craggs. dolly remains mutch shee doct williams went see capt page returnd, tarried night. close ye year mr craggs watcht. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 8, 1791 1 7 severe snow storm. mr craggs. pally better. sett part ye night. mr craggs. 2 b clear part ye day. dittoes. sett night. polly little wandering feaver fitts. dtoes. 3 2 cloudy. tarried till near night. polly got bed, bed made, fitt ye feaver. find dolly mutch left hannah weaving blankett. went bed early slept well. dtoes. polly sick yet. snowd. 4 3 cloudy, weather moderate. doct coney took acount births deaths ye year past minnits. home. home. 5 4 clear pleast, thawd mr hollowell, ye tinker dind. pattey anne bullin dind drank tea. james cowen wife took tea jonas red colt hookt one ye steers, hir entrales came jona returnd sewed rent. shee standing, expird morn. home. parthena gon burtuns. home. jona lost colt. parthena gone. pattys new shoes brot home. 6 5 cloudy morn. parthena returnd morn. shee dagts went help mrs pollard quillt bed quillt. dolly tarried night. home. foster sleeps home. 7 6 cloudy warm. home" implied] hannah got ye coverleds 4 ym put wove web shirts ephm patty. home. 8 7 clear colder. home, made candles, 18-1/2 dzwt. mr pitts dolly wove 10-1/2 yds. home. mr bullin paid wheat 2-1/2 bl. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 9-15, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 9 15, 1791 9 b clear day, snowd evn. mr pitts went breakfast. mr savage took brkft home. mr ballard went colo norths ys evng. mr pollard informs yt moses returnd ye woods wound hand. home. snow. 10 2 clear cold. mr wiesom ys morn advise, wife dangerous saircumstance. sent stiptic powder gave gave relief. went self, left things take. calld mr hamlins, wife well could wish; mr burjess, shee comfortable shee mr westons, shee well usual; mr craggs, polly apears mending. removd chamber ys day. came home dusk. son dagt town little daft came left famely well. mrs pollard paid 1/6 work mr wiesoms neigrs. phinehas pane, dagt born. 11 3 clear cold. mr ballard went coart. mr town wife dolly pitts town. mr field, rust, shaw piercs son dind. esqr weston leut learned supt home, ye girls washt floors. finisht shirt patty workt one epm. home. 12 4 clear. mr titcom took breakfast. capt slackpool, bullin, goodin town, yr wives dind took tea mr benn porter tea, home. dolly seems well. doct coney left bitters. home. number friends visit. 13 5 clear. home. son dagt town, mr porter others break fasted &c, &c. home. 14 6 clear. esqr weston, mr pitts foster, son dagt town took breakfast. calld see polly bisbe, tarried night. delirious feavor fitt. bisbes. 15 7 cloudy snow. polly little easier. left near night. calld mr taylors, youngest child measels. arivd home aft sun sett. ditoes. son town went winthrop. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 16-21, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 16 21, 1791 16 b clear pleast. son dagt town parthena returnd evng. calld saml cumingss wife labour. shee delivd dagt 1h 30m, 5 m arival. parents one else. mrs briggs hamlin delivery; tarried thro ye night, patient exercised much pain. saml cumings. j. kenny go see wife. 17 2 x. birth saml cumings dagt. xx. severe snow storm. left mrs cumings 2 h pm little easier. got home thro much diffuculty, find yt mr kenny soon left home last evng. hear yt esqr coneys lady delivrd dagt morn 10 h. ditoes. birth saml cumings dgt 1 h. esqr coneys dagt 10 h morn. 18 3 clear cold. home, feel falagud worries abroad. cumings brown case tried. jeury brot favour cumings. home. 19 4 clear. cool pleast sun. son dagt town took yr departure 12 o clok. jewet foster dressing flax. went see polly mc kekney, find seting much better. mr craggs mr blacks. childn left us homewd bound. 20 5 clear. home. mrs rokwood came mr ballard coart, ye jurey dismist. home. 21 6 clear cold. mr ballard went home bound sandy river. calld see wm densmore, siesd collic, got ease arivd. returnd home went directly mr bisbes, tarried watcht. pollys feaver high ye night. wm howard came evn. wind shifted ye s blew hard. mrs bisbe anxious polly. mr bisbes. mrs rockwood went home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 21 26, 1791 21 6 clear cold. mr ballard went home bound sandy river. calld see wm densmore, siesd collic, got ease arivd. returnd home went directly mr bisbes, tarried watcht. pollys feaver high ye night. wm howard came evn. wind shifted ye s blew hard. mrs bisbe anxious polly. mr bisbes. mrs rockwood went home. 22 7 clear cold, ye wind shifted nw, blew high. mr howard brot home aftn. polly much shee days past, helpless. mr bisbes. 23 b clear cold. home. mr densmore says son much mr ballard came mr rusts sandy river day. home. 24 2 cloudy cold. mr ballard ye hook meeting ye proprietors unity. home, finisht pair mitts patty. home. 25 3 cloudy cold. unwell, rise till mr pinkam calld go mr bisbes, dagt polly siesd complaint nervs. made use pipe phisic gave relief shee rested much bitter shee nights past. capt haywoods lady watcht. mr bisbes. mrs haywood &doct williams evng. 26 4 x. birth mr blaks son. xx. cloudy morn. calld mr bisbes day dawn mr james blak see wife. shee deld 7h 13m morn fine son. tarried thro day night; awake y ye night. dos mr blaks. birth 1st asisting ys year. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 27-31, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 27 31, 1791 27 5 cleard away 10 h morn went mr craggs see polly mc keckney, find much comfortable. left mrs blak comfortable could expected. mr blak gave 12/ reward. arivd home ye 11th h, find mr ballard gone pitts town hay, epm mr blaks. hannah went see polly bisbe ys aftn. 28 6 x birth mr catons dagt 1st child. xx. fee recd july 21. cloudy. calld mr field go see mrs caton 1 h morn, walkt allmost com arivd. put safe bed dagt 3, returnd home 7. husband home. calld 8 see capt burjess little son scalt left arm yester morn. drest ye arm. calld see mrs hamlin burtun, receivd 6/ mr burtun reward assisting wife travil sept 23d. calld see mrs blak, find cleverly. calld mr savages rest self, find mr benn leighton came home. girls gone see polly mc keckney. hannah informs polly bisbe better. mr chamberlins, burjess, neigrs. birth 2nt assisted ys year. rested bed yn 2 3 hours sinc tuesday morn. 29 7 clear, pleasant day. home mending cloaths. mr ballard ye meddow. home. 30 b snowd day. mr ballard jona attended worship ye coart hous. mr smith winthrop performd. wilm haywood sleeps clear evnn. thoms kenny calld 11 h see wife. got ye 12th. kennys. 31 2 x. birth t. kennys dagt. xx. began snow latter part last night severe storme. wind high. mrs kenny deld 9 h morn dagt. left inft well could expicted returnd 3 pm. kennys. birth 3d. june 24th receivd 6/ mr kenny. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 1-4, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 1 4, 1791 1 3 clear. dolly unwell. gave senna manna anis seed rheubarb, operated kindly. mr ballard went mr crosbys bot 5-1/2 pints w e rhum, 2 lb butter, 1 lb sugar 1/2 dozn bisquit. home, feel fatagud. jabe cowen work aftn. jona pitts town stones. home. 2 4 clear cold. severe pain head ys morn, calld see mrs caton. shee taken cold pain hip. feel much better returnd. dolly unwell thro day, seemd revivd ye evng. mrs benjamin spent ye evng mr chamberlins. 3 5 birth mrs welchs dagt. clear. calld 9 ys morn see mrs welch labour. shee delivd 12 dagt, dead born, ill delivery. tarried till 9 evn shee seemed little comfortable. calld thomas hinklys. mrs welches. birth 4th. mr ballard gone wiscasset. 4 6 x. birth thoms hinklys son. xx. clear. mrs hinkley delivd 1 h morn fine son. left comfortable 8, returnd home. calld see mrs welch, find well could expected, sister cyphers calld immedialely return see willm densmore find low, thigh sweld much saw jona ephm gone meddow thos hinkleys. birth 5th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 5-8, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 5 8, 1791 5 7 clear moderate. went see esqr conys lady, find little comfortable shee shee troubled biles soar nipples. calld helpt git mrs welch bed, shee well could expected. calld see mrs blak, shee ill turn yesterday better. dolly seems better evng. mr ballard returnd wiscasset. esqr coneys, mrs welchs mr blaks. 6 b clear pleast. went see mrs welch ye forenn, find little easier. calld mr savages. dolly rode comfortable. mr hamlin burtun yr wives, mr patridg mrs h. rockwood spent evn mr blackman calld see wives sister. fall ye sleigh way. receivd hurt, tarried night. mrs thompson watcht. went bed ye latter part ye night, gave ye lady senna manna seeds left ounce elixer propts. mrs welches mr blackmns. 7 2 cloudy snow. left patient little easier returnd home. twisted 7 knotts yn went see mrs welch, find well could expected. son town famely well. mr blackmns. 8 3 severe storm snow. son town mr fuller dind mr ballard went see mrs welch wood, made shovel &c. spun thread. home. son town source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 9-14, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 9 14, 1791 9 4 snow storm. mr ballard carried wood mrs welch. began mitt cyrus. home. 10 5 snowd day. home. girls washt. knitt mitt. home. 11 6 clear. mr ballard carried ashes mr westons. home, finisht knitting cyruss mitts evng. home. 12 7 clear. calld mr crane go see mrs pond winthrop, went far mr saml cumingss, informd lady safe delivrd mrs whiteing, dagt. returnd home ye 11 h morn attended mr eastman. went mr pollards mr westons aftern. leut hains learned sleeps bot 1lb tamerins mr baxter pinte wine mr weston. mr cumingss, pollards mr westons. leut learned 13 b clear part ye day, wind ye south began rain 10h evng. mr densmore came go see little son remains low state, thigh sweld much saw recommended applying person skill ye safety ye child. went mr savages evng. mr densmores mr savages. 14 2 clear warm pleast till 2 h pm, squall came suden haill wind cold evn, clear. girls went capt belchers. mr seth williams field wives home. home. company. girls gone capt belchers. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, february 15 19, 1791 15 3 clear cold. mr ballard ephm went mr briggss hay. arth j. foot wife dagt visit. mrs savage bakt georg boltons wife vine savage home. home. 16 4 rainy day. home, knitt mr ballards stockin. mr walker 7 mile brook sleeps home. 17 5 clear cold, cloudy aftn. home. mr allin informs youngest child scolt. girls gone ys aftn help quillt coat sally gillman mr pollards. peter jones let pint mustard seed paid apples last fall. home. 18 6 x. birth mr greelys dagt. xx. clear cold. went see wilm densmore, find much late. calld mr greely see lady labour safe deld 10h 30m evn fine dagt, 7th child 4 dagts. tarried night, slept little. mr densmores mr greelys. birth 6th. receivd 3/ august 16th 1794 mr greely. 19 7 snowd left patients well could expected ye care mrs walker arivd home noon. receivd 3/ mr greely part performance. mr bullin informs asisted doct williams open soar willm densmores thigh. mr gralys colo sewalls. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 20-23, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 20 23, 1791 20 b clear part ye day, cloudy aftn. attended public worship, mr smith performd. mrs pierce sent bill prayers. calld 9 h evn see leut pollards wife labour. mrs savage, williams cowen night. meeting mr thomass. 56 years old ys day. 21 2 x. birth leut david pollards dagt. x. clear cold. mrs pollard ill thro ye day. old lady fletcher, mrs pollard ephm cowens wife aded company, patient safe delivrd 9 h evn fine dagt cleverly, considering ill shee tarried night. sett mrs pollard. mr thomass. birth 7th. 22 3 clear pleast. mr ballard came inform yt capt nicholss lady house. returnd took breakfast, leaving patients remarkably comfortable. chatting little friends, took walk far mr pollards. calld mr blaks savages return. fredrick foot, wife sister way mr bullins. mr pitt ditoes. mr thomas gave 6/ reward. receivd letter doct barton freby 6th. 23 4 clear except little snow ye morn. went mr savages dusk. mr foot ye ladys returnd. dolly makeing coat. capt savage informs mr densmores son like soar break mr savages. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 24-28, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 24 28, 1791 24 5 clear cold windy. mr pitt left ys morn. home. receivd letter sist waters jany 26th inst hannah one jany 1st together shee dolly ym cap, hond mothers. home. receivd letter sist waters 26th jany. 25 6 clear pleast. jona ephm went pitts town hay, mr ballard mr carrs. went mr savages see saddle irons. mr thomas gave letter doct barton jany 26th. snows evng. mr savages. receivd letter fromdoct barton jany 26th. 26 7 clear, cold windy. mr ballard gone ye hook business relating unity. mrs benjamin home. mr densmore informs son better. home. 27 b clear foren, wind s, cloudy aftn evn. went see willm densmore, helpt dress soar, smells disagreably. coalld mr pollards, find moses unwel pain ear side head. girls went mr hamlins. hors got away dolly tarried night. mr savage wife inform yt doct colman opend ye soar william densmores groin. mr densmores mr pollards. 28 2 rainy day. mr ballard went mr thomass. dolly returnd mr hamlins. home. spent part ye day cleaning ye platform ice, kniting part perrusing ye news papers, one informs ye death uncle thomas kidder. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 15 18, 1791 15 3 x. birth bizer benjamins son. x. receivd fee sept 4th 1792. clear part ye day. went dress pollys finger forenn. mrss mc ithny, heuston whitin mr craggs little dagt aftn. calld 6h 1/2 pm see mrs benjamin. shee safe deld 10 evn lusty son. mrs pollard, chamln caton went home. mrs welch tarried till day. ephm bot 1 lb chocolat bowl wood carried markett. mr savages. birth 8th. pollymc kethney others 16 4 little snow morn, foggy, misty day. came home 5h 1/2 morn, went bed slept. echabod pitts wife son came noon. shee tarried went farther returnd sett home tea. mr burtun came sleigh waited girls hous, went drest little pollys finger, drest ye infant. dittoes. mr pitts lady girls went mr burtuns. 17 5 cloudy till 10 h morn broke away ye sun appeard. cyrus sett winslow, patty town shee 13 mounths one day. home. dolly gone take care sally hamlin mammy go capt smiths. one jonas oxen dropt expird instantly sun sett ephm john savage bringing lode wood crick. home capt hershys 10 evng. jon lost ox. cyrus gone winslow, carried patty town home. 18 6 foggy. capt herseys, calld last evn 10h, walkt far mr craggs rode. mrs savage, voce, cowen calld. ye rest ye night. cloudy. mrs thomas came capt herseys early ys morn, went home night; thee rest aftn. women tarried night. mrs hersey seems comfortable. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 19-22, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 19 22, 1791 19 7 cloudy rain. capt herseys. mrs savage cowen went home evng, mrs voce tarried night. capt herseys. 20 b clear pleast till near night arose squall wind snow. mrs voce tarried ys night. mrs hersey rested well. dittoes. 21 2 clear cool. capt hersey conducted mrs voce home. left lady house. find famely well usual. josiah ketth informd yt mrs peirce expird morn. mr ballard gone ye hook meeting ye proprietors unity. parthena returnd mr foots, informs fredricks infant fitts yt polly bisbee much better. snowd fore night. ditoes. mrs peirce expird ys morn 6h 30m. 22 3 clear pleast. jon went ye hook, dolly mr blaks. ephm teem attempted going onto ye crick load boards belongd mr hamlin. steers broke thro thee ice great surprise. mrs welch, mr cragg wing came assistance. relievd teem savd, went fatague severe. hannah parthena went mr blaks aftr dinner. went mr savages, find comfortable. ephm cowen things capt savages lady. mr savages. mrs pierce interd 4 h pm. epms oxen like drowned. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 23-28, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 23 28, 1791 23 4 clear morn. mr ballard went ye meeting, tarried night. went mr baxters, took 7/6 order mr hodgess. mr blaks, lady gave skein cambc thread. mr pollards. sist williams came mr savages, drest pollys finger. mr baxters neigrs. sistr williams 24 5 rain. foster jona went ye hook. sister williams left denner bound varsalboro. epm carried mr hamlins bords far ye meeting house. benn brown informs mammy poorly. petitioners unity drew 4 lotts day mr ballard returnd home evn. finisht kniting cyrus leggins. home. sistr wilms went 25 6 rainy. mr burtun writeing ye plann unity. mr baker sleeps makeing soap. home. home. mr baker 26 7 clear. mr baker left early. doct coney see dolly. home. mr ballard went ye hook. joseph foster work. home. esq coney 27 b clear pleast. home, hear mrs brown mr woodwards, infant put nurs. home. 28 2 clear morn, cloudy aftn, rain evng. mr ballard went winthrop. mr weston lady home, girls washt. joseph foster workt seth j.foster informs mrs brown delireous yet. home. mr ballard winthrop. mrs weston source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 29-Apr. 2, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 29 april 2, 1791 29 3 x. birth john coutchs dagt. xx. misty morn. calld 7 h morn john coutches wife labour. shee delivrd dagt arivd drest infant, took breakfast returnd home noon. rainy evng. informd day sister mrs neys lately murdered self. mr coutches. mrs hinkley performdfor mrs coutch. june 27th receivd 6/ mr coutch. 30 4 cloudy rain. home. home. 31 5 x. birth capt herseys son. x. clear. capt hersey calld 5th hour morn see lady labour. shee safe deld 6h 30m pm fine son. mrs thomas mrs voce assistants. tarried night, patients comfortable. mr voce supt capt herseys. birth 9th. receivd 6/. tolman son born. 1 6 clear morn. took breakfast set home. crost river ice, went mr pollards. mr westons, tarried thru day night. thee river opend, thee freshet high. came capt herseys, ye river opend 4 h pm. 2 7 clear morn. took breakfast mr westons went mr hamlins burtuns. dind mrs hamlin. lucy cassety went capt burjess day. came hamlins, calld see mrs childs mrs pollard, prosceded homeward. met mr ballard conducted home tho thro difuculty. find family well usual jona securd boards. rain high wind ye night. mr westons neigrs. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 3-9, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 3 9, 1791 3 b rainy day, freshet high. mr pollard savage see bridg, informs us yt mr voce savd bords. home. ice went ye hook. home. 4 2 clear. mr ballard sons went town meeting. home, ye girls washt. peter jones took tea home, began stockin cyrus. 5 3 clear. mr ballard makeing planns. mr pollard lady home, attempted make soap. cyrus gone winslow. mr foster workt b. porter. home. jonas saw mill began saw ys day. 6 4 clear pleast. mrs savage polly childn little polly fell seller. old mrs whealor sleeps home. cyrus returnd. home. son towns famely well. 7 5 snowd morn. mrs whelor tarried day, sleeps home, dolly finisht makeing coat ephm. home. death mrs gardner, pittstown. 8 6 clear. mrs whealor left home, knitt began fix remooving. informd old mr fletcher sick. mr fields eunice hodgkins home, hear mr fletcher sick. 9 7 x. birth capt norcross dagt. xx. clear. calld 1st h morn see capt norcross lady labour. arivd 2h. shee safe deld 5 h dagt wd 9-1/2lb. left 10 arivd comfortable. arivd home 1 h pm, rideing bad. henry badcok paid 6/ tea sugar attending wife travil feby 28, 1790. eat new chees mrs husseys. wido husseys. birth 10th. mrs gardnr interd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 10-14, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 10 14, 1791 10 b clear pleast. home. jona killd rabbit sent mrs nabby hodskins unwell. home. 11 2 clear. mr jones sleeps mr cragg finishing bridg ye mill pond. mr livermore evng. calld 10 h evn see mrs dany labour. went land, find saml norcross lady mr danys. death mr fletcher. 12 3 x. birth mr danys 4th son. xx. cloudy. mrs dany calld women 3 h morn safe deld son 4 h 1/2, cleverly. calld see phillip norcross lady unwell came water. reacht home 9 morn. mr ballard cyrus gave yr possission peter jones. informd old mr fletcher expird last night. mr woodwd, wife, mr brown brother poor woman distresst state mind. compelld shee says, go fathers seems much time. may god restore comphort mind. girls washing scouring. mr danys. birth 11th. mrs brown way daddies. 13 4 clear, chilly air. mr ballard attended funeral mr fletcher, interd 4 h pm. home, feel well could wish. girls cleaning thee house prepareing remove. home. funeral mr fletcher. 14 5 clear pleast. mr ballard ephm went plough gardin improve. thee bridg ys crick finisht covering day. mr childs burtun, ladies mr patridg, mrs rockwood home. mrs savage polly calld home, company. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 15 23, 1791 15 6 mr ballard surveying mr norcross. girls went mr childs visit. home. mr jones came gillbreath work corn mill. mrs benjamin molly wall also. home. girls mr childs. 16 7 clear. home. mr ballard ploughing, ephm home. 17 b clear pleast. home. mr hamlin wife young ladies evng. gillbh cyrus went varsalboro. loin veal dinner. home, company. 18 2 clear pleast. mr ballard went part furniture. girls washt. mr andrews mrs bolton home. mrs savage home, company. 19 3 clear. home. mr ballard went meddow, girls mr hamlins. mrs benjamin brot yarn. home. mrs benn girls gone 20 4 clear morn, cloudy aftn. home. old mrs cowen mrs savage allso. girls went evn. mr ballard carrying efects. home, fixing remove. 21 5 clear. removd mills house old leut howards, peter jones went mills famely. removd famely. mrs savage polly helpt 22 6 clear except sprinkling rain. mr ballard went ye mills. jon son town came loggs. town came informs wife well hee little dagt better. home. began gardin. son town 23 7 cloudy brisk south wind. son town left mr ballard went mr joness, mare dockt. home. cyrus came evng. capt lathrop went sloop ys aftn. magr getchel expird day. home. mr town left wrote doct barton. death. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 24 30, 1791 24 b cloudy day, rain aftn. informd yt mr gould preach. mr ballard cyrus ephm went found misrepresentation. jona dind mr livermore drank tea. home. rainy night. home. 25 2 clear. calld 10 morn see mrs cottle, arivd 1h pm, find unwell. mrss tylor hollowell mr cottles. high wind. 26 3 clear high wind cold. mrss tylor hollowell went home. mrs cottle poorly. dittoes. 27 4 x. birth mr cottles 5th dagt, 9th child. xx. clear. mrs cottle mrs t h calld safe deld 10 h morn fine dagt. left well could expect 1 h pm. returnd way colo duttuns, road bad. reacht home 4. mrs densmr isaiah manley ditoes. birth 12th. cyrus went tend mill mr robinson. 28 5 clear. dolly wrode far mr pollards. went see mrs ney. mr ballard surveying mr cragg thwing. thee wind high. capt neys. 29 6 cloudy. workt ye gardin, went mr livermores aftn. mr ballard went survey mr briggs. girls sowd gardin seeds. mr ellis jona dind mrs livermore mr gillman allso. mr livermors. 30 7 clear forn, cloudy aft. workt gardin day diging grass roots, rakeing planting beens. ephm sett cabbage stumps, beets, carrots parsnips turnips. dolly wrode mr janss. cyrus came mr robinsons varsalboro tend mill since wedensday last. home. workt gardin. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 1-12, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 1 12, 1791 1 b clear except sprinkleing rain. home. mr burtun wife, mr partrage mrs rockwood, mr livermore drank tea. polly livrmr evng. home. 2 2 clear. sowd peas, mr ballard went town meeting. mrss savage benjamin girls washt. throat soar. home. mrs savage 3 3 clear. unwell ys foren, finisht sowing gardin pees aftn. old mrs norcross calld mr ballard ephm drove old cow shee calvd ys day. home. mrs norcross 4 4 cloudy, raind night. old mrs norcross mrs livermore visit. hannah unwell. home, company. 5 5 cloudy rain. mr lankester dind home. hannah better, dolly well shee mr ballard makeing fence. home. 6 6 clear except squall haill rain. mrss dorcas polly pollard mr savage allso. home. home, company. 7 7 clear part ye day. esqr coney juett foster allso, directly westward. home. ephm went mr joness, brot hen chicks. shee hatcht 16, eleven ym perisht want proper care. home. cyrus came 8 b clear. capt daviss brigg two vessels went ys day, jona aftern. mr ballard went mr livirmors ys evng. parthenia went mr burtuns work mr livermors. 9 2 clear. girls washt went mr voces. planted potoes foren, calld mr shaws aftn, oldest child sick. watcht mr shaws. 10 3 clear warm. naby shaw expird 3 h pm returnd home evn. son town ditoes. son town death. 11 4 clear. dolly sick, mrs livermore see calld see james moores wife. mrs shaws dagt interd aftern. james moores, mrs welman allso. 12 5 mr moores, wife ill women calld. thro night. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 13-19, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 13 19, 1791 13 6 mrs coy went home, mrs welman allso. mrs preskott mrs tylor tarried. mrs moore ill. rainy 8 ys morn. went bed, got little rest. mr moores. 14 7 x. birth james moores 4th dagt. xx. rainy morn, cloudy day. mrs moore calld us 2 h morn, shee safe deld 2h 30m morn fine dagt, fifth child, cleverly. returnd home accompanied mr mortgain, find dolly work much comfortable. mr ballard sowd flax day. town mett yesterday chose danl coney esqr represent town. cyrus came ditoes. birth 13th. receivd 7/6 mr james moore days performance, sept 30 1793. 15 b clear. mr bullin lady son dind dolly wrode parthina jona cyrus ephm sought young cows calf, found dead drove thee cow home. home. home. 16 2 clear. home. shuball hinkleys wife hous work weading gardin. hannah washt bakt washt kitchen floar. dolly weak low, able sett little. thoms smyle dind home. dolly low. 17 3 clear. mr ballard 66 years old day. home, wd gardin fore nn. dolly wrode capt p. browns far mr westons ys morn. hannah shee went mr livermores aftern. mrs livrmr home. mr ballards birth day. dolly comfortable 18 4 clear. workt gardin foren. dolly wrode mr hamlins, wife churnd made chees. mr ballard complains faintness ys aftn. corn beens peas beets come hannah planted cucumrs. home. 19 5 clear. wed gardin foren. mrs livermr jona dind us, greens, first gatherd gardin. mrs livermore went see mrs coney poorly. mr ballard went meddow, saw mrs brown mother came town ys day. doct coneys. ephm went mr bullins, sons wife sick. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 20-26, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 20 26, 1791 20 6 cloudy forn, raind aftern. wed part peas. mr livermore sons planking seller. dolly finisht pair trousers jon dind home. capt howland went ys noon sloop. 21 7 clear except sprinkling rain. weading gardin planting mellions beens. dolly went see jona. cyrus came evn. home. 22 b cloudy part ye day. magr keath dagts went mr hamlins. home. mr fields informd yt nabby hodskins low indeed. home. 23 2 clear. dolly faint turn. went see nabby hodskins wed one onion bed, find low. tarried night watcht. mr hodskins, watcht dagt. 24 3 clear warm. returnd home foren, left mrs hodskins little revivd. calld mr densmores see thomas unwell. find dolly well shee generally went mr livermors, find lady unwell. mr dummer capt hussey juet foster mr ballard sons sett fence meddow 3 h pm. cyrus came home. nabby hodskn better. dtoes neigrs. mr ballard gone fence meddow. 25 4 rainy. mr densmore came go see little son. thee rain abated went noon. adminesterd clister, child revivd. betty complains pain head. liddia fitt collic, anne poorly cold. tarried till near night, walkt home. cyrus meddow. mr ballard, epm john savage came home. mr bald went mr pollards reference. mr densmores see children unwell. 26 5 clear. mr hurd robbinson oxford, brot letters bror sist barton collins, informs friends well. went mr densmors, child got releif phissick clister. set home. calld upon went put ye grave cloaths mrs nabby hodskins, returnd home late. ditoes mr hodskins, dagt expird. mrs t slakpool sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 27-31, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 27 31, 1791 27 6 clear. mrs sally stakpoole went cyrus waited water. went ye hook, bot needles, pins combs. borrowed mrs carrs side saddle. wed gardin returnd, cyrus helpt mr ballard ephm ye meddow, fencing mr cottle paid 2/8_ cash mr densmors yesterdy, mr dany 1/6 ys day. thee letters receivd mr hurd 1 sist barton one br collins 8 inst, one sist barton ye 11th, one frm doct barton 15th inform ye death leut nicholss lady oxford; shee expird april 14th 1791. son town came dusk, pownalboro. famely well usual yester day left ym. hook. receivd letters yesterdy. son town sleeps ys night. 28 7 cloudy foren, sun shone noon, son town dagts sett wins low. sprinkling rain sun sett, showers went round us thunder lightning. mr ballard ephm came ye meddow. mrs nabby hodskins interd 2h pm. home. funeral mrs hodskins. dagts gone winslow. 29 b clear hott. mr ballard cyrus went meeting, mr emerson rerformd. augustus ballard mother, robert mc causland wife jony white wife allso. much alarmd ephm, circumstance went chamber, laid bd cloaths fell asleep. went mr livermors mr kennadys seek lookd every bed found thought turnd mind search found asleep. home. sist williams others alarmd ephm. 30 2 clear. mr ballard surveying, rode mr jones. mrss livermore cumings drank tea. cyrus ephm spent ye day sheep, found home. mrss livermr cumings 31 3 x. birth robt fletchers dagt. xx. clear. mr ballard ephm went ye meddow. put robt fletcher wife bed 4th dagt 30 m pm. left cleverly, fee receivd june 19th. mr fletchers, birth [14th]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 1-8, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 1 8, 1791 1 4 clear. wed gardin foren. hannah washt. mr ballard finisht fencing meddow, got home noon. mrs porter came 1 h pm. mr hamlin burtun childn parthenia tea. juet foster sleeps dagts returnd wins tow yester day. dolly thinks ride servis shee workt steady ys day pain stomach evng. cyrus sheard sheep yesterday. home, company. mrs porter winthp 2 5 cloudy, misty day. foster went breakfast. jon dind mrs porter sett dinner. wed gardin aftern. mr ballard went ye hook. cyrus ephm brot last potatoes. home. 3 6 clear part ye day. mr ballard gone survey mr gilley. workt gardin. mr haywood mr hurd took tea hurd sleeps home. haywood hurd 4 7 cloudy, raind foren. workt ye gardin. son dagt town came brot dollys sheep wool. mr ballard came home evn. home. son dagt town came 5 b x. birth ezekl pages son. xx. clear warm. calld 1 h morn see mr ezekiel pages lady labour, safe delivd son ye 6th hour. left mother child cleverly returnd home ye 11th h, took knap sleep. dind haslit veal. mr livermore, lady brother drank tea mr pages. birth 15th.my childn dind us day. 6 2 clear. mr ballard went esqr norths evidence, mr town pownalboro, three dagts parthena capt filly browns. home, bakt cakes. mr smyle sleeps home. 7 3 clear, frost ys morn. houghd corn beens. dagts parthena went mr hamlins. mrss white suky norcross went mr livermores mr livermores, dagts mr hamlins. 8 4 clear. mrs livermore warpt web mr shuball hinklys lady home, children dind jona took breakfast drank tea. cyrus went brot swine home. home. mrs hinkley mr shaws. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 9-13, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 9 13, 1791 9 5 x. birth eliab shaws dagt. x. birth alvin neys son xx. cloudy. eliab shaws, calld 9 h last evng. wife ill night safe deld 8 h ys morn dagt. left cleverly. came spead alvin neys 7h ys morn. arivd neys ye 11 h. wife safe delivrd 2h 30m aftn son. receivd 6/ performance. left wife son cleaverly arivd home half aft 6 much fatagud, went bed early. thunder shower ye night. mr shaws, neys. birth 16 17. slept [since] left [home]. mr town jona pownalboro. 10 6 clear. rose late, workt gardin, lucy went see old lady coney. dind ye docts lady. calld calld [sic] mr cumingss, returnd home 3h pm went mr livermores. mrs black came sent home. mrs livrmr daugt drank tea us. mr town returnd pounalboro. mr pitts evng. [deacon] coneys neighrs. 11 7 clear pleast. childn left 9h morn bound home, mr pitts allso. went work ye gardin. cyrus got wood went pitts town. workt ye gardin day. mr thorp came shirts dolly made, paid 5/3d makeing. home. son dagt town left 12 b clear warm. elisabh cleark informs mr pages inft well could wish. went see gave directions &c. jona took breakfast dind us. mr page gave 6/ reward servis done. old lady coney well. polly livermr girls pickt strauburys. mr pages. 13 2 clear warm. wed onions, allmost overcome ye heat. juet foster drank tea us. mr pitts girls washt ys day. home. esq coney returnd [coast]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 14-20, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 14 20, 1791 14 3 clear. calld 2 h morn see mr blacks infant unwell, little revivd arivd. gave syrrup mullin gave relief. went dind mr joness. calld mr savages mr craggs, little dagt well usual. receivd letter may 23 esqr cony sist waters, informing well. mr blaks neigbrs. receivda letter sist waters may 23. 15 4 clear. workt gardin. mr ballard sons workt ye road. hannah put web ye loome. home. 16 5 clear. home, wed gardin. mrs hannah rockwood mr ballard sons workt ye roade. home. 17 6 clear morn, fine showers aftern. sett cucumbers mellon plants. mr ballard got french turnips sett. mrs kennady home, sett plants. 18 7 clear. home, made 13 dzn candles. cyrus run 18 spoons. mr ballard makeing planns unity. thos smiley dind sett cabbage turnip plants. home, made candles. 19 b cloudy morn, began rain 10 h morn. mr ballard, self cyrus attended public worship. revd mr little wells performd. dind mr pollards. thee text foren luke 10-20, rather rejoice names written heaven. aftern ye 12 verse, one thing needfull. meeting. revd mr little performd. 20 2 clear. cleaning ye door way setting plants. ephm choping chip struck face, hurt much. applyd camphr. mrs davenport shee went mr livermores, mr ballard ye girls allso tea; mr fields wife, mr norcross mrs hodskins mr b. livermr, jona devenport. mr livermors. mrs devenport others source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 21-27, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 21 27, 1791 21 3 clear. home. mrs livrmr mrs white esqr coney calld see dolly, recommends taking port wine. leut hains learned, shuball pitts juet foster night. mr ballard ye hook meeting propriaters unity. home. mr learned sleeps 22 4 clear. see mrs livermore, shee unwell. mr learned foster went breakfast. mr ballard went wiscasset. mr livermores. 23 5 clear. mrss livermore dinsmore polly took tea home, quilld hannah, workt gardin knitt mr ballard returnd, mr livermr drank tea home. 24 6 clear hott. mr johnston wife, mr woodward, capt springer son jona dind. mrs anny bullin drank tea sleeps make syrrip mrs livermore. mr ballard land ye uper end ys town. mr livermo[res]. 25 7 clear foren, showers aftn. mr [sic] anne bullin went dineing. wed gardin helpt sett plants. mrs densmore sent 80 cabbages turnips. mr chamberlin mr ballard went mr carrs, receivd 6/ plann unity. hannah got webb 45 yds. home. hannah got webb 26 b clear. home, wrote brothr barton sister collins. jona took breakfast dind brot us part smokt salmon. home, wrote letters. 27 2 rain foren, sun shone little aft n, showers 6 h evng. mr adams, thee printer, another gentleman putt reason ye rain, tarry night. home. home, workt gardin. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 28-Jul. 2, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 28 july 2, 1791 28 3 clear pleasant. wrote sister waters went mr westons. commited letters conveyance. hannah receivd letter ezra davis boston 17th inst, wrote mr weston hoome left 6/ procure wine dolly. mrs livermore ys aftn. mr adams bror left breakfast. mr westons, sent letters friends. jona sleeps 29 4 clear. houghd plants door, went mr livermrs. came home, wed onions. son town came informs family well thomas sewalls wife delivd last lords day. mr ballard runn ye lines round land north end ys town. polly livermore visit. dolly well usual. son town sleeps mr livrmrs. son town sleeps mr ballard runing lines self. 30 5 clear. mr ballard cyrus surveying. wed gardin foren. esqr coney son town left homewd bound. mrs welch mrs livermore went mr whiles. old mr hinkley mr adams sprague presented election sermon dagt daddy. mr ballard return, cyrus mr whites. mr adams left mr robbins election sermon. 1 6 clear. workt gardin. mr ballard surveying, tarries ys night. clarrissia barton lucy ens] dind parthenia went mr foots. mrs livermore deacon coneys house raisd. home. parthena went mr foots. deacon coneys house raisd. 2 7 clear. home, quite well usual. mr ballard returnd, surveyd land lying north end ys town. informs jona well. dolly wove 6 hand kerchiefs ys day, hannah 2. parthenia returnd. home. mr ballard came home surveying. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 3-9, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 3 9, 1791 3 b clear. walkt meeting. revd mr judson performd, descourst foren jobe 1c 1v, aftn luke ]c 41 verse. wrode mr densmores home, wife jesse bullin son jona drank tea meeting. 4 2 clear. home, finisht dagt towns stockins began self mittin. dolly finisht weaving thee lawn hankerchiefs. mr hamlin burtun, wives childn, hannah rockwood. mrs livermore wove hankerchief mr ballard esqr coneys ys morn, helpt mr densmore fraiming raising house fraim. home, company. mr densmores house raisd. independance observd. 5 3 clear. home, sett beet turnip plants. mr ballard went thee hook survey capt smith washington. home, sett [plants]. 6 4 clear warm. mr ballard left home bound seven mile brook. home. rufas ballard dind old mr hinkley capt hersey girls alterd hatts bonnits. hannah parthenia went mr whites evn. home. mr ballard gone 7 mile brook. 7 5 clear warm till evn, wind blew ye n. smart shower. girls went mr bullins water, sons waited hannah parthenia home. dolly tarries night. benn mrs livermore mr sawyer mr ballard survey. home whitening hand kercfs. porter 8 6 clear windy. tend cloath, home. parthenia wove 8 yds. dolly returnd. home. 9 7 clear. tended thee cloath knitt. sons went mr bullins dolly. girls made coat trousers ephm shee came home. robert mc causlin wife going winslow. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 10-15, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 10 15, 1791 10 b clear. jona watcht mr page, came went bed. mr ballard returnd. ephm girls went meeting water. wrode aftern. mr judson dis coarst 2 timothy 4 c 7 8 verse. mr livermores evng. attended worship aftern. 11 2 clear warm. gatherd string beens dinner, veall mr pollards. mr ballard went jonas, cyrus cobbecy. went see mrs livermore, shee well shee late. cleand well ys day. mr livermores. 12 3 clear warm. mr ballard ephm gone rafft boards take hook mr stanley. mr cottle paid 3/4 coffee, sattisfies attending wife april 27th. mr livermore made prest quarter lamb. mrs white, mr mc causland wife son towns famely well. home, compy. used ye last water well aforded day. mr ballard epm gone rafft paid coming ye crick morn tide. 13 4 clear foren, shower aftern, haill considerable damage done ye fort. mr ballard got boards paid mr stanley due us cyrus. home. mr livermore got part hay. home. shower. 14 5 clear hott except shower. mr ballard gone pownalboro. houghd gardin thee girls washt, cyrus ephm helpt mr livermore hay. home. light shower. 15 6 cloudy morn, clear hott noon 3 heavy shower hard thunder. mrs welch helping dolly draw piece huckaback. cyrus crosst ye river ye heffer. home, houghd gardin forenoon. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 16-21, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 16 21, 1791 16 7 cloudy morn, sun shone middle ye day, thunder shower near night; n e storm followd. sett beets cammomile. mr ballard returnd coart. thee french man acquited, mrs barker imiprisond defaming polly noble. sally cox son jona sleep home. sally cox sleeps planted cucumbers. 17 b storm y morn, wind n e rain abated dind, sally cox went away mr ballard jon famely attended public worship. storm continues. home. peas, first gardin ys year. home. polly densmore says two ye childn sick. green peas. 18 2 cloudy rain. sett cammomile roots. mrs voce dagt dind took coffee us. went see mrs livermore, shee seems unwell. girls went ys aftn, find little better. cyrus brot 2 bushel meal home jonses mill ys eving. mr livermores. mrs voce dagt mr james page allso. 19 3 cloudy part ye day. went mr catons. calld mr pollards, jonses, boltons, voces densmores. came home went mr shuball hinkleys. capt savages lady came home sleeps shee informd sally peirce swore child son jon taken warrent. mr abisha cowen bonds man appearance coart. mr catons hinkleys. mrs savage nathanl norcross married eunice hodskins. two [blac allso. 20 4 clear warm. mr adams brother john johnston jon dind. mr savage went mr livermores, mr densmores; child unwell. mr livermores dinsmores. mrs savage left 21 5 mr caton sent 6/ son cyrus. cloudy morn, clear hott aftn. mr ballard went magr smiths. cyrus brot jonas things hee sleeps home. mrs livermr home. jona moovd source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 28-Aug. 4, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 28 august 4, 1791 28 5 clear hott. unwell. seisd thee colic last night got little rest. cleand little cabbage seed. polly densmr says marm better. shee tissick. home. 29 6 clear warm. mr ballard returnd mr lees. went mr westons, bot 3lb pott ash /6, mr burtuns, left four dollars order mr cogsil boston 3 m shingles left hains learned oct 88 purchase articles boston. receivd letter brotr elijah 21st inst, informing friends health. mr burtuns westons densmores, shee got better. receivd letter [br] elijah 21 inst. 30 7 clear day, cloudy evng. mr ballard brusd leg halling timber. applyd camphere. attended lectere aftern. john johnston took breakfast went mr livermores, polly alice unwell. washt cloath, dried putt ley. church meeting held. mr livermores. dolly spun 34 notts linning yarn ys day. ingrahams dagt born. 31 b clear warm morn. mr ballard, jona hannah attended public worship wrote brotr collins, elijah barton sist waters send mr burtun. sent 7/11-2/1 hannah purchace things boston mr pollard wife calld sun sett saml badcocks wife, went water. seisd gott thee collic. sleep night. saml badcoks. wrote [friends] oxford. collic ys night. 1 2 rainy. mr badcocks, ill collic day, ease evng. dittoes. 2 3 clear. dittoes jery badcocks. dittoes. 3 4 clear. mrs badcock comfortable. ditoes. 4 5 clear. left mrs badcock, walkt home. dolly poorly. foster work finisht [shoes], went mr pitts store, bot 1 quart w e spirrit, 1 skein black silk 2 knots thread, cost 2/3. calld mr pollards mr densmores, went see mrs welch unwell. mrs lucy norcross mrs pheba hinkly mr ballard workt mr densmrs house. ditoes. compy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 12 19, 1791 12 6 showers foren, clear aftn, shower evn. calld little night see asa masons wife, got day light sleep ys night. masons. liddia [went] home. 13 7 birth asa masons son. clear. masons still. went gatherd black berries. mrs mason grew ill aftern. calld women evn safe deld 10 h son. tarried thro night. patient cleverly. sleep ys night. ditoes. birth 18th. 14 b clear. sett home soon day, walkt far mr james savages rode far mr isaac savages, sons brot water. searcht cloaths immediately arivd, found vast number flees calld mr pittsis, boltons savages. mrs dorcas pollard parthenia. ditoes. 15 2 clear warm. mr ballard sons went ye meddow, cyrus pitts town. mr foster work. mr benn porter, densmore yr wives, master eaton mrs livermore drank tea dagts washt scourd floors. home, knitt home, company. 16 3 clear except shower. mr ballard sons returnd ye meddow. home, informd yt mr cragg sick confind bed. home. 17 4 clear. jona ephm went meddow, jona returnd noon unwell. gave tea mullin maiden hare gave releif. mr ballard attended meeting ye church aftern. foster workt part ye day, informs dagt sick. home. mrs livermore put webb home. mr ballard church meeting. jona unwell. 18 5 clear. mr ballard went early meddow. jona better. home mending stockins houghing cabbages. home. 19 6 clear. home, washt wool, hilld cabbages, gatherd corn. men returnd meddow, finisht giting hay. mrs norcross, polly cowen anne norcross jona bot quarter veal. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 20-28, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 20 28, 1791 20 7 clear. mr ballard surveying ebenz church. home, gatherd ripe beet seed, mended hoes. dagts went mrs welches. home. 21 b clear. mr livemrs lady home, dagts mr hamlins. home. 22 2 clear. mr ballard cyrus went pitts town, returnd. mr balld went esqr lovjoys look mill place. mrs lois hinkley lucy cleark home. 23 3 clear. jona helpt kill 3 bares mr abm pages. dolly sick. son town sleeps home. mrs livermr densmr home, gatherd ripe water mellion. 24 4 birth saml badcks son. clear. mr ballard returnd. capt fillebrowns lady dolly better. calld 5h 30m evn see saml badcoks wife, arivd 7. shee delivd fine son 10. tarried night. saml badcoks. birth 19th.i receivd 3lb1/4 unwasht wool mr badcock. 25 5 x. birth capt neys son. xx. clear warm. came home 6h morn. son town calld 8 see mrs ney. shee safe deld 1h pm son. tarrid till near night. sprinkling rain. receivd 6/ reward. find mr john jones, ezekiel chace mrs rockwood mr jones sleeps capt neys. birth [20th]. mr john jones 26 6 clear. mr ballard hook, bot 1 quire paper. mr weston lady mrs johnston home. home. 27 7 x. birth isaac hardings dagt x. x. james savages son x. clear. calld isaac hardin 4 h morn, wife delivd dagt 1 h pm. went directly james savages, hors mrd swamp fell arivd savages 3, find safely deld fine son marms assistance. fresht went back hardins colo duttuns farm. wrode hardins hors home, arivd 8 much fatagud. mr hardins james savages. birth 2[1]th. birth james savages son. birth 22. 28 b clear. jon went baptist meeting, saw 9 persons receiv baptism. parthenia, polly pollard mr hamlin, eliphlet robbins home. home. dagt town 33 years old ys day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 29 september 6, 1791 29 2 clear. mr ballard mr vahns. home. mr cragg wrode feeble. home, gatherd one musk mellon yesterd 4 30 3 cloudy foren, clear aftn. home. mr ballard thrasht peas. dagts washt ye river. home. 31 4 rainy. home. mr john jones sleeps home. 1 5 x. birth esqr juetts dagt. xx. clear pleast. jona gone winslow. calld esqr juett see lady 1h pm, arivd 2. shee safe deld 3 dagt, 8th child; ye number sex equal. mrs dearburn, broadst, shaw, barry lang attendants. wrode home alone, arivd 9 evn. hors pestyrd got safe thro. esqr juetts. birth 23st. 2 6 clear except shower. mr ballard cyrus went pitts town. mr livermores mr densmores. son town sleeps esqr juett came hors, gave 6/ reward assisting lady yesterday. mr livermrs mr densmores. son town 3 7 clear. mr ballard surveying capt hersey. son town left ye 12th hour. mrs welch warpt hand kerchfs home, gatherd seeds &c. home. georg brown dind 4 b clear. mr ballard sons attended divine servic, revd mr farrah new ipswich performd. georg brown polly mc kekny meeting. peter grant nancy barker, thos norris mary shepherd publisht. 5 2 clear. wilm haywood polly bisbe mrs livermr went help mrs hinkley quillt bed quillt. find mr strattne lady return, mr j jones allso. mr shuball hinkleys. mr straton lady sleep 6 3 cloudy misty morn. mr dingler came breakft hurry mr strattne. sett directly go board capt springer bound boston. raind stedily day. home kniting. home. mr straten lady went sent 6/ purchace cambric. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 12 17, 1791 12 2 rainy. left mr whites breakfast, wife seems comfortable. scalt pickles. jason coney mr ballard paid owed laid slept aftn. mr whites. 13 3 clear, brisk s wind. vessels arivd. went mr livermores mrs densmr forenn help mr thos hinkley quillt, dolly aftn, hannah parthena went evng. mr ballard workt mr densmores. mr hinkleys quillt, girls allso. 14 4 clear part ye day, wind s cloudy aftn. mr ballard ye hook. mrs savage dagt dolly wrode mr burtuns, brot home 8 yds chints mr burtun bot boston, cost 3/10 pr yd. letter bror collins august 28 informing friends health. home. happy hearing glad tydings friends great distance. jon[n] gone winslow. home, receivd letter bro collins agst 28, refreshing hear ye health prosperity dear connections hundrds miles 15 5 cloudy day, rain night. mr ballard ephm went river foren, mr densmores aftern. removd new house. home, knit parthinias stockins. mrs livermore girls makeing pair staise. home. 16 6 cleard little sun rise. went mr densmores, shee 3 childn came home shee cutt gown. dolly tooth extracted mr livermore. mr peter joness lady tarries night. parthenia went winthrop, brot clarrissa home mr densmors, shee mrs jones clarrisa allso. 17 7 clear pleast. mrs jones wrode hors part ye way home. ephm brot quarter lamb mr craggs. mrs livermor mrs densmr went home ye later, chimney ye ridg pole. mr densmores. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 4-10, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 4 10, 1791 4 3 clear. mr ballard went mr browns mare, bled ye mouth. shee bled way home continued bleed hour two coming home. length filld ye incision fur ceast. mrs livermr went mr saml norcrosses, marm mr phillips wife mrs barton dagt hannah went mr densmores. mr saml norcrosses. mare bled excessively. 5 4 cloudy foren. mrs barton left homeward bound. dolly went mr wicksoms. calld evn see jeremy whites inft, gave manna, annis seed safron; revivd. tarried night. scolt pickles ys day. cyrus came evn. jery whites, inft unwell. 6 5 clear pleast morn. tarried mr whites till noon, returnd home went mr densmores. spent aftn. mr ballard gone work ye mill pitts town. mr densmrs. 7 6 clear. home, pickt wool. jona went green lodg. ephm mr densmrs sons finisht giting potatoes seller. home. 8 7 clear. mr porter tarries ys night. ephm went pitts town ye mare daddy ride home. cyrus came evng. home, pickt wool. old mrs cowen brot 1/2 lb sage. home. mrs porter informs mecapt [fairbanks] lady deceast septr 28th,shee ye westwd. 9 b cloudy rain. mrs porter went cyrus went away bound washington. doct colman coney mr livermore home. home. esqr coney informs mrs goodin near ye close life thinks. 10 2 x. birth benn whites dagt. xx. clear. mr walker calld 2 h morn benn whites wife labour. shee safe deld ye 7th dagt, returnd home 12 o clok. calld mr walkrs, jacksons devenports. took nap returnd. cyrus returnd gillbreaths went pitts town, daddy mr benn whites. birth [26]th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 11-17, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 11 17, 1791 11 3 clear. home. mr burtun, wife sister, mrs hannh rockwood, patty bullin phebe hinkley mr ballard returnd pittston, brot letter 25 ult doct barton, wrote answere. thee moon eclipst evng. home, receivd letter brr barton, wrote answer. 12 4 rainy till near night. home. patty bullin mr ballard gitting wood. ephm helpt mr densmore git potatoes. jona went winslow returnd 10h evn. son towns famely well. home. 13 5 clear part ye day. mr ballard went mr hardins prepare giting mill stone ephm went allso. clarrissa barton came went mr densmrs gown made. patty bullin went ys evn. home, sewing kniting. girls washt went mr densmores evng. home. pally bullin went home, clarry bartun 14 6 clear part ye day, wind s. mr ballard got wood us mr livermore. home knitting spoold woorsted, 16 skeins. clarrissa went home, parthenia got cabbages 20 heads. home. clarrissa went home. 15 7 rainy foren. went mr chamberlins borrow read. calld mr childss, wife unwell. dind mr pollards. mr ballard ephm git mill stone mr hardins river. mr keneda savage bolton helpt mr chamberlins neigrs. 16 b clear, cool morn, wind s aftern. cyrus tended mill last night. went mr densmores, mr ballard, livermore lady evn. mr densmores. 17 2 clear, wind norwd. mr ballard went pitts town mill stone. ezra town came folks well. dug french turnips foren, went aftn mrs livermore see mrs norcros. shee absent made visit old lady coutch. old mrs coutches. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 18-24, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 18 24, 1791 18 3 clear pleast. mr ballard hodges went pitts town ye boat, got far william haywood moses pollard dind hannah washt, dolly weaving. home. mr weston calld mrs sherburns infant interd. home. funeral mrs sherburns inft. 19 4 clear pleasant. mr ballard surveyd land yt mr pollard sold esqr williams, made plann wrote deed evn. mr dagts went help thos hinkleys wife quillt bed quillt. ephm ezra went pitts town. home. got beets mrs livermr evn. w. haywood sleeps dolly tarried till late. home, girls went quillting. doct colman removd hook. 20 5 clear foren, cast aft evng. dagts went winthrop attend weding richard foster clarra barton. mr ballard went pittst early ys morn. epm ezra returnd afternn. home, finisht footing self pair hoes. home. dagts gone clarrasweding. 21 6 cast morn. mrs kennady cloudy evn moderate. mr ballard came home pitts tn. home. dagts returnd day. home. 22 7 cloudy forenn, rainy aftrn. ezra left ys morn, home wd bound. epm went carried hors back far mr wals. mr ballard giting wood. home. home. girls returnd weding. 23 b snowd raind. calld see sally peirce 9 h morn, rideing bad. doct colman calld aft noon see lady. calld sally morn. mr peirces. snow storm. 24 2 x. birth sally peirces son. xx. clear. calld ye docts sally, shee safe deld 1 h pm fine son. illness severe left cleverly returnd ye docts sun sett. sally declard son jona father child. doct colmans mrpeirces. birth 27th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 25-31, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 25 31, 1791 25 3 cloudy morn. calld docts see mrs tubs, shee removd thoms hinkleys sick, unwell thro ye day. calld 11 h pm see mrs wesson. mr tubs westons. 26 4 birth mr tubss dagt. clear. calld mrs weston mrs tubs 2h 30m morn) safe deld 10h 03m dagt. labour severe left cleverly 12h returnd mr westons. dito. birth 28th. 27 5 clear pleast. calld mr westons see mrs childs, find unwell. calld mr hamlins returnd mr wessons. mrs johnson went capt p. browns. mr wessons childs. 28 6 cloudy. mrs wesson remains much shee consented go home see famely find mr ballard gone pitts town, rest famely well. returnd mr westons. mr wessons. 29 7 cloudy. mr westons. wife w goodins expird day consumption. ditoes. mrs goodin expird. 30 b birth doct colmans dagt. xx. cloudy morn, snowd noon. calld mr wessons doct colmans 3h. morn, lady safe deld fine dagt 11h. 40m. mrs dummer sewall attended ditoes doct colmns. birth 29th. receivd 9/8. 31 2 rain. returnd home water, informd mrs goodin departed life 29th inst. shee left husband 7 childn bewail loss, parents, brors sisters allso. may god giv thim sanctyfying crace mourn aright. calld mr westons 5h pm. docts home mr wessons. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, november 1 9, 1791 1 3 clear. mr westons selvesters doct colmans. mr selvesters. 2 4 cloudy chilly air. mr wesson calld hook last evng. went see child. mr wessons. 3 5 cloudy chilly. mr wesson brot mrs fillebrown see marm. shee tarried night. ditoes. 4 6 snowd. mrs pillebrown went home. mr wesson brot work. ditoes. 5 7 cloudy. went mr pollards mr daviss store. mr wessons yet. thee ice runs ye fort, stopt cobese. ditoes. 6 b clear pleast. came home, find famely health. left mrs wesson well shee cyrus home. mr ballard work cobese mill part last weak. mr livermr moses pollard informs yt shaw, ye sherrif, taken doct johnson virtue advertisement forgery. home. 7 2 clear part ye day. mr ballard went work cobesy mill. mrs porter came sent ephm mr childs parthenia. mr moore green sleeps home. mrs porter 8 3 clear pleast. mr moore mrs porter left mr ballard went esqr coneys cobesy. went see bradwl livermore, find easier mr thos smyle came home, sleeps informd wife mr andw goodin expird last night 11h, allso yt wife mr wiman jonses plantn lately deceast child bed. mr livermrs. mr smily death mrs goodin. 9 4 x. birth mr wessons son. xx. clear cool. calld 3 h morn see mrs wesson, shee safe deld 4h. 30m. fine son. mrs pollard, duttun hamlin assisted. shee child cleverly. recievd 12/ reward. mr ballard sett explore country back fort hallifax, inployd common wealth. tarried mr westons, mrs fillebn sally floid allso. mr wessons. birth 30th. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 15-19, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 15 19, 1791 15 3 dolly went mr densmores. smart n e wind powerfl rain morning, cleard pleast noon. dolly went mr densmores learn taylors art. wish sucseess happiness. ephm gone hall hay mr hamlin, returnd without home, spun wick yarn made wicks 21 dozn candles. home. raind evn. 16 4 cloudy. began make candles calld see mrs wesson, find well could expected, mind shee take care inft home. stupud afair, think, must shee pleases. mr wessons. walkt home, much fatgd. 17 5 cloudy day, observd public thanks giving. dolly cyrus home, tarry night. son town famely cough. mr fuller james wall sleep watcht mr densmores infant, childn cough much. mr densmores night. son town mr eaton drownd. 18 6 cloudy. came home day takeing breakfast, laid slept, watchings fatagng time life. mr town fuller left mr david jackson lost sea, vessel allso. 19 7 clear part ye day. finisht makeing cottne shifts went see mr densmores childn, find infant weaker, others much wrote doct waters enclosd letter doct barton. wife mr edwd springer town interd day. shee departed life night 17tnth inst, infant interd ditoes. wrote bror waters. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 20-24, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 20 24, 1791 20 b clear pleast. mr brdwl livermore calld morn, favrs carrying letter doct waters. went see mr densmores famely, inft ill; childn much came home, supt went back watcht. elephelet robbins came go mr pollards, betsy heuston sick, could go. mr [densmors]. 21 2 cloudy. came home. cyrus went mill, dolly mr densmores. ice stopt ys morn, movd evng tide. smart rain night opind river. ditoes. 22 3 cloudy part day, sun sett clear. mr ballard returnd mr town came go house. cyrus came brot us [much lame]. gentle men chosen referees cause peter jones son jona sett day. gave jones £8 damage cost coart 2 pound 5/. could wish son might learn govern temper futer. home. mr ballard returnd. joness jonas [referees]. 23 4 clear. mr town left house 8h morn, put dificulty ferry, got safe 11 h, arivd mr towns 6h evn; found well. mrss stackpool strattne quillting coat mrs barton, got fatagud, went bed rest. went mr towns. 24 5 x. birth son towns [6]th dagt. xx. cloudy. dagt seisd labour, women calld shee safe deld dagt 10 h evn. sett thro ye night. shee faint put bed, revivd cleverly. 8th child. rainy night. son towns. birth 31st. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 25-29, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 25 29, 1791 25 6 rainy morn, cleard aftn. ladies went away. dagt cleverly. 26 7 clear pleast. mrs haywood dagt stratten see dagt morn. shee cleverly. death mr hewens infant. 27 b clear pleast. son sett come calld capt grants. shee came home charls jacksons, informd dagt jane deld son 10h ys morn. came mr pollards ferry. conducted son turnd back home. tarred mr pollards watcht betsy heuston, near close life. mr voce sett came winslo mr pollard, watcht betsy heustn. funeral mr hewens infant. 28 2 x. birth mr webbers dagt. xx. clear cold morn. calld mr webber pittstn see wife. shee safe deld 1h pm dagt well expected. childn cough. son towns childn allso. mr webbers, pitts ton. birth 32nt. betsy hueston expird 6h evn. 29 3 clear pleast. sett home, accompanied mr webber dore, wrideing bad. calld see mrs colman, shee cleverly. arivd home 1h pm. mrs barril gave 6/ capt norcross lady sent assisting travil april 9th 1791. mrs welch ys day warp webb. jona rafft last thurs day night severe storm. informd mr david jackson town unfortunately drowned boston ye 18th inst, vessel cargo lost. ditoes. mr webber bestowd 8/8 service. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 5-9, 1791 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 5 9, 1791 5 2 clear. mr ballard went capt husseys wool, found cannoe gone time. ephm hauled water. home, house work, hannah spun. dolly went mr densmores, bed bed stead carried sleep home. 6 3 x. birth mr bradfords son. xx. receivd 6/ son cyrus, sept 30 1792 mr bradfd. snowd day. calld mr bradford pitts ton 7h morn. wrode hors far hook point. ephm went take home. prosceeded water, arivd 9h, found lady safe deld doct parker) fine son, second child; sons. conducted nath norcross littleboro) water far mr selvesters. calld warmd, walkt home. wet much fatagud indeed. arivd home 7h evn. mr bradfords pitts ton. snowd.33nd birth. 7 4 snowd day. mr ballard siesd pain (ys morn) got easier short time. parthenia came mr childss home, doubled stockin yarn dagt town gave hannah spun. jack livermr ephm went hook, got sheep home find home. snowd. parthen came home. 8 5 snowd mr ballard went help cyrus dress mill. clear evn. calld 9h evn see mrs walker. ice run got safe wrode mr devenports landing. mr walkers. 9 6 x. birth mr walkers son. xx. clear morn, snowd noon, clear aftn. mrs walkers safe deld son whichwd 10-1/4 lb. came 11h arivd safe home 1 h pm, find mrs pitts sent laid slept, severe fit cramp. birth 34th. fee receivd feby [25] 1792. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 6, 1792 1 clear morn, overcast day, snow evn. mr ballard went hear mr smith, performd acadame ye hook. home. cyrus dolly mr ballard mr pollards, ys evn. mr densmores dagts lucy kennady dolly went away. home. 2 2 snow foren, raind evng. mr ballard ephm went ye meddow. home. hannah warpt got web work. hous work, feel fatagud. home. hannah put web ye loome. 3 3 cloudy foren, clear pleast aftern. mr ballard gone varsalboro others road. home house work. hannah weaving, wove 5 1/2 yds. home. 4 4 clear cold. mr ballard returnd. home, wound quills. hanh wove 5 1/2 yds. mr livermr evn, left 8 dollars esq coney sent mr ballard. esqr sett boston ys morn. home. 5 5 clear pleast. mr ballard epm giting wood. mr bullin lady brot us beef. jona brot home goos 25 lb beef. went mr shepherds, bot 3 chip hatts sheet past bord paid 3/9 cash. calld mr livermores took ring mr greanlief mended. hannah got piece ye loom, 15-1/2 yds. went stores ye hook. snowd ye night. mr bullin lady 6 6 clear windy, snow flys briskly. mr ballard epm gone meddow, returnd reaching ther reason wind. hannah made cottne wool sheets. jona home since yesterday. mr ballard sett bone left wrist misplast wriding yesterday. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 7-13, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 7 13, 1792 7 7 clear cold. home. mr ballard town. cyrus, jona dolly night. hannah washt larg wash ys day. home. 8 birth danl savages dagt. xx. clear cold morn, moderate aftn evng. calld 11h morn see wife danl savage junr deld 2h pm dead daugt, well self expected. came home evn. calld mr seth williamss, find mr densmore wife mr savages. birth 1st;still born. fee recd may 7th 1793. 9 2 clear cold. mr ballard gone varsalboro hay colo sewall. hannah washt. shee lett stik fall foot, brusd toe almost fainted. mr town dagt patty mr fuller came jona went washington. home. mr savages inft interd fort western. home. funeral mr savages inft. 10 3 clear cold. mr town fuller wnt coart aft breakfast. mr ballard returnd aftn went colo sewalls business. home. cyrus came evn. jon ys night. hannah washt ye rooms ys day. home. cyrus came brot 3 peks indian, 2 wheat, 2 rie meal. 11 4 clear cold morn. mr town fuller went coart aft bkft. two unity men mr ballard cyrus went town. jon home since yester day. home, mended coverld knitt mrs welch home. jon married sally peirce. 12 5 clear. son town went home. home. mr goold fuller sleep shuball pitts allso. home. 13 6 x. birth mr hamlins son. xx. snowd. mr ballard brot hogg home purchast yesterd. calld see mrs hamlin 9 evn, shee deld son 10h 15m. left 10h 45m went capt philibrowns, wife unwell. mr hamlins capt phillibrowns. birth 2nt. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 14-19, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 14 19, 1792 14 7 x. birth mr joness dagt. xx. clear. calld noon capt p browns mr joness, lady deld 3h pm dagt, 3d child, ye 2, sons. tarried night, patients well could expected. mr joness. birth 3d. hannah sent winter gown 15 clear pleast. mr jones brot mrs savage returnd home 1h pm. cyrus sett pitts tn. receivd 6/8 mr jones asistance made prest 1/2 bsl rie piece fresh pork former servises. dtoes. 16 2 clear, cool morn pleast day. mr waid calld see oldest dagt unwell. ephm went teem help break road ys side ye river. returnd night. mr ballard went colo norths carry schadule house fraime mr lee. mr waids, oldest dagtis sick. 17 3 clear cold. mr ballard geting wood. calld mr hamlins, wife unwell taking cold. tarried night, made soap pills; gave 5. shee rested tolerable well., infant fine boy indead. mr hamlins, wife ill turn. hannah mr densmores. 18 4 clear cold. returnd home. mr hamlin made prest quill wheal 3 quarts rice. mr waid informs dagt better. hannah washing. mr hamlins, wife better. 19 5 x. birth savage boltons 4th son 8h evn. severe storm snow. mr ballard gone ye fort, returnd 2h pm. mr savage came directly go savage boltons. went hors back far mr pollards, sleigh mrs savage went sett, got helpt push behind ye carriage. arivd safe sun sett boltons. boltons. birth 4th. tarried night. doleful storm snow,[ fee recd source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 20-25, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 20 25, 1792 20 6 x. birth phillip norcross 1st son. xx. clear high wind. [sic] calld 6h morn go phillip norcross wife labour, men shoveld thro drifts arivd 7. left mrs bolton inft cleverly. mrs norcs deld 1h 30m pm. 5th child first son. tarried night, slept little. patients cleverly. mr norcros home. mr norcross. birth 5th. 21 7 x. birth mr waids son. xx. clear windy. capt fille brown came carried mr norcross house. tarried till 7h evn mr waid calld see wife labour, safe deld first son 3d child middle night. tarried night, sett receivd 6/ mr waid. capt p browns mr waids. birth 6th. 22 clear, calm cold. returnd home mr waids 10h morn, went bed slept. mr livermore capt p brown came conducted house, lady unwell. cold ys night. mr waids capt philebrowns. 23 2 clear excessive cold. ["ditoes" implied] mrs p brown comfortable. ditoes. 24 3 clear cold. tarried capts till evn came home. went mr dumers bot 2yds sarsnet, 1/2 lb snuff, 4yd lawn, mustard sallt; cost 8/4d, paid ye cash. finisht mr ballad buskins calld mr sewalls 11h 30m. ditoes mr dumers, mr ballad jona meddow. 25 4 x. birth moses sewalls dagt. xx. clear cold. mrs sewall safe deld 2h 15m morn dagt, 3d child, well could expected. returnd home dind. receivd 6/ cash, 1/2lb tea, 3 skeins cambk thread compensation. lois hinkley calld mr moses sewalls. birth 7th.mr ballard gone mill. mr searls dind. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 26-31, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 26 31, 1792 26 5 snowd little cold. mr livermr taxes, took coppies &c, &c. mr ballard ephm giting wood. jona gone git ye mare shod. hannah washt. knitt helpt house work. home. 27 6 clear pleast day, cold evng. mr ballard meddow, danl livermr jona mill. home, knitt stockin. hannah began cap. home. 28 7 x. birth mr shaws son. xx. clear moderate. calld mr shaw ye hook see lady labour, arivd ye time ye clock struck 12. shee safe deld 3h pm. son. tarried night, patients cleverly. mr shaws. birth 8th. 29 clear. came mr shaws arivd home 11h morn, receivd 6/ reward. dolly home. hannah shee went mr waids. josh foster cyrus ephm went far capt husseys take ye hors back. jona ys day. moses pollard informs eliphalet robbins recovering late illness. ditoes. dagt went see mrs waid. 30 2 clear pleast day, cloudy evng. mr ballard gone help cyrus fix mill. jona came home aftn. hannah spent evn mr livermrs, dolly mr densmrs dagts home, finisht stockins began foot one. home, hannah mr livermors. 31 3 snowd foren, raind aftrn evn. mr ballard pittstn. jona went meddow camp hauld 5 thousen shingles. home footing pair stockins. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 1-4, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 1 4, 1792 1 4 sun shine cloudy turns, wind westwd. mr ballard returnd pittstn, brot cloath bot mr barker, went mr savages. home kniting stockin. home. 2 5 x. birth capt fillebrown dagt first child. xx. clear pleast. calld see mrs randal ye sitty. shee removd shuball hinkleys night. calld 12h capt f browns, lady women calld 1h pm, safe deld dagt wd 10lb 1h 45m pm, cleverly. shee ill indeed delivery. mr randals capt f browns. birth 9th. dagts went pittstn ys evng. 3 6 x. birts [seth], williamss dagt. xx. clear, sharp air ys morn. calld ye capts 2h 30m morn mr williams, arivd 3. lady ill safe deld 3h 45m seems cleverly. left returnd ye capts 6h 50m. took mr willms gave 6/ reward. went see mis randal, find comfortable returnd home, attended capt f brown bestowd two crowns tea pot sett tea dishes servis mrs densmore cutt goun. mrs lidia cleark sleeps feel great deal falagud. dolly home. mr williamss, ye capts mr randals. birth 10th. 4 7 cloudy. mrs lidia dolly went mr densmores aft breakfast. lidia came back wrode ye carriage yt ephm going mill mr ballard went mr shepherds, bot 2 bushl corn 3/; mr livermores got 2 lb raisens /8, 2 skeins silk /4-1/2; colo duttuns bot w.e.r. 2/1 mr dumers bot 3 yds sarsnet 2/6 pr yd, 1 sheat past bord /8. home, finisht footing worsted hoes began pair yarn ones. ephm pittstn mill. cyrus came home home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 5-8, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 5 8, 1792 5 clear pleast. went pittstn see mrs town unwell. hors stumbled dismounted brusd little able walk till met sleigh. gentlemen asisted mounting hors arivd safety; aplid camphir brouses, tarried dind. left direction medisin returnd home 5h pm. mr seth williams came go see lady well could wisht. went, made use means medisine gave relief spent ye night bror towns mr williams. 6 2 clear windy. returnd mr williams breakfast, find mr ballard gone fairfields back pittstn, ephm mill teem selvs mr densmores livermr; got home 9h evng. mr benn porter son judy heuston wrote doct barton. mr williams. judy heuston benn porter 7 3 clear pleast. went mr densmores. capt savages lady came sent home. cyrus dind conducted mrs savage hook sleigh. sons gone ye meddow. savage bolton brot load hay, informs infant unwell. john savage went one teem. mr densmrs. mrs savage cyrus. 8 4 clear. unwell. hannah gone mr densmores coat cutt calld 2h pm see savage boltons inft, find destresst child. tarried night, tho unable. mr cragg calld see dagt cough complaints. mrs savage boltons. mr boltons, watcht, mrs brown allso. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 9-13, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 9 13, 1792 9 5 cloudy snow. mr bolton went docts bot senan seeds; gave infant calld mrs savage left child little easier returnd home, sett felt exceedingly fatagud, went bed dark. calld ye 11 h pm went joseph preskotts, wife labour. mrs hinkly preskot wrode part way ditoes mr preskots. receivd letter sist waters jany 20th 1792. sent one doct barton. 10 6 x. birth joseph preskots son. xx. clear cool. patient unwell thro night safe deld 6h morn lusty son. left inft cleverly 11 morn arivd home 2h pm; receivd 4lb coffee trouble. jona came home evn, informs yt savage boltons infant expird 5 ys morn. mr preskots. birth 11th. death mrboltn infant. 11 7 clear cold morn, pleast sun ye middle ye day. mr ballard returnd evn, dolly came home. jona attended funeral mr boltons inft, small number home, able perform business. home. funeral mr boltons inft son. 12 birth mr randals son. xx. cloudy morn. calld midnight 1h m see mrs randal, safe deld 1h fine son. shee sufferd arival life mother child preservd. tarried night, receivd fee pork, 18lb, 4lb lard former attendance. left lady inft well could expected. calld see mrs f brown find cleverly. mr randals. birth 12th. 13 2 clear pleast sun cold air, cold night. mr ballard hay, procurd 1/2 ton mr norriss. mr densmores dagts cousin dolly allso. cyrus came daddy go mend mill. home knitting cyruss mitt. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
