title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 14-18, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 14 18, 1792 14 3 clear, pleast sun cold air. mr ballard cyrus sett pittstn, dagts winslow, ephm work mr child. helpt two yoak oxen, jack livermore yesterday; ys day. joseph foster cutt shoes son cyrus. ephm broke [sliyd]. dagts left home 11h morn bound winslow, acompanied mr burtun, pollard patridg. polly self left home. siesd severe paine head held till evng. home. [dagts] went winslow, mr ballard pittstn. 15 4 clear. mr waid workt foren. mr shubal pitts, sister parthenia barton calld going brothers green lodg. home. home, parthenia 16 5 cast ye day jon went meddow lot shingles, mr ballard returnd pittstn. home. dagts returnd winslow. friends health mr pitts brot parthenia home. dagts returnd. ephm went mr sewals, bot 4lb butter /9 2 dozn bisquet paid ye cash. 17 6 cloudy snow. calld see mr densmores inft, unwell. mr pitts, sistr sela, mr burtun lady evn. mr densmors see [inft]. 18 7 cast morn. mr pitts, sistr parthenia left 12 o clock. mr hamlin mr ballard ephm clearing road wood. jona brot 14lb rice, 1/2lb tea, 1 gal molasis. dagts finisht makeing goun. finisht cyruss mitts. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 19-24, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 19 24, 1792 19 cast morn, clear aftn, cloudy evng. dolly went mr peirces. sarah densmore informs inft better. mr hamlin evn. home. cyrus jona went sun sett. home. 20 2 snowd ys morn. cyrus went pittstn, dolly mr densmores. jona ys day till night. mr ballard ephm got load wood. home, feel well could wish. day 57 years old. hannah washing. mr waid supt. home. aneversary birth, 57 years since. 21 3 snowd. mrs densmore sent go see inft. gave decoction sage mullin seems revivd. came home evng. ephm hauling brick mr hamlin. mr densmores. 22 4 cloudy ye day. ephm workt mr hamlin part ye day. brot quill wheal home present mr hamlin polly livermore spent ye evng mr ballard went colo howards evng. home. home. 23 5 clear pleast. mr ballard gone survey run lines jery badcok others. jon gone winthrop. mr walker brot 2 lb cottne 1 lb chocolat former services. mr ballard returnd without ye business went mrs black hannah went mr densmores. went mr livermores. shee well usual. dolly came drank tea. georg brown sleeps 2 horses. mr livermores. mrs black severe fitt ye cramp ys night. 24 6 cloudy morn, clear aftn. mr waid choping wood. mrs wickson, h. rockwood polly livermr latter hatt made. men broke slead home. company, mrs wickson source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 25-29, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 25 29, 1792 25 7 clear, something windy. mrs livermore patty town made dagts visit. david densmore epm carried wood capt meloy receivd 2 setts tea dishes 2 small muggs. mr ballard mended slead. home. dolly came home. home. mrs livermore 26 clear part ye day. snowd evn. patty bullin dind cyrus dolly home, jona home. home. patty bullin 27 2 snow, haill almost raind, uncomfortable day. cyrus tarried jon came home evn. home. dolly went mr densmores ys morn. mr ballard ephm workt ye house barn. hannah spining wool. home. 28 3 clear, plest sun tho cool air. mr ballard cyrus went pittstn, jona went woods shingles. mrs welch jenny goin mr beemans, ye dagt tarry two childn, shee informs shee given mr mitchell 25 mile pond, home. hannah finisht spining mxt wool daddys hoes. home. 29 4 clear, cold morn, pleast day. son jonathan brot wife little son mr ballard returnd pittstn. home, finisht kniting hannah pair hoes. mrs welch shee left dagt jenny mr beemans. home. jona brothis wife visit. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 1-6, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 1 6, 1792 1 5 clear, wind southard. home. childn went mr burtuns visit. ephm helpt mr densmores sons ye hook ashes. mrs black calld went mr densmores try overcoat. home. childn went mr burtuns. 2 6 rain. hannah washt. home. helpt sally nurs babe, well usual. mr ballard home. ephm brot hay mr densmores. dolly went aft breakfast. home. 3 7 clear moderate. mr ballard got wood went ye hook, jona woods shingles; brot home 2lb coffee. seth j foster home mending hoes. dolly came home evng. informd infant mr selvester interd ys aftn. home. funeral mr selvesters infant son. 4 clear pleast. mr ballard severly exercisd pain ye small back. preaching meeting house, attend. mr warrin pittstn performd. cyrus dolly home. mr pollard, patridg, mrs ballard mrs dorcs pollard evn. son jona 29 years old ys day. home. company evn. jonas birth day, 29 years old. 5 2 severe snow storm. jona went pittstn, brot 7 bushels meal. mr ballard easier. home. hannah washt. home. danl fosters wife deld, inft expird. 6 3 birth black edmonds son. snowd ys morn. calld edmond 6h morn see wife. one fall hors, assisted moses white prosceeding rest ye way. lidia delivrd 1h pm son, first born. mr walker conducted home sleigh. hannah bakt pumkin pies. black edmonds. birth 13th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 7-12, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 7 12, 1792 7 4 clear. sally, hannah self went mr livermores, little dagts visit polly town. mr ballard much comfortable mr livermores. 8 5 cloudy snow. mr ballard went mr childs git pair shoes made hannah. ephm mr shepherds, bot chip 2lb. sugar. cost 3/, mr dumers bot 1/2 yd. sarsnet 1/3. mr georg brown brot us 4 bushl wheat 7 mile brook. home. jona well ys day. home. 9 6 snowd little foren, clear aftn. sally hannah spent ye aftn evng mr densmores. jona went haull shingles. went girls evn. mrs densmore unwell. home. mr livermore returnd home westwd 10h. evng. home. dagts went mr densmores. mr livermre returnd westwd. 10 7 snowd. went see mrs densmore, shee unwell, gave camphir aplid hott bricks feet, brot perspiration shee seemd little relievd. dolly wrode home ye sleigh hannah bakt pies. mr georg brown sore finger. mr livermore mr densmores. 11 g rain foren. cyrus came home dinner, waited mr densmores. find little comfortable. jona dolly sheep lambd, twins. mr densmores. 12 2 cloudy. jonns lambs brot ye hous, feeble revivd. mrs livermore went see old lady coney, shee ill turn, little better. deaon coneys. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 13-17, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 13 17, 1792 13 3 snowd part ye day. mr burtun came hannah keep house wife went winthrop visit. jona carried wife son home. home. feel well usual. mr ballard ephm made pen sheep. dollys lambs expird. capt porter home. hannah burtuns. sally went home. 14 4 clear. unwell. mr ballard ephm workt ye barn. old mr ingerham jon came home dind went town. unwell could sett ye aftern. home day. home. 15 5 clear pleast. mr ballard went meddow. hannah returnd 12 oclock. mr hamlin, burtin, pollard, pattridg, esq hales lady, 2 mrs bisbes, rockwood sally hamlin ladies dind drank coffee mr haywood, pollard pattridg waited dagts evng mr pollards. home, unwell ye foren, comfortable aftern. mrs haill polly bisbe returnd slept home. dagts went mr hamlins. receivd letters doct barton bror collins feby 12. 16 6 snowd raind. mr haywood m pollard came conducted mrs haill mrs bisbe town. mr densmore waid wives calld way ye hook. mr ballard, ephm david densmr ye meddow, returnd giting hay except hand sleigd load, ye boy halld. home, well yet. mr black came acompanied dagts house. jona came home evng informs son burnt one feet day. home. company. dagts gone mr blacks. spent ye evng mr thomass. 17 7 clear pleast. home. mr ballard ephm got load wood. dolly went mr densmores ys morn returnd evn. saw esqr coney wride ye river sun sett. home. esqr coney returnd frm boston. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 18-23, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 18 23, 1792 18 g clear foren, cloudy aft n, snowd evn. mrs densmore ys day. david sleeps cyrus home home. jona sheep lambd. gave dolly decoction two worm woods. home. mrs densmore 19 2 rain ye morn, foggy day. mr ballard, epm d. densmr brot hay mr waids. home. hannah washt. cyrus went mill. dolly service, sheep better. home. 20 3 cloudy till 9h. morn, ye sun shone, pleast ye remainder ye day, cool evng. mr ballard ephm d.densmore gone ye medow. john savage sett ye teem little night. home knitting stockin mr ballards. jona ye hook ye fort. polly cowen swore child phinneas pain ys day. home mr ballard gone ye meddow. 21 4 cloudy morn, sun shine ye aftern. mr ballard returnd meddow, boys brot little hay home. jon wood, shingles brout went see james savage, finds low. home, finisht knitting mr ballard pair hoes. hannah gone mr dinsmores, polly livermr allso. home. hannah went mr densmrs. 22 5 cloudy morn, clear rest ye day, sun eclipsed. jona brot wife mrs densmore visit, husband mr waid supt. mr livermr wife, mr ballard went mr phillip norcroses, childn cough. colo sewall foren. mr norcross. 23 6 clear foren snowd little night, raind night. mr ballard went hay could get came home much fatagud. mr livermore wife hors sliegh, went ye hook, came back 2h. p.m. dind. shee spent aftn went home evn. home. home. isaiah manly workthere. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 24-31, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 24 31, 1792 24 7 rainy morn cloudy till 3h. p.m. ye sun shone. mr ballard went mr stephenss. home. jona went hook ye fort. ephm cowen dind. dolly came home evng. home. 25 g clear pleast. esq coney calld see us. cyrus dolly home. home. mr manley went cousins. home. 26 2 clear pleast, white frost ys morn. dolly went away early. mr ballard went survey little mr livermr took breakfast mr john jones dind home knitt hannah washt. jona went woods shingles. cyrus went mill. manly came work ye 3d day drest flax us. home. mr john jones 27 3 foggy misty day. calld see mr nathl shaws infant, cough appeard danger fitts. mrs lishance watcht. mr shaws. 28 4 cloudy misty. inft revivd returnd home 1h. p.m. jona ye hook fort. ephm sugar works mr densmores. ditoes. 29 5 clear. home. mr ballard ephm assisting ye sugar works. jona sett saw mill work, sawd 1 log. hannah sally carding sping cottne. home. fast day. 30 6 clear pleast. mr ballard waid makeing troughs collect sap jona ye saw mill, ephm dad. 13 years old night 11 hours evng. home nursing jack, well. hurt eye nale. home. ephms birth day. 31 7 clear cool morn, pleast day. went see mrs livermore polly, unwell. mr manly brot dolly home evng. mr ballard ephm ye sap works, jona saw mill. mr livermrs. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 1-5, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 1 5, 1792 1 g clear pleast. home, cyrus dolly home. three dagts went see mrs livirmore, shee pain face ocationed cold. well could wish self ys day. home. dolly wrote wido barton. 2 2 clear pleast. town met vote govrs, sennater, &c, went see mrs livermore, shee little easier. mr densmore, wife, two dagts dagt ice broke river open allmost acrost, houses. parted people crost boats ye fort. mr livermores. company. 3 3 clear pleast. mr ballard went mr joness, informs yt yr son stephen scolt badly. went see mrs livermore, find unwell. face sweld shee much pain. applyd cateplasm made hysop wheat bran, shee seems easier. ice removd river open aftern. docs. rivir opend. 4 4 clear pleast. jonn wife went house keeping. hannah wrode sally, ephm walkt. mr manly went carried jonns things water ye forenn. mr ballard colo howards. went see mrs livermore, find much comfortable. mrs hinkly white selvenus hatch sleeps mr waid mr ballard divided flax raisd land. mr livermors. 5 5 foggy showers, lite ones. went peter joness see son scalt. tarried night, child little easiel. went bed sleep little. mr peter joness. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 6-11, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 6 11, 1792 6 6 foggy morn, clear middle ye day. drest stephens joness burn went see son jonas wife, returnd mr joness. made ointment lint seed oil, bees wax rosin. drest child sett home. mr crage calld see little dagt sick canker. drank tea mrs h. cox arivd home dusk, rodes muddy wet way. mr ballard laying house lotts ye hook mr vauhn. ditoes sons mr craggs. 7 7 rainy morn, clear aftn. mr ballard doct coneys ye hook mr savages. informs yt mr joness mr crages childn mending. home, found turky nest, 5 eggs hannah finisht comeing flax. dolly sleeps night. home. 8 g clear, wind southardly. jona dind informs son well could wish. mr jones mr livermore took tea home. home. mr john jones mr lory goodins house burnt. 9 2 cloudy rain. mr ballard went mr vahans. home. found blak turky 7 eggs home. 10 3 clear. mr ballard went survey colo duttun. home. mr woodward dind home. mr woodwd 11 4 clear part ye day. mr ballard epm john savage brot bords mr livermore, find lady much weller. finisht mr ballards hoes. mr livermrs. snowd evn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 12-15, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 12 15, 1792 12 5 cloudy morn, ground coverd snow, sun shone middle ye day, cloudy evng. mr ballard lay house lott mr dany ye hook. home. mrs porter dagt dolly sleep son jona broke mill saw ys day. one swine yesterdy, another ys day. home. carded cottne. mrs porter 13 6 cloudy, chilly air. esqr cony paid attendance medesin dagt dolly. demand 6/. mrs porter left dind. dagts sally densmore went help mrs norcross quillt bed quillt. pally went uncles take care little son. ephm went see safe home. home. mrs porter went home, dagts quillting, patty jonathans. 14 7 cloudy rain. mr ballard mr seth j. fosters pittstn. son town came evng, left famely well. informs yt hannah davis son weak old. home, mended mr ballards short coat. calf come. home. son town 15 g clear, frost ys morn. wrode far mr shepherds. calld mr shaws, inft better. mr phillip norcross gave 6/ returning home, assisting wife 20th jany. mr shepherds d. colmans [home]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 16-21, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 16 21, 1792 16 2 clear cold. mr ballard mr savages, haveing cumpas mended. mr town went mr bisbe home, feel unwell. mr manley workt mr wade. home. son town went home. 17 3 snowd ye day. mr ballard mr wade setled acounts. manly made gate. mr ball went hook town, receivd 8/ petr voce isaac hardin left attending wife illness. home. home. isaac hardin paid 8/. 18 4 clear cool. mr ballard survey land mr briggs. esqr wesson sleeps home, spun 15 knots linning yn thread. home. esqr wesson 19 5 clear cool air. mr ballard esqr wesson went esqr coneys engagd lay 21 town ships, rivers penobscott kenebeck. land belongs commonwelth. home. hannah scoured puter kitchen. seth manley brot us corn workt one yoak oxen. home. mr ballard esqr wesson esq coneys. 20 6 clear. seth manly workt ys day oxen. mr ballard lay road joseph preskots. home. home. mr ballard surveying road. 21 7 clear. mr ballard esqr coneys, receivd 30 dollars part surveying commonwealth. allso went mr shepherds ye fort business. home. hannah made pumkin pies. mr webber wife ill. home. capt howard howland went aftnn vessels. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 22-27, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 22 27, 1792 22 g clear. home. mr livrmr, densmr. child, hamlin, burtn wives others cyrus dolly home, jona wife babe allso. home. company 23 2 x. birth saml jacksons dagt. xx. clear. calld saml jackson see wife, safe deld 1h pm dagt. shee turn faintness revivd. left arivd home sun sett. saml jacksons. birth 14th. receivd6/ fee july 5. 24 3 clear, frost number morns past. home. bror town cyrus dind slept night. brot mill spindle mr savage mend. mr manley left noon. mr ballard paid service month past. home. brr town cyrus manly left 25 4 clear. mr ballard gon town. ephm john savage brot home barril pork mr pitts, 28lb sugar /11d, 18lb chocolat 1/5. bror town cyrus came evn sleep home. bror town cyrus sleep 26 5 cloudy, wind n e. raind snowd night. mr ballard gone winslow. bror town cyrus went 2h pm. jona went desk barl cyder. home. home. mr ballard gone winslow. 27 6 cloudy, snowd ye morn, clear little night. mr ballard came home noon. well son towns. went ye hook, breud barrild, bot tinn kettle, 3 dippers fustian ephm cloaths, went mill. home. home. hen, brot 11 chicks source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 28-May 2, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 28 may 2, 1792 28 7 clear. mr ballard makeing preperation tour woods. home. john savage workt us. put 16 eggs turkey. dolly came home. mr livrmr supt home. 29 g clear pleast. preparing mr ballards deparlure lay town ships. wm haywood jona dind. mr jones took tea home. mr jones 30 2 x. birth moses whites dagt. fee receivd. xx. clear pleast. calld see moses whites lady travil. arivd 4h morn. lady safe deld dagt 11h 5m. left 2 pm, find return mr ballard took departure tour surveying 12 o clok. may god prospur return company safety. receivd 6/ mr white mr roberson. letter bror collins 2d inst, one doct barton 16th; hannah one fm aunt barton 18, inform friends well. mr moses whites. birth 15th. mr ballad sett tour surveyng. recievd letters fm oxford. 1 3 clear pleast. john savage came work. home, began make gardin. home. workt gardin. 2 4 clear pleast day frost ys morn. workt ye gardin till near night, went see mrs livermore well usual. hannah pain head. mr livrmrs. sowd somecarrot seed. hannah unwell evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 20-23, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 20 23, 1792 20 g clear morn. went bed day, rose sun, took breakfast left mr preskotts 7h morn accompanied noah, son. calld mr benn porters, wife gave legg veal. calld mr fosters, find inft well could expected. ill turn yesterdy milk came, cleverly. arivd home ye 11th h morn, took dinner went see mrs livermore put bed yesterdy, cleverly; inft allso. calld see wife leml jackson, arivd 8h pm, find exercisd cramp pains. tarried night, much fatagud exercise. came mr preskotts went leml jacksons. receivd 9/ mr preskott. 21 2 clear. mrs jackson relievd distress left 3h pm. calld jonas, mr childs wessons. arivd home 8 evn. jacksons. 22 3 clear. went see mrs livermr foren. son jona dind informs daddy well expects return home soon. went stores aftern. mr livermors. putt 17 eggs undr turkey. 23 4 clear. mr densmore wife datt dolly dind mrs dinsmr went see mrs livermore cleverly. ditoes wrote doctbarton. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 31-Jun. 1, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 31 june 1, 1792 31 5 x. birth james childss son. xx. clear warm. mrs childss illness came women calld shee safe deld fine son 0h 30mpm cleverly, every circumstance seemd agreeable, alass, changesing seins take place. 8 evng number collected diverting selves, may use expression, fireing field pieces, three men; vis voce, james saml johnson wounded unexpectd discharg reason properly swabd. two johnsons thought mortally wounded, carried mr craggs. went mr childs batheir [sic] wounds returnd mr childs. mr [childs]. birth 22[nt]. threemen wounded discharg field piece. nancy gillmanwent mr childs mr shepherds. 1 6 clear cooler. went mr craggs, helpt dress wounded. saml johnson carried bier born 4 men mr craggs mr childs dresst. took care thro day. doct colman informd wife childn went board vessel bound nubury. went mr hamlins, burtuns. mrs wicksom mr craggs childs hamlins. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 2-4, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 2 4, 1792 2 7 cool rainy. mr childs takeing care saml johnson. mrs childs infant well indeed. made ointment applyd sams soars, bathd spirrit wormwd. mr ballard returnd survey health. came mr childs conducted home water, ephm assisted. calld mr pollards, find well shee could wish reason troubles shee calld bear. mrs childs made prest handkercf. find famely turkeys hatcht, ye whole 43 chicks. mr childs mr pollards. mr child givs credit 15/ reward asistance 3 g clear morn. gatherd fine mess greens gardin. cyrus, jona dolly mr ballard went mr livermores, shee inft cleverly. mr livermores. 4 2 clear morn, cloudy aftern. went mr childss, wife inft cleverly. johnson well expected. calld mr pollards, pitts, mr wessons, bot store 2 skeins silk /5/, 1 quart 3 gills rhum cost 1/6, 1 comb 2/, 3 lemmons 1/. came home informd yt mrs livermore unwell. went see gave directions take remedies returnd home. mr childss neigrs. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 5-10, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 5 10, 1792 5 3 cloudy rain. workt gardin, mr ballard makeing plann survey. hannah went brothers evng. home. 6 4 clear foren, cloudy misty evng. mr ballard gone pownalboro. weading gardin, went see mrs livermore; find comfortable. hannah washt west roome floore. mr livermores. 7 5 birth enenz church dagt. xx. cloudy, rainy day. knitting. ephm trod board nale, lambd self. wrote bror collins, send mr burtun. calld 8h evn ebenz church see wife labour. child born alive), arival, shee dangerous circumstance. ebenz churches. birth 23d. 8 6 cloudy morn, clear aftern. relievd patient 4h morn left comfortable. came home 10h, receivd 6/ reward. went bed slept. mrs dorcis pollard dagt dolly son town sleeps famely well; sistmc causland low. ditoes. mrs dorcas pollard dagt dolly 9 7 clear hott. esqr wesson took breakft took coppy plann. mr town left homewd bound. mr ballard returnd coart. home. home. 10 g clear, pleast day. son jona wife little son ephm brot ym water returnd home cyrus dolly home allso. dagts went mr livermores tea lheir bror sistr. home. home. childn phins[pains] dagt born. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 11-15, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 11 15, 1792 11 2 clear warm. home, workt gardin spent time seeking turkeys knitt hannah washt, mr ballard went mr craggs. home. 12 3 clear warm. workt gardin fornn, felt much come laid ye bed time. mr ballard ephm weading corn, began morn. mrs woodward hannah wall home. mrs woodwd 13 4 clear, ye wind southerly. shuball pitts wm haywood mr ballard ephm weading corn. home, kniting workt gardin. polly livermore informs mammy fell thro ye floor hurt self. ephm gone evng mr waids eels. home. 14 5 clear till near night light shour. mr shepherd gave invitation go see lady tomorrow. home, finisht kniting dagt towns hoes doubled yarn dolly pair, wed gardin little, &c. mr ballard ephm houghing corn. home. 15 6 clear pleast. mr ballard surveying hous lotts ye hook. bot 1/2 barl beef mr devenp. went mr shepherds, returnd found son jon wife son, mr haywood sister p. bisbe dagt dolly ye girls sleep twisted yarn dolly pair hoes began knitt mr shepherds. company source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 16 19, 1792 16 7 clear warm. mrs bisbe, haywood dagty hannah went see mrs fillibrown ys foren, son jonas aftern. mrs nancy cleark dind mr livermore supt. mr ballard finisht weading corn. ephm attempted going mill water, got far mr shepherds. thee wind left canoe corn daddy went brot home home, workt gardin hous work; feel much fatagud. home. compay. 17 g x. birth mr dawss son. xx. clear warm. calld 7h 30m mr haws see mrs daws labour, deld 9h evn fine son, fifth child, males. tarried night, mrs cox allso. patients well could expected. mr daws sett long reach morn. mrs ney, greely, parmur, sherburn mrs cox assistants. mr daws. birth 24th. 18 2 clear warm. went mr shephards, bot 2lb loaf sugar 2/, _ hyson tea, cost 2/6. came back mrs daws, left cleverly returnd home 2h pm. mr ballard gone pittstn mill. mr shephards. 19 3 clear hott. wed gardin foren. calld mr jere whites see child, toothing feaverish. came home 4 pm, bror moore dagts wint mr hamlins. returnd mr whites, tarried night. jere whites. mr ballard raising mr dummrs house. bro moore source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 20-23, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 20 23, 1792 20 4 clear except sprinkling rain. went mr whites see mrs lashance sick, see mrs daws; find cleverly. calld mrs sherburns, selvesters, greelys, capt fillibrowns mr norcrosses. arivd home night. mr ballard went town. ephm workt mr kenadas. mr whites child seems comfortable. mr whites neighbours. receivd 6/ saml cumings junr allending wife. 21 5 clear, coolish air. home, workt gardin mr silas barns mr ballard went meddow. ephm went pittstn see capt grants vessel lancht disapointed, launcht yester day. jona informd mrs jones unwell ocationed husbands ill usuage, keeping seller bare foot. o wretch, deserves severe puneshment. home. informd yt p jones abusd wife. 22 6 clear warm. workt gardin forenn. mr livermore wife polly dolly sally densmr allso. informd sun sett billy foster fell canoe drowned. bot 17lb veal mrs coutch /3 pr lb. paid cash. home. mrs livermr billy foster drowned 6h pm. 23 7 clear. workt gardin. dagts went winthrop. billy foster interd 4h pm. mr ballard finisht weading corn. home. funeral wm foster. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 24-28, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 24 28, 1792 24 g clear, cool air. cyrus dind went brors. patty sore throat. mr childs borax apply wives nipples, inft sore mouth. dolly returnd winthp. hannahs hors got ye pasture shee tarried. attended baptist meeting, saw one mrs smith baptised. mr baxter mrs dorcas pollard joind wedlock evng. home. 25 2 clear foren, cloudy sprinkling rain aftn. mrs desnmr dolly came dagt tarries night. mr ballard left home bound winslow apriser land belonging mr pitt, esqr williams purchace. dagt hanh returnd winthp ys evng. home. mr ballard went winslow. 26 3 clear day, sprinkling rain evng. went mr norcross 4 milk pans, pay ym. mr dana gave refues puding pan. suky norcross cleand seller ys day. mr norcross. 27 4 clear. home. mrs white hannah went mr livermores son dagt town oldest youngest dagts dolly home. son dagt town came 28 5 clear. dolly, son jona, wife little son came dind took tea. mrs densmr went acquaint mrs livermr yt childn, others taken field, wallowing ye grass. mrs livermors. childn except cyrus. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 29-Jul. 3, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 29 july 3, 1792 29 6 showers foren. son town, wife dagts sett ye 11th h morn bound pittstn. wed gardin hannah well usual. home. 30 7 clear hott. home, wed beets sett cabbages son town, wife dagts returnd pittstn; dads famely well, sister mc causlin comfortable shee inft low. expected long survive. son town left went far sons. home. well usual. son dagt town childn sett home. 1 g clear. dagt hannah tooth extracted morn mr livermore. mr ballard self son ephm attended public worship. mr smith discourst ye morn john 7th c 37:v ye aftn fm 1 corinth 4th 20th. mr livermr exercise. cyrus came home evn. hannah well could wish. attended worship. mr joseph slackpl son born, alive. 2 2 clear. workt gardin foren. calld see georg bollons wife labour, 1h pm. shee remaind linguring situation thro ye night. georg boltons. 3 3 birth georg boltons 4th son 5th child. clear. patients illness increast ye 11th h morn shee safe deld 30m pm son, mother inft cleverly. left 3 arivd home night, considerably fatagud. hannah patty mr densmores. birth 25th. bot pair shoes hannah, cost 4/8. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 4-8, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 4 8, 1792 4 4 clear cool. home, able sett ye day reason fatagues. mrs bradbury hatt made dagt hannah. home. 5 5 cloudy part ye day. hannah washt. went mr livermrs, lady went spent aftern mr densmores, mrs edson dolly came home, tarries ys night. mr ballard ye hook, bot 2/1 galn n e rhum 1 galn molases. dolly went mr wessons, bot self pair shoes. gave money. mr densmores. s.j. foster saml jackson paid asisting wives. 6 6 clear. home mending kniting. dagt hannah maid bunnit anew finisht mrs bradburys; shee came betsy champny allso. mr ballard houghing beans ye entervail. home. nathaniel voce drowned ye hook. 7 7 clear. houghd cabbages went hook. informd yt nathanl voce drowned yesterdy interd ys aftn. find return home thal mr ballard gone sett ye jury inquest ye boddy. purchast stores thread cost 1/6, tape bobn 1/6, silk sewng /6, sugr 2/, shalloon 2/6, fan 1/6, snuff 1/, 7yds callico 2/10; 19/10; 6lb buttr /7; 3/7. mr voce interd ys aftern. hook far mr shepherd. funeral mr voce, attended 4h pm. 8 g clear. mr ballard, dagts ephm attended worship foren aftn allso. cyrus self aftern. mr smith discourst numbers 23d 10th. attended worship. aft. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 9-14, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 9 14, 1792 9 2 x. birth wilm swantns dagt. xx. cloudy moderate rain aftern. calld ys morn see mrs swanton labour first child. shee safe deld 9h evng fine dagt. mother inft cleverly. tarried thro thee night. capt savages. birth 26th. receivd 6/ reward. 10 3 rainy. returnd home 6h morn. feel falagud, went bed slept. sett plants aftern. dtoes. 11 4 clear hott. well could wish workt gardin; removd beets. gatherd string beens, ye first ys summer. mr ballard ephm mowing. mr benn leighton sleeps home. mr ballard began mow grass home. string beens. 12 5 clear. mr ballard giting hay. ephm unwell ys aftern, able sett dady complains pain back. applid burdock leavs, wiltid spirrit. houghd gardin foren raiked hay aftern. hannah dolly went mr burtuns, find brors wife mrs oliv hamlin mrs livirmore evn. home. ephm unwell. 13 [6] cloudy part ye day. mr ballard went ye meddow, freer pain. ephm able work. home. mrss ferwell, lee, mrs betsy howard home. hains learned sleeps 14 7 clear. mr savage calld see wife, shee pain ear face. went sons mr burtuns, bot lenten hand krcf 4/6, mr wessoms bot pint half brandy, cost 2/1. sons neigrs. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 15-19, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 15 19, 1792 15 g clear. mr ballard, self ephm attended public worship day, son cyrus aftern. mr smith discourst 1st john v ch 10 vers ye morn; aftn fm proverbs 1st 29th. mr livermr evn, drank tea. dolly tarries ys night. meeting. wm briggs nabby fuller publisht ye 2nd time. 16 2 rainy. son jona mr savage way pownalboro. cyrus went ye hook, bot 1 quart 1/4 w e rhum, 2lb sugar, 1 tea pott, 1 bowl. mr eustiss, hamlin, burtun yr wives sisters drank tea. hannah rockwood hurt foot going ye river, brot back tarries ys night. home, company. h. rockwd spraint foot tarries ys night. 17 3 rainy. s. jewet foster inft mending. son cyrus mrs rockwd dind mr daws sent 6/ reward assisting lady labour june 17th. mrs rockwd went home hors back, cyrus hannah company. hannah went see brother, well home. 18 4 clear hott. isaac savage workt mr ballard mowing. son cyrus went winslow, ephm pittstn mr densmores son. mrs livermr gave piece lamb. home, knitt home. 19 5 clear hott. ephm went brors, brot cherries. sally babe came aftern. 2 mr leightons came mow noon. home. dolly tarries ys night. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 20-24, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 20 24, 1792 20 6 shour ys morn. dolly went mr densmors. mr livermore butcherd 2 piggs us. roasted one dinner. dolly came dind, jona wife allso. left 3 o clock home, well. home. jona wife went home. 21 7 x. birth benn preskotts 2nd son. xx. clear fine morn. calld dawn day see benn preskotts wife, safe deld 1h pm son. left comfortable 3h 15m. wride shower, arivd home 4. mr preskott gave 6/ reward. mr savage see could go see wife causd hurrying home. dolly complains pain head. benn preskotts. birth 27. 2nd child. cyrus winthrop day. 22 g clear. feel well could wish, attend public worship. rest famely except patty. colo duttun supt dolly complains pain head. home. 23 2 clear. went far sons. calld see mrs andrews mrs savage, well. mr hamlin house phraim raisd aftern. mr [sic] dagts gone daunce, ephm allso. sally gone capt savages. jonas neigrs. mr ballard finisht geting hay. 24 3 x. birth mr andrews son. xx. cloudy. calld day see thee wife saml dawin, met ye foot ye hill beyond savage boltons news shee got bed, returnd home. mr andrews calld noon, wife deld son 4h pm. tarried night, patient cleverly. mr andrwss. birth 27th. saml dawin child born ys morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 25-31, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 25 31, 1792 25 4 rain foren, clear aftern. returnd mr andruss 9h morn, find hannah cox work mr ballard went pownalboro ys aftern. mr vahan calld mr andrewss. 26 5 clear. mr ballard pownalboro. home. hannah washt. shubl pitts ephm david hilling corn. jona mare much sweld jaw. home. 27 6 clear morn. mr waid breakfstd little son bringing hay place us, brot 24 hundred. mr ballard returnd coart. home. 28 7 x. birth mr sheppads son. xx. clear. calld seee mrss sheppard, arivd 12 o clok. shee calld mrs ney evng deld 9h fine son, 3d child. mrs cox sett patient well could expected. mr sheppards. birth 28th. 29 g clear warm. tarried patient thro ye day, mrs cox allso. left 7 evn. receivd 24/ 8 reward, walkt home. calld capt fillebrowns, daws norcross. 30 2 clear. went mr livermores forenn, mr densmores aftern. mr ballard ephm houghing, jona wife sidney. mr livrmores densmores. 31 3 clear hott. roasted pigg. mrs densmr dolly dind. mrs livermr, mrs densmr went shubl hinkleys aftern. receivd letter brr elijah june 17th. mr hinklys. receivd line brr elijah june 17th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 1-4, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 1 4, 1792 1 4 clear. mr ballard sett survey mr vauhan. mr wing returnd mr ballards papers. son jona dind cyrus aftern. dagts went mr wessons, shee son chever calld foren. home. mr wing gave mr ballard 1/2_ servis done. 2 5 clear. calld see mrs savage exercisd severe pain stomach. adminestred remeds gave relief. went see jobe springer unwell. dagts went quillt mrs baxter, lucy pettie allso. mr savages springers. 3 6 clear. returnd home, calld mr pollards. hannah informd mrs sheppard wisht see went, find cleverly. made prest bottle wine. purchast pair lether sliprs 5/, papr pins /9. savages, pollards sheppards. 4 7 clear. mr ballard went pittstn early ys morn, jona gone allso. went board capt howland, bot 8_ lb wool 1/9; mr wessons bt 2_ lb loaf sugar 2/4, 2 brown 1/1 1lb raisens /9; mr childs, paid 2/6 makeing patties shoes. mrs baxter visit. mr wesson 1 quart w e r 3 lemmons, mr livermr 6lb butter, others 7_ lb lamb, 2 dzn pigions. abrm page washington sent 3/ due since twins birth. mr wessons neigrs, board howland &c. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 5-9, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 5 9, 1792 5 g clear. mr ballard, self lucy pettie, ephm polly attended worship, cyrus aftern. mr frisby ipswich performed. spoke foren acts 17th 30:31, aftern fm matth 11th 30th. mrs baxter left evn. colo sewall child baptisd ye name meriah, mr capin one namd charlotta, mr livermr one ye name alpheus. mr abrm pages childn one mrmc masters baptisd evn mrmc masters. mr livermr meeting. mr frisby performd. 6 2 clear till near night little rain ought giv thanks. mr ballard sett unity. dagt hannah 23 years old ys day. gatherd part cammomile. home. 7 3 clear warm. calld see mr andrewss inft, sick ye thrush. tarried night, much rest. jonas, mrs swanton mr andwss. 8 4 clear warm. returnd home 1h pm, able sett till near night. left ye inft little easier. find dagt washing. dolly sally densmr ditoes. 9 5 clear hott. home. dolly sleeps ys night. esq coneys dagts home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 11-15, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 11 15, 1792 11 7 clear except lite shower evn. home. mr ballard returnd evn unity, brot malloncolly news david page drowned aftern pond capt whichers. home. david page drowned ys aftern. 12 g clear warm. attend worship. cyrus came noon, laid slept. mr winget calld. page taken water morn. mr medcalf go see mrs sheppard. went evn, find nurs gone. mr sheppards. david page takn water morn. 13 2 shower ys morn, cloudy day. mr ballard dagt hannah attended funeral david page. mr pollard hannah went mr porters. parthenia barton came home shee 20 years old ys day, polly town 9 years. home. parthenia came david page interd aftn. 14 3 cloudy fine rain. home. mr ballard went ye hook ye fort, ephm pittstn mill. home. 13 turkeys hatcht. 15 4 clear part ye day, showers. mr ballard went help cyrus dres mill. home. dolly sleeps sally, polly [poly] livermr home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 21-26, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 21 26, 1792 21 3 clear pleast. left patients cleverly returnd home 9h morn. mr petingl bestowd 9/ reward. mr seth williams lady made prest coffee, tea sugar. mr ballard surveying hous lotts ye hook. jery fairfield, wife bror dind ephm went jonans. ditoes. company 22 4 clear. mr ballard laying hous lott mr pitt mr wessons. mr lankester dind ephm brot 3 quarters lamb home, lent one mr andrus, 8_. mrss burtun, sister mrs rockwd husband brr came acompany home. home. mrs burtun others fitt ye cramp ys night. 23 5 clear. mr ballard went survey mr vauhn. dagt s niece went quillt mrss baxter. mrs kidder thwing, leighton bradbury home. home. company. girls home. 24 6 clear morn. mrss leighton left breakfast. began rain noon. mr ballard son went mr burtuns keg molases. home. home. smart shower evng. 25 7 cloudy part ye day, rain. mr ballard prepareing tour surveying. mr bullin lady sidney. home. robertmc causlands infant expird. 26 g x. birth saml churchs son, 4th child. xx. clear cool. mr ballard epm attended worship foren self aftern. augustus ballard, cyrus mr pollard dind went mr livermores, inft unwell. mr smith discourst luke 6th 4:5:6:7:8 verss. saml churches wife deld 11h 30m evng. meeting. mr mc causlands dagt interd 3 o clok. birth 30th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 2-7, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 2 7, 1792 2 g clear part ye day. went meeting mr childs. famely tarried home. hannah tooth extracted. cyrus came home evng. mr livermores swine field number times. went self informd mr childs mr livermores. dagt dolly 20 years old day. 3 2 clear. girls washt ye brook. calld 2h pm see mrs savage labour. women calld evng. mr savages. 4 3 birth isaac savages dagt. clear. mrs savag deld 2h morn dagt, 11th child cleverly. calld early see mr andrewss infant sick chin cough. went sons, son unwell. returnd home evn. saw mr benn brown, wife sister way canaan. mrs brown recoverd late indisposition. birth 31st. mrandrus paid fee 6/ allendance. isaiah manley expird. 5 4 x. birth charls clearks son. xx. clear. calld night see charls clearks wife deld 3h morn son, 4th child, 3d destilule reason reason fitts. receivd 6/ mr cleark, gave former acount 6/. calld see mr uriah clearks dagts confind weakness. calld mr pollards mr hodges, childn unwell. charl clearks. birth 32nt.my girls went mr pollards evng. 6 5 clear. helpt hous work. girls went help mrs weston quillt. son town famely well. mrs oliv hamlin came home dagts. home. mrs oliv hamlin son town. 7 6 clear foren, cloudy aftn. mr ballard returnd surveying ys commonwelth. mr town pitt ys night. home. dind turkey. home. mr ballard returnd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 8-15, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 8 15, 1792 8 7 clear till 3h pm showers thunder. oliv hamlin left arivd home began rain. mr ballard mrs porter son town mr pitt left morn. home. mrs porter 9 g cloudy. mr ballard patty went meeting. ephm went dagt ballard. shee babe came. mr pollard son jona aftern. cyrus home. jona wife wrode hors home. home. moses polld hannah ballard published. 10 2 clear. mrs porter went home. capt blunt took breakfast mr ballard sett waldoborough. home takeing care field. mrs livermore dagt home. mrs livermore mr balld waldoboro. 11 3 clear. home takeing care field. leut nichols oxford mr ebenz davis charlton dind mrss wesson mrs lovjoy took tea. parthinea went mr foots. mr pitt sleeps dagt dolly allso. home. mrs wesson son cyrus 36 years old day. leut nichols 12 4 clear. workt field day gathering husking corn. norths horses broak ye fence lay corn night. home. 13 5 clear. home like servic. wilm dinsmr helpt yesterday. hannah weaving. home. 14 6 clear. huskt gatherd corn. wilm workt mrs brown sleeps shee right mind. home. 15 7 cloudy. mrs brown left gatherd corn. mr ballard returnd home unwell. home. aunt moore oxford interd ys dy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 16-21, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 16 21, 1792 16 g x. birth mr allins dagt. xx. clear part ye day. calld mr allin 7h morn see wife. shee safe deld 9 dagt. left cleverly 12. mr allin gave 6/ reward. conducted ye ferry attended worship public afternn, walkt home. ephm chicken pox. mr allins. birth 33d.cyrus home. rainy night. 17 2 cloudy rain. home, mending ephms cloaths. mr ballard hook. parthenia returnd sydne. selv moore folks well. home. 18 3 clear. home, mr ballard town meeting. home. 19 4 clear. mr ballard rest famely went see ye muster. mrs mc causland others dind took tea jonas wife tarries receivd [9]/ mrs powel asisting home. general muster ye regament shubal hinkleys. andrus son jona fout. 20 5 cloudy morn. dagt ballard sett home, went far mr densmores, informd yt husband beat mr andrus last evng. shee came back mr ballard went mr norcross, finds bad represented. jona came went see sally sett arivd safe home. ephm went wrode hors back. mr shubl pitt jona dind home. home. 21 6 clear. home, cast 23 candles. mr ballard pittstn. mrs white informs mr andrus poorly. mr ballard met mr davis going doct parker come see doct page attends home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 22-27, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 22 27, 1792 22 7 clear. parthenia went mr shaws foren. went lecter aftern went mr norcross. return, see mr andrus; find ye recovery. lecter mr norcross. 23 g clear pleast. mr ballard, self patty attended worship public. mr frisby performd administred thee ordinances ye supper bapt ism child mr wessons. meeting. 24 2 clear. mr ballard working high way. went see mr andrus fore nn sons aftern. found mr andrus comfortable son taken, david pollard david berry allso. crime wich aledgd warrant riott. thee tryal pospond till octr. hook sons. hannah got web 45 yards. 25 3 clear pleast. went see andrus forenn. mr ballards request, invited com hous tarry till able go home. diclind accepting favour. came home noon. old lady norcros, sons wives mrs livermore afternn. mr norcross. 26 4 cloudy. went aftern jobe springers see wheal bot capt houland, gave 13/ 2/9 pair cards. bot 1/2 bushl apples mrs pollard 1/3. mr springers neigrs. 27 5 rainy. mr ballard ephm went see mrs medcalf baptisd plunging. home. home. snowd raind. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 28 october 3, 1792 28 6 clear, cold n w wind. mrss hinkley calld home, mr working thee bridg. home. 29 7 clear pleast. mr densmore butcherd swine us wd 30[ mr ballard went ye hook. esq jewet [dover] sleeps home. mrs colman calld home. 30 g clear. mr ballard parthenia dolly ephm attended public worship. mr smith deliverd farewell sermon, text foren corinth 13:13, aftn, isah 17:17: wilm haywood dind son jona supt receivd letter doct barton informing famely well aunt moore deceast, remains interd 15 inst. home. receivd letter doct barton informs ye death aunt moore. 1 2 clear. mr ballard workt bridg, raising mrs densmore dagt dolly dind took tea us. mr waid dind. home kniting. home. mrss densmr 2 3 clear cloudy turns. mr ballard finisht raising ye bridg ys morn. laying streat hook. home. mrss pollard, dagt ballard lucy petty lucy sleeps home. mrss pollard beemd web 26 yds. 3 4 cloudy foren snow. lucy workt part ye day. dolly dind took tea us. mr ballard got wood dug potatoes. home. sent 6/ indigo sallts buck home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 4-10, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 4 10, 1792 4 5 clear cloudy turn cold. mr ballard makeing plans. home. gatherd cammomile, ye second gathering. cyrus came sleeps home. 5 6 clear. hannah washt. mr ballard went pittstn. home, helpt house work knitt saml foster gentmn mr robbins plans. home. 6 7 clear. mr ballard returnd pittstn went mr sheppards, paid 20/ due blankits. home, helpt house knitt home. 7 g clear, great frost yester morn. cyrus came home ys aftern went back home. home. 8 2 cloudy foren, sun shone aftn. mr ballard went early ys morn pittstn help cyrus dress mill, returnd. mrs edson warpt web son jona dind lidia densmore spun 3 double skeins cotten ys day. home, carded work. home. mrs edson hannah got web 9 3 clear pleast. dolly came home instruct girls draw pieces dimmity, tarries ys night. mr ballard returnd. home, carded cottne mended ephm jack coat. home. ephm brot hannahs wheal home. 10 4 rainy. home. mr ballard hook, bot 2_ cottne. girls got yr web work. jona wounded thumbs. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 11-17, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 11 17, 1792 11 5 raind day. mr ballard went jones mill. home, finisht piking hannahs cottne. home. 12 6 cloudy foren, clear aftern. went mr wicksoms, calld mr hamlins baxters mr dinsmores. finisht card ing hannahs cottne ys evng. mr wicksons others. 13 7 cloudy morn, sun shone warm 11 2 o clock, cloudy showery. mr ballard went winthrop. home. lidia dinsmore finisht spining hannahs cottne. killd turkey. home. mr ballard winthrop. 14 g clear pleast. cyrus came home, john goodin pownalboro mr savage son jona dind turkey roasted. mr ballard went esqr coneys. colo duttun dolly wrode brothers. home. informd mr swet two childn deceast ye small pox. home. 15 years ys day sinc arivd kennebeck jones landing. 15 2 cloudy misty morn. mr ballard went esqr coneys, returnd sett pounalboro. parthenia mr pollards six twenty slay. hannah beemd ye wollin shurting. ephm mr waids work. home. raind aftern evng. home. mr ballard pownalboro. 16 3 clear. ephm workt mr waid. went see oldest dagt swelling neck. mr waids. hannh wove [15] yards. 17 4 clear. home. hannah got shurting 20 yds, put another web quilld work. mr ballard returnd, brot 9_ yd cambleteen, 5 yds linning 3 lb tea, hand kf mr bridg attendance suprem cort. home. mr ballard returnd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 18-25, 1792 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 29-Nov. 2, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 29 november 2, 1792 29 2 cloudy. dolly went mr densmrs, mr ballard hook. home. sally helping girls. mr pollard savage supt home. killd three young turkeys. 30 3 clear pleast. mr ballard colo sewalls hook. home. sally girls put bed quillt ye fraim parthenia. sarah densmore dolly evng. home. roasted turkey. 31 4 clear. mr ballard went pittstn. polly pollard, mrs damrin dagt dolly quilted day, mrs livermore aftern. home. mr town sleeps home. 1 5 x. birth ezra hodges son. xx. cloudy rain. mr town left breakfast. girls ladies help quillt. calld see mrss hodges 4h pm, shee safe deld 11h evn fine son, sixth child. mr ballard came home. mr hodges. birth 38th. son town went home. 2 6 x. birth benn stickneys dagt. xx. clear foren, cloudy aftn, rain evng. receivd 6/ mr hodges returnd home noon, left patient cleverly. calld mr burtuns, lady cleverly. bot 2 iron kettles cost 7/, 1 spider 3/6, 2 pepper boxes 2 dippirs /6 2/; 1 yd binding /1, ginn 2/6; total 15/1. went magr stickneys 9h evn, wife deld 11h 5m dagt. tarried night. mr burtuns magr stickneys. birth 39. bizer benjamins wife deld 2 sons, dead. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 3-11, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 3 11, 1792 3 7 rainy foren. tarried magrs till dineing, receivd 6/ reward. mrs conry came mr devenports spent ye remainder ye aftern, returnd home dusk. left patients cleverly. mr stickneys mr devenports. 4 g clear. home. dolly dolly home. 5 2 clear. mr ballard pittstn. mr john jones mr duttun girls washt, home. home. j. jones 6 3 clear. went see mrs burtun ill turn better. dolly sleeps mr burtuns. 7 4 clear. cyrus came home, helpt quillt hannahs bed quilt. got late ye evng. home. ephm banking ye house. 8 5 foggy morn, sun shone 10h. cyrus went brothers. mr j. jones home. mrs edson warp web mrs densmores. mr pollard pitt ys night. home. mr jones son cyrus also. 9 6 cloudy morn. cyrus went pittstn aftern. raind night, severe n e storm ye night. home. mrs bradbury betsy champny home. cyrus went pitstn. mrs parker returnd home. 10 7 cloudy rain. home, stript turkey feathers. home. 11 g clear pt ye day. mr ballard returnd fm ptstn. mr j. jones, jms page son jona dind mr pollard pitt supt. home. mr ballard paid john jones 21 dollars part note home. mr page jones source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 12-17, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 12 17, 1792 12 2 clear part ye day. mr ballard ye hook joness mill. cyrus came 6h pm. home. home. cyrus [came] 13 3 sun rose clear. cloudy part ye day. mr ballard gone varsalboro, cyrus mr savages, ephm clearing wood road. home. cyrus sleeps 14 4 cloudy chilly air. went far savage boltons, paid 8/ mr burtuns attending wife ye 19th jany last. bot 2 puter dishes, wt 5lb 2/; 1 coffee pt, 3/6; six table spoons, 1/8; total 15/2. paid 7/2 cash. mr bolton answers 8/ savage boltons others. 15 5 clear. mr ballard workt ye bridg ye gully. home. mrs densmore dind took tea. mr seth williams wife cyrus came home, quit thee grist mill tended. dolly returnd apprenti ship mr densmore. cyrus tended mr hollowells mill 14 months. capt nichols hired home. cyrus dolly returnd home late servises. 16 6 snowd ye day. home. killd 2 turkeys. mr ballard went mr pollards, bt 5_ lb flax /9, 5lb butter /10. home. finisht pair [hoes] dolly. 17 7 clear. mr ballard jonas ye hook. cyrus went pitstn brot chest things home. home, well could wish. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 18-24, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 18 24, 1792 18 g rainy. mr pollard pitt dind thee latter joind thee bands wedlock parthenia barton. ceremony pirformd saml dutton esq. home. company except famely attend. thee justice gave fee ye bride. home. mr shubal pitt parthenia barton joind mariage. 19 2 cloudy day, raind night snowd. mr ballard left home 11h morn survey land belonging mr t. pitts. home. dolly went mr burtuns little sun sett. home. mr ballard sett tour surveying. 20 3 snowd raind. home. cyrus went brors, brot three quarters muttun home. hannah piecing bed quilt. cold n w wind evng. home. 21 4 cold day. home. hannah wove bed blankitt self, tow wool. home. p. livermr evng. 22 5 clear callm. river full ice allmost stopt ys morn. unwell day, home day. home. river closing. 23 6 clear cold. cyrus went brothers, brot bushel turnips. dolly returnd mr thwings. shee maid 3 gouns mr burtns, took pay cash 2/3 pr day. home, finisht ephs hoes. snowd ye night. home. ephm workt densmr cragg team. 24 7 snowd day cold. epm got wood mr livrmr, densmr waid. home, mended epms buskins. dolly finisht coat. home. ephm workt livr, densmr waid teem. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 25-30, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 25 30, 1792 25 g clear cold son jona came took hors home, 1 busl potatoes ephm. home. roasted turkey diner. home. mr pollard pitt 26 2 clear moderate. sons got 2 load wood, ephm went git mr desnmr. hannah put bed quillt fraim quilted shee slept. parthenia dolly helpt home. hannahs bed quilt quillted ys day. 27 3 clear. dolly began make coat mr sargent. parthenia put callico bed quillt ye fraim hannah helpt quillt. home. 28 4 cloudy day rainy night. dolly finisht ye coat partha bed quillt. jona home. home. parthenia finisht bed quillt. 29 5 clear pleast. home. day appointed thanksgiving. mr pollard pitt waited wives dolly mr pollards. mr densmore turkey home. roasted turkey. 30 6 clear except squall snow forenn. mr pollard pitt took breakfast mrs rockwood goun made. home, house work. ephm workt mr bradbury. mr ballard returnd surveying 15 mile lott. home. mrs rockwd mr ballard came home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 1-4, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 1 4, 1792 1 7 clear. mrs h. rockwd finisht goun wore home. mr ballard ye hook ye fort, cyrus mill. parthenia put coverleds loom. home. dolly makeing waist cot cyrus old [surtnet]. girls went mr livermores evn. home. 2 g clear cold. informd old lady coney like survive little symptoms dangerous. mr livermore, wife son self went see crost ye river canoe breaking thro ye ice several places. found old lady helples allmost sencles situation. dagt cumings nurs, tryals great. god grant strength patients perform arduous task. moses pollard ill night. calld help hannah nurs went see old lady coney late shock ye palsey, left side useless. 3 2 cloudy clear. mr ballard sett survey mr pittss land north mrs pollard came see son ill indeed. gave sage tea decoction snak root cammomile, [steamd] feet &c. girls washt, jona home. mrs pollard 4 3 cloudy. mr pollard pearly see moses, seems little comfortable; marm went home. dolly went work. home, batht mr pollards feet applyd onions much better. mr benn porter sleeps home. mrs pollard went home. mr porter source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 5-11, 1792 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 5 11, 1792 5 4 clear pleast. mr jimy pollard took breakfast mr porter son pollard allso. latter far recoverd able return home. home. hannah weaving ragg coverleds, mrs pitt spining. shubl pitt brot two cows left ym keep days. home. son pollard went muck better. 6 5 cloudy cold. snowd little evng. killd 2 turkeys. home. girls spun hoes yn cyrus. ephm giting wood home. home. 7 6 clear cold. calld see mrs child, shee unwell. recommended portion senna. calld mr wessons pollards. bot 1 mugg 1/, 2 tumblers [2]/, 2 cruitts 1/2. mr childs. ellenr taylor expird 8 7 clear. mrss savage daugt made visit. mr [sic] daugts mrs pitt went son jon home. mr ballard returnd surveying varsalboro, informd eller taylor deceast last night. mr pitt sleeps home. mrs savage snowd ye night. 9 g cloudy. home. mrss pitt dolly came home, fall ye hors; hurt much. elly taytor interd ys day. home. funeral mr taylors daugtr. 10 2 clear cold. mr ballard street ye hook. home. dolly workt home. 11 3 clear. mr ballard sett survey mr pitts. hannah walkt brors, much falagud. home. dolly workt home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 13 22, 1793 13 f clear. mr thwing desird go visit lady. wrode aftern, find well. came sun sett. calld son pollards took tea, arivd home 8h evn. mr thwings. 14 2 x. birth mr thwings son. xx. birth mr suells son. x. clear. mr ballard cyrus went town meeting. bakt brewd calld see mrs thwing 6h evn. shee deld 10 first born, son. waited mr brown attend mrs suell arivd 11 30m. shee deld son 12. tarried thro night. patient cleverly. receivd 7/4 march 18 1794. mr thwings suells. birth 1st. birth 2nd. receivd 6/ mr thwing. 15 3 cloudy. left mrs suell cleverly 8h morn. went mr thwings, find inft cleverly, went marm. tarried till 3 pm son cyrus came conducted home, find dagt ballard son lucy town daddy mrs barton came yester evn, business judg boman. son jona came evn. mr suells thwings. 16 4 rainy morn. jona wife went home. georg brown came evn. calld shubal henkleys, jona came returnd home without patient night. mr hinkleys. 17 5 x. birth shubl hinkleys son. xx. snowd. mr hinkleys. son jon came evn, could dismiss mrs hinkley deld fine son half 11h evn, conducted sons. receivd 6/ reward mr hinkley. birth 3d. birth ye 18 1 2 morn. 18 6 clear. sons, mrs barton allso. sally comfortable. sons. 19 7 clear. mrs barton went jonas house, sent evn. 20 f clear. mrs barton went house. tarried sons. 21 2 clear. sons. isaac hardin calld see wife 9h evn. 22 3 x. bth hardins son. xx. hardins, wife deld son 3h morn returnd sons 8h morn, find sally tolerable. mr hardin paid 6/ mr blaks. content: martha ballard's diary, february 18 28, 1793 18 2 clear pleast. childn mr stratn went home, mrs barton son pollards. capt hersey lady home, ephm mr childs. home. son dagt town left home. 19 3 clear pleast. mr ballard surveying mr vaun. mrs barton returnd 11h morn. son jon came patty, shee went home parson warrin home, washt 4 blankets cloaths. home. ephm workt mr childs. 20 4 cloudy foren, clear aftern. home, work house. mrs barton mending pattys cloaths. home. seen 58 years day. 21 5 clear pleast. mr ballard went varsalboro survey. combd flax. calld see mrs childs infant, tarried night. mr childs. 22 6 clear cold. mrs child unwell cold, infant teething. left dining. calld mr hamlins, sally unwell; mr pitts, lady well shee could wish; mr wessons, well son pollards. came sleigh. mr keth attended dittoes neigrs. 23 7 clear cold. home. mr ballard returnd, brot 4 lb butter. ephm went brot dolly home. 24 f x. birth moses cars dagt. xx. snowd morn. calld 3h moses cars lady. shee delivd 5 fine dagt, first born. arivd home 8. mr car gave 6/ reward. mr ballard attended worship ye academy. moses cars. birth 10th. 25 2 clear cold. home. mr ballard surveyd mr waid foren. home. 26 3 snow, haill rain. bakt ys foren unwell aftern. mr ballard mr livermr settled acounts. home. 27 4 cloudy. home. widdow mr thomss. home. 28 5 clear cold. mr waid workt widdow, dolly wrode mr thwing wife sore breast. home. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 1-9, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 1 9, 1793 1 6 clear pleast. went see mrs thwing, shee sweld breast, mr childs, wife unwell; infant allso. mr ballard surveying esq matthew howard, went mrs husseys. mr thwings mr childs. 2 7 clear pleasant. mr ballard two bushls corn benn porter went s. jewit fosters, ephm jonas team. home. home. 3 f raind morn, clear pleasant aftern. home. mrs barton went visit sister, finds comfortable shee mr s. jewet foster sleeps home. 4 2 clear. ephm sett teem 1h mont vernan hay mr livermore, mr ballard foster surveying. eph returnd evng. jona, richd foster, wives, dind tarried night. mr pollard pitts wives took tea home. home. compy. son jona 30 years old ys day. 5 3 raind ye day. mr foster wife went dineing. sally childn night. boisterous wind snow evng. home. home. 6 4 clear. home. mr ballard returnd evng. jona came conducted wife infant home. left jack restless part ye night. home. 7 5 clear pleast. dolly came shee walkt, pain head since shee came, workt ephms coat. mr ballard went mr dumers bot 1 yd blue ratteen. home, mrs barton washt. home. 8 6 stormy day, snowd, raind haild. home. mr ballard fort, bot 2-2/2 yds durant, 1 skein silk; cost 6/. dolly. home. mr livermr extracted tooth one dolly. 9 7 severe storm snow haill. mr voces store, consums fire. home. mrs barton dolly mr densmores. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 10-19, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 10 19, 1793 10 f clear cold. mr savage, esqr mathew howard shubal pitts dolly went mr pollards aftern. home. home. 11 2 rainy day. capt stackpole mr ballard went winslow. home till 11h evng calld see leut d. pollards wife. home mr pollards. 12 3 x. birth david pollards son. xx. clear pleast. mr pollards, wife deld 11h evn son. mrss voce, williams, hamlin black assisted. mrs gordin fitts. mr ballard returnd winslow. ditoes. birth 11th. receivd 6 reward. 13 4 clear. went see mrs gordin, find unwell. mrss thomas hersey came mr pollards. returnd home noone. jedh preskott dind mr waid work. mr ballard gone winlhp. mrss livermore polly visit. ditoes. 14 5 clear. mr ballard carried little jacky home foren, brot dolly went winthrop aftern. mr benn brown wife took tea home. cyrus bot 1/2 lb snuff mr smiths store, cost 1/6. home. dolly came mr benn browns wife 15 6 clear, wind s w. ["home". -.implied] mrs barton dolly washt. calf damaged laun handkerchif [sic] dollys. home. 16 7 clear. ephm cowen wife receivd letter bror collins 10th inst informing friends health. mr ballard returnd. home, receivd ltr bro collins ye 10th inst. 17 f clear warm. georg brown breakfasted. shubal pitts dind went mr lathrops. mr lathrops. 18 2 x. birth hinklys dagt. xx. cloudy. went latps james hinkleys 3h morn, wife deld 7 evng dagt 7 evn returnd 10 mr lathrops. find ill. receivd 6/ mr hinkly. mr hinkleys. birth [12th]. 19 3 x, birth lathrops son. xx. rainy morn. mrs lathrop women deld son 11h 30m morn son wd 12 lb. went dr colmans procurd 3/ worth drugs returnd home. sally polly densmore p. livermore lathr. birth 13[th]. receivd sugar july 28]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 20-28, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 20 28, 1793 [20] 4 clear beautiful pleast day. home. mr ballard went settle colo howard. cyrus went ye hook, bot 5 pecks corn went ground. epm workt waids. home. 21 5 cloudy. mr ballard waited mr twings, lady little comfortable; breast broke twice. went hear sing evng. dolly came home mr livermores. mr thwings. snowd night. 22 6 x. birth ezekl pages son. xx. clear. calld 6h aftern see mrs page deld 10 fine son, 8th child. returnd home 2h morn, receivd 6/ mr page. turn cramp ys morn. mr pages. birth 14th. 23 7 clear coo ler. ephm gone work mr waid. cyrus waited dolly son jonas. cyrus returnd informd yt jack burnt hand. jona says child easier. mr faught dind cyrus went mr sewalls, purchased chees cost 6/. ditoes. 24 f clear, cool air. ephm went jonas. dolly came home evng. jack better. home. 25 2 clear. went hook far elisha preskotts. mrs barton calld see sister low. bot mr dummers store 1 yd durant, 2/4; [1_th] yd cambric, 2/6; 2 skeins silk, /8; 3 knots thread, [/6]. paid cash. hook. 26 3 x. birth p. jones son. xx. cloudy. calld peter jones wife labour 3h morn. shee safe deld 4 son. tarried till near night left patients cleverly. receivd 6/ reward. mr ballard gone survey doct parker. rainy night. peter joness. birth 15th. jobe springr son born ysnight. 27 4 clear pleast. went see mrs densmore. sally polly tarry night. mr densmores. [28] 5 clear. sally densmore went home breakfast. polly tarried spun dolly. mrs densmore came dagt went home. dolly went son pollards. mr densmore came evn. home. mrs densmr river opend. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 29-Apr. 4, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 29 april 4, 1793 29 6 clear part ye day. dolly spining cotten. ephm went brors, jackys hand giting better. freshet high. pain head, home till 11h evng calld see mrs parker, ye next house mr parkers. 30 7 x. birth mr parkers dagt. xx. clear. mrs parker safe deld 11h foren daugt. left infant cleverly 2h pm returnd home, find dolly gone mr densmores. mr ballard returnd evng, surveyd doct parker tuesday wednsday, thursday faught fire cobesy uper mill. 2 days workt ye grist mill. mr parkers. birth 16th. 31 f clear. mr ballard attended worship hook. calld see mr parkers infant foren, evn see asa masons wife. arivd 10h evn. asa masons, bad wriding. 1 2 clear pleast. mr masons, wife linguring case. mr masons. 2 3 birth asa masons son. clear. mrs mason safe deld 2nth morn son, second child. shee ill, left infant cleverly 4h 30m, reacht home 9. calld helpt little jack allso. mr thwings, wife ill breast maledies. polly densmore work dolly. went bed slept returnd. masons. birth 17th. much fateagud. 3 4 x. birth wm pitts son. xx. clear pleast. mr ballard went pittstn work. calld see mrs pitt labour. shee delivrd 10h evng dead son. tarried night, mrs pollard voce allso. mr pitts. birth 18th. 4 5 clear. mr pitts infant interd aftern. left lady comfortable, arivd home 7h evn. mr pitt gave 12/. dolly mr densmores, yester day. [sow] killd lamb. ditoes. child interd. mother ballard desseast. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 5-11, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 5 11, 1793 5 6 x. birth mr x buzels son. xx. clear. dolly washt scourd west roome. mrs densmore mr ballard returnd pittstn, cyrus work jona. calld sun sett see mrs buzel safe deld 9h evn fine son. tarried allnight. mr buzels. birth 19/th. 6 7 clear. left mrs buzels inft cleverly arivd home 10h morn. receivd 9/ fee hors hire medisin. feel little falagud ye rodes bad. raind aftern. mr ballard gone meddow. dolly makeing soap. ditoes. much fatagud. 7 f rainy foren. dolly went son pollards aftern cyrus came brors. home, receivd letter doct barton ye 19th ult informs friends health. home. receivd letter fm doct barton march 19. 8 2 clear. dolly washt shee went mr livermores. calld mr capins evng. mr ballard colo howards. mr livermores [mr] capins. 9 3 clear. mr capins day. returnd ye reach. mr capins. 10 4 rainy foren, clear aftern. came mr capins deacon coneys, find old lady sick. came home, receivd letter bror kingsbury informs yt motr ballard low, friends well. calld see mrs densmore 11h. deacon coneys. receivd letter fm capt kingsbury march 30th. 11 5 x. birth densmores dagt. xx. clear. mrs densmore deld dagt 11h morn, well expected. inft troubled much wind. gave remedies releivd returnd home 4. hannah parthenia mr ballard meeting ye hook. went danys evn. mr densmores. birth 20th. receivd fee candles. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 12-19, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 12 19, 1793 12 6 x. birth mr danys 5th son. clear. put mrs dany bed fine son ye mdl ye night. shee inft cleverly. returnd home 4h morn, went bed; severe fit ye cramp 6. dolly watcht mrs densmore. shee returnd attentive waiting went bed slept till 9. mr ballard gone surveying esqr howard. calld [epr] cowens. mr danys. [birth] 21st. receivd6/. 13 7 clear cool. mr cowens, wife little comfortable. went daniel savages. son town went mr cowens. 14 f clear, windy cool. returnd mr cowens, left wife much better. cyrus jona dolly went bror pollards. wm thomas ditoes. 15 2 clear. went see mrs densmore, find inft comfortable. mr ballard mr foster, noah woodwd silva moore sett run lines mr pittss land pownalboro. mrs barton returnd sisters, left comfortable shee found shee 3 weaks. mr densmores. mr ballard went survey. mrs barton came 16 3 cloudy part ye day. went mr densmores drest infant. ditoes. 17 4 clear, warm foren. sally cox came work mrs livermore went mr shubl hinkleys, mrs norcross, mrs selvester ney calld see mrs parker, inft well. david willm densmr sleep ephm [un mr hinklys. sally cox 18 5 cloudy, rain. mrs livermr sent see inft, scollt. [mr livermr]. 19 6 raind part ye day. home. girls went moses pollards. mrs blake returnd westwd. [home]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 20-27, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 20 27, 1793 20 7 showry. makeing soap. mrs barton dolly went deacn conys. home. 21 f cloudy. cyrus jona little jack, mr pitts, wife, daugtr polly pollard home. calld half 8 evn deacon coneys, lady expird 10. mrs mc masters put grave cloaths. mrs brooks present. former went home midnight. mrs brooks tarried night. deacon conys, wife expird 10h evng. 22 2 clear, cool. returnd home 9h morn. mr ballard came home surveying 12 o clok. cyrus sleeps mrs barton well shee could wish. wrote brors kingsbury, barton collins. ditoes. wrote friends oxford. 23 3 clear. home, wrote bror elijah moore. home, wrote br elijah. 24 4 clear. closd letter doct waters sent packet mrs hamlin. attended funeral old lady cony. shee interd docters field. mr prockter maid ye prayor, preaching pittstn. cyrus took tea us. funeral mrs cony. wrote doct waters. 25 5 clear. mr forgeson paid note. mrs hamlin went past bound boston. betsy voce p. livermore aftern. cyrus came jonas work us. ephm began plough. mr ballard makeing fence. girls finisht kniting ye [scan]. home. betsy voce 26 6 clear. calld see mrs hinkley exercised severe cough, tarried night. mrs hinkley mrs ney betsy went home. thos hinkleys. 27 7 clear. mr hinkleys till near night returnd home, left wife comfortable. receivd letter aprl 1st bror jona moore informing famely health. mrs brown sandy river mr hinkleys. receivd letter bror jona 1st inst. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 2-10, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 2 10, 1793 2 5 clear. writing bror jona. dolly went mr waids. mrs livermore workt doors part ye day. home. wrote bror jona. 3 6 cloudy. dolly went son pollard. bror moore ephm cowen calld see wife unwell. mr cowins. 4 7 cloudy part ye day. dittoes, wife unwell. dittoes. 5 f clear. capt savage two dagts attended worship. mrs cowen turn faintness, calld women. shee seemd better part went home. dittoes. 6 2 clear. mrs cowin lingering much deprest spirits. calld mrs fletcher. mrs coal calld mrs savage fletcher tarried night. dittoes. town meeting. 7 3 x. birth epm cowens dagt. xx. clear. mrs cowens illness came two ys morn shee safe delivd 3h 30m fine dagt, 5 pains inquiry case. tarried, took breakfast sett homewd. calld colo sewalls, child much better. arivd home 10h morn. receivd 6/ reward. mr ballard gone pittstn. fanny cox hannah goodin came ditoes. birth 24th. 8 4 clear. went see mrs mc causland, find low; husband unwell. crost ye river genl derbns norcroses. feel fatagud. dolly workt mr livermores. mr ballard gone colo norths. robert mc causlands. 9 5 clear warm. mr baker forenn. robt mc causland hannah cox dind. mr leightn supt. cyrus came team. girls mr densmores went mr hinkleys. mr ballard son pollards, brot ye haslett veal home ephm fish. home. home. may 9th receivd bushel wht t hinkly. 10 6 clear. home, unwell. dolly sally went son pollards. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 11-16, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 11 16, 1793 11 7 clear. mr ballard went survey briant fletchers. went son pollards visit. mr pitts persute thief. son pollards. 12 f clear. son jona dagt dolly went see mrs mc causland found low. shee views self near close life. may shee composd, easy passage time eternity, may change seins everlasting happiness. sally cox went dads. home. mr densmore wife home. dolly [went] see mrs mc causland. 13 2 clear. mr ballard preparing planting. mr james page dind old lady coutch calld, ephm helpt ye river. home. girls washt went mr densmores. cyrus went jon home. dolly went mr densmors. 14 3 x. birth saml cumings dagt. xx. clear. mr ballard flax sowd. calld saml cumings see wife. shee deld 2h pm daugt, 3d child. calld see mrs child, find seting arivd home dusk, walkt mr childs. saml cumingss.birth 25th. dolly mr danys. receivd6/ mr cumings july 13. 15 4 clear. dolly went mr danys work, mr ballard survey colo north. went take leave mr dany wife left ys town going new town. went [godlin] pages paid 1:18:8 mr ballard owd stores. mr danys stores. elisha preskott paid 6/ assisting wife octr 27th. 16 5 clear. john savage workt home, workt gardin. sally went mr pollards. hanh woodwd yesterday. home. mrs mc [causland] deceast. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 17-24, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 17 24, 1793 17 6 cloudy part ye day, sprinkling rain evng. dolly gone mr bisbes. home, workt gardin. informd death mrs mc causland. home. dolly mr bisbes. mr ballards birthday. 68. 18 7 clear. home. dolly returnd, jona brot jacky. ye girls took bonet apart new made home. 19 f clear warm. cyrus went pitts lon, attended service aftern funeral mr robert mc causlands wife, oldest daugt brother town. sally polly densmores returnd. dind mr moores hors put allso. mrs hamlin returnd oxford ys day. shee gone 3 weaks 4 days. pittston, remains mrs mc causland interd 5h pm. 20 2 clear warm. girls washt washt floors. cyrus carried little jacky home. home, workt gardin. home. 21 3 clear warm. finisht cleaning door yard, went see mrss hamlin, find much fatagud joirney. calld mr baxters. find mr ballard returnd arivd home. mrs densmore mr hamlins mr baxters. 22 4 clear. men planted corn beens potatoes. esq cony planted mellon seeds ye north side house. warm. home. dolly went mr hamlins evng. 23 5 clear cool. mr ballard gone meddow, dolly son pollards. ephm went help fight fire mr kenadas hill, tarried night. home. 24 6 clear. fire rages sides river. sally cox gone sons, dind home. receivd letter sist waters march 4th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 22 26, 1793 22 7 clear. home. bleaching yarn. mr ballard ephm workt road aftern. cyrus went pittstn. dolly returnd jon home. 23 f x. birth james hinklys son. xx. clear foren. sally densmore brot infant burn drest. calld see james hinkleys ys 3d wife 12 o clock. shee delivd 11h evn son, first born. tarried night, patients cleverly. james hinklys. birth 31st 24 2 clear warm. receivd 6/ service, returnd home 9h morn. calld see mr parkers infant. shee thinks better. mrs coutch dind went far mr shepperds. bot 1 pair shoes 4/4, three yds black ribbon /6; doct colmans bt 1/2 oz camphr /8, myrr /7_, alloes /4_, viall sallts /6_, 3 oz spermaseta /4_. mr dummers bt 2 muslin hand kercfs, 1/2 yd lawn 7/9. mr greelys, shee well could wisht. infant fitts last evng. saml norcorss, cleard inft breasts milk. esqr lithgow evng, wishes see house fortnit hence. dittoes. stores. cyrus sleps child killd fall tree [sic]. 25 3 cloudy part ye day. mr ballard gone vasalboro survey. mr david smyle finisht kniting pair cottne hoes self. ephm workt oxen mr childs. home, raind night. 26 4 fine rain last night ys morn. working gardin carding cottne. dolly gone mr bullins. home. dolly mr bullins. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 27-Jul. 1, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 27 july 1, 1793 27 5 x. birth thos stikneys son. xx. clear warm. calld thomas stickneys wife labour 8h morn. shee safe delivd 10 son, first born. receivd 6/ reward, left cleverly 3 pm returnd. cyrus sleeps borrowed 13-3/4 lb veal mr densmr. thos stickneys. birth 32nt. 28 6 clear except sprinkling rain. mr ballard returnd, cyrus sleeps sally went son pollards, ephm workt mr child. home, lent mr densmr 6 lb, lacking 2 oz, pork. mr hinkly drownd pittstn. 29 7 clear warm. mr ballard fort ye hook. went see mr blaks infant, taken cold, seems little revivd. calld mr hamlins, shee feeble. mr childs, wife much shee mr beadle unwell. mr pitts. dolly returnd mr bullins. cyrus sleeps mr blaks neighs.a man wounded woods, badly. 30 f clear warm indeed. mr famely attended worship hook. self, aftern. calld see mrs greely remains feeble, infant soar mouth. calld mr hinkleys, wife cleverly. jona little son came home. dolly wrode mr pollards. went see mrs densmore, shee well could wisht. meeting thee hook. calld mr greelys. 1 2 clear warm. mr ballard went mr dumers money mr pitt sent dolly sally went stores things. went see mr beadle, find poorly. mrs lang gone. saml philbrook hurt saw mill. natn burtens child drowned. mr pitts son pollards. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 2-7, 1793 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 5-13, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 5 13, 1793 5 2 clear except light shower. mr ballard went aftern surveying mr vauhn. went far mr sheperds, bot 2 lb sugar /10, 1 chip hat /9; doct colmans, bt 1 oz senna, manna 1/ pr oz, 1 oz annis seed /4, 1/2 oz pink root /4_; mr livermores, bt 1 skein sewing silk /4. stores calld see mrss dumers mrs norcross. 6 3 fine rain. mr ballard fixing meddow. home. dolly made hatt patty town put shurting web. home. hannah 24 ys old ys day. 7 4 clear warm. pulld flax. mr ballard ephm went meddow, dolly weaving, sally washt. dolly conductd patty part way home. home, pulld flax. 8 5 clear warm. unwell kept bed day. cyrus working mr capin, girls weaving. home, unwell. 9 6 clear warm. calld see wilm hewins wife 10 7 12/o clock. shee unwell. tarryd till ye 11 t 12th left comfortable came home. mr hewins three days. mr sualls childwas interd. 12 2 clear warm. mr ballard gone ye meddow, epm allso. dolly went capt fillebrowns. sally gone dads. deacon conys, well; gave apples. cyrus informs son jonas son better, number larg worms past takeing pink root senna mr hewuns. 13 3 clear. went mr densmores livermores mrs cumings. sally came home. d l mores. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
