title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 1-6, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 1 6, 1793 1 f clear warm. meeting. mrs ingerham informd mrss hewin delivd son 26 ult. mr childs intermition, find wife shee son pollard, mr pitts, wives polly pollard evn. meeting. famely 2 2 clear. mr ballard went meddow. went aftern capt meloys, colo duttuns, capt fillebrowns mr dummers. mrs duttun mending slowly, shee able walk alone yet. dagt dolly 21 years old, many changing siens past thro years. hook. dagt dolly 21 ys old day. 3 3 x. birth jery dumers son. xx. clear. calld 9h morn see mr jere dumers lady labour, shee deld 5h evng fine son, first born. tarried nurst patients thro night; comfortable. mr dumers. birth 36th. 4 4 clear. tarried mr dumers day. mrs williams came evn came home, receivd 13/6 reward performance. find dolly gone work mrs burtun. mr dumers, receivd 13/6. 5 5 clear till near night rain. home. bror moore mr lathrop dind dolly returnd mr burtuns evn. sally wilms dress. mr ballard writeing ye fort. home. 6 6 x. birth mc neels son. xx. clear. calld 6h morn see mrs mc neele labour. shee deld 12 son inspird life expird short time birth. left well could expected 6h pm came home. dolly sally came home son pollards. mr mc neeles. birth 37th. dagt ballard [childn] came ys evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 7-13, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 7 13, 1793 7 7 clear. home fixing mr ballards departure lay 4 townships common wealth. home. dagt bald 8 f clear cool air. mr ballard, cyrus, ephm attended divine service. revd mr turners discourse concerning great day judgment. went see mrs dummer, find weak tollerable comfortable, babe fine child. son jona, pollard, wife mrs pitts meeting. childn went home. mr savage informs boy servd mr sheppards drowned near, wharf ys afternoon. calld see mrs lashnees 11h evng. meeting mr dumers. childn jonas wife went home. indian boy drowned. 9 2 x. john lashnees son. xx. clear till near night raind. mrs lashnees safe deld 5h morn fine son wd 11_ lb. tarried till 6h pm, left cleverly could expected. receivd [7/4d] service. calld see mrs dummer, find cleverly. mr ballard sett tour surveying. ephm went take hors home. mr lashnees. birth 38th. mr balld left home survey 4 townships. 10 3 rainy. home. dolly makeing leut string goune mrs gage. ephm returnd. home. dolly began spin warp. 11 4 rainy aftern. ephm returnd 1h pm, son towns famely well. dolly went work mr blaks. home, sally spining. son cyrus 37 years old day. home. cyruss birth day 37 years. 12 5 rain. home. dolly returnd mr blaks. home. 13 6 cloudy. mrs gage son dind went deacn conys, dagts, sewalls church mrs cumings gave [cup] [marny]. deacn conys, childn source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 14-17, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 14 17, 1793 14 7 clear. house work till near night workt gardin. sally made pies. siesd severe pain back lasted hour seemd freed mr buzell calld go see sister judy labr. arivd house dusk. felt collick reacht severely exercised thro night. mr buzells, new france. 15 f x. birth slepn hinklys son judy buzell, wedlock. xx. clear. still labouring triall ye collick. mrs hinkley took great care easier towards night patients illness came regular, shee safe deld 5h pm fine son, shee declard stephen hinkly thee true father shee well expected. exceeding feeble thro night. dittoes. birth 39th. receivd 6/. 2/ due hors medisin. 16 2 cloudy rain. sett weak wrode home. find dolly unwell. shee wrode bror pollards sistr mrs pitts came see polly livermr took tea drank 2 cups tea eat little, first food taken since saterdy noone, except thin gruel. made decoction feavr fu, peneroial cammomile self dagt. ditos. left judy infant comfortable. 17 3 cloudy rain. feel much comfortable self. dolly unwell forenoone. shee went sisters aftern. mrs densmore warpt webb 42 yds home. dolly sisters. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 18 26, 1793 18 4 clear, great frost morn. home. sally went sons help quillt bed quillt. ephm got part corn, youngsters help husk home. dolly came home. sally bot goun patn. 19 5 clear. home. home. 20 6 clear. dolly went son pollards. son jon camethere go see wife unwell. swetther. tarried night. sally got easier sleep. son ballards pollards. 20 6 clear. came jon son pollards. dagts p. pollard went winslow, sett noon accompanied jon mrs pitts went aftern see mrs wesson mrs child, find comfortable shee calld mrs capin. ditoes, mr wessons childs. tarried son pollards night. 21 7 cloudy morn evn, clear middle ye day. left mr pitts noon, came mr waids, bradburies &c. got home 3 o clock. son pollards. 22 f clear warm. meting, feel well. home. 23 2 clear. calld 1h morn mr daws capt cars. 24 3 clear. ditoes mr cars fillebns. finisht [dollys] stockins. dittos. 25 4 clear. came home mr daws, left comfortable. calld mr dumers, inft ye thrush. wilm hurd, wife sist betsy, mr meriam sleep brot letter doct barton informs capt learneds wife dead. mrs voce betsy dind. mr ballard returnd surveying. ditoes. receivd letter doct barton augst 15, '93. 26 5 cloudy day, raind night. mr ballard attended church meeting. home. friends oxford left home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, october 17 25, 1793 17 5 x. birth [alphs] xx lyons dagt xx. clear. mrs moore unwell consented yt go see mrs lyon labour safe deld 8h evn dagt returnd mr moores, find unwell. mrs tylor welman calld. moores lyons. birth 42nt. receivd 6/. 18 6 x. birth james moores dagt. x. clear. mrs moore deld dagt 6h 30m. left infant comfortable noon returnd home, find famely well; much fatagud. moores. birth 43d. receivd 6/9. 19 7 cloudy raind night. home. cyrus went mr wessons, bot 1 qut w e rhum. home. 20 f snowd raind ys foren, clear aftern. mr lee preacht hook famely attend. mr parker aftern, exprest desire make lady visit soon. read 2 doct prices discourses ys day. home. mr parker snowd ys morn. 21 2 clear. picking wool. john jones calld dolly gone mr wessons. sons planking seller fell yesterday. home. j. jones made cheese. 22 3 rainy. thunder evn. picquing wool. sons finisht planking ye seller. home. 23 4 cloudy part day. home. sally washt. piqut wool cottne, 2 lb butter mrs pollard. home. 24 5 clear pleast. finisht picking wool scoured woolin yarn got spun. mr ballard returnd surveying magr goodin. hannah coks drank tea home. mr ballard returnd. hanh coks 25 6 clear. home. mr ballard went mr browns, bot tallow. ephm made pen put 3 [turkeys]. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 26-31, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 26 31, 1793 26 7 clear foren, cloudy aftern. went mr parkers claps. augusts ballard sick claps. dolly came fm lucy doty went fm receivd wages us shee done mr parkers. 27 f x. birth nathl shaws son. xx. clear. mr ballard sons went meeting, mr turner performd. sally went aftern. augustus ballard brot ys aftern. calld 8h evn see nathl shaws wife, shee delivd 11h 5m son. tarried night. mr shaws. birth 44th. receivd 6/. 28 2 x. birth timy pages son. xx. clear. returnd mr shaws, left cleverly. find agsts much dolly gone son pollards. mr bullin ys day. calld aftern mr timy pages wife safe deld 7h evn. tarried night, child son wd 11lb 1/4. shaws timy pages.birth 45th, ys year 500thsince came country. 29 3 severe snow storm heavy wind ye noth. tarried mr pages ys day night, mrs coks allso. patients cleverly. mr pages. feby 94 receivd 3/7_ mr page. 30 4 clear. returnd mr pages, receivd 2/8_ part fee 6/ wm white going wife second child. ship pitt built lanched ys foren. augusts much appetite. dolly sally mr thomass evng. dittoes. ye ship lancht. 31 5 clear. doct parker left augustus 2 grns tartar emitic. home. mr ballard lecter. home. doct parker [vist] agustus. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 1-7, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 1 7, 1793 [1] 6 clear. mr ballard went work mr bullins. home. pollymc master cloak goun made, dagt pollard warp web strike hernis. agsts taking senna, sally watcht home. hannah [2] 7 clear. dolly faint turn. augusts better, kept bed ys day. home. [3] f cloudy, raind evn. famely attended worship except self son cyrus. augustus went room aird son town came evn, famely well. ordinance ye supper administred ys day. home. dolly tarried son pollards. [4] 2 rainy. mr ballard cyrus gone town meeting. dolly came home. augustus went room. home. mr town sleeps home. [5] 3 cloudy. mr ballard went ye fort hook, dolly son pollards. son town left homeward bound. cyrus ephm banking house. augustus went house. home prepareing thanksgiving, high se wind rain night. home. [6] 4 cloudy day, high s e wind rain night. brig lancht fort. home prepareing thanksgiving. broke tea kittle. mr ballard bogt one cost [4/.] home. [7] 5 x.[birth reads dagt]. xx. clear pleast. calld five o clok morn see mrs read safe deld dagt 9. returnd home noone, left patients cleverly; receivd 6/ reward. son jona, wife childn supt us. pally jack sleep mr thomas waited dolly mr pollards. mr reeds. birth 46th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 8-14, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 8 14, 1793 8 6 clear till near night light shower. cyrus conducted patty jacky home. ship grounded near landing, morn, fleeted went sun sett. home. rufus ballard day, informs yt sister lucy delivd son last weak comfortable. augustus seems dull day. home. 9 7 clear. home. mrs parker hors go see negro woman docter. mrs densmore warpt 2 webs. mr ballard writeing. home. 10 f cloudy. mr ballard, self childn attend worship hook. revd mr turner discoarst words. god spirrit. calld capt meloys exercise. dolly wrode home sent hors back dagt pollard mrs pitts capt nichols meeting. 11 2 clear pleasant. dolly went work mr hamlins. georg brown andw mc causlin calld see wife evn. andw mc causlands. 12 3 clear pleast. ditoes, james mc causlands, patient, unwell disentary. ditoes. 13 4 snow rain. mc causlands. ditos. 14 5 cloudy misty. returnd home, left patient comfortable, find husband confind ague face. augustus better. dolly went benjamins, sally shubal hinkleys. calld see mrs daw mrs beamans child. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 21-27, 1793 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 21 27, 1793 21 7 clear. home. ye house work, pain head evng. ephm went thee meddow, put pair new trousers. mr ballard pair new boots made beemans. home. 22 f cloudy. sick day. mr child came go see wife could home. 23 2 clear. made candle wiks dipt 27 dozn three times mr child came wife sick. mrs pollard patridg tarried night. mr child. 24 3 birth john badcks dagt. clear. mrs childs little easier. calld john badcoks see wife 1h pm. shee safe deld dagt 9. tarried night, mr [sic] patient well could expected; negro doctres ditoes badcoks. birth 53d. mrs childs doct cony night. 25 4 cloudy morn, snow storm aftern. returnd mr childs, wife ill. calld evn mr pollards see mr blak [davids] childrn, ver [torn page]. mr childs pollards. mrs dickmans child [expird] yester[night]. 26 5 clear [torn page] 27 6 [torn page] source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-11, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 11, 1794 1 4 clear cold. mr ballard mr burtuns settle ["home"- implied]. sons carreing wood mr beaman. home. 2 5 clear cold. mrs cushin son town, mr burtun wife allso. dolly came home. home. home. began buskin. 3 6 clear. mrs cushin gown made. home. ephm brot last hay ye meddow. home. son town sleeps 4 7 rainy. home, made pies. dolly weaving jonas web. mr ballard brot corn, wheat, tea sugar home. home. made [mins] pies. 5 e clear pleast. famely attended worship public. went mr pittss intermition. meeting. 6 2 clear cold. mr ballard waid ephm giting wood mr beaman selvs. dolly went colo sewalls. sally washt. home. home. dolly colo sewalls. 7 3 clear cold. mr ballard workt shop, ephm mr wade. sally went help mrs pollard quillt. home. charls john cox mrs patty goodin dolly came home colo sewalls. home. young company 8 4 clear cold morn, moderated evng. home. dolly went son pollards, ephm carried 19 busl ashes mr wessom. receivd 3/3_ cash 1 quire paper 1/6. home. dolly son pollard. 9 5 foggy. mr pollard wife, mr thomas dagt dolly went visit magr stickneys. home. home. dolly mgr stiknys. 10 6 foggy warm. sally went dads. dolly wove. home. home. 11 7 cloudy. home. dolly sally quillting dagt pollard. waid, robbins livrmr workt paid doct cony money agusts ballard left home. ye girls son pollard. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 12-18, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 12 18, 1794 [12] e clear cold. mr ballard attended worship day, self aftern. calld see mrs benjamin 7h evng. mrs voce stevens night. severe cold. patient fathers. meetg mr savages. sally bakt mins pies evng. 13 2 x. birth benjamins son. xx. clear morn, cloudy, cold day. snowd night. patients illness came women calld shee safe deld 7 evn son. tarried night. mr benjamin absent. mr savages. birth 1st. receivd 6/ july 10th. 14 3 clear windy. left patients well expected returnd home 10h morn. mr ballard gone varsalboro. mr bullin brot us beef, dind mr ballard returnd [11]. mr town sleeps detoes. 15 4 clear cold. mr ballard coart. son town sleeps home. sally cox went dads bror john. ephm sleding wood town. home. 16 5 clear cold. mr ballard coart. home. bakt pies. david smyle town sleep ephm sleding wood town. home. 17 6 clear. mr ballard coart. mr bullin wife home. mr town sleeps cyrus ephm coart. home. [18] 7 clear, moderate day. mr ballard wrote part ye day, went coart aftern. home. cyrus attended coart. ephm sliding wood pitt. mr baxter returnd boston. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 19-25, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 19 25, 1794 19 e clear pleast. mr ballard, cyrus attended divine service hook. son dagt pollard dagt dolly aftern. moses springer lucy norcross, joseph white sally humphry gardner cryd ye last time. meeting. 20 2 clear pleast. mr ballard went mr gaslins survey home. sally washt washt house, ephm meddow mr kennady. home. 21 3 cloudy, rain night. mr ballard returnd. mr town sleeps home. margarett foot desird go see mrs norcross whos breast soar. ephm brothers, jacky sick. home. son town 22 4 rainy. calld son jonas see oldest son ye canker. night, ye child sick. son jonas, child sick. 23 5 rainy. sons. procurd cold water root child, seimd mend. la faet well could wisht. ditoes. 24 6 x. birth capt herseys dagt. xx. snowd ye morn. capt hersey calld see wife day. got safe river, freshet rose broke wife safe deld 7h evng dagt, like well. capt herseys. birth 2nt. 25 7 cold. capt herseys, seeking nurs transporting women home. tarried night, patients cleverly. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 26-31, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 26 31, 1794 26 e clear cold. capt hersey went brot mrs conrey nurs wife. went mr parkers, judg lithgow colo howard detoes mr parkers. 27 2 clear. calld mr parkers mr williamss see youngest child sick, night. mr parker gave 18/ attending lady illness last child. mr parkers williamss. 28 3 clear. calld mr wilmss mr parkers see infant unwell, returnd mr williamss. mrss fletcher ingerham watcht. ditoes. 29 4 clear. mr williamss, went jonss plantation; child sick. tarrid night. mr wilmss. 30 5 snowd. mr williamss. returnd james bennet, prisner. ditoes. 31 6 x. birth seth williamss dagt. xx. clear. mrs williams travil safe deld dagt 7h 40m evng. tarried night. betsy comfortable. mrs williams infant cleverly. ditoes. birth 3d. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 6-9, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 6 9, 1794 6 5 clear day, overcast evng. dolly sally washt washt floors went mr densmores evng, ephm ym. sleighded wood market day. home. home. girls mr densmores. 7 6 birth eliab shaws dagt. snowd. calld early ys morn eliab shaws, wife safe dild daught 1h pm returnd home. wrode home, saml braleys slead. calld sons, child better. dolly mr hamlins. began cottne stockin. eliab shaws. birth 4th. april 29,1795, receivd son jona shaws acount, 3/. 8 7 x. birth jasson butlers dagt. xx. clear pleast. mr ballard went survey land mr gilley. calld 5h evn see thee wife jason butler ye hook. shee safe deld dagt 5h 50m, tarried night nurst receivd 6/ reward. mr butlers. birth 5th. 9 e clear. returnd home went meeting, went cyrus. went mr seth williamss exercises, sick dagt low. calld sam pollards, well. find dolly unwell, balht feet gave herb tea. butlers, hamlins, williamss,son pollards meeting. doct ward &patty bullins cryd first time. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 10-16, 1794 (P)

content: martha ballard's diary, april 24 27, 1794 24 5 x. birth natn burgss son. xx. clear. mr ballard went varsalboro. calld see wife nathan burges safe deld (tho ill indeed) 11h evn fine son. tarried night. patients well expected, husband sea, living. nalhn burgess. birth 17th. first born. receivd 6/. 25 6 cloudy. came mrs burgess 9h morn. mr ballard ye hook. capt bouland unity reubin fairfield dind dolly went mr bisbes. sally workt gardin. jason livermore junr took current sprouts land leav. calld back gave ym back. sett others ye gardin. dittoes. 26 7 x. birth james kenneys dagt. xx. rainy. doct williams dind mr ballard gone mr thomass, law seut mr peter parker colo sewall. calld 2h evn see james kenneys wife labour, delivd 11h dagt; husband absent. tarried night, sleep. james kenneys. birth 18th. 27 e clear pleast morn. left patients cleverly 9h morn returnd home. feel fatagud. son jona son mr ballard left home 3h pm tour surveying commonwealth. may preservd returnd safety prayer spouse. dittoes. mr ballard sett sandy river. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 28-May 2, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 28 may 2, 1794 28 2 clear pleast. selve moore others sett assist mr ballard surveying. cyrus went take hors home dady wrode. home, workt gardin seting currant bushes &c. home. thunder rain night. 29 3 clear. mrs densmore dind william workt sowd parsnips, beets, carrotts, onions sett beets parsnips seed, dugg beds, &c. home. mrs densmore 30 4 clear. home, workt hard gardin. planted beens cucumbers sowd beets, carrots, parsnips, safron, radishes, onions &c. home. 1 5 clear. mr densmore put gargett cows neck. informd mrs pitts unwell went see find little easier. tarried night. raind evn, brisk wind. mr shuball pittss. 2 6 clear. went mr pitss mr child, find comfortable. mr dagt dolly work. went see mr wesson ye mumps, mending. came son pollards took tea. calld mr densmores, came home sowd cabbage seed sumer savory, sett jill run ye ground. wife danl bullon interd day. informd ye death mrss hopkins, mrs allin richd moores wife joell chandler. ditoes neigrs. funeral mrs bolton. news deaths. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 3-6, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 3 6, 1794 3 7 clear. home, carding tow sally spin. ephm brot bords hay colo howard. mr wessons vessel arivd hook ys day. home. 4 e clear till near night shower. shubal pitts wife comfortable. borrowd pork dolly came home. home. sally bakt pumkin pies wheat bred. home. 5 2 birth mr waids dagt. cloudy. mr beaman desird go see lady; left hors wride. went dind went see mrs carr, find much comfortable; husband better. calld see mrs fillebrown, shee cleverly. mr fesandans store, bot 4 lb cottne 2/4, 1 pr shoes 4/. jery dmrs bot 2 yds durant 2/9. came back mrs beamans, calld mr waid see wife labour, safe deld [sic] 10h evn dagt. tarried night. mr beamans others hook, mr waids. birth 19th. colt mare ys day. 6 3 cloudy. returnd mr waids, left patients cleverly took fine nap came home. ephm workt shubal pitts, mr carlton dolly sally went mr shubal hinklys. polly densmr lucy kenada evng. mr waids. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 13-18, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 13 18, 1794 13 3 rainy. home, informd yt mr ballard found snow 4 feet deep arivd place destination begining tour surveyings. cyrus hook, 1 bushl indin corn, 1 dito wheat esqr dumer. home, news fm mr ballard. 14 4 clear. home. girls wint mr blacks quillt. plant mellon seeds beens. sons yoakt ringd piggs, turnd made pen ym. home. sally wilms evng. 15 5 clear warm. workt gardin, planted mellons cucumrs. dolly gone sisters. ephm workt mr waid foren, gone see phraim raisd matw haywood esqr. wrote doct barton mr burtun yesterday. home. wrote doct barton yesterdy sent mr burtun. 16 6 clear cool. work ye door yard, sowd cabbage turnips. planted beens &c. sally went mr hamlins. sons ploughd piece ye north side ye gully. home. sally cox mr hamlins. 17 7 clear cold ye season, wind n w. piking cottne. ephm workt mr waid, cyrus finisht planting potatoes barn. hard frost night. home. mr ballard 69 years old ys day. severe frost. 18 e clear cold. s. moore j. slurges came ys morn. mr ballard returnd evng. found snow 5 feet tour. mr hamlin son, son jona, s p densmore took tea home. old mr hamlin mr ballard returnd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, may 19 23, 1794 19 2 clear till aftern. mr ballard doct coneys. calld see rold smiths wife unwell. calld mr beamans p. norcross t. kennys. bot earthen vessel, price 1/. [han] clearks. 20 3 clear pleasant. dolly went work mr hamlins. calld see mr hodgess child, shee much exercisd pain easier. informd boddy young girl ye name tilton found woods varsalboro. suspected negro ye name edmond fortis ye perpetratr. coroner calld town. mr hodges son pollards. girl found dead, thougt murderd. 21 4 cloudy rain. calld see mr moses whites wife labour, day night. edmond fortis, black man, conducted pounalboro jail commiting rape mrs tilton afterwds murdering ye evng ye 18th inst. shocking sein confest. wife 2 childn. mr whites. edmond fortis conductd jaile murdering mrs tilton. 22 5 x. birth moses whites dagt. xx. cloudy rain. mrss white deld 2h morn fifth daughter 9th child. left mother child cleverly 7. mr white bestowd 7/6 reward. ditoes. birth 20th. fee receivd. 23 6 x. birth john beamans son. xx. clear. calld 7h morn see wife john beaman labour. shee delivd 10 son; first son 5th child. left 7h pm cleverly came home. receivd 6/ reward. james sturges came work. mr beamans. birth 21st. fee receivd. funeral selvestr, [int]. ys [aft] source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 14-18, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 14 18, 1794 14 7 clear morn, fine shower aftern. mr densmores see dagt dorcas soar throat. gave cold wtr root tea fue drops viteral. finisht kniting stockins. mr densmo see dorcas. 15 e clear coal ye season. mr ballard returnd washington. betsy lidia densmore inform dorcas better. dolly came home mr pollards. coverd plants fear frost. home. cold day. 16 2 clear, frost morn. planted 10 cramby beens. mr bullin, wife son capt nichols, wife, son dagt took tea us. dolly sally went mr shepards, bot 9yds callomanco 2/4 yd skirt. workt gardin. home. capt nichols, [wife] friends girls hook. 17 3 clear. quilted quilt mrs densmore, dagts polly livermore helpt us. dolly bot 2 setts tea cups tea pott mr blaks. home. quiltd coat. 18 4 clear morn. dolly went mr burtuns work. went see mrs smith, shee taken cold unwell. sister came ys day. son jona calld see childn, exercised disentary. son pollards. dagt washing. mr smiths, burtuns, pollards son jon jamess [brother] sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 19-22, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 19 22, 1794 19 5 cloudy part ye day, rain aftern. workt gardin doubled hoes yn, knit sett french turnips. mr ballard made plan, boys cutt bushes, james brother calld see ye westwd. home. james sturges brother yeboys cut bushes. 20 6 x. birth capt phillip norcross son 3d child. xx. clear cool morn. calld 5h morn see capt phillip norcross wife labour. shee safe deld 20m noon fine son, 3d child. left mother child cleverly 4h pm, conducted water shepherds wharf, walkt home. calld capt neys, gows, parmers, sewalls. bot 2 skeins silk, 1/2 dozn table spoons, cost 2/2. calld mr danys, norcross, t. hinkleys, arivd home 7h pm. dolly returnd evn. mr town sturges sleep james unwell. capt norcross. birth 24th. receivd 6/ reward. mr town sleeps 21 7 clear. mr town sett home, dolly cyrus pownalboro, sally esqr smiths. selva moore working gardin home day. home. dolly went winslow. 22 e clear cool. mr ballard sally cocks went meeting, james varsalboro. went see mrs pitts, shee thinks shee mending. shee came home mr foots afternoon. shubal pittss, wife comfortable. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 23-28, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 23 28, 1794 23 2 clear. mr ballard ye boys cuting bushes. cyrus went winslow. sally washt scourd bakt washt 2 floors. sewing raggs together. home. 24 3 x. birth ezra hodgess dagt. xx. clear. mrs pitts came feavour fitt. cyrus dolly returnd. well son towns. calld mr hodgess, wife labour safe deld 11h evng daugt, 7th child, cleverly. receivd 6/ reward. tarried till daylight. mr hodgess. birth 25th. mrs hodges 29 years old ys day. 25 4 x. birth aaron hinkleys dagt. xx. clear. calld aaron hinkley mr hodgess 3h 30m morn. mrs hinkley safe delivd 4 dagt, 5th child. left child cleverly 6 returnd home. receivd 6/ reward mr hinkley. mrs pitts seems comfortable. dolly cleverly journey. shee went mr bullins winslow. ditoes aaron hinkleys. birth 26th.mrs densmor see mrs pitts. sally gone home. 26 5 clear till near night dull weather. mr floid mrs voce dind mr ballard went meeting church town. mr pattin mr pitts sleeps wife comfortable ys day. done work house tended feel fatagud. home. mrs voce mr pattin. shubal pitts sleeps 27 6 clear. done house work. mrs livermore see mrs pitts. home. mrs pitts comfortable. home. 28 7 clear warm. sally came home near night, brother sick. mrs pitts wrode hors home dolly returnd son pollards. quillted bed quillt since shee went source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 19 23, 1794 19 7 clear except lite shower. went aftern see mrs pitts, find well shee yesterday. dolly spoold warpt linning web. sally gone home evng. bot mr wessons 1 lb coffee 1/4 2/7, tea 1/6, 2 lb sugar 2/, paid ye cash. son pollards, mr [sic] daught cleverly. son pollards mr pittss. 20 e clear. mr ballard went meeting, revd mr turner performd. unwell, dolly likewise foren. shee went aftern see mrs pitts, finds better, mrs voce sally cocks came fathers, brother little better. boys got ye sow 7 piggs home. home. dolly went see mrs pitts, finds low. 21 2 clear. went see mrs pitts, find case difarant, shee severe gripeing, relax. old mr pollards hamlins. old mr hamlin ys foren. mr pittss others. 22 3 clear. shubal pittses day. shee low, exercisd severe gripeing loose stools. god knows may terminate. sent hors, find ill tarried thro night. shee entervails pain rest, weak indead. mr pittss, wife low. 23 4 clear. mrs pitts rose hour sun ye morn, went milkt ye last milk ye cow mouth swallowd recommended beneficial mr amos page. pain still continues god knows event. may shee prepared. kept bed ye day. dolly went brors, calld see mrs pitts, finds low. mrs densmore mr pittss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 24-28, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 24 28, 1794 24 5 clear warm. mr ballard went pittstn mill. son jon brot oldest son foren. ephm went ye hook biskitt, 2 dozn 1/4, galn vinigar 1/6, 1 lb loaf sugar 1/10. betsy voce calld informs mrs pitts comfortable shee yesterday. daugt ballard childn sleep home. dagt ballard children 25 6 clear warm. mr ballard surveying hook. see mrs pitts, find weak low. may shee divine presence support jona, wife childn sleep shubal pittss, wife low. 26 7 clear warm. mr ballard went meddow. son jona gone winslow. went see mrs parker find feeble. jonas wife childn went home water, boys conducted selva moore sleeps wrote bror barton. dolly went see mrs pitts, finds fadeing. mr parkers. wrole doct barton. jonas wife sons went home. selva moore sleeps 27 e clear, comfortable air ye morn, warm day. self famely attend public worship. calld see mrs pitts find little revivd, dare build expectation recovery. mr pitses mother came see left sun sett. sally williams polly livermore evng. meeting famely prayrs diserd behalf mrs pitts. shee low, relax abatedd. 28 2 clear warm, cooler evng. mr ballard boys went ye meddow cut dolly son pollards. sally washt. mr pitts wife well shee yesterdy. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 4-8, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 4 8, 1794 4 2 cloudy morn, clear aftern. mr ballard gone survey mr wesson esqr howard. gatherd safron, radish pods parsnip seed, done house work made pills dagt dolly. sally weaving. ephm wounded foot. dolly came home, informs hannah babe well could wisht. home, heard mrs pitts well. 5 3 clear warm. workt garden day, wed beds. sally washt, dolly wove 3_ yds. mr ballard went esqr conys, boys pulld flax. hear mrs pitts much home. wed gardin. 6 4 clear. mr ballard sett farmingtn. dolly went jonas. calld mr hamlins see babe, disentary; wife mending. calld see dagt pollard, shee better. mrs pitts comfortable day. sally wove 3_ yds, ye boys finisht pulling flax. mr hamlins, pittss mr pollards sons. hannah 25 yr old ys day. 7 5 clear. boys went fince stacks hay. sally went see mrs pitts, finds unwell. work gardin fatagud, went watcht. shee disentary much grip. shubal pittss, wifevery sick. watcht. wrote doct barton. 8 6 clear. mrs pitts day, shee sick. husband returnd home, brot port wine. left sun sett. calld son pollards, took tea. dolly ditoes. mrs pitts ill. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 9-13, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 9 13, 1794 9 7 clear foren, cloudy aftern. done matters gardin went hook. left letter doct barton isaac livermores. calld capt f browns. sally gone son pollards, boys finisht reaping wheat bound hook. mr perham sandy [river] interd ys day. 10 e rainy day. mr ballard returnd sandy river, attended public worship aftern. famely tarried home. ephm went see mrs pitts finds low. shee two fitts feavour day. severe pain ear night. home. mr ballard returnd sandy river. 11 2 clear except light shower. mr ballard mr pollards business. matters ye gardin, galhering safron. dolly sally washt washt floors. dolly went mr shephards foren son jona. brot oldest son left home. son jona brot jack 12 3 clear hott. jon killd lamb carrid son home. calld see mrs pitts appears drawing near close life. shee seeme resind great degree leav world. daugt ballard watcht mrs pitts. shubl pittss, wifevery low. 13 4 clear warm. mrs pitts till sun sitt. calld wife richd foster labour. sleep night. expect find mrs pitts alive returnd. ditos richd fosters. mrs [pitts] seen 22 years [night]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 14-17, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 14 17, 1794 14 5 birth richd fosters son. clear warm day. mrs foster safe deld son, second child) 4h 50m morn. left 9 well could expected. calld see mr james page low fall receivd last satterday. find mrs pitts greatly revivd, wonderfull gods goodness. came son pollards slept, refresht much fatagud. came home evng. dolly gone jonas. richd fostres pitts son pollards. birth 31st. 15 6 clear warm. calld son jonas see daugt dolly sick disentary faintness pukeing. tarried night. son jonas, dagt dolly sick 16 7 clear. made three attempts dolly sett shee allmost fainted. shee seemd little revivd aflern helpt onto hors. shee wrode river conducted home water. shee much overcome watking ye water ye house. put onions feet, gave castor shee seems comfortable. detoes. brot dagtdolly home. calld see mrs pitts, find little morecomfortable. 17 e rainy morn. mr ballard sons went meeting. attended aftern. ordinance baptism administred mrs pitts divine service shee well shee days. went see mr hamtins child, find low. dolly little easier. meeting mr hamlins pittss. mrs pitts baptised ys day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 18-20, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 18 20, 1794 18 2 clear morn. dolly ye night past number times. gatherd safron, helpt hous work foren. silva moore look breakfast dend dolly seems little better. mr hamlin calld see infant, sick. went mr thwings kimbals. calld hast mr pitts, wife thought near dissolution. tarried night, bed 12h 4. shee revivd rested mr hamlins, kimbals, thwing pittss. 19 3 clear, fine air. mrs pitts comfortable shee sett easy chair 3 hours foren, feavour fitt aftern much put breath. revivd little went see mr hamtins infant, find much revivd. dagt pollard gave suck day. returnd home sun sett. calld see mrs pitts, shee well shee could wish. dagt dolly little better. mr hamtins, pitts pittss. 20 4 clear cool. gatherd safron matters house foren. calld 12 o clok see mrs pitts alteration. shee seemd drousy state, hands feet cold, shee revivd. tarried watcht indiens noisy disturbd evng shee natural rest 12 known illness. mr pittss hamlins. indiens evn, noisy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 21 24, 1794 21 5 rainy. mrs pitts day. shee comfortable shee yesterday. doct williams calld see spoke les couraging, known find help using bark, wish advise unless shee chose shee wisht try prepard shee took 7 tea spoonfuls. saw ill efect left 6h 30m returnd home, find dolly little better shee mr pittss, doct williams 22 6 clear. home matters gardin. shubal pitts dind informs wife much left phillip bullin dind informs sister anna little better. mr ballard mr bisbes. dolly makeing waist coat cyrus, went mill varsalboro 2 bushels wheat raising. made beautifull flower. home. cyrus went get wheat ground esq farewells mill. 23 7 clear. cyrus went see mrs pitts finds well shee yesterday. mr ballard fixing tour planking seller. calld shubl pittss (watcht) wife ill. mrs abbott setts mr pittss. dolly sleepsat son pollards. mrs porter pittss. 24 e x. birth mr kimbals son. xx. clear part day. slept morn, calld 9h morn see mrs kimball. shee safe delivd son 4h receivd 6/ reward service returnd mr pitts. mrs porter richd foster watcht. mrs pitts rested better ys night. mr pittss kimbals. birth 32nt. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 25 28, 1794 25 2 clear warm. came son pollards, took breakfast. ephm brot ye hors came home, met mr ballard, selva moore james sturges way surveying. may preservd safety return. left mrs pitts comfortable, informd shee carried mrs pitts since left sally cox gone watch ys night. mr pittss. mr ballard sett tour surveying, ephm bring hors home. 26 3 cloudy forenn, shours thunder aftern. calld see mrs pitts, shee thought growing near close life, revivd. mouth throat soar. poore creature indures illness great patience. husband watcht. fitt feaver began sun sett, continud till midnight. may patience continue. mr pittss, wife pain shee 27 4 clear warm. went mr pittss break fast, mr craggs, thwings, kimbals, hamlins, pollards, blaks calld mr pittss. shee little comfortable shee yesterday. dolly sally went mr densmores. sally went mr grealys bed pann mrs pitts. mrs hamlin made present 6/ com bot 11 lb veal, cost 2/6. mr pittss neighbr, 1-2/1 lb butter mrs pollard. shee sent dolly 6/. 28 5 clear. dagt pollard came foren, mrs davis aftern. shee went colo norths. calld hast 8h evn see mrs pitts altaration thought near expireing. watcht, mrs livermore allso. mrs pitts revivd. shubal pittss mrs livermore watcht. dagt pollard mrs [davis] ys day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 29 september 1, 1794 29 6 clear sun rise. fine shower 1h ys morn. left mrs pitts revivd returnd home 10h morn. shubal pittss, wife ill indead. 30 7 mrs davis mrs porter sleep night. rachel cumings, crazy, ys day. broke corn, beens mischief. confind sally led mr hinkleys care shee object pitty, may god restore reason consistant divine mrs davis, porter rachel cumings crazy. 30 7 x. birth nathl thwings son. xx. clear. calld see mrs thwing labour, deld son 10h morn. receivd 6/ reward returnd far mr pittss, tarried watcht. capt coxs wife apprehend mrs pitts near close life. mr thwings. birth 33d. watcht mrs pitts. 31 e clear. mrs cocks went mr pittss house ys morn. went home aftern, took tea mrs cocks returnd mr pittss. old mrs pollard mrs barton watcht till near day. mr pittss, wife distrest night till near day, shee slept sweet knap. 1 2 rose, retird take rest 6 oclock, shee desird mr pitts moov fix bed. laid shee expird short space without strugle except distress breath. reason hope loss gain. clear day. came home mr pittss performd last ofice friend ship, except interment. son ephm went inform friends winthrop. four months day since calld see dead neace seisd last illness, shee born christian meekness humility. shee manifested regard christianity opne profission religion receiving ordinance baptism. morn los company, greatest reason hope shee changd [sic] world shee free pain sorrow, joind glorified saints sing redeeming lov. mr pittss, wife expird. ephm gone inform friends. mr pitts. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 3-7, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 3 7, 1794 3 4 clear pleast. dolly went son pollards, cyrus varsalboro. mrs livermore mr pitts mrs barton came home dolly. sally hamlin charls cocks took tea us. mr robbins calld see wife well shee could wish. cyrus returnd home. wrote doct ["barton." implied], sent mr craig. wife went board afternoon. gave mrs robbins derections relurnd. mr robbins. wrote doct barton. 4 5 cloudy foren, smart rain aftn. home, jona home. 5 6 clear pleast north wind. killd lamb yesterday. sent jona quarter one mr livermore, one dolly wrode son pollards. sent piece lamb. home. dolly went son pollards. 6 7 birth doct colmans son. clear, north wind. calld see wife doct colman labour 1h 1/2 ys morn. shee safe deld fine son 11h 10m foren. left well could expected returnd home 3h 30m aftern. wrode mr robbins, find lady comfortable. capt fillebrowns, well. doct colmans. birth 34th. mr robbinss capt fillebrowns. bot 4 oz snuff 9d. 7 e raind. attended worship aftern, sons day. sally cocks unwill. calld mr pitts, lonely. mrs barton gone winthrop. meeting mr pittss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 8-13, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 8 13, 1794 8 2 clear pleast. home, helpt house work. sally workt self, shee better shee yesterdy. ephm workt son jona. home. made 2 [doz] candles, part mr pittss. 9 3 clear. scolt pickles. ephm workt jon dolly went mr burtuns. 2 galns vinegar home. 10 4 clear. mrs black small tumbler full aloetic tincture, paid /9; shee 1 oz safron allso. cyrus gone pittstn, ephm work mr pitts. son dagt pollard, dagt ballard, mrs pierce barton took tea cyrus went see home. home. childn friends 11 5 clear. cleaning mustard, galhering herbs matters. dolly wint mr pittss, sally colo norths, cyrus mr burtuns vinagar; got 1 galn. 38 ys old ys day. home. cyrus 38 years old ys day. 12 6 clear warm. house work gathering herbs seeds. cyrus carrid radish pods beens pickle mrs burtun, brot 1 gallon vinegar. son town sleeps home. son town sleeps 13 7 x. birth benn fitches son. xx. foggy morn, clear warm afterwds. calld see benn fitches wife 1h morn. shee deld son first born) 5h m. left cleverly, babe allso, arivd home 10. receivd 6/ reward. dolly gone son pollards. sally finisht bleaching yn, cyrus went capt f browns, bot 1 quart w e rhum, paid cash; 2 lb shugar, dito butter 1 lb coffee paid benn fitche. birth 35th. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, october 6 10, 1794 6 2 clear. see mr hodges child, think mending. calld son pollards, well, mr baxters, wife unwell, doct colmans, well. 1 oz galbanum 1/3, dito alloes 1/, _ oz myrr /7, one nutmeg 1/, 2 oz clovs. mrs colman made present thimble. calld mr hamlins, well. mr ballard doct coneys mr pollards. cyrus bot m 3 pints spirrits, cost 1/20_. mr hodges others, doct colmans. 7 3 clear. home. mr ballard church meeting. mr densmore quilting hushing. young folks came home late. home. girls mr densmores. 8 4 x. birth mr felpss son. xx. clear. ephm fitt day break, sick till noone. calld 3h pm see mrs felps deld 6 son, third child. left infant cleverly returnd home 9, find ephm comfortable. cyrus pitts tn mill. mr felpss. birth 38th.my son ephm fitt morn. 9 5 rainy. mr williams dind calld see david sewalls wife unwell. night. david sewalls. 10 6 x. birth david sewalls son. xx. cloudy. mr sewalls, intimidated calld dr page gave patient [50] drops ot laudenum put stupor pains regular promising) manner [scant] till near night shee pukt returnd shee delivd 7h evn son, first born. left cleverly 10 walkt home. receivd 12/ reward. ditoes. birth 39th. mr perham sleepshere. dolly unwell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, october 11 15, 1794 11 7 x. birth nabby towers son moses parmer. xx. clear, serene day. calld 4h morn see nabby towers labour. shee deld 11h 30m son shee declard moses parmer father tarried dind. esqr haywood arivd home 3h pm, fatagud. dolly unwell, blister lames much. mr lathrop. birth 40th. receivd fee oct. 2nd mr daw hook. 12 e x. birth wilm whites. 4th son. xx. clear pleast. calld belween 12 1h see william whites wife labour. crost ye river went hors back. patient ill. laid took fine nap. shee calld day break safe delivd 6h 20m fine son waid 11 lb. left infant cleverly arivd home noon. sally cocks patty levermore ferried mrs blanchard, brown, winstow, page adkins attended. mr ballard sons mr perhan gone meeting. wilm whites. birth 41st. receivd 6/as reward. 13 2 clear. home, dolly son pollards. son town famely well. home. 14 3 clear pleast. mr craigs, burtuns thwings, well. bot 1/2 lb snuff 1/2. sally dolly quillting sally williams aftern. mr craigs others. 15 4 clear. selva moore wrote doct barton, bror collens sister walers, went see mrs parker unwell. dolly gone mr [smiths]. mr parkers. wrote friends oxford. silva moore sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 16-20, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 16 20, 1794 16 5 clear. wrote ys morn bror elijah moore douglas. silva moore took breakfast sett home. mr ballard esqr conys mr burtuns. mr green sandy river sleeps jona nichols receivd letters carry oxford james sturges came yesterday. home. wrote bror elijah moore. 17 6 clear. brewd went see mr parkers youngest child unwell, afflicted worms. mr ballard perham went esqr coneys make return survey. mr parkers. mr ballard perhambeen esqr coneys returnd plan. 18 7 clear pleasant. went mr sheppards, bot 8 yds baise cost 17/3, four yds black ribbin 1/4. mrs coutches, m d sewalls, capt fillebrowns, lathrops mr robbinss. mr perham came sleeps. hook. receivd 7/ mrs felps. henrey mc causland murderd mrs warrin. 19 e clear part ye day. home. mr ballard cyrus meeting ye fort, mr perham ye hook. dolly well go meeting. sally went dads yesterday returnd ys evng. informd henrey mc causland cutt mrs warrins throat yesterday. home. informd ye murder mrs warrin. 20 2 cloudy. mr perham left homeward bound. pally easty spooling web jonas wife. went see mr parkers child, think better. selva ebnz moore day. mr ballard fort. snowd evn, heavy rain high wind ys [night]. mr parkers. mr perham went patty easty source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 21-25, 1794 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 21 25, 1794 21 3 cloudy moderate. mr ballard fort, ye hook. cyrus winthrop jon hors. helpt hous work knitt. pally easty warpt beemd web went jon hernes. calld 10h evn see mrs robbins unwell. went bed 2h morn. mr robbins. 22 4 x. birth chandler robbinss son. xx. cloudy. mrs robbins linguerd till 4h pm illness came doct parker called shee wish see came returnd home. shee safe deld son, first born, 10h 30m evn well expected. tarried watcht. mrs ney shee except ye famely. mr robbins. birth 42nt. 23 5 cloudy. mr robbins went brot mrs voce nurs wife, conducted home boat. gave 18/ reward. found mrs baker house return. ditoes. receivd 18/. 24 6 clear. mr ballard unwell disentary, voids blood. went mr bulluns, baxters son pollards. snowd evn. mr burtuns others. 25 7 x. birth magr sticknys 2nt son. xx. cloudy. calld magr stickney 4h morn see lady labour. shee safe deld 2h pm 4th child, son. women tarried till near night left infant cleverly. receivd 6/ reward. find mr ballard better gone ye hook. mgr stickneys. birth 43d. mr [ballard] [comfortable. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, november 16 20, 1794 16 e snowd. left mrs bracket well could expected. calld found mrs burtun cleverly. mrs baxters, shee much son pollards jonas, well. little jona came evng conducted james mc clewer. bracketts others. 17 2 clear part ye day. dolly put new triming case draws. movd bedroome. done much work, got fatague. sally washt. drest 9 chickens cooking. home. 18 3 clear. home. baked pumpkin apple pies. capt stackpoole, dagt dingley, inft made sleep way hook. dingley going hous keeping home. capt stackpl sleeps 19 4 clear. son town took breakfast company slept went away. calld go see mrs baxter, hors could go. son jona brot wife youngest child mr ballard returnd evn, health favr desire thankfull. hom. capt stackpl went fm mr ballard returnd. 20 5 rainy. mr ballard cyrus went meeting, childn, mr pitts, mr barton jo mc causland dind us, women childn sleep home. high wind [ys] night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, february 7 11, 1795 7 7 clear moderate. left childn well could posably expected. dagt ballard seemd composed head, may infinite goodness grant safe recovery, may concernd give praise great name kind evle unthankfull, whose tender mercies work. find dagt dolly comfortable, widdo barton work son pollards. find dagt dolly much comfortable. 8 d cloudy. famely, except sally self, attended devine service foren, self shee aftern. tilton went mr livermores afternon. calld see son jon wife, find comfortable even admiration. may benevalent authur mercies still continue goodness famely. mr gill white evng. meeting, son pollards. augustus ballard s. g. sleep night. 9 2 cloudy part day. mr ballard, silva moore ephm surveying river. dolly wrode son pollards, finds jonas wife well expected. mrs barton sally cocks washt, assisted kitchen work. home. dolly made gown mrss abbott. 10 3 clear pleast. went see son jon wife, find tolerable comfortable. mr capons, blacks, smiths, pitts store old mr pollards. well except mr stodard, mending. son pollards others. 11 4 x. birth saml husseys 3d son. xx. clear. calld capt husseys, walkt loading place crosst mountains ice. arivd fatagud death, found wife deld son. returnd home fort weston, wrode hors mr pollards. dagt ballard [cleverly]. capt husseys. birth 8th calld. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, february 12 16, 1795 12 5 clear. mr ballard went town meeting. home. much fatagud knitt home. 13 6 cloudy foren. mr ballard went survey mrs hussey. cyrus, silva ephm surveying road mr pollards crotch whites. dolly work mrss burtun, ephm sally singing school evng, mr white came home cyrus took hors capt neys dady. home. home. mrs barton tooth aick. 14 7 x. birth david pollards 2nd son. xx. clear. home till evn, 9 o clock, calld see david pollards wife dild fine son 10. tarried night. mr stodard sick house, dilarious. doct page visit calld ye night. mr pollards. birth 9th. david pollards wife 27 years old day. receivd 6/7 novr 20 old lady pollard. 15 d clear. tarried patient part day night. calld see mrs baxter, shee recovering. mrs voce wint mr childs evng, well mr stodard little composd. dittoes. 16 2 clear. tarried patient till dinner. left infant cleverly. mr stodard seemd made feavour. doct page bled ye feet morn, bled, phissicked btistered sickness. calld mr abbotts, capins, son pollards. dagt ballard well could wisht aftern, sister trask lamb son. dittoes neighbours. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 8-13, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 8 13, 1795 8 d severe storm, wind s e. mrs porter ill, women calld. ditoes. 9 2 birth benn porters son. clear. mrs porter labour day deliverd son 8 hours evn. case difucult shee faint delivery till midnight, shee revivd got rest. mrs carr watcht. porters. birth 11th. ship [wreck] mentionedin days [herald]. 10 3 clear pleast. mrs porter comfortable weak. left 11h morn. mr chambers accompanied home. arivd 8h evng, find famely much better left dolly wrode day. son dagt pollard mr gill, wife returnd winslow last sater day. well ditoes. returnd home. mr ballard surveying pittston. 11 4 clear morn, snowd aftern. went hook mr chambers, sent spirrit sugar mrs porter. mr sheppards, robins, parmers, daws, shaws capt f browns. mrs livermore visit. hook. mrss livermore mr ballard returnd. 12 5 clear pleasant. went mr craigs, shee made present half yd cambric claoth. mrs burtun thwing calld see mrs child, shee infant well expected; mr pollards, davids wife calld son pollards jonas, well. mr craigs neigrs. mr ballard went mr john jones. ephm gone hay. 13 6 severe snow storm, wind n e. ephm jason livermore junr returnd hay josiah hawls. one jon oxen faild thee way oblidgd leave road. home. home. esqr cony returnd coart yesterday. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 18-22, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 18 22, 1795 18 7 x. birth benn branches son. xx. clear day. mrs branch deld son 9h 30m morn. left cleverly 11, calld nath runels mr dyers esqr runels. returnd far son pollards went see mrs capin, find well could wisht. mr gills, well. mrs abbot unwell. calld see mrs parker unwell. dolly mr pollards, capins, gills mr burtuns. girls made 2 barrils soap weak. [mr branches]. birth 18th. receivd 9/ deckmansstore april 27th branches order. 19 d rainy. mr ballard went meeting thee hook. well could wish. augustus ballard dind us. loin veal roasted. mr barnabas lambart auskt consent might marrie daugt dolly. hom. consentd mr barnas lambert marrie dagt dolly. 20 2 rainy. mr ballard went mr jonses. mending shirts, apron trousers. mr lambart dagt dollys intencions marriage made public posting ye meeting house. home. mr lambart dolly publisht. 21 3 clear. mr ballard silva sett survey east andover. home, mended cloaths. home. mr ballard gone survey. 22 4 clear pleast. combd flax wint hook corn got none. bot 28 lb rice ounce turnip seed capt fillabrown, cost 8/3. calld ye stores, walkt home calld see capt welts confind wound thigh. hook. unwell night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 23-26, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 23 26, 1795 23 5 clear. unwell day, feel better evng. ephm went hook mill, brot home 1 bushl wheat, 1_ indien meel, one purchast mill, paid 6/. home unwell. sally hamlin 24 6 clear. comfortable. mr isaac savage seconds wife visit. mr john abbot calld 6h pm see wife unwell. night. shee slept mr town took breakfast dolly went son pollards. mrss cashin foren. mr abbots. mr savage wife son town allso. 25 7 x. birth john abbots dagt. xx. cloudy rain. mrs abbot unwell day, women calld 1h pm shee deld 3 dagt, first born. went mr blacks, wife mrss smith calld see mrss abbot. went see mrs capin, returnd took care patients night. mr abbots. birth 19th. receivd 6/as reward. 26 d x. birth capt john moloys dagt. xx. rainy. calld capt molloy day, find wife unwell. shee women calld 10hm, came intermition. shee deld 1h pm dagt, second child, dagts. tarried till near night left mother child cleverly, returnd. find famely well. mr densmores livrmrs dagts evng. mrss moloy unwell last night alltho shee call till morn. ditoes capt molloys. birth 20th. receivd 18/ reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 27-30, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 27 30, 1795 27 2 clear till near night. went mr capins, find mending; mr abbots, wife cleverly; mr hamlins, wife unwell; mr dickmans, receivd 9/ benn branches acount assisting wife child birth. calld mr smiths took tea, went slept son pollards. great danger fall hors escapt unhurt thro gods preserving mercy. son pollards neigrs. rainy night. preservd danger fall hors. 28 3 rainy. mr baxter came son pollards go attend wife operation emetic. favourable opperation came mr blacks took tea went son pollards slept. mr [baxters] others. dolly bot barril cyder vessel, price [21/]. 29 4 clear. came home, wrode hors son jonas, find mrs young helping dolly strike harnis. doct cony plan. son pollards. 30 5 clear. mr hodges workt wife visit. hatchild 11 lb 3 oz flax. sally washt, dolly spining linning. home. mrss hodges source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 1-5, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 1 5, 1795 1 6 x birth mr claps son. xx clear. mr hodges calld see mrss clap labour. left home 4h pm, walkt far mr hodges, wrode edwd savage junr rest ye way. patient deld 5 son cleverly. tarried night, slept mr clapss. birth 21st. saw mrss jones 2 7 clear. went see mrss parker, shee well could wish. calld see mrss kimbal, shee unwell; mr crages dind; mr thwings, well usual; mr capins, shee mending; mr abbots, shee feeble; son pollards, well usual. wrode hors home. ditoes neighs. sally gone dads. cyrus came home. 3 d rainy day. cyrus went pitts tn. unwell. jona dind mr lambt came aftern. home, unwell. 4 2 clear windy. mr waid workt mr ballard men returnd east andivour, much fatagud. unwell could. home. mr ballard returnd. son jon house burnt evining. 5 3 clear pleasant. mr ballard, self, selva ephm went meeting acadima. discourse deld revd mr bradford pownalboro adapted ocation, viz, opening semenary inslruction. deacon coney lady dind us went mr livermrs jonas wife children came house built bizer benjamin liv consumd fire last evng. meeting ye hook mr livermores. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 6-11, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 6 11, 1795 6 4 x clear warm. dagt ballard dolly went stores. hook, dolly brot crockery 3/4 lb snuff. mr ballard selva went town meeting. sewd raggs coverled. home. 7 5 clear. mr ballard went colo howards. dagt pollard workt little gardin, sett car current bushes &c. home. dagts 8 6 clear pleast. mr ballard esqr conys. dagt ballard childn went home. dolly sally washt went mr gills. mr princ baker calld see capt molloys infant, unwell. gave rhubarb. tarried night. capt molloys. dagt ballard went home, son town slept 9 7 clear windy. left ye infant little comfortable. mrss molloy made present muslin cap. felt dull came home. mr preskott son mr pullin dind sowd seeds sallit. dittoes. 10 d clear pleasant. famely, except self dolly, went meeting ye hook. mrss holman, mr trask wife, augusts ballard, jessy bullin, wm parmer, anna bullin fanny cocks supt girls sleep ballard allso. home. receivd letter doct barton april 22nt, mrss holman. 11 2 cloudy rain. mr ballard went pittstn. planted cucumbers sowd turnip lettuce seed. mrss page gardin seeds. polly livermore evn. richd foster famely well. bror ebinz moore, anna fanny sleep home. bror moore slept source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 12-15, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 12 15, 1795 12 3 clear. workt gardin. capt f browns company calld exercise day. phillip bullin wm parmer mr lambart, anna fanny took tea girls sett home dusk. planted beens cucumbrs. home. miss cocks bullin wenthome. 13 4 rainy. home, workt gardin showers. mr capin wrote home. 14 5 clear extreamly pleasant. mr barnabas lambart dagt dolly united ye bonds matrimony (may pleas author mercie bless restoreing impared health granting long liv lov harmony.) magistrate performd wm brooks esqr, returnd ye fee dagt. attendants ocation mr capin, sons pollard jon mr gill yr wives, mr pitts sister, mr richd foster wife, mr stodert miss pollard, together famely consisted mr ballard, self, sons cyrus, ephm, s. g. moore, sally cocks, lucy petty bickford. mr davenport ocationally tea us. whole performd desency. home. mr barnabas lambart daugt dolly united matrimony. mr capin writing foren. 15 6 clear. mr lambart wife went dine son pollards, spend aftern mr capins. mr capin writing plans mr ballard, bestowd 6/ reward assisting wife. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 16-20, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 16 20, 1795 16 7 cloudy rain foren. workt gardin aftern, planted beets mellon seeds. wind blowd cool. mr ballard varsalboro. silva came home pitts tn. ebenz moore sleeps home. 17 d clear. mr ballard, self, selva, sally ephm attended meeting hook. mrss waid lost woods. ebenz moore went home. dolly unwell ys day. meeting. dolly unwell. 18 2 clear. mr ballard silva finisht planing. workt gardin, sowd carrotts, parsnips, onions, radishes; planted cucumbers vermillion seed. mr ballard gone ye fort. home, workt gardin. 19 3 x. birth james blacks daugt. xx. clear foren. went hook, bot brass kettle wt 5 lb 4/ pr lb capt fillebrown. cloudy aftern. went mr pollards, mr smiths, pittss, gills son pollards. came home 5, sett write doct barton calld mr hodges see mrs black. shee deld 7 daugt, 4th child; number sex equal. tarried night, patient exercisd pain. ye hook fort, atmr blacks. birth 22nt. raind night. fee receivdjune 4th. 20 4 x. birth jessy kimbals dagt, first born. xx. rainy. calld mr blacks capt cockss see dagt kimbal 4h morn. shee ill safe deld 4h pm fine daught. left infant well could expected returnd home water; fatagud. famely bed wn came [home]. capt cockss. birth 23d. receivd 6/ reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 21-26, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 21 26, 1795 21 5 cloudy rain. sally hamlin came yesterday. calld see edmond getchels wife unwell, tarried night. mr getchells. 22 6 rainy. calld mr gitchels see briant fletchers infant sick; returnd evn. ditoes mr fletchers. 23 7 rainy. mr getchels, wife unwell. mr getchels. 24 d rainy day. mr getchels, wife unwell yet. ditoes. 25 2 birth x edmond getchels son. xx. clear pleasant except cool. mrss getchell women calld aftern safe deld son 4h pm. left infant well could expected 7. calld see mr fletchers child, find little comforlable. ditoes. birth 24th. receivd 6/7. 26 3 x. birth jery badcks son. xx. clear pleast. calld benn petingal go jerimy badcoks. went ye fort water, wet arivd taken hors back wrode mile orderd return, ye patient deld son. crost river ye boat receiving 6/ mr petngll troubl. invited take breakfast mr smith. dind allso. took tea mr gills. calld see mrs capin, calld brestow grefin, man coulor whos wife white. came home hors, went water much fatagud climbing ye assent. find ye patient ill opt take rest sleep. calld jery badcoks. birth 25th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 27-Jun. 2, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 27 june 2, 1795 27 4 x. birth grefins son. xx. clear pleast. hous brestow grifins. wife safe deld son 6 hours pm. receivd 6/ reward, returnd home water. grifins. birth 26th. 28 5 clear pleast morn. planted beens ye door yd. sowd pees round flax. mr gill wife mr lambart took tea home. 29 6 cloudy, raind aftern. clearing door yd foren. asa mason gave order mr baxter owd dind capt nichols son alaxander directly oxford, friends well. brot letter josiah kingsbury. wrote brors collins moore, barton waters. home. wrote friends west. dolly sett wb diaper work. 30 7 rainy day. little ye door yd kniting. dolly wove 2 yds diaper. home. 31 g rainy. mr ballard wint meeting ye hook. silva moore, mr raiment [pettie] dind mr abrm pages wife hors wride mr pollards. home. selva moore 1 2 showers morn evn heavy one. workt showers mooving doore dirt. dolly cut web weaving 4 yds drew plain cloath, hard weav shee could weav home. 2 3 clear, part ye day showers. mr ballard meddow, found flowd. ephm went sidney polly easty. workt ye door yd seller. planted cucumbers house, came 8 inst. home. polly easty [came] work. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 3-7, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 3 7, 1795 3 4 xx. birth ezra smiths dagt. xx. cloudy part ye day. calld 7h morn mr ezra smith see wife deld 9h 30m fine dagt. tarried day night. shee well could expected. shee got ye rash. mr ezra smiths. birth 27th. captdancy left ye fort. 4 5 clear, wind ye northerd. mr kilridg conducted wife capt deans vessel ye hook bound south shore. came mr smiths assisting git wife bed calld mr gills. saw son town, famely well usual. esq haywoods son pollards. dagt helping dolly bed quillt. mr smiths. receivd 7/6 reward. polly [sic]. 5 6 clear. home, workt gardin &c. mr ballard returnd coart. ephm winthrop one dozn chairs dolly. home. 6 7 clear. tending cloath yt ws whitining quilling yn dolly weav, working gardin kniting. capt ney sheard sheep. mr ballard bot cloath coat self. home. 7 g clear. mr ballard, cyrus ephm attended meeting ye hook. sally went dads polly easty son pollards, finds dagt ballard unwell. expects shee got rash. augustus ballard mr hodgden supt home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 8-14, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 8 14, 1795 8 2 clear warm. mr ballard sett asist laying road new sharon sandy river. ephm went wrode hors home. home, tending cloath whiten divers matters. home. mr ballard sett lay road. 9 3 clear. tending cloath weading beens cucumbers things. mr gill wife unwell. ephm went winslow. capt nichols dind home. capt nichols ephm went winslow. 10 4 cloudy sun shine turns foren, heavy shower noon, rain afterwards ye day evn. houghd water musk mellons, quilld carded cottne. mr cooshman ordaind winslow day. home. ephm gone ordination. 11 5 clear. tended cloath transplanted cucumbers. dolly sally went ye hook. got thee web put another bed ticks. home. 12 6 clear. tended cloath workt gardin, sett cabbbage turnip plants. eph returnd ordination, well mr towns. home. 13 7 clear windy. tending cloath. mr ballard returnd tour. home. 14 d clear. famely attended worship meeting house except patty. dind jon pollards. dolly unwell evng. meeting. mr stone performd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 15-18, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 15 18, 1795 15 2 clear. dolly put bed quillt tho shee unwell. mr capin, gill, dagts pollard ballard mrss p. pollard came assisted gentmn came conduct home. home. quillting dollys bed quillt. 16 3 clear. home, quilltd dollys bed quillt. mrs savage came aftern, helpt us got mrs peterson home. 17 4 clear warm. went hook, paid mr joseph dummer 15 dolrs buro, table bd stead dolly. bot mr strattne 2 poringers 1/9, one 1/6 5/ 2 candlesticks 1/4; rold smiths 2 kenisters 2/8, whole 9/. went see mrs waid whose oldest child dagt expird 10h morn. mr ballard surveying mr child patridg. ephm brot dollys furniture mr dumers. hook mr waids. dagt betsy expird ys morn 10h 18 5 x. birth mr frosts child. xx. clear warm. mr ballard went survey mr pollard. mr lambart conducted daugt home house keeping. may god pleasd bless prosper restore health sally cocks went home ephm assisted take boat furniture, attended interment mr waids oldist dagt; one pall bearers. saml page, dannie mc master wm densmore others. calld go winthrop, went far mr stephenss. mr [sic] dagt dolly went house keeping. birth 28th. funeral. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 19-25, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 19 25, 1795 19 6 x. birth georg boltons son. xx. clear warm. charls cockss wife visit. calld evn go georg boltons. viry fataguing journey, found patient deld son. tarried till morn. wrode mr ballards hors. georg boltons. birth 29th. receivd8/5 june 27th 1797. 20 7 clear warm. returnd boltons. calld john jonses, mr lambarts son pollards. much fatagud. ditoes. mr sheppard, robbins 2 gentlemen boston 21 g clear forenn, raind night. selvester g. moore made present orange 2 apples. mr ballard sons went meeting, feel able go. cyrus sleeps home. selvister g. moore 22 2 cloudy part day. done hous work wed gardin polly spun days work helpt work. home. 23 3 clear till near night, shower. mr ballard ephm weading corn mr livrms workt gardin day, feel fatagud. sally came morn. shee brewd ys aftern. mr ballard brot 1 galln molases pork home. home. sally cocks came son lambarts ys morn. 24 4 clear. workt gardin till near night went see mrs peterson unwell. came home evn. mrss petersons. 25 5 rainy part ye day. house work foren, sett plants houghd mellons aftern. mr town sleeps famely well usual. hom. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 1-4, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 1 4, 1795 1 4 clear warm. workt gardin foren. calld see capt molloys lady aftern, find exercised weakness, gave directions. shee gave 1/6 returnd home evn. mr ballard ye fort survey esq coney. ephm workt road ye oxen. capt molloys. 2 5 x. birth mr danys son daugt xx. clear warm. workt raggs coverled, calld mr dany go see wife labour. left home 3h pm. shee deld 4 son half 4 daughter. mother infants likely well. receivd 6/ part fee, walkt home sun sett. informd neighbours put camp mrs peterson 8 rods road, back mr kenaday. mr danys. birth 30th 31st. receivd 6/. 3 6 clear warm. workt gardin raggs coverld. mr james [webber] sister sally dind john kenady david densmore workt 9/ cash night. mr shubal hinkleys man workt aftern. sally shows much uneasiness wages. magr stickney receivd money mr ballard bounty wolf. home. magr stickney receivd bounty wolf mr ballard. 4 7 clear warm. workt gardin. mrs savage paid spining 3/. independence observd hook. assembled ye island. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 5-9, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 5 9, 1795 5 d clear pleast, warm days past. mr ballard, ephm sally went meeting fort. cyrus came home went aftern. felt well could wish. augusts ballard tarries home. mr savage wife sleep 6 2 clear. mr stone child calld mr ballard sett pownalboro coart, ye grand jury. dagt pollard dear little dagt. shee, sally patty, went mr pages strauberies, mrss hodges allso. mr town pollard conducted home. home. dagt pollard mr ballard coart. 7 3 clear. houghd things ye house gardin day, feel falagud. ezra town came evn. betsy page home. ezra town sleeps 8 4 clear. houghd w squash wound quills patty easty. mr fuller ezra town took breakfast ephm went ye fort, brot letter sister waters june 19th. shee famely well. home. ezra went home. receivd letter fromsist waters june 19th. 9 5 clear. filld quills cleand store doore, remoovd much dirt old ashes 12 bushels, put cumbers mellons planted chipy ground. sally went capt f browns, bot 2 lb cottne 5/, mr mdcalfs bot 1_ yd ribband /9. falagud ys night rest well. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 23 27, 1795 23 5 clear warm. mr ballard went see meddow, finds good ever saw home. sally cocks 20 years old day. son town cyrus left aft breakfast. sally piqut 3 pints rasburies aftern. home. cyrus slept last night. son town took breakfst. 24 6 cloudy, rain aftern. sally washt. houghd gardin got string beens densmr. mr ballard wrode business. home. [nancy young] son, expird ye 25. 25 7 x. birth wm daws dagt. xx. clear warm. mrs kenney says dagt comfortable. houghd cabbages ye door. calld 2h pm see mrss daw ye hook. shee deld fine dagt 8. tarried night, sett first dagt 6th child. mr daws. birth 33d. receivd 7/6. jessy kimbals inft expird 8 hours evng. 26 d clear. returnd mr daws, left patients cleverly. informd noon ye death jessy kimbals infant; born may 20th. sally went dadys evng. meeting aftn. mr partrage wife child piqut three cucumber. ditoes. funeral nancy youngs infant son. 27 2 cloudy, raind night. dagts pollard lambart spent day returnd home evng. dind] roast lamb, string beens green peas cucumbers. sally cocks came home evn, attended mr jessy bullin. mr ballard home. home. dagts jessy kimbals infant dagt interd aftn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 11 17, 1795 11 3 clear. mr ballard went meddow, sally cocks son lambarts. informd death brother john, diseast jamaca june 19th, 1795. home, workt hard. home. sally mr lambarts. shee tarried night. 12 4 clear foren, cast aftern. dagt lambart came morn, shee ill turn last night. shee seems better aftern. attended ordination mr gillet hook. mrs brown oldest dagt, mr town mrs foster, dagt lambt ebenz moore junr dind ye hook see ye ordination mr gillet. sally went dads. 13 5 heavy rain ys morn, well filld. mr ballard went meddow. mrss foster sett home. boys fensing ye garden. home. home. mr balad ye meddow. 14 6 clear. mr ballard went meddow. home, much fatagud work. sally came home dads near night, marm overwhelmd grief lose son. home. mr bald themeddow. 15 7 clear. mr ballard went ye meddow. wm kenada mr burgin reapt wheat, got barn. mrss burtun rusha capin allso, marm made present beautifull muslin hand kerchief. home. mrss burtun mr bald ye meddow. 16 d clear. cyrus came home. mr ballard sons attend worship foren, went self aftern. calld mr lambarts, well. meeting son lambarts. 17 2 clear, men went meddow. sally washt bakt, cleand store sarah neall came spin home. men meddow. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 18-25, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 18 25, 1795 18 6 rainy. home picking wool. sally coloured yarn make womens cloaths. [jamy] hanskom home. 19 7 raind foren. hanskom thrashing wheat. cyrus home, killd 2 lambs us. mr porter, wife mrss foster made prest pair cottne hoes dear sisters mrs pitts. deryus ballard came going work us. home. mr porters wife mrs foster 20 d clear pleast. cyrus, deryas sally cocks went meeting. dagt lambart came husband came dind raind left us. mr ballard, p. bullin john putman returnd surveying 6h pm. home. son dagt lambart mr ballard came home. 21 2 clear till noone, raind aftern. mr ballard went fort, informd mr miles expird last night interd ys aftern. mr james page dind derius ballard began work us. sary neal came work son town came aftn, famely house. home. funeral mr miles died mr woodwads. 22 3 clear cool. went son towns, find famely well except john, turn pukeing relaxt. dind mr trobridges. went son towns. 23 4 clear. ditoes, helpt dagt fix bed quillt ditoes. 24 5 cloudy. helpt break wool put bed quillt fraim. mrs haill calld helpt chalk ditoes. 25 6 clear. dagt invited neighbour ladies quillt. finisht quillt sociable meeting. mrss haywood, widdow haill dagt, cragen, two mrs fullers, 2 mrs stackpols, wiman, dingla hawl collar ladies assisted dagt. ditoes. dagt bed quillt quillted. mr [putnm] wife source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 26-Oct. 1, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 26 october 1, 1795 26 7 clear. dagt part made bed quillt. made coats blankets. went leut cragens noon. dagt unwell night. ditoes leut cragens. 27 d x. birth son towns 7th dagt. xx. rainy part day. dagt women calld. shee ill till 5h pm, delivd 6 dagt. obstruction breath nostrils expird 8h evn. mr dagt exercised faintness, revivd seemd confortable midnight, slept mrs spring straten tarried night. took sleep 3h morn. son towns. birth 38th. infant expird 8h evng. mr danies dagt expird aftern. 28 2 rainy. mrs spring strattne went home fore n, mrss eunice stakpoole came nurs dagt. infant interd 5h pm. dagt comfortable expected. revd mr cushman attend house, made prayer well adapted. sons, infant interd 5 pm. 29 3 cloudy morn. left dagt noone. calld see mrs lithgow, shee got mumps. wrode far mr daws began rain, abated sett wrode rain. fall hors mr thomases receivd much hurt. arivd house 6h, informd death mr danies infant dagt. expird last lords day. ditoes returnd home. calld esqr lethgows. son town sleeps 30 4 clear pleast. son town left mr ballard went saml norcroses survey writeing. home, feel fatagud. sally cocks went help dagt lambart put feathers bed ticks. home. sally son lambts. 1 5 clear. mr ballard sett surveying. deryus ephm went carrie men bagage, dresden water. went see dagts, well. mrss capin coat ye fraim, helpt sally cocks allso. mr shuball pitts came home sons pollard lambarts. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 2-7, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 2 7, 1795 2 6 clear. went hook see sick mr danies, greelys, dingleys sewalls. sickly time came home 2h pm, mrss savage, kennada, leach burgin deryas ephm returnd. sary went home. hook. sary got web 26 yds. wollen 3 7 cloudy. home. son jon wife dagt mrss livermore going visit sick hook. home. david sewalls child expired. 4 d clear foren. went meeting. mr gillit performd. went son lambarts intermition, calld colo sewalls; dagt meriah expired arivd. tarried mrs harris put grave cloaths. tarried night. meeting colo sewalls. dagt expired. shee born may 11, 1792 6h pm. 5 2 cloudy. came colo sewalls fore n. calld mr parkers see mrs voce old lady howard, crost river, calld mr burtuns, son lambarts, mr gills. came son pollards 1h pm. quillted coat slept. mrs haywood, hodges, polly pollard, patty easty assisted son pollards neigrs colo sewalls. 6 3 cloudy rain foren. son pollards sewing dagt lambart meriah sewalls remains interd. son pollard returnd wiscassett. tarried night. son pollards, colo david sewalls childn interd. 7 4 cloudy. went see dagt lambt. thee mrss capin, gill abbott came son pollards aftern. tarried night. sons pollard lambart. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 8-13, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 8 13, 1795 8 5 cloudy rain. informd morn dagt lambart unwell. went see find comfortable shee last night. calld mr gills see son unwell. came son pollards, tarried night. mr ballard calld came home surveying day. childns mr gills. son town slept folks well expected. 9 6 cloudy morn, cleard pleasant noone. came home breakfast. mr ballard went hook. son town sett home. doct ward, wife mrs anna bullin visit, dind took tea. mr trew took breakfast. son pollards. company came home. 10 7 clear pleasant. mr ballard surveying hook. mr capin took breakfast cutt shirts, gatherd beens matters. mrs leach evng. sarah dagt went home evng. home. 11 d cloudy morn, raind aftern. dagt lambart came mr isaac savage calld see wife unwell. tarried night son dagt lambt tarried house. isaac savages, wife unwell. 12 2 clear pleasant. returnd home. spoke mrs burtun informd son james unwell. sally cocks washing. shee went mr lambarts evng. calld see mrs savage mr ballard town meeting. ditoes. came home went evn. 13 3 clear. came savages mr burtuns, dind. james unwell. calld mr lambts mr pittss, unwell. slept son pollards. john abbott moovd ditoes neigrs. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 14-19, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 14 19, 1795 14 4 raind. came home breakfast. scallt pickles, house work. mr ballard went hook business. boys cutt pumpkins drie. knitt esqr petingail expired ys day. son pollards. death esqr petingail morn. 15 5 raind. heavy shower lightning thunder evng. brewd done house work, felt unwell noon. mr ballard sett attend funeral esqr petinagail, late went farther mr pollards, returnd. home. remains esqr petingail interd ys aftern. 16 6 clear pleast. mr ballard went fort. mrs benjamin gave string beens. heard mary densmore sick, went see find poorly. complaint pain sweling abdimen. mr densmors, mary sick. 17 7 clear morn, rainy aftern. mr ballard went pittston. gatherd beens, drie green, sheld stringd. sally cocks came home morn, made pumpkin pies. sarah child went home, boys mill savage boltons 1_ bushel apples, price 3/ pr busl. home. 18 d birth son pollards dagt. clear. calld 2h m see dagt pollard. shee safe deld 8h foren dagt. tarried day sett night. shee exercised pain. son pollards. birth 39th. 19 2 clear part day. tarried dagt pollard. shee much pain thro day night. tended night. little rhoda unwell evng. son dagt lambart evng. ditoes. dagt well aswe could wish. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
