title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 20-23, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 20 23, 1795 20 3 x. birth james page junrs son. xx. rainy. calld day break son pollards james page junr see wife, find illness coming took little sleep foren. patient deld son, first born, 10h evn. took nap fire midnight. women tarried thro ye night. ditoes james pages. birth 40th.i receivd 7/9d reward. 21 4 clear. left patienl cleverly. came son pollards, find dagt seting comfortable. came home, drest went meting house see ordination mr daniel stone. things performd great regutarity, famely attended. went dineing see mr densmores dagt polly find sick. complaint much abated. augustus ballard sleeps night son cyrus allso. ditoes. ordination mr daniel stone first church hallowell. 22 5 clear. great frost morn. calld see polly densmore foren, administred clister, went sun sett tarried till 10h evn; performd opperation twice. shee seems little easier. mrss capin, gill dagt lambart, agustus ballard son cyrus dind gentmn came tea waited wives home. mr densmors twice day. company. 23 6 cloudy, raind aftern. went mr densmores aftern breakfast. dolly little easier. doct cony went son pollards. dagt severe head aick. gave clister wint see mrs savage, helpt bed tarrid time. shee full complaints. returnd, gave dagt another clister left calld performd opperation polly densmore came home 8h evn. son pollards sick famelies. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 24-27, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 24 27, 1795 24 7 clear pleast. went see dagt pollard, find exercised severe pain head. applied feaver fue temples gave clister. shee seemd easier. left evng. calld performd like service polly densmore returnd home 9h evn. son pollards mr densmors. 25 d clear pleast. famely allended public worship. revd mr cushman performd. calld see dagt pollard, find exercised pain head. abated evng. mr ballard sally cocks dind mr capin. went see polly densmore tea, performd usuas opperation. shee seemd relievd returnd home. meeting son pollards, capins densmores. mr cushman preacht psalm. 26 2 raind. home day, unwell afternoon. hear polly densmore much home unwell. 27 3 clear. went mr densmores, performd polly, informd dagt pollard unwell. walkt find exercised severe pain head. went doct colmans, procurd senna, manna medisins; returnd, gave small dose. shee soon became dilarious. sent doct cony approvd done, advised continue medisin till opperaton. shee siesd severe pukeing soon sick weak. tended thro night. mr densmrs son pollards. dagt sick indeed. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 28-Nov. 2, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 28 november 2, 1795 28 4 clear. dear child. doct came visit recommended senna. shee sick thro day. sent sally cocks, shee came calld see wife asa blanchard drawing near hour labour, extreamly ill. son pollards asa blanchards 29 5 clear pleast. mr blanchards, shee much shee feel anxcious dagt pollard. mr blanchards. 30 6 clear pleast. prepard self go home aftern, patient seemd unwell dare leav mr blanchard kind go house inquire child. brot word shee relievd eased mind ditoes. 31 7 clear. went old mr blanchards, wife went mr john norths, young woman unwell patient unwell night. snowd blew latter part night. ditoes mr john norths. 1 d cloudy part day, snowd morn. patient unwell. calld old mrss blanchard wilm whites wife eveng. little sleep thro night. mr blanchds. 2 2 x. birth asa blanchards dagt. xx. clear. patient delivd 11h morn dagt, first born. returnd home, left inft well could expected went son pollards, find dagt low. ditoes. birth 41. receivd 9/ fee medesins. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 3-8, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 3 8, 1795 3 3 clear. dagt pollard still low tho much exercised pain shee gave senna opperated twice assistance clisters. son pollards. hannah weak yet. 4 4 clear. yet dagt remains feeble. shee two fitt pain head every day; infant well could expect. son pollards. 5 5 clear. still child great better. calld evn see mrs pillsbury severe fitt thee collic. returnd gave dagtr three pills prepared myrr, alloes grain boarux. undrest night. dagt slept ditoes mr pilsburys. 6 6 clear. dagt. shee sick day. pills opperated 4 times. shee much fatagud opperation relievd shee anything shee takin shee rest night. son pollards. 7 7 clear pleast. dagt sett 1/2 hour foren much aftern, faint. sent sally cocks stay night came home silf. son lambarts little aftern, house. ditoes son lambarts. 8 g cloudy. famely meeting aflern. dagt pollard foren. shee seems comfortable, able sett table dind. mr capin 2 dagts baptised jos stackpole 1. phillip bullin came evn. cyrus meeting son pollards mr hamlin. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 9-13, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 9 13, 1795 9 2 x. birth mr dickmans son. xx. rainy. calld see mrs dickmn middle night, found deld son arivd mrss pollards assistance assisted tarried thro night day. left inft well could expected. calld see dagt pollard, find well shee yesterday. son town sleeps famely well left mr dickman bestowed 12/ assistance medisns. mr dickmans. birth 42nt. receivd 12/. 10 3 clear. mr ballard men sett survey ephm went see mrs dickman, find infant cleverly. mrs jones mrs crage mrs pollard calld see dagt pollard, shee remains comfortable. polly densmore feeble yet. polly livermore evn. mister greely sleeps put 1 pair oxin hay. mr dickmans, son pollards mrdensmores. 11 4 clear morn, cloudy aftern, rain evn. son town mr greely sleep workt gardin giting cabbages &c, sally cocks put coat fraim, helpt quillt till 12h evn. home. son town sleeps 12 5 clear. dagt lambart came quitted little sallys coat, dind went see polly densmore, finds feeble. mr lambt came accompany home. sally wrode came back hors. son town made prest 6/7d. jona famely well. home. son dagt lambart mr ballard robd ye woods compas papers men disguise. 13 6 clear. done house work. mrss livermores home. home. mrss livermores source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 14-18, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 14 18, 1795 14 7 clear pleast. home, workt house. mr greely night oxen. paid self oxen, cash 9/, brot 1 galn molases 1 lb coffee. home. paid sarah neall work shee done 15 d x. birth theops hamlins 2nt son 4th child. xx. clear, cold morn pleast day. calld see mrs hamlin, arivd 6h morn. shee safe deld 9 fine son wd 10 lb 1/4. shee ill spell insensable delivery, revivd seems comfortable. went meeting nn. calld see dagt pollard, find complaining ye head aick. mr ballard men returnd surveying, assaulted sleep last thursday night, wilderness, men knew robd papers instruments. demanded muskit presented breast. may ever praise god goodness preserving assistants hurt person. mr hamlins. birth 43. receivd 12/ reward. mr ballard returnd surveying, robd compas papirs. 600th birth attinded since came eastern clime. 16 2 clear pleasant. mr greely brot two shillings worth tea owed boarding last weak. went see mrs dingley, shee child unwell coald. mr jonah crosby dind mr ballard esqr coneys fort. mr dingleys. informd joseph webber varsalboro drowned. 17 3 clear pleasant. mr ballard went ye fort. fixing meat pies, sally cleaning house. home. 18 4 clear pleasant. calld see mrss hamlin ill turn. shee attended feavor delarious. sett night. shee rest ye latter part. mr hamlins, wife sick. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 19-22, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 19 22, 1795 19 5 clear, warm pleasant. came mr hamlins, shee seems comfortable. dagt pollard childn, son dagt lambart, mr gill wife harnon, barton, cyrus, derius, ephm, sally cocks sarah neall dind mr ballard self. day observd public thanksgiving. phillip bullin mr jones brot news yt unruly gang burnt 2 barns, 59 tons hay, one hors, two swine whict property mr jones, father young gentleman. may detected brot justice real wish. mr hamlins, son pollards. mr jones informd us horrid crime commited father riotus gang. 20 6 clear pleast. mr ballard surveying colo duttun. young mr jones dind calld see david pollards youngist child. gave senna, manna seeds. went see mrss hamlin, find much comfortable. cyrus carried rhoda home. informd mr poore robd rufans robbed mr ballard. david pollards mr hamlins, wife better. 21 7 clear pleasant. son pollard came wife infant went home cyrus went take hors home. reckoned sally cocks paid owd shee went dads. mrs dingly took tea mr ballard went ye fort. stranger sleep. home. mrss dingly dagt pollard went home. 22 d cloudy foren. calld see mary densmore, find exercised great pain. administred clister returnd home. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. lodgd stranger. began snow noon. sarah came mr densmores. mary well shee late. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 23-27, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 23 27, 1795 23 2 clear cold. son jona brot wife infant see us, returnd home evng. done hous work bakt. mr gill says wife well could wisht. receivd letter day doct waters. home. son jona, wife dagt receivd letter fm doct waters. 24 3 clear. mr ballard surveying esqr hayward. calld see mary densmore, find less exercisd pain shee sunday. ephm workt foren ye oxen. mrs cumings breud came home cut pumpkins drie. mr densmores. 25 4 clear except light shower. done house work scowerd 35 skeins woolen warp. mr ballard surveying esqr hayward. derias workt forn, went ye hook aftern. home. much fatagud work. 26 5 clear cool. house work nursing cow, bag amazeingly sweld. derias went mr ballard ephm got wood home. cyrus cleand wheat went fort. sarah went watch mary densmore. doct williams came shee returnd, sarah densmore 11h evn. picking wool till womans work never done ye song says, happy shee whos strength holds end ye rais. near ye middle night mr densmore calls house. sett till day. mr densmores. doct williams see dagt mary. 27 6 clear pleasant. doct cony came, williams examined consulted mary densmors case. result help expected phisitions. came home noon, calld sun sett mr bullin go see wife timothy page, find unwell arivd. mrs bullin, adkins white mrss cocks. severe turn cramp limbs ye night. auther mercies heard petition grantd relief. ladies used great kindness. ditoes timothy pages. cramp ys night mr pages. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 15-19, 1795 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 15 19, 1795 15 3 x. birth jery dumers dagt. xx. clear cool. calld jeremy dumers see wife 10h morn. shee deld 6h evn dagt. tarried night, sett patient. shee cleverly. sarah neall went ys morn. paid 3/ cash. shee done 4 weaks work since setled jery dumers. birth 46th. receivd 12/ service. 16 4 clear cool. returnd home 9h morn, left patient cleverly. feel fatagud, took little sleep feel better. ironed fine linning aftern. mr dumers. 17 5 clear cool. mr ballard p. bullin surveying mr woodward. cyrus drest flax. made 11 dozn candles wound 8 skeins hoes yarn balls doubeling. home. thee ice stopt ye river house. 18 6 clear cool. mr gow morn. desired go see wife, shee unwell. went aftern, find better. calld see mrs gillman, find unwell; capt molloys, absent, wife well; roland smiths, well; mrs dumer cleverly. find sarah neall came home. mr gows neigrs ye hook. elisha bisbe expired ys night. 19 7 clear cold. combd 6_ lb flax. paid elisa taylor 6/ work shee done dismist shee went away 2h pm. day aneversary marriage 41 years since. determind pay girls ill manners. home. elisabath taylor paid desmist. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, december 20 26, 1795 20 d x. birth mr gows dagt. xx. clear pleasant. mr ballard, cyrus bullin went meeting, informd ye remains elisha bisbe interd. calld 6h evn see mrs gow. shee deld 8 dagt, second child. returnd home 15m morn 22, receivd 7/6. mr gows. birth 47th. elisha bisbesfuneral. 21 2 clear. done house work, calld see wife roland smith 8h evn. roland smiths. 22 3 x. birth roland smiths son. xx. clear. mrs smith deld son, second child, 1h m. tarried till morn, left patient cleverly returnd home. receivd 18/ reward. house work. mr ballard surveying hook. mr savage came shod oxen. mrs page ditoes. birth 48th. 23 4 clear day, snowd evn. mr ballard gone sidney survey. hains learned sleeps brot letters doct barton bror collins. sett go wm blanchards 11h evn, one fall ye way. wm blanchards. mr hains learned sleeps brot letters oxford. 24 5 clear. blanchards, mother feel much falagud. dittoes. 25 6 clear. mr blanchards, feel much comfortable, wife allso weller. ditoes. 26 7 x. birth wm blanchards dagt. xx. cloudy snowd day. mrs blanchard women calld deld 11h evn dagt, first born. shee ill. calld see joseph browns wife immediately put mrs blanchard bed. wrode hors back saddle accompanied mr atkins browns son. ditoes jos browns. birth 49th. receivd 8/1 service mr blanchards. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Index to Martha Ballard's Diary for 1795
Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-5, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 5, 1796 1 6 clear pleasant. washt washt kitchin, calld 9h evn see wife capt moses springer well shee could wish. husband gone, trip boston. tarried night, slept 1 o clock. capt moses springers. mr swetlands child expird. 2 7 cloudy. capt springers ys day, lady comfortable. began knitt pair socks. ditoes. 3 d x. birth eliab shaws son, dead born. xx. rainy aftern. returnd capt springers, left house. shee made present 1/2 lb souchang tea. came home 11h. bakt cleand hous matters, calld 7h evn see wife eliab shaw ill arivd, deld 9 dead son. appeard dead time, skin came mother comfortable expected. ditoes eliab shaws. birth 1st ye year. recd 6/ dickmn snuffon shaws acount. 4 2 clear remarkble pleasant. returnd home early morn, calld mr kimballs see sick child, rash canker. took breakfast son pollards, well. calld mr lambarts, well mr densmores, polly comfortable saw last, tho feeble yet. ditoes neigrs. 5 3 clear pleasant. mr ballard bullin surveying mr bridg. cyrus went winthrop, carried 21 yd s wool cloath mr allen, dress mens cloaths. done house work washt ye west room. sally cocks informs sister pages infant sick. home. sally cocks source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 6-11, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 6 11, 1796 6 4 cloudy. washing. son jona dind mr livermore, wife cousin mrss holdman took tea. feel fatagud ys evn. laid washing aside company came finisht went away, except rinsing. home, compy. 7 5 snowd. calld early mr gills, find wife unwell. house work, feel unwell, pain head. calld esqr brookss lady evng. shee tarried night. mr gills. 8 6 clear except squalls snow, cold evn. mr gill brot sally cocks, came home; feel much fattagud. ditoes. sally cocks came 9 7 x. birth mr gills son. xx. clear cold. calld 3h ys morn see mrs gill shee safe deld 5 son first child mr gill), comfortable. mr gill bestowd 12/ reward service, returnd home. brot harnon barton us. calld mr pollards lambarts, well. finisht washing work. mrs dingly sent home shirt shee made mr ballard. ditoes. birth 2nt. receivd 12/ 3 lb sugar. 10 d clear cold. cyrus went meeting. harnon barton went mr pollards, came cyrus returnd meeting. felt unwell. mr burtun sent could go, youngest child burnt. phillip bullin returnd home. well could wish. 11 2 clear. cyrus bullin gone ye meddow. mr densmore brot hs dagt mary door sleigh, come hannah goodin fanny cocks, nancy hilton sally smith home. mary densmore wrode sleigh. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 12-17, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 12 17, 1796 12 3 clear pleasant. mr finny giting wood 1/2 ye day. ezra town went see unkle aunt gill. laban princes wife child sleep mr ballard returnd surveying m. tabors. done house work, feel fatagud. home. 13 4 clear. home. bulah sleeps washt paid 1/6 service. mr town sleeps home. mr town 14 5 snowd. calld 7h evn see mrs mathews labour. tarried night, slept none. wm mathews. 15 6 x. birth wm mathewss dagt. xx. cloudy. mr mathews, wife deld 6h morn fine dagt severe illness, first child. receivd 9/, made prest 1/6 infant. returnd home find house arms, long god preserv strength perform done late, knows. may trust times, good hee fullfill promis according day. may giv strength may conduct accordingly. ditoes. birth 4th. 612th birth attended since ye year 1777. first assisted wife petton warrin july 1778. 16 7 cloudy, snowd done house work ironed cloaths. mr ballard coart. home. 17 d clear day, snowd night. mr densmr, wife dagt mary, son dagt lambt, ephm phillip dind roast chickins. meeting. calld 6h evn mr peter clearks see wife wilm moore labour. mr eads came shee would dismis sleep. mr peter clearks. death jimy pagess infant. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 18-24, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 18 24, 1796 18 2 x. birth stephen hinklys son. x. birth wilm moores son. xx. clear pleasant. calld mrs moore steven hinkleys wife 10h morn, shee deld 11 son. part drest infant calld return mrs moore, find unwell. shee deld 4h 30m son. childn first born momys. returnd home 8h evng. bror ebenzr moore sleeps made bids, washt dishes, swept house got supper. feel fatagud. mr clearks stepn hinkleys. births 5th 6th. receivd wm moore 7/10_ reward. 19 3 clear cold. mr ballard coart. home, feel well could wish, done work house washt floores. sally cocks going attend interment sister pages infant. mrs eads deld dead inft yesterdy. home. funeral jimy pages infant son. 20 4 cloudy morn, snowd aflen. mr ballard gone ye fort coart. home. phillip went home. home. 21 5 clear cold aftern, snowd foren. mr ballard went hook. cyrus went brot patty easty shee brot rhoda home, done hous work mended hoes. home. 22 6 clear cold. home. son dagt town came famely well. home. 23 7 clear cold. sons pollard lambart wives, son ephrm, son town dagt dagts spent day. home. pally easty helpt work. home. childn see us. 24 d x. birth capt moses springers son. xx. clear pleast. feel unwell, calld directly aft breakfast see wife capt moses springer labour, safe deld 3h 30m pm second child son. taken tea receivd 7/6 returnd home. capt moses springerss.birth 7th. receivd 7/6 reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 25-30, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 25 30, 1796 25 2 snowd. home, unwell, nesesaly doin hous work. mr ballard, son ephm mr kenadys 2 sons went meddow. went bed early sick night. home unwell. 26 3 snowd. sick, nesesaty geting breakfast mr ballard cyrus. god grant may one assist business. cyrus went hook brot nabby jewell work home. nabby jewell came work 27 4 clear cold. nabby made chicken, minc, apple pumpkin pies. bulah calld made flower bread allso. mr ballard ye hook fort. home. 28 5 clear. childn, mariage affinnity, sat table dind, god knows whether may last time. son dagt town sleept childn returnd habitations. father mercy bless prosper way directed duty. home. dear childn god bliss prayr. 29 6 clear cold. mr town went dresden. son jon came dagt town go son pollards. washt. home. 30 7 clear cold. mr chambers came corn mr ballard. calld hast 1h pm go see dagt lambart exercised severe pains. dagts town pollard made use means gave relief returnd home. mr lambarts. dagt unwell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 31-Feb. 6, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 31 february 6, 1796 31 d clear cold indead. mr ballard cyrus went meeting ye fort, nabby hook. felt unable go). shee went home mr andrews. mr town came conducted mr ballard mr dingleys spent ye evng. wife came home us sleep informd dagt lambert comfortable shee yesterday. mr dingleys, son dagt town allso. paid nabby 3/. 1 2 clear cold yet. son dagt town sett home breakfast, 9h morn. mr waid helping mr ballard git wood. home. home. son dagt town went home. 2 3 cloudy moderate. home, done house work. phillip bullin came home. 3 4 cloudy, snowd bakt. jessy bullin came carrid sally cockss chest away. cyrus went mill. calld see sist lambart, finds better. ephm ys morn, took breakfast took books go school. home. 4 5 clear. home till sun sett, calld go see mrs dickman. doct williams sett night, mrs mc master mr waid allso. patient sick indeed. mr dickmans, wife sick. 5 6 clear cold. tarried miss dickman till near night, left much found much fatagud unwell night. ditoes. 6 7 snowd. cyrus went conducted nabby jewel mr andruss. unwell, finisht makeing flanil shift self. mr ballard turn collick. cyrus hook fort aftern. home unwell. mrss dickman expired 7h evn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 7-12, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 7 12, 1796 7 d x. birth mr rices dagt 5th child. xx. clear cold. sett go meeting, went road mr timy foster met took sleigh conductd mr rices winthrop. wife deld dagt 1h 30m pm returnd home evn, conducted mr moses wood. informd mrs dickman expird last evn 7h. mr rices winthrp. birth 8th. receivd 9/ service. 8 2 clear pleast. cyrus went pittstn mill, waitd see dagt lambart. nabby washt house work. find dagt better. son lambarts evn. 9 3 clear pleast. mr ballard, self cyrus attended funeral wife mr dickman. corps brot hous worship revd mr stone delivered discorse sutable ocation, afterwards made prayer well adapted. remains conducted burying ground mr mc master intered. mr dickman, bell, polly mc master parents followed moarners. pall bearers wm pitt, j. black, capt smith, peter jones, j. child mr parker. proseeded grave, retird son lamberts, spent evng. dagt well ys day shee yesterday. attended house worship prayers interment remains mrss dickman. met 12 o clock. dagt pollard spent evn mr lambarts. 10 4 cloudy part ye day, snowd evn. nabby went hook bot pair shoes. doubled hoes yn sewed shift. home. 11 5 raind day. finisht makeing flanel shift self, mended mitts mr ballard cyrus, knitt nabby twisted 5 skeins hoes yarn 1 thread. mr ballard fixing pen sheep, one brot lamb ys day, one ye 9th inst. home. 12 6 cloudy foren, clear aftern. home. mr ballard nabby went hook hear mr wagar, methodist teacher preacht mr besseys. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 13-20, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 13 20, 1796 13 7 clear. home. mr ballard went mr stephenss. mr waid workt foren, phillip aftern ye oxen. mended pair breaches mr ballard. home. 14 d cloudy foren, snowd aftern evn. mr ballard cyrus went meeting ye fort. tarried home. ephm came meeting. home. ephm 15 2 snowd till noon. mr ballard went ye fort. home, mended mr ballards great coat self gown, sewd raggs coverled. cyrus phillip got load wood. nabby hous work spun 1 skein hoes yarn &c, &c. home. 16 3 clear. mr ballard went capt molloys, bot cloath breaches, receivd james kenny owd us. home, doubled thread sewd raggs coverled. nabby spun 1 skein hose yn 1 tow. home. capt randals son expird ys night. 17 4 clear. helpt wash, home day, knitt evng. home. 18 5 clear. went son lambarts noon, mrss capin, dagt pollard pally easty quillted coat went. son town came evn, mr capin allso. cyrus conducted wife dagt home. mr ballard cyrus attended funeral capt randals son noon. son lambarts. remains mr randal commited grave. 19 6 clear. mr [sic] dagt lambart cyrus went winthrop, pally easty wrode sleigh uncles. ephm came sister, husbands parents home. dagt lambart cyrus went winthp. 20 7 clear. day, arivd ye age 61 years, old lady lambt son luke barna, wife, mr capin wife made us visit. spent aftern agreably. home. old lady lambart source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 21-27, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 21 27, 1796 21 c clear. attended public worship aftern, absent 13 sabaths since last. seven sick detaind wether indesposition. son jona, wife, little dagt mrs hitty pierce evng, mr dingley allso, son ephm. meeting. son dagt ballard others evng. 22 2 cloudy. cyrus sett winslow. mr capin informs mr luke lambart mother gone home ys day. home. nabby washt. phillip went varsalboro hay. home. cyrus went winslow. 23 3 clear part day. home. daniel robbins winthrop brot corn benn porter. bunker ferwell home. 24 4 cloudy, wind ye southwd. men got 4 loads wood home one mr dingley. sewing raggs coverled kniting nabby spun 2 skeins hoes yarn done ye house work. cyrus returnd winstow, well son towns. home. informd mrs sewall ye hook child born dead ys night. 25 5 clear. calld 3h morn see wife shubal hinkley unwell. tarried thro ye day. shee women calld aftern illness came regular 11h evn. night. mr shubal hinkleys. 26 6 x. birth shubal hinkleys son. xx. cloudy. mrs hinkley safe deld 3h morn son, 3d son 4 child mr hinkley. returnd home breakfast, left patient cleverly. mr allin monmoth. ditoes. birth 9th. augs 14trecd one dollar. 27 7 rainy day. home, kniting hoes self. mr ballard went fort hook, cyrus fosters boots. nabby pain stomach. phillip sleeps reason ye rain. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 28-Mar. 6, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 28 march 6, 1796 28 c clear. unwell foren, attended public worship aftern. revd mr cofin brunswick performd. calld son pollards. patty returnd winthrop, informs mrs rice sick since left meeting son pollards. 29 2 clear. home. son dagt lambart sary neall ephm sleeps 5 lambs came ys day. home. 1 3 clear. home till 8h evng calld go see barsheba cowen, wrode hors back mr burtuns, sleigh. mrs burtun craigg ys aftern. found patient sick. jabis cowens. paid nabby 12/4d. 2 4 cloudy snowd aftern. tarried mr cowens night. women, part went home. barsha better mother thot fit tarrie night. ditoes day night. 3 5 snowd. returnd home cowens, left well. calld son jonas, wife, moses pollard, son lambart yr wives gone son towns; went yesterday. calld mr peter joness mr burtons. ditoes. 4 6 birth jobe springers dagt. clear. mr waid helpt us get wood. calld 8h evn see wife mr jobe springer, labour. shee deld 10h dagt, eighth child 5th dagt. left comfortable returnd home midnight. capt jobe springers. birth 10th. son jon 33 years old ys day. 5 7 clear. kniting. mr ballard fort, bot shawl gave cyrus dresing flax, phillip makeing plans. thos stickney came go see brothers wife sick, could go brot hors. home. 6 c clear pleasant. attended meeting. went son pollards noon. son jona evng. meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 7-10, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 7 10, 1796 7 2 clear cold. cyrus went conducted dagt lambart attended us hook ye stores purchast moses sewals one patern goun, 1_ yds lining, one shawl, 1_ yds ribbond, 1 oz thread, _ lb hisan tea, 6_ lb sugar, 2 cards great pins, 1 skein silk. magr filebrowns 7 lb flower, _ lb shushon tea. returnd noon calling see mrs norcros hinkley. dind went mr densmores spent remainder day. hook stores. bot roland smiths 6_ yds callico 4/ yd; 2 3/. 8 3 clear cold. mr ballard gone colo howards. mr saml norcross calld see wife well shee could wish. gave portion dgn bd lefe take necesary. doct ward jessy bullin sary neall suky kennady spent evng son ephm sleeps mr saml norcrosss. 9 4 birth capt neys son. recd 6/ sept 7, 1797. clear cold. calld 3h morn see lady capt ney deld 5 son, wd 13_ lb. measured round ye breast drest thin cloaths) 18_ inches. left infant cleverly breakfast. calld see mrs norcross, find feeble. mr ballard went ye hook, cyrus pittstn. nabby washt went see sister, phillip gone fathers. mr morses. capt neys mr norcss. birth 11th. john jonston wife sleep 10 5 cloudy. mr ballard went fort business. mr johnson, wife rufus ballard went mrs densmore mary benn porter dind went mr dingleys evng see nancy hilton, shee unwell. mr dinglys. mrs densmore [dagt] source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 11-17, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 11 17, 1796 11 6 clear. home. mr wall brot dagt hannah help polly wrode mr ballard capt seth williamss business. home. hannah wall came work. 12 7 cloudy part ye day. mr ballard turn collic pain. esq cony calld informs mrss brooks unwell. home. home. 13 b clear. attended public worship aftern, famely. mr john page evng. nabby hannah went mr phillip norcrosses, bullin meeting. 14 2 clear. deryus ballard mr ballard paid due service mr ballard went mr thwings visit, calld son lambarts pollards. mr thwings, son pollards lambarts. 15 3 snowd little ys morn. mrs gill dagts pollard lambart dind us went spent aftern evng mr dingleys. son jon wife came found came joind us, mr gill lambart allso. mr ballard went hook. mr dingleys. dagts mrs gill dind 16 4 rainy aftern evng. calld see wife mr moses sewall, shee labour tho ill. old lady dilingham calld first ye evng. patients illness increast ther calld young mrss dilingham 4h morn, mrs greely allso. mr moses sewalls. 17 5 x. birth moses sewalls 2nd son. xx. snowd. mrss sewall deld 4h 45m morn) fine son mrss greely came ye chamber. shee infant cleverly. left 9h returnd. left old lady dilingham mr sewall gave 10/6 reward. ditoes. birth 12th. receivd 10/6. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 18-22, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 18 22, 1796 18 6 clear morn, cloudy cold aftern. mr wall came dagt, dagt polly sick. home, mended cloaks doubled yarn. paid hannah wall service home. hannah wall went home, sister sick. 19 7 cloudy. mr wall came camphir dagt better. home, made 23 dozn candles. mr ballard went hook aflern, cyrus bror lambts, brot box candles, prest son lambart. dear son ephm came home home. made candles. ephm sleeps 20 b x. birth mrs welches dagt. xx. recd may 3, 1799 weaving 14 _ yds wool cloath. clear cold. mr ballard cyrus went meeting fort, nabby hook. thee remains widdow petingail interd 5h pm. calld mr garish see mrs welch labour. shee deld 7h evn dagt shee declared garish father left well could expected returnd home 10, find mr allin monmoth mrs welches. birth 13th. funeral widdow petingl. 21 2 cloudy, cold morn. mr ballard cyrus gone town meeting. paid nabby jewel 6/. sally andrus came tarried night. mended waist coat breaches mr ballard. stephen hinkly paid 7/6 attending wife jany 18. home. nabbys cousin sally andous came 22 3 x. birth james kenneys son. xx. cloudy. nabby went hook cousin. washt kitchen, calld 9h 30m evn see wife james kenny labour, deld son 11h 30m evng. left patients cleverly returnd home 3h morn. mr kenny gave 6/7 service. james kenneys. birth 14th.receivd 6/7. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 30 april 6, 1796 30 4 clear foren, cloudy aftern, snowd evng. son lambart came spends ye night us. dagt makeing gouns. cyrus went roland smiths, bot 4 yds callico 4/, 16; 1_ yds lining 1/10, 2/9. mr dingley lady took tea home. gave dagt lambart 1 yd _ calco work time. home. mr dingley, wife son dgt lambt son ephm 17 years old night 11 o clock. 31 5 beautiful clear morn. son dagt lambart went home takeing breakfast. day observed day fasting prayer thro commonwealth. home. nabby unwell. dagt lambart went home. 1 6 clear till near night. combd 8_ flax, 5_ lb tear. son jon informs mr pierce better. home. 2 7 cloudy rain. home. mr ballard phillip returnd surveying varsalborough. cyrus ye fort hook. home. 3 b clear pleasant morn. mr ballard cyrus gone meeting, phillip dadys. home. home. son ephm came see us evng. 4 2 clear. town meeting. home. men went town meeting. home. 5 3 clear. calld 11h fornn wilm chamberlains wife unwell. wilm chamberlains. 6 4 clear. ditoes, patient well. find shee inclination drink rhum. shee drank one quart, illness increast. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 7-13, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 7 13, 1796 7 5 x. birth wilm chamberlins son. xx. clear. mrs chamberlin deld 3h morn son, first child, cleverly. calld mr james catons 10, wife well. ditoes. birth 16th. receivd 6/. 8 6 cloudy. mrs caton went saml clearks nn. mr catons clearks. 9 7 cloudy, rain, haill snow. mrs caton washt unwell wards. mr simeon clearks wife son samls wife came see us. mr catons, mrss cleark 10 b snowd day. mrs caton calld women unwell night. mr catons. 11 2 cloudy. mr catons yet. wife fitt left. went river. shee wisht drink wine eat bisquit, procured shee drank eleven glasses day, eat bisquit wine evng 3 times. mr catons. finisht kniting yarn,have knit 1 pair hoes since left home. 12 3 x. birth james catons son dagt. xx. clear. mrs caton ill deld son 2h 30m pm, dagt 3h pm. tarried night, little sleep three nights. mr simeon clearks wife watcht. could sleep flees. mr catons. birth 17th 18th. receivd 12/ reward. 13 4 clear. returnd home attended john chamberlin. calld son jonas, wife unwell; peter joness son lambarts, well. find famely well return. nabby made soap since left home. found 80 flees cloaths came home, brot mr catons. ditoes others. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 14-20, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 14 20, 1796 14 5 clear morn. rose early, fine nights wrest. young man ye name ebenz coal came work 12th inst. home. receivd letter bror collins march 27, '96. 15 6 cloudy. home. cyrus went son pollards lambarts. ephm home. 16 7 cloudy day. cyrus went son jonas, wife comfortable. mr ballard doct coneys. went see mrs dingley, shee well. phillip bullin left morning breakfast. mr dingleys. 17 b clear warm. mr ballard cyrus went meeting ye fort, nabby ebenzr ye hook. tarried home, hors lame able walk. sons pollard lambart wives, pally easty son ephm meeting. dolly walkt home. home. childn see meeting. 18 2 clear pleast. mr ballard went mr bullins survey. ziba halls wife nancy fletcher dind home. home. mrs hall dind 19 3 clear warm. mr ballard went survey mr wesson, meeting bridg kenebeck river. mrs livermore mrs heartford home. mr prim took breakfast dind home. mrs livermore heartford 20 4 clear warm. ebenz went mr james pages drove cow calf mr ballard bot page. mr ballard gone run line ye east side ye river mile back. home. old mrs kenny home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 21-25, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 21 25, 1796 21 5 clear. mr ballard surveying. son lambart butcherd swine us. mrs pages mrs cumings calld home. 22 6 clear. mr ballard mended plough. home, planted seven hills cucumbers sett current sprouts. pain head evng. ebenzr makeing beds gardin. nabby went see mary densmore, finds unwell mr dingleys, wife unwell. home. made sausages. 23 7 clear. well could wish. mr ballard surveying esqr haywood. cyrus gone winthrop. ebenz sett fire brush gully, run fence burnt lengths. went see mary densmore, find comfortable shee yesterday. mr densmores. cyrus brot cloath winthp, 14 yds dresing. cost 1 dolr 96 cents. 24 b clear pleasan t alltho great frost morn. mr ballard clear. mr ballard, cyrus ebenz went meeting fort, mr prim also. nabby hook. phillip bullin came noon, went fort aftern, returnd supt, mr capin allso. attended meeting aftern. hors fell returning, threw doleful gully. mr ballard cleard hors much hurt. mr allin evng spent nabby. meeting. mr capin phillip bullin mr allin meeting. 25 2 clear, frost morn. mr ballard went varsalboro survey. home. capt abm pages wife gardin seeds. shee brot flower. cyrus finisht dresing flax. 62 lb ye whole. mr prim paid 6/4_ cash chees mr burtun, wt 10, board [one] weak. home. capt abm pages wife mr ballard went varsalboro. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 26-30, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 26 30, 1796 26 3 clear, nabby washt went hook. houswork foren, workt gardin aftern. cyrus ebenz ploughd, ebn sowd parsnips. mrs heartford evn, brot 5 skeins lining yarn mrs livermore spun. sent 1/6 shee 1 lb lard /10. home. cleand [garden] roots currants sett 27 4 x. birth benn browns dagt. xx. clear. calld day break see mr benn browns wife. walkt ferry, wrode arivd 6 h morn. patients illness came severe 9. shee deld 12 fine dagt. illness severe shee faint shee put bed, revivd seemd comfortable could expected. left 3h pm walkt ferry, son pollards hors wride home. mr brown gave 7/6 reward. calld mr james cowens; mr pierces, find better wido savages, shee unwell. crost ferry, old mr pollards. mr benn browns. birth 19th. receivd 7/6. 28 5 cloudy rain. men ploughd part day. cyrus went home son pollards hors. ebenz cleand store swept workt door yard, feel fatagud. home. 29 6 x. birth thos kennys dagt. xx. rainy. calld aftern go ephn cowens. prepared go thoms kenny came, exprest wish go see wife. mr cowen consented. went, find ill. shee deld dagt sun sett. left comfortable went cowens evn, find sick. lost shoes. thos kenneys. birth 20th. ephm cowens allso, lost shoes fell hors. 30 7 rainy. mr cowens. went early seek shoes, found informs mrs kenny cleverly. mrs cowen sick. tarried night. ephm cowens. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 1-5, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 1 5, 1796 1 b clear cool. came mr cowens meeting, sacrament ye lords super administred. first time revd mr stone since ordaind pastor church christ parrish. 18 members partake. god grant others may made sensible duty embrace privaledg. meeting. came mr cowens. sacrament lords supper administred. 2 2 clear. home. mrs livermore brot soap home borrowed. home. nabby unwell. mrs livermore 3 3 clear. nabby well shee washt. mended cloaths mr ballard, went son jonas. ephm morn sause eggs. cyrus ebenz ploughing north part ye field door yard. mrs mc master, dagt bell mrs hardford calld unwell evn, calld 11 o clok petr clearks junr, wife ill. peter clearks. 4 4 x. birth peter cleark junrs second sone. xx. foggy morn. mrs cleark deld son 3h morn. left inft cleverly returnd home 5. old lady cony calld going hook. mr ballard, ebenz nabby went exhibition. feel well could wish. peter clearks. birth 21st.receivd 9/ reward. 5 5 clear windy. mr ballard p. bullin sett survey selters lotts bangor penobskot river. work house &c. churnd 2_ lb butter. mr prim took tea home. mr ballard bullin sett bangor survey setlers lotts. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 6-10, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 6 10, 1796 6 6 clear. workt door yard clearing chips. old mrs whealer came shee tarries night. cyrus went mr benn fairbankss, bot 1_ bsl wheat sow, paid 15/ home. mrs whelor day night. 7 7 cloudy ye day. cyrus went pitts tn. mrs whealor went workt gardin door yd, removd gardin roots. ebenz made fence entervail. calld magr stickney go capt littlefields, lady unwell. women calld, ys night. capt lilllefields. mrs whealor went raind night. 8 b x. birth capt littlefields son. xx. rainy. mrs littlefield unwell, illness increast women calld 10h evn. shee safe deld 11 3/4 fine son cleverly. tarried thro night. ditoes. birth 22nt. 9 2 rainy morn. left patients cleverly returnd home 9h m. ebenz went training capt smiths. cyrus went mill &c, &c. sett seed beets carrots door yard. laid took sleep aftern. nabby went see mary densmore, finds poorly. ebenz returnd evn mallancoly news peter jones drowned. may god grant supporting mercie afflicted widdow, connections, enable us make wise improvmint. ditoes. informd evng peter jones drownd aftern mill stream. 10 3 rainy. cyrus went brothers, informs return mr peter jones taken water. determind go see distrest widdow, calld see wife ephm cowen, unwill. ephm cowens, wife unwell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 24-29, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 24 29, 1796 24 3 clear. planting seeds, cape horn pumpkinss squast w. meeln. nabby washing house, scouring puter cleaning bed steads. removd bedroom. sally cocks went dads. home. sally cocks went 25 4 cleare. childn dwell town except ephm, mr mrs dingly mrs alice livermr. planted beens ye door yard. nabby went visit friends. home. childn 26 5 clear. without help ys day, done house work washt raggs scourd yarn, doubled tow yn bed tick warp. men planted corn entervail new ground. home. nabby gone. 27 6 rainy day. nabby returnd noon. calld see wife josiah norcross 6h pm, find unwell. tarried ys night, slept josiah norcross. 28 7 x. birth josiah norcross dagt. xx. rainy foren. mr norcross, wife deld 3h pm dagt. receivd 8/1_ returnd home sunsett. nabby jewel left house business middle day bound monmoth, accompanied mr allin. paid 1/1_ shee past mr norcross. mr norcross. birth 24th. nabby jewel left 29 b clear. cyrus ebenz went meeting. mr calf performd. went see mrs dingly aflern, shee unwell comfortable. informd house revd mr mc lain consumd fire 23 inst, daughter lost life mr dingleys, wife well shee could wish. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 30-Jun. 4, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 30 june 4, 1796 30 2 rainy. calld bed morn go see mrs waid collic. gave red peppers, steept, shee got ease soon able sitt work aftern. mr wade conducted home evn, let salmon fish, wt 21 lb. mr waids, wife collic. 31 3 clear. cyrus went see lucy shaw work shee engagd cannot come. worn fatague sick. capt littlefield sent sons two piggs 4 weaks old last thursday. ebenz finisht planting made yard put cows home. receivd 2 piggs capt littlefield. 1 4 clear. cyrus ebenz made pin sheep. son town informs wife well usual. dear child, wish see makeing soap, informd ys evn old mr smith ye fort expird ys aftern. may hear call prepared follow may god enable surviveing connections make wise improvment visitation. home. death old mr smith. 2 5 clear. home. patty easty washt paid 2/. house work wed gardin. feel well could wish. home. 3 6 clear. attended funeral old mr smith aflern. calld son lambarts went, dagt went dagt pollard went allso. son cyrus attended. house capt ezra smith. remains father interd. 4 7 birth joseph youngs son. clear. house work. calf butcherd mr lambart. cleand ye head feet bakt. mrs savage came see calld see ye wife joseph young 6h evn. shee deld 10, infant expird 11, son. joseph youngs. birth 25th. ye child expired hour old. 5th source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 5-8, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 5 8, 1796 5 b x. birth isaac carters dagt. [first born] xx. birth john stratins son, first born. xx. cloudy part day. came home mr youngs 7h morn, got breakfast part work, calld see mrs carter. shee deld dagt 11h 30m, expird hour ye birth. old lady hamlin come oxford, shee brot m letter may 11th doct barton. calld 3h pm mrs carter mrs straton. shee deld 4h 30m son likely liv. came home evn feel much fatagud, oblidged sett cook orful veal. ditoes, mr carters gillmans. birthsx 26th 27th. x receivd letter doctbarton may 11, 96 mrs hamlin come residein place time. 6 2 clear. feel unwell. mrs cocks two little boys dind. son town mrs ficky took tea cyrus began shear sheep. mrss cocks gone colo norths. mrs cocks 7 bushl potatoes home. capt cockss lady son town allso. 7 3 x. birth elisha noless dagt. xx. clear. son town left early, going coart. done work, sett 3h pm see dagt lambart, met mr noles disered go see brother elishas wife labour. arivd 6 shee deld dagt, third child, 9h evn. tarried till morn. elisha noless. birth 28th. april 27, 1798 receivd 3_ yds cottne cloath @3/. 8 4 cloudy. left patient breakfast, arivd son lambarts 11. mrs capin dind came home. work, feel fatagud. dagt lambart cookt loin veal dind. son jona dind ditoes, ebn son lambarts. mrs capin source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 9-14, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 9 14, 1796 9 5 rain. home, done work gardin showers. home. mrs cocks sleeps 10 6 rainy. home. cleard aftern mrs cocks went home ward bound. washing aftern. home. mrs cocks left 11 7 x. birth daniel fosters dagt. xx. rainy. bakt. son lambart calld see wife afflicted tooth aik. calld 3h pm see wife daniel fosterss. labour, deld fine dagt, third child, 8h pm. left cleverly returnd son lambarts 11h evn. find dagt tooth extracted doct colman shee easy. tarried night, slept dagt. son lambarts. dagt unwell, wentfrom daniel fosters. birth 29th. receivd6/ reward. augst 24 recd 3/. 12 b rainy. returnd home, son ephm acompanied cyrus ebenz went meeting ye fort. bakt puding, pork beens dinner. son town came coart, negro man commited gaol weak attempting murder mr saml gooding drisden. son lambarts. son town came 13 2 clear. done washing. son town spent day hook business capt molloy, sleeps ys night. home. son town sleeps 14 3 clear part day. mr town went hook, returnd noon, sett home. cyrus went varsalboro seek help suckseed. done work ye house wed gardin sett french turnips. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 15-19, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 15 19, 1796 15 4 birth abial heringtons 3d dagt. clear. workt hard till six pm whin calld hast go see wife abiah herinton labour, deld 7h 30m help mrs smith. found infant dagt cleverly arival. tarried night, 22 number slept roof ys night. mr braleys. birth 30th. 16 5 clear morn, rain aftern. returnd mr braleys. calld see wido jones, shee well; mr john joness, ruthe lee unwell. calld see mrs rice, shee unwell. dind son pollards. calld lambarts. came home, skimd milk calld directly see mrs rice labour, women calld shee unnatural travel. mr bralys friends. 17 6 x. birth john rices dagt. xx. rainy morn. mrs rice deld 9h 30m, mrs rice dild fine dagt, third child. returnd home 2, mr lambart butchered swine us. sett late work necessary feel much fatagud. mr rices. birth 31st. fee receivd. 18 7 clear warm. son lambart came cutt pork salted feel unwell worried thro work. mrssmc master dagt bell calld cyrus saml cony 1 galn molases 1/2 galn w. rhum, price 9/. mr gills acount. home. mrs mc masters bell 19 b clear. son dagt lambart, eph, jessy bullin sally cocks dind well could wish. dind roast spairib. home. childn, jona evn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 20-27, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 20 27, 1796 20 2 clear. home, feel unwell work son jon evn, informs rhuth lee thought near close life, mrss [kimble] expired last evn hous ziba petingail. shee mother wife; came visit child lived 4 hours shee arivd. home. son jona evn. 21 3 clear warm. home, unwell yet. mrs dingly aftern, seems cleverly see kind. home. 22 4 clear. wed beens, cleand seller done house work, feel unable. cyrus ebenz finisht weading corn. hear mrs lee yet living. home. 23 5 x. birth mr rolandss son 4th child. xx. cloudy. calld 1h morn see wife mr rollands south parrish. shee labour safe deld fine son 6h 30m, returnd home 1h pm. left patients cleverly. receivd reward 9/. cyrus ebenz brot poles beens sett cyrus went mill. mr rolandss. birth 32nd. receivd 9/. 24 6 clear. home, feel little comfortable able perform home. receivd letter mr ballard 20th inst. 25 7 clear. home, unwell day. washt west room aftern. home. 26 b clear warm. home day, ill turn evn. mrs ficky eat dinner. home. feel unwell. 27 2 clear, cooler air. sally cocks came washt drest 6 lb butter, unwell. sally ironed cloaths washt bed rooms kitchen. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 28-Jul. 3, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 28 july 3, 1796 28 3 cloudy. much weller. sett beets workt gardin till aftern mr burtun, wife, mother little james came spint remainder ye aftern home, company. feel much better day. 29 4 cloudy part ye day, showers. sett muskmellon plants done hous work. mrs heartford calld betsy andrews came noon work home. 30 5 clear except light showers. dagts jonas wife see comfortable home. dagts sally cocks 1 6 clear. calld see mrs dingly morn, find unwell. throat soar shee pukt blood. sent honey. attended lecter noon. see david pollards child, sick. dagt pollards infant unwell. dagt lambt informd ruth lee expird morn 10h. mr dingleys meeting. revd mr farrer performd. mr gillit made first prayer. death mrs lee. 2 7 clear. well could wish day. men cleand store. betsy helpt hous work, churnd made small chees. home. feel unwell. 3 b x. birth ephm burges son. xx. clear comfortable. calld 8h morn see wife ephm burges labour safe deld fine son 10. left cleverly. ephm burgess foren, meeting aftern mr crags. birth 33d. came home mr burgess 3h pm, walkt meeting. remains rhuth lee deposeted house worship service conducted burying ground honb daneil cony, interd. mr crage calld see little son unwell. calld see dagt lambart, shee unwell. mr crages son lambarts. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 11-15, 1796 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 23-26, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 23 26, 1796 23 7 clear. dagt lambart. shee nurs yet well expected. dagt ballard went home. watcht. debby law came washt slept son lambarts. 24 b x. birth ansel neys son. xx. clear morn, heavy thunder rain aftern. calld son lambarts 10h m ansel neys wife deld son, first born, 2h pm. heavy thunder illness left mother infant cleverly, came home, put clean linning went son lambarts. find without help except dagt pollard childn, jon lit dagt brot take milk dollys breast. ditoes ansil neys. birth 37th. receivd 9/3_ mr ney. 25 2 clear. dagt. polly butterfield came nurs eve. tarried night, mother inft expected. son lambts, nurs came evn. 26 3 clear. son lambts day. polly washt nurst dagt. mr ballard came conducted home evn. son lambart help rais house phraim mr sewall ye hook. ditoes. came home dusk, put vinesand wrote abov 19th inst. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 27-31, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 27 31, 1796 27 4 x. birth moses whites dagt. xx. clear warm. son jonas wife came houghd cabages, gatherd beens went mr moses whites wife labour, dild dagt 10h evn. tarried night. mr moses whites. birth 38th. receivd9/ reward. 28 5 clear warm. returnd home. mrs dingley came cut herbs dry, houghd french turnips, went see dagt lambart, find comfortable. dagt pollard childn mrs carter tea. mrs carter bestowd 18/3_ assisting travil june 5th. ditoes son lambarts. shubal pitts sally cocks joind marriage ys day. 29 6 clear warm. helpt house forn, dull turn middle day. esqr cony ys morn. went see mrs dingly little night. mr ballard went took tea. went board schoner. pally went son pollards, finds dagt dagt lambart comfortable. mr dingleys. pally son pollards lambarts. 30 7 cloudy rain. calld 10h morn see mrss baly labour. women calld near night. exercisd gripeing pain. mr balys north parrish. 31 b x. birth mr balys son. xx. clear warm day. mrs baly deld son second child) 2h morn. took nap sleep. sett home 5. calld son jonas, well son lambarts, cleverly. mrs cowen calld little grand sons sleep us. ditoes. birth 39th. receivd 9/ reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 1-5, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 1 5, 1796 1 2 shines showers. much exercised pain workt gardin day. hear mr livermore capt pages wife unwell. son came carried sons home. mr capin sleeps home. 2 3 clear. helpt house work foren, went son lambarts aftern. dear little infant got thrush. went mr baxters voces. calld see dagt pollard, shee childn well. returnd home, went mr beemans, find well could wisht. mr capin writing mr ballard plans. son lambarts others. 3 4 clear. collecting herbs, working gardin &c. unwell, went see mrs dingly. shee expects sett boston tomorrow. pally washt went son pottards lambarts. well usual except infant soar mouth. mr dingleys. 4 5 clear cool. mr dingley wife, others, sett boston morn. went son lambarts, find cleverly infant well could expect. revd mr stone visit, mrs hamlin, savage benjamin allso. ephm came home son lambarts. 5 6 x. birth mr judsons dagt. xx. clear. calld see mrs judsun hook 7h morn. shee deld 3h pm dagt, 3d child, daugts. left infant cleverly returnd home little sun sett. mrs pickford mr judsons. birth 40. receivd 9/as reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 6 10, 1796 6 7 clear. went son lambarts foren, dind mrs capin dagt remarkable well, dear little babe recovering soar mouth. calld see mrss burns, find unwell. applied remidies gave relief. tarried night, shee rest. son lambarts mr burnses. 7 b clear. mr burnses, wife unwell yet. calld see mrss robbins feels self unwell, seems comfortable aftern. dind took tea returnd home evn, find mrss pikford, sister nabby mrs dingleys dear little dagt mrs welch childn came tarrie ys night. mr burnses mr robbinss. mrs welch childn sleep 8 2 clear. home. patty washt. helpt house. jason pierce wife, mrs heartford pickfors nancy dingly tea. mr saml pierce sleeps revd mr stone calld us ys fornn. home. compy. mr stone foren. 9 3 clear. pally went see mother. done house work mended two shirts mr ballard. bullin compleeted plann sartifacates fitt return bulin went ebenz began pull flax. home. 10 4 clear. mr ballard surveying mr bridg. home, done house work. patty livirmore nancy dingly. ebenz puling flax. son ephm came brot 13_ lb veal son lambart. daugt cleverly. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 1-5, 1796 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 6-11, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 6 11, 1796 6 3 clear pleasant. alone except ebenz, cuting stalks. done house work put gardin seeds. home. 7 4 clear pleasant. dagt lambart came aftern, husband came evn waited home. eph returnd hors sleeps ebenz training half day. paid ebenz two dollars. home. dagt lambt ephm sleeps 8 5 clear warm. done house work ironing. mr pitts wife, son ephm polly wall sleep ebenz giting stalls barn. home. shubal pitts wife dolly wall came 9 6 x. birth robirt abbots dagt. xx. cloudy. mrss paten dind went lecter aftern, mr bowers performd. calld mr pollards son lambarts. mrss duttun wrode hors home. wrode home afterwards. mrs abbot deld 3h morn dagt. lecter, mr bowers performd. birth 43d.receivd 9/ reward. 10 7 clear. gathering seeds herbs cleand sellar. cyrus came home evn. home. 11 b clear pleast. attended public worship. ordinance ye super administred. mr robert fletcher admited full communian children baptised; first name anna; 2, mary; 3, susanna; 4, zeruah. behaved great decency, may tender minds inprest duty mature. mr mrss dingly returnd boston. went found gone mr livermors, returnd without seeing meeting. mr robart fletcher wife taken full communion church childn baptised. son cyrus 40 years old day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 17-24, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 17 24, 1796 17 7 clear. mrss stackpole returnd mr dingleys breakfast. went spent remainder day. mr dingleys. 18 b rainy morn, clear middle day, showers aftern. polly fathers, shee informs haill capt abrm pages wife calld home. home. polly wall went dadys. 19 2 clear part day. home. dagts dind mrs town dagt pittstn, except mrs town, took tea. mrs pitts sely, son ephm, peggy wall james burtun, son jona sons, dagts childn rachell capin dinner dat pollard childn jonas sons sleep home, company. regament met shubal hinkleys. 20 3 clear. mr dingleys, dagt pollard allso. mrs dingly came dind took tea. mrss livermore two oldest dagts son alpheus tea, capt abm pages wife allso. mr dingleys foren, compy aftern. 21 4 clear pleasant. dagt pollard, childn son jon sons left dind. son cyrus attended home. gatherd beens took care fethers swept store left ebenz cole workt oxen mr child. home. dagt pollard childn went home. 22 5 cloudy, rain afternoon evn. washing. mr prin another man dind ebenz workt ye oxen mr child. home. 23 6 clear windy. ebenz workt ye oxen mr child. washing. polly went far mr carters store. calld see mr waids infant, hooping cough, ill. mr waids see infant. cyrus informd yt dagt town fell hors. 24 7 clear pleast. cyrus ebenz harvisted corn entervail. baking brewing ironing, polly wall helping home. began harvist corn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 25-30, 1796 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 1-6, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 1 6, 1796 1 7 clear. went breakfast son lambarts, seting go mr capins. assisted dress see depart, went son pollards, well except little hannah. shee better shee came home near night. cyrus ebenz housd flax. cyrus went hook, bot f browns stratns _ gln spirit 1 lb coffee, paid cash 6/. son ephm came sleep sons pollards lambts, latter went varsalboro. 2 b clear. famely, except self, attended worship day. aftern, calld see shubal pittss wife. shee faint went meeting. son ephm came supt returnd home. meeting shubal pittss. 3 2 x. birth antony brackets son. xx. clear part day, rain night. swept chambers lower rooms, done matters. pally mended quillt. calld see wife anthony bracket 9h evn, fatagud hors bad roads. shee deld son 11. tarried night, mother infant well expected. anthony bracketts. 4 3 x. birth anton y bracketts son. xx. rainy day. left patients cleverly breakfast came son jonas; heavy shower son conducted far ye meeting house met mr dingly, desird go see wife unwell. calld shee seems better. arivd home dusk, feel fatagud. ditoes son jonas mr dingleys.birth 47. receivd 9/ reward. 5 4 clear. home. collins moore wife dind mrs burgin, dagt grand dt took tea. wrote doct barton bror collins moore. home, compy. wrote friends oxford. 6 5 cloudy part day. son town informs wife able walk reason wound shee receivd 3 weaks ago ys night. becky robbins went hook aftern. 1 bushel new corn ground ys day home. son town source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 7-14, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 7 14, 1796 7 6 clear. coming flax, 6 lb _. mrs savage dagt ballard dind took tea knitt buskin aftern. home. mrs savage dagt ballard 8 7 clear. home, combd flax. son ephm sleeps home. 9 b clear pleast. cyrus girls attended fort. heman robins ebenz moore meeting. home. ephm came dind returnd home. home. robbins moore 10 2 clear. combing flax, finisht last years groth, 24 lb tear. cyrus ebenz finisht husking corn. cyrus went got 1 bushl wheat ground. informd capt tobey child lately deceast. mr child wishes go see wife unwell. bror ebenz home. 11 3 clear. went see mrss child. mrss dingley went son pollards calld mr hamlins see dady lately left oxford. friends well informs yt john wolcott cutt throat left mr childs friends. 12 4 clear. polly wall wint son pollards help young mrss hamlin came dind home day. home. 13 5 birth john chamberlins son. clear, cool morn. calld 3h morn go john chamberlins. attended saml jackson, arivd 7h. patients illness came rapidly 6h pm shee deld 7 fine son. tarried night. josiah norcross infant interd day. john chamberlins. birth 48th. mr ballard returnd [home] day. 14 6 clear warm. returnd home, find mr ballard came home yesterday blessed auther mercys, apears tolerable good health. may seulably notis favour. girls ditoes john t h keefer dind source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 15-23, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 15 23, 1796 15 7 cloudy part day. calld see grifins youngest child, seems unwell. returnd mrss austin came advice, shee well shee could wish. dagts yesterday, mrss pitts allso. sent mr ezekiel pages patty easty come shee came confist shee took property cash twice sumer past, likewise promist make restoration. matter yet setled. god grant shee may led declare truth posible, make restitution whome shee injured property. home grefins see sick child. mrss austin advice case illness. 16 b cloudy day, raind night. mr ballard young men went meeting fort, girls hook. tarried home. mr georg brown phillip bullin dind us. home, feel well usual. severe fitt ye cramp last night. mr ballard ye girls rose assistance. home. georg brown p bullin dind 17 2 clear. home, hous work, part washt baggs blanketts mr ballard brot home woods. polly wall came son pollards. home washing. 18 3 clear. home washing. becky washt mrs dingley. phillip makeing plans survey. home washing. 19 4 cloudy. washing [sic] things brot woods. dirtyer parsil cloaths never saw. home. cyrus went pittstn. 20 5 rainy. filld quills becky helpt hous work, knitt legin evn. mr ballard fort. home. 21 6 rainy part day. boild sised 30 skeins lining yarn, helpt house work. becky got blanketts 20 yards. home. 22 7 raind calld master dilingham see wife 2h morn. shee ill thro day night, case preter natural. gave three small dozes stiptick pouders gave relief. mr dilinghams. 23 b cloudy. patient delivrd 3h morn dead son, second child. shee seems comfortable considering low shee brot weakness. went meeting aftern. calld see hannahs childn, poorly. son lambt, wife ephm derias ballard thankful godfray ditoes. birth 49th. receivd 9/.son lambt dagt thee babe. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 24-31, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 24 31, 1796 24 2 x. birth mr pillsburys dagt. xx. cloudy. calld 6h morn see mrss pillsbury labour. shee safe deld 1h pm fine dagt. went doct colmans store, bot 2 oz spermaseta /4_ /9. cammomile. yd vial salts, box snuf /8. see mrss child, find better. returnd took tea, receivd 6/ came home, attended mr pittss boy. left mother infant cleverly. mr pillsburys childs. birth 50th. receivd6/ reward. ebenz [cool] left 25 3 rainy. home, prepared medisen cough knitt evng. home. 26 4 cloudy part ye day. scourd yarn quilld becky weave. shee drew piece slay morn; lining warp filld wool. daniel livermore informd mr pickfords infant expird 24 inst interd aftern. home. 27 5 clear. home, wound quills knitt mr ballards buskin. home. 28 6 clear pleasant. home, filld quills, house work knitt. mr baker keritunk dind david wall wife took tea us. home. 29 7 raind mr capin dind home, filld quills helpt hous work. patty eastey came afternoon subscribed name acknolidgment shee took quantity silver money mr ballards desk unjustly last august, promist restore phillip bullin polly wall witnes's. home. patty eastey 30 b clear. famely attended worship foren except self. cyrus came self went aftern. mr cushman performd. meeting mr dingleys. 31 2 cloudy, snowd evn. home, cleand coverled warp, mend waistcoat mr ballard knitt mr james page dind becky went ye hook. becky source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 1-7, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 1 7, 1796 1 3 clear cool. polly went dads aftn patty son jonas. home, fiting coverleds weaving. becky returnd hook evng. mr ballard survey mr james page. home. 2 4 clear part ye day. doubling yarn sewing raggs. girls went visit dagts aftern. son town sleeps home. 3 5 clear. home assisting work. becky began weav coverled; work according wish. calld dagt lambart gave instruction weav ym able perform. mr ezekiel pages wife calld home. dagt lambart 4 6 clear pleasant. mr ballard self attended lecture ye meeting house. small number calld see dagts childn cough, better yet. young man name rice sleeps becky got coverled shee patty went mr dingleys evng. lecture, mr pillsburys, son pollards lambarts. 5 7 clear. bizer benjamin mr rice workt geting wood. son jona joseph foster junr dind mr coulridg breakfasted. becky patty left 11h 30m morn homewd bound. home, puting house order. 47 yards made cloath two ragg coverleds since girls came work part spun home. becky robbins patty moore went homes. son ephm sleeps 6 b clear pleast day, rain evng. famely attended worship fort. ordinance super administred. mr ballard went mr childs intermition. calld son lambarts meeting, dear little babe cough yet, severe ever. meeting mr childs son lambarts. son ephm came sleeps 7 2 clear. mr ballard cyrus went town went meeting. mr capin calld phillip bullin sleeps mrs dingley nancy tea. thos kenny sent 6/ son cyrus. home helping house work knitting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 8-14, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 8 14, 1796 8 3 cloudy. house work kniting; home. polly makeing bed blanketts. mr ballard writeing. home. 9 4 cloudy. knitt 60 purls mr ballards legin. went mr savages hors shod, cyrus work polly ye house work. capt deans vesel went past 10h evng going fort. home. 10 5 clear pleast. done large wash day knitt 30 purls evn. mr baker sharon dind mr ballard son jonas, childn comfortable home. 11 6 clear part day. kniting washing. mr ballard went mr shepards. mr tibbits sharon mr bond cyrus went street, polly tooth aick. home. finisht kniting pair buskins mr ballard. 12 7 clear pleast. mr ballard went winthrop, brot home 3 cheeses bot mr joel white, two pots butter bot mr saml cumings. brot house last evn, purchased hook, 2 quarters lamb 28 lb cod fish. began futt stockin mr ballard afternoon. home. unwell cold. 13 b clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus attended worship, polly self colds mr lambt wife babe meeting. mrss rice sent see shee ill. mr ballard conducted gave melleot tea brot perspiration ang gave releaf returnd. calld see son pollards childn unwell. mr rices. son dagt lambarthere. 14 2 clear pleast. revd mr stone calld us dind. pally easty came restord 11/2 part money shee took us. shee allso left mustin gown secure till shee restores rest. went aftern see mrss rice find comfortable, dagt pollards childn better allso. [elijah] hinklys. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 15-21, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 15 21, 1796 15 3 x. birth elijah hinkleys dagt. xx. cloudy. mrss hinkley safe deld dagt, first born, 6h morn. left inft well could expected breakfast. receivd 9/ service 1/6 hors. went bed sleep, calld noon see mrss byerns. raind great falague geting find unwell. women got comfortable retird homes. mr hinkleys mrss burnss. birth 50th. receivd 9/ fee 1/6 hors. 16 4 clear windy. mrss byrns. shee unwell. mrss byrnss. 17 5 clear. went mrss byrnss old mr whites, patient well yet. ditoes mr whites. 18 6 cloudy snow ground ys morn. mrs byrns day. shee unwell day seems easier evn, rested better night. mrss byrnss. 19 7 cloudy. left mrss byrns well could wisht, came home attended mr graves; find famely well. calld 6h evn mr partridges see dear little child mc causland struk billit wood, life dispared find little revivd. spent night ditoes mr partridges see child mc causland almost deprivd life. 20 b hazy morn. left mr partridges, child little revivd. came home noon. mrss dingley came inquire childs welfare. went prison saw irons put mc causlands hands, aufull spectacle behold. may god grant pardoning mercy offencies giv us sutable reflections; may dear babe restord health parents make wise improvment chastisment. mr partridges. mrs dingley 21 2 cloudy. kniting, finisht self pair socks. mr ballard fort, bot tea, coffee sugar mr conys store. cyrus went mr childs, brot pair shoes, paid 7/ cash ym. mr joy moovd hook mr livermors house day. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 22-26, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 22 26, 1796 22 3 cloudy, snowd haild night. home. son town sleeps mr ballard cyrus went help raise mill fraim mr james bridg, began finisht. home. son town sleeps 23 4 haild. calld see mrss dingley 3h morn, shee excessive pain head, severe pukeing. gave decoction [cherytreoine] relievd mr bedinton dind mr dingleys. 24 5 clear pleast, cold. ice stopt river. mr abram page broke thro crost canoe. went see mrs dingley, find cleverly. mrs densmore came calld see anna partrage convulsed turns, revivd. sett till 1 o clock. ditoes mr partriges. 25 6 x. birth saml damrins dagt. xx. clear morn, cloudy day. calld 2h 15m ys morn mr partridges see wife saml damerin labour. shee safe deld dagt, first born child 10h. left mother infant cleverly arivd home 1h 30 munits. mr damrins. birth 51st. receivd 9/ reward.at mrs byrnss. 26 7 birth mrss byrnss twins, dagts. great snow fell last night ys morn. mrss byrns shee siesd illness severe noon. calld women little sun sett shee safe deld two daughters 8h evn. short space births, fine children. may god long preserv sett patients, mrs canre benn whites wife allso. cold night. calld mrs byrns yesterday. mr ballard dingley broke thro ice got river. fatagud climbing ye bank side. mr dingley graves assisted mrss byrnss. births 52 53. receivd 9/ part fees. mrs stickny gave 6/ mrss sent 3/ yet due. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 27-Dec. 2, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 27 december 2, 1796 27 b clear cold. left mrss byrns hir babes well could expected. wrode hors back colo sewals, could cross river colos night. cros t mrs byrnss colo sewalls. 28 2 river foot clear cold. crost river foot colo howards mr burtuns, came mr pollards, conducted home mr whiten sleigh. arivd home 2h pm. phillip bullin makeing plan, tarries night. calld 8h evn see mrss mory labour. colo sewalls. crost river ye ice. mr morees. 29 3 x. birth mr morys dagt. xx. clear cold. mrss mory safe deld 1h ys morn dagt, 6th child, eaqual number sex. tarried thro night, patients cleverly. 1 hours sleep, took breakfast, receivd 6/7 part fee, 2/6 remains due. arivd home 10h morn, find cyrus well could wisht. mr moress. birth 54th. receivd 6/7. due 2/5. 30 4 clear. mr waid, finny benjamin helpt git us wood. cyrus went brot dagt lambt conducted us hook. purchased mr roland smiths goods amount £2/10/4; returnd. son lambart came spent evng day informd mr moore green death bror ewd davis. hook. son dagt lambt here.i day informd ye death bror ewd davis. 1 5 clear cold. home. son jona, wife two youngest childn came dagt childn sleep young man name churchel allso, keritunck. home. son jona, wife 2 childn 2 6 clear day, cloudy evng. son jon came dind us. roast chickens. wife childn went home. home, knitt helpt hous work. home. childn went home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 3-9, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 3 9, 1796 3 7 clear part day. home, washt washt kitchen. cyrus went mill. killd 5 chickins. home. 4 b clear pleast. mr ballard went meeting unwell. cyrus bile hand. mr rice calld go see infant, unwell could mr pitts calld evng. home. 5 2 clear. went son lambarts goun made. dagt pollard childn came ruth rockwood allso. ebenz cole sleeps mr wicksone thracshing wheat us. son lambarts. 6 3 clear part day. esqr cony dind us, dagts pollard lambart childn allso. mr weeksam workt day. ebenz cole began work us, agreed tarrie one month. phillip bullin night. finisht futing pair hoes mr ballard. home. severe snow storm began evng. 7 4 snowd blowd day. mr ballard ebnz winnowd wheat 5_ bushels. began knitt self pair hoes mended pair small cloaths mr ballard. went son lambarts, find childn got home well last evng. home. 8 5 clear. sons jon ephm came assisted us butcher beef cow, wt quarters 669 lb. began work noon cleand tripe feet tried tallow; straind cool. closed evngs work 11h 30m. home. one year day since son ephm went liv son lambart. 9 6 clear. home house work. patty easty came restord 3_ dollars cash shee stole us receivd goun shee left security. mr joy workt us oxen. home paty eastey replace stolen money. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 10-16, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 10 16, 1796 10 7 clear. home, washt west room ketchen floors work house, brewed &c. mr ballard winthrop purchase wheat rie, left chandlers mill ground. home. 11 b clear cold. calld bed morn go see dagt lambart unwell, throat canker nurst shee seems comfortable returnd home evng. mr ballard, cyrus, ebenz went meeting. son lambarts, dagt unwell. 12 2 clear cold. cyrus went winthrop bring meal home. bot 19_ lb chees /9 prlb. house work, boiled neets feet tripe &c. home. 13 3 clear cold. home prepareing thanksgiving. feel much fatagud evng. home. 14 4 snowd day. makeing pies matters. mr ballard cyrus stores. home. 15 5 clear pleast season. day observd day thanksgiving great parent blesings bestowed year past. favd company children children reside town. mr gill wife sister, friends (except son dagt town, jack ballard rhoda pollard) retired home 9h evn. calld 10 see mrss graves labour. shee remaind ill thro night. self women attinded sleep. home till 10h evng. calld see mrss graves. 16 6 x. birth mr graves son. xx. clear pleast. mrss graves safe deld 8h 30m morn fine son comfortable expected. shee ill time labour. left arivd home perciscly 12, find polly wall unwell ague face. held till evn went bed slept 3 hours. receivd fee 30 inst. unwell, polly wall. mr gravess. birth 55th. childn gone varsalboro, source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 17-24, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 17 24, 1796 17 7 x. birth charls dingleys dagt. xx. clear pleasant. calld noon see mrss dingley labour deld dagt 2h pm. left infant cleverly returnd home evng, find son dagt town mr dingleys. birth 56th. fee recd [feb] 6th, 1797. 18 b clear morn, cloudy aftern. son town wife left breakfast homeward bound. conducted rhoda pollard home. jack ballard us yet. mr ballard famely attended public worship. home. son ephm dagt lambart evng. 19 2 x. birth john abbots son. xx. snowd day. washing. calld 10h 10m evn see wife john abbot labour. shee delivd 11h 30m fine son. tarried night. mrss felps dany attended us. john abbots. birth 57th. since marriage 42 years. 20 3 clear. went mr abbots mr damrins see wife well could wisht. returnd home noon. receivd 9/ mr abbot reward. son jona dind son pollard came ephms sheep. mr ballard gave rhoda pollard lamb. ditoes. 21 4 clear. calld 1h 10m morn see wife saml norcros unwell. spent day saml norcross. 22 5 x. birth saml norcroses son. xx. snowd. mr norcross, wife women calld safe deld son 9h 20m evng. watcht. feel fatagud, women could sett patient, shee feeble. ditoes. birth 58th. fee recd augst1797. 23 6 clear. made self ready come home 9h morn infant apeard unwell. tarried till 4 pm seemd revivd left mother well could expected, came home. find famely well usual. phillip bullin came home. mr ballard gone esqr coneys. ditoes. 24 7 clear cold. calld mr thwings, wife unwell house day, unwell night. mr thwings saml norcroses. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 25-31, 1796 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 25 31, 1796 25 b thwings son. xx. clear cold. mr thwing sett mrs eastman take care wife cept chamber day deld 5h pm third son. arivd 7 nurs. tarried night, patient cleverly. mr thwings. birth 59th. saml norcss inft interd. 26 2 clear cold. came home noon. receivd 9/10_ service. calld directly see mrs dingley taken cold exercised various complaints. tarried night, made use remidies gave relief. ditoes mr dingleys. receivd mr thwing 9/10_. mr waid workt 27 3 clear pleast. came mr dingleys 11h morn, left wife comfortable prepareing syrrup made sent mr dingley evn. mr dingleys. mr waid workt 28 4 clear pleasant. washt feel much fatagud, unwell. little rest night, home day. home, washt. 29 5 clear part day, snowd cyrus went pitts tn mill. sons jona lambart supt daniel livermore made present almanack son cyrus. mr ballard ebenz giting wood home. home. sons jona lambart hereat evn. 30 6 clear. mr ballard got wood foren went survey mr james bridg aftern. helpt house work kniting. home. 31 7 clear. home, finisht futing pair hoes son ephm. mr ballard collic turn. cyrus fort. son dagt lambart sett long reach visit connections. mr heartford monmoth sleeps polly mr burtuns close ye year. home. mr ballard collic. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
