Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-6, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 6, 1797 1 clear. attended public worship except polly wall. polly town came home shee left fathers famely well friday last. revd mr stone pirformd exceeding well day. meeting mr dingleys. 2 2 clear cold. mrss stackpole, granddauter nancy, dagt pollard childn dind, capt cocks lady mrss pitts took tea mr ballard surveying esqs cony bridg.i home. polly wall left diner attended abisha cowen junr, paid 3/ due home. compy polly wall left dagt pollard childn sleep 3 3 clear cold. mr ballard went mr conys store. purchased small shovel tongs, cost 9/6. esqr cony dagt pollard childn went home patty town helpt work, feel fatagud unwell. home. dagt pollard childnn left ephm evn. 4 4 clear cold. mr ballard fitt ye collic. desired mr sprague go see wife, came without hors go. done house work waited husband, feel much fatagud. home. 5 5 clear. home, washt much fatagud, went bed 11h evn. home. 6 6 clear. calld see mrss burtun 1h 20m morn, shee seemd get better. went bed 3. spent forenoon went visit mrs thwing. calld 2h pm reason polly burtuns burnt shocking maner cloaths takeing fire. shee chamber brother billy, used every measure rilief vain, shee became victim death. mr burtuns mr thwings. polly burtun burnt. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 7-11, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 7 11, 1797 7 7 clear cold. mr burtuns, dagt expired 11h 30m morn, death ocationed burnt.a distresed famely mother expecting soon sick. tarried night, mrss burtun allmost whelmed sorrow. god grant gracious aid visitalion. mr burtuns dear daughter expired. mrs cocks duttun assisted lay 8 clear cold. spent day afflicted family mr burtun, child interd public service ended. returnd home much fatagued. son dagt lambert came return fathers tarrie night. mr burtuns, child interd evn.mrs peirce expired last evng. 9 2 clear cold. calld see wife isaac hardin 12h pm, tarried night. mrss cumings briggs patient seem sick. isaac hardins. 10 3 clear. came mr hardins breakfast. left wife house. wrode sled mr briggs court house. went see mrss burtun, find well could expected. came home 1h pm, feel much fatagud. patty town tarries night. hardins mr burtuns. 11 4 clear cold. old mr luke lambart calld see us. patty town went son lambarts. phillip bullin planing home, hous work cleand rooms. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 12-18, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 12 18, 1797 12 5 birth fickys dagt. clear pleasant. piggs butchered sons jona lambart, son town assisted. calld noon see mrss ficky labour dild dagt 3h pm, wives shubal james hinkley attended. came home sun sett. mr fickys. birth 1st phillip sleeps 13 6 clear pleasant. mr ballard cyrus went court. house work, feel well could wish. phillip bullin took tea us evng. tried hoggs lard. bot 7 oz snuff paid 1 oz mr carter last friday, cost 2/3. home. 14 7 clear. calld evn see mrss burtun unwell. old mrss hamlin went bed together. mr burtuns. 15 x birth mr kimbals son. x x clear moderate. calld 6h morn mr burtuns mr kimbals see lady labour deld 4h 30m evn son. returnd mr burtuns 7, calld back 10, reason infants bleeding, made use means preventd tarried thro night. snowd. mr kimbals. birth 2 nt. receivd 9/ reward. 16 2 snowd day. came mr burtuns spent day mr kimbals burtuns. 17 3 x birth genl sewells son. xx. clear. calld mr burtuns 2h morn see lady genl sewell labour deld 11h 30m son, shee faint delvy. left comfortable 4 returnd home. calld mr burtuns, find well shee crakt spair rib came home. mr plantain sharon sleeps genl sewalls. birth 3d. receivd 9/7 18 4 clear day. home, able. mrs leach dind mr ballard writeing esqr coneys. cyrus hook corn. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 19-25, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 19 25, 1797 19 5 clear cold. mrss leach washt paid 1/6. home, house work. home. mr joys sister death]. 20 6 clear cold. home, done hous work helpt mrs leach make sausages. mr ballard went meeting patitioners. paid mrs leatch 1/6 days work. home. 21 7 clear. bakt brewed done house work. mr capin lady, son dagt lambart evn, calld mr linkorn see wife 8h evn, left company wait selves. patient women calld ill night. mr linkons. august 7 th recd fee mrss linkorn 22 x birth mr linkons dagt. x x. snowd. mrs linkon deliverd daught 4h morn, infant apeard destitute life time revived drest left mother well could expected, arived home 1h pm. polly town came home son lambarts. ephm sleeps ditoes. birth 4 th. fee recd augst 7th mrss linkon. 23 2 clear pleasant. house work, polly town helpt mr ballard brot load wood home. phillip bullin calld home. phillip 24 3 clear pleasant since cold sett home, washt bakt mince pies, feel much falagud altho polly town house work. home. 25 4 x birth isaac hardins dagt xx. clear cold. calld see wife isaac hardin 2h 30m morn. calld go see mrss gage could spard. mrss hardin deld 1h pm daugtr, 9th child. left infant cleverly arivd home sun sett. may 3d receivd cash 3/6, pickend cottne /6. isaac hardins. birth 5 th. april 2nd 1799 recd mrss hardins [spining 20 skiens cottin yarn 4/]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 26-31, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 26 31, 1797 26 5 clear pleast. childn reside town except ephm, ruth rockwood allso polly patty town, dind took tea. mr webber workt us. mr ballard drove teem. home. 11h evn. home. childn 27 6 clear moderate. polly patty town went son pollards. went see nancy dingly unwell cough. came home went see mrs burtun, find cleverly. bot mr carters two shawls 4/6 gave son towns dagts. calld dagts. allso, /9 worth gingr bread. mr dinglys fort settlement. lamb come day. 28 7 clear, except little rain thee morn, thawd day. cyrus mill pittstn, wheat, rie indian corn ground. home, house work. mr ballard fort, informs theops hamlins youngest child burnt badly. home. 29 rainy. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. ephm came evn supt us. home. mr hamlin 1 oz salv. home. 30 2 clear cool. well could wish. mr ballard mr sheppards capt seth williamss. cyrus helpt mr finny oxen get load wood. mrss leach peck potatoes. mr dingley makeing ax helve. home. 31 3 clear day, snowd evn. mr dingly brot nancy mr ballard fort, brot 10 lb cottne conys store 2/10 pr lb. house work nursing lamb. cyrus choping wood door. sons pollard lambart wives gone winslow. home. mr dingly brot nancy mr ballard bot 10 lb cottne conys store. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 1-6, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 1 6, 1797 1 4 clear part day. son jona dind cyrus went savages, chopt wood [mr] leach. done house work nurst lamb, seems likly live. home. 2 5 x birth mr john brookss dagt first born. xx. cloudy morn rain wind sun rise. calld first h morn wm brooks esqr see wife john brooks labour safe deld 3/4 hour 4 dagt, first born, mrss bond williams calld assistants, left infant cleverly arivd home 11h 30m. receivd 9/ cash pair shoes 6/-15 reward. put house order cookt dinner. mr ballard went fort cyrus hook came home. esqr brooks. birth 6 th. receivd 15/ reward. 3 6 clear. mr waid helpt mr ballard giting wood. cyrus went hook fort. done house work washt, cut meet apples pies. home. 4 7 clear. home, bakt mins pies bread. son jona came wisht go see wife, business would admit home. 5 x birth capt guilds dagt. xx. clear pleast. calld breakfast see lady capt guilds labour safe deld 10h 30m fine dagt, second child, feemales. calld see mrss abbot. find famely cleverly. mr dany conducted home. son cyrus gone brother jonas. set portland. ephm took breakfast us. capt guilds. birth 7 th. receivd 9/ rewd. 6 2 clear. home, house work knitt home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 7-12, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 7 12, 1797 7 3 clear pleast. mr waid workt us. son jona came conducted house dind. mr dingley paid 12/ service done wife famely medisin. calld sons 10 11h evn see wife timy branard. wrote rhuben. mr floid attended son jonas rhuben branard. 8 4 x birth rhuben branards son. xx. clear. mrs branard deld fine son 6h morn, left infant well could expected returnd son jonas 9h, find comfortable. conducted home aftern, long came carried see wife david pollard, seems unwell. mr branards. birth 8 th. receivd 9/. son jonas david pollards. 9 5 clear. mrs pollard, tarrie night, shee seems well could wisht. old mr pollard went conducted mother sister wife mrs black went home. mr pollards. 10 6 rainy. mr pollard brot home, work cyrus went brot polly town calld mrs pollards rainy night. ditoes. 11 7 rainy. old mrs pollard went home. mrs jones came see mrs pollard. tarried night. ditoes. 12 x birth james burtuns son. xx. cleard evn. mr pollard came sons conducted house, went meeting foren, calld intermition mrs burtun delivd 3h pm fine son cleverly. tarried night. ditoes, meeting mr burtuns. birth 9th. recd 24/ reward servics done. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 24-27, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 24 27, 1797 24 6 clear. mr ballard went dresden. son jona came go see infant well could wish. calld mr dingleys see infant, cough ill dagt ballard well could expectd. jack went home us, le faett hannah aunt hitty. son jonas. mr dingleys. 25 7 x birth ebenzr hewens dagt. xx. clear morn, snowd 11h. calld mr morril see wife mr ebnzr hewin 3h morn, shee safe deld 5 daugtr, 4th child. left infant cleverly arivd home 11h morn, mr hewin acompanied gave 9/ compensation service. ebenz hewens. birth13th. receivd 9/. 26 x birth mr finneys second dagt. xx. clear. oblidged rise 2h morn take care sally fletcher seisd puking, gave tincture red pepper, shee soon revived went rest. went bed calld 4 go see mrss finny labour deld daught 5h 30m. infant survivd one hour expird aparant distress, seemd struck mortification. put grave cloaths. tarried till aftern conducted home, left mrss finny well could expected, shee hooping cough. hors sick directly arivd mr finnys. mr finneys. birth 14th. inft expired one hour old. receivd 6/7 augst 26. 27 2 birth moses frenchs dagt. snowd. sally washt, house work foren, unwell aftern. calld 4h 40m go see wife moses french labour safe deld 8h 30m evng 4th dagt. tarried night. women mrss tilor, two mrss moors, mrss welman coy. mr wilm moore conducted patient. moses frenchs. birth 15th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 6 13, 1797 6 5 clear. sons, dagt well. mrss haill, spring stratin calld tarried night us. ditoes, dagt unwell night. 7 6 clear. mrs spring went mr fullers, calld see us aftern, mrs cragen dagt better returnd home. son jona took breakfast ditoes, dagt better. 8 7 cloudy snowd night. dagt felt self ill shee mrss cragen, haild fuller calld. severe snow storm morn. ditoes. dagt unwell women calld. 9 snowd last night day. mr town found allmost knee high conducting ladies home, seems like winter indeed. feel ankcious dagt, gods time best, may discover goodness ditoes. great snow. 10 2 cold indeed, snow lies. doleful weather watching lumber river. ditoes. 11 3 cold. sons, wife comfortable, house. ditoes. 12 4 clear. ditoes. mrs eunice stackpole came see us. dagt went bed well shee sinc came ditoes. mrs eunice stackpole 13 5 x birth son towns dagt 11th [child]. xx. clear. son town calld bed 1h 5m morn, find dagt ill, able removd bed, shee dild dagt performd labour required 1h 20m. woman arivd till performd dresing infant. eleventh child, shee comfortable ever saw ditoes. birth 20 th. unwell day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 14-17, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 14 17, 1797 14 6 snowd fore n. unwell tarried son towns. mrs eunice went dadys returnd evn. dagtr seemd comfortable. son towns. 15 7 clear pleasant. dagt ill turn morn. administrd clister relievd shee seemd willing leav sett home 9h morn. calld mr thomass capt smiths. crost ferry town 2h 30m. calld mr hamlins see youngest dagt rash, hope dangerous. informd mrss briggs deld twins sinc left dead, wife shubal pitts deld dagt day. calld see find well could expected. ditoes capt smiths, hamlins shubal pitses, birth dagt 9h morn. reacht home find famely well. 16 clear. mr town sett home. home foren. cyrus came pitts tn. augustus ballard dind. went meeting aftern, calld see two mr hamlins childn sick. son pollard unwell better. mr blacks, youngest child unwell. meeting, mr gittil performd. mr hamlins blaks. son ephm ebenz cole 17 2 clear. mr ballard went son jonas, young man came saterday night went home. cyrus went pittstn. mary washing. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 18-26, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 18 26, 1797 18 3 clear. mr dingleys mr blacks youngest child sick rash. tarried night. mr dingleys mr blacks. 19 4 cloudy rain. mrss blacks, child seems comfortable. mr pollards, mrs baxter caty m lad unwell. mr pittss, wife comfortable. son pollards, famely well except son lambarts, well mr blacks neighrs. 20 5 x birth mr atkinss son [3d] child. xx. rainy. calld 1h morn go mr atkinss wife labour deld 4h morn fine son wd 9_ lb. left inft cleverly returnd home 11h foren. receivd 12/ reward. mr atkinss. birth 21st. receivd 12/ reward. 21 6 clear. home. dresst tow yarn. old mrs kenny gardin seeds. mr ballard hoyet mr wade workt bolton place. phillip bullin brot stores. home. sally oliv fletcher 22 7 clear. mr ballard surveying danl foster foren, went son jon aftern. hoyet day. polly went conduct sally lauson ephm carried current bushes mrss lambart. home. home. sally loson came evng. 23 clear pleasant. mr ballard, cyrus hoyet attended worship fort, polly sally hook. went hear mr stone aftern. dinner cook fatagud. phillip bullin meeting. brother ebenz moore rufus ballard meeting. 24 2 clear. home. ephm workt home. 25 3 rainy. home, spoold 44 skeins lining warp. phillip sleeps home. 26 4 clear. cleand store, sally warp 45 yds drew thro harnis read. packet went past upward. mrs north dagt board. phillip sett surveying. home. packet went past day. quilld skeins. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 27-May 3, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 27 may 3, 1797 27 5 clear. mr ballard sett lott townships river penobscott. mrss page sally sett web work, broke much. went got sary neal come show mr dingly. mr ballard sett survey. 28 6 clear, south wind. number vessls went yesterday ys day. mrss child savage dind took tea rakt chips, wound quills knitt stockin. sally weaving, ephm helping plough. home. mrss child savage 29 7 rainy part day. ephm hoiet plowing butcherd veal. rackt chips wound quills done something soap. home. 30 clear pleasant. home. others famely attended worship fort. dagts pollard lambart, childn, came spent aftern son jona evng. home, [childn] 1 2 x. birth mr phelpss dagt. xx. cloudy foren, clear part ye aftern, raind evn. calld 5h morn see wife mr phelps, shee labour deld 10 fine dagt. calld see mrss guild, find famely well. mr lords. returnd home aftern, sowd lettis, peper, s grass, radish savory seeds. mr phelpss. birth 22nt.septr [11] receivd 9/ mr phelps. 2 3 rain, haill snow, air chilly. winding quills. sally spun could keep fire loome roome. home. 3 4 clear, cold morn, ground frozen. house work winding quills. sally wove 6 yds, polly workt dagt pollard. son ephm sleeps home. ephm sleeps ys night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 4-8, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 4 8, 1797 4 5 cloudy morn, clear aftern. attended worship fort. revd mr stone discoarst isaah 66 c 2nt vers. dagt lambart faint turn time service. shee attend aftern. son pollards intermision. rhoda seemd unwell. calld evng service, find better. son lambarts, shee comfortable. hannah fletcher dind mr harford allso. meeting sons pollards lambarts. 5 6 clear. home, workt door yard wound quills. made chees, sowd beets peppers. mrs savage cyphers tea. polly bakt washt. home. 6 7 rainy day. sowd pees. brother moors son, elijah, dind son town sleeps planted beens. mr higen paid 10:6 mr carters rice. hoiet went brot home. home. son town sleeps mr higens paid 10:6 part owd. 7 clear foren. wrode mr towns hors far son lambarts, walkt meeting. ordinance lords super administred. mrss jones joind church. heavy shower close divine service. son pollards hors ride home rain well. son town joseph greely meeting. mrss jones joind church day. 8 2 clear day cold season. sowd beets door yard. hannah fletcher sally polly went deacon conys spent aftern. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 9-13, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 9 13, 1797 9 3 cold day. home. hoiet cleard door yard chips. swept famely bed. polly washt, sally spun tow, house work. home. 10 4 clear, heavy frost, planted beets, parsnips oinions. removd gardin roots. washt 7 lb cottne, boild 40 skeins lining yarn. feel fatagud. son jona seeds. home. 11 5 clear warm. planted winter squash beens houghd current bushes put cloath lee. remoovd wood, cutt, door yard evng. 11h evn, famely bed 2 hours. jabish cowens wife, dagt polly sarah cowen took spin 2 lb cottne 7 lb tow. home. jabish cowins wife 12 6 clear warm. removd parsley burnit roots planted 30 hills cucumbers made visit mrss joy aftern. mrss dingley went see sary neall weaving shee came evn brot home 16 skeins lining yn took 5 lb flax spin. mr joys dingleys. 13 7 clear. planting beens mellons. paid sarah lasson /6 owd shee done allso paid polly butterfield 17s:6d owd work day. hoiet went mr blaks 1/2 galn son ephm came mrss capins hors pasture, sleeps home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 14-19, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 14 19, 1797 14 clear. attended worship afternoon. calld meeting shubal pittss, sons pollards lambarts. sally williams sleeps cyrus allso. ebenz coal meeting sons pollard lambart. 15 2 clear. put cloath whiten. mrs gill lucy town dind took tea. ruel williams sally, mr gill tea. sally spining tow, polly washt. carded cottne. home. mr gill wife lucy town 16 3 cloudy forn, raind aftern evng. planted sumer squash, crambury beens, musk mellons mandrake seed 1 hill cucumbers. hoit planted corn beens entervail. carded cottne. home. 17 4 clear. put cloath whiten watered self. girls finisht spining tow combd flax boild yarn. carded cottne. hoiet went mr devenports bot 1/2 peck corn plant planting back barn. home whitening cloath, 40 yds. 18 5 rainy. ephm came brot sashes chamber fixt old fraims. put swing shilf seller. hoiet put one store. wound doubled 18 skeins tow yarn house work. home. 19 6 clear. put cloath wet self house work, dresst 37 skeins lining yarn. girls spining coten. hoit finisht planting corn. home. finisht planting. 20 7 rainy morn. calld see wife capt saml hussey labour. found safe deld son, 4th sex. much fatagud. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 24-28, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 24 28, 1797 24 4 birth son pollards dagt. clear. calld see dagt pollard 1h morn. shee safe deld third daugt 4. shee seems well could expected. calld see wife abraham devenport, shee labour. women calld night. son pollardss. birth 24th. 25 5 x. birth abm devenports son. xx. clear. mrss devenport deld 40 muinits midnight son, first child. shee ill, case somewhat singular, got safety thro divine aid, left cleverly; ye inft allso, returnd home 8h morn. went see dagt pollard aftern, find cleverly. tarried night. shee infant slept well. mr devenports. birth 25th. fee recd.at son pollards aftern. mr ballard came home. 26 6 clear part day, showers. dagt lambart came helpt get sister shee faint. dind returnd home noon. mrss haden dingley tea. makeing syrrip dagt pollard. son pollards till aftern. mrss haden dingley 27 7 clear part day. hous work foren. philip bullin returnd surveying calld see dagt pollard aftern, find ill. made use means gave relief; tarried night. mr ballard collic ys morn, went son jonas aftern. son pollards. dagt ill. famely came house mr pollard livd. 28 rainy. tarried dagt till near night left much comfortable. old lady pollard came little night. ditoes. dagt comfortable. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 29-Jun. 2, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 29 june 2, 1797 29 2 clear day, cold. tending cloath. sally washt, bullin makeing plan survey. mr robbins business, gentleman ye name blanchard andiver allso. home. 30 3 clear. house work tending cloath. mrss haull mary buterfield allso. shee says dagt cleverly. ephm workt paid sally lauson 8/10 due service home. mrss haull 31 4 x. birth charls coxes second son. xx. clear. mr ballard went winslow referance. sally lauson went calld see wife charls cox labour, safe deld fine son 8h evng. tarried night took care patients. mr goodins. birth 26th. receivd 9/ reward. 1 5 x. birth mr martins dagt. xx. clear. calld 5 6h morn mrss cox see wife mr martin father clearks. proseeded fast could found put bed help mrss ingerham. receivd 6/ trouble returnd son pollards 11, tarried till 4 pm. find dagt well could wisht, made use remidies gave relief. purchased pair shoes john brooks, price 7/6; paid cash. feel fatagud. jona le faett ballard came see ditoes mr isaac clearks. birth 27th. receivd 6/. son ephm jonas sons sleep 2 6 clear. feel much fatagud, without help work calld see sally waid unwell. shee seemd revivd arivd. calld see dagt pollard went administred clister gave relief, returnd home sun sett work hard lott life. mr waids son pollards. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 10-12, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 10 12, 1797 10 7 clear warm. mr ballard hoiet went bolton place work. done morning work 8h went cut clover swine means, misplased bone great toe right foot. soon became lamb could walk. critical moment, son lambart came assisted get bed remaind till calld doct page assistance, rectified misplaced bone able walk room. paid doct 3/ went work. wound 16 skeins cottne yn quills. mr ballard informs son jona ill soar face. home. put bone foot. sent doct page sett could walk. 11 x. birth mr carters second child dagt. born alive. xx. clear. calld 9h morn go savage boltons isaac cowen, met mesage go mrss carter. went deld dagt alive 40 noon. went boltons, two falls hors, lambd hand brused face, wint find mrss bolton sick. conducted mrss mosier jona wemans, shee arivd soon mrss boltons request, tarried night. hand much pain thro night. mr carters. birth 28th. savage boltons; misplasd bone left hand fall fm hors. receivd 15/ reward july 5th. 12 2 clear. left mrss bolton consent care mrss mosier seemd fond tarrying. calld various places arivd [noon]. mr ballard hoit work. son jonas, got cleverly dagt pollard seems strong. polly bulerfield came last evng. esqr wesson canaan sleeps hand pains much. boltons [carters]. son jonas, pollards, lambarls, carters, colmans, mr wessons, baxters densmores. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 1-5, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 1 5, 1797 1 7 clear warm. mr ezekiel pages house took fire roof foren. weting cloath discoverd two mr dingleys, young men men board 3 boats ran assistance. extinguished fire returnd. helping work, fixing cloath whiten, weading gardin. mrss mathews little dagt lucy ney home. mr ezekiel pages house caut fire day, fortunalely saved consuming. 2 clear warm. young folks went pittstn church, mr ballard self fort. ordinanc super administred. young gentle man, stranger, performd. deld two exelint discourses. went mr hamlins intermition. calld mr eadss son pollards aftern. son dagt lambart little son meeting. meeting. 3 2 clear warm. home, tended 80 yards cloath whiten, houghd consedarable part gardin. bullin makeing plan. home whitening cloath. rain night thunder. 4 3 x. birth magr [benn] stickneys son. xx. thunder shours foren. calld 2h 30m see wife magr stickney labour safe deld 2h 7m pm third son 5th child. left infant cleverly returnd home 4. receivd 9/ reward. magr stickneys. birth 31st. receivd 9/. mr james bridg mrs hannah north united mariage covenant. 5 4 clear. houghd gardin foren went see mr carters infant. ill turn yesterday seems weak day, much pain. old mrs smith mr carters. receivd 15/ assisting wife. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

[childn] 15 7 x. birth mr eads son. xx. clear warm. killd lamb quarters waid 36 lb. mrss cyphers came brot home yarn. shee john blunt dind calld see wife mr eads, labour,and safe deld fine son hours 4 5. returnd home evn. mr eads. birth 33d. receivd 9/ reward, ye 31 inst. 16 clear warm. famely attended worship fort foren, expcept self. aftern. gentleman ye name stone performd. sons pollard lambt wives babes meeting, mrss joy dagt, polly pollard caty mc lad allso. [meeting] mr eadss, lady cleverly. 17 2 clear warm. men got hay barn aftern. mr ballard hoit jonas foren. polly buterfield washt went ziba halls work. home. polly went [fm] 18 3 clear warm. bakt done house work. thankfull stent spining helpt mr ballard hoit workt sons. [home]. 19 4 clear warm. mr ballard cyrus son jonas work. made new milk chees, changd milk mrss joy. puter 28 times full chees. thankfull spun 4 skeins warp helpt cleand sellar dirty. [home]. 20 5 clear warm. thankfull help work. cleand chambers dirty. company mrss livermore, joy dingley tea. men son jonas work. [home]. prev. page july 14 20, 1797 next page home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive browse search stories themes lens decoding transcribing diary online diary

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 21-25, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 21 25, 1797 21 6 clear warm. home till evn. revd mr stone took tea us. polly btfd evn. thankfull shubal pittss. calld milking go see mrss waid unwell, revivd. slept mr waids. 22 7 clear. left mrss waid early morn, work house. washt east chamber stairs many things, feel much falagud evng. thankfull son jon polly jakens came home ditoes. thankfull went son jonas. polly jakins came home allin lambt 1 year old. 23 clear warm. men attinded public worship. polly jakins left aftern. sela pitts meeting. feel fatagud work. made chees day. home. sela pitts 24 2 clear warm. mr ballard workt son jonas. thankfull washt washt bed rooms, kitchen store. cleand seller washt old cloaths. went mr livermores see alpheus confind broken legg, see comfortable. mr livermores. 25 3 x. [birth jessy kimbals first son 3d child.] xx. cloudy foren, fine rain aftern. calld morn day see wife jessy kimbal labour deld middle day fine son, wd 12 lb. shee seemd much fatagud labour. tarried till 6h pm whin left well could expected. receivd 9/ reward service. jessy kimbals, first son 3d child. birth 34th. recd 9/ reward. 700th birth assisted since june 1778. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 26-31, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 26 31, 1797 26 4 birth benn waids dagt. clear warm. calld see mrss waid labour 5h 30m; oblidged walk, broke one shoe heels way much fatagud. found ill deld dagt, 7th child, 6h morn. put bed mr roby calld see wife detaind day. calld see mrss cumings aftern slept genl sewalls. mr waids. birth 35th. [goods]reacht us capt hinkley. 27 5 clear warm day, rain evn. mrss dingley dagt lambt, mr lambt allso, took tea came home mr robys morn, went mr halls conductd polly buterfield home men son jonas work. mrs mr robys. mrs dingley dagt lambt 28 6 cloudy rain. home, house work. home. 29 7 x. birth theops hamlins 3d dagt. xx. clear warm. calld see mrss hamlin 4h pm, find ill. shee safe deld 5 dagt, 5th child. left inft cleverly returnd home evn. receivd 12/ riward. mr ballard cyrus went work son jonas, little sons sleep jack [unwell]. mr thelps [hamlins]. birth 36th. receivd 12/ [reward]. 30 clear, family went meeting. tarried home jonas sons, gatherd currents. ebenz coal meeting, supt us. home. [jacky] [unwell]. 31 2 xx. birth mr thomsons dagt 3d child. xx. clear. calld 2 hours morn see wife mr thompson, find labour. shee deld third child, daugt, 4h. left inft cleverly, came home foren. receivd 9/6 reward. went see mrss eads mrss hamlin, find cleverly. son cyrus sett winslow. mr [thompsons]. birth 37th. receivd 9/6. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 1-7, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 1 7, 1797 1 3 clear comfortable weather. mr ballard went son jonas, cyrus returnd winslow, well son towns. widdow davis polly jakins house work. home. 2 4 birth eliab shaws dagt. clear warm. calld day dawn see wife eliab shaw. thro day. shee deld dagt, 8th child, 9h evn. left drest child, returnd home. came far bridg bomans brook, came part ye way alone. eliab shaws. birth 38th. 3 5 clear. mr ballard cyrus went work son jonas. thankfull washt went mr thwings. man name edson dind way sandage expects see bror jona. cyrus informs old mr pierce expird day noon. may attend call, ye allso ready. home. 4 6 cloudy. mr ballard cyrus son jonas foren. husband attended interment remains brother pierce aftern. 3 sons 3 dagts, 2 sons 1 dagt afinity, 4 grand sons. mr ballard self followd moarners. calld see mrss hamlin thompson returnd, find comfortable. calld see mrss eadss infant, unwell. interment bror pierce, funeral 3h pm. 5 7 cloudy, rain evng. calld aftern see youngest child mr thwing, sweling left side neck seems feavourish. calld son pollards, well usual; son lambts, dagt gone sidney. cyrus came conducted home hors back. mr thwings see youngest child. 6 rainy. calld see mrs gill, shee unwell. tarried night. mr gills. 7 2 rainy. ditoes, returnd evn. [left patient] [find] husband unwell. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 8-14, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 8 14, 1797 8 3 clear foren. mrss davis came befor diner, shee tarried night. raind aftern. mrs cypers brot home 15 skeins lining yarn shee spun home day. home. wido davis 9 4 clear warm. mrss davis left cyrus went hook, bot 7 lb flower /6, 2 lb sugar 1/2. sons pollard lambt, wives babes, mrs baxter polly pollard rachil capin allso. home, childn 10 5 clear. house work gatherd seeds gardin. mr ballard returnd varsalboro, informd ferry mr thwing child drowned wel. could wish might prove mistake, alas provs fact. god support parents afliction better ten sons pitition. home. mr thwings second son drownd well evn. 11 6 clear. mr ballard went son jonas foren. phillip bullin came saml norcross dagt brot 12/ due home. 12 7 clear till near night raind little. cleand bed chamber skolt floor timber chamber forn. mr ballard attended funeral mr thwings child aftern. funeral [saml] thwing. 13 rainy fore part ye aftn. mr ballard, cyrus hoit went meeting. bror moore, natl lovjoy agustr ballard took tea. thankful took ride beloved tea. home. bror moore 14 2 clear. phillip bullin divide things brot boston. mrss savage mary buterfield home. home. [bullin mr ballard divided goods source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 15-20, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 15 20, 1797 [15] 3 clear. home. roasted pigg butcherd yesterday. dagt lambart dind us. mrss page dagt calld mr ballard paid dagt work shee done day. lost swine day. home. dagt lambart dind let [8 lb] chees milk. [16] 4 clear. mr ballard sett go mont vernon survey. house work. mrss dingly hepsy brown came work paid 12/ advance mony cash. home. [17] 5 clear warm. calld see mrss gill 9h morn, find unwell. shee calld women 7 evn, shee continued unwell night. young mrs brooks went home evn. mr gills, wife unwell. [18] 6 x. [birth charls gills dagt]. xx. clear. patient seemed feeble. force illness came noon shee deld 1h 30m pm first dagt 4th child. left inft well could expected 7h evn returnd home, find mr ballard unwill. applied burdoc leavs rhum warm neck sholders. son town sleeps ditoes. birth 39th. son town sleepshere. receivd 12/ cash butter jany 19 20th.1798. [19] 7 clear. house work. thankfull hepsy went help dagt lambart quillt aftern. mr ballard better. home. [20] x. [birth danl robys son]. xx. clear. attended worship, calld close ye sermon mr roby see wife, labour. shee deld soon arivd son. returnd home sun sett. son jona meeting robys. birth 40th. fee receivd march 6th, 98. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 21-26, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 21 26, 1797 21 2 cloudy morn, heavy shours thunder. mr ballard hook business. son jona dind nathan bridg calld, shour. home. [home]. 22 3 rainy day. spoold 40 skeins wolen warp. mr ballard went town. derias ballard dind, supt sleeps home. 23 4 cloudy. went help dagt lambart quillt, got bed quillt helpt finish shee went son pollards spint aftern. rhoda hannah unwell. son pollard unwell got better. thankfull warpt woolin web put loom wove 1 yd. carded spun 1 skein wool day evng. sons lambart pollard. 24 5 x. birth saml joys dagt xx 3d child. cloudy foren, clear aftern. mr ballard surveying mr cragg. cyrus pittstn. winding quills wound 19 skeins. thankful wove 8yds. helpsy washt scoured puter. hoyit cutt bushes. calld 9h evn see mrss joy labour. shee deld 10 dagt, 3d child. left cleverly returnd home 1h 30m morn. mr saml joys. birth 41st. receivd 9/ reward. 25 6 clear pleast. spoold 35 double skeins lining yarn thankfull quilld 8 single skeins woolin self. home. 26 7 clear foren, cloudy aftn. quilld 2 skeins, went see mrss joy, find comfortable. mr ballard carrid web mrs finny weav 15 fifteen knot skeins warp. mr joys. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 27-29, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 27 29, 1797 [27] rainy day till near night. mr ballard attended worship day. cyrus hoiett aftern. son ephm dind us, dind roast lamb. mr ballard went son pollards,his wife childn unwell. tarried night expected might wanted attend one greater distress. shubal pittss wife came see dagt. son pollards lambarts. dagt pollard isunwell. raind powerfully night. 28 2 x. birth mr james blacks dagt. xx. cloudy morn, shower foren. clear pleast aftern. calld 7h morn see mrss black labour. find ill. shee safe deld 8 9 find dagt, 5th child. tarried till afler dineing left infant cleverly could expected. mr black bestowed 12/ reward. thankfull got web 24_ yds. mr james blacks. birth 42nt.i recd 12/ reward. thankfull godfray went mr dingleysto board. 29 3 x. birth capt gershom coxs 2nd dagt. xx. clear pleast. calld 5h 30m morn see wife capt gershom cox labour. [foets] unnatural posetion brot proper direction shee safe deld 7h morn fine dagt, second child, sex. took breakfast 9 coming home inft appeard well could wish see tarried using means relief till nn left seemingly better without concern. left old lady cox capt gershom coxss. birth 43d. receivd 9/8_ reward. mr ballard hoit meddow. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 30-Sep. 3, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 30 september 3, 1797 30 4 cloudy morn, clear 10h m. went see mrss joy aftern, find kitchen. shee came chamber yesterday. shee informs shee made bed three days. infant finely. mr ballard meddow. mary densmore sally, cousin, evng. mr joys, [find] well. mary densmore ys evn. 31 5 clear except shower. mr ballard went meddow. home. churnd made chees. cyrus girls went gather blackburys hill. home. 1 6 clear. dagt lambart child dind mrss davenport allso. son jona, wife little son came aftern. mr delino penobscott dind, supt sleeps mr gadfray wife came evn. went mr dingleys sleep. hoit came home meddow. mr bunker farewell expird night 10h, suden. home. son dagt lambart 25 years old ys day. mr bunker farewell expired. 2 7 clear pleasant. dagt ballard went husband attended mr benn porter dind. rufas ballard patty moore sleep informd mr bunker farewell expird last evn. finisht tow shift made boddy another. home. dagt ballard went dagt lambart 25 years old ys day. 3 clear pleast. attended worship except hepsy. rufas patty left home. wife joseph stackpole admited full commumon church meeting. sacramint super administred. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 4-8, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 4 8, 1797 4 2 clear except shower foren. finisht self tow shift went see mrss dingley, find tolerable well. mr ballard son jonas. cyrus hoit cutt stalks. mr dingleys. 5 3 birth andrew goodins first x dagt prest wife xx. clear except ligt showers. calld 3h morn go see wife andrew goodin labour. arivd 4. shee safe deld 12 40m fine dagt. left inft cleverly 4h pm. mr goodin bestowd 12/ reward. find mr ballard gone dresden. hepsy washing. ebenz haild esqr sleeps ys night. mr andw goodins. birth 44th. recd 12/ reward. 6 4 clear part day, showers. mr ballard ye hook foren surveying mr isaac cleark. attended lecture aftern. association met revd mr stones lodgings. mr ballard mr theops hamlins meeting. lecture mr hamlins. rain bow thewest 9 hour ys evng. 7 5 cloudy rain aftern. mr ballard sett survey mr reubin fairfield. went hook far capt neys. receivd 6/ lady part assisting march 9th, 1796. calld number neighrs. capt neys neighbours. 8 6 cloudy part day, shours. working shift self spooling warp dagt lambart. thankful finisht weaving web, 33 yds. home, spoold warp. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 21 28, 1797 21 5 birth mrs getchels son. clear pleast. calld 4hm see mrss getchel hook labour first child, husband sea. shee deld 11h fine son. tarried till till [sic] 6 pm left inft cleverly returnd home. [mrs] gitchels. birth 45th. march [11], 1798 receivd 6/ part. 22 6 clear pleast. wound yarn thread went mr densmores house work pikt wool. mr densmrs. 23 7 clear pleast. gardin matters doublid thread. hepsy twisted 28 knots. thankfull spool web, nansy dingly took tea home. 24 clear pleasant. attended worship hallowell, hepsy allso. john rices child baptised name betsy. meeting hollowell. 25 2 clear. home gathering beens sheling mr thomas hinkleys wife hernis. thankfull warpt web bars. home. 26 3 cloudy. home. cyrus went son jonas, mr ballard men returnd surveying bodinham evng. home. mr ballard returnd. 27 4 clear pleast. mr ballard went hook survey mr vauhn, cyrus son jon gather apples. hepsy washt. work house gathering sage herbs. son jona supt home. 28 5 x. birth mr gows son. xx. clear pleast. calld 1h 40m morn see mrss gow. shee safe deld 4h 40m fine son, 3d child. left cleverly returnd 11h. mrs moore calld went see mrs dingly. mr gows. birth 46th. recd 9/ reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 29-Oct. 3, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 29 october 3, 1797 29 6 x. birth [wm stratens] dagt. xx. clear pleast. takeing care apples brot bolton farm foren, calld 1h 35m pm see wife mr wm straton hallowell labour, safe deld 2h 15m dagt, second child. returnd 7h evng. receivd 12/ reward. mr stratens. birth 47th. recd 12/as reward. cyrus brot 12 bushels apples home yeboltn place. 30 7 clear pleast last septr. fresh cucumbers gardin. home. home. 1 clear pleast. mr ballard hoit went meeting ye hook attended ye interment joshua learned lately resided farm mr charls vahun hallowell. son lambart richd foster wives, son ephm, aguslus ballard, thankfull godfray dind us, boild dish roast chickens. home. remains joshua learned, expird 29 ult, interd. calld 11 o clock see mrss densmore. 2 2 x. birth mr thos dinsmores dagt. xx. cloudy morn rain. mrss densmore safe deld 4h 30m morn 9th dagt twelvth child, cleverly. larried till 11 [haur] lefet inft well could expected. receivd 6/ reward service. mr ballard gone son jonas, cyrus pittstn, hoit carting bark feuell. mr densmores, 9th dagt 12 child. recd 6/ cash. birth 48th ys year, allsorecd beef heart. 3 3 clear pleast. mr ballard went new france. things house tending thread whiten. old lady coutch shee tarries night. home. old lady coutch came sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 4-8, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 4 8, 1797 4 4 rainy, held little towards night, mrss coutch conducted river son hoit. afterwds heavy wind ne. feel well could wisht. hepsy finisht picking wool. home. mrss coutch 5 5 clear windy cool. home, feel comfortable. mr ballard hoit workt son jonas. gentleman name stone sleeps townsend. home. 6 6 birth isaac savages ye 3d, dagt. clear morn. calld 3h m see wife isaac savage ye 3d, shee labour, deld 4 dagt, second child. returnd home 6h 30m. mr ballard hoit went jonas. old lady coutch came dind, went home. isaac savages. birth 49th. 7 7 clear morn, rain aftern. mr ballard went varsalboro. home. made mins pies. thankfull godfray sleeps shee spoold warpt bed tick. home. 20 years day since left oxford. 8 clear foren, raind night. famely, except cyrus attended worship hook. feel well go, made chees. string shell beens diner. hepsy informd naby andrews sick shuball hinkleys. hannah savage advice respecting brothers infant. shee says pases blody stools. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 18-25, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 18 25, 1797 18 4 clear pleast. dagt lambart ephm went bkfst. gathering beens door yard. hepsy washt rooms, cyrus hoit puting manure barn yd heaps. mrs tombs pittstn home. 19 5 clear pleasant. thankfull finisht weaving dagt lambarts web, 18 yds. home sheling beens. home. 20 6 clear. home, finisht sheling seed beens. thankfull came aftern spun shee went sleep mrss dingley. home. 21 7 clear pleast. thankfull workt foren. john moore came conducted fathers aftern. home cuting apples drie knit mr ballards slockin. dolly polly polly greely home. thankful godfrey went mr moores pittstn. 22 clear day, raind evng. went meeting mr stone returnd. calld son pollards, tarried little shee came son lambarts, find mr gill wife mrss kitridg came partook fine pigg good things. calld see mrss densmore came home, find well could expected. sons pollards lambarts, allin 15 monthsold ys day. 23 2 clear. home divers sorts work. hepsy washt. home. 24 3 clear till near night. scolt pickls, bakt, pared cut apples. cyrus hoit dug beets. home. home. 25 4 birth wilm whites son. rainy snow morn. calld 6 hours moses parmers see wife 7, wm whites. calld back parmers 3h pm. mrss white calld mrss hinkley deld 4 son. moses parmers wilmwhites. snowd morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 26-31, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 26 31, 1797 26 5 x. birth moses parmers son. xx. clear pleast. mrss parmer deld first child, son, hours 12 1 morn. shee ill first half night, cleverly put bed. went mr whites, find wife safe deld son cleverly. walkt capt coxes whites back mrs husseys, crost river mr bullin walkt mr shepherds parmers, wrode colt home woman never went mr dingleys came home, mr ballard allso. returnd journey aftern, health safety. parmers, whiles. capt cox charlssand gershoms, mr bullins, husseys dingleys. birth 50.mr ballard returnd, receivd 9/ mrs parmer june 28th,1798. 27 6 clear. home, knitt mr ballards stockin. went son jonas, dagt ballard gone visit sister getchel low. brother ebinz moores son, elijah, bill kelly sleep ys night. home. 28 7 rainy day. mr ballard went dresdin, cyrus son jonas. home, finisht kniting pair stockings mr ballard removd apples seller, pared cut drying. home. 29 cloudy chilly air. attended worship ye fort except hepsy. shee went mr hinkleys evng. son dagt lambart, yr little son son ephm meeting. meeting. mr stone spake st. john, 3 chap 19th vers. 30 2 clear. cyrus went winthrop cloath, 16_ yds. cost dresing 2/31. coal hoit left bound home. mr ballard paid owed ym. home. 31 3 clear. mr ballard went jonas, cyrus mr moores tend mill. hepsy washt. got 70 cabages, churnd made chees. revd mr gillit calld mr allin, cloather calld paid due dresing cloath. ezra allin left acount taxes. home, 11h evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 1-7, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 1 7, 1797 1 4 clear pleast. home. hepsy brot 70 cabages mrss dingley left childn shee went see [mrs parmer]. home. son jonas dagt came 2 5 clear. brot 40 cabages. home, knit finisht mits began foot stockins. home. hepsy spun 1 skein woolin yarn. 3 6 clear warm. son jona brot dagt mr ballard attended lecture, small number calld son pollards, find little hannah distress costivness. used means relievd calld son lambarts, find dagt seems well. removd rhue camomile gardin. little jack ballard die know better next time. lecture calld see childn. mr dingley returnd boston. 4 7 clear foren pleast season. son jon came took dinner conducted little ones home. may god bless prosper make ym ornaments day riligion, may useful members society home. son jona conducted children home. finisht kniting pair hoes self. 5 rainy, quite windy evng. mr ballard attended worship, ordinanc ye supper administred. came son lambarts intermition, dagt well. cyrus came home aftern. meeting. 6 2 rainy morn. calld 25m midnight see lady mr james child unwell thro ye day. tarried thro night. shee seemd comfortable 10h evn. mr childs, wife unwell. 7 3 cloudy morn, snowd 10h morn. mr hamlins store, left mrss child near night. find roads bad. calld son lambards, tarried night. ditoes; mr hamlins son lambarts. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 8-17, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 8 17, 1797 [8] 4 clear cool. mr ballard came son lambards conducted home noon. seeing pickels, apples matters. hepsy work wool stockins yet. son lambards. 9 5 clear. son lambarts, dagt unwell. came home evn. ditoes home. 10 6 rainy morn. calld see dagt, shee unwell, got better. went see dagt pollard. ditoes. 11 7 x. birth son lambart dagtr. xx. rainy, morn, yesterday. went mr lambarts, shee ill day, women calld evng shee safe deld 8h 45m fine dagt. second child. dagt pollard tarried night. son lambarts. birth 51st. recd 12/. 12 x. birth james childs son. xx. rainy froze. calld son lambards 3h ys morn see mrss child labour. shee safe delivird 6h 45m fine son, fifth child. left cleverly 10 returnd son lambards, tarrie night. ditoes mr childs. birth 52nt. decr 1802 recd 10/6 mr child performing ys 13 2 clear pleast. tarried dagt lambard till evn, came home, ephm mr capin sleeps patty nabby livermore evng. mr ballard sett day go view land river penobscott, man name bond, vermont state. son lambarts. dagt comfortable. 14 3 clear pleast. home till evng, calld see mrss child ill turn. took care thro night. mr childs. 15 4 cold. dagt lambart, made 20 16 5 dzn candles. ditoes son lambarts. 17 6 clear cold. home. mr dingley, wife childn mr brown tea. mr ballard returnd. betsy hinkley slept last night. robart fletcher came work 15 inst. home. mrs dingley source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 18-24, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 18 24, 1797 18 7 clear cold, ice runs river. home. mr ballard went mr bonds hook. capt williams lady put bed yesterday son, doct cony opperator. informd shee well could wisht. home. capt went [past] famely. 19 clear cold. attended worship, son dagt lambard gave infant baptism, name dorothy. brot little allin home us. cyrus came home morn, went meeting. meeting son lambarts. 20 2 clear cold. mr ballard went son jon spent day nursing allin lambard, oftne calld pah mah, cried much. home. allin lambard 21 3 clear pleast sun cool air, kenebeck bridg dedicated. mr ballard son cyrus attended. david wall, james savage asa fletcher burnt catradges takeing fire thro carelesness. mr lang pittstn sleeps home. home. allin lambt went home. 22 4 cloudy, snowd evng. calld 6h evn see wife josiah norcross labouring feemale complaints. found low, tarried night. mr ballard surveying mr ezekl page. josiah norcrss, tarried ys night. 23 5 raind. came home 2h 30m pm, left patient comfortable. mr ballard gone son jonas. ditoes. 24 6 clear cold. mr lambart butcherd pigg wd 70 wt us. mr ballard work barn son jonas. home, began shift self. home. pigg butcherd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 25-Dec. 2, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 25 december 2, 1797 25 7 clear cold. mr ballard son jon work foren, hook aftern. home, finisht shift. home. 26 x. birth mr bonds son 10 child. xx. snowd. mr ballard went meeting. 6 persons foren. calld 7h evn see mrss bond labour. shee safe deld midnight fine son, wd 11 lb _. tenth child. mrss cony cumings tarrie night. patient well could expected. mr bonds. birth 53d. receivd 12/as reward. 27 2 clear cold. tarried mrss bond till evng shee disapointed nurs. mr dingley evng. went returnd sleigh. ditoes. 28 3 clear cold. home makeing preperation thanksgiving. home. 29 4 clear cold. calld evn see mr theops hamlin unwell ten days. came home 9h 30m, sett work till midnight. mr theops hamlins, parents 30 5 clear. day observd day thanksgiving. attend worship, childn resede super us except moses pollard rather chose company. wife childn lucy shaw oblidged tarrie. home. childn supper dagts jonas wife sleep 1 6 clear. moses came famely, son lambt jona took breakfast us retired son dagt lambart varsalboro, jack le faett ballard came augustus ballard thl godfray sleep home. childn went breakfast. hepsy mr hinkley ys evng. 2 7 clear. augst thankfull went diner. home, bakt pudings pies. jack ballard seemd unwell last night cleverly day. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 14-23, 1797 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 14 23, 1797 14 5 cloudy. mr ballard went work son jonas. calld 9h evn go see wife james moore reidfield. arivd 11, find patient comfortable shee sent william morres wife tarries night. james moores. 15 6 cloudy day, snowd night. mr moores, shee unwell night, keep us sister ditoes. snow storm. 16 7 snowd part day, clear cold night. women calld attend mrss moore, shee ill till 3h mrn. ditoes. women calld 9h evn. 17 x. birth james moores second son. xx. clear cold. mrss moore safe deld 3h morn son, 8th child. shee ill, left comfortable 10 hours morn, reacht home 2 pm. old mr lambart barna, dagt son ephm evn. old gentleman sleeps ditoes. birth 54. receivd 9/ reward.hepsy 18tn years old yesterday. 18 2 clear cold. mr ballard went hook salt. home, hepsy washt. home. 19 3 clear cold. mr ballard went work son jonas, informs childn unwell. home. home. aniversary marriage 43 years. 20 4 clear cold. home. mr ballard bot piece cloath hepsy. home. 21 5 clear cold windy. mr ballard got load wood. home. [hepsy hinklys]. 22 6 clear cold. home, finisht self pair hoes. mr ballard collic. home. 23 7 clear cold. mr ballard better. calld go isaac cowens 9h evn, arivd 11. isaac cowens, sidny. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 7 17, 1798 [7] 1 clear. got patient shee able walk help, infant cleverly. son jona came conducted home. calld see mr paten, seems easier saw calld son lambarts, well usual except babe, exercisd humer neck head, mrss capin came spent evng us. mr titcombs pattins son lambts, wife, childn mrss capin spent evng 8 2 cloudy. mr ballard breaking wood. snow deep. makeing candlewicks. home. 9 3 cloudy. mr ballard sleding wood. mr dingly hilton helpt chop. made 26 _ dzn candles, last tallow came cow killd year ago. home. made 26_ dozn candles. 10 4 clear. home, washt west room. mr ballard cyrus hear coart. son town sleeps home. son town sleeps 11 5 cloudy. mr ballard cyrus court. old mr hopkins sleeps john brown allso. home. home. mr hopkins sleeps 12 6 clear. home. mr ballard cyrus coart. man name stephens came work. home. 13 7 clear. mr ballard sett go meddow, cyrus coart, young man giting wood. mr dingley informd bror joseph drownd sea. home. 14 1 cloudy. mr ballard famely, went meeting. home. hepsy hinkly. 15 2 rainy. home, helpt wash. home. 16 3 rainy. home, cut apples pies sause. mr ballard streat. home. 17 4 clear morn. bakeing pies. mr ballard streat, cyrus vinegar matters. phillip bullin supt us. home. phillip bullin sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 7-13, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 7 13, 1798 7 4 clear. returnd home seps early morn, fatagud, went bed slept. mr ballard sett survey friend fairfield. hepsy went spend ye night james hinkleys. mrss whitwell cragge left home yesterday. sieps. mr ballard went mr fairfields. 8 5 clear.i home. hepsy put bed cover fraim quilted home. 9 6 cloudy, snowd night. piecing border bed cover put cyrus went brors. finisht pair hoes ys evn mr ballard. home. 10 7 cloudy morn, snowd aftern. cyrus went settlement. mr patradg came go house, expecting imediate calls home go. infants superfluous thumb taken day doct cony. hepsy finisht bed cover. matters. home. mr patridg came go. 11 1 cloudy, misty day. fell frose came. tarried home. husband absent home. home. 12 2 snowd forn, clear aftern. sewing two shifts w finisht mr ballard came home, informs hors kickt le faett ballard head hurt much. colo duttun mr ezkl page informd capt toby sick. home. 13 3 clear pleasant. mr ballard went son jonas, son le faett comfortable expected find complains mostly swiling arm. calld son lambarts, well. began stockin mr ballard. son jonas lambts. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 14 19, 1798 14 4 cloudy, windy. mr ballard went son jon mr baleys hon danl conys. little le faett better. piecing bed cover knitt home. 15 5 raind. sewing kniting. mr ballard mr balys seek hay. jonas son better. mr soal sent 9/. home. 16 6 clear pleasant. mr ballard surveying makeing plan mr vauhn. doubling thread piecing raggs. hepsy went mr hinkleys twist thread. shee went mrs gitchels receivd 6/ part assisting child birth. home. 17 7 clear pleast. home, boxt great wheal leather spun 14 knots worsted. home. spun worsted. 18 1 clear cool air. went meeting fort. went son jonas noon, find son poorly. hepsy went ye hook evng. son jona came went home took care sick child. much distrest hours got sleep ye latter part night. meeting son jonas. 19 2 clear. came sons. doct cony see child, better. calld mrs titcombs son pollards, little sally unwell, mouth soar throat sweld dagt lambart childn came home son came evn. cyrus brothers. son jonas dagts. genl sewall calld see evn. dagt son lambart childn snowd evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 20 26, 1798 20 3 clear. mr ballard went colo norths, conducted son pollards see babe. find better. came home evn. cyrus informs le faett seems comfortable. calld son lambts, well. son pollards lambts. 21 4 clear. colo north calld mr ballard gone woolwidg. home, mended winter goun knit cyrus came jonas, le faett better. home. mr bald woolwidg. snowd night. 22 5 snowd blowd day. mended mr ballards thik sett waistcoat. home. 23 6 clear pleast. home, mend cot mr ballard. returnd woolwich. home. mr ballard came home. 24 7 cloudy. mrss pattin son inft shee went hook, informd us shee returnd mr moses sewall departed life last evn. mr ballard makeing plan, cyrus went brors. le faett better. home. 25 1 cloudy. calld 4h morn genl sewall see lady labour. shee pains gradually till insewing morn. mrss livermore went found wife thoms sewall went see mrss comings, find low state, complaint throat. genl sewalls solomn cumings. 26 2 x. birth genl henry sewalls 4th daugt. xx. clear. mrss sewall safe deld 3h ys morn fine daugt, 7th child. left cleverly returnd home 9h 30m. receivd 6/7 reward. mrss livermore tarries till went magr filebrowns nurs. mr ballard son jonas, well bad head aick aftern evn. genl sewalls. birth 8th. receivd 6/7 reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 27-31, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 27 31, 1798 27 3 x. birth [nathn] shaws 3d dagt. xx. cloudy day, snow. feel well attended hous widdow sewall husbands funeral. son jona brot two oldest sons cyrus went carrid le faett home. sons jona lambart gone conduct wm levy parmer, john freeman hinkley ebenz farewell tryal asaulting john johnson rufus ballard high road. calld 7h evn mr shaw see wife, shee safe deld 8 dagt, 5th child cleverly. tarried night. fit night mair. funeral mr moses sewall, mr shaws, hook. birth 9th. recd 7/6 reward. 28 4 clear pleast. returnd home 7h morn, left patient cleverly. mr ballard gone uper parrish business, hearing coart aftern. mr shaws. mr johnson ballard sleep 29 5 clear pleasant. mr bullin wife dind took tea us. mr ballard cyrus went coart house hear cause tried. hinkleys parmers acquited. home. mr bullin wife 30 6 clear spring like, snow waisted much. mr ballard surveyed john brooks. son ephm sleeps 19 years old night 11h. home. son ephm 19 years old ys day. 31 7 clear warm. mr ballard sett get hay returnd without pasing bad. s.j. foster setled acounts mr ballard. home. son jona supt. son jona went school went home night. home. s.j. foster informs infant 2 weaks old. receivd letters bror jon moore march 5. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 10-18, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 10 18, 1798 10 3 clear. home. ice broke away shoar evng fort. home. 11 4 cloudy. mrss densmore warp web. mrss dingley nancy river opend slopt shore. mr ballard returnd winthroy, informs bridg bomans brook moved. home. mrss densmr dingley 12 5 rainy. ice stopt us entervail covered water, shore fence carrid away. home. mr ballard went see bridges, kenebeck damaged, brook impasable. home. 13 6 clear. ice runs ye freshet high. mr ballard mending pasture fence put cattle sheep home. home. 14 7 clear part day. mr ballard son jonas. home. home. 15 g clear part day, misty turns. mr ballard cyrus attended worship augusta, hepsy hallowell. home. dagt lambard wrode meeting. home. dagt lambard 16 2 clear part day. helpt hepsy wash knit allin lambard dad went ptstn. mr ballard workt son jonas, jack came home home. 17 3 cloudy clear turns. home, finisht kniting cyrus pair hoes began pair mr ballard. son jonas. hannah mags shee informd man colour drowned hallowell yesterday. home. 18 4 clear. mr ballard cyrus town meeting. mr brown came dagt hepsy shee set 1h pm. mrss brown sick, life expected. jack ballard helpt hous work. home. hepsy went home see sick mother. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 19-27, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 19 27, 1798 19 5 clear cold. mr ballard giting wood. cyrus went pittstn tend mill mr moore. jacky gone school. find self lonesome. phillip bullin ys aftern. home. 20 6 clear. home, mr ballard sons, jack school. washt n. bedroom west room. home. 21 7 cloudy rain. home. mr ballard went ye hook lecture. 7 years since removd 22 g cloudy. mr ballard sett meeting augusta, informd mr stone unwell could perform. went hallowell meeting. son dagt lambard, childn son ephm jack well could wisht ys day. home. hear revd pastor unwell. 23 2 x. birth james kennys dagt. xx. cloudy rain. unwell calld mr james kenny 4h pm, went see wife. shee safe deld 5h 30m second dagt 4th child. left inft comfortable arivd home 10h 30m evn. mr james kenneys. birth 11th.receivd 6/ service. 24 3 clear. son town sleeps unwell calld evn go see wife thos kenny. wrode esqr smiths went water found mrs kenny unwell women thos kenneys. 25 4 clear. patient shee comfortable. women went home except sist blanchard. ditoes. 26 5 cloudy rain. tarried patient day. shee washt bakt. ditoes. 27 6 clear. returnd home 10h morn, find hous alone every thing arms, find time set till 2 pm. mr shubal hinkleys wife see elisha noles paid cloath assisting wife. ditoes morn. mrs hinkley afternoon. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 28-May 3, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 28 may 3, 1798 28 7 clear. mr ballard makeing plan went hallowell. done house work. watson diging gardin. shubal pittss wife calld home. 29 clear. home, feel unwell. cyrus came mr ballard went meeting augusta, watson hallowell. home. 30 2 clear. mr ballard went son jon watson went brot swine went mill. washt, feel much fatagud. thoms hinkleys wife widdo davis sleeps home. wido davis sleeps gardin seeds 1 3 clear warm. mr ballard watson went son jon wife two daugts see dollys childn allso. polly densmore allso. john brown informd mother departed life last fryday remains interd yesterday. may god sanctify berievment surviveing companion dear children. home. mrss davis left dagts see informd death ofmrss brown. thunder evng. 2 4 x. birth ephm burges 2nd son. xx. augst 27th 1799 receivd 3/7. cloudy cool. calld morn see wife ephm burges labour. shee deld 8h morn second son 3d child. lefe mother infant cleverly returnd home ten eleven. mr burges paid 6/ part service. brewd medisinal beere. mr ballard gone riedfield survey. jonas hired man helping plough. ephm burges. birth 12th. receivd 6/. cald evng see genl sewalls wife whos breast soar. night. 3 5 raind ys morn. went see mrss cumings, find low. came home 11h. old lady hamlin, mrss burtun doct odion took tea informd james andrews wounded knee discharg musket. genl sewalls mr cumings. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 4-10, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 4 10, 1798 4 6 clear except shower. unwell day, work mrss white hallowell aftern. home, mrss white 5 7 clear part day. men business mr ballard. got thro work great inebility. thunder rain aftern. watson sowd beets parsnips. sent dagt lambart 9 ducks eggs. home, unwell. 6 g rainy. mr ballard went meeting, ordinance ye super administred. unwell indead. cyrus came pittstn, informs mrss mc causland better. home, unwell sett little. 7 2 clear. mr ballard cyrus went town meeting. mr james chosen represent town augusta ye genl coart year. comfortable ys day, done part washing. mrss densmore livermore calld see watson work son jon cyrus sleeps henry mc causland wounded hand. home. feel self little better. mrss densmore livermore 8 3 cloudy sprinkling rain. cyrus went pittstn. mr ballard winthrop see hepsy brown wd come work trying finish washing. mrss dingley came made prest pice roas veal. ead feel refreshed. home. mrss dingly 9 4 clear. home. mr ballard watson went meeting, continentall fast. home. 10 5 clear. mr ballard son pollard went take sheep pound hallowell. old mr lambard calld see famely well. watsons brother dind polly livermore came helpt polly barbarick came work home. son town dind mrs dingley calld source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, may 11 17, 1798 11 6 x. birth thoms kenneys dagt. xx. clear. mrss baxter kniting. calld 8h 30m evng see wife thoms kenney labour safe deld 10h 30m dagt. tarried night, patient well could expected. 6th child. thoms kenneys. birth 13th. receivd9/ july 11th son cyrus. 12 7 clear. came home water, arivd 6h 30m morn. mr abrm devenport assisted conduct water home feel really fatagud tour, went bed 10h rose 2h pm, feel much refreshed. isaac hardins wife ditoes. isaac hardins wife 13 g cloudy, wind n e chilly. go meeting, rest famely mr bradford performd. mrss dingley came see daniel livermore meeting. home. 14 2 clear. washt washt bed rooms kitchen. helpt really able girl complaind feeling well. home. 15 3 clear. capt stackpole calld morn, informs yt dagt town unwell. mrss dingley childn polly washt ye west room ironed gown. home. mrss dingley 16 4 clear. home hous. mr martin, lives son jona, work yesterday. watson went work, took loom son pollards. home. 17 5 clear. calld saml cony 3h morn go assist put grave cloaths remains solmn cumings wife expired ys ["morn" implied]. mrs mc master fletcher assisted mr cumingss, wife expired 3 hours morn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 18-23, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 18 23, 1798 18 6 clear windy. home, help. polly left yesterday. paid 4/ service gave small looking glass. home, one ducks began sett. 19 7 clear. work, washt bedroom kitchen. mr ballard attended funeral wife soloman cumings. procession hous brother esqr cony, long concoars people attended. feel much fatagud. son ephm sleeps interment mrs cumings. 20 g clear warm. cyrus came men attended public worship. felt unwell day obligd work house. home, unwell. 21 2 clear warm. men planting potatoes. lucy town rachl capin allin lambard doct odihon calld us, informs dagt town low state. wish aid divine goodness resination home. 22 3 clear. unwell. eat little cold puding 23 4 cold milk twice coars ye day performd part washing. laid self bed bed room, able rise husband went bed come see lay cloaths till 5 hours morn made shift rise. got men breakfast, able eat morsil self till 3pm, finisht washing. many times nesesatated rest self bed, able say. god grant patience go thro fatagus life fortitude, looking forward happy [state]. home. mrss livermore calld shee gone hallowell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 24-29, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 24 29, 1798 24 5 clear. mr ballard went varsalboro survey mr webber. watson washt sheep set watson went work son dagt pollard jon wife jack came aftern. dagt ballard jack ephm tarried night. mrss livermore foren. sick aftern. home. mr ballard gone varsalboro. dagts pollard ballard mrss livermore allso. 25 6 cloudy, raind night. felt comfortable. son jon wife day, work. son took breakfst diner watson workt informs came home le faett scolt foot morn. jona went home raind wife childn tarry night. home. dagt ballard day night. 2nd duck began sett. 26 7 clear morn, cloudy aftern cool, clear evng. watson workt son jonas, came home night conducted dagt child home. jack tarries. well ys day dagt ballard done work. home. dagt balld went home. 7 young ducks hacht hen. 27 g clear chilly s w wind. felt able attend worship foren. wrode behind son cyrus returnd mr ballard. informd remains elijah ingerham interd day. meeting aftern. funeral mr ingerhamss son. 28 2 cloudy foren, rain aftern. fat calf killd. wd [81] lb. dagt lambard came helpt work. wido smith came tarry night. home. dagt lambard mrs smith allso. 29 3 rainy day. dagt lambd went home aftern. mrs smith tarries. mending stockins, feel feable. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 30-Jun. 4, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 30 june 4, 1798 30 4 raind day. mrs smith went home aftern. mr ballard went sidny seek girl help suckseed. watson cleand seller. done house work. home. mrs smith went home. 31 5 heavy showers. mr ballard watson went son jonas, jack went home. james sturges dind derias ballard yesterday. mr lambard informd dagt town thinks self recovery. home. 1 6 cloudy part day. done work unable. nabby smith came evng help little home. nabby smith came work. 2 7 raind. home. mr ballard colo howards mill, mr bullins hallowell. home. workt little gardin. 3 g clear part day. attended public worship fort. nabby andrews meeting. old mr pollard calld see us took tea mr pollard informd woman livs lately deld two childn, 8 weaks births. meeting. mr bond prayrs death mother. remarkable birth twins. 4 2 cloudy rain. watson workt son jon mr ballard setled saml phillip norcross took obligations due went mill afterwards, sett run south line plymoth companies tand. left home 1h pm. nabby washt. washt store floor. mr ballard saw son town informs wifeis better. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 5 11, 1798 5 3 rainy foren. home. watson went haull boards colo howards mill river. home. 6 4 clear warm. workt gardin cleand store cobwebs. mrss pattin mrs dingley calld. nabby washt bed rooms west room. watson went rafted bords, brot foren, began sett fens entervail aflern. home. 7 5 raind part day. home. mr emry penobscott came see mr ballard, tarries night. home. man [poland] see mr ballard. 8 6 rain. mr ballard returnd noone. mr emry mr georg brown sleep home. home. 9 7 clear morn. mr brown emry left mr ballard went son jon polly smith dind home. 10 g clear. attended worship aftern. calld son lambards, dagt came meeting. cyrus home. mr lambd informs yt dagt town comfortable. meeting. 11 2 clear. went see mrs pegy craig, find poorly. calld see mr thwing, find much distresst tisick. lues hamlins, well; mr carters, well rufus ballard sleeps informd bror jon famely well long since. mr craggs others. nabby mrs dinglys. heard rochester. mr bror famely well. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 12 15, 1798 12 3 x. birth rachl savages dagt. x. clear. mr ballard went son jon calld see rachel savage labour deld 6h pm dead child. left cleverly returnd home 9h evn. wido savages. birth 14, recd 6/. 13 4 clear forn, showers aftern, thunder. mr ballard survey mr briant fletcher. mr hersey poland sleeps two men name watson dind home. mr hersey sleeps 14 5 x. birth lewis hamlins dagt first child. x. clear. calld 5h 30m see wife lewis hamlin labour. safe deld 4h 20m pm dagt, wd 8 lb 2/1. left infant well could expected, sun sett, returnd home. found polly dingley polly livermore mrs dickmans sister george town interd day. wife james bridg deld morn 1h son, born dead interd ys evn. doct page operator, poor unfortunate man practice. capt zimry haywood departed life walking barn house, instantly apoplecktic fit. may teach us uncertainty deaths aproach inable allways ready. may god sanctify dealings providence us especially connections decesed. lewis hamlins. birth 15th. recd 12/ july 5th '99. birth james bridges son, born dead. first born intered evng. capt zimry haywood expired evng. 15 6 clear. home. mr ballard finisht business road augusta sidney returnd home. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 16-20, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 16 20, 1798 16 7 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mr ballard pittstn fort hollowell. lady esqr mathew haywood, grand dagt dagt lambard james moore allso. home. home. informd death captzimry haywood, remains interd day. 17 g clear warm. cyrus came attended worship day. nabby hallowell. mr ballard self calld son lambards. son dagt pollard, mr gill wife, shubal pitts wife partook good puding roast veal mr lambard informs dagt town comfortable shee proposes come soon. may seutably imprest sence gods goodness meeting son lambards. mr stone discoarst proberbs xxii c 2 vers, rich poor meet together, lord maker 18 2 x. birth wm bells son. xx. clear warm. calld ]th h morn wilm bell see wife labour. shee deld 8h 30m evng son, first born, comfortable. mrss mc master haywood assistants. tarried night. mr bells. birth 16th. receivd 12/ reward. 19 3 clear warm. mrss bell siesd severe pain head little day. made use means gave relief, left much comfortable 4h pm. mr carters, kitridges, wessons, pittss, soals pattins dingleys. ditoes neighbours. esqr preskot wife sleep 20 4 clear hott fore noon. went mr bells, find comfortable. lewis hamlins, wife cleverly; mr crags, pegy low. calld mr heartfords, wife deld two dead babes esqr cony morn, one sex. mr bells others. birth. mrs heartford twins, son dagt. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 21-24, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 21 24, 1798 21 5 x. birth son john v. davis, born mehitable peirc, first born. xx. rainy day. calld first hour see mrs mehettable peirce labour, safe deld 7h morn fine son shee declared begoton john varsal davis esqr. shee positively affirmd extremity illness, presenc wife jon ballard hosea houland assistants case. latter stept room examined patient. mrss tetcomb calld arive till birth child. mrss burtun mr father child came see aftern. receivd 24/ reward returnd home. mr ballard went acompanied home. son jonas. birth 17th. receivd 24/ reward. 22 6 cloudy part day. home. son town sleeps son dagt lambard, son son jon dind dagt town remains feeble think better shee home. son town sleeps 23 7 clear. son town left mr ballard turn collic. calld mr bells see infant thrush, wife recovering. mr kitredges hamlins patredges mrs patins. young woman coulor expired aftern. mr bells famelys. polly cooper expired aftern. 24 g clear. famely attended worship foren. went aftern. polly coopers remains interd burying ground esqr cony evng service. nabby smith attended. son cyrus went pittstn meeting. meeting son lambards. text john 14th c, 1st vers. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 25 30, 1798 25 2 clear warm. mr ballard watson workt son jon home. nabby went field gathered strawberes finisht washing. home. 26 3 clear fine air. mr ballard watson workt son jon washt goun shirt cyruss coat waist coat, ironed nabby went mr devenports. mrs dingly nancy evng. home. 27 4 clear. mr ballard watson went son jonas. home. mr ballard informd dagt town unwell. may god prepare us concerning home. 28 5 clear warm. hallowell divers stores, moses parmers, receivd 9/ wife assisting child birth. went see mrss bell aftern, find infant comfortable, mrs loes harris nursing calld sons pollards lambards. mr pollard fathers, well except dady. son towns, dagt better. hallowell mr bells. son pollards lambts. 29 6 clear morn, cloudy 10hm. mr ballard watson working road forn. attended lecture aftn. went mr dingleys came home, mr livermores. mrs peckford brot unwell. leclure mr blacks dinglys livrmrss. 30 7 clear. mr ballard surveying mr vauhn. went see pegy crage, find low. son lambards. mr benn browns wife lidia densmore watson sett go fathers evng. mr craggs lambards. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 1-4, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 1 4, 1798 1 g clear warm. attended worship. cyrus ordinance supper administred. mr stone discoarst 2 corinth foren 1st corinth aftern. pegy crage desired prayers near close life!!! dagts sons wife meeting. meeting. sacrament day. 2 2 clear hoter sumer. mr ballard town meeting genl sewals. nabby washt went mr densmores. son dagt town came 7h evn, dagt feeble expected see may please god restore health, prepare happy futurity. mr ballard informs pegy cragg expired aftern 6th hour. may attend call ready. watson came home 10h 15m. home, sewd houghd cucumbers. home. son town brot wife 3 3 clear warm. mr ballard went pittstn survey doct parker others. son town sett home, wife sick day indead. mrss livermr, dingly page calld see mr bond allso. nabby went interment mrs crage. home. nursing dagt town. peggy crage [interd]. 4 4 clear. nursing dagt town. shee comfortable day yesterdy, cought much night. mr ballard returnd aftern. doct cony calld see dagt ys morn. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 5-8, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 5 8, 1798 5 5 clear morn. dagt seems little easier shee last night. calld 9h morn see mrss lowell labour. shee attended doct page last night; calld home sunrise wife labour. shee deld 11h foren son. doct calld patient returnd home 4h pm. receivd 9/ mr lowell. dagt town better day day. shee little feaver. mr gill lambd took tea us. mr lowells hallowell. find mrss gill dagt lambt childn birth doct pages son. 6 6 clear part day, shour aftern. dagt wrode far thos hinkleys. shee seems fatagud, well day. son jona wife mr gill came bring buckthorn roots dagt. home. dagt town well ysday. jona wife see 7 7 x. birth mr kitridgs dagt. xx. clear warm. dagt town seemd comfortable thro day, feavour fitt night. calld 9h morn see mrss kitridg labour. shee deld 10h 30m daugt, second child. left inft cleverly returnd home 2h pm. receivd 7/6 reward. mr kitredges. birth 18th. recd 7/6. dagt town feavor fitt nigt. 8 g clear high wind. mr ballard went meeting. dagt town sick day, shee shee sent bill prayers. mrss densmore foren, helpt get son dagt pollard polly pollard meeting. hannah tarried took care sister. home. mrs town sick. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
