content: martha ballard's diary, july 18 22, 1798 18 4 cloudy, raind evn. dagt pollard mrss dingley helpt work; washt kitchen &c. mrss livermore dagt heartford came see mrs town. shee seems comfortable shee yesterday. son town came aftern, famely well home. home. dagt town little comfortable. company. 19 5 clear foren, showers aftern. mr bullin wife dind took tea us. destitute help. dagt lambd came evn, tarries night. dagt town comfortable day rested tolerable well. home, comp. 20 6 birth abel chases son first born. clear except showers. calld 1h 30m go see wife abel chase labour. shee deld 5h 30m fine son, first born. left inft well could expected returnd home 9h foren. dagt town severe fitt ague feaver. mrs dingley came helpt mrss livermore densmore aftern. dagt faint turn evn. gave caster shee revivd. abel chases. returnd 9h m. mydagt town shakeing fit, began 10, severefeaver fit birth 20th. 21 7 clear. dagt comfortable shee yesterday. shee rode far fense ye road twice day. mrss dingley foren. dagt pollard, mrs pattin mr james hinkleys wife took tea us. home. 22 g clear. mr ballard young men went meeting. dagt town rode hors road morn shais aftern, far mr hinkleys; husband doct odion see mr gill wife, wido savage, son jona wife, dagt tarries, son dagt lambt. home. son town came. dagt ill friday. hannah [calld]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 23-25, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 23 25, 1798 23 2 clear warm. dear dagt town took departure house morn 9h, homeward bound. god support way famely prepare mind concerning o lord, hearts thy creatures thy hand thou turnest rivers waters turnd. may shee look unto saved. grant thy blessing rest famely. may numbered thy chosen ones!!!. alone day since childn left felt gloomy. may mind resined thy things. home. dear dagt town left mr balld, cyrus watson went son jonas work. lonely day. 24 3 heavy showers aftern. done larg wash fatagud. brewed, allso. dagt lambd came finisht, assisted mr ballard jonas. mr sturges calld informd son dagt town past dadys yesterday little past noon. home. dagt lambd childn aftern. 25 4 birth printer robinsons son second child. clear. calld 4h ys morn see mrss robinson, wife printer. shee deld fine son arivd. shee alone birth, neighbour women got bed. drest infant, took breakfast returnd. mr ballard cyrus went jonas. wives james thos hinkley spent aftern informd son dagt town went past levy robinsons morn. mr robinsons. birth 21st. two mrsss hinkleys source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 26-31, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 26 31, 1798 26 5 clear. home. dagt lambard childn becky sewall men work son jonas. mr lambard came son towns morn, informs yt dagt got safe home well shee lately home. son dagt lambd childn 27 6 clear. home till sun sett calld see wife isaac stone extreamly ill collic. tarried watcht. red pepper seemd reliev mr town conducted dagt pollard home, says wife comfortable. mr isaac stones. 28 7 clear. left mrs stone easy came dagt pollards, took breakfast came home, wrode son lambard s hors. men jonas. son dagt lambt ephm mrs heartford dito son pollards. 29 g clear except shower. tarrid home, men went meeting. mr martin son ephm dind us meeting. 30 2 clear hot. washt cloaths one water. mrs pikfd, p. dingly nabby livermore 3 densmor girls home. men jonas. 31 3 clear except showers. washt cloaths 2nd water. men sons. mrs dingly childn mr livermore saw dagt town yestd. shee well sent bottle current syrryp, sheet shift hand kerchief dear dagt town mr straten. home. home. mrs dingly childnhere. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 1-6, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 1 6, 1798 1 4 clear. mr ballard cyrus watson work son jonas. finisht washing, cleand sellar done matters house. henry mc causland came helpt pull wool lamb skin scoured knives forks. home. mr livermore son towns ys day. dagt comfortable. 2 5 clear warm. men jonas work. mr josp whites wife mr page calld shee going lecture. house work gardin. home, mrss white 3 6 clear warm. men work jonas. dagts pollard lambard childn went see mrss dingley aftern. dolly, childn, came home sleep mr dingleys livermores. dagts 4 7 clear warm. dagt lambd tarried day babe. mr ballard carried allin home went jonas. cyrus went phillip bullin ys aftern. home. dagt lambd helpt work. 5 g rainy day. men went meeting. tarried home. home. 6 2 clear warm. men went work son jonas. meriah grifin came washt house work washt bed rooms kitchen. day anniversary daght pollards birth. home. meriah grifin washt paid 2/ service. informd dagt town low last tuesday. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 7-11, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 7 11, 1798 7 3 clear. home. men son jonas work. p. barbh home. 8 4 clear except showers. mr ballard watson jonas foren, finisht giting hay cyrus began pull flax. bakt done work done gardin. watson informd dagt town sick yesterday. home, [heavy] news dagt town. 9 5 clear warm. esqr preskott two men dind mrss dingley came see barril pork divided. shee helpt giting diner. sharp turn collic, got ease soon takeing decoction read peppers. mr ballard went home esqr preskott run line. home. 10 6 clear till aftern heavy shower heavy thunder sharp lightning. dagt lambard mrs pitts calld mr ballard returnd raind much. mr martin work. two informations day; dear dagt town thought near close life. may god prepare us concerning home. 11 7 clear hott. mr ballard went son towns, found dagt comfortable shee days past, low. son towns. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 12-15, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 12 15, 1798 12 g rainy foren, held noon mr ballard sett home, tarried sons. capt stackpool wife, mr fuller aftern. dagt taken fainting distress limbs. shee thought expireing, shee revivd evn gave good exhortation childn. mrss stackpole watcht son towns. dagt ill turn. 13 2 clear warm. tarried dagt. shee another faint turn aftern, revivd. shee seems much resined gods even wishes time departure. patty town 15 years old day. mrs mary crosby watcht. son towns, dagt low. 14 3 clear. sett son towns home, left dagt revived. may great god support thro sees fitt lay upon ys tife croun glory may present help consort childn connections!!! calld mrs capins rufus ballards mr benn browns retn. son towns. cyrus went son towns. 15 4 rainy foren. dagt lambd mrss dingly makeing goun mydr dagt towns last dress. mr ballard unwell collic. cyrus returnd news sister much revivd. home, hear cyrus dagt comfortable. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 20-23, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 20 23, 1798 20 2 clear warm. jane welch came work. mr ballard, p. bullin jona brown sett poland perform tour surveying apointment genl coart. left house 4h pm. calld 5 go see mrss brown. took keys. bullin came back papers oblidged pry hinges ye desk. mrs brown calld women 10h evn. much rest night. mr benn browns, varsalboro. wife moses ingerham deld son doct cony night. mr balld left home poland. 21 3 x. birth benn browns dagt 11 child. xx. clear except shower evn. mrss brown deld dagt, 11th child, 11h 30m. left inft well could expected reacht home sun sett. mr brown gave 6/ cash chees, wd 7 lb, service. son natl came hors, sleeps night. mr browns. birth 23d. heard, mr thoms, dagt town better. 22 4 clear. mending skirt bed quillt. went see mrss dingley aftern. mrs page calld mr dingleys. 23 5 clear cooler. mrs dingley calld going ye hook. shee bot pins needles. went son lambds pollards, hear dagt town much shee went hamlins carters, bot 1 pr cards, 1 dzn biskit, sheet g board, cost 5s;2d. sons polles lambs,receivd letter bror jon famelyare well. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 24-31, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 24 31, 1798 24 6 cloudy morn, raind noon. knit gatherd cucums, camomile, merigolds pickt wool. jane hous work spun yarn mop. home. 25 7 clear. gatherd musturd matters gardin, calld 6h pm go see wife richd foster winthrop, find comfortable sent tarried night, mrs french allso. richd fosters. 26 g rainy. mr fosters, wife sick. mrs french ditoes. 27 2 clear. mr fosters, wife well. ditoes. 28 3 clear. mrs foster seemd comfortable. left afler breakfast arivd home 30m pm. mr foster attended went son lambards, came son towns 11h morn. dagt low. pray divine support famely. ditoes son lambards. 29 4 clear. helpt hous work went hook. bot 1 yd muslin dagt lambard 1 yd self j.o. pages 7/6 pr yd. capt nichols oxford mr moore pittstn hook. 30 5 clear. home, wrote brother collins, send capt nichols. home. wrote bror collins. 31 6 clear. went lecture, dagts mr crages. gentleman name williams discourst colons 3 c, 12-13 vers. informd dagt town remains much shee time past. child saml braleys inlerd aftern. lecture friends. heard dagt town alive yesterday. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 1-4, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 1 4, 1798 1 7 clear. helping house work. dagt ballard came shee thinks going winslow tomorrow. went see nancy dingley unwell, dady marm gone winslow. jane well evng. gave cammomile tea shee got cleverly morn. mr dingleys. nancy unwell. barn consumed fire reedsfield last thursday, belonged mr smith. 2 g clear. attended meeting. ordinance supper administred. went mr dingleys, nancy better. informd dagt town comfortable ys two days, favr would bless great author mercies. son ephm jery heartford took tea us. calld sun sett see wife zyba petingail labour, ill. tarried night. sleep. meeting. lords spr administrd. mr dingleys informd yt dagt town revivd little. mr petingals. son ephm aneversarey birth dagt lambard, 26 years since. 3 2 clear. mr petingals. patient lingars. mrss fletcher calld ys morn. shee went mr allins. women calld see mrs petingl midnight. mr petingls allins. mr hill rachelsavage married. 4 3 x. birth zeba petingls dagt first born. cloudy morn. mrss petingail deliverd fine dagt 1h 40m morn. left infant cleverly arivd home 4h 20m, went bed slept till 8. since matters house. mr petingls. birth 24th. receivd 12/ reward service. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 5-11, 1798 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 3-8, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 3 8, 1798 3 7 clear. home puting house order &c. home. 4 g clear morn, snow fel past night. mr ballard attended worship day. ordinance supper administred. mrss lamb partook us. calld sun sett go esqr haywoods see sick children, dagt ill night. meeting esqr haywoods, watcht childn. 5 2 clear part day. came home early ys morn. mr ballard cyrus went town meeting. otis pierce conducted sister, hitty, see shee tarries night, babe esqr haywds. mrs hitty pierce visit. 6 3 clear. john davis esqr mrss burtun mrss dingley childn allso. hous work. killd two chikens send dagt town. may god support pleased lay upon home. 7 4 cloudy. mr ballard went son towns. home. mrs pierc yet. home. mr bald went winslow. 8 5 birth mr thwings dagt. cloudy. brewd bakt, calld sun sett mr thwings see lady labour, deld dagt 8h evn. walkt mr thwings. saw mr ballard returning son towns, informd dear dagt departed life day. returnd home 10h evn, mr ballard infmd shee expired 10h morn. may god grand us hearts submit hear call, allso ready. mr thwings. birth 27th. recd 6/as rewd. death dagt town, aged 40years, 2 months 11 days. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 12-17, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 12 17, 1798 12 2 cold squally. home. mrs pierce went attended mr kimbal shais. mr ballard surveying doct cony. home. 13 3 clear. mr ballard sett lay county road moses pollards winslow. home, washt mrss livermore came dagt patty sleeps home. mr ballard gone survey road. 14 4 clear pleast. pally livermore washt polly goodin calld going mr dingleys. pally sleeps night. home. mr finny oxen plough day. home. pally livermr washt 15 5 cloudy rain. mr town calld home. mrss livermore came see aftern. bradwil sleeps home. mrss livermr made visit. 16 6 clear. home. mr finny oxen day half yesterday. mr herinton came chopt wood woods half day, brot us legg pork son jon mr ballard returnd laying road. home. 17 7 dinglys dagt. xx. clear. calld see mrss dingley 9h morn. shee safe deld 10h 30m fine dagt. left infant cleverly returnd home 2 pm. mr ezekl pages lady aftern. patty livermore workt sally fletcher [came mr [dinglys]. birth 28th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 18-25, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 18 25, 1798 18 g x. birth suky kenadys son. xx. cloudy, snowd cold. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. calld 9h 30m evng mr kenadas see dagt suky, labour. child born muinets arivd. performd necessary put bed comfortable. tarried night. say wilm ellis father ye child. mr kenadys. birth 29th. may 14th 99 recd fee spining. 19 2 snowd. mr ballard went hook, bot _ gn spirt, 2 lb sugar, 2do candles. came home mr kenadys, left patients cleverly. sick day. sally done work mended. ditoes. 20 3 snowd cold windy. home. 21 4 snowd. mr ballard found brot sheep home. home, knit home. 22 5 clear. mr ballard went son jonas, finds kild two oxen beefs day, famely well. spoke son pollard, famely well. cleard snow ye chamber dryd bed cloaths knitt sally spining wool. home. 23 6 clear. mr ballard went son jonas. killd 3 fowls drest calld 10h evn lemuel devenport go see wife labour. old lady devenport, mrss sewall sole attended. lemuel devenports. 24 7 x. birth lemuel devenports dagt. xx. clear. patient safe deld 4h morn fine daught, first born. tarried till 9h m sett home. arivd 10. receivd 9/ reward. ditoes. birth 30th. recd 9/ reward. thisis 750 case [asd]. 25 g clear. meeting son lambards. meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 26-Dec. 2, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 26 december 2, 1798 26 2 clear pleast. home. swine butchered, wd 202. home. 27 3 clear pleasant. calld 10h evn see wife mr philip norcross labour. mrss randal hankerson mr phillip norcross. 28 4 birth phillip norcrosses dagt. cloudy, raind evng. mrss norcros safe deld 2h morn sixth daughter 8th child. left mother infant cleverly returnd home 10 forn. sally bakeing pies. ditoes. birth 31st. 29 5 cloudy morn, cleard foren. attended worship except sally. shee went fathers. observd day thanksgiving commonwealth. son lambd wife childn, cyrus ephm saml trask mr moses patridg ruth rockwood published. meeting. part childn moses patridg publisht. janee welch married. 30 6 cloudy. mr ballard conducted dagt lambard childn home. phillip bullin dind sally returnd dads. home, housework knit stockin. home. dagt lambd childn went home. bullinhere. 1 7 cloudy. helping house work. made sausages. mr ballard went mr pittss, hors shod. went hallowell allso. 2 g cloudy morn, snowd night. mr ballard famely meeting. mr dingley calld see wife soar throat. bathd put mullin. cyrus came home [towns]. mr dingleys. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 3-7, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 3 7, 1798 3 2 cloudy, snowd evn. mr ballard went winthrop, carried 25 yds white woolen cloath coulered prest. calld see mrss dingley find ill. tarrid night, sett shee seemd easier morn, throat much sweld inwardly. mr dingleys, shee sick. mr heartford wife allso 4 3 cloudy. came home 10h morn, find mr ballard fit collic, got easier went town aftern. mr waid butcherd beef cow us. ditoes, patient little easier. mr ballard collic. 5 4 cloudy. mr waid choping wood us. mr dingley calld see wife ill rash. went spent day night doct cony calld, approvd done. left cm tart, niter senna. ditoes. doct cony calld. polly town 17 years old ys day. 6 5 cloudy. mrss livermore came mr dingleys go see sick dagt. find patty sick. put black wool, wet brandy pepper, ears gave present relief. returnd helpt mrss dingly shee seems well expected. doct cony came see nancy complains. son town came calld mr dingleys hast reason bleeding mouth. mrss densmore mrs mc causland calld rheubin moores, mr lakemans. ditoes mr livermores. mr dingley hors go mrss mc causland. 7 6 x. birth lakemans son. clear. put mrss lakeman bed 4th son 5th child 2h morn, returnd mr dingleys 6, find wife comfortable. receivd 6/ reward lakeman. ditoes mr lakemans. birth 32. receivd 6/. july '99 rec 3/. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 8-14, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 8 14, 1798 8 7 clear cold. came mr dingleys, helpt hous work. hear mrss dingly remains comfortable. home. dingleys. 9 g clear cold. sons pollard lambard wives childn, rhoda son ephm old mr pollard allso. went see mrs dingley evn, find better. parents sister mc causland old mr mc causland buried day, deseast fryday. mr dingleys. funeral old mr mc causland. 10 2 clear. mr waid helpt us git wood. home. home. 11 3 cloudy cold. mr ballard cyrus went hear coart marshal. home, made 33 dozn candlis. noah watson sleeps home. 12 4 cloudy cold. watson went mr ballard cyrus hear coart marshal. home, house work knitt. sally spun home. 13 5 cloudy cold, snowd night. mr ballard went see sick mr livermores finds better; mr dingleys, better hannah unwell. done house work, cut sewett washt kitchen floor. sally washt went fathers, cyrus conducted sleigh. home. 14 6 x. birth anty braketts 3d son. xx. clear. house work. chopt meet pies &c. sally spun pikt wool. calld 7h 30m go see wife antony brakett, shee deld 9h 30m son. tarried night. mr anty braketts. birth 33d. receivd 8/4 reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 15-18, 1798 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 15 18, 1798 15 7 clear. left patient well could expected, came far son lambards 10h morn. son cyrus conducted dind. mr dingley says wife childn better. seems well could wish. anty brakets son lambards. 16 g clear cold. famely attended worship except self. cyrus conducted sally mr kitridges singing school, returnd 9h 35. home. cyrus sally kitridges. 17 2 x. birth charls gills second daugt. xx. clear, pleasant day. mr waid workt washing, sally house work. cyrus conducted see mr dingley famely. find poorly, wife better. hannah unwell. mr ballard came 8h evn. mr gill came soon go see wife labour safe delivered daugt 10 11h evn. old lady brooks, mrss capin dagt lambard assistants, returnd tarried night. mr dingleys mr gills. birth 34th.it snowd evn. receivd 6/ _ lb hyson tea myservice. 18 3 clear. mr gill went mrss conry nurs wife. left patients cleverly came home 11h 30m foren. mr capin lambard wivs dind us. cyrus went winthrop cloath, finisht. calld 11h evn mr asa williamss wife labour. slept little. mr gills. mr capin lambard wives dind source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, december 19 27, 1798 19 4 x. birth asa williams dagt. xx. cloudy snow. mrs williams safe deld 3h pm 6th dagt 7th child. left cleverly came son jonas tarried night. house childn, left jack brot others home. ye aniversary mariage, 44 yrs. mr asa williamss. birth 35th. islept sons. 20 5 clear morn, cloudy part day. son jona conducted home. calld shubal pills, find wife washing. mr waid choping wood us. capt jones sleeps sons mr pittss. 21 6 clear cold. mr waid workt richard foster wife mr blackman dind fine pice roast beef. finisht footing pair slockins self began mittin. home. 22 7 clear. home. home. 23 g snowd. calld 6h ys morn see wife wilm sprage well shee could wish. day, shee better. wilm sprages. 24 2 clear cold. went mr sprages son jonas, gone winslow. ditoes sons. 25 3 clear pleasant christmas. sons, went varsalboro. sons. 26 4 snowd raind. sons. ditoes. 27 5 cloudy. sons. oliv left ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-6, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 6, 1799 1 3 clear, snowd evn. dagt lambd childn becky sewall came morn, made winter goun. sons lambard ephm came evn conducted home. calld 11h 30m see wife shubael pitts labour. home till 11 o clock night. dagt lambd made goun, becky 2 4 x. birth shubael pittss 2nd dagt. xx. clear cold. mrss pitts deld 45m afler noon 2nd dagt. left infant cleverly sun sett went home son jona, wife ill turn comfortable. tarried night. cold. mr shubael pittses. birth 1st. receivd 9/ reward. 3 5 cloudy, snowd came sons mr ballard, l faett us; left dagt better. calld mr hamlins store, bot pair specktacles, price 4/6; _ yd cambric 3/9; 3 yds quallity /6; thread /4_; biskit /6; plates 3/6. calld see mrs pitts, find cleverly. dind son lambards roast turkey, brother truman wife son ephm sleeps son jonas others. 4 6 clear. home. l faell hannat mr ballard mr burtuns. home. 5 7 clear cold. calld hast son jonas, oldest son drank spirrit apparently dead. immersed warm water put oil. doct cony calld used means, recovered thro goodness god. tarried night. son jon jack drunk. 6 1 clear cold. mr ballard came sons, jack better complained throat. calld son lambds, babe unwell got better conducted home. cyrus sally singing school. son jona lambds. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 7-13, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 7 13, 1799 7 2 clear cold. mr ballard went streat cyrus pitts tn. sally washt, hous work. home. 8 3 clear cold. home. mr ballard cyrus went coart house. son town dagt polly came home. son town polly sleep 9 4 clear moderate. men went hear coart. polly went son lambard s, son pollards. sally fletcher unwell kept bed aftern, done work knitt home. son town dagt polly went son pollards. sally sick. 10 5 clear pleasant. home, hous work, scoured table pails. sally workt self. phillip bullin brot money mr ballard poland. cyrus mr hopkins grain, wheat rie, mr bishop left us. home. phillip bullin took tea us. cyrus capt hopkinss. 11 6 clear pleasant. mr ballard got 1 load wood went hear coart, cyrus went allso. noah watson evn, receivd 22dol. mr ballard paid sally fletcher owd brewd bakt wheat brown bread, done hous work. home. paid watson 22dol, sally fletcher 3dols 1:1_. shee recd 2/ shee workt us. 12 7 clear. home hous work. mr ballard cyrus court house. sally washt west room workt self. home. 13 1 clear part day cold, snowd evn. son town polly, mr gill lambard wives, allin mr gills infant mr ballard, cyrus sally meeting, shee came home 10h 30m accompanied mr cleark others. home. mr gill childn source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 14-20, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 14 20, 1799 14 2 cloudy. mr ballard meddow. home. polly town seems unwell. made tea camomile. son ephm came sleeps, go meddow. home. polly town unwell. gave herb tea night. 15 3 cloudy part day. mr ballard went ye meddow hay. son ephm drove teem. mr dingley came conducted house, widdow haywood winslow ephm sleeps mr waid supt sally washt day. polly town went son lambards foren. mr dingleys. widdow haywood son saml 16 4 clear pleast. mr ballard ephm went meddow last hay. cyrus went hear coart. son jona came caried childn us two weaks. conducted sally fletcher, allso, house take care wife. doct quimby took tea paid 2 crowns gave receipt could find note. home. sally went son jon childn went home. doct quimby 17 5 clear pleast. felt unwell done house work finisht mit cyrus. mr ballard coart house, coart ajourned without day. home. 18 6 clear pleast. mr waid helpt mr ballard get wood. son dagt lambard childn, son jon calvin ballard supt us. done hous work knitt home. 19 7 clear. home. cyrus son jon home. 20 1 cloudy little snow. mr ballard, self cyrus went meeting. went son lambards noon. gentleman name tiltne performed foren fm romans 1st 22 vers, aftn st. john vii c 16-17 verss. noah watson came work us. meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 21-24, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 21 24, 1799 21 2 cloudy morn, snowd little. mr ballard company esqr haywood son alford son dagt lambart, wrode son pollards dind. mr pollard gone fathers, dagt hannah well could wish; others famely well. sett home sun set, addition ezra town sisters company, returnd esqrs took tea came home 7h 30m evn. son pollards. mr waid watson giting wood us. 22 3 clear pleasant. mrs eunice stackpole bror jack, selvanas hatch, wife dagt mrss paten dind mr ballard gone hear tryal coartial capt greanlief. ezra town sisters patty lucy, son ephm tea. inform yt dagt lambd unwell. wrode see shee little easier. little allin came uncle. grand childn sleep mr waid helpt us. son lambards. dagt unwell. mr halch wife mrs eunice stackpole allso. 23 4 clear. dagt lambard childn dind us. mr hatch wife, ezra town sisters, mr fairfield redington eat aftern. mr dingley, luke son lambd, wife childn goung man name pollard look tea. cyrus sally singing school. home. hav compy. finisht pair mits. 24 5 cloudy part day. mr ballard watson got wood. house work began mittn. ephm tea, informd robt kenada thankfull chace married. home. robt kenady junr thankfulchase marrid. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 25-30, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 25 30, 1799 25 6 clear day, cloudy evn. mr waid helpt watson get wood. finisht makeing coat self. mr abm divenport cyrus went bror jonas, brot turnips apples home. home. 26 7 cloudy, snowd haild raind evn. mr ballard surveying mr mr abm devenport. cyrus pitts tn son jon watson workt mr waid fore noon went sidny aftern. spent ye day puting news papers regular order sewing sally done hous work mended cloaths. home. mr ballard surveying mr abm devenport. 27 1 rainy. home. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. ephm supt conducted sally singing. cyrus went see home. home. text romans 3 3. 28 2 x. birth abm devenports 2nd son. xx. clear. calld mr abm devenpt 3h morn go see wife labour. shee ill thro gods goodness safe deld hours 8 9 second son child. left comfortable arivd home 11h 30m. mr devenports. birth 2nd. receivd 9/ july 11th, 99. 29 3 x. birth andw goodins son. xx. clear part day. calld 4h pm go see wife mr andw goodin labour. shee safe deld 9h evn fine son, second child. widow davis tarried night took care patient. mr andw goodins. birth 3d. recd12/ rewd. 30 4 cloudy, snowd little ys morn. left mr goodins 11h morn, patient bed made seemd cleverly. watson returnd sidney last night. cyrus breaking flax, began yesterday. mr ballard gone mill. allin lambd sleeps dad gn son pollards. mr goodins. mr ballard receivd 5 bushels corn surveying road sidney. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 8-16, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 8 16, 1799 8 6 cloudy rain night. doct came drest] patient, allso soar throat child mr robbins varsalboro. mr hail keratunk took breakfast us. home. robbins well expected. 9 7 rainy day. finisht kniting seventh pair mitts. began first decr 24th 1798. home. 10 1 clear windy. sally tarried worship. shee went singing evn, returnd 10h 30m. calld 11h evn mr roland smiths, wife unwell. went bed rest. [roland] smiths. son dagt lambard, brother evn. 11 2 x. birth roland smiths dagt. xx. clear. mr smiths till evn calld capt littlefields, walkt much fatagud. calld mrss smith shee safe deld 10h first dagt 3d child cleverly. tarried night, cramp. mrss cleark meloy tarried allso. mr smiths [littlefields]. birth [4th].recd 15/ mr smith june 17, '99. [12] 3 cloudy. came home 7h morn, left patients cleverly. mr smith gone varsalboro sally brown nurs wife. find eliphalet well expected. mr smiths. 13 4 clear. home till evn calld capt littlefields find lady well. night, slept patient. shee little rest. capt littlefields. mrs [dickman] deld [doct] cony, mrs churchs mrs mosier. 14 5 clear. patient day night. shee rest night. [ditoes]. 15 6 clear. took breakfast left patient work, cleverly, returnd home 9h m. doct cony came drest etiphalet foren. lady youngest dagt spent part ye aftern evn us. ditoes. doct cony lady sally singing evng. [16] 7 cloudy. home, feel well usual. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 4-14, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 4 14, 1799 4 2 clear cold. dagt lambd, son, mrss foster, dagt inft, mrss pitts infant diner tea. son ephm came took tea, soar throat; mr ballard, pain right knee. home, sally part washing. eliphalet docters. home, compy. 5 3 clear cold. home, feel well. sally finisht washing shee began yesty. home. 6 4 clear cold. unwell day, severe pain left ear. applied british oil warm brick, went onto bed got easier, able rise undress, lay cloaths night. could wish grant better attendance one may fall care. sally went singing come see shee returnd. home, unwell. 7 5 clear except squalls snow, cold. mrss mc causland came foren see mrss livermore aftern. phillip bullin old mr hamlin sone thos mr partridg wives mrss lamb visit, took tea us. eliphalet ye docts, returnd evng. home, company. 8 6 cloudy cold. mr ballard ye fort. old mr burges delded crown son nathan sent eliphalet took walk hallowell. home, unwell yet. 9 7 cloudy, snowd raind evn. dagt lambd sone came foren, son came ym evng. feel comfortable since tuesday. elipht went streat day. home. 10 g clear pleast, famely went meeting except self. hawk killd one hens. eliphalet went mr kenadas came meeting. cyrus bring sally singing school. home. nabby andrws tapt thee 2nt time day. 11 2 severe snow storm, men town meeting. son lambd conducted rhoda pollard combd 9 lb flax knitt 40 purls stocken. home. 12 3 clear windy cold. kniting. sons jon ephm evng. cyrus drest flax. home. 13 4 snowd. home kniting. home. 14 5 clear cold. calld [8]h evng go see mr blacks son billy, sick seems better. returnd 11h mr black wife gone fathers. son ephm mr blacks. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 15-24, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 15 24, 1799 15 6 clear pleasant till noon. son pollard came dagt hannah 11 o clock, tarried dind left us two dagts 1h pm. elijah, son bror ebenz moore, aftern. saml trask thumb soar. advised wheat bran poultis. sally washt, elipt went streat. home. son pollard dind 16 7 cloudy moderate. combd 14 lb 8 oz flax knitt last sheep lambd. eliphalet informs dorkis dinsmore sick yet. home. 17 1 clear. famely attended worship except self. mr john peck saml cony came home mr ballard. formr gave 12/7 information township nw son dagt lambd ephm took tea cyrus went conducted sally home evn. home. mr peck, son dagt lambd 18 2 cloudy cold, snowd even. went see dorkis densmore, find comfortable shee wilm anny quite unwell. p. bullin mr strattne dind elipt went forn, returnd. informd yt mr georg brown frozen feet part thim come sad misfortune. mr densmores. 19 3 clear pleast. home till evng calld capt littlefield see wife unwell. tarried night. capt littlefields. 20 4 cloudy morn, snowd aftern night. ditoes, patient unwell. sally hatch ditoes. 21 5 x. birth capt littlefields 7th son. xx. rainy. mrss littlefield women morn safe deld 10h fine son, 8th child. left cleverly arivd home 4h pm. ditoes. birth 10th. receivd 4/6in cash 5 lb butter. 22 6 clear. home. capt stackpool lady mrss dingly made us visit. home, company. 23 7 snowd foren. combing flax, son jona dind calld see dorkis densmore, pain returnd severe. famely seem unwell colds. mr densmores, dorkis unwell. 24 1 clear. famely attended worship except self. feel unwell. dagt lambd childn meeting. home. dagt lambd childn source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 25-31, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 25 31, 1799 25 2 clear ye day. cyrus sally gone son pollards. mr jabish clough mr ballard paid 6 d 60 cents hay sometime past. young man paid mr ballard 15 dols note mr stanly winthrop. home. cyrus old mr boltons funeral. 26 3 clear pleast. mr ballard self went son lambds, son town morn. mr town informs dagt dolly unwell, may pleas great authur good restore health calld mr dinsmores, find wife sick, daugt easier. son lambds mr densmors. 27 4 snow rain. calld mr densmores dress btister wives side. shee easier pain, feeble. dorkis comfortable. found becky fletcher returnd. rainy evn litening. mr densmors. beky fletcher 28 5 snow rain. home, kniting. becky fletcher tarries ys night. home. 29 6 cloudy morn cold. feel unwell. becky fletcher went breakfast. mrss livermore camee see spining shee son daugt ballard childn came visit. jack le faett sleep finisht kniting self pair hoes. let son jona 11_ lb flax. paid sally fletcher 6/. home. mrss livermore son jona famely. capt saml howard expired night. 30 7 clear part day, snowd evn. combing flax. augustus ballard, wife infant informd death capt samuel howard. calld 10h evn wilm moore go see wife labour, arivd near midnight. wilm moores. ephm 20 years old ys day. 31 1 x. birth wilm moors dagt. xx. snow, rain hail. mrss moore deld 1 2h ys morn dagt wd 11 lb, second child. left inft well could expected returnd home 11h foren. mr ballard cyrus went meeting foren, sally aftern. felt fatagued remains capt saml howard interd evn. calld 10h evn go see wife joseph savage sidney. shee labour, ill arivd. ditoes. birth 11th. receivd 9/ reward. funeral captain saml howard. went [joh] savages evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 1-10, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 1 10, 1799 1 2 x. birth [joseph] savages 12th child, son. x. snowd mrss savage day. shee safe deld 5h 30m son, twelfth child. left well could expected 8 returnd home. calld son pollards, find well except rhoda pain ear. mr savages. birth 12th. recd 9/ ths hamlin july [8]. 2 3 cloudy. combing flax. sally went singing, jonas sons went home. dagt lambd childn ephm calld mr partrdges see childn badly scolt. tarried sett destresed famely. snowd, raind haild night. mr partridges, childn scolt. 3 4 severe snow storm. came home aflern, mr partridg gave cabages. left childn well could expected. ditoes. 4 5 snowd morn, windy day. mr ballard cyrus attended worship, observd day fasting prayer. mr stone discoarst 2nd cron 7 ch 14 vers. informd mr bullin, past mr george brown likely recover. home. 5 6 x. birth benn fitches 3d son. xx. clear pleast. calld 8h morn go se benn fitches wife labour. went hast found put bed mrss hinkley. returnd home noon, find dagt lambd shee spun 2 double skeins linning wheal, husband came conducted son home evng. mr dingley wait mrss mc causland see husband. poor woman, must feelings see beloved husband chains, justly murderer. benn fitches. birth 13thto calld ys year. dagt lambdand son 6 7 clear pleast. home kniting. home. 7 1 clear pleasant. calld 8h morn see mr patradges childn, find oldest ill rash. burns good way expected. tarried till evn, returnd home 8h 30m. mr partridges. anna sick. 8 2 cloudy till 10h m, clear wds till near night calld mr heartford see wife unwell. gave tea relievd tarried night, slept patient, marm allso. mr heartfords, mrss livermore allso. 9 3 raind morn. left patient little comfortable arivd home 10h morn. went mr bells, child unwell. ditoes mr [bells]. death anna patridg. 10 4 x. birth mr eatons dagt. xx. cloudy sun shine turns cold. calld 2h m go see wife mr eaton, livs mg stickneys. patient ill thro day safe deld 8h evn 2nd dagt 3d child. tarried night. receivd 9/ mr eaton reward service. cyrus finisht dresing flax. makes 770 cases. mr eatons. birth 14th. burial anna partridg. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 11-23, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 11 23, 1799 11 5 clear cool. left patient cleverly returnd home 9th hour ys morn. able sett little day. mr eatons. 12 6 clear. pain head foren, felt better aftern, went mr partridges. find babe low comfort shaw unwell. calld son lambards, well usual. mr partridges son lambds. 13 7 clear pleast. severe pain head 8h morn till 2 pm. able knit finisht pair hoes self. home, finisht 4th pr hoes. 14 1 clear pleast. go meeting wel could wish. dagt lanbd childn came noon, husband came meeting conducted home. home. 15 2 clear warm. home kniting. sally washt, capt littlefield p. bullin lamb badly poisoned, gave oill relievd home. 16 3 x. birth mr stickneys 4th son 6th child. xx. clear warm. calld 8h morn magr stickneys wife labour. conducted river sleigh, pusht mr eaton. drawn mr devenports landing hors sleigh. patient safe deld 7h 30m evng fine son clevy. self, ladys assisted, tarried night. henry badcock ys night, absent. mag stickneys. birth 15th. recd 9/ reward. crost ice. 17 4 x. birth ths stickneys son. xx. cloudy. mr thomas stickney calld us brothers see wife labour. shee safe deld 3d son 6h pm cleverly. mrss devenport mrss whites conducted home. tarried night. mrss conrey nurs patient. leut thos. stickneys. birth 16th. recd 9/ asa rewd. 18 5 cloudy. conducted home mr stickneys mr devenports landing sled drawn oxin. launcht connoe crost river arivd safe. finisht futing hoes came home. ditoes. crost river, home water. 19 6 cloudy clear turns. hatcheling flax makeing soap. mr ballard son jonas, carrid 9_ lb flax. home, combd flax. 20 7 cloudy cold. combing flax. finisht soap, half barril. home. recd 19 skeins cotn yn [hard 21 1 clear cold. famely attended meeting except self, traveting bad. home. 22 2 clear cold. mr ballard went work sellar. finisht soap makeing knit done hous work. home. 23 3 clear pleast. mr ballard house work. boiled 35 skeins lining, comb flax knit, sally spun 8 skeins tow yarn. cyrus done things fence cattle. ice runs. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 24-30, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 24 30, 1799 24 4 x. birth daniel heartfds 3d dagt. xx. snowd. calld 2h morn see mrss heartford labour, marm mrss haywood bell calld shee safe deld fine dagt 6h, returnd home 2 pm sleigh. mrss heartford two childn born ye 20th june last. mr heartfords. birth 17th. receivd 12/ rewd. 25 5 clear pleast, roads bad. day apointed worthy president observd day humiliation prayer united states. mr ballard cyrus attend worship, sally went fathers meeting. home. 26 6 clear cool. finisht hatcheling flax. becky sewall came spin yarn hernis. mr ballard work seller, mr waid helpt home. becky sewall 27 7 clear forenn, cloudy aftern, snowd night. mr heartford calld 2h pm see wife ill turn. marm went us, batht used remedies gave relief. returnd home evn. mrs sewal sleeps mr heartfords, wife ill easier. 28 1 cloudy bad wriding. mr ballard son cyrus went meeting. becky sewall wrode home hors noon. ephm evn. informd mrss heartford cleverly. home. mrs sewall went nn. 29 2 x. birth jessy kimbals dagt. xx. cloudy. calld 2h morn go see wife jessy kimbal labour. went brick yard norcross foot, water. arivd patient 4, shee deld 3d dagt 4th child 5. necesary performances, returnd home 9h morn. jessy kimbals. birth 18th. recd 9/ reward. 30 3 x. birth stutely springers son 7th child. xx. clear showers turns. mrss capen dagt lambard moses partridges wife lidia densmore allso. mr ballard work house. calld sun sett go see wife stutely springer labour. arivd dusk evn. 29th springers. clear, patient safe deld 5h m fine son. sett home breakfast. calld see mrss ball, find low soar breast. spoke dagt ballard, le faett sweling throat. mr ballard work, cyrus carting wood, sally washing, jason livermore came home last evng. stutely springers. birth 19th. inft wd 9 lb. recd fee hamln store. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 1-5, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 1 5, 1799 1 4 cloudy clear turns. 7 visels went past home. mr ballard cyrus carted brick mr norcroses house. son town came evn, sleeps informd deaths mrss crosby mr fullers youngest child. home, son town sleeps 2 5 cloudy clear turns, raind night. wrote day, rain night. cloudy morn, cleard 9h morn. son town went see father unwell, calld return home. mrs harington brot 14_ yds cloath mother wove isaac hardins wife paid shee owd service done calld 11h evng go see wife levy page, found labour, night. home, son town levy pages night. 3 6 cloudy part day. went levy james pages see lheir child bad humour head feet. patient women calld dinner. night. women attended mrss hains, cumings briggs. mr pages. 4 7 x. birth levy pages dagt 4th child. xx. clear pleast. mrss pages illness came severe day shee safe deld dagt, 4th child, 7h morn. left infant well could expected returnd far son lambards. mr ballard calld conducted home. informd deaths mr rhuebin page sidney belgrade mr soper pitts ton, old mr hastings, winthrop. ditos. 20th birth. recd 6/. jany 15th recd 3/. acount deaths. 5 1 x. birth theops hamlins 3d son. xx. clear cold. calld 2h ys morn go see wife mr theops hamlin labour sixth child. wrode mr john rockwood, reacht safe alltho roads bad, shee safe deld 3h morn 3d son sixth child. left cleverly came home 7. attended worship, famely allso. son dagt lambd came service. mr theophs hamlins. birth 21st. recd 12/ reward. son dagt lambd source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 6-14, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 6 14, 1799 6 2 clear cold. mr ballard collic morn. cyrus attended town meeting aftern. makeing bags fixing gardin seeds. sally washt, mr capin home. 7 3 raind moderately day. mr ballard complains chollic pain. home, done hous work knitt home. 8 4 rain sun shine turns. mr ballard cyrus went son pollards puting house fraim. wint son lambards. calld see mrss densmore, find feeble. sent polly hodges mr w waids carry memorandum mrss haywood procure things boston. son lambards. sent 9 dols mrsshaywood boston. 9 5 clear cloudy turns. home. mr ballard hous. cyrus went tend mill rhubin moore. home. cyrus went work mr moore. 10 6 clear part day. mr ballard attended lecture. dagt lambard faint turn left meeting. mr ballard calld meeting, shee complains pain head side. calld see mrss hamlin, find cleverly. lecture mr hamlins son lambards. 11 7 clear part day. wed part current trees. mr vauhn calld took limbs white ones. mr ballard hous, workt chimney. home. home. 14 lb veal mr livermore. 12 1 snowd morn. showers. went meeting, famely. ordinance ye supper administred. calld son lambd s service dind. mercy tuper came work weak. meeting. mercy tuper came spin 13 2 clear cloudy turns. mr ballard went house bricks, wilm cypher drove teem. cyrus went pitts tn cleaning door yard. sally washt, mercy spun home. 14 3 clear warm. home. receivd letters bror barton collins. dagt lambard allin home. recd letters april 27 28 source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 15-22, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 15 22, 1799 15 4 clear. mr dingleys. mr ballard saw mrss gill, shee infms father low. son town famely well. mr dingleys. 16 5 rainy. mr ballard ploughd gardin. home, hous work knitt home. 17 6 clear part day, cloudy aftrn. mr ballard farm, seen 74 years day. oliv fletcher visit sally. home, oliv fletcher 18 7 clear part day. mr ballard jon hous work door yard, fixing gardin. home, mercy tuper went home. 19 1 clear. mr ballard went pittstn see bror town cyrus informs, near close life. may god guide thro valley shaddow death, may holy angels stand waiting receive conduct departing spirit relms immortal bliss!!! cyrus informd intermition mrss gill calld go see father expected survive long, shee tarries night. home. mr ballard see bror town, left alive low. son dagt lambd mrs smart evng. 20 2 clear. washt 10 bed blanketr, one coverled, one great coat, one quillt, 2 single coats cloaths, boild 41 skeins tow yarn. feel fatagud. mr ballard put hay pasture fence. home. 21 3 clear windy. mr ballard went son jon sowd flax. mrss dingley presented two dols assisting illness last nover. planted squashes. home. mrss dingley 22 4 rainy. son town came 11th hour, informs hond father expired 6h ys morn, remains intered 3h pm tomorrow. planted beens, cucumbers, mandrakes sowd pees. bror town expired 6h morn. mr [pitts] returnd fm vasallb. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 23-31, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 23 31, 1799 23 5 rainy forn, cleard 1h pm. went pittstn attended interment remains brother, thos town. sons town jon dind went us. mr gill wife went us. corps born church prayers red, carried church yard interd. calld mr moors took tea, arivd home sun sett. son town sleeps funeral bror town. 24 6 clear warm. mr ballard went meddow. saml trask workt dug gardn. workt gardn, sowd beets carrots, planted mellons, removd roots &c, &c. home gardining. 25 7 cloudy. mr ballard meddow sons. workt gardin, feel fatagud. sally hous wk went street. home gardining. 26 1 cloudy. cyrus came pittstn. mr ballard, sally meeting day. attended aftern. sally return till evng. calld son lambds, well. meeting. 27 2 clear morn cool. mr ballard set meddow early, cyrus pittstn, sally washing. allin lambd came person calld go see friend nathan husseys wife varsalboro, thought advisable go doct parker. calld see mrss burtun noon, find unwell tarried night. shee got better. mr burtuns. 28 3 clear pleasant. went see mrss stone mrss miller, sett home. calld mr whitwells lambd s. mr ballard son jon dittoes. bulah childn sleep 29 4 clear warm. mr ballard survey capt ozgood. saly fletcher left noon. dagts ballard lambard home. dagts ballard lambd sally left 30 5 x. birth james burtuns 2nd dagt. xx. clear part day. mr ballard meddow, finisht mending fence. calld 7h pm see mrss burtun labour, deld 10 evn fine daugtr. tarried thro night. mr fenny 8, wisht go see wife ill allso, could leave mrss burtun speak hime, went mrss mosier, shee absent. mr burtuns. birth 22nt. recd 12/ store. 31 6 rainy. got patinet changd lining came home. ditoes. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 1-8, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 1 8, 1799 1 7 rainy. home, informd wife mr james lethgow departed life yesterday, remains interd tomorrow. home death 2 1 rainy. cyrus came father attended worship. mrss lithgow interd ys day. home. 3 2 clear. mr ballard farm. help part day, allin planted beens, corn dug piece ground planted 20 squash seeds mrss dingley gave son town sleeps waited mrs eunice slackpole mr dingleys. home. son town famely well. 4 3 clear. mr ballard setts go jonas breakfast, mr town allso go son pollards. house work bakt wheat bread. mrss livermore made prest butter. mrss dingly children eunice stackpool made visit aftern. sally oliv cloaths. home, compy. 5 4 clear cool. mr town came took breakfast. left son pollards famely well, sett home 9h, went mr dinglys (accompanied mrs eunice) 9h 45m. mrss dingley left nancy hannah went ye hook. mr ballard gone jon 6 5 clear part day, raind night. mr ballard gone son jonas. unwell day could sett feel little better towards night. mr livermore took tea us evn. home unwell. 7 6 clear till near night began rain, continued thro night. mr ballard went carrie web timy pages wife weav 32 15 knoted skeins lining [80] skeins tow. cyrus came home. mr ballard timy pages. 8 7 rainy. calld 4h pm son pollard go see wife unwell. wrode mr robinsons alone, reacht sons night. raind powerfully night. found self manner woman night. [1806]. remaind situation every [moment] since. son pollards. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 9-18, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 9 18, 1799 9 1 rainy. son pollards. ditoes. 10 2 rain. son pollards. ditoes. 11 3 clear. ditoes. dagts ballard lambd came informd mr ballard collic lidia nud gone take care house. dagt pollard hous. son pollard went coart augusta, returnd night. ditoes. dagts ballard lambd 12 4 raind. son pollard went coart come home. ditoes. 13 5 x. birth son pollards first son 4th child. xx. clear part day. dagt siesd labour women calld shee safe deld 12 oclock) fine son, 4th child, well could expected. husband returnd evn seems much pleased favour. may god bless ofspring. son pollards. birth 23rd. recd 6/. recd letter sister williams may 30. 14 6 rainy. dagt, shee remaind cleverly till evn shee great pain milk coming. sett till midnight. sally selvester tended remainder night. shee got rest, infant seems well. sent sist williams come nurs obtain mr pollard come home. ditoes. 15 7 cloudy morn, cleard sent john bolton augusta mrs polly pollard, shee came left child well could expected 4h pm, reacht home sun sett. find mr ballard better ditoes. came home, informd sister moore lately twins, one living. 16 1 clear. home. mr ballard cyrus meeting, mrss livermore. home. 17 2 clear foren, cloudy aftern. dagt lambard came shee walkt far j.o. pages store. calld p. norcross, rold smiths mr martins. hallowl. 18 3 clear. workt gardin cleand chambers, went see mrss dingley aftern, mrs p. densmore mr ballard went meddow. mr dingleys. planted [1] hill cucumbers. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 19-22, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 19 22, 1799 19 4 clear. mr ballard sett mount vernon. went work gardin, killing buggs plants 9h m. mr benn white calld go see wife unwell. went aftern see old lady white mrss burns slept mr whites. patient seems better. mr whites. 20 5 x. birth benn whites 5th dagt. born dead. xx. clear. mr ballard sett colo dutuns directly reacht home 8h m. hous work gardin. mrss densmore came aftern beens plant. calld hast go mr whites boys landed jackson landing. took shoes walkt stockins, steerd strait coars could reacht mr whites soon, much fatagud. wife delivd 10h evn daughtr dead. tarried night, slept ye patient well expected. mr whites. birth 24th. receivd 9/ reward. 21 6 clear. left mrss white well could expect. calld mgr stickneys leuts whose infant ill turn. feard expireing, use means revivd left walkt mr pages landing whence mr stickney conducted home water. arivd 2h pm. matters house went mr dingleys took tea mrs livermore, moore, mc causland &c. ditoes. funeral infant dagt. 22 7 clear. mr ballard went mr moodys bot 7yds callico, 1yd cottne, 2 lb sugar; conducted dagt lambd make gown, thin went streat. informd yt betsy welch found river. went capt williams, sumoned jury. mrss dingley mrss livermore dagt heartfod calld rufus ballard son lambd took tea us. home. mrs land made goun. betsy welch found buried. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 23-28, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 23 28, 1799 23 1 clear till evn thunder showers. cyrus sett go john browns winthrop, 9h m, hepsy. misfortune put bone foot 9h 15m. doct cony immediately calld sett comfortable. mrss dingley came assistance, shee, husband patty livermore came meeting see son ephm allso. cyrus returnd without hepsy. home. put bone place foot. doct cony sett wd take thing service. 24 2 x. birth capt cains dagt. xx. clear part day, thunder showers noon. done hous work gardin. mr ballard son jonas. calld 2h pm go see wife capt cain labour. walkt, crosing river, far mgr stickneys, wrode behind willm littlefield without saddle pillion, patient safe deld 4h pm fine dagt. left comfortable could expected arivd home sun sett. capt cains. birth 25. receivd 6/. 3/ remains due 25 3 clear hot till afternoon, raind night. mr ballard went son jonas. houghing gardin planted hills potatoes 24 cucumber seeds. home. ptanted 24 seeds cucumbers. 26 4 clear warm foren, thunder rain aftern. mrss livermore sent went stranger man name treadwood wanted see mr ballard; gone son jon mr livermores. 27 5 cloudy. mr ballard went work grave yard makeing fence, compleetd home, considerable wash. 2 strangers sleep home. lodgd 2 strangers. 28 6 clear warm. sally andrews came work went visit mrss crage, dagt lambd mr ballard son jonas, took tea mr crages. mr fellows sleeps mr crags. fell hors return. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 29 july 5, 1799 29 7 clear warm. washt wolen garments ironing. sally hous work nurst child. mr ballard went jonas mill. sloop grounded gravel bed. home. 30 1 clear except shower morn. cyrus came home went meeting. mr ballard went, attinded aftern. partook fine loin veal son lambards service sloop part unloaded aground yet. meeting son lambards. 1 2 clear warm. mr ballard diging stoning drain seller house. done hous work nurst sallys child shee washt. cloud came sun sett, thunder much rain. home. 2 3 clear warm. mr ballard went finisht seller drain. sally ands washt west room, stairs entry. partly cleand store. sally oliv fletcher former took deeds threatend sue us 1 weak time pai due. shee looks thin fased shee shee left us. home. 3 4 clear warm. houghd gardin foren, went quillt old lady hamlin aftern. dagt lambard went old lady lamb, mrss crage burtun, two mrss hamlins, mrss duttun two mrss patridges made company. number grand childn sons tea. old mr hamlins. mr ballard [jonas] cart got wood. 4 5 clear warm foren, cooler aften. mr ballard went jonas meddow. workt gardin done mending. mrss densmore tea. aneversary independance. home. 5 6 clear warm. went mr ballard lecture, text peter 1st 15. felt unwell, went son lambds, mr blaks. took tea mr hamlins. informd daniel foster son born ys morn. luis hamlin paid 12/. meeting mr ths hamlins neighs. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 6-10, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 6 10, 1799 6 7 clear warm. mr ballard son jonas hallowell. old lady hamlin pigg us. son lambd killd drest one roast. bakt brewd mended cloaths cyrus, feel well could wish. sally spun 1 skein mended stockins nurst child. home. killd pigg wd 14 lb. 7 1 clear warm comfortable air. mr ballard walkt meeting. came home noon. son dagt lambard came took breakfast us, famely dind cyrus hors went mr john browns hepsy, arivd [5]h pm. meeting forenn. ordinance ye supper administred. hepsy brown came 8 2 clear except shower aftern. mr ballard unwell day, wrode sons aftern. girls washt sally andrews went away. gave 2/ cash shee done since shee came cyrus went pitts tn morn. home. sally andr went 9 3 x. birth capt abm pages son. xx. clear pleasant. calld 6h m capt abm page go see wife labour. shee safe deld 10h 40m fine son wd 12lb _. left infant 1h pm cleverly. recd 9/. mrs page child 11 years past till mr ballard son jonas. went hallowell 4 o clok bot pages store 8 yds black lubstring 9/6 pr yd, 12 dol 4/; 1_ yds lining 1 skein silk, 1 dolr; 1_ yds ribbond /10d 1:3; doct pages, 1 oz spermaseta /9. capt abm pages. birth 26th. recd9/. went hallowell aftern. 10 4 clear pleast. mr ballard went son jonas. went son lambds houghing cucumbers, mr burtuns. dagt old lady hamlin, mrss crage lidia mc kekney tea. mr burtun paid crickery assisting wife illness 30 may last. 1 boul 4/6, 1do 2/6, 1do 1/6, 1 pitcher 3/, chamr pot 1/6. calld mr pittss. hepsy picking wool mending hous work. mr burtuns son lambds. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 11-18, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 11 18, 1799 11 5 x. birth church williamss son first born. xx. clear. mr ballard went son jonas. workt gardin foren. mrss dingley childn elijah moore dind calld 2h pm see wife church williams labour. shee safe deld 10 evn son, first born. tarried night, patient well could expected. church williams. birth 27. mrss dingley dind. receivd 9/7 service. 12 6 cloudy rain. left patient cleverly 4h morn relurnd home, went bed slept, went seting plants. mrss densmr plants us. ditoes. 13 7 clear warm. felt well could wish, sorted part wool. mr ballard son jon laid floor barn. hepsy hook, bot pr shoes comb. home. 14 1 clear good air. famely attended worship except self, feel able. dagt lambard came took diner us afler meeting pickt currents allso. hepsy brown conducted home. home. dagt lambd meeting. 15 2 clear warm. mr ballard son jonas, lamb killd wd 8 lb quarter. mr dingley 1 quarter. hepsy washt. feel well, something gardin. home. 16 3 clear. mr ballard went coart. capt coxes lady, gershoms wife dagt dagt ballard dind. mr cox joind us tea. set table doors reason heat house. jona came wife, took tea dad. home, compy. 17 4 x. birth isaac stones son. xx. clear. mr ballard coart. dagt lambd came make ma black silk gown. calld 12 o clok 15 m go see wife isaac stone labour. shee deld 6h pm 3d son. left inft well could expected 8, got safe home. dagt lambd walkt home attended husband. son town sleeps isaac stones. birth 28th. recd 12/ reward. 18 5 clear. mr ballard coart, son town allso. hepsy cleaning hous. hollowell business. hepsy son lambds aftern. mr georg brown sleeps walk cruches. home. mr brown sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 19-26, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 19 26, 1799 19 6 clear warm. mr ballard mr brown went coart house. went son lambd s, dagt finisht goun. sewd old mr lambd came sons, family well. son lambds. shee finisht blak goun. 20 7 clear till near night cloudy cool. mr ballard returnd coart 1h pm went sons. cyrus came home pitts tn went see timy hanskum receiv 20 stripes punishment thieft. mrss dingley childn hepsy mr hinkleys. home. timyty hanskum receivd punishment thieft. 21 1 clear warm. mr ballard, self cyrus attended worship. contribution relief mr georg brown, cash 15 dolars, subscriptions wool, &c, &c. son dagt lambd son meeting. meeting. contribution mr brown. 22 2 clear warm. felt unwell morn, sett little till afler 9h m. mrss capin calld see mr ballard cyrus went son jon hepsy piking wool. home. mrss capin allin lambd 3 years old day. 23 3 clear warm. mr ballard cyrus son jon hepsy washt went carry warp mrss hinkley weav, 42 skeins lining. grand son jon came brot cherrys. done hous work pickt wool. home. 24 4 clear warm. home, pickt wool. old lady pollard came tarries night. mr ballard cyrus jon home, mrss pollard 25 5 clear hott. mr ballard cyrus jonas. mrss pollard went 9h morn. walkt far mr densmores, calld mr dingleys, pikt wool came home. polly hodges allin lambd mr densmores dingleys. mrss pollard went 26 6 x. birth mr martins 2nd dagt. xx. clear warm. mr ballard cyrus jon calld see mrss martin hallowell 10h morn. shee safe deld 4h 30m pm second child dagt. left inft cleverly arivd home 7. mr martin gave 12/ service, 33 years old day. assistants capt neys lady mrss smith molloy. mrss beeman come till birth. phraim mr gillets hous raisd aftern. mr martins, hallowell. birth 29th.recd 12/ rewd. gatherd cucumbers, sent dagtlambds. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 27-31, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 27 31, 1799 27 7 x. birth mr gows dagt 4th child. xx. rainy. calld 1h 35m morn go see mrss gow labour. walkt rain reacht mr gows 1h 50m, found patient deld dagt help mrss tucker little done doct page. got bed dresst infant, tarried attended till 7 returnd home. found famely breakfast. receivd 6/ mr gow. samuel trask came go see dagt lambd. went came home evng. mr gows. birth 30th. recd 6/. 28 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus attended worship foren, aftern. mr brown came tarried night us. drest feet. mr livermore see meeting son lambds. mr brown 29 2 clear except shower. went mr blaks foren, dind dagt pollard aftern. old lady pollard, mrss blak, dagt pollard came son lambds, spent aftern. dagt ballard joind us. returnd home evn. mr ballard cyrus jonas, husband son jona tea lambds. mr blaks son lambds. dagt pollard others 30 3 clear warm. mr ballard cyrus jon hepsy mr hinkleys. mr densmore came desired go see mr beadles son sick. mrss thomas came staid house walkt found ye patient sick. fear complaint putred kind, administred clister, prepaired comphry, mallows mellolott. mr beadles see sick child. 31 4 light shower morn. mr ballard cyrus went jon cyrus came home noon bring lamb. wrode mr lambds mr dagt washing. esqr haywoods lady mrss pitts came took tea mr ballard cyrus allso. ephm well. polly hodges went visit lucy page. son lambards. mrss haywood pitts tea. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 12 17, 1799 12 2 clear. mr ballard sett new sharon, cyrus son jonas. son selvanus [hatches] calld allin lambd day. hepsy washt went home informd barn mr hallowells burnt litning last evng. home day feel fatagud little work. dagt cleverly, mrss pickford allso. home. mr ballard sett new sharon. 13 3 clear warm. went son lambards early morn, went river. wife babe cleverly. saml, polly childn came son lambds. dagt went ye kitchen. 14 4 clear. cyrus went jonas, saml came allin. hepsy pickt wool. mrss livermore took tea home. 15 5 x. birth amos partridges son. xx. clear. cyrus went jonas, saml came go see dagt lambd. shee concerned infant. tarried till near night amos partridg came go see wife labour. shee safe deld 9h evn son, 3d child. shee infant well could expected. tarried night. mr ballard returnd new sharon noon. son lambds mr partridgs. birth 36th. recd12/ novr 19th reward. 16 6 clear except light showers. left patients cleverly 9h morn returnd son lambds, find dagt well shee infant cleverly. spent day mrss capin came near sun sett came home. mrss whitwell calld see us, took tea. find hepsy unwell poisoned face hands. washt spirit ointed sweet oil hous work, finisht 11h evn. mr partridgs son lambds. mrss capin came 17 7 clear part day. mr ballard got wood, cyrus went pitts tn. went hook, calld see mrss pickford, find comfortable. inft soar mouth. mr burjess, breast soar; mr martins, wife scouring floor. mr norcross hinklys, well mr pickfords neigrs. yarn dagt pollard spun 1799. lining 29_ skeins, tow 13 skeins. [sic]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 18-23, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 18 23, 1799 [18] 1 clear. felt unwell foren. hepsy bad poison. went son lambds aftern, find well. shee pain head. infant carried presented baptism, name calld thomas. mr whitwells son calld wilm. returnd home evn, dagt easier. son [lambards], babe baptisd. name thomas. [19] 2 clear warm day cool night. felt unwell, hepsy unwell. mr ballard town business committee road river winthrop. home. 20 3 [birth isaac savage 2nd dagt.] clear, cold morn, warm day. calld 10m past midnight go see wife isaac savage labour. reside phinias pains. shee deld 2nd dagt 3d child 3h morn. left well could expected came son lambds 5h 30m, find dagt ill. tarried day night. applyd feaverfue head poultises feet shee seemd easier night; slept little, babe cleverly. isaac savages. birth 37th. came son lambds. [21] 4 clear. dagt. gave senna kind operation shee seems much comfortable feeble. son town dagt ballard came mr town came home famely well. son lambds. son town came [22] 5 clear warm. son town went home, mr ballard cyrus hauling stone seller. mrs dingley paid 3/ capt cains acount. home, feel well. nabby livermore home. son town left [23] 6 clear warm. mr ballard cyrus hauling stone. hepsy washt. unwell sett little. wives saml phillip norcross came visit mrss livermore calld. mr ballard informs dagt lambd better fright little dagt runing away, found safe. home, compy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 24-28, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 24 28, 1799 24 7 clear warm. mr ballard cyrus giting stones seller underpining. cleaning bedroom bedstead buggs. hepsy work house cleand west room. calvin ballard dind informd brother derias cast away sea; 25 left ship escaped boat landed [ireland], went liverpool, took shiping came boston. home, calvin ballard 25 1 x. birth john dunns son. xx. clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting day. attended afternn, calld mr young go see wife john dunn labour. shee safe deld 7h 30 evn fine son. tarried night. shee child cleverly. mr dunn married last thursday, 20 years old last july. meeting mrs dunn. birth 38th. recd9/ novr 23. 26 2 clear. walkt mrs dunn son lambards, calld mr child go see wife infant sick; mother swelld legg, infant soar mouth. calld afternoon see mr millers infant, unwell. returnd mr childs; directly calld son lambards, little daught fitt, revivd reacht seems high feavor. applied burdoc leavs stomach feet gave syrrip mullin, shee rest. mr lambd went watch james andrews suspected thieft. quantity goods found trunk fathers house. mr youngs, childs, millers son lambds. little dolly fitt. 27 3 clear cool. went son lambds mr childs, find mrs child feeble legg much swelld. infant yet living better, fitt morn. bound mrs childs limb burdock leavs wilted vinegar spirrit, givs great relief. lefe returnd son lambds, find dolly unwell yet. gave senna. calld directly go see son esqr davis, gave senny rheubarb; mother, son jon son lambds, mr childs, pitts son jonas. mrss capin son lambds. mrs conry went home. 28 4 clear. mr ballard cyrus hearing james andrews tryal thieft foren. mr ballard lecture aftern. revd mr [hall] performd. calld [took] coffee dagt lambd. mrs pitts childn [allso]. lecture son lambds. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 29-Sep. 2, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 29 september 2, 1799 [29] 5 cloudy, raind aftern. mr ballard surveying mr whitwell. cleand spring done matters house. hepsy washt, cyrus brot water went mr [carters], bot 2 lb butter /10 2 lb suger 1/2_. home, cleand spring. [30] 6 clear except light shower. mr ballard cyrus went jon returnd. mr ballard fit collic. hepsy see dagt lambard, finds well shee mr childs finds poorly. allin lambd came home hepsy. home. [31] 7 clear. calld 9h morn mr childs, wife inft sick. tarried till 9h evn, calld see mrss hill labour. mr ballard cyrus farm. mr childs mr hills. 1 1 x. birth mr hills son. xx. cloudy rain. mrss hill safe deld 2h 30m morn son, second child. left well could expected 5, wrode fort, came water. went bed slept, rose attended public worship ordinanc super. went mr childs intermition, find dear little babe alive distress. may god deal mercy prepare concerned holy calld son lambds, well son seen 27 years day. text foren thesns [v] c 8.9 verss; aftern math xi c 28:29:30 [ver]. mr hills. birth 39th. [recd] 9/ rd. mr childs son lambds. 27 [yrs] old ys [day]. 2 2 clear. mr ballard went son jonas forenn, cyrus pittstn see vesel launched, hepsy work daugt lambd. allin came home home, done hous work, swept rooms sellar chambers. mr atkins desired readiness wait wife soon. informd infant mr child expired 5h morn, remains interd tomorrow 3h pm. home. mr child infant expired. dagt lambd 27 years old day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 3-9, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 3 9, 1799 3 3 clear. mr ballard cyrus farm, hepsy son lambds. home. widows lathrop sewall p. bullin allso. harvesting sage hous work. home. mr childs infant interd. 4 4 x. birth anson hoiets son. xx. clear. mr ballard cyrus farm. went son lambds, dind calld anson hoiet go see wife labour. shee safe deliverd second son 5th child 9h evn, cleverly. tarried till day light. mr saml preskott sleept son lambds mr hoiets. birth 40th. recd 9/ reward. 5 5 cloudy morn. left patient well could expected reacht home 6h 25m morn, find mr saml preskott took breakfast mr livermore turnd cattle feed hous. mr ballard finsing gardin fence. went bed slept. mrss dingley sister calld mr hoietts. 6 6 rainy. hepsy went son lambds help daugt quillt coat, finisht fell hors way reason sliping. walkt home, hepsy wrode brot allin behind sleeps son lambds. 7 7 cloudy. mr ballard collic doct cony calld. nursing matters. took pills castor oil medisin got relief. pukt medisin. slept little. home. mr ballard sick, doct cony calld. 8 1 cloudy till 10h morn, clear pleasant afterwards. mr ballard remains unwell yet. doct calld see gave caster oil 2 anidines. son dagt lambard came see ephm allso. mr livermore dingley wives calld see home, mr ballard sick. 9 2 clear. mr ballard better. home tending sons jona lambd wives mr ballard pukt exceedingly, brot excrament. hopes allmost vanished recovery. home, mr ballard better. jona sett source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 10-14, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 10 14, 1799 [10] [3] rainy. mr ballard sick yet. hopes allmost vanisht recover god infinitily good wise dealings us, really wish able say done!!! hard thus say seems oposite present comfort. husband low aparantly symtoms near close life. neighbours came see mr dingly tarries night. distrest husband seemd little revivd 4h morn. sister williams, hapened visit, rose went bed took rest. home. mr ballard continues puke ill. dagt lambd others see cyrus brot two cows us improve. 11 4 clear morn, presented happy prospect dear compannion better) favour immence fine). great god glory shall thine). sister williams went son augustuss returnd noon, took leav us sett home. jona came son cyrus 43 years old day. mr livermore dinsmore sett mr ballard undrest went bed 11h, slept till 3h morn rose reason cramp, mr livermore went home. home. sister williams went home. 12 5 cloudy foren rain. mr ballard comfortable, phisic operatid. mrss livermore see mrss haywood pattin evng. took care mr ballard night much fatagud. home. son town sleeps mr ballard better. 13 6 clear. mr ballard remains better. son town came evn sleeps went bed slept night. mr ballard walkt morn. doct dagt lambd home. mr ballard doors. son town sleeps 14 7 cloudy rain]. mr ballard gits better. son town jason [pierce] joll white [dind] home. home. ephm sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 23-28, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 23 28, 1799 [23] 2 x. [birth gershom coxs 3d] dagt. xx. case 800th. clear foren. mr ballard gone [auguds], cyrus work road abov hepsy washing. himing strainers. leut benn porter wife inft mrss foster dind, supt slept calld 9h evn see wife capt gershom cox labr. shee safe deld 11h evn 3d dagt. left cleverly 1h recd 9/ rewd. deld 9 dols 10 cents p. bullin [sent] [por capt greshom coxs. birth 43d.recd 9/ reward. leut porter wife others 24 3 cloudy rain. left patients cleverly 6h morn. came home water, find famely friends takeing breakfast. left soon mr ballard went hook son lambds, conducted allin home. cyrus work road. ditoes. mr porter wife mrssfoster left breakfast. 25 4 clear cloudy, raind evn. cald see mrss pattins youngest child, unwell. calld son lambds, shee babe unwell. one cows got went far esqr haywards. cyrus went brot back. workt road oxen. mr minot took [muinits] mr ballard drawn price 50 cents. pay wido pattins see infant unwell. mr ballard son jonas. 26 5 clear pleast. mr ballard jonas, cyrus workt high way oxen. churnd made chees. dagt lambd, sons, polly pollard mr lambd came acompany home, unwell. pickt wool. home. dagt lambd polly pollad 27 6 cloudy. mr ballard cyrus went got apples son jonas house, 27 bushl, brot one home. hepsy hook fort. thos hinkleys wife made settlement, paid 4/11d owed home. 28 7 x. birth mr atkins dagt. xx. clear. calld [1]h morn go see mrss atkins. arivd [day] break, found deld mr james hinkleys wife. came home breakfast. brot home 24 yds cloth mrs page wove pickt fethers old ducks &c. mr atkins. birth 44th. recd 7/6. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 29-Oct. 6, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 29 october 6, 1799 29 1 rainy morn, clear aftern. mr ballard hepsy went meeting hallowell. home. genl sewall jery badcock wife calld home. 30 2 clear cool. mr ballard, cyrus hepsy went parade see review. son lambd famely cyrus conducted sister home evn. jack ballard sleeps asa pierc waited hepsy home ys evn. home. dagt lambd famely mr ballard, cyrus hepsy 1 3 clear day. mr ballard surveying josept stackpole. mending cloaths mr ballard cyrus. mrss duttun dagt dind ehphalet robbins calld hepsy washt broke wool. home. 2 4 x. birth kimbs dagt fort. xx. clear. dug part beets. mr ballard cyrus farm. calld 4h pm go see mrss kimbal fort, shee labour safe deld fine daugt 11h evn. left 11h 10m went see wife john jackson sidney, found unwill. sleep night. mr kimbals. birth 45th. recd asa rewd 23d inst 9/. 3 5 cloudy. mr jacksons, wife unwell day, seems comfortable night. lodged john jacksons. 4 6 cloudy. patient much better came son pollards. night, good nights rest. ditoes son pollards. 5 7 cloudy rain. calld son pollards georg boltons see youngest child sick canker, find sick child. tarried childn day night. son pollards georg boltons, son expird[ys] night. 6 1 cloudy showers. informd georg boltons child expired night past. left son pollards famely well usual, returnd home noon. calld see mrss kimbal, find inft well could expected; son lambd, find operation itch. find famely well arival home. went see wife genl sewall meeting. son pollards, kimbals son lambds, mr gills genl sewalls mr pittss. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 7-14, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 7 14, 1799 7 2 x. birth john jacksons 2nt son. xx. clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus house. calld mr leanard go see mrss jackson, wrode hors son pollards, jacksns. left home 1h pm, patient safe deld 6 3d child 2nd son. left cleverly 8h evn came son lambd s 11h 50m, tarried night. calld son pollards, gone n. yarmoth. famely well. john jacksons. birth 46th. georg boltons son interd. wrote bror jon 8 3 rainy. took breakfast son lambds went spent day shubal pittss. mr bunker better sally taylor remains sick. mr ballard cyrus went hous returnd. husband complains pain back. son lambds mr pittss. 9 4 clear part day. mr ballard cyrus got wood forn, mr bd went survey hous lotts mr whipple hallowell. son town came home sleeps mending cloths. hepsy washt went mr hinkleys. heringtons wife went past water, shee going portland husband. 12 soldiers sett place water. home. son town sleps night. 10 5 rainy day. son town left breakft. home. began stockin self. mrs dingley made prest pork stakes. home. 11 6 rainy morn. mr ballard cyrus giting wood forn, went jon aftern. revd pastor returnd home day. home. noah watson sleeps home. 12 7 cloudy morn evn, sun shone middle day. mr ballard cyrus jon hepsy son lambards. dresing lining yn hous work, feel much fatagud night. home. hepsy lambds. 13 1 clear. meeting son lambds pitss. saml, polly allin dolly lambd allin sleeps. meeting son lambds. 14 2 x. birth jason peirces dagt. x. rainy. calld 4h 10m go see wife jason peirce sidney. left home ]h 30m, went fast possible, reacht 6 7 morn. find patient deld help mrss jackson. drest inft came home 1h pm, went see mr dingley sick. jason peirces, son pollards &dingleys. birth 47th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 15-24, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 15 24, 1799 15 3 rainy. home. home. 16 4 clear. mr ballard cyrus hous. home, washt new cloath. hepsy spun. mr lambd, wife mrss capin supt feel fatagud work. wind blew gardn fence ys night. home. son dagt lambd mrss capin 17 5 clear, windy cold. mr ballard cyrus house. mr brown came hepsy shee sett home 2h pm. washing scouring yarn, feel unfitt service. mr stone, townsend, sleeps slept night octr 5th 97. home. hepsy left went fathers. 18 6 clear, cold windy. home hous work. mr ballard cyrus hous. home. 19 7 clear. mr ballard cyrus house. went see mr dingly, better. two men thee name stone sleep mr dingleys. 2 mr stones [sleep hr]. 20 1 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. went see mr dingly evn. mr ballard went lantn conducted home. patient better. mrss thomas lidia densmore came watch lidia nud came work. ditoes. 21 2 clear pleast. home, hous work. lidia spun, mr ballard cyrus farm. mr stone sleeps informd mr dingley better, ulser broke last night. home. 22 3 clear wind northwd. calld 7h ys morn genl sewall go see lady labour, women calld 10h evn. mr ballard farm, cyrus winthrop. lidia washt cleand floors. genl sewalls. wido howard deceasedat 4h 45m ys morn. 23 4 x. birth genl h. sewalls dagt. xxx. cloudy. mrss sewall safe deld 10m morn 8th child 5th dagt. shee viry ill little cleverly shee put bed. took care till day light, short nap sleep. left inft 10 o clock well could expected. recd 12/ rewd. calld mr gills, inft unwell; mr millers, kimbals, pitts son lambds. mrs baxter sally taylor mending. ditoes. birth 48th. recd rewd 12/. [24] 5 clear. mr ballard collic morn. rose gave hot tody pipper, got ease; went house took care board s, returnd noon. went colo howards attend funeral old lady howard mr ballard attacked pain pukeing severe oblidged return home. bathd feet, got warm bed put kegg hott water feet, warm bricks back, belly parts affected pain. got easier 9h evn slept. gave medisin except castor. brother moore calld see us, disered request doct cony come see arivd 10h evn, gave phisic, accused going mr dingleys sickness objecting prescriptions prescribeing seting mrss dingley crying giving opinion disease, one many instances done must deny till bring recollection. world tryals, may calld meet serv good. went attend funeral widow howard. mr ballard haveing collic, returnd ye interment. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
