title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 30-Nov. 8, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 30 november 8, 1799 30 4 cloudy part day. mrss smith left 10hm. mr ballard went [sic] hous work early. done hous work pikt wool, lydia spun. home, mrss smith left 31 5 cloudy day. mr ballard hous, cyrus got wood. done hous work pikt wool. mrs hitty pierce dind lydia spun. home. 1 6 clear forn, cloudy aftern cold. hous work. mr ballard cyrus went hous, carried ash box, bed bedstead, beets f. turnips gardin roots. mr ballard attended lecture. invited take tea colo north. mrss dingley mrs paten gone. pikt wool ys evn. lecture. text psalm 4th, 4 vrs. took tea colo norths. 2 7 clear part ye day. mr ballard cyrus ye house. done hous work, bakt brewd. 2 indiens dined lydia spun 1 skein hose yn helpt work. thoms devenport wishes ready wait wife decemr next. home. 3 1 clear. attended public worship. mr ballard, self cyrus partook good dinner son lambds; father mr gill wife dagt ballard. mr kitridge calld go see youngest child, canker mouth. mr aime sleeps green. wrot letter send sister walers. meeting. sacramant supper administred. wrote evn sister waters. son town eunice stackpole marrid]. 4 2 clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus house. done hous work, doubled wick yarn mended small cloaths mr ballard. lydia spun. home. 5 3 clear. mr ballard surveying mr vauhn. done hous work, cleand store chamber put things mooving. pickt wool evn. cyrus workt jonas. home. 6 4 clear part day. done house work cleand swept west chamber. pickt wool evng. mr ballard surveying mr vn. cyrus went ye team hauld load wood mr fletcher got hous. lydia finisht spining grey hoes yarn. home. 7 5 birth james blacks dagt. clear pleasant windy. calld see mrss black 7h 30m morn. shee unwell day, women calld 9h evn shee deld 11h 20m 4th dagt 6th child. tarried night, david pollards wife allso. mr blacks. birth 49th. 8 6 clear morn, cloudy aftern, rain evn. returnd home 1h pm, left patients cleverly. helpt washing, wound yarn knitt moses partridges ezekiel pages ye foren. mr ballard cyrus house yesterd ditoes. 1 year ys day dagt [town] expird. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 9-16, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 9 16, 1799 9 7 rainy foren. house work puting things removeing. feel much fatagud. miss hepsy much. mr ballard house day. home. dagt lambd mr dingleys. 10 1 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mr ballard cyrus meeting, lydia uncle norriss. home. son ephm dagt lambd evng. aniversary burial dear dagt town. home. dagt lambd son ephm evn. 11 2 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mr ballard cyrus house, took cows lydia washt, made 41 dozn candles. home. 12 3 cloudy, raind night. mr ballard cyrus hous. prepareing removing. home. 13 4 clear windy. done hous work. mr ballard cyrus hous. son town came evng, sleeps mr whealor exprest wish wait wife needed. may god prolong lives happiness new made pare, may shee fill place mother mistress acceptance great parent univerce, may childn commited parental care obedient ready receive good counsil times, may god peace delight dwell amen. home. son town sleeps mrs eunice stackpole joind mariage 3d inst. 14 5 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mr ballard house. cyrus samuel trask giting wood. mrss dingley 1h pm inquire henrymc causland ran saml saw runing streat. lydia fixing things removing. scoured puter &c. picking wool evng. home. 15 6 clear. mr ballard son pollards house. striping feathers baking pies sewing. cyrus [geting] wood. lydia hous work spun mr claps famely came house furniture evng. home. mr clap brot famely hous [3]h evng. unaprisd coming till ready remove. 16 7 clear pleast. mr ballard hous, cyrus carried load matters. made woolin shirt mr ballard since 9h evn last. lydia things house. mr ballard went early ys morn informd mr livermore son bradwell past stool well. boy denyed source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 17-23, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 17 23, 1799 17 1 cloudy cold. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. home. mr balld mr dingleys evn, youngest child 1 year old day. ephm samuel came help cyrus git ducks home. got ym ye landing lost sight dark. home. 18 2 cloudy. mr ballard hous, cyrus went aftern. went hallowell call arearages receive anything promises. mrss molloy removd habitation academy mr martins. mrss clap daugt took tea hepsy brown returnd liv david robbins sleeps husband reaconed. hallowel. 19 3 clear part day pleast, cold evn. mr ballard cyrus went ye house load things. doubled hoes yarn began make shirts cyrus. hepsy done hous work twisted 14 knotts yarn sewed evn. lydia went son jonas. mr amos partridg calld gave 12/ rewd assisting wife ye 15th august tast. home. mr partridg calld 20 4 clear cold. mr ballard surveying mr ingarhams. cyrus hook cuting wood bringing water brewing. hepsy done house work workt shirts. felt unwell aftern. home. 21 5 clear cool. puting things. hepsy washt ye north bedrooms kitchen. mr ballard ye house, cyrus cart oxen, brot barril parmers. mrsmc causland henry calld home. 22 6 cloudy rain. mr ballard cyrus went load stuff. mrs mc causland calld harry went home behavior mr dingley wd keep longer. heart aicks dear mammy must present situation. makeing shirt mr ballard, hepsy one cyrus. home. 23 7 clear part day. finishing mr ballards shirt. cyrus hous. went mr dingleys aftern. mr dun sent 9/ assisting wife. mr dingly supt mr dingleys. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 24-30, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 24 30, 1799 24 1 clear pleast till aftern, raind evn. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. mrss dingley came see cyrus went light see home. mr kider winslow, mrs crosby augusta, published. home. mrss dingly evn. 25 2 clear part day. mr ballard house. cyrus went brot ye team carried 1 load things. home. home. 26 3 clear. removd howard farm son jona purchased savage bolton. arivd 5h pm. son dagt ballard childn came see us new habitation. removd house. 27 4 clear part day. mr ballard cyrus brot part things left. jessy bullin wife sist calld old mrss whealor allso. ephm thomas made partition north room entry. home. 28 5 clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus, jona wife mrs peirce attended worship, day appointed thanksgiving. husband, self, son dagt lambd took super mr shubal pitts. calld son jonas evn, reacht home 30m past [1]h. meeting. 29 6 snowd. mr ballard home. cyrus went slead matters. ephm thomas made chamber stairs. home, done hous work. hepsy bakt part made loop goun. indiens calld home. 30 7 clear cold. mr ballard got wood, cyrus went slead load hay son lambd; wife son dagt ballard, son jona asa peirce took super us. roast veal. ephm thomas finisht working ye present. laid ye entry floor put door kitchen bedroom. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 1-7, 1799 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 1 7, 1799 1 1 clear cool. mr ballard, cyrus jona meeting. son dagt lambd cyrus, ephm hepsy took super son jona. son lambd ephm thomas went son pollard work. saml trask came conducted dagt home. lydia densmore published mr smith. son jonas, supt dagt lambd evng. 2 2 clear pleast. mr ballard got wood, cyrus went brote 33 sheep home. hepsy house work sewed shirt. clearing chambers mended small cloaths cyrus. son jona wife spent ye evng shee doubling yarn. home. jona wife evng. 3 3 clear pleasant day, snowd 7h evn. regulateing things. mr mr [sic] ballard got wood, cutt beef &c. cyrus helpt saml git sheep home. bought new tea kettle brot home. old mr pollard calld see us. home. old mr pollard 4 4 clear, cold windy. mr ballard jona makeing slead tongue. house knitt home. 5 5 clear till evn began snow. home. mrs peirce s. tole spent ye evng knitt mr balds buskin. home. 6 6 x. birth mr whealors dagt. xx. snowd. calld mr whealor day break go see wife labour. shee safe deld daugt, first born, 10h m. tarried dined, returnd far son lambds, tarried supt saml conducted home 7h evn. mr whealors son lambds. birth 50th. recd 9/. 7 7 snowd. home, well could wish. son lambd brot allin left went conducted dagt pollard house. hepsy prepareing make pies. stag son jonas hookt mare shee expired soon. home. peris hamlins wife deld mrss mosier. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, december 8 15, 1799 8 1 clear. mr ballard went meeting. sons ballard, pollard lambd, wives childn, mr mrs pierce jack pierce took supper us meeting. home. childn meeting. 9 2 clear. home. sorted apples. felt unwell ys aftern. mr barbreck belgrade mr saunders took 10 sheep mr ballard. home. 10 3 clear cold. mr ballard coart, cyrus geting cuting wood, hepsy washt. dagt ballard double yn, childn jack unwell went home. mrs pierce took coffee us. hepsy spent evng began snow 10h evn. home. 11 4 clear. home. hepsy washt room. son town, mr gill wife, son jona wife supt us. mr town [mr] gill sleep home. mr town mr gill wife 12 5 clear pleast. mrss gill spent aftern son jonas; came wife, mr ballard cyrus see coart, hepsy sons evn spin. son jon 13 6 clear cold. mr ballard hear coart. home. mrss page came herbs dagt whealor. hepsy went sons spin twist yn mop. home. mrss page 14 7 clear. home. mr ballard got wood went town. bakt pies bread. home. 15 1 clear pleasant. mr ballard attended worship day. went warm mr robinsons. jane black calld see marm aunt baxter. mr warrin past thro operation tapt fore noon. sally tole, jack peirce son jonas childn supt us. hepsy spent evng asa peirce came home meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, december 16 26, 1799 16 2 clear morn, snowd night. home, helpt ye hous work, brot wood knitt home. 17 3 snowd. home kniting. finisht mr ballards legins began cyruss. home. 18 4 cloudy part day. home, [binding] legins kniting. polly hodges, rispha capin nabby soal evng. home. 19 5 snowd. home, knit cyrus legin. hepsy spining [wool] yarn. ye anneversary mariage, 45 years. home. 20 6 birth mr saunders son. clear. calld 10h morn go see mrs saunders labour. arivd 1, find patient deld son help mrss edson. performd necesary. taried thro night. left mother child well could expected came home 9h [evng]. dagt ballard childn dind. son daugt lambd supt us. mr saunders. birth 51st. sincerecd 6/. dagt ballard lambd 21 7 cloudy snow. cut made mr ballard pair drawers, knit mr ballard hallowell. home. 22 1 clear. mr ballard, cyrus attended worship. went son lambds intermition. allin mr capins, rachel sons, hepsy son jonas evng. meeting. text math 6th 24th. 23 2 snow night. mr ballard surveying judg north. home. dagt ballard part childn tea. home. 24 3 clear cold. mr ballard surveying judg cony. home. stag hookt son jonas colt let guts wife hepsy helpt put sewd wound. home. jonas colt hookt stag. 25 4 pleast. colt expired killd stag, mr waid assisted. home. hepsy jonas helping wife. home. 26 5 clear pleast. home. mrs baxter sent 21 skeins lining warp mrs wellch weav. home. [2] 5 [birth davenport dagt.] clear pleast. calld 1h 30m morn see wife thos davenport safe deld 3d daugt 5 child 12 o clock ye day. returnd home 4 pm. sons lambd ephm finisht outside house. mr davenports. birth 1st [3] 6 clear. home unwell. son jonas wife took tea home. [5] 1 clear cold. famely attend worship except self. felt unwell. home. content: martha ballard's diary, january 11 21, 1800 11 7 clear. home, finisht allin lambds mitts. home. 12 1 snowd. calld son lambds see thoms, unwell. gave senna seemd better. wrode home mr ballard evng. son lambds. thomas unwell. 13 2 cloudy, snowd night. home. hepsy past operation ye itch. mr ballard jona mending slead. cyrus went mill son lambds. thomas much better. home. 14 3 snowd. polly faught left 1-2/1 busl corn son lambd. kniting mitts cyrus. wrote sister waters sent mr burtun carrie boston. home. wrote sister waters. 15 4 clear pleasant. brother moore, wife 2 sons, son dagt lambd, mr truant lady, son jona wife home. home, compy. 16 5 clear fore n, cloudy aftern. went mr parkers mrs welches foren, kniting ys aftern. jonas wife mrs welch sent cloath, 20 1/2 yards. mr parkers mrs welches. 17 6 snowd. home, finisht 3d pair mitts knit prest weak. home. death old mrss littlefield. 18 7 rainy. home sewing. home. 19 1 x birth james herimans dagt. xx. clear, pleast son windy. mr ballard, jon wife attended worship. went evng. shubal pitts wife calld 9h evn see wife mr heryman, shee deld soon arivd, dagt. shee wrode sleigh 13 miles 7, illness shee sett doct quimbys. went see mrss robinson, shee ill cold. son jon mr herimans. birth 4th.recd letter decr 6th fm sister waters news ytbror jonas dagt sophia dead. 20 2 clear till noon cast. mr ballard jona ye meddow, cyrus breakng flax. widdow farewell mrss pierce kniting stockin mr ballard, hepsy washt. home. 21 3 clear. son jonas. mrss titcomb son mr ballard got wood. son jonas. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 22-Feb. 2, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 22 february 2, 1800 22 4 clear. home kniting. mrs saunders silva edson mr benn browns wife took tea son jona wife sleigh ride. home. 23 5 clear. kniting, finisht stockin husband; home day. home. 24 6 clear pleast. mr ballard, self, cyrus, hepsy bror wilm, son town supt son jon fine turkey roasted. son town, hains learned wm brown slept son jonas. 25 7 snowd windy. mr ballard went town, company homes. josiah parker calld dagt ballard see wife dusk. shee ill arivd. mr parkers. 26 1 x. birth josiah parkers [3d] son 7th child. x. clear cold. patient safe deld 5h morn fine son, husband went conducted mrss stone dagt came home 8h morn. went bed reacht home slept. mr ballard wt meeting. josiah parkers. birth 5th. recd 8/ crosbys store. 27 2 clear cold. home. home. 28 3 clear cold. home kniting. home. 29 4 clear cold. home, finisht pair hoes mr ballard. jona wife went son pollards. hepsy went came home midnight. colder winter. home. 30 5 clear cold morn. fire put seller. son pollard lambd, wives babes, rhoda came meet beens diner. son jona wife joind us tea. rhoda went home dagt hannah tarries night. home. sons ballard, pollard, lambard wives 31 6 clear. rhoda pollard hanh ballard foren. calld 1h pm go see wife james moore read field, find unwell. mrss gould taylor tarried night. james moores. 1 7 snow storm. mr moores, wivis sist calld evng. patient unwell night. ditoes. 2 1 birth james moores 3d son. clear pleast. mrss welman calld day mrs moore safe deld son 7h morn. left infant well could expected arivd home 3h pm, receivd 4_ lb salt pork mr moore. ditoes. birth 6th. sons jona ephm hereat evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 3-12, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 3 12, 1800 3 2 clear pleast. son town, jona, mr goodin wives supt us. mrs pierce, rhoda hannah, le faett saml trask. home. home, compy. son town wife sleep 4 3 snowd raind. mr ballard self cyrus, son town wife, son lambd wife spent aftern evng son jonas. hitty son sleep son jonas. son town wife sleep 5 4 cloudy rain snow. mr ballard, self, son jona wife, pollard, lambd, pitts, old mr gill, wives, visited. mr gill, revd mr stone, capt haywood, wm thomas son ephm allso. young ones daunced. mr gills. son town went wh wife. 6 5 snowd clear part ye day. home. sons pollard jon wives hannah ballard hurt ankle, rhoda went home parents. home. childn 7 6 clear. went son jonas, hannah lame. went see mrs parker, find ill. put oinions feet gave decoction mugwort feaverfue came back sons. find lame hannah uneasy, tarried till 9h evn walkt home. son jonas mr parker. 8 7 clear pleast. went tarried mrss parker till evn. calld sons, find comfortable. mr parkers son jonas. 9 1 clear cold. calld wm chamberlin go brother johns wife. find unwell ill shee might tarried night, sufered ye cold. mr pilsbury expired aftern 4 o clock. john chamberlins. lambd wife went past evn. 10 2 birth john chamberlins dagt. clear cold. chamberlins, wife safe deld near midnight daughter. old mrss savage son jamess wife calld old lady self tarried till morn. chamberlins. birth 7th. 11 3 clear. came home chamberlins, left patients well could expected. went son jonas, hannah brot house tarried till evn. shee lame yet. ditoes son jonas. 12 4 clear morn, cloudy afternoon. james page, wife childn calld doct cony mrss fisher allso. mr ballard gone survey jaill yard. invited attend mr bunkers weding mrs fanny cocx. son jona wife went. hepsy tarried childn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 13-22, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 13 22, 1800 13 5 clear cold. went morn see hannahs foot, find easier shee cannot walk. went aftern see esqr warrin, find low. calld mr millers, herrimans dind mr burtuns. came home sun sett. mr blacks. find esqr warrin low. 14 6 clear, cold morn. mr ballard brot lamb frosen feet ears. home kniting. son jona wife spent evng us. shee weaning wilm. silva edson brot worsted yn shee spun, 8 double skeins. shee _ lb wool snowd night. home. son jon wife 15 7 snowd. kniting, finisht pair small stockins. began 4 o clock yesterday, knitt two pair weak. home. death esqt g. warrin. 16 1 clear cold. mr ballard, son jona jack went meeting. home. 17 2 clear. home, knitt stockin besides going 3 times barn take care sheep distress. shee brot 2 dead lambs. jonas wife home. gray makeing shoes. 18 3 clear pleast. mr ballard, self, cyrus, jona, wife 2 oldest sons attended meeting house. heard prayers funeral georg warrin esqr. interd masonic mode, number brithren society present. calld visited mrss crage foren. mr crages funeral esqr warrin. 19 4 clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus giting wood. son jona, wife son ephm gone belgrade. le faett wilm came tarried returnd spent evng us; went farther yn mr pollards. home. 20 5 clear pleast. home, knitt pair hoes wilm. hepsy binding shoes. home. jonas wife twisting yn. day 65 years old. 21 6 clear pleast. jona, wife asa peirce gone mr crosbys belgrade. hannah stayd mr ballard james gilly got wood. home. 22 7 day, recomendation president united states, set apart commemorate death genl georg washington. met meeting hous augusta assembled lodg hallowell. capt casts company malitia larg concoarce people. prayer deld ye revd mr stone, oration mr whitwell closing prayer mr gillet. meeting house death genlgeorg washington, ye aniversary death. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 23-Mar. 4, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 23 march 4, 1800 23 1 snowd. mr ballard meeting, son cyrus hepsy son pollards. sent childn pair wolen hoes. dagt ballard calld informs dagt unwell. home. 24 2 snowd raind foren, fine pleast aftern. dagt ballard, s. j. foster, wife oldest child evng. knit pair hoes thos lambd, part one dolly ys day. jona went sinclears hay. home. mr foster wife 25 3 clear cold. bror ebenz moore wrote bror jona, went sons see hannah, find better. knitt pair hoes dolly lambd. sons. 26 4 clear. home, knit pair socks mr ballard. son dagt lambd jona wife ephm supt us. home. childn 27 5 clear pleast. mr ballard son dagt lambd went son pollards, dind took tea. mr tole wife evng. son pollards. 28 6 clear part ye day. went son jonas early morn, home. hous work kniting dolly lambds mitts. hepsy went mr parkers, finds sick colds. son pollard, wife babe came son lambds. home. 1 7 severe snow storm. feel self unwell, went onto ye bed calld rise go son lambards see son pollards infant, find sick. gave senna rhubarb. son went home take care famely. son lambds. harry pollard sick 2 1 clear cold. mr ballard came see child intermition. sick yet. ditoes. 3 2 clear. babe better. son pollard lambd went doct cony come see babe, absent. son pollard came calld doct colman recommended castor oil; made use cony came evng, gave opineon dangerously ill, advised pursue cast oil sick thro night. doct left snake root, cammomile ingreedient parrigoric used acording direction punctilio affect, illness still increases. ditoes. mr stone visit. babe sick. 4 3 clear. childn yet. cony came gave babe emetic kind operation alas, cause yet removed. gave excesive washings brandy red oinions applyd belly feet. followed directions. mrss haywood polly pollard sett child, thot expireing 4h morn. ditoes. babe better. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 5-8, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 5 8, 1800 5 4 clear cold. babe sick indead. cony came, proposed put blister neck, cast hard reflections without grounds, think. may mercyfull god forgiv child fade away gave ghost 11h 55m evn, little struggle. mr pollard brot dagts see dear lillle distrest brother. may god teach us take visitation duty teacheth us. ditoes. babe expired 11h 55m evn frown brow. 6 5 clear cold. dagt ballard went home. son pollard, wife childn, son dagt lambd inft, left son lambds 4 o clock pm. saml trask wrode sleigh remains deposited. number friends came condole childn seems comfortable trouble. son jona brot home. feel fatagud. son jonas wife, mrs pitts mrss bunker self togither puting grave cloaths. cofin made mr gill, put remains therein. lookt pleast whin health sweat sleep. lord gave recalld self, may able bless holy name. ditoes. childn went home. remains child carrid allso. 7 6 clear cold. home husband absent know sorrow) went attend interment son pollarss child, son. revd mr stone invited attend. interment performed decency reacht home sun sett. hepsy went watcht mr parkers oldest dagt sick. informd, doct cony givs opinion, shee must soon die. son pollards. attended interment son. 8 7 clear cold. done part house work. hepsy returnd parkers, informs sally sick. mr ballard returnd runing line varsalboro harlim, fatagud. son ephm supt father. home. ephm evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 9-16, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 9 16, 1800 9 1 clear cold. son dagt pollard, two oldest childn, calld ys morn, fanny hodges mr ballard, cyrus self, jona, wife lefaett went meeting. revd mr stone discorsed psalm 19, 7 8 v. dagt ballard calld see abigail andrews pased thee operation taping dropsy, find comfortable. take refreshment, dagt went visit neigr parkers famely sick. find sally unwell. put blister side acording docts direction. meeting, mr andress mr parker. son lambds intermition. 10 2 clear pleast. home. mr ballard cyrus anual meeting. home. 11 3 cloudy morn. son jona wife sett 8h ys morn winslow, cyrus settlement things selves jona. cyrus selfe sett son pollards ten eleven, arivd twelve. find ym well could expected. son pollard, mr black wife babe sett yesterday seven mile brook see father pollard sick. doct cony went 9 inst see son pollards. 12 4 clear. son pollards. son polds. 13 5 clear cold. son pollards james boltons, dagt went ditoes james boltons. 14 6 clear. sons, returnd evn; informs father better. son lambard came conducted home. arived 11h 30m. mr ballard collic complaint sinc absent. son pollards. returnd fathers. 15 7 clear. home. dagt ballard three youngest childn shee well could wisht. knitt two pair hoes pair socks futed one pair hoes sinc left home tuesday. home. dagt ballard john shaws wf deld dagt mrs 16 1 clear. mr ballard famely went meeting. went see sally parker meeting, find seting better shee mr parkers. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 27-Apr. 1, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 27 april 1, 1800 27 5 clear pleast. son lambd famely took breakfast us, way sydna. son pollard may god pleased bless laufull takeings. home. son lambd removd famely sydna live. mrs fletcher expired night. 28 6 clear warm. home. mr ballard collic. mr robd fletcher wife, son jona wife evng. husband easyer. home. mr ballard sick. mr fletcher wife 29 7 cloudy. mr ballard went settlement finisht pair hoes john town. ye 17th pair knitt since year commenced, futed 1 pair, knit 2 pr socks 7 pr mitts. home. 30 1 snowd morn, held noon. mr ballard went meeting aftern. son jon wife, hannah william went son pollards. thee remains mrss fletcher intered meeting. home. son ephm seen 21 years ys day. 31 2 birth joseph browns 6th dagt. cloudy clear. calld 4h 30 [morn] go joseph browns wife, arivd 6. shee safe deld 8h 15m 6th dagt. tarried till 3h pm, arivd home 5. left inft well could expected. shee laborious illness blessed god, terminated safety. may shee ascribe prais [sic] great parent universe. joseph browns, hallowel. birth 9th. recd 6/. 1 3 clear pleast. son pollard brot wife childn dagt lambd babe dind us. went son jonas aftern. mr lambd, son ephm, mr gill, wife, mr trask wife, son cyrus took tea felt unwell, severe pain head. son jonas. dagts dine. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 2 11, 1800 2 4 clear. mr trask wife calld see mr bullin wife dind mrs pierce sabery price took tea. home kniting, feel comfortable. home. mr bullin wife 3 5 cloudy. mr ballard cyrus went meeting, yearly fast. home, jon wife dind home. 4 6 cloudy. home. mr ballard jona went s. j. fosters hay. son ephm dind brot cloaths finisht stocken home. 5 7 rainy day. son ephm sleeps supt jon kniting stockin dolly town. home. 6 1 birth eliab shaws dagt. raind part day. mr ballard went meeting. calld 5h 30m pm eliab shaw go see wife labour. shee safe deld 9 evn fine dagt. left midnight reacht home 1, wrideing bad. eliab shaws. birth 10th. 7 2 clear. mr ballard, cyrus ephm went town meeting. home, knitt stockin. dagt ballard took tea informd brother pollard expired 5th inst yt remains interd tomorrow. allso hear mr kimbal sick complaint throat. home. heard death mr pollard. 8 3 clear. mr ballard got wood, cyrus drest flax, hepsy washt. futed stockin dolly town. home. 9 4 clear. home kniting. old mr pitts dagt ballard supt home. 10 5 clear. mr ballard surveying esqr john davis. went son jonas evn. took tea sabery price spun wheal. son jonas. 11 6 clear cloudy turns. mr ballard surveying dito. dagt ballard removed part banking ye house knitt finished black hoes. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 12 16, 1800 12 7 clear morn, cloudy night. mr ballard makeing plans mr whitwell. john davis esqr shube wlm pitts went deliver ye mentioned. mending waist coat mr ballard work door yard. son ephm sleeps home. mr ballard went setlemt 13 1 cloudy rain. mr ballard famely attended public worship. mr stones text psalm xix. son ephm jon wife supt us. calld evng mr francise go see wife abram devenport labour. find, arival, old mrs devenpt, mrs lee wido patin mrs shaw afterwards calld. patients illness came shee imediate care 11h 50m. abm devenpts. 14 2 x. birth abm devenpts 3d son. xx. mrs devenport safe deld 3d son 1h morn cleverly. mrs shaw went home, took repose. took breakfast afterwards attended prayers left patients cleverly, reacht home 11h 30m. calld esqr haywoods left yarn mrs patin sent ditoes. birth 11th. recd 12/ rewd. cyrusswhite faced cow calvd. 15 3 clear. home, moovd banking fm ye north end ye hous. calld 6h evn jessy bullin go see wife, find poorly arivd near 8h. night, shee unwell. jessy bullins. 16 4 x. birth jesy bullins dagt. xx. clear. mr bullns, patient ill day. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 17-24, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 17 24, 1800 17 5 clear. left patients cleverly 8h morn reacht home 10h 17m. acompanied phillip bullin went conducted becky faught brors nurs. mr bullins mr catons. 18 6 clear warm. helpt remove dirt back house. doct cony past mr caton calld 7h 30m evng go see wife unwell. 10h evng. 19 7 clear pleast. catons, patient house. mr ballard others surveying altering road catons. catons. 20 1 clear warm. catons. mrs chambertin came went home patient calld women night. ditoes. 21 2 x. birth james catons 3d son. xx. recd 9s apl 11 18001 mr crosbys. clear morn. mrs caton deld 3d son 7th child 5h ys morn, returnd homewd far son pollards 9h morn; tarried dind. cyrus met informd hepsy brown sick. reacht home 3h pm, find ill. son jonas wife lydia nud used means promote perspiration. dagt ballard sett ditoes son pollards. birth 13th. well son pollards lambds. 22 3 raind ys morn, clear aftern. mr ballard calld doct cony see hepsy, shee much easier came. gave puke medisin. home. d. cony see hepsy brown. 23 4 clear day, raind night. doct cony left medisin hepsy. workt gardin, sett curent bushes &c. home doct hepsy better. 24 5 snowd forenn. lydia nud helpt wash. hepsy workt self. mr kittridge setled mr ballard, gave due bill ye ballance two dols 17 cents. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, may 15 20, 1800 15 5 clear. home little comfort. god grant grace patience sufer pleased inflict upon home, house work. 16 6 clear. done house work alltho sufered much pain. o god, consistant thy let cup depart, thine done. home. 17 7 clear. mr ballard cleand flax seed sowd seen 75 years. bakt done work. o parent allmighty, give [strength] bear thou art pleased lay upon may things work good immortal sole. mr capin wife dind way son lambards. home. mr capin wife 18 1 cloudy rain. husband went meeting finds time keep afair hepsy torment sleep night. lay kitchen fire, compared everdon. o god, pardon sin cruel conduct towards home. 19 2 cloudy morn. mr capin, wife son ephm came took breakfast. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 4-9, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 4 9, 1800 4 6 clear warm. son dagt lambd came forenn. went settlement observ independance, wife went see son jonas wife. felt unwell. came home sun sett. sister pollard calld door way home. bror lambard took tea sett acompany dagt home. may prospered way reach place destination safty, may son, confined famely, returnd safety thine time. giv seutable contemplations thy divine disposal may time devote thy service. son jonas. mrs saunders 5 7 clear warm. brother lambd dind dagt ballard see husband allso try borrow money help trouble, sucsceed. helping house work. took walk east house till came sight howards mills. home. 6 1 clear warm. calld mr sole go see wife ill. administred remedies gave relief, went meeting sermon began, communion day. foren service sacrament past, went patient found faint, gave medisin. shee got little sleep shee deld untimely birth. tarried night, mrss dickman allso. mr soals meetin foren, communion. 7 2 clear warm. returnd, left patient well could expected, calld see mrss crages inft unwell. find polly washing, helpt things gardin. mr ballard went son pollards monney son jona confined prison yard. mr soals. recd attendance medisin 6/ 18. 8 3 clear except light shower aftern. son jona discharged debt confined one weak, returned famely. wife revd mr stone took tea us aftern. may troubles work together good. home. revd mr stone made us visit. 9 4 clear except shower night. houghd gardn. calld mr edsons night see mrs collier. shee relievd arivd. larried night. mr ballard gone pownalboro coart. mr edsons see mrs collier source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 28-Sep. 4, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 28 september 4, 1800 28 5 clear. mr ballard surveying mr roland. home. home. 29 6 birth waids dagt. clear. calld 6h 20m morn see mrss waid labour. shee deld 5h pm daught. returnd evn. went son jonas see hannah sick relax. mr waids son jonas. birth 19th. 30 7 clear. takeing care pickles matters sons see dagt. shee better. gave bark shumake clister. mr ballard surveying mr swetland. mr floid died sudenly morn. sons. death mr floid. 31 1 rainy. mr ballard famely went meeting. mr hodges wishes polly tarrie went see son jonas dagt, find less pain shee yesterday. doct cony calld see gave rheubarb calomeel, left elx vitl stotn. came home supper. mr ballard went evn. may god grant blessing means used child. sons. cony see hannah, gave calomel. 1 2 clear. mr ballard surveying esquir lyon. mr floids remains intered. hous work gardin till 3 o clock aftern, went son jonas. dagt much shee s. juett foster wife son lambd 28 years old ys day. sons. child much remains mr floid interd day. 2 3 clear. son lambd took breakfast wife came went see hannah ballard, find comfortable. dagt lambd 28 years old ys day. son jonas. dagt lambd birthday. 3 4 clear. went see nabby andrews, find viry distressed situation. shee tapt dropsy yesterday. calld see little hannah, find better, went evn. mr andrews son. p. bullin went river survey. 4 5 clear till evn shower. gathering beans pees gardin, informd mrs andws yet living. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 5-13, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 5 13, 1800 5 6 clear. mr ballard laying road east side river. much fatagued swine. calld 7th hour go see nabby andrus, sick. tarried night, aunts pain springer, dagt nabby tarried night. many people calld see patient. shee gave good admonition, took leav expecting expire soon. mr andreuss. nabby sick indead. 6 7 clear warm. mr andss, dagt much distressed boddy mind. many people calld see doct grisswill, deacon briggs mr asa williams prayed tarried sett night. ditoes, dagt better. watcht, mrs woodwd allso. 7 1 clear. came home. slept came home. slept returnd evn. sett patient night, mrss woodward olliv fletcher shee, oh distresst shee may god pleased shine soall influence holy spirrit giv comphort shee goes hence, ditoes, watcht hannah ballard well 8 2 clear. came home morn. left patient little easier shee sick indead. takeing care gardin matters. ditoes. hannah ballard part ye day. 9 3 x. birth james kenneys 3d dagt. xx. clear. hallowell, left home 4h morn, put wife james kinney bed; 3d dagt 5th child, left comfortable. calld see nabby ands, find low. arivd home noone. ditoes mr james kenneys. birth 20th. recd 9/ moodys store. 10 4 clear. mr andruss, nabby better. mr andruss. 11 5 clear. ditoes, distresst famely. left 10h evn. ditoes. 12 6 clear warm. cutt sage went mr andruss, thought nabby expireing. ditoes. 13 7 cloudy. ditoes brownens. came home wrote bror jona. wend mrs mott williams sett ditoes night. wrote brr jona source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 14-20, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 14 20, 1800 14 1 left mr andruss famely ill. mrss pain calld mr brownns, one sons ill. calld meeting see mrss guild hallowell. tarried night, patient much pain. andruss, brownns mrss guils. 15 2 clear cool. left mrss guild hour sun, returnd home. mr ballard gone sidny. went mr andruss, found distressed. helpt remove nabby. put bed made clean could tended till evn, left. mrss cowen, ingerham cypher watch.. mrss guilds andruss brownns.son dagt pollard sleep 16 3 clear. calld 6h morn go assist put nabby andrus grave cloaths. doct cony dissected found comptaint uterus, contained 1 galn water together substance. wt water taken 7 lb. liver wd 3_ lb. trunk boddy contained larg quantity water. frost killd vines night. mr andruss. dagt nabby expired 6h morn. 17 4 clear. dagt pollard dind us. mr ballard, self, cyrus son jonas famely dagt pollard attended funeral nabby andrus. revd mr gillit presided performd prayers. thomas fletcher expired last evn sudinly. funeral nabby andrus. doct barton sister sleep ys night. 18 5 funeral mr yeatons dagt. clear. doct barton sister sett go oxford. went see mr andruss famely, seem comfortable except betsy, remains weak yet. calld mr brownens, child better. remains thoms fletcher intered aftern. mr ballard dined son jon father sett fire bushes cutt land sumer. mrs baxter sleeps mr andruss, brownens son jonas. doct barton wife left oxford. funeral thos fletcher. 19 6 clear. home. mrss baxter went aftern. death lyons child. home. 20 7 cloudy, raind night. finisht harvesting apples. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 21-27, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 21 27, 1800 21 1 cloudy rain. mr ballard went meeting hallowell afternoon, informd wife capt hatch interd aftern; allso child mr burns new france. lucy town came morn, hannah ballard went sons, son jona unwell. mr wigins informs child alpheus lyons interd ys aftn. sons. lucy town three funerals day. 22 2 birth mr brackets son. x. birth mr basfords son. xx. clear cool. calld 4h ys morn see wife anthony bracket, shee safe deld 7 fine son, 4 child. left comfortable returnd home 11. went son jon see sister pollard, calld 12 mr basford see wife labour. shee deld 4pm first son 3d child. left mother inft comfortable returnd home 9h evng. find cyrus unwell, made catnip tea. mr ballard sett wiscasett survey capt fallinsbe. son jona gone jaill lucy town sleeps mr brackett. birth 21st. recd 6/. mr basfords. birth 22nd. recd 9/. son jonas. mrs polld lucy sleeps 23 3 cloudy day. lucy town went home aftern, sister polly come mr gills. harvested beens, gatherd cucumbers plumbs. cyrus unwell went hear coart. wigins spread flax got part stalks. jon wife mrs pierce home. lucy town went home 24 4 clear cool. calld mr dickman go see wife unwell. found wife esqr belcher mrss dickman met abortion. left well could expected. calld see mrss basford, found infant cleverly. mrss duttuns lues hamlins, conducted home shais. polly town came mr dickmans. birth 23d polly town sleeps 25 5 clear. calld ephm cowens see wife unwell. colo ["jabez cowens." implied] colo jabez cowens. 26 6 clear. cowens, patient betr. ditoes. 27 7 cloudy. cowens. mrss duttun collic mr cowens night. cowen. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 28-Oct. 5, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 28 october 5, 1800 28 1 rainy. mrs cowen well, sent mrs welman sist savage. cowens. 29 2 clear cloudy turns. cowens colo duttin dind took tea ditoes colo dutns 30 3 showers. mrs cowen unwell. mrss seekin welman calld. got little sleep night. cowens. 1 4 birth ephm cowens 4th dagt. clear. patient mrss duttun, moore gould calld safe deld 0h 30m evng 5 child 4th dagt. left infant cleverly arivd home 6h. dagt ballard supt us. mr ballad returnd. hope well. cowens. birth 24th. 2 5 cloudy little rain. workt gardin diging potatoes gathering last beans greu vein. mr ballard returned wiscasett noon. capt falinsby made present black waist coat. husband supt son jonas. dagt ballard dined us. son jonas evng. mr ballard 3 6 cloudy clear turns. scolt pickles done matters, feel well could wish. dagt ballard colo howards. shee informs shubl pillss youngest child expired sun sett. feel affliction, may sanctified us home. 4 7 clear pleasant. working gardin diging potatoes &c. old mr chamberlin supt us. mr ballard went esqr haywoods winthrop borrow money sucseed, went son jonas acount. home. son jon returned jaill. 5 1 clear pleasant. attended worship aftern, mr moody performd. thee remains shubal pittss youngest child interd service. meeting. funeral shubal pittss child, ae 1 year 9m 1 day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 6-17, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 6 17, 1800 6 2 raind fore n. mr ballard sett aftern n2. home, pared apples. home. mr ballard gone survey. 7 3 clear. calld see mr brownens son. son lambd carried dagt home polly hodges allso. mr browens. 8 4 clear. done hous wk, got [beets]. sons jona, lambd wives supt, ye latter slept. home, childn 9 5 clear. son lambd sett boston, wife went home. jona wife home washing. thunder rain night. home. son lambd boston. 10 6 clear pleast. finisht wash. heard mrs parker fitts, went see doct cony brot jonas. mr parker. shee fitts. 11 7 clear. home. dagt ballard came ironing. home. 12 1 cloudy, raind night. calld noon go mr capins, arivd night. mr capins. 13 2 raind. mrss capin unwell, women calld 9h evng. ditoes. 14 3 x. birth theop capins dagt. x. clear part ye day. mrss capin dismist calld women 10h evn deld 11 6th dagt 7th child, cleverly. got sleep. ditoes. birth 25th. recd 6/ rewd. 3/ recd since. 15 4 cloudy. returnd home, sufered chill air. son came take back hors. ditoes, son sleeps 16 5 raind. mr capins son went home. parkers boys helpt sort apples, washt cloaths. home. 17 6 cloudy. finisht wash. betsy cowen helpt aftern. dagt lamb, son allin, came calld soone afterwds mr bunkers wife, dagt went jonas. raind night. mr kenny sent could nt go. mr bunker. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 18-29, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 18 29, 1800 [18] 7 [x. birth bunkers dagt. x.] raind hard night. patient deld first child, daugt, 5h pm. mrss soal, pitts moody went home. tarried night, women. ditoes. birth 26th. recd 7/6 [1/4]. [19] 1 raind hard day. returnd 1h pm. son jona, wife sist gitchel dagt lambd took tea allin allso. ditoes. [20] 2 cloudy. dagt lambd son went mr gills. home. home. [21] 3 clear part day. dagt lambd son dind went home. mrs saunders dagt ballard allso. home. home. [22] 4 cloudy. got part cabbages. home. [23] 5 rainy. heard mr ballard well monday last. home, cutt apples drie. home. [24] 6 clear part day. bakt washt washt buttery kitchen floors. home. [25] 7 clear. dagt ballard sister, ephm willm dind son ephm sleeps home. [26] 1 clear part day. cyrus dind son jonas. son lambd calld return boston. jona winslow, sold hors. sons lambd came home. [27] 2 clear pleast. done larg wash. dagt ballard quilting bed quillt. home. [28] 3 clear pleast. got last carrots cabbages. sett 100 young sage roots. ironed evng. mrs farewell home. [29] 4 clear pleast. finisht ironing, went sons tea. mrs farewell dagt quillt got evng. sons. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 30-Nov. 12, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 30 november 12, 1800 30 5 clear pleast. sorted apples, cut strung drie. indiens home. 31 6 clear pleast. home, finisht cuting specht apples. 3 indiens gave 2/1 bushl apples bark. dagt ballard supt home. 1 7 clear pleast. mrs welch brot chips, brewd boiled apple pareings done matters, feel fatagud. home. 2 1 rainy ys day. go meeting son jona evng. home. 3 2 clear. mr ballard returnd surveying n2. got apples seller washt cloaths first water. cyrus town meeting. home. mr balld returnd n2. 4 3 clear. home, washt cut apples. dagt ballard childn, son ephm, mrss edson cole took tea us. home. compy 5 4 clear ye day. mr ballard workt road. cyrus ye hook, bot 2/1 bushl rie 4/1 lb snuff. mrss saunders home. churnd 4 lb 5 oz butter. 6 5 cloudy, raind evng. bakt, done hous work, finishd washing. mr ballard workt road, cyrus carting coal ely andrus. dagt ballard evng. home. 7 6 clear. home, washt floor. home. 8 7 cloudy. mr ballard got part turnips went hear mr kibby preach mr roices. home. son jona, wife, sons ephm wilm dind preacher discoarsed 2nd thesilo 1st c, 7 8 verses. home. 2 years since death dagt town. 9 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting. went aft. mr stone discoarsed fm psalm 119. meeting. wegens returnd. 10 2 clear cool. home, done hous wk knit 22 purls stockin. home. 11 3 clear. dagt ballard, mrss pierce saunders tea. home. home. 12 4 cloudy. jon killd 3 swine. home. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 13-23, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 13 23, 1800 [13] 5 snowd raind. jona 2 oxen butcherd. home. mrs herington home. [14] 6 cloudy cold. home, sorted apples, paired cut ones roting. mr ballard makeing hogg pen. home. 15 7 clear cold. put pickels seller. mr ballard surveying winthrop mr smith. home. 16 1 clear cool. mr ballard meeting. son ephm dagt lambd sent us piece fresh pork, son jona us legg pork head hart beef. home. betsy cowen came back jonas. home. received presents jona son lambd. 17 2 clear foren, raind haild evng. mrs herington washt shee child dagt ballard aftern, mrs edson allso. finished kniting pair worsted hoes mr ballard. surveying mr weston. home. dagt ballard 18 3 rainy day. cyrus went son lambds brought 3 bushls corn home. jane pickt wool went home night. done house wk began stockin. mr ballard home. mr dogett came request service surveying lotts n2. home. 19 4 clear windy. wilm cypher came work, whealing dirt bank house. mr ballard puting boards cyrus went hallowell. home takeing care cloaths washt, housework; feel fatagued. home. invited quilting mr andruses could go. 20 5 cloudy, snowd night. ely andrus shod oxen son jon phillip bullin sleeps return surveying river. home, symtoms collic. mrs farewell calld home. philp bullin sleeps finisht banking ye hous. 21 6 snowd fast ys morn, haild 11 oclock, raind fast aftern evn. done ironing hous work. son jona dind mr scribner wind hard n e 10 evn. home. put 3 swine fattne. 22 7 clear cold. sons pollard ephm supt bakt done hous work. mr ballard settlement business. home. sons pollard ephm informs lambd unwell. 23 1 bth mr thwings dagt. snowd. mr ballard meeting, cyrus mr lambds. calld see mrs thwing deld daugt reacht mrss norton principle performer. mr thwings. birth 27th. recd 6/ rewd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 24-30, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 24 30, 1800 24 2 clear pleast. left mrss thwing inft cleverly returnd home 10h morn, find son ephm work anointing itch ys evng. mr kitchredg evn. mr [thwings]. son jona wife supt 25 3 clear pleast. home. cousin saml davis oxford sleeps bror ebenz came supt us went home. flint barton collins moore evn. betsy cowen helpt day, bakt mins apple pies. home. cousin [davis] bror moore jack ballard unwell. 26 4 clear. home. cousin davis left ys morn, homward bound. done work alone, bakt mins pies. felt unwell. home. cousin davis left jack better, hr]. 27 5 thanksgiving day. snows. 2nd hour. rest night. day appointed giv thanks mercies received ye past year. feel ill able perform work. betsy cowen came helpt shee, son jona, wife childn, lambd famely, son pollard wife, cyrus ephm partook us dinner. esqr davis son evn. betsy waited james savage asa peirces. home. childn dind us. 28 6 clear. home, bakt. betsy cowen washt elijah gidian barton came evn, sleep siesed 10 h evn collic, continued till near morn. mr ballard got bed, made [lie] warmed brick put stomach. home. ye collic. bror [bartons] sons sleep 29 7 clear. blessed auther favours. relieved pain. dagt ballard belsy came waited mended stockins husband. bror barton son luke dind spent remainder ye day sleep left sister esqr reads bodenham. home. easy feel weak. brorbarton 30 1 clear. mr ballard went meeting, cyrus ephm lambds. bror barton son mr pittss, bill fathers. home. home. bror barton left david [walls] 2nd dagt born. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 1-9, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 1 9, 1800 1 2 clear cold. mr ballard left home riseing ye sun n2 survey. washt cleand north room. cyrus waited jonas wife daugt asa peirces, went evn conducted home. bill cuting wood. home. 2 3 cleare, windy cold. home. jona wife supt spent evng. bill cuting wood. jona brot 2 load door 1 settlement. home. expired hallowell, old mr norcross. 3 4 clear pleast. washt buttery kitchen, sorted apples cut cyrus went settlement, bot _ gln spt, 3 lb sugar, 1 dos biskit, 1 card gt pins, mr wesns dexters. cost 8/6. home. 4 5 clear pleast. son jona bill geting wood. brot 2 loads home. cut apples stewed pumkin allso. informd sally andrus remains old mr norcross intered aftern. capt stones wife calld home. funeral mr norcross. 5 6 cloudy ye day. dagt ballard son lambd took breakfast cyrus went hous brot home 4 bushls corn. home. bill got 4 bushels turnips yard. home. raind, haild snowd night. 6 7 cloudy cold, snowd evng. mr ballard returnd n2. slept son towns last night, well. bakt apple pies ys day. ephm came evn, sleeps home. mr ballard returnd. 7 1 clear. mr ballard went meeting. amos pollard way home. spent evng son jonas. son jonas evng. 8 2 clear. mr ballard ephm building [necesara] house. home. home. bill went home. 9 3 clear. son jonas childn forn, marm gone settlement; cyrus conducted gone hook. home. home. son town sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 10-18, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 10 18, 1800 10 4 clear. home, hous wk knit ephm work well usual. made herb tea. home. 11 5 clear till near night. mr ballard 200 25 lb beef brot home ys aftern, cost 3 dols pr h. home, done hous wk knitt ephm comfortable. home. 12 6 rainy day, attended high wind. home. son town calld ys morn bid us farewell. removd things east side sellar cleard drane water ran home. 13 7 cloudy. mr ballard sett go son lambards corn. salted beef. trees blown mr b. could get farther mr edsons sleigh. wrode without saddle lambds, got 1_ bushl corn carried mill. home. 14 1 clear cloudy turns, cold. mr ballard three jonas sons went meeting, wife wm spent evng us. bell cow calvd field, men got ye calf ye barn meeting. ephm gone son lambards. home. son jona wife 15 2 clear pleast. mr ballard hallowell meeting hous. home. betsy cowen washing gave 1/6. home. 16 3 clear pleast. home, pickt 10 bushels chips hous wk. home. ephm sleeps 17 4 clear. mr ballard gone run lines moses ingerham. cyrus son lambds, brot home 2 bushels corn informs dagt pollard well. home. ephm sleeps 18 5 cloudy moderate. mr ballard returnd. home, hous work mended 3 pair hoes cyrus. ephm put ash box together went coart. dagt ballard dind. p. bullin supt sleeps home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 19-23, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 19 23, 1800 [19] 6 clear pleast. home, bakt cake. ye anniversary marriage, 46 years since. mr ballard returnd home surveying mr ingerham others neighbourhood. sorted apples evng mended pair hoes son ephm. home. 46 years ys day since marriage. 20 7 cloudy moderate foren, raind aftern evn. mr ballard went survey land mr francess hallowell. land near alps lions. corking west side ye north room. son lambd took breakfast ephm finisht door buttery hung put hatch ye w door. home. son lambd gave straw fill [beds]. 21 1 clear day moderate. mr ballard famely went meeting. jona came puld turnips. ephm taken sallts, went son lambards toward night. cutt stued apples. home. 22 2 cloudy rain. baked bread done hous work. mr ballard writing. fall barn hurt left shoalder. bathed spt turpintine spirit. cyrus butcherd veal jona. quarter, wd 11 lb. afterwards went son lambards, brot home 3 bushels corn. home. 23 3 clear pleast. mr ballard, cyrus self dind son jonas, calvs head harslet good things. attempted wride found ye road bad dismounted walkt. calld see mrs heringtons child sick. cyrus put hors sleigh led home emtied underbed filld swept chambers, made two beds, mended coat cyrus sewd raggs coverld came home. sons mrs welchs see james herington. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 24-31, 1800 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 24 31, 1800 24 4 clear pleast. mrss welch things sick babe. mr ballard went mr asa williams got lether shoes mended. unwell ys day done hous work. son jona evn, sold mare nathan tylor, took note 9 dols payable middle march; another, sum, paid september ye first good shingles. home. 25 5 clear pleast. home. mr ballard hook fort. home. 26 6 cloudy, raind mr mofett n2 dind loin veal roast. gathered parsly, fresh green, gardin put gravy. home. mr mofett dind 27 7 cloudy day moderate, raind night. mr ballard makeing plan foren, went parish meeting aftern. cyrus went son lambds, brot home 2 bushel corn, went mill part doct barton came evn, supt sleeps brot beef sellar repacked boiled pickel &c, &c. home. doct barton sleeps 28 1 cloudy moderate till evng began snow. mr ballard meeting. doct barton, son jon wife dind us, roast beef. home. doct barton sleeps 29 2 clear cloudy alternately, cool. home. mr ballard makeing plann, cyrus things ye barn cuting wood. doct barton left breakfast bound goshan. home. doct barton sett home. 30 3 clear till evn snowd. went see little william. ephm let fall ys morn burnt arm, cut chin pott ye fire. mr ballard makeing plan. son jon evng. 31 4 clear part day snowd part thereof. mr waid butchered 3 swine us. capt toby mr fish dind son jona allso. bitsy cowen came helpt part day, year come close happy made wise improvment time. home. 3 swine bulchered purchasd 31 lb rough tallow capt ney 10 cents pr pound. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 10, 1801 1 5 clear. home, done hous wk. home. 2 6 clear. home till 8h evn calld son jonas see john davis scholt brot asa pierces, fitts. tarried night. sons, john davis brot 3 7 clear cold. twice sons, tarried night. son dagt lambd childn came left allin went mr pittss. sons. son lambd famely 4 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. esq davis brot miss son gave north room doct colman sleeps esq davis, son lambd famely allso. husband lay kitchen fire. home. john brot childn sleep 5 2 severe snow storm. son lambd famely went son jonas. esq davis son ephm sleep john seems cleverly. home. 6 3 snowd. john ill, cony colman calld early ys morn. drest burns poulleses 3d pt rhum, oinions indien meal. colman mrs duttun night. laid little cloaths. home. docters day. 7 4 snowd haild. betsy came helpt work. docts john seems comfortable. night. home. cony made 2 visits. 8 5 snowd. john seems better. mrs woodwd watch. laid cloaths mid night. doct colman came tarried ye remaindr ys night. calld 5 help dress john. past 1 worm. home. 9 6 clear cold. colman went home. colman went home cony came. john past 19 worms ys day. dad twice see sons lambd ephm dind mrs saunders watcht. mr ballard unwell. feel much fatagued, keep home. 10 7 clear. fatauging day. mrs gill farewell see john. mr mofet jane herington came evn help son pollard calld 9h evn see wife labour. son pollards night. betsy cowen helpt source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 11-14, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 11 14, 1801 11 1 birth son polards 2nd son. birth son jonas 2nd dagt. snowd raind ys morn. dear dagt pollard 0h 20m morn safe deld second son 5t h child. sett till 5. shee exercised pain faintness, infant seemd unwell till mrs toll sett night. dagt lambd came morn went bed finest nap since first year. mr ballard came 3h pm come son jonas wife labour. shee safe deld 6h 30m evn second dagt 6th child. tarried till 10 came home sett john till mid night. sons pollards jonas. birth 1st. birth2nd. 12 2 clear. home, done hous work done john, ungreatfully treated mother. may god forgiv home. 13 3 clear. hitty continues ingrattitude. esqr davis came removd son son jonas. mrs conry, jason pierce wife, son jona sabary price came assist. happy allmost fataugd death doct barton sleeps son jonas aftern. john removd sons. 14 4 clear. day great composier. bror barton writing plans mr ballard makeing. mrs herington washt. son dagt lambd way mr capins. jane cleand skins sausages. home. doct barton, son lambd wife source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 15-22, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 15 22, 1801 15 5 raind. jane went home. betsy cowen came helpt fill sausages. cyrus killd calf. feel fatagued confused. home. 16 6 clear. mr ballard workt planing. cyrus hook, bot _lb tea calld hyson skin. made 24 _ dozn candles. polly sally farewell see betsy. feel well could wish ys evng. home. 17 7 clear. home, washt buttery kitchen. feel unwell evn, go barn take care cyruses cow. bathd feet went bed. betsy took kinde care home. 18 1 clear. mr ballard walkt meeting, slipt hurt sholder son dagt lambd took supper us. bitsy went home evng. husband went jonas. mrs conry sick ye head aick. sons ys evn. 19 2 cloudy. wrose day, feel unwell work bear troubles. god giv grace bear bror barton son ephm sleep home. cyrus bot 2 milk pans 1 pail. 20 3 severe snow storm. home, ill collic evn. home. 21 4 slormy. doct barton ephm yet. feel unwell, betsy helping home. 22 5 clear. doct barton ephm went betsy bakt, brewed, churned, boiled pickele swines feet. 4 lb 6 ox. butter. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 23-31, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 23 31, 1801 23 6 clear. betsy washt. feel well could wish. doct cony wrode home. 24 7 clear. feel comfortable pain stomach. doct cony went past morn road. mr ballard gone parish meeting. son lambd came conducted house, daugt unwell. spent night son lambard, childn unwell. 25 1 clear cold. childn seem better. mr ballard came son lambards went son pollards, find well could expected. dind calld son jonas, find wife setting john restless. ephm came 10h evng. sons pollards, lambds jonas. john takeing ye bark. 26 2 clear. betsy washt n room bedroom. son jona came invited go house. went, long davis doct colman page came administer dose callomel. returnd home soon. home sons. 27 3 clear. mr ballard colo duttuns, ephm betsy sleigh wride, cyrus mill. washt boards cover milk washt ketchin. esqr davis came administer clisters john. colman page mrs springer allso. went evng. oliv fletcher watched. sons twice. betsy gone sleigh wride. 28 4 clear pleast. mrs welch took breakfast finisht removeing turnips matters. mrs conry wisht go see jonas inft, well sons. john wrestless 29 5 cloudy, haild evn. unwell, knit evn. little ephm ye ear aick. home. 30 6 clear pleast. bakt, brewd churnd, 5 lb 10 oz butter. ephm wilm home. mr ballard hook. 31 7 clear. home. mr ballard went parrish meeting. mended pair breaches helpt hous work. roasted loin veal diner. 3 jonas childn dind source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 1-3, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 1 3, 1801 1 1 clear pleast. calld see john davis al sons, apears symtoms near aproach death. doct cony colman calld. constitucion seemd far spent able take medisin. severe spasms relievd salt water revivd little. revd mr stone invited see meeting. made well adopted prayer ocation. tarried thro night child, doct colman allso. sons see john aprehensive near close life. 2 2 clear pleast. left sons fore n. came home, took care business. calld aftern sons, find john apparently near close life. doct colman administring decoction pink beet without affect. tarried night, father doct colman allso. mrss saunders calld watch. laid ye fire 11, calld midnight alteration patients breathing took place. able swallow great struggle. life went candle. sons, tarried night. informd dagt pollard trouble one breasts. 3 3 cloudy snow. john, son j. v. davis, expired morn 1h 10m. mrss saunders, oliv fletcher self put grave cloaths, finisht performance 3. doct colman conducted home 6. went bed slept. mr ballard went colo duttuns hay. bill cypher went team. sons. john expired 1h 10m ys morn. 2 years, 7 months 13 days. promising child, oft expectations cut source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 4-6, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 4 6, 1801 4 4 xx. birth s. juet fosters 2nd son. xx. clear. calld sons see desection son esqr davis performd closly. left lobe ye lighls found much inflamed, intestines, allso, 4 interscections, inftamation kidneys blather. singte worm contained ye boddy small quantity operators supposed bed resided. gaull blather larg full. opperation performd docts colman page. judg north, son jon self attendants. calld see wife s. j. foster labour safe deld 7h evn second son 5th child. tarried night, patient well could expected. sons. desection performd ye boddy john davis junr. s. j. fosters. birth 3d. july 13th receivd reward 10/10. 5 5 snowd. came home mr fosters find son dagt lambd ephm come mrss conry dind attended funeral son john v. davis. procession doct colmans interd grave yard colo howards. came sons supt, came home. childn sleep mr fosters ye interment esqr daviss son. revd mr bowers attended, mr stone allso. 6 6 clear. sons lambard ephm went pittstn. jona, wife 3 childn dind took tea. esqr davis mr lambd, wife ephm went home evn. betsy pain head. gave sage tea. shee bathed feet. het bricks put hr feet. home. part childn source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 7-15, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 7 15, 1801 7 7 snowd. son pollard informs wife unwell, breast danger breaking. home, bakt churnd 7lb 14 oz butter. doct cony mr ballard cyrus signd petition send genl coart. home. 8 1 clear cold, windy. unwell. mr ballard meeting, informd dagt pollard better. home, unwell. 9 2 x. birth john pages 2nd son. xx. snowd. calld alpheus lion go see wife john page. past mr hamlins 20m 9 ys morn. patient deld 11 second son 3d child. left well could expected. past mr hamlins 20m 5h pm, reacht home dark; cold fatagued. john pages. birth 4th. recd 6/ reward. 10 3 clear. home, mended mr ballards mitts knit esqr davis evn, gave mr ballard 8_ dollars acount trouble son. home. esqr davis evn. 11 4 clear. went see dagt pollard confined soar breast. doct howard saw recommended wheat breud poltis. son pollards lambds. 12 5 son pollards. dagt lambd mrs pollard ill, infant restless want breast. slept little. ditoes, rather son pollards. 13 6 son pollards. dagt poorly. son pollards. 14 7 ditoes. mr pollard came home, left load fort hallifax. ditoes. could git milk dagt breast. 15 1 clear cold. ditoes. gidn braley got yellow lilly roots apply mrs pollard breast, seemd giv pain. ditoes. dagt better. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 16-23, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 16 23, 1801 16 2 clear. hannah seems easier. went noon son lambds returnd evng. dagt ill night, infant wrestless. sons pollards lambds. 17 3 son pollards. doct howard calld, thought breast fitt open. dagt ill night. son pollards. 18 4 clear. son pollard calld doct colman open wives breast, copeous discharg shee seems comfortable. infant cleverly. mrss black came brother. ditoes. 19 5 clear. mr ballard came son pollards came home, left dagt low well could expected. great discharg breast morn. calld son lambards, well usual. informd mr allin interd aftern. calld son jonas, son wilm sick. revd mr joseph boman, pastor satt oxford, came see us aftern. sons pollards lambds. revd joseph boman see us. funeral mr phinias allin. 20 6 x. clear pleasant. home, seen 66 years roal away. o may remainder life spent service heavinly father, long preserved kindly supported home,have seen 66 years. 21 7 clear. home. son pollard, lambd, ephm polly hodges dind jona killd swine. home. 22 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. revd mr boman performed. home. 23 2 clear. went see dagt pollard. breast likely break shee feeble. tarried night. son pollards. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 24-Mar. 6, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 24 march 6, 1801 [24] [3] clear. son pollards, dagt poorly. son pollds. [25] [4] cloudy. ditoes. dagt ill, ye doct sent ditoes. [26] 5 clear pleast. doct colman came opened dagts breast, shee easier. doct conducted home. went son jonas, infant sick. gave medisin gave relief. son returnd winslow came home late evn. son towns famely well. nabby hail marrid ys evng. ditoes. dagts breast opend. jonas allso [27] 6 clear warm. went shubal pittss, find dagt ill. calld mr thwings, mrs kider calld sons, babe better. mr pittss, thwings son jonas. [28] 7 clear pleast. brewd bakt. betsy gone see sist polly sick. wido farewell dind home. [1] 1 clear. calld see mr dingleys inft, sick. spent ye night mr dingleys. [2] 2 rainy. spent ys day mr dingley. mrs wiman goshan child ill, gave senna brot much fleghm. seems comfortable night. ditoes. [3] 3 clear pleast. left child easier came home 10h morn. son dt lambd mr capins. daniel piper 2 mr ballard deld plan survey sartificates carrie setlers, one plan d. levermore esqr. ditoes. son dagt lambard [4] 4 clear. betsy washt rooms. rufas ballard wife dind churnd, 4_ lb butter. betsys bror wm dind calld 11h evn go see wife shubal pitts. leut sbl pittss. ball mr pittss. [5] 5 x. [birth shubal pittss 1st son. x.] clear pleast, mrss pitts safe deld 1h 50m ys morn first son 3d child, wd 11 lb. tarried till noon. compy old lady cox, pitts, sister barton, moody, soal witherel. ditoes. birth 5th. recd 10/. [6] 6 clear. home, betsy grand fathers. doct barton supt, bror ebenz home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 15 25, 1801 15 1 cloudy. mr ballard returnd runing line harlem varsalborough. home. mr balld returnd. 16 2 cloudy moderate. removd chips ye door yard knit jessy bullin, wife child bror fore n, took dish tea. jonas wife twist thread. home. jesy bullin wife 17 3 clear part day warm. home, finisht mr ballards mitts began cyruss. oxen sent mr pages kept. timothy page removd house mr roice ocupied meeting house. home. 18 4 birth saml titcomb 2nd dagt, dead born. cloudy. combd 4_ lb flax calld see wife saml titcomb labour. shee safe deld 6h pm second daught, dead born. patient severe cough case natural severe, know ascribe death ye inft cough mother saml titcombs esqrs. birth 7th. recd 13/2d rewd. 19 5 cloudy. left mrs titcomb well could expected returnd home 8h morn. colo duttun mr ballard paid owed 7 dols 70 cents. ditoes son jonas. 20 6 rainy. kniting, finisht cyruss mitts knit stockin, 50 purls. home. ephm [workt] 21 7 rainy. mr ballard jon finisht plough. mended cloaths. ephm work church williams. home. river opend ys morn. 22 1 cloudy showers. mr ballard went meeting. doct cony went past traviling bad. home. 23 2 cloudy rain. calld mr georg reeds see wife youngest child unwell. jabish cowens wife sett night, child wrestless. georg reeds. 24 3 clear cooler. returnd mr reeds. doct cony went informs patients wors. dagt ballard childn aftern. ditoes. 25 4 clear part day. mrs herington spoold warp. mr james cowen dind, supt sleeps mr ballard 800 hay wido blakman. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, march 26 april 5, 1801 26 5 clear. home. ephm works bror lambard sleeps home. 27 6 clear. calld son lambd go see wife unwell, father ephm workt son lambds. 28 7 clear. son lambds. breaking land, father helping wife well. ditoes. 29 1 clear pleast. mr lambd son went thos allins, brot apples home. dagt, self, sally selvester childn dind son pollards. ditoes son pollards. 30 2 raind snowd. son lambard ploughd foren. day. son ephm seen 22 years day 11h pm. son lambds. 31 3 raind snowd fore n. son lambd finisht breaking ground ys aftern. ditoes. 1 4 clear. bror lambd sett home. saml drove oxen john norths wrode sons hors home. colo duttuns dagts ditoes. 2 5 clear. son lambd went augusta. dagt pollard childn ditoes. 3 6 clear warm. returnd home 10h morn. betsy sett go dads. calld see wife magr bengm stickney unwell, night. ditoes mgr stickneys. 4 7 clear pleast. mrs slickney women calld aftern unwell night. sleep. ditoes. 5 1 x. birth mgr benn stickneys 5th son. xx. clear. patients illness came severe morn shee 10h 30m safe deld 5th son 7th child. lefe inft cleverly reacht home 3h 30m. supt son jonas. betsy returnd evng. ditoes son jonas. birth 8th. recd 9/ rewd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 6-14, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 6 14, 1801 6 2 clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus went meeting govr senator. removing banking east side south end, part ye west side n end hous; removd chips allso. home. meeting choic gov senator. 7 3 clear till evng. workt doors, removd banking [hoeud] round hous. son lambard famely well. home, workt doors. 8 4 cloudy. dug ground sett 165 cabbage stumps french turnips. calld, done, go see wife georg rhead weak situation. mrss mott woodwd night. slept mr rheads ys night. workt gardin day. 9 5 mr rheads. snowd foren, cloudy aftern, raind evng. patient deld 2h pm, birth premature. left well could expected returnd 5. fast day. mr ballard allin lambard meeting. ditoes. case 9th, recd 6/. 10 6 rainy day. mr ballard got wood went mr cypherss hay. workt seller knitt mr lambards stockins doubled thread. home. rainy day evng. 11 7 cloudy clear turns. home, well. mr ballard mr cypherss hay. home. snowd morn. 12 1 clear. mr ballard betsy meeting, ephm son lambds. allin well. home. dorkis marrd nicolas. 13 2 clear. pain head stomach little work gardin. polly pollard, sally savage, abby sewall son lambard took tea mr ballard parrish meeting. allin went home. home. 14 3 clear. mr ballard lay road thro james keatons land. mrs edson gardin seeds, husband bot son jonas old cow. knitt mended coat husband workt doors removing chips. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 15 22, 1801 15 4 clear cool. mr edson took sons cow barn morn. mrs saunders took coffee us aftern. son jona, wife hitty gone settlement. home. 16 5 clear cold. mr ballard gone varsalboro survey land doct colman. workt hard gardin feel much fatagud. cyrus helpt sett goosbery bushes currents. dagt ballard hitty visit mrss saunders. home, workt gardin day. 17 6 birth son lambards 3d son. clear cool. calld 3h morn son lambard go see wife labour. shee safe deld 5 3d son 4 child, well could expected. son jona wife calld son lambds. birth 10th. 18 7 clear cold. son lambds, dagt well helpt sett table take breakfast us. daughts pollard ballard aftern. son jona sleeps wife went bror gitchels. ditoes. 19 1 clear cold. dagt pollard, husband childn son lambards. left sun sett reacht home 9. ditoes. 20 2 clear cool. workt hard gardin feel much fatagud. home. 21 3 clear cool. workt gardin day. home. 22 4 clear. workt gardin, sowd peas. mr ballard went hallowell, cyrus son lambard s; cleverly conducted jonas wife home. mrs welch swingle flax, childn home, sowd peas. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 23-30, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 23 30, 1801 [23] 5 clear. workt gardin. mr ballard gone varsalboro run lines croses. home. 24 6 birth mr dexters dagt. clear. unwell went see son jonas infant, unwell cold. calld evn mr dexters wife, shee deld dagt doct cony arivd. went mr shubal pittss slept sister barton. sons, mr dexters pittss.11th case. 25 7 clear. theops hamlins, bot 1 pr shoes 5/6, 1_ yd ribbond 1/5. saw polly rockwood informd uncle ebenz learned deceast 3 weaks since. workt gardin returnd. mr pellss, dexters, hamlins &esq titcombs. 26 1 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mr ballard betsy meeting, cyrus seeking white fast cow; found calf noon. ephm taken sallts ys day. home. betsy went grand dadys, tarrid night. reeds child died. 27 2 clear. home, workt hard house gardin. feel fatagued evn. informd ye death mr reads daught. capt saml hussys remains interd yesterday. home, sowd peas house. 28 3 clear, pleast foren, cool aftern. mr ballard betsy attended funeral mr rheads child. revd mr stone calld took tea us. home. mr georg rheeds child interd. 29 4 cloudy rain. done hous work cleand buttery. betsy cowen went away home. betsy left 30 5 clear. unwell keep bed day, sick night. aprehensive liv till morn. jonas wife came ye night. home, sick night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 9-18, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 9 18, 1801 9 3 clear. mr ballard planted corn potatoes. planted cucumbers houghd peas. feel unwell aftern sett jonas wife near night, shee well. sally done larg wash. home. 10 4 clear. done hous work gardin, sett cabbage plants &c. mr ballard, wm cypher cyrus planted potatoes. home, wrote bror jon 11 5 clear. cutt sage feaverfue. sister pollard, dagt ballard hitty pierce took tea ephm came evng. home. 12 6 clear. mrss pollard went mr ballard sett wiscasett. workt gardin, removd cucumber, mandrake, cabbage squash plants, houghd part beans &c. home. 13 7 clear. home, wed 2 beds beats helpt hous. savage bolton, wife youngest child doct barton came ys aftern tarries ys night. home. 14 1 clear. home. mr ballard absent. sons jon lambd yr wives part yr childn dind took tea luke barton dind, dady breakfasted went home. sister gone gotian. home, compy childn. 15 2 rain. mr forbs, wife daugt sleept home, workt gdn. home. mr forbs 16 3 rainy part ye day. workt gardn, sett plants. mr forbs left gloster. home. 17 4 cloudy rain. sett cabbage plants, feel falagued. sally spun home. 18 5 cloudy part day. workt gardin. sally washt went help quillt bed quillt hannah ballard. lucy shaw came home sleeps mr ballard returnd pownalboro. home. lucy shaw sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 19-24, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 19 24, 1801 19 6 clear. helping clean hous. mr merrick sary mott allso. mr ballard put 2 shelves ye buttery. lucy shaw left breakfast. home. mr soal request yt wd home. 20 7 clear warmer. planted 10 cucumber seeds went stores aftern. bror bartons, mr densmores, burtuns, dickmans betts stores; mr pittss soals hamlins. flint barton wife came home sittlement. planted cucumbers. 21 1 clear longest day ye year. happyness wait god hous, entertained two agreable discoarses deld mr parker dresden. mr ballard spent intermition brother bartons. son dagt ballard, 5 yr childn, took supper us, nephew ebenz moore allso. meeting. mr parker performd. 22 2 cloudy foren, clear aftern. wife mr robd fletcher two daugts, dagt ballard, 2 childn, sist hitty sally farewell took tea mr ballard see mr robinsons hous raised. workt gardin part ye day. made chees. home, compy. capt robensons hous raised. 23 3 clear. washing wool weading gardin sett 50 cabbage plants. home, sett cabages. 24 4 x. birth mr soals 2 dagts. xx. cloudy foren, raind night. calld see mrs soal 7h morn, shee deld daugl 11h 10m, 5m another daugt. shee infts likely well. relurnd 4h mr soals. birth 13th 14th.recd 12/ reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 25-Jul. 1, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 25 july 1, 1801 25 5 clear. done work gardin, knitt mr ballard workt road day, cyrus _ ye day. old mrss chamberlin came shee sleeps home. mrss chamberln 26 6 clear warm. mrs chamberlain went mr woodwards foren, sons aftern. workt gardin, sett cabbages cucumbers. mr dingley calld evn. home. mrs chamberln sleeps 27 7 clear warm. home, mended cloaths, helpt ye hous work. mr ballard workt road. mrs chamberlain went home. mrss chambn left 28 1 clear warm. mr ballard, self cyrus attended worship meeting hous, revd mr stone performd. ebenz moore meetg. 29 2 clear warm. mr ballard sett surveying boudinham. unwell fore n. mrs conry son jon wife old mr cypher took tea cyrus, attempting take young hors water, caut one leggs dragtd way ground; hurt considirably. home. 30 3 clear. calld sons morn see oldest son ill pain like collic. administred clister gave ye decoction ye flowers london pride, got releivd noon; came home 2h pm. workt gardin went towards evn, find comfortable. mr forbes wife came home sons, jack sick. mr forbes wife sleep rhoda pollard 7 years old. 1 4 cloudy morn, clear warm aftern. mr forbes wife sett home. hannah coole, mr burtun daughtr mgr pains calld cleand sellar, made chees, houghd beens &c, knit home. wm stone son born, mrs mosier assisted. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 2-6, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 2 6, 1801 2 5 clear morn, showers thunder aftern. mrss selvester dind went son damerins hook aftn. home, sett plants. ephm sleeps coart hous partly raised aftern. home. hear yt mr knowland broke legg. 3 6 clear warm. workt gardn till 11 o clock. drest self went lecter, sister barton went shee took tea mr craggs. went see mrss hamlin, shee fitts yesterday. lecter places. 4 7 clear warm. son dagt lambd, allin barna came early ys morn, took breakfast. dagt ballard childn tea, gidion braly allso. informd death bulah grifin, persons coulor. turn faintness childn left home, part childn faint turn evng. deaths. 5 1 clear till near night raind. went meeting, communion. full meeting seen lately. ephm went son lambd s meeting, allin went home saml trask took tea informd old lady coutch disceased. esqr john davis bride meeting. hains learned evng. meeting, sacrament day. interment old mrs coutch. esq davis bride meeting. 6 2 clear warm. helpt wash hous work, mend went sons aftern, took care babe billy shee went settlement. sons. wrote bror jon source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 7-11, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 7 11, 1801 7 3 clear warm. home, mended shirts. finisht mending 5th since began one yesterday. mrs selvester, hodges mills dind sally went settlement home. 8 4 clear warm, shower evng. rose early, brewed, made chees sally scoured puter. felt feeble aftern, went towards evn houghd revived son ephm wounded hand. home, hous work houghd. 9 5 clear warm. houghd cabages helpt hous work. ephm fore nn. planted yellow eyed rock. home, planted 1 10 6 clear. home. old ladys mosier rheed bakt apple, cherry, currant tarts, custard, wheat bread. gathered peas. home. 11 7 clear warm. houghd ye gardn shelled peas till 11h morn sudendly alarmd news dagt lambd, attempting come visit thron hors dear infant, much hurt. imediately sett go see overtaken doct cony calld relief. found, arival, dagt much hurt feared; infts head much sweld. thee doct examened bathd camphr. allso lett blood revivd left returnd home near night. find doct barton, gill, sons pollard, jona wivis childn, son lambard dolly kymbal, took tea us. blesed great author mercys lives childn spared. son lambds. mercyfull preservation took place emenent danger. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
