content: martha ballard's diary, august 13 19, 1801 13 5 clear foren. sett home breakfast, left patients cleverly. calld son pollards, lambards, well. father son pollard allso. oldest child ill turn last night better. reacht home 10hm. brother lambard dind went mr capins. raind since 4h pm. mr moores. mrs herington washt yesterday. 14 6 clear forn, shower aftern. doct barton dind look land. mr ballard sett survey dagt pollard came near night. cyrus went home ye hors shee wrode. home. 15 7 clear. home, feel unwell. dagt lambard came sister barton went home diner. dagts, sons wife, went mr gills. dolly returnd sleeps mr ballard returned surveying. paid sister 3/, mrs herington washing 2/, stors 6/. home. dagts went mr gills. 16 1 clear except shower evn. sons pollard lambd came, dind son jonas except dagt pollard, mr gills till near night. went home ye shower. mr ballard cyrus meeting meeting hous, ephm uper parsh. sons. 17 2 clear. home, houghd part cabbages hous work. doct barton mowing home. 18 3 clear warm, raind evng. home, unwell. dagt ballard came got breakfast helpt get supper. doct barton workt son town sleeps famely [well]. home. son town sleeps 19 4 clear. mrs herington washt paid 1/8 cash, buller /3d. sons town lambard sleep feel weak low work home. sons town lambd sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 20-26, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 20 26, 1801 20 5 clear. home, matters gardin. sally cypher came help mr james waw sleeps informd yt mr dickmans infant interd. departed short life yesterday, convultion fitts mr ballard cyrus coart. home. mr wow sleeps mr dickmns inft [interd]. mr ballard surveyed mr petingail yeslerday. 21 6 clear warm. mr ballard cyrus town. feel fitt business help work. mrs farewell, dagt ballard mr pierce new salem took tea ye laller receivd letter, 14th inst, sister marvin informd shee well. home. receivd letter 14thinst sister marvin. 22 7 clear. mr peirce sett hamden. unwell. mr ballard surveying geo hodgskin. home. mr ballard surveying. 23 1 clear, except showers. mr ballard meeling. mr cushman performd. comfortable. jona famely sally cypher went home, nose bled 4 5 times ys day. home. mr lambd went board captpool bound boston. 24 2 clear. unwell. dagt ballard came hous work. phebe church came noon part washing. wind brisk ye n wd. 25 3 clear. phebe finisht washing went. comfortable. home. 26 4 clear. phebe morning work went home. dagt ballard made 12 dozn candles. mr ballard surveying james howard. home, made candles; 12 dozn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 27 september 1, 1801 27 5 clear. mr ballard gone show taxes. unwell, sally cypher helping work. mr waid amos pollard took breakfast latter diging well. mr abbott business mr ballard. home. 28 6 clear. mr waid pollard part ye foren. capt stones wife, dagt ballard mrs saunders doct barton allso. sufered much day infirmety. home. mrs stone visited 29 7 cloudy heavy shower. mr ballard surveying ebenz church mr rollands. done work gardin part hous work. churnd. mr fletcher driling blowing well. home. mr fletcher workt part ye day. 30 1 clear. home, husband ephm meeting. home. 31 2 clear. home, feel unwell. sally cypher came home. 1 3 clear. able sett chair day reason infirmaty. swept chambers, lower rooms seller, left home free work. walkt mr moodys, rested little went bror bartons. laid ye bed little sister went shuball pitss. tarrie night. mrss soals inft ill turn evng, went see leut pittss night. son lambds birth day, agd [sic]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, october 13 19, 1801 13 3 clear. pain returnd last night continued day. husband went doct hubbard come sister williams, jonas wife hitty day, could give relief, without effect. home, ill indead. 14 4 rainy. ill yet. doct barton wife came see distress continued till sun sett puked soon pain subsided. wrest night. sisters b. w. ys night. capt littlefield go [sic] see wife alas, could go. home, distressed day. capt lilllefield 15 5 clear morn, cloudy day. sister wiliams left home home. doct barton came doct hubbard came see gave prescriptions opinion provible ever shall injoy good state health home. doct hubbard visit left medisin. 16 6 clear. comfortable disere bless author mercies. mrss jones see ys fore n. mrss child theops hamlins wife, afternoon. mrs cypher calld see home, comfortable; friends see 17 7 clear. comfortable forenn, severe turn pain aftern. dagt ballard came see got easier night weak. home. severe pain part ye day. 18 1 clear. mr ballard went meeting, ephm allso. son dagt pollard came see brot babe; better. son jona wife took tea. mr gill son lambard evning. felt comfortable. home. son dagt pollard 19 2 clear part day snowd part felt well ys day yesterday. dagt ballard took tea dagt lambard made prest loaf sugar. home, well. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 20-24, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 20 24, 1801 20 3 clear. pickt wool, gathered hollihock seed cut broom. dagt ballard mrss hatch took tea, latter sleeps home. mrs hatch sett day. 21 4 clear pleast. mr ballard collecting taxes east side ye river. mrs hatches hors got ye pasture. cyrus went far rheubin pinkams brot back. mrss weston informd salmon rockwoods wife deld daught doct hubbard, last night today. mr saml jacksons wife calld see mrss butler farewell allso. felt wel ys day yesterday, hitty went jonas take care ye childn ys evn son dagt go son lambards. washt dishes swept hous evn. mr ballard returnd 11h evng, informs yt deacon coneys wife sick. home. mrs hatch left breakft. company ys aftern. 22 5 clear sun rise, brite rain bow soon apeared squall wind rain. home, cleand cucumber seeds pickt wool. doct barton removd town varsalboro ys day. mrs pierc washing. home. 23 6 clear. mr ballard collecting taxes. mr bullin wife calld going canaan. picking wool. jonas wife home. mr bullin wife cyrus sett patty [tn]. 24 7 clear. mr ballard went streat, hitty allso, paid 6/ part service. felt well ys day emtyed soap pulld cabbages. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 25-31, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 25 31, 1801 25 1 clear pleast. mr ballard meeting, jona ephm n parrish. mr lambd cyrus returnd, pally town came informs yt lucy unwell. dagt ballard aftern. doct cony calld feeble. hitty pierce left morn. home. feeble. mrs [pierce] left [paid] [1/6]. patty town came 26 2 cloudy misty. son jon wm cypher hauld stones well. mr ballard pay taxes ye treasurer. feeble ys day. dagt ballard see allin lambd allso. home, feeble. 27 3 clear pleast. wrode far mr parkers way ye new roade. mr ballard sett survey mr josh f. davis. dagt lambd came allin barna. dagt ballard hitty pierce son lambd tea. rest well ye night. home. childn mr ballard sett boudinham. 28 4 clear. well work. revd mr stone dind mrss wickson, welch cyphers calld home. revd mr stone see 29 5 clear. wrode see mrss crage, find comfortable. went see mrss black, find unwell. mr craggs blacks. 30 6 clear. went see mrss black, find comfortable. attended preparetory lecter, felt fatagued returnd. jason pierces wife dind men brot ye beats evng. mr blacks lecture. mrs crage wrode mr lawsons. 31 7 clear. helpt ye hous work caused ill turn night. son dagt pollard calld going see mrss black. home, well. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 1-7, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 1 7, 1801 1 1 cloudy. went meeting forenn, communion day. see mrs black, find feeble. dagt ballard sister polly came morn. revd mr stone discoarst mathew 22nt c. 42nt vers. meeting forenn, ordinance ye supper administred. 2 2 cloudy little rain foren, sun shone part ye aftern. home, wound 10 skeins hoes yn helpt make apple pies. patty done ye hous work. hear mrss black much shee yesterday. home. mended stockins. 3 3 snowd mr lambard dind mrs cypher allso. joseph davis jos rockwood oxford son town sleeps lucy better. feel feeble self. son dagt pollard calld going home. mrs black better. home. friends calld paid mrs cypher1/10_ sallys work. 4 4 cloudy. helpt work hous pulld 1 bushel f. turnips foren, able sett aftern. mr waid sloneing well. mr bullin wife calld mr ballard returnd boudingham. home. mr ballard returnd. 5 5 clear morn, cloudy windy early ye day. mr ballard gone run line town read field. mrss saunders son jona, wife 2 daugts evn. home, washt things. dirtyd silf. mr ballard gone read field. 6 6 rainy. mr ballard returnd fm read field. pickt wool. jona butchered two stears, cyrus bill assisteid home. mr ballard returned. 7 7 clear. mr waid finisht stoneing well. home, mending. home. mr waid finisht stoneing well. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 8-16, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 8 16, 1801 8 1 cloudy morn. mr ballard, pally cyrus meeting meeting hous. mr parker performd. mr gill, lambd ephm dagt ballard ye uper parish. mr cibby perfmd. calld see wife john chamberlin 2h pm, women calld 9h evn. shee lingured till midnight. john chambrlns. 9 2 birth john chamberlins son. clear. patients illness came shee safe deld 3h 30m morn son, 7th child last mariage. left cleverly arivd home 10h, took refreshment. ditoes. birth 18/th. 10 3 clear part day. men bankt hous. washt cloaths first water part ye second, washt dishes breakft diner; feel fatagued ye bed aftern. home. allin lambd ys day. 11 4 snowd raind. mr ballard collecting taxes. mrs chamberlin calld foren. cut apples. home. mrss chamberlin 12 5 raind snowd. mending waisl coat mr ballard. revd mr stone mr ballard paid 27 dolrs 20 cents collected. bakt mins pies. home. mr stone 13 6 clear. mended pair trousers, cut coverlid raggs sewed ym cut flocks. mr ballard cyrus got wood. home mending cloaths. 14 7 clear. mending mr ballards cloaths. mrss edson home. 15 1 clear pleast. mr ballard meeting. went son lambards intermition. ephm attended aftern. cyrus went son pollards. meeting. text numb 23 c 10 v, corinth 16 c 13 vers. 16 2 cloudy rain. mr ballard sett surveying mr vaughn fair field. patty wido farewells quilting. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, november 17 27, 1801 [17] 3 cloudy moderate. home, sewd wolen sheets cut apples. jonas wife old mrs rhead allso. home. son lambd breakfast 18 4 rainy. home. home. 19 5 rainy part day. helpt wash pulld french turnips; sick night. home. 20 6 clear. mr waid bulchered cyruss cow. helpt clean tripe feet. mr ballard returnd fairfield. home. mr ballard returnd. 21 7 clear. home mending shirts ephm matters. home. 22 1 clear pleast morn, cloudy aftern. mr ballard patty meeting. shee went mr gills, cyrus went evng. sons lambard, jon ephm went sidney. son town came informs lucy better. home. son town sleeps 23 2 cloudy part ye day. home. bakt mins pies. mr ballard went hook. home. 24 3 rainy. home. bakt pies wheat bread. mr ballard twice ye settlement. salted beef cut apples brewed. son jona unwell. home, bakt. saml braley son born. 25 4 clear cool. washt bullery, kitchen n rooms helpt make apple pies, done things. son jona supt us, well. mr c. vaughn home. jobe springer son born. 26 5 clear. mr ballard attended meeting. children dind us, hitty pierce allso. pally town, spent ye evng son jonas; except cyrus, well. jonas childn dagts brot babes. home. thanksgiving day. childn see us. hitty sleeps 27 6 cloudy, raind evn. sons pollard, jona wives dind pierce allso. jona, le faett hannah, son pollard wife went home noon. home. childn dind source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 28-Dec. 9, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 28 december 9, 1801 28 7 clear morn, cloudy afterwards. home, helpt finish washing sewing, laid boards walk well hous. pally bakt pumkn pies. mr ballard laid platform ye well. home. 29 1 clear. mr ballard, pally ephm attended public worship. feel able go. son jona, wife daugts meeting. mr stone discoarsed romans 1st c 28 v. home. jona wife 30 2 clear part day colder yesterday. home work hous. mr ballard makeing plan. cyrus jack went colo duttuns. home. 1 3 cloudy. washt wolens part linning. dagt ballard evng. mrs cypher home, helpt wash. 2 4 clear part day, snowd evng. helpt hous work, washt old wolen pieces. feel falagued, laid ye bed part ye aftern. dagt ballard son jona phraim raisd crotch ye road field. home. jona phraim raised ys aftern. 3 5 cloudy. home. home. 4 6 cloudy snow. home. home. 5 7 snowd. made apple mins pies. cyrus went bot 8yds flanel, brot home 2h pm. made shift put ys evng. chace pages wife expired. home, made flanel shift. 6 1 snowd. mr ballard went meeting, rest famely home. home. 7 2 clear cold. mr ballard cyrus town meeting. ephm saml trask boarding jonas new hous. mended 2 pair hoes self done hous wk. home. chase pages wifes remains interd. 8 3 clear. mrs pollard young son town sleep home. home. mrs pollard 9 4 clear. mrs pollard went went son jonas. mrs young bolloming chairs us, done 8. son jonas. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 10-18, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 10 18, 1801 10 5 rainy. home, hous work began mittin. mrs young finisht bottoming chairs, 13th, 2 son jon three jon sons dind home. 11 6 clear. mrs young bottomed 1 chair son jona paid 4/2d three shee gave order son lambard 19/. shee went away noon. kniting mittin. mrs welch david dind home. 12 7 clear. finisht mr ballards mitts began cyruss. son pollard supt ephm went home mrs parker home, finished pair mitts mr ballard. 13 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. patty sett ye aftern went son lambards. wife babe came home son jona, wife, ephm babe, supt son ephm gone son pollards. home. 14 2 cloudy. mr ballard sett varsalboro surveying mr c. vauhn. woman name calld shee requested give buds balm gilead suthern wood. shee took shee wisht went capt stackpoles winslow. home. mr ballard varsalboro, pally son lambds; paid 4 dols. 15 3 clear. home. pally came home dagt lambds. home. 16 4 clear cold. feel unwell. sist pollard came evn, jonas wife mr ballard came home unwell. home. mrs pollard sleeps 17 5 clear, cold windy. home kniting mitts. mrs pollard sleeps son pollard calld home. 18 6 clear moderate. mr ballard hallowell, mrs pollard son jonas. charlottee brown sally farewell visit. home. pally compy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 19-29, 1801 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 19 29, 1801 19 7 clear. anniversary mariage, 47 years. home kniting mitts. home. 47 years [since] mariag. 20 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting, jon wife, pally ephm north parrish hear comft smith. anty bracket told expearence. home, feel unwell. 21 2 clear part ye day. home, knit part mit little ephm, pair wilm 1 thos lambd. home. 22 3 clear part ye day. mr ballard run line sidney agusta. home, finisht tommys mitts. patty washt. home. 23 4 rainy day. mending hoes. home. 24 5 cloudy ye day. home mending hoes. mr ballard ye settlement. informd mr abbotts store, goods therein, consumed fire night past. home. mrs cypher dind 25 6 clear pleast. ephm patty kept christmas son lambards, partnr. polly farewell cyrus [tolle]. home. mrs wiman winslow expired. 26 7 clear. mr ballard confind lamb hand. home mending hoes shirts. son dagt ballard mrs pierce supt informd mrs wiman winslow expired last night. son town came bring tidings. home, compy. 27 1 rainy day. ephm went meeting. mr ballards hand lambe. home. 28 2 clear, pleast morn, cloudy night. made sausages knit jonas wife supt. home. 29 3 cloudy cold. knit, unwell. mrs wimans remains interd day. may nearly concerned make sanctifyed improvment dispensation providence may learn allso ready. old mr gill home, severe head aick night. funeral mrs wiman winslow. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-11, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 11, 1802 1 6 clear pleast. home. jonas wife 4 childn dind. shee mr benn brown took tea began foot pair hoes son ephm. home. dagt [bald] 4 childn 2 7 clear part ye day, sea fogg came aftern. thought fire went sons found fogg. sons. 3 1 cloudy, misty warm. mr ballard went meeting, agreably entertaind discoarses new year. son lambds noon supt son jonas famely. meeting, son lambds jonas. 4 2 rainy day, snowd 11h evng. kniting. home kniting. 5 3 clear colder. finisht futing pair hoes ephm, began another pair, mended pair socks jon wife dagts came evng want fire. patty went home carried wood. leut john shaw supt home kniting. 6 4 clear. patty washt, ephm saml workt hous makeing sashes. wm cypher workt us. finisht ye 3d pr hoes son ephm wound 10 skeins yn balls. home kniting. 7 5 rainy. doubled 10 skeins yn helpt hous work. mr ballard went cuminsen mill, bot 2 bushels corn ground. ephm saml workt ye hous makeing sashes. home, doubled 10 skeins yarn. 8 6 clear. home kniting. shingling jon hous. home. 9 7 clear pleast. mr saunders began son jon chimney. mending kniting. home. 10 1 raind foren, snowd evng. mr ballard sons meeting, patty went aftern. jona wife, hannah, sally ephm evng, ephm sleeps home. 11 2 snowd ys morn. home. mr sanders got chimney hous. son jona got 3 colts barn, till fodered. home, finisht footing pr tow hoes. sally 1 year old. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 12-19, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 12 19, 1802 12 3 clear cold. home, made petty coat sally old worsted stockin leggs began hand pair mitts hannah. mr ballard taxes. home sewing kniting. 13 4 clear cold. kniting, mr ballard taxes. patty washt, part ye hous work knit. son town came evng sleeps informs yt lucy failing fast. may god prepare wil life death. home. son town sleeps lecter preachtat benn browns childn baptised. 14 5 clear part ye day. mr ballard giting wood. son lambard conducted wife 3 childn came 10h evng. dagt ballard part childn spent aftern. old lady cypher james cyphers wife calld dolly lambd tarries sons ys night. home, finisht pair mits hannah began another pr. 15 6 cleare. home. hannah ballard dolly lambard spent day mr ballard went nathan breads surveying. home. mr ballard varsalboro. 16 7 raind foren, clear evng. calld mr moody see wife 7h evng, women calld 11h evng. mr moodys. mr balld returnd. ezrahodges 1 son 2 dagts born. 17 1 birth daniel moodys 3d son. clear. patient safe deld 1h ys morn 3d son. got sleep returnd home 9h morn, famely meeting except self. son jona famely dind us. mr moodys. birth 1st. recd 9/. 18 2 clear. home, finisht kniting pair white mitts hannah ballard. dolly us yet. home. mrs hodges 3 children born 16th inst. 19 3 snowd little. mr ballard mr lawsons revd mr stones. home, knitt pair tow hoes cyrus. dagt ballard twist yarn. home. news confirmd ye childn wd 9 lb mother help till born. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 20 28, 1802 20 4 clear, pleast forenn, cloudy aftn. mr ballard gone parish meeting. cyrus ephm ye settlement. patty hous wk spun dolly pikt chips. knitt pikt wool. home. 21 5 snowd raind. kniting, patty washt. home. 22 6 clear. kniting. patty bakt, twisted yn. number sleighs passt us ys day. home. snow fell winter 23 7 snowd. mr ballard went settlement. doubling yarn kniting. finisht ye 3d pair tow hoes. saml trask came conducted dolly lambard home, shee since ye 14th inst. home. dolly went home. 24 1 clear cold. famely, except self, attended worship meeting hous foren. went aftern; dagt ballard day. jona, wife, ephm patty son lambds evng. mr gill wife gone winslow ys day. north parish worshipt new coart house. jotham sewall performd. meeting famely. mr gill gone son towns. 25 2 clear cold. home. dagt ballard spin wheal. childn except jack, gone bellgrade. home. dagt ballard 26 3 clear cold. washt wollin cloathss part ye lining. patty ye hous work, washt part ye lining. home, washt. 27 4 cloudy, raind began pair mens hoes helpt hous work. mr austn brot corn us. home. let mrs cypher /3/. 28 5 clear pleast morn. cousin saml davis penobscott came tarries night. pally gone mr gills. home. saml davis sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, february 8 18, 1802 8 2 clear. mr cottle wife dind doct ballard mrrs trask supt. cyrus went son towns patty. home. betsy church came work us. son lambd, dagt thoms wm gill informd mrs trip child, wd 12 [lb]. home, compy. 9 3 cloudy, snowd evn. betsy washt washt ye kitchin. cyrus returnd, informs lucy much shee rest ye famely cleverly. home. 10 4 clear morn, snowd soon, comfortable afterwards. home. home. mr lawson recvd [money]. 11 5 clear. home. hannah ballard slept last night. shee unwell. betsy went son jon see famely home. dagt gone asa pierces. home. saml smith sidney expired ysday. 12 6 cloudy, snowd little evng. home overhalling raggs coverlid &c. sally cypher informds yt saml smith expired yesterday. home. mrs bridg deld first dagt 3d child. mrs mosier performd. 13 7 cloudy rain. mending shirts son ephm, done three. betsy brewd hous work mended trousers saml trask. home. 14 1 clear pleast. mr ballard sons went meeting. betsy went dadys. home. home. 15 2 cloudy. done part hous work. revd mr stone lady made us visit. home. mr stone lady 16 3 clear. home. son jona wife mr fletchers, jack wilm came wm severe turn ye collic, ephm tarried night. home. billy ye collic. 17 4 snowd little. mr waid butchered 2 swine us. 12_lb sparerib. home, killd hoggs. 18 5 x. birth pegy whealors dagt. x. cloudy windy. calld 4h morn see peggy whealor, shee deld dagt 9 shee declared gates father came home 12 o clock, tried lard. mr meril n. gloster, wife, robd forbes fanny sleep marm made prest pair mitts. saunders. case 3d. receivd 9/ ofl. hamlin. compy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 1-13, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 1 13, 1802 1 2 snowd. done washing. betsy ye hous work helpt wash ye buttery kitchen. son lambd famely well. home. 2 3 snowd raind. put leach soap. betsy washt nh room. son lambd 3 childn. home. 3 4 sons pollard, lambd, jona, mr gill wives came visit. dagts tarrie night, mr gill wife sons. son pollard mr lambds. made kettle soap home. childn collic. 4 5 cloudy, snowd evng. mr ballard, self childn, except cyrus, dind son jonas. seen 39 years ys day. sons, ye collic pain 5 6 clear cooler. son ephm sett wait sisters jon wife son towns. home, finisht makeing barril soap, turn ye collic. home. ephm went son towns. 6 7 snowd raind. soap works, feel fatagued. collic pa home. 7 1 cloudy, cold windy. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. felt collic ys day. hitty pierce, hannah, sally ephm dind childn returnd son towns, well except lucy, low. jona wife came shee came home. ye collic pain ys day. home. childn returnd winslow. 8 2 raind. home soap. home. 9 3 clear. home makeing soap. home. 10 4 snowd. betsy church went mr wm pitts. finisht soap, feel unfit work. home. 11 5 clear. washt ye n room olher wk. home. 12 6 cloudy snow. unwell. mrs farewell calld sick night, put bed husband cyrus lay cloaths. home, sick night. 13 7 cloudy snowd. dagt ballard came got breakfast. feel feeble. mrs pattin came see informd mrs cain dead. home, feeble. dagt bald mrs pattin source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 14-19, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 14 19, 1802 [14] [1] clear cold. mr ballard ephm went meeting. hannahs ballard pollard came son jon wife 4 childn went mr saml pierces. mrss edson came see hearing sick. take kind indead. son dagt lambd came meeting, tittle [toms] o good see one concernd would forgit gods goodness preserving death thought even hold may still live shew sence goodness. home. gods goodness comfortable. son lambd wife mrss edson see 15 2 clear. home, unwell forenn. betsy andrus came help began wash. jona famely returnd. ephm, b. cypher, robd fletcher got 6 loads wood 1 jonas. home, betsy andrus came assist 16 3 clear pleast. betsy finisht wash. mrss church dagt lidia took tea bill cypher cut wood door ys aftern. mr ballard cyrus ye settlement, ephm allso. coart sett. home. mrss church betsy went home. 17 4 clear. home. mr ballard cyrus coart. mrs farewell, dagt ballard son town took tea son town sleeps famely well except lucy, declineing fast. may god aford comfortable hopes love immortal part, may send guardan angel guid better part bliss. sons jona ephm sidney. jason pierce came sons. home. son town sleeps lucy better. 18 5 clear warm. mrs herington scoured puter. men gone coart. dolly kimbal came work home. 19 6 clear part ye day. mended waist coat shirt cyrus. dagt ballard mrss pierce tea. men coart, caus capt wm haywood robinson mills tried went thee jury evng. home. dagt balld mrs pierce source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 20-24, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 20 24, 1802 20 7 cloudy part ye day, snowd night. home fixing son cyruss cloaths, unwell. home, unwell. 21 1 clear. mr ballard meeting day, ephm aftern. mending cloaths son cyrus, going mr lees tomorrow. sally betsy church home. 22 2 clear pleast. son cyrus sett wiscassett, son ephm went conduct part way sleigh. gone tend mill mr silas lee. may god guide preserve return safety. mr ballard gone settlement. feel gloomy. saml freeman cuting wood door. ephm returnd evng, informd mare, sleigh, fell thro ye ice opisite mr smiths. two men came asistance thro gods goodness, lives sons hors saved. harness damaged. home. son cyrus sett mr lees ye point. fell thro ye ice mr smiths, assisted two men escaped lives. dagt ballad 23 3 clear part ye day. ephm went compy ye revd mr stone, son lambd saml page grealy pond fish. caught 3 mending stockins brewing. dolly washt went son jonas. home. dolly went sons evng. 24 4 cloudy, raind night evng. mending cloaths. dagt ballard billy dind us. mr ballard settlement. ephm saml workt shop. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 25-Apr. 1, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 25 april 1, 1802 25 5 clear. home, unwell. mr ballard ye settlement. home. 26 6 clear. home, able much work. dolly card ing cottne. home. 27 7 clear. home, unwell. mr ballard ye settlement. dolly went sons spun wick yn. home. 28 1 clear morn cold, snowd aftern cold. son dagt ballard childn supt us. sheep died. mr ballard, ephm saml trask went meeting. feel comfortable ys day unwell night. home. son jona famely supt 29 2 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mending stockins legins mr ballard cyrus. mr ballard gone east side ye river collect taxes. informd john brown joal commiting rape daught 11 years age. home. 30 3 cloudy. mr ballard sett monmoth survey. home mending hoes hous work. dolly went marms. paid 6/7. son jon childn, except hannah, took tea. bror moors son james jack le faett ballard sleep home. mr ballard gone monmoth. jethro gardner 31 4 rainy. home mending hoes mr ballard, helping hous wk. james lester sodered ye handle coffee pott, mended tea 2 basons. dolly spun 1 skein cottne. home. paid tinkering 1/4. 1 5 cloudy. home, hous wk mended pair legins. mr ballard returnd evng right hand sholder lamb reason fall got yesterday. jimy page supt us. home. mr ballard returnd lambe. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 2-10, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 2 10, 1802 2 6 clear. done part work, dolly spun forin. shee dagt ballard went ye wido farewels quilting aftern, returnd 11h evng. home, dolly quillting. 3 7 rainy. makeing holders peicing raggs foren, able sett little ys aftern. home. 4 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. jack ballard brot hannah son pollards. jonas wife childn supt came sett table great passion white mare hurt. overcame much able sett could wish might see folly evil conduct reform. home. 5 2 clear. mr ballard ephm town meeting. done sewing part hous work, able sett aftern little. dolly washt. home. mrss farewel calld 6 3 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mending stockings, dolly ironing, dagt ballard mr woodwards. jona mr motts hay, got 9 hundred wt. saml returnd marms, shee sick feaver. home. 7 4 clear part ye day, thunder shower aftern. dagt lambard 2 childn, son jon wife childn took tea us. son pollard calld door, famely well usual. ephm put lower casements 3 windows light hous. dolly went mr parkers. home. childn visit ruth fairfield winslow expired. 8 5 clear. mr ballard dolly went meeting, ye yearly fast. home. son lambd mr gill calld informed yt wife church williams deld son, 2nd child, ys morn. home. mr ballard meeting, fastday. 9 6 clear. home mending shirts son cyrus, dolly hous work. home. 10 7 snowd day. dat ballard unwell, dolly went take care home mending stockins. home. dagt bald unwell. dolly went help source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 11-19, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 11 19, 1802 11 1 clear. dolly went sons forn help dagt, shee little comfortable. mr ballard went meeting day; ephm aftern. saml n. parrish. son jona wife sally supper, legg pork stuft. home. son dagt ballard meeting. 12 2 clear cold. cow calvd morn sun rise. went barn milk shee fine heifer calf. dolly washt. quite confined part ye day pain stomach. son ephm made bread trough. home, unwell. 13 3 clear. mr ballard went lambds, brot dagts new cottne cards. makeing candles, 20 dozn self 3 dagt ballard. shee came see aftern. saml went meeting cowens. home, made 23 dzn candles. 14 4 clear. helping hous work. mr ballard son ephm gone settlement. jonas wife unwell, sister hitty came see home. 15 5 clear. made cake, wheat bread, rice, pumkin pies. dagt ballard sister took tea us. informd ye death daniel townsins wife child bed. home. 16 6 clear cold. mr ballard surveying son jona. pain stomach done mending. home. 17 7 clear. washt 5 bed blankets one rag coverled helpt wash kitchen, done mending. hitty pierce sleeps home, washt 18 1 rainy morn, cloudy day. mr ballard famely went meeting. son jon dind dolly capt stones. saml shott partridg gave dagt ballard. home. 19 2 clear. mr ballard went mr gardners. receivd letter cyrus ye 16th inst, wrote answer; well. dolly son jonas ys aftern. home. recd line fm cyrus wrote answer. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 20-25, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 20 25, 1802 20 3 clear. home helping clean hous racking piking chips sorting potatoes. fatagued sett aftern. mrs h. pierc dind home. 21 4 clear part ye day moderate. done part hous work, sorted potatoes, cleard seller 3 pails ful dirt, sett 30 cabbage stumps removd part banking hous. dagt ballard 3 childn sally farewell took tea son pollard calld, famely well. pain stomach. home. dagt ballard 22 5 clear. sett french turinps. mr ballard returnd mr gardners. home. 23 6 clear cold season. removd banking east side ye house. son pollard, dagts ballard lambard dind polly sally farewell spent aftern took tea us. receivd letter sist waters march ye 1st, connections well westwd. home, compy. recd letter sister waters march 1st. 24 7 clear pleast. done hous work removd dirt, banking, hous, feel fatagued. dolly unwell, bror john aftern. home. lucy town expired ys aftern. 25 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. sons lambd, jona ephm son pollards. capt stackpool came inform us death lucy town, may god pleas sanctify dispensation us may hear call, ye allso ready. home. informd ye death lucy town. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 26-May 2, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 26 may 2, 1802 [26] [2] clear foren. unwell walkt sons, wife bake ys aftn. dolly done washing. sons. 27 3 clear cold windy. sons lambard ephm sett ys morn go son towns. remains lucy town interd 2h ys aftern. may famely, connections neighbours, presence great parent universe may ye call, ye allso ready, attended us son dagt ballard part yr childn supt us. mr ballard giting hay fm motts. home, feel well. funeral lucy town ys aftern. dolly kimbal went home. 28 4 clear windy cold. work able. dagt ballard home. 29 5 clear cold. bakt done work, feel unwell sett aftern. home. 30 6 x. birth abm devenports dagt. xx. clear. calld ye 5th h morn go see wife mr abm devenport labour. shee safe deld 9 1st dagt 4th child. returnd attended lecter. calld mr blacks, saunders moodys, several stores. son dagt ballard supt son cyrus came home ye point, arivd 9h evng; fatagued. mr devenports. birth 5th. recd 12/ rewd. lecture aftern mr moodys. 1 7 clear windy. much alarmd fire caught drie stuf ye shop, ran allmost ye fence ye lots. home. 2 1 clear cold. mr ballard, self, ephm, dagt ballard hannah meeting. ordinance supper administred, 7 male 14 female members communed. went son lambds, babe unwell. dolly kembal returnd meeting son lambds. dolly k. came evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 3-8, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 3 8, 1802 3 2 clear. spent ye day racking chips door yd. sett currint bushes balm giliad. mrs pattin brot home 21 double skeins yn shee spun paid 7/6. dagt ballard mrs pierce took tea mr ballard, cyrus ephm town meeting. magr saml howard chosen represent town general coart. home. mrs pattin, dagt ballard h. pierce 4 3 clear. sett curent bushes, sowd letues pepper grass, finisht removing banking ye hous; feel fatagued. georg rheeds wife deld daught day. ephm saml gone training. home. workt gardin. ephm gone traning. 5 4 clear cold ye season. sett french turnips, 2 another kind 1 beat. went eliab shaws web wove, 25 skeins wp, 2do lining filling, 47 cottne. gone 2h fm home. mr eliab shaws calld mr parkers. 6 5 cloudy part ye day cold. mr ballard cyrus finisht ploughing corn ground. home, feel well could wish. mrs pierce bake. home. 7 6 clear windy. jona wife dind took tea. old leut shaws barn burnt much put save hous. capt stone great danger loosing buildings. done little watch ye motien ye fire. home. 8 7 clear. fire drove mrs welch famely sleep hous. ye day watching ye fire, calld james keton go see wife unwell. mr ketons night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 15-23, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 15 23, 1802 15 3 clear. well went sons see sally, shee unwell. sons. 16 4 clear. hannah ballard brot home mr saunderss shee sick night. went see workt gardin. ditoes. 17 5 clear. unwell could sett little, houghd part beens. salmon rockwood dind home, unwell. 18 6 clear part ys day, light shower aftern. sally towl went paid 6/3 pence two weaks work. son jon dind, wife, billy, jason pierce, hannah sally pollard took tea home. workt gd n. 19 7 clear. unwell till 3:o clock aftern, done work ye hous. grand childn went sons aftern. mr ballard surveying road leads mr westons winthrop. home, unwell. 20 1 showers forenn. famely went meeting, except self. severe pain stomach. clarissa stone came noon, shee going work 5 son jon childn, 2 pollards, allin lambd luke barton evng. home. clarrissa stone came 8 g. childn 21 2 clear. mr ballard unwell, pain back. workt gardin, pain fore n night. mrs farewell son dagt ballard took tea home, mrs farewell 22 3 clear part ye day, thunder shower adtern. helpt hous work. son pollard made prest head harslet calf. well. son jona wife jack dind us. ill turn. home. clarrisa fathers. 23 4 cloudy rain. home, work gardin altho pain stomach, ill night. home, sick night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 24-30, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 24 30, 1802 [24] 5 cloudy part ye day. sick day. dagt ballard came see several times. got ease better night. dagt bald mrs farewels aftern. home, ill indead, day. 25 6 clear till near night became cloudy. workt gardin considarable part day. much reason bless god restoreing mercies. able bring us low raise us seemith good unto mr ballard well gone collect taxes. dagt ballard gone son lambds. clarrissa aftern mrs farewels. home, gods great goodness muchmore comfortable. clara went mrss farewels. 26 7 clear day. well work gardin part ofthe day. wm cypher helping hough corn. mr ballard cyrus son jona, wife william dind us. home, workt gardin. 27 1 clear. famely meeting. revd mr parker performd, spake forenn exodus xx c 8 [vs], aftern fm matthu xxiv 42nt. went mr pittss intermition, son lambd meeting. unwell night. meeting mr pittss son lambds. 28 2 clear, part ye day showers. dagt ballard took tea unwell done little work day. home, unwell. 29 3 clear. home, workt gardin knit comfortable. home. 30 4 clear. home, houghd peas, beens, [radashes], cucumbers, millons, knit. mrs farewell dagt ballard tea informd james cyphers infant dead. rhoda pollard 8 years old ys day. home. mrs farewell [dagt] ballard [death]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 1-7, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 1 7, 1802 1 5 clear. mr ballard ye settlement business. home, feel well could wish helpt hous work, knit work gardin. son jona wife went asa pierces see le faett sick measels. clarrisa scourd puter. home. dagt ballard gone see le faett. 2 6 clear. home. dagt ballard came home, left le faett comfortable. houghd part beens. home. 3 7 clear. workt gardin foren. mrss moody dagt ballard tea. mr ballard river, finds le faett better. clarrisa head aich. home. mrs moody dagt ballard 4 1 clear. famely attended worship except self ephm. went sydney son pollard, took breakfast jon wife part childn evn. le faett seems feeble. clarrisa sett go fathers went mrss farewels. home. clarrisa mrs farewels. 5 2 clear. indipendance observd hallowell. mr ballard ephm went see rather hear oration deld performd thos bond. clarrisa went mr parkers. sett 62 cabg plants. old mrs rhead shee going mr asa williams. unwell, night pain. home. mrs rhead calld 6 3 clear. ill ys day. dagt ballard came nursed may gods blessing rest goodness home, sick day. 7 4 clear. feeble left take care self famely. paid clarrissa stone 8/8_ shee done since june 20th. home, unwell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 8-11, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 8 11, 1802 8 5 clear. done hous work houghd gardin. calld 3h pm go see dagt lambard find feeble. doct coney given emetic. find sist barton betsy kumbal help work. larried night. son ephm slept night. son lambds, wife sick. sist barton 9 6 rainy forenn. dagt lambd. shee much better shee partly made goun sister barton. mrss gill came left 3h pm went lecter, mr stone performd. met mr caton mr pittss store paid 9/ assisting wife labour may 18th. allso receivd 9/ luis hamlin assisting peggy whealor like circumstances 18th feby last. mr ballard, cyrus self took tea son jonas. calld mr towns, wife comfortable. ditoes, lecture, luis hamlins, towns mr pittss store. son town mr lambds, famely well. saml trask unwell. 10 7 clear part day. pain stomach severe hous work, except churning sally tole ill shee went home time seemd must expire soon, author mercies grant relief disire prais holy name. home, ill day. 11 1 clear till near night rain haill. famely meeting, ordinance ye supper administred. great reason bless god opt commorateing dying lov savior sinners, may life agreable mercies receiv. meeting, communion day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 25-31, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 25 31, 1802 25 1 clear warm. dagt pollard spent day, ye comfortable yesterday. son lambd, wife son pollard, jona, wife childn mrs getchel dind meeting. string beens green peas. feel well evng. son pollard conducted wife home, childn well usual. expected haveing measels. home. [childn] dine, 7 grand childn. 26 2 clear warm. unwell, pukt morn. husband one take care suckseed. dagt ballard came made bed brusht rooms. may pleas god direct us one may pitty case grant assistance case requires, give acquiess divine home, unwell. 27 3 cloudy, heavy thunder aftern. feeble. lydia hallowell cut part sage mrs gill. home. 28 4 clear. menasa duttuns wife came help wrode sons see mrs getchel, shee collic. mrs farewell calld son jona returnd winslow. son towns famely well. sons. mrss [gitchel] seck 29 5 clear part ye day. mrs duttun wacht. done part hous work knit mrs hity pierce dind mrs dattun went home evn. paid 3/ service. mr ballard cyrus town meeting. home, feel better. 30 6 cloudy misty. mr ballard mr vaughns. doct cony calld left pill [cocha] blister. well sew shirt. home, feel better. 31 7 clear warm. blister allmost makes seck. wm webber wife dind jona wife gone sydni. home, blister. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 17-26, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 17 26, 1802 [17] 3 clear. wast north room went see hannah ballard, shee got measels. sons see hannah. 18 4 clear. washt kitchen, feel unwell indead. mr ballard coart. home. 19 5 raind see hannah, find better. capt parker killd cart overseting. sons. 20 6 rainy. mr ballard cyrus coart. son town selpt last night went morn. home. son town 21 7 clear. done washing, mr ballard cyrus coart. sister wilms, dagts ballard lambd took tea ezra town sleeps ephm came home hannah ballard foren, sally shee slipt hurt head stone. home. sister wiliams sleeps ezra town allso. 22 1 clear warm. famely meeting. sister willams spent day dagt ballard came meeting, took walk shop orchard. ezra ephm son pollards meeting, returnd evng. home. sister wilms ezra sleep 23 2 clear. sister wilms helpt morn went son jonas. finisht work, went aftern. feel much fatagued, went bed rested. took tea mr ballard cyrus allso. sister came home mrs farewell us fm ill night. aneversary lucy towns [birth] 17 years. sons. ezra town sleeps 24 3 cloudy part day, raind night. son jona men work haying, wife went sith j. fosters. mrs hallowell came evn tarries night. jona wife gone night. home, feel unwell. 25 4 clear. sister williams part ye day. home. 26 5 clear. mrs welch washt paid cash 9/8_. mr ballard sett ball town. sister williams spent ye day sons, came evng. well could wish. home. mr ballard sett ball town. mrs welch washt source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 27-31, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 27 31, 1802 27 6 cloudy rain. done hous work, cleand seller boiled pickle. sister wilms dagt ballard dagts sally parker took tea [home]. dagt balld 28 7 cloudy. sister wms went son jonas. done 29 1 aftern work. sister ye morning work taken phisic evng preceeding ys day. lott singular patience wish conform husband returnd evng fm balls town much fatagued journey, fitt shakeing. heat blankett put 3h morn. relaxed, dirtied bed. rose, shirted removed dirty lining, went bed cold could sleep. rose sun rose, washt things unclean felt unfitt attend worship lhat tarried home. famely attended. o god, time may power go thy house worship home. mrs duttun husband [returnd]. home. dagt ballard mrss stone went board capt bruister [boston] [morn]. 30 2 cloudy till aftern sun shone. men takeing care hay. mr ballard gone sidney survey mr getchel. havee washt cloaths. sister wilms went sons. shee dagt came took tea mrs duttun mending cloaths revd mr stone calld home. mr ballard gone sidney. 31 3 clear. men takeing care ye hay. done work tho ill able. walkt sons see sally sick measels. sister wilms part day. james moore go see amos lions wife. able. sons. sally sick. mr james moore source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 1-4, 1802 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 1 4, 1802 1 4 clear. calld visit mrs lyon. went, wrode without dismounting. find little easier help opiate doct hubard given pain returned sun sett. calld see 10h evn, made pertinent prayer gave annidine. shee easier thro night. amos lyons, wife sick. son lambds birth day. 2 5 clear. mr lyons, wife much distresed pain; seems uterine complaint, wind. administred clister gave great relief. shee became pirfectly easy. went mr preskotts larried night, cramp slept little. peris hamlins wife ditoes, mr swantons preskotts. dagt lambds birth day. 3 6 clear. calld back visit patient, administred clister performed services left hopes recovery. calld mr james moores, colo duttuns son pollards. arivd home night, find mrs duttun washt lower rooms absence lake kind. ditoes, colo duttuns son pollards. 4 7 clear. mrs duttun went home foren. went sons, find wilm sally unwell. returnd, prepared self went lecture; mr abbott performd. calld mr andrusis came home sons. childn seeme comfortable. son ephm well. sons, lecture mr andruses. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 29 october 3, 1802 [29] 4 clear. mr gills, child viry low. old lady hamlin, mrs camble moore came see old lady gill came left afler diner. calld son lambds, thoms sick measels; fm came mr burtuns, took tea friends consisted mrs hamlin, crage, camble, moores, carter 2 mrs burtuns, returnd home. calld sons, wife better. le faett wilm sick. sist barton, mr porter wife sleep mr gills friends. content: martha ballard's diary, february 28 march 7, 1803 28 2 clear. home. began snow evn. girls washt jonas. began make skirt. leut john shaw paid taxes. georg andrus paid 1d 50 cents. home. mr ballard gone mr foys. 1 3 snowd. finisht skirt knitt mr ballard returnd. home. jona wife asa pierces. 2 4 clear cold. nabby fall left paid wages work shee done home. nabby left wint hallowell. 3 5 clear pleast. mrs forbes son robd left breakfast bound gloster, slept last night. home. dagt ballard went son pollards. son ephm [sic]. home. mrs forbs set fm gloster. 4 6 clear pleast. son jona daug lambd dind went son pollards. returnd 10h evn. mr ballard pay money treasurers. bror ebenzr sleeps allin lambd ephm ballard allso. home. bror ebenz sleeps son jona seen 40 years day. 5 7 clear. mr ballard went sydny survey, bror ebenz moore jona wife dind finisht futing stockins. home. 6 1 clear. mr ballard, cyrus, ephm lidia went meeting. home. home. 7 2 birth mr thompsons child. clear. calld mid night go mr thompsons, wrode beyond mr edsons met informd patient delivered. returned home attended mr edson, arivd 2h morn, cold. mending cloaths. lidia washt. mr lathrop came work son ephm. set go mr thompsons. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 1-7, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 1 7, 1803 1 [6] clear. home, began stockin sally ballard. home. 2 7 clear. went sons see sally, shee unwell. came home evng. sons, sally sick. 3 1 cloudy. mr ballard, cyrus ephm meeting. lydia went sons. sally remains unwell, le faett, ephm wilm allso. home. 4 2 cloudy. mr ballard sons town meeting. informd daniel woodwards infant sufocated bed parents night past. mr lathrop makeing cofin lydia went son jon see childn unwell. sons see childn. daniel woodwds infant expired bed parents. 5 3 cloudy rain. mr ballard sett mr hartwill [sum] surveying leeds. lydia, ephm mr lathrope attended funeral daniel woodwards infant. betsy church lydia came took coffee. informd mr whitwels oldest daught expired last night. home day. son jona says childn seem comfortable. home. mr ballard gone leeds. esqr whitwels dagt expird last night morn. 6 4 clear. mrs h. pierce dind went sons. went took tea childn seems better. lydia spint evn little sally day. sons. h. peirce paid lydia nudd12/. 7 5 clear. ephm lydia went meeting, day sett part fasting prayer. felt unwell day. mr ballard returned home leeds fatagued. home. mr whitwels oldest daugt interd meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 8 13, 1803 8 6 cloudy. home sewing. allin thomas lambard snowd night. home. 9 7 clear, snow went calld aftern mr moody go see wife, found mrs woodward patient defucalt circumstances, tarried night. mr moodys, wife unwell. 10 1 clear. mr moodys. doct hubard calld see gave medisin opinion complaint wil thron natures eforts. tarried night, number ladies visit ye patienl. ditoes. doct hubard calld 11 2 clear. tarried mrs moody till near night returnd home unwell, find husband unwell. exercised pain head seemed life must go. calld lydia night. shee applyed poultises feet warm brandy head hot flanell, became easier morning. 12 3 clear. easier. mr ballard sett boudin ham. jona, wife, mrs pierce see mrs bolton dind mrs farewell sleeps informd deacon cony expired last night. since hiard sun rise. home. mr ballad boudinham. [hear] deacon cony dead. 13 4 clear. feel comfortable. mr puringtn mrs farewell gone mrss andrews took tea. home. mrs ands mrs farewell left source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 22 26, 1803 22 6 clear. went sons see son jona hurt self yesterday uncle lambds. aprehensive briech. bathd bandaged came home. informd mrs whitwell delivd last night, infant expired soon shee expired morning 4 o clock. dagt ballard took coffee son wilm sleeps may god support bereeved affliction better taken home. hear death mrs whitwel infant. mr livermore aftern. 23 7 clear. sett 10 curent bushes, sorting beens matters. mr ballard settlement. fanny hodges hannah sally ballard son ephm lathrop work son lambard. home. 24 1 clear cloudy turns. went meeting hous mr whitwell. wife infant interd, vast concoarce people followed procecsion corps. one service meeting hous. revd mr stone calld attend funeral capt homans, varsalborough. mr gillet presided mr whitwels. informd mrs cowen failing fast. meeting funeral mrsswhitwall infant. calld mr pittss, mr thwings& moodys. 25 2 clear. home. dagt ballard sally dind home. mr [balld] parish meeting. 26 3 clear. mr ballard sett davis town. mr merril mrs forbs, dagt ballard sally dind. mrss crage took tea home. home. mr ballard gone davis town. mrs forbs crage source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 27-May 3, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 27 may 3, 1803 27 4 cloady. home. raind. dagts ballard lambard part childn old mrss church allso. home. childn see 28 5 cloudy rain. workt gardin. lydia compy, sister zepporah, hitty hatch, betsy andrus polly mosier. home. 29 6 cloudy. removed part banking west side hous. carried part make level well part towards necessary hous. home removing banking house. 30 7 clear. home, done work gardin finishd pare small hoes. mr ballard returnd. dagt ballard tea. home. mr ballard relurnd. 1 1 cloudy, raind night. mr famely attind public worship except self. unwell find hors till late go. ordinance supper administred. mrss cowen bill prayers. may god grant comfort shee stands need life may better part received close life relms bliss happiness. home. communion day. receivd letter fm bror collins april 11th, came hand yesterday. 2 2 cloudy. husband sons cyrus ephm gone town meeting. working gardin fixing better way well. paid lydia nud one dollar. home. sett current bushes. 3 3 clear colder, ground frosen ys morn. got greens gardin sett skellions. mr ballard son pollards. dagt ballard dind home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 4-11, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 4 11, 1803 4 4 clear part day. lydia nudd sett go fathers. washt ye bullery performd work foren, unwell night. fanny hodges came sons assist ill night. home. lydia [went] home. unwell. 5 5 clear part day, raind night. unwell day. mrs edson, dagt ballard, saunders mrs crockett old mr jo foster son jona took tea home, unwell. mr ballard surveying mr gilly. 6 6 cloudy. well made flower bread self, brown bread mr puringtun. bott 10 lb butter leut john shaw. home. 7 7 clear. cleand chambers. fanny hodges helpt fore nn. sons pollard jona ant wives took tea. son p. wife sleep mr ballard settlement. home. son dagt pollard, theiroldest youngest dagts ym. 8 1 snowd. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. mr gill lambard came conducted dagts pollard ballard son lambd s. jona ephm went home. severe storm aftern evng. home. dagt pollard went son lambards. 9 2 clear cold. unwell day. fanny came helpt make apple pumpkin pies. lydia returnd, sister odlin came shee sleeps home. informd mr john badcock expired last night. 10 3 clear. mrss odlin left 9h m. lydia went stores uncles. mr ballard surveying hous lotts mr whilwel. mrs crocket dagt ballard tea. home. son towns youngest child expired. 11 4 clear. home. lydia washt. cyrus informd son towns youngest child home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, may 17 27, 1803 17 3 clear. helpt hous work rakt chips. dagt ballard mrs chamberlin mr ballard fenced ye gardin. seen 78 years day. years may grace creas. [home]. son town sleeps 18 4 clear. mr ballard went winslow, son town home. vary sick day. dagt ballard came see home, sick. 19 5 clear cloudy turns. feel feeble. jonas wife seeds forenn, mrs pierce aftern tea. home, feeble. jonas wife mr pierce 20 6 clear. mr ballard returnd. well mended stockins self. mrs hodges fanny sleep betsy andrus home, done sewing. mrs hodges 21 7 clear. mrs hodges left breakfast. done part hous work. mr ballard surveying mr purington. fanny helpt day lydia spun daugt. mrs farewel took tea home. mrs farewel 22 1 clear. famely meeting. mr parker performd 2 corinthv c 11 verse. mr thwings intermition, child mending. calld mr moodys service, wife feeble yet. calld son jonas, son daugt lambard billy ballard unwell, pukt worm. meeting, mr thwing, moodys sons. mrs hitty peirce published saml babcock. 23 2 clear. went mr thwings dind, genl sewalls took tea, son lambards evng, tarrie till ye 27th. son lambds others. 27 6 clear. left son lambards foren. dind doct coneys, took tea mr craggs, gnl sewalls, mr thomass thwings. ditoes, [returnd] home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 28-Jun. 8, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 28 june 8, 1803 28 7 clear. calld 2h morn go see midian cowens wife unwell. see safe circumstance returnd home, felt allmost sick. lydia work sons. mrs farewell took tea shee informd theos hamlins wife deld last night. midion cowens. receivd 3/9 trouble. 29 1 clear warm. famely attended public worship meeting hous, revd mr stone discorsed gospel st john 7th c 46th verse, ofersers answered never man spake man speaketh like man. meeting mr westons. 30 2 clear. went work gardin morn, planted 8 sorts beens removd part sage, catnip &c. went genl sewalls afternn. genl sewalls, mrs coney allso. judg sewill came evn. 31 3 clear. ditoes. 1 4 clear. detoes. mrs gill 2 5 clear. went mr gills returnd. 3 6 ditoes. ye genl returnd. 4 7 rainy. ditoes. 5 1 rainy. detoes. mrss sewall unwell. judg left went doct colmans. 6 2 clear. ditoes. 7 3 clear. mr evthleths, colo lithgows, colo norths, thwings ye stores. sleep mr thwings. 8 4 clear. left mr thwings, calld mr moodys hors left husband, came home. find dagt ballard source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 18-22, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 18 22, 1803 [18] 7 cloudy. put candles sellar. 11 lb made winter past 45 dozn made weak. allso sown parsley, pink radishs, peppers. zepporah nudd dind lydia went hollowell came home unwell. made cammomile tea. hannah pollard sleeps home, washt north room various servises. lydia came home sick. made herb tea. 19 1 cloudy rain. mr ballard famely meeting. dagt ballard supt home. 20 2 clear cool. mr ballard mend meddow fence. unwell foren sett little. went aftern sons see martha, shee sick night seems better sons. lheir babe unwell. 21 3 clear. workt gardin, sett squashes cucumbers. mr ballard settlement, cyrus hallowell. son jona, wife, le faett martha sydney. lydia washt shee lambe one legg. son ephm lathrop came home mr williamss work. home. 22 4 clear except sprinkling rain. knitt workt gardin. planted cucumbers, sowd peas, houghd beens &c. mrss farewell calld mr ballard began wead corn. jack wrode hors plough. home. mrs farewell source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 28 august 9, 1803 [28] 5 raind fast aftern. sally church washt mr ballard returnd noon. done hous wk kniting. polly t. sewing home. mr balld came home. 29 6 clear pt ye day. washt nth room windows. jona, wife, mrs trask part ye childn tea. home. 30 7 calld 1h ys morn go saml clearks, arivd 4. wife unwell. wife ezekiel coal expird night soon delivery, left infant dagt. saml clearks. mrs coal expired. 31 1 clear. mr clearks yet. mrs hodges calld. detoes. 1 2 mr clearks. 2 3 ditoes. 3 4 clear. left mrs cleark, took breakfast son pollards. calld georg boltons returnd home. pollards g. boltons 4 5 clear warm. done hous work, polly t. assisted shee went crockets, found babe fitt, came informd jonas wife went, seemd revive. let 1 lb candles. mrs farewel bennit, son dagt ballard, betsy pierce, hannah wm took tea. mr ballard meddow. mr crockets; company 5 6 clear. done hous work. polly town went visit sons. mrs crocket babe sick yet. mr ballard meddow. home. 6 7 clear morn, raind night. georg boltons, wife unwell; tarried ys night, sally bolton allso. georg boltons 7 1 cloudy morn, clear aftern. went son pollards, slept dagt went see mrs woodward, find inft cleverly. nucomb, jail, bound home. ditoes son pollards &c. 8 2 clear. left son pollards, calld mr bollons, wife unwell; wisht go home, tarried. mr bollons. 9 3 birth georg boltons dagt. clear. patienl safe deld 2h morn first born, dagt. left cleverly 8/ arivd home safe. polly went mr gills. gatherd 2 quarts curents. dagt ballard [sic]. ditoes. birth 9th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 10-17, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 10 17, 1803 10 4 clear. cleand seller washt mrs crocket cyrus ye stores, &c. home. 11 5 clear. feel unwell done work. betsy andrus piking wool. home. 12 6 x. birth saml [clearks] 2nd dagt. xx. clear. mr simion clearks lady dagt ballard dind made self ready sett soon cyrus came home, mr clearks. met mr cyphers, reacht 4 pm, wife safe deld 5 second child dagt; first 7 years old month. dagt pollard went us. mrs crosby, bisby, mosier, cleark keton attended. oliv fletcher came nurs 9h evng. saml clearks. birth 10th. recd 12/ reward. 13 7 clear. returnd, calld son pollard georg boltons. shee complains breast. calld mr edsons, came home wrote letter bror jona send calld hast go john boltons wife, cloudy dark reacht slept little ys night. john boltons, wife ill. wrote bror jona mrs edson. 14 1 x. birth john bollons first dagt. xx. raind ys morn. patient safe deld 9h ys morn dagt, first born. returnd home 2 aftn. calld crockets, child unwell. came syrip balson ditos. birth 11th. march 22nt [1806]receivd james bolton pair shoes 1 lb. sugar. 15 2 clear. home. dagt ballard part childn tea. cyrus brot 9lb roals ye masheen. home, dagt ballard 16 3 clear. wash cloaths kitchen workt gardin. cyrus carried wool mrs coal spin. dagt ballard mrs crocket home. 17 4 clear. home, cut herbs source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 18-27, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 18 27, 1803 [18] 5 clear part day, thunder rain night. done work. allin lambd ephm ballard sleep home. 19 6 clear. home, planted english goos beries n ye hogs pen. done hous work, bakt, boild soap grees &c. home. 20 7 clear. churnd, bakt brewd, workt gardin, gatherd ripe beens planted may 30th. old mr lambd, dagt, son jona, wife 6 childn, son ephm lalhrop took tea jack pierce allso. cyrus recd 5_ dols judg robbins. home. old mr lambd gatherd ripe beens. 21 1 clear part ye day. unwell calld 4h pm go see jessy goodins wife, find well. tarried night, old mrs gill mrs goodin allso. jesy goodins. 22 2 goodins, patient washing wd consent returning home. ditos. 23 3 clear. left patient comfortable returnd home. calld mr gills genl sewals. ditoes. 24 4 clear. home, cyrus card ing masheen. home. 25 5 clear. done hous work, bakt mr purington. sally church washt, paid 2s/3d ziporah nud dagt ballard allso. home. 26 6 clear warm. betsy andrus workt workt gardin knit dagt ballard polly town went mr dingleys. home. 27 7 clear warm. betsy workt paid 4/2_ 5 days work; polly farewel 4/6 work shee done dind son jonas. polly town came home sons. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 28-Sep. 7, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 28 september 7, 1803 28 1 clear warm. polly town tarried home, ye young men meeting. mr parker performd. son jona, wife part childn tea. mrs capin son set boston. home. 29 2 clear. son pollard brot wife dagts, sally dolly, babe well. home. mrs black, dagt ballard, hannah sally tea. home. mrs black 30 3 clear. dagt pollard washing went son lambds. mrs farewel getchel tea. finisht futing pair hoes, began another pair. jona receivd line dad 20th inst well. home. 31 4 clear pleast. wido higins dagt peve dind son ephm lathrop allso. lalp supt. done hous work. ye young men training. home. mrss higins &dagt 1 5 clear. done hous work washing. son dagt pollard calld way home. home. 2 6 clear. hous work went lectur. calld luis hamlins went. mr crags returnd. ironing came home. lectur. 3 7 clear forn, shower noon. done caps. dagt ballard mended lathrops trousers. heman bur came work son ephm. home. h. burr came liv ephm. 4 1 clear. attended worship, communion day. capt cony susanna published. meeting. 5 2 clear part ye day. cleand butery done hous work. sally polld hanh ballard came helpt bakt purington self. home. 6 3 raind part ye day. cleand chambers done hous work. cyrus kille porcapine hous. home. 7 4 clear. sally church washt hous work, feel fatagued much. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 8-21, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 8 21, 1803 8 5 clear. bakt mr purington pumkin pies self, done hous wk. home. 9 6 clear warm. done hous wk gatherd string peas. mrs dany made visit. fanny hannah sleep home. mrs dany 10 7 clear. dagts lambd ballard dind husbands tea. s. pollard, h. ballard, son ephm, lathrop burr sleep bakt mr purington self. home. dagt lambd 11 1 clear. unwell. dagt ballard part childn son jona, ephm lambd pollards, lathp winthrop. home. 12 2 clear. done work unable. dagt ballard tea, childn allso. sn ephm sleeps home. 13 3 clear pleast. reviw hallowell day. done work, took tea son jonas. sons. 14 4 clear. unwell bear alone, work home. 15 5 clear fore n. sally church washt mrs page dagt ballard bakt mr purington. h. b. s. p. tea. feel comfortable wich wish thank god. home. 16 6 clear. done work. home. 17 7 clear. scoured n room floor work. home. 18 1 clear. calld evng savage boltons. got sleep. savage boltons. 19 2 birth savage boltons dagt. clear. mrs bolton safe deld 3h pm 5 dagt 11th child. left comfortable, came son pollards sleep detoes. birth 12th. 20 3 clear. returnd home, work hous gardin. dagt ballard mrs crocket mr benet took ephms coalt keep. son pollard. 21 4 clear. gatherd beens, done hous work, informd husband wel ye 19th inst. home. heard husband wel 19th inst. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 22-30, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 22 30, 1803 22 5 done hous work, bakt last meal made corn raised last year, harvested beens. cyrus began gather apples. home. 23 6 clear. done hous work mallers. home. 24 7 clear. gathered hops. fanny helpt aftern. bakt mr purington self. capt ozgood sumons mr ballard apear evidence coart next weak, left 1/6 cash. home. 25 1 clear warm. cyrus, lathp, burr meeting. mr parker performd. ephm son pollards. unwell done work. home. 26 2 cloudy, raind aftern. gatherd sheld beens. cyrus son lambds. mr cottle wife unwell. dagt ballard ironed sist wilms came home. 27 3 cloudy morn, clear aftern. sister williams took breakfast mr ballard returnd tour surveying davis town. went attend coart directly. mrs farewel calld went sons son town sleeps informs polly better. rest famely wel. son jonas. son town sleeps mr ballard returnd. 28 4 clear pleast. genl salem town took breakfast penobscott. mr ballard cyrus coart. sally church washt pay since paid. home. s. church washt 29 5 clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus coart. done work. dagt ballard evng. home. 30 6 clear. mr ballard sett sun sett wiscassett. done hous work. polly farewel came work home. mr bald wiscasett. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 1-11, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 1 11, 1803 1 7 clear pleast. finisht harvisting beens. polly workt ys day, went home evng. ephm men came home. polly farewel wt home. 2 1 clear. men meeting. sett aftern, met augustus ballard, wife 2 childn going hous. returnd home. son jona, wife part childn tea. dagt went mr danys evng. deld 6/ genl town sent present. mr danys. augusts ballard wife 3 2 clear warm. polly farewl work. dagt ballard mrs pitts part yr childn home. 4 3 cloudy, raind noon. polly mending bed quillt. rhoda hannah sleep mr purington paid 6/7 bakeing sumer 2/ stalks shock. home. 5 4 clear. done hous work. polly finisht ye bed quillt mending, went home [diner]. paid 6/7 3_ days. sally church workt half ys day. paid dagt ballard conducted joanna smith work shee 16 years old. home. joanna smith came work evng. 6 5 clear. joanna washt. rhoda hannah sleep night. home. 7 6 clear. helpt hous work. home. 8 7 clear. cyrus puled beens ye corn field. piqut part ym fm ye vines. betsy, rufus rachel smith son ephm polly farewel gone winslow. mrs farewel home. compy ephm winslow. 9 1 clear. famely meeting. bror towns widdo came mr gill lambard evng. georg andrus came home joanna. home. mrs town 10 2 clear. mr ballard collecting taxes. washt. mr town ys day. home. 11 3 cloudy. mr town went son lambds, joanna quillt betsy andrus, taried night. fanny, rhoda hannah sleep home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 12-22, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 12 22, 1803 12 4 clear part ye day. folded cloaths, finisht sheling beens evng, lathrop burr helpt. mr ballard milkt. joanna gone dads, sister rachel betsy andrus came home son ephm returnd winslow. ezra town susana spring joind wedlock since went may god bless prosper mariage state. home. 13 5 cloudy rain. mr ballard n parish collecting taxes. various kinds business. son ephm sleeps home. 14 6 cloudy. joanna washt floors. rhoda mended hoes young men. bakt pumkin apple pies. home. 15 7 clear. pared cut apples drie. son ephm sleeps home. 16 1 x. birth saml badcoks son. xx. clear. son lambd brot wife babe calld sun sett go see wife saml badcock ye 3d. shee safe deld son 8h evng. tarried night. saml badcoks. birth 13th. recd 12/. 17 2 rainy. tarried patient till aftern. calld son lambds. reacht home sun sett. colt lamed. detoes. 18 3 cloudy. joanna finisht washing shee began yesterday. hous work. mr ballard cyrus street. joanna went home evng. home. 19 4 clear. done hous work. phillip bullin writing plans. home. 20 5 cloudy. mrs smith, babe betsy andrus tea. selvanus hatch wife sleep joanna went home. feel fatagued must put lott. home. mr hatch wife 21 6 cloudy. bullin done hous work. allin, thomas lambd ephm bald sleep home. 22 7 cloudy. mr ballard bullin busines. fatagued, cut quarter beef. joanna left marn 2_ bushel ashes, gal milk 3 qts soap. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 23-Nov. 5, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 23 november 5, 1803 23 1 clear. attended worship aftern. mr parker performd. went son lambds see lucy, shee unwell. meeting son lambds. 24 2 clear. hous work went sons. jonas. 25 3 x. birth pres hamlins 3d child. clear. went peres hamlins, put wife bed 3d child first dagt, left comfortable returnd home 3h pm. recd [9/] rewd. peres hamlins. birth 14th. recd 9/. 26 4 clear. home, done work. home. 27 5 clear. mrs cypher sally church washing. paid pisterene dagt lambd, rachel capin dolly lambd went jonas took tea, mr ballard allso. jonas. dagt lambd 28 6 clear. done hous work, ironed till mid night unable. home. 29 7 rainy. sick evng, lost much seat life aftern. god grant grace submit dispensations patience. home, unwell. 30 1 clear. able sett part ys day. doct barton came noon, tarries night. mr ballard, cyrus ephm meeting. dagt ballard came helpt get supper. home. doct barton came 31 2 x. birth mr cottles 16th child. x. clear windy. mr cottle calld early ys morn see wife. shee safe deld 4h pm 10th daugt 16th child. tarrid night. receivd 9/ reward. mr cottles. birth 15th, 16th child. 1 3 clear pleast. left patients well could expected. calld son pollards reacht home 10h morn, hous work ditoes. 2 4 clear. sally church washt paid 2/1. hannah getchel came help home. 3 5 clear. helpt work. home. 4 6 clear. helpt work went lecter. meeting. 5 7 cloudy. mr ballard ploughing. home, helpt work. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 6-13, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 6 13, 1803 6 1 cloudy morn, began rain got meeting continued day. ordinanc super administred. mr ballard went shubal pitses intermition, richd foster wife inhabiter jail present. feel affliction. meeting, communion day. 7 2 cloudy. hous work, cutt pumkins drie. mrs getchel dind dagt help work. mr ballard went ye settlement aflern. mrs getchel brot dagt new coat short goun. shee put day. home. mrs gelchel 8 3 clear. done washing cut 7 pumpkins drie. hannah getchel helpt hous. mr ballard mr andruss smith work done plough. home. 9 4 snowd foren. bakt pumkin pies, helpt hous work doubled yarn. home. 10 5 cloudy. hannah getchel went sons, unwell. done hous work finisht doubling yarn. home, hannah went sons. 11 6 cloudy. got breakfast, calld see wife jery towl unwell; day night. jery towls. 12 7 x. birth jery towls 11th child, dagt. xx. clear part day. patient ill women calld aftr 5h morn. shee lingured till 45m pm shee safe deld dagt, 11th child. wd 9 lb _. left 2 returnd home, find work finisht 10h 40m evng. jery towls. birth 15th. decr 10th, crdt pr shoes. 13 1 cloudy cold, snowd little. home. mr ballard meeting. son dagt ballard, mrs getchel dind billy, sally martha, hannah g. b. lindy slept son ephm went mr pollard s. home. jona part famely source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 14-19, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 14 19, 1803 14 2 clear part day. son lambard jona butchered 2 pigs us. son ephm lathrop done hous work. h hannah g. helpt fore noon. shee went aunts liv aftern. paid 3/. home, 2 pigs killd. 15 3 clear part ye day. done hous work washing, felt unwell aftern. mr ballard paid state tax got receipt full arthur lithgo exqr. sorted part apples, cut spect rot stued home, done various kinds work. 16 4 clear part ye day. mr ballard hallowell. rachel town came work cut apples pumkins, shee mended stockins work hous. home. rachel town came help 17 5 cloudy, raind night, wind ne. finisht culing pumpkins stued end pieces, finisht sorting cuting apples rotting. mr ballard pay money treasurers &c. rachel helpt hous work mended stockins. cyrus bill finisht bank hous. informd amos partridg sick home yt bror moses dead perloiny cony sick boston. home. heard moses partridg death. 18 6 snowd blowd cold. roasted pigg. son jona, wife sister getchel came partook us, ephm billy allso. mr ballard went ye settlement. home. roasted pigg, wt 18 lb. 19 7 clear part day cold. bakt apple pumkin pies. mr ballard ye settlement, infmd judg dumer chartered loaded vesel w. indies frozen river. cyrus informd mr moody, precepter, buried 2 childn yesterday sick son ephm sleeps muinit informd charls dinglys 2nd child expired last night. home. heard ye death 2 mr moodys childn one mr dingleys. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 20-26, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 20 26, 1803 20 1 clear cold. mr ballard meeting. son jona, wife, mrs getchel, jack, le faell marthe lathrop burr supt roast pigg. cyrus rachel town spent evng son jonas. home. son part famely 21 2 cloudy foren, raind aftn. son ephm dind rachel part washing, hous work matters. home. ephm noon. 22 3 clear part day. mr ballard river call parish taxes. went help mrs dany quilt. dagt ballard sist, betsy ands, joe betsy smith fold cloaths ironed part evng. mr danys. son jona sent us goose. 23 4 clear. mr ballard mending slead shop. rachel went 9h 30m help mrs dany quillt. son pollard brot cloath home, 30-2/1 yds, ye blanket lent lydia nud. cyrus settlement, saw son town. gave 5 goos wings bring done hous work finisht ironing. home. gave order georg bolton 9/. 24 5 cloudy snow. rachel went fore n help mrs dany. went aft dinner, tarried till evng. got squars nearly struck quilting mr danys, rachel allso, dagt ballard. 25 6 clear. mr lambard son jona butchered 2 piggs us. 1 wd 22_, 21 lb. rachel went help mrs smith quillt bed quillt. home, cyrus hallowell rie. bot 2 yds cotten linen 3/ pr yd. home, rachel quilting. 26 7 clear part ye day. bakt brown white bread, apple pumkin pies. cyrus went son lambards, carried pigg roast, borrowd 3 lb hogg lard. mr ballard taxes. home. bakt. son ephm night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 27-Dec. 3, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 27 december 3, 1803 [27] 1 clear. mr ballard son ephn attendd meeting. sons jona, lambard yr wives supt roast pigg. little barny sleeps home. 28 2 clear part day cold. mr ballard workt shop foren, went aftn ye settlement. found wilm cypher road much intoxocated liqur. ye help mr ands smith, got mr andruss. done hous work, rachel washt. mended pair small cloaths mr balld evng. lindy hannah home. 29 3 clear part ye day. mr ballard shop mending slead. helpt ye hous work. hannah, sabery, sally, le faell wm see barny. dagt ballard mrs getchel evng. bakt apple pies. home. 30 4 clear part ys day. home. bakt 2 oven fulls pies, washt floors &c. gidion barton dind says father better; rest famely wel. home. son ephm sleeps wel. 1 5 rainy day. mr ballard famely meeting, yearly thanksgiving. roasted goos, boild beef, pork fowls diner. home. 2 6 clear part day colder. son dagt ballard, part childn, mrs getchel bhillip bullin dind rachel joana smith tea. mr mathews evng pills lynda gitchel, shee ill, says. home. p. bullin joind wedlock yesterd mrs thustin. 3 7 clear cold. went son jonas noon see linda gitchel, find unwell. gave 2 tea spunfuls stotins elixr swetened water. shee seemd better soon. returnd 4. allin lambd ephm ballard, son ephm lathrop sleep sons, 4 swine butchered. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 4-11, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 4 11, 1803 4 1 clear moderate. mr ballard, cyrus ephm attended worship mr stones meeting. home. work aftern reason rachel unwell. shee bed till got super table, shee got partook us. washt dishes went spent ys evng son jonas. home. 5 2 clear pleast. mr ballard workt ye shop till aftern came well. rachel washt, ye hous work knit polly town 22 years [old] ys day. home. son lambd calld pollytowns birth day. 6 3 clear pleast. working cyruss winter shirts. rachel town helpt hous work. mrs cypher home. mrs cypher 7 4 clear pleast ye season. home, hous work. bakt broun bread pumkin pies. mrs farewel calld mr ballard workt ye shop, well. home. mrs farewel calld 8 5 clear pleast. sent brot polly farewel make goun. mr ballard surveying road sydna south saml hovys. finisht shirt cyrus. home. polly farewel workt 9 6 rainy. home, done hous wk sewing. polly finisht goun mended cloaths mr ballard. son lambd came carried barny home. jon wife part yr childn home. barny lambd went home. 10 7 clear pleast. mr ballard wel go ye settlement. lathrop moody dind polly went home 4h pm, le faett went rode ye hors home. done hous work knitt home. polly [went] home [aftn]. 11 1 clear pleast muddy traviling. mr ballard ephm went meeting rachel spent aftern son jonas. supper prepare self tho unable. heman burr supt sleeps home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
