content: martha ballard's diary, december 12 20, 1803 12 2 rainy. done hous work knit, rachel finisht shirt cyrus. mr ballard workt ye shop. home. 13 3 raind ys day. helpt wash hous work, finisht mr ballards mitts. workt ye shop forn went aftn. home, knit, [washt], hous wk sewed 14 4 clear colder, freezes night. finisht mending drawers began stockin son cyrus. son lambards, brot present 2 new pockets little dolly. mr ballard ye coart hous. home. mr ballad bot 4 oz snuf. cyrus bot much 15 5 clear. bakt done hous work, sorted part apples cut speckt rot. rachel town sett go pitts ton 11h mr ballard cyrus settlement. home. rachel went visit mother. paid 6/ cash. 16 6 cloudy, snowd little. done hous work knit home. 17 7 clear cloudy turns. done hous work. sally farwel calld shee going marms. son ephm took supper went mrss farewels. home. 18 1 clear cold. mr ballard meeting. son jona, wife, martha mrs getchel supt hannah, sally, sabery, ezekiel wilm ys aftern. felt wel could wish done work. dagt brot loaf wheat bread butter. home. son jona part famely 19 2 clear prety cold. done hous work, washt ye buttery kitchen knit 28 purls cyruss stockin. aniversary mariage. home. livd mariage state 49 years. 20 3 birth whitons dagt. clear cool. dagt ballard stay pieces. polly sally farewel calld going ye settlement ys evng. home, work knit 40 purls. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 21-25, 1803 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 21 25, 1803 21 4 clear. calld 11h last night go see mrs whitton hallowel. arivd 1 morn, find patient deld child, daugt. 5 child 2nt prest husband. shee fully delivd. performd remaining done put bed safe. tarried night. mrss freeman, benn whites t. stickneys wives dresed infant &c,&c. sett home wrideing bad. calld revd mr stones warmd, reacht home noon. capt toby dind us. much fatagued indead. home till 11h evn calld mr whinton hallowell. birth 16th. 22 5 clear, cold pleast sun. hous work feel unfitt mrs church brot 2lb 3 oz flax. let wt candles. son dagt lambd came, went dolly son pollards, returnd slept home. son dagt lambd sleep 23 6 clear. dagt lambd makeing self goun. shee went son jonas aftern. helpt hous work knit. home. dagt lambd 24 7 xx. birth francis touls son first [child. birth 17 th. xx.] snowd last night day. son lambd brot sister capin foren. shee dagt set home 3h pm. washt mr ballard cyruss shirts. bakt ys day. calld francis toul go see wife dusk, arivd son pollards reside, 6 evn. shee deld 8 son, first born. tarrie night, slept home till evn, f. towls. mrs capin made pres 3 pulits dolly lambd. 25 1 cloudy misty. left patient 2h pm, reacht home 3, find calld go hallowell. son ephm supt. lathrop burr came evng. bur sleeps finished work mr voce. son pollards. ephm finishd work voce last night. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, december 26 31, 1803 26 2 cloudy. done hous wk unwel. sons jona, lambd wives son pollards. home. 27 3 cloudy. unwell. mr waid butchered two swine us 1 jona. unwel old lady cypher came assisted us work. home. swine butcherd. sick. mrs cypher helpt 28 4 clear. mr waid cut pork salted mrs cypher helpt feel comfortable. home. mrs cypher helpt 29 5 clear. mrs cypher washt. wel help mrs farewel calld home. mrs cypher helpt 30 6 clear morn, cloudy aftern. rachel town returnd. finisht trying hoggs lard, cut sauches meet done matters. rachel washt floor ironed shee returnd. allin lambard sleeps night ye 3 past. home. rachel returnd, gone 2 weaks 1 day. 31 7 clear pleast last day ye year. home business hous. mr ballard returnd surveying reeds field well could expected. evng paid tax ye prest year leut john shaw junr, took receipt full. year near clos, god grant may begin ensewing peas happiness. home. mr ballrd returnd. paid taxes john shaw junr. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 6, 1804 1 1 cloudy, snowd night. mr ballard ephm meeting. unwell. son jona, wife 6 childn supt puding roast spare rib. unwell night usual, much care taken rachel bed 8 oclock. home, unwell. 2 2 clear. mr ballard gone ye meddow. feel unwel. husband came home 4h pm, took little food. complains feeling pain stomach, calld john sewall answer execution 800 dollars. conducted jail augusta commited. two sons, jona ephm bound liberty yard pray great parent universe protect giv comfort present tryal. home, unwel. husband evng committd jail acount tax collection. 3 3 snowd. son lambard conducted wife babe left tarrie night, slept ill turn night blessed great author mercies, got easier. son ephm came ys evng ill cold. gave herb tea. home. dagt lambd kind com see made sausages. jonas wife calld see 4 4 cloudy. son lambard came conducted wife babe home. ephm better went settlement. home, feel unwel. home. daugt lambd went home. 5 5 clear cold. son pollard brot wife two youngest childn jona wife allso. unwell, able set little. home, unwel childn lo see 6 6 clear. dagt ballard washt self. mrs getchel dagt pollard [child] went son lambds evng. home. better]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 7-11, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 7 11, 1804 7 7 clear cool. felt wel help work. rachel washt floors. mrs farewel calld severe turn coughing ys evng. cyrus went carrie clean cloaths father, found well; dind judg cony day. home. mrs farewel calld see 8 1 clear. rachel town meeting aftern return mrss getchil badcock jona sent go dine able, dagt pollard childn went. jona wife spent ye evng little ephm sleeps home. dagt pollard day, part. shee slept 9 2 snow storm. son pollard came covered sleigh took wife childn home, left 4h 20m. hope got home safe. home. dagt pollard went home. 10 3 cloudy. heman burr conducted rachel town mr gills sleigh. shee home since shee went meeting last sabath day. lold thought shee used ill, shee much ofended. home, remove bed kitchen without help. 11 4 snowd. rachel bundled cloaths going sett storm hallowell dagt ballard came insisted shee washing clean hous. shee clean shee found shee gave lie several times washing however, quite sulky noon. home. ephm evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 11-17, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 11 17, 1804 11 1 clear warmer. home. ephms wife heman allso. home. dagt 12 2 cloudy part ye day moderate. annual meeting town. son ephm returnd belfast, wife ys night. home. dagt yet. 13 3 cloudy, snowd night, raind allso. ephm conducted wife home marms. phebe church came help shee hous work twisted yarn. home. pheebe church came ephms wife went home. 14 4 cloudy morn, clear aflern. luke barton wriding sleigh ran sheep hurt could stand. sons sheep. home, unwel. home. luke barton ran sheep sleigh. 15 5 clear cloudy turns. home unwel. ephm burr got wood. home. james hinkly expired. 16 6 clear cool. feel comfortable wish giv god praise. home. dagt ballard mrs getchel 6 grand childn dind 3 sleep home. dagt ballard 17 7 clear part day. son dagt pollard part thier childn shee went see father. went aftn conducted lemuel witham, lad com work son ephm. returnd evn unwell. lemuel went take son lambds hors sleigh joness jona come finding ready come returnd came foot jona came hat. took supper, pusht adors, drove home hous damning pushing struck shaw burr went prevent deprived life. followed falling went till meeting dagt lambard assisted reacht hous, find cursing swearing would go giv hard whiping. dagt lambd desired heman go conducted ephm. went tarried night. son lambd brot home sleigh. o god mercy would forgiv misconduct. shubl pittss, feel unwel scean go evng. may good god support funeral mr james hinkley hallowel, death suden. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 22-29, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 22 29, 1804 22 5 cloudy rain. home, done work, brewd &c. much fatagud. home. 23 6 clear part ye day. dagt ballard bake, shee made nutts ephm. home. jonas wife bakt 24 7 clear part ys day. done hous work cleand ye chambers, mended stockins &c. feel much fatagued. home. 25 1 clear, pleast sun cool air. home, feel feeble work shaw went sydni. home. 26 2 clear. done hous work unable. lemuel went went [sic] son pollards olliv fletcher shee come heman went mr churches phebe, shee promist come morrow. lathrop sleeph 27 3 x. birth david edwardss lucy shaws dagt. xx. clear. pheebe church workt paid /9d. calld noon go see lucy shaw mr brackets) labour safe deld 2h pm daught. shee declared david edwards true father child. left comfortable reacht home sunsett, find joanna babcock shee come work. mr anthonys brackets see lucy shaw. birth 2nd. wedlock. mrs trask sleeps fee recd decr. 4th. 28 4 clear pleast. home, helpt hous work mended stockins knitt home. 29 5 clear. home, helpt ye hous work knit. receivd letter son cyrus 25 inst, well. joanna washt. home, recd line cyrus 25 inst. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 11-19, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 11 19, 1804 11 6 clear. went lecture, wrode son ephms mare. lectur. 12 7 clear. felt unwel joanna went home aftern. ezra town sleeps fathers famely wel. home. ezra town sleeps 13 1 clear. attended worship meeting hous except lathrop. communion day. ezra town sleeps ys night. mr pittss intermition. shee informd infants found pond winthrop. meeting. communion day. ezra sleeps 14 2 clear. home, planted cucumbers pumkin seed. feel fatagud. joanna returnd forenoon. dagt ballard shee feeble yet. home. dagt ballard 15 3 raind ys morn, cloudy ye day. cuting coverled raggs. joanna sewing hous work. charlotte brown calld son ephm finisht jobb wk school house. home. 16 4 clear cool wind. workt doors helpt ye washing. unwel night severe pain left legg, applyd burdock leavs. home. 17 5 clear. feel unwel ys morn pickt chips done many matters knitt dagt ballard sally dind loin roast veal. ephm work mr voce. husband day seen 79 revolutions sun, ended began 80 year age augusta jail. home. dagt ballard dind husband seen 79 years ys day. 18 6 clear. home, workt gardin knit bakt. joanna helpt hous work, irond mend hoes. shee helpt clean sellar. home. 19 7 clear. helpt joanna clean chambers schold cyruss bedstead. shee left ys aftern. home. joanna went home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 20-27, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 20 27, 1804 20 1 clear pleast. daugt lambard, sons jona, ephm wives dind felt unwel. morning joanna smith came work. home. part childn 21 2 clear day, thunder rain night. helpt joanna wash. home, washt. 22 3 clear. done part hous work workt gardn. sowd cabbage seed north ye hous, sett 6 apple trees. 23 4 clear pleast. son ephms wife came morn, mending cloaths boys. roasted veal dinner, made rhubarb tarts aftern. jona wife wilm tea. joana washt part wool. home. jona epm wives lothrop wel yesterdy. 24 5 clear pleast. son ephms wife workt shee went son jonas aftern. mrs church came sons. 25 6 clear. workt little gardin washt wool knit dagt ballard sally pierce tea. mr partridg plan jail yard. old lady cypher seeds. home. 26 7 clear warm. workt gardin hous much fatagued. lord knows shall relivd. home, workt gardin planted [beens]. 27 1 clear. felt unwel work son ephms wife took super. jonas wife part childn son lambard home. son cyrus meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 28-Jun. 2, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 28 june 2, 1804 28 2 clear. sett young trees done matters gardin. feel fatagued, knit home. workt gardin, sett trees &c. 29 3 clear. joanna washing. houghd gardin knit son ephm gone plant ground potatoes aftern. cyrus planting corn. went foren carried baskett greens shubal pittss. home. sent basket greens mrs pitts. 30 4 clear. felt feeble day. joanna washing son jona. wife mrs farewels. mrss smith freeman ephm leml planting ground. heman work ye shop, lothrop came night. election day. home, company. 31 5 clear foren, cloudy aftern, raind evng. son ephm apprentises mr lathrop went morn work mr whitwel. ephm hird part hous. gave bed bolster pillows 1 blankett pair pillow cases. wish prosperity. cyrus says father work [epm]. boiling soap. home. son ephm removd tools things mr whitwels. 1 6 cloudy rain. soap. dagt lambd rhoda pollard took tea cyrus hallowell 3 sheep. joanna hous work pickt wool. home. dagt lambd calld 2 7 clear. cleaning buttery, finisht soap. sowd peas south ye hous, dug chips door yd &c. mrs farewel calld lemuel 15 years old ys day. joanna cleand hous. cyrus nicholas shaw planted potatoes yoaked hoggs. home. mrs farewel calld source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 18-23, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 18 23, 1804 18 2 clear except sprinkling rain. home, felt feeble hous work. joanna badcock came cloaths shee left mr waters supt sleeps cyrus carry wool masheen dagt ballard. home. mr waters sleeps 19 3 clear. mr waters went go bror ebenzr moors doct bartons, jona gone sally farewel calld shee ye stores cloathing son ephms babe. hannah ballard went draw aunts breasts, returnd evn. says aunt quite unwel aftern. cut grass, houghd polatoes west side ye hous. feel fatagued. home. 20 4 clear. cutt grass, sage feverfue burnit. went aftern see son ephms wife, find comfortable. babe seems cleverly. cyrus settlement. informs yt ebenz towns youngest child expired ys day. mrs farewels, find comfortable. death. 21 5 clear part day. sett [120] cabbage turnip plants done matters gardin. bakt cake done hous wk. son ephm gave joanna smith order p. t. voce 12/. home. joanna washt fr 22 6 clear. workt gardin, sett 24 plants, transplantd w squash cucumbers. mrs stone calld see mr lambard waters went son pollards, jona wife allso. nepheu sleeps home. mr waters sleeps 23 7 clear. done hous work attended plants. covered uncoverd done washing nephew pain endurd left knee legg. mr waters calld son jona wife see went home home, ill evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 24-30, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 24 30, 1804 24 1 clear cloudy alternately. exercised much pain work dagt lambd came see shee going quarterly meeting methodist society. mr waters attended meeting. heman burr calld took tea home, unwell. dagt lambd calld see 25 2 clear. exercised pain limbs helpt work. betsy church came morn help bakt pies bread. mrs farewel calld says son ephms wife feeble yet. mr waters took breakfast, dind supt roast lamb green peas. home. green peas. wrote sister walers. 26 3 clear except showers aftern. mr waters left hous 4h pm go board vessil boston. workt gardin, transplanted cucumbers. sett east side hous. betsy workt home. mr waters left boston. 27 4 cloudy rain, thunder evng. cyrus went carried greens son ephms. sett cabbages wed beets carrotts. son lambd sent 2 qts spirit cyrus. great pain left legg. home, workt gardin part day. 28 5 raind workt gardin. betsy washt rooms. cyrus went carried greens mrss pitts. severly exercised pain, went bed early. home, ill evng. 29 6 clear shoury turns. went lecture. stranger performd. mr pittss, shee unwel. young man ye name eaton came evng, business betsy church. lecture mr pittss. 30 7 clear. workt gardin. mrss church, pheebe dagt ballard 3 childn tea. rhod, hannah dolly sleep former 10 years old day. home, company aftern. workt gardin foren. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

[ba smith washt self [dind] informd death mrss robinson 4 corners. sett cucumbers cabbages. cyrus gone settlement. heavy shour. wind severe fort, damage rafts &c. joan smith sleeps son ephm lemuel slee supt boltns. funeral mrs robinsons, capt joness e. warrins infants. 8 1 clear. cyrus famely attended public worship. dagt pollard, dagt sally oliv fletcher dind lemuel allso. string beens green pees. sons pollard, ballards part childn aftern. home. son pollard wife &sally saml betsy church [went] home see folks. 9 2 clear. workt gardin pikt wool. dagt pollard came son lambds went home. shee informd mrss joness soar opened polly pollard got self business. leml informd lathrop soar opened face dr mann. son jonas. dagt pollard went home. hannah sally sleep 10 3 clear. betsy washt. houghd gardin pikt wool. mrs stone, wickson chace tea. hannah sally sleep home, compy. mrs farewel calldhere. 11 4 clear. houghd cabbages, potatoes done work hous. cut catnip &c. cyrus conducted mrs farewel river. sally town wilm sofy, carotine gill took tea. home. mr gills childn 12 5 cloudy heavy shower. pikt wool sitt plants. went sons see jack pierce, seems sick. betsy went helpt bathe feet get bed. lydia church cherrys curents. sons. lydia church source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 13 17, 1804 13 6 clear except light showers. unwel. cyrus butcherd calf, went markit one quarter ye skin. hannah sally pollard sleep home. hannah sally sleep 14 7 clear. cyrus went carry harslet ye calf father. jack ballard conducted son ephms wife babe home. son ephms wife babe came 15 1 cloudy. son dagt lambd, babe, son jona, wife, ephm wife, heman lemuel james purington partook loin veal alas, husband debard favour. home. part childn 16 2 clear part day. ephms wife went son jonas. mrss black kent sally farewel allso. came home, made coffee. lefy cowen, dolly thomas, barny lambd, hannah sally pollard partake ephms wife babe sleep son jonas. mrs black kent 17 3 clear part day, showers. son ephms wife babe went breakfast. cleand sellar done [matters]. betsy washt. hannah sally sleep cyrus informd yt mr cottles youngest child interd ys day 1 mr crosbys belgrade. home. son ephms wife went home, cyrus conducted deaths mr cottles crosbys childn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 18-24, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 18 24, 1804 18 4 clear cool. felt unwel. mrs farewel calld scolt bed room bed stead. betsy washt ye floor buttery. hannah sally sleep lemuel supt home. dagt balld mrss] farewel 19 5 clear morn, raind night. old mrs arnold, cleark, 2 childn, dagt ballard mrs thomson took tea old lady sleeps unwel. betsy church left hannah sally sleep home, compy. mrs farewel tea 20 6 rainy. old lady day, shee hannah sally sleep mrss bunker saunders calld finisht picking black wool. home, well. 21 7 clear. done various kinds work. old lady arnold left forenn. sally belsy church calld nancy titcomb parthena pitts eat curents. home. lathrop burr ephm took supperhere. x 22 1 clear morn, cloudy aftern, rain night. heman took tea dagt ballard, wm, martha, sally pierce allso. sally polld meeting. home. dagt bald noon. churnd 4 lb butter. 23 2 clear part day. houghd cabbages cucumbers, done hous work; feel fatagued. sent branch curent bush husband, gave one son ephm. full frute. mrs farewel smith dagt lucy home, houghd plants. cyrus settlement. 24 3 clear. bakt flour bread brown, cherry curent tarts. mrs pitts made visit, john dagt ballard, mrs getchel betsy andrus took tea us. home, company. h. s. p. h. b. sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 25-31, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 25 31, 1804 25 4 clear. done hous work gardin. son ephm calld home. 26 5 clear. son ephm conducted wife babe home hous keeping. lemuel came furniture. heman came team aftern. gave greens curents carry home. mrs gill, williams betsy dind went son jonas, mrs pierce two childn h. b. [mchll] peirce sleepe jack ephm allso. sons. mrs gill made visit. ephms wife went hous keeping. 27 6 clear. houghd gardin done hous work. dagt ballard, mrs pierce sally mrs cleark daugt took tea betsy church came help evng. hannah ballard hitty pierce sleep wm gill brot _ gln ginn father. home, company. girls sleepe mr gills sent _ gn ginn. 28 7 clear. wed nusery. betsy church washing ironing. cyrus brot 9_ lb flower ephm. home, unwel workt. 29 1 rain. unwel relax. dagt ballard dagts evng. allin lambd box curents, heman hops. home, cyrus meeting. 30 2 showers. mrs farewel came took tea felt feeble work. sallys help churnd 3_ lb butter. home. mrs farewel 31 3 showers thunder. home, done work sallys help. cyrus brot 1 bushl indien meal home mr gill sent got 1 peck rie mr mosier. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 1-7, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 1 7, 1804 1 4 clear. done work, washt n. room kitchen, stares entry floors. mr [wilson] sleeps home, washt floors. cyrus carrid 13 lb wool ye meshene. 2 5 clear cool. done hous work gardin. joanna smith workt spun 2 skeins [cotten] yarn chors. sally farewel calld took tea informs son ephms infant soar mouth. home. sally farewel informd yt ephms babe soar mouth. 7 months since husband went jail. 3 6 clear part ye day, showers. joanna washt. workt gardin hous wk. shee went home time night. luke barton came conducted sally pollard cyrus bror ephms, infant well. home. mr puringtn calld sally went home. 4 7 cloudy showers. went son ephms done morning work, find babe unwell; tarrie ys night. son ephms. 5 1 clear. went meeting. babe better. rachel smiths nose bled night. sons. meeting son ephms. 6 2 clear. sons, babe much scurf comes mouth mrs farewel sally sons, babe better. 7 3 clear. left sons 10h morn, babe seemd sick. left marm son jonas wife went felt almost sick since came home. deloes, returnd home quite fatagued. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 8 16, 1804 8 4 clear. home, done hous work feeble. mrs farewel calld informd babe sick yet. mr purington camomile son james. unwell. lemuel sleeps home. mrs farewel 9 5 clear. washt done hous work. dagt ballard mrs farewel took tea lemuel sleeps babe much home. mrs farewel dagt ballard 10 6 clear. cleand buttery. leml soap mr puringtns mother sleeps shee way varsalboro home. home. 11 7 clear. home. mrs densmore went sons returnd sleep, mrs farewel sleeps allso. home. 12 1 clear. cyrus went meeting. mr purington mother dind home. leml slept 13 2 clear. scolt bedroom bed stead kill buggs, done matters. mrs densmore sons breakfast. home. heman sleeps 14 3 clear warm. heman slept. cleaning hous went son jonas tea, mrs farewel shee informs yt shee lost swine. son jonas. mrs farewel sleeps 15 4 clear. sally church washt. dagt ballard dind sally requests /9d work. paid home, feel feeble. 16 5 clear. mr benat brot mrss farewels furneture shee came reside. home. mrs farwl came reside [fr] ye present. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 17-23, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 17 23, 1804 17 6 clear. mrss densmore left go bodinham. mrs farewel went son ephms. home. mrs densmr left 18 7 clear. washt kitchen ironed mended husbands cloaths, workt soap. dagt ballard took tea sally martha allso. mr hussey gitchel home. mr thing came go. 19 1 cloudy morn, warm day. cyrus tarried home. jona, wife 2 youngist childn tea. mrs farewil returnd son ephms, informs infant sick yt [daugt] sally unwel. receivd letter bror elijah wrote return. home. lemuel sauce. beens, squash,cucumbers apples. brot leller brorelijah 7th inst. wrote answr. 20 2 clear. went son ephms see babe, find unwell. tarried [night], administred clisters restless night. son ephms see ye babe. 21 3 clear. sons. gave babe rheubarb, seems little easier. went ephms new hous mr partridges. sent letter bror elijah, wrote enclosd ye [19th]. ditoes]. wrote bror, sent mr brigg. 22 4 cloudy morn, clear aftern. mrs farewel went business road taken washt. dagt ballard mrs [trask] son town supt sleeps home, washing. son town sleeps 23 5 clear. son town left breakfast. seen 50 years day. hous work went sons see girl unwel. daugt absent. sons see pally doore. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 24-31, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 24 31, 1804 24 6 clear. done hous work ironed cloaths. mrs farewel returnd dusk, informs yt ephms infant better. home. mrss [farewl] came home. 25 7 clear. mrs farewel went mr bennets, cyrus carry fathers cloaths. dagt ballard mrs getchel took tea mrs g. son sleep home. hear ephms babe better. 26 1 clear. mrs getchel went son jonas. went son ephms, babe sick. tarry ys night. son ephms. 27 2 cloudy rain. sons till near night mr gill sent see wife sick feeble yet. tarrie night. ephms babe seems easier. ditoes mr gills. 28 3 clear. left mr gills breakfast, calld mr craggs pittss. reacht sons 12 [o] clock. _ past calld belgrade sherebiah clearks. reacht 3h pm, find wife labour. shee linguered thro night. belgrade. 29 4 x. birth sherebiah clearks 6th child 4th daugt. xx. clear. mrs cleark deld 8h morn 6th child 4th dagt. fine child wel could expected. went mr bisbys, hankseys sett home. calld s. boltons, dind son pollards, s. boltons brackets. reacht home sun sett. lemuel sleeps says babe better. mr clearks. birth 6th. recvd 9/ compensation. 30 5 clear part ye day, raind 10h evn. harvested beens done matters gardin. hear babe better. home. 31 6 clear warm. hous work went lecter see son ephms babe. find better. hear mrs gill low yet. lecter son ephms. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 1-12, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 1 12, 1804 1 7 clear. home, done hous work. home. 2 1 clear except shower. communion. meeting fore noon. tarried ephms babe. mrs farewel went home. meeting son ephms. 3 2 sons till ye 6th went home see 4 3 hous, find patty doore sick. sons jonas. 5 4 childn. babe expired mid night. 6 5 7 6 clear. lemuel came sons find [mourning] loss dear babe. may god sancktify berievement us mr frosts babe sick son ephms, babe 12 weaks lacking 5 hours. 8 7 clear warm. mr stone came see childn. ditoes. 9 1 clear warm. thee remains son ephms infant interd. revd mr parker made prayer. left came home sun sett, wint jonas helpt take care patty thro night. hir father sett funeral son ephms infant. 10 2 clear till night heavy shour. men cleand wel. takeing care things gardin went helpt pally bed drisst blisters &c. son jonas. patty sick. 11 3 rainy day. cyrus gone see review. rain swine matters feel much fatagued. home, rain hoggs &c. 12 4 raind part ye day. done hous work see pally. shee much shee marm sick [night]. son jonas, mrs farewel came home aftern. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 13-19, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 13 19, 1804 13 5 clear part ye day. went son jonas see patty, find much shee dagt ballard informd [yt] betsy andrews deld fine son morn 3m mid night. unwell, much relaxt last night. sally farewel ye situation. son jonas. pally much shee funeral chases infant. 14 6 clear. feeble work wash. went son jonas sett pally. joa smith sett old mrss dunfy sleeps son jonas watcht. 15 7 clear. done hous work ironed. capt savages widdo came see tarries night. mrs dunfy came took breakfast. son jonas ys morn. 16 1 cloudy morn, clear aftern. mrs savage went jonas foren. drest go meeting could hors. went see pally evng, find thirsty. son jonas. 17 2 clear part ye day, raind aftern evng. done hous wk things ye gardin. gathered ripe scarlit beens. squash, shell stringd beens pork diner. home. 18 3 rainy part day. told yt patty much better, glad [sic] made 13 [dozn] candles, sent 1 dzn son jonas replace borrowed prudance [snow] came bake son jona. cyrus went son ephms carry plumbs apples father polly. home. mrs farewel benets sons. 19 4 rainy. cleand sellar done hous work went see pally. find greatir delirium ever seen sons jonas. saw [great patian boys.] source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 4-9, 1804 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 4 9, 1804 4 5 x. birth ebenz trasks son. xx. clear. mrs trask deld son 5h 30m ys morn. felt unwell. came son pollards, tarrie night. dagt nurst mr trasks. birth 7th. recvd 9/ rewd. 5 6 cloudy. sons till 3h pm set home, ill night. cyrus got night wait son pollards, wel. 6 7 clear part day. mrs warrin calld ill till n. joanna smith came helpt much better eat dinner. drank gruel took medisin since taken ill. home, unwel. joanna smith 7 1 clear. taken ye 11th hour excrutiating pain breast, took fue drops campfr. got easier ye pain return number times coars ye day. son lambd go see thomas sick could go. home, sick. son lamb go see son thomas. 8 2 clear part ye day. part hous work. son lambd came informd [child] wors. set went find ill. number times thro night. betsy kumbal watcht. son lambds, thomas ill indead. 9 3 rainy day, high wind night. pain return dispared life. doct man calld night see mrs savage came night reason wind high. shee dare tarry hous. ditoes, sick, child ill allso. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, october 10 15, 1804 10 4 rainy. easier, childn. thomas ill. mr gill wattct. calld thinking expiring revived. son lambd, thomas better. 11 5 cloudy rain. son lambds, thomas ill. mrs fletcher came sett mrs savage sett allso. w thought expiring midnight revivd little alternd, 2h morn. ditoes. child ill. sett ye night. 12 6 clear. thomas expired 5h 20m ys morn. mrs savage fletcher put grave cloaths tarried till breakfast. dagt polly, mrs gill, betsy [kumbal] helpt sew. feeble may god sanctify bereevment us detoes. thomas expired 5h 20m morn. 13 7 clear. tarried till ye 11th h sett home. calld doct conys see lynda gitchel sick calld son jonas see jack pierce, thought better. dagt pollard calld took tea went son lambards. heman bur went ditoes, doct conys son jonas. 14 1 clear. cyrus attended interment thos lambard. revd mr parker made ye prauer. mr capin wife, pollard wife, sons jona ephm wives, mr gill proseeded mourners. wrode shais. funeral thos lambd. [recd] letter augst fm sist waters. 15 2 clear. mr lambd calld see mr swanton fitt 3h morn. went ys morn, better gone read field. dagt pollard left sister went son ephms forn. mrs capin went home. walkt bridg, calld crosbys fathers stors. mr carters, danys, fletchers mr andrus son jonas. returnd son lambds]. receivd 3/ mrs swanton, old debt mrs capin 1/6. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 24-31, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 24 31, 1805 24 1 clear. home. sally farewel came informs son ephms wife unwel lemuel went away morning day sun rise, unbeknowen family. home. sally farewel 25 2 clear till evng. washt fue things ironed feel wel could wish ys evng. home. hear mrs babcock sick. 26 3 cloudy moderate. well, done little work. luke barton hannah trask sleep ebenz t. supt sleeps jason pierces. mrs pierce dind hear mrs babcock better. home. luke barton 27 4 clear part ys day. mrs pierce spun wheall, dind took tea luke ebenz sleepe night. cleand chamber, removd part ye banking fm ye house &c. home, removd banking hous. 28 5 clear warm indeed march. removd banking fm ye hous knit mrs pierce washing jonas wife. mr pierce butchered calf son. dind took tea ebn trask luke barton took breakfast. hannah t. spent ye day sleeps home, removd banking fm ye house. 29 6 clear pleast. removd banking, cleand ye door yd, knit part mended winter gound. home. h. trask sleeps 30 7 clear. mrs farewel son ephm dind son seen 26 years day. mended winter gound. home. son ephms birth day. 31 1 raind. felt unwel. mrs farewel us. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 1-7, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 1 7, 1805 1 2 clear pleast. mrs farewel spent ys day night, town meeting. son ephms wife wrode son lambds hors. shee dind took tea us. happy see much better come home. son ephms wife son jona late home. 2 3 clear pleast forenn. mrss farewel left ye 11th hour. mrss pierce bake, shee dind feel well could wish. home. mrs farewel went 3 4 clear foren day. unwel. mrss pierce dind mr wiman brot tub sett hoopt put new bottom 1 b potaloes. home, unwel. 4 5 clear pleast morn, raind aftern. wel could wish removd part potatoes. mrss pierce dind shee washt. fast day. john pierce j. ballard guning foren, meeting aftern. could giv ye text. home. fast day. mrs pierce 5 6 clear pleast. washt cloaths floor chamber stairs. drinking beer made hops balm gilliad. home. 6 7 sun shone early ys morn, clouded soon began snow. mr pierce dind knit receivd jason pierce 2 qts molases, 2 lb sugar _ lb tea cost 5:6. 1 bushl polatoes. home. 7 1 clear. home. one famely attended divine service. mrs pierce mr babcocks, finds comfortable home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 12-24, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 12 24, 1805 12 1 cloudy. attended public worship. revd mr parker performd. mr ballard went mr thwings intermition. went son ephms night, sleep ditoes, meeting son ephms. 13 2 raind foren. went son lambds aftern, find dagt 14 3 washing babe unwel. son lambds. 15 4 rainy. 16 5 clear part ye day. 17 6 rainy. 18 7 clear part ye day. went mr ushers, saml babcocks tolmans. 19 1 cloudy. went meeting allin lambd conducted home. unwel. deloes meeting. 20 2 cloudy. still ill. son ephm mrs pierce mrs cleark allso. dagt ballard went mr pierces aftern. polly made grewel. home, ill indead day. 21 3 rainy. feel much better eat two small potatoes, first substance taken since sunday morning. hannah, william sally mumps. mrs pierce dind much better afternoon took tea eat bread butter. may treuly grateful every mercy receive great parent. home. mr hall wounded knee went home. [thro] god much comfortable. 22 4 cloudy. home, feel much better. gathered greens famely sent son ephms. sally remains sick yet. mrs pierce ding cafvs [haslet]. home. 23 5 clear pleast. unwel, throat soar. doct howard calld see sally. shee seems comfortable. dind roast veal. home, feel unwel. [24] 6 rain. sumoned mr clefard apear coart evidince. sett went son ephms. son ephms. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 25-Jun. 2, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 25 june 2, 1805 25 7 clear. ephms, went jail slept husband. ephms ye jail. 26 1 clear. meeting. revd mr parker performd. meeting. 27 2 clear. sons. ephms. 28 3 clear pleast. old lady partrage came see mr ballard libarated yet, went ye jail ys night. ditoes. 29 4 husband liberated ys day. clear. election day. husband sett liberty day. went son lambards, finds william sick. came went tarry night. ye babe ill. ditoes, mr patridges son lambds. 30 5 clear. son lambds, child threatoned fitts. doct cony came see approved done ye child. left elixer satutus, seems better. son lambards, babe sick. 31 6 clear. babe seems much revived. tarry night. ditoes, child better. 1 7 clear. mr ballard came took breakfast son lambds. set home, went son ephms, look cloaths. calld see mr craggs child. c. voces, bot 1yd black durant. calld see mrs thwing, shee better. ditoes others. 2 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. got pork ye sellar, packt matters. polly goodin left son jonas, shee unwel. pierce wife dind jonas. home. polly left source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 3-10, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 3 10, 1805 3 2 clear sumer like. home. mr ballard bot 2 quarts vinager. pork greens dinner. dagt ballard dind us. took tea home. 4 3 clear till 4h pm warm. felt feeble. mr ballard gone coart. took dinner dagt ballard, mrs pierce allso. home. 5 4 clear. home, done part washing, brot burden wood took 300 50 steps. fatagued work done ys day. husband coart. home. husband coart. 6 5 cloudy. persueing work, fatagueing indeed. husband gone coart. mrs weman jonas wife went pierces. jack pierce ye mumps. home. 7 6 clear part ye day. finisht washing went see mrs pierce, shee mumps. dagt ballard told wanted prevalidg house sumer. could wish see peace. mr pierces. 8 7 clear part day. cookt pork greens diner. dagt ballard famely partook, mrs pierce allso. mrs nason elijah barton sleeps folks well. home, ironed cloaths. 9 1 rainy day. mr ballard went meeting. elijah spent ye day sleeps home. 10 2 cloudy. mr ballard got wood went mr gills. son jona went saml pierces. elijah sett home. removd corn ye chamber, 22 pails full sheled bag ears. dagt ballard mrs pierce took tea us. home. husband dind jonas wife. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 11-18, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 11 18, 1805 11 3 clear part ye day. mr ballard went see mrs gill, finds better. removd washt roome done matters, feel fatagued. home. 12 4 birth josiah thomsons 4th dagt. clear. mr thomson calld [m] see wife labour. reacht 8h m, shee safe deld noon 4 dagt 5 child. left comfortable returnd home 3h pm. mr thomsons. birth 5th. 13 5 clear warm. saml pierces wife took breakfast son jona, dind us. pork greens y[l] sons famely partook. husband mrs pierce took tea dagt ballard. home. 14 6 clear warm. feel feeble cannot perform much work day. home. 15 7 clear warm. home unwel. mr ballard ye settlement. home, unwell. 16 1 clear warm, shower noon. husband meeting. unwel. dagt pollard came, fanny hodges rhoda came afterwards, sleep feel better evning. mr wood child baptised ye name [sic]. home. dagt pollard 17 2 clear warm. dagts pollard ballard took bed steads ye chamber cleand buggs. hannah helpt father cord ym mr pollard came conducted wife childn home. dagt pollard paid _ dollar shee receivd james bolton 2nd home. son polard came wife childn. 18 3 clear. mr aron page sent us 9 lb wool use [9] sheep year. done washing, feel falagued. cleaned sellar part. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 19-27, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 19 27, 1805 19 4 clear morn, shower middle day. taken bed slead clean bugs, skolt ye sealing washt floor. le faett gone saml pierces. home. 20 5 clear. home. old mrss dunpha gave old cloaths childn dagt disceased. dagt ballard went visit mrs wiman. home. 21 6 clear. home. jona wife went son pollards. son cyrus came informd man ye name dunppha apprehended abuseing wife. widdow gelchel imprudent liv since. boild soap ys day. home. cyrus came 2h pm. dunpha commited jail. 22 7 clear. cyrus sett nr pullins aftern. jonas wife came home falagued boddy mind, [sic] sister getchel apprehended brot tryal justice north. shee found guilty tryal. home. mrs getchel apprehended. 23 1 clear. felt unwell, attend worship, husband mrs getchel calld way home. home. marriage mr stackp m. babcock. 24 2 clear. home. mr ballard sheard sheep belonged son pollard. saml babcock ye 3d sleep 25 3 clear. mending cloaths son cyrus. mrs badcock pierce, dagt ballard mr cone took tea home. lransplanted musk mellions. 26 4 clear. mend pair trousers cyrus. mr ballard made forem sett leach. little saml better. mrs pierce done washing home. mrs pierce washing 27 5 clear. cleand sellar, drew lee got soap many attempts. mr ballard done surveying got hoops tubs casks &c, &c. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 28 july 7, 1805 28 6 clear. washt persued soap worke. feel falagued. mrs pierce sewing dagt ballard. home. 29 7 clear. done ironing almost compleated soap makeing. husband son lambards, wel usual. home. 30 1 clear. home, feel wel could wish. husband went meeting. john pierce, jona b. junr william n. parish. home. 1 2 clear. sewing coverled raggs. mrs wiman paid 1/6 spining. mrs pierce sised web. home. 2 3 clear. home, feel feeble. betsy andrews sewing jonas wf. mr ballard houghing potatoes. home. 3 4 clear. home. washing. mr ballard went son lambd. home. 4 5 clear warm. mr ballard thee crotch ye roads hear oration deliverd. returnd jonses, walkt procescion ye federals. returnd home 10h evn. dagt ballard took tea mr pierces. mr pierces. 5 6 clear warm. son ephms wife dind mr ballard went lecture. went home dagt lambd, babe much aflicted humer. calld capt williams. lectur son lambds. 6 7 clear warm. son lambd. mrs edwards shee sewd dagt. mrs savage came see us. son lambds. 7 1 clear warm. went meeting, son lambd conducted shais. sacrament administred ye church baptism infant james williams, ye name loes w.. husband son ephms intermition. ditoes meeting. communion day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 8-19, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 8 19, 1805 8 2 fine rain ys day. may thankful mercies bestowed us. bakt bread pork beens. rain lhunder ye night. home. fine rain. 9 3 clear. home, workt ye gardin hous work. mrs pierce bakt dagt ballard went mr woodwards. home. 10 4 clear warm. done hous work sewd coverled raggs. home. wido getchel 11 5 clear warm. home, houghd ye hogs sty. home. 12 6 clear warm. shower, began 4h 30m pm. done washing. mrs getchel pierce raind night. alpheus lyons barn burnt. home. 13 7 clear warm. washt room, stairs entry, cleand sellar &c, &c. home. 14 1 clear warm. mr ballard meeting. john pierce, p. wiman jona b. junr went n. parrish. home. 15 2 clear warm. home. son ephm sent us piece veal, wt 10 lb. sent box curents. home. 16 3 clear warm. done hous work sewd coverled raggs. husband workt forenn part ye aftern hay. much distresst side hurt yesterday. mrs gilbard workt jona, childn tea, mrs pierce allso. home. 17 4 clear warm. home, hous work sewd raggs. home. 18 5 clear warm. son lambd calld 3h pm go see daugt lucy sick. son lambd, mr ballard sleeps 19 6 clar warm. ditoes lucy seems better. wrode mr gills, youngest child expired yesterday. ditoes mr gills. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 20-27, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 20 27, 1805 20 7 clear. sett son l., husband hors back. son dagt, allin, barny, dolly sally pollard walkt. hors started little zibe petingails threw son lambd ran assistance. mounted hors went mr gills attend ye funeral child. revd mr stone made fine prayer ocation. could prosceed grave tarried till returnd went son lambds. lucy unwell yet. distrest night. old mrs savage took care lucy. son lambds funeral mr gills dagt betsy. 21 1 clear. mr lambd conducted home shais. lambe scairsly walk. ye bed ye day. mr ballard attended worship. pierce, p. wiman, rosa cottle 4 jonas childn meeting. son lambds. came home forenn. 22 2 clear warm. home lame work. home. 23 3 clear. home, lame. home. 24 4 clear except showers. gathered cherrys done work, feel better. home. 25 5 clear. mr ballard gatherd cherrys. mr b. went settlement 15 qts. sold 7 qts gave others mrs thwing pitts. mrss conry gill ys aftern. sally farewel, 2 mr eads daughts 3 sons calld home. mrs conry gill 26 6 clear except showers evng. dagt ballard went hallowell, childn troublesome evng. home. 27 7 clear. home. mr ballard lambds ephms. jonas wife shewn tantrums. could wish night ye god might see treatment. mr gray, teaches gramer school, evng. home. tumultuous aftern. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 28-Aug. 3, 1805 (P)

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 12-19, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 12 19, 1805 12 2 clear warm. done washing. calld 5h 30m pm go see wife mr james caton labour. went bed. slept little. mr j. catons. june 9th receivd 1 bushel wheat. 13 3 x. birth james catons 9th child 4th son. xx. clear. patient deld 4th son 9th child 4h morn. left wel could expected came son pollards 9. wife wel could wish. reacht home 11, old mrs dunpha rensed hung cloaths, gathered mustard &c. mr catons son pollard. birth 5th. 14 4 clear. went son lambds aftern, husband bror pauls wife mr shaw son lambds. 15 5 clear. ditoes. son daugt yr connections wrode forks. tarried childn. ditoes. 16 6 little rain fore n, clear aftern. mr ballard returnd home, 2 youngest childn unwel. ditoes. 17 7 clear, wind ye n. son lambd conducted sister vesel go bath, relurnd dagt conducted mr wimans returnd home. reacht home 11h morn, ironing. mr ballard son pollards. detoes mr wimans. funeral man expired shubal pittss fall [vesel]. 18 1 clear warm. mr ballard went meeting. revd mr packard performd. meeling son ephms 19 2 clear. bakt done work, calld hast mr cyphers see old mrs pollard fell hors carried doct winship came lett blood. shee put shais, conducted mr blacks. went tarried night. mr cyphers blacks. mrs pollard fell hors, hurt much. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

[lost] much ye seat life. may pleas thee great parent ye univers grant better health. mr ballard went carried 2 lb 5 oz wool ye masheen, brot 8_ roals home. home. 20 1 clear. mr ballard went meeting. revd mr stone discoarsed forn fm st john c 12 v 35 aftn, fm peter c 1st v 5. son ephms intermition. meeting son ephms. cyrus came home. 21 2 clear. sally pierce mrs wiman bake. two mr puringtons dagts calld evng. home. home. 22 3 cloudy morn, severe slorm rain snow aftern night. mrs farewel came ys morn. mr wiman wife, saml, betsy d. bolton came slept wind blew could stay home. home. home. 6 persons slept besides famely. 23 4 clear. mr wimans famely went home, mrs farewel allso. nabby holms came 2h pm spin mr ballard mr bridges office business. home. home. nabby holms came wk 24 5 cloudy, raind night. mr ballard mr bridges office cyrus sett watervil winslow 2h pm. home. cyrus watervil. 25 6 clear windy. done washing. mr ballard home. prev. page october 17 25, 1805 next page home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive browse search stories themes lens decoding transcribing diary online diary

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 26-Nov. 9, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 26 november 9, 1805 26 7 rain. home. mr ballard got wood home. home. 27 1 cloudy windy. mr ballard went meeting, mr parker performd. home. 28 2 clear ye day. mr ballard went mill ye carding mesheen. home, hous wk cutt apples stue drie. cyrus returnd, bror towns famely well. home. cyrus returnd. 29 3 clear. home. mrs holms mills sleep home. mrs holms mills 30 4 clear part ye day. home. home. 31 5 clear. mr ballard cyrus helpt dig potatoes jona. miles lethers hauld load us. home, ristbanded shirt cyrus. home. cut pumkins drie. 1 6 clear. mr ballard attended prepairtory lecture. mr stone discst fm 2nd cornith. lecture. 2 7 clear. nabby hoelms went paid ye work shee done us. scoured yn, boild warp cotten filing, washt straind apple jack &c, &c. ephm conducted nabby son pollards. home. jabish cowen dagt dind 3 1 x. birth son ephms 2nd dagt. xx. clear. calld 12 1 o clock ys morn son ephm go see wife. shee deld second child daugt belween 4 5 cleverly. went meeting foren, communion. babe wd 9lbs _. dagt lambd tarried foren. son ephms meeting, communion. birth 6th. recvd present gound patrn. 4 2 dagt takeing care infant. 5 3 6 4 mrs farewel returnd varsalboro. 7 5 returnd home. ephm gave gound patn. son ephms. 8 6 clear part ye day. washt bakt. sent syrrup epms wife. home. 9 7 clear. done washing. cyrus carried 3lb factory cottne warp dagt lambd weav. home. mr ballard receivd taxes pierce. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 10-22, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 10 22, 1805 10 1 snowd, raind haild. mr ballard meeting. cyrus home. ephms wife cleverly. home. 11 2 cold. home. home. 12 3 clear cold. home. mrs wiman husband workt son jona, dind cyrus went mr kingsley find washt north room. home. mrs wiman 13 4 cloudy. mr ballard workt son jona part ye day. home. rosanna cottle bakt cyrus went son lambds, carried 42 skeins wool filling 2 lb f. cottne home, cutt apples. 14 5 raind. sorting apples pairing cuting mr ballard workt son jonas new hous. home. 15 6 rainy. washt mr ballard went son ephms hired cow wido farewel. luke barton helpt drive home. shee gave small cremer full mitk night. home. mr ballard took cow [mrs] farewel. 16 7 rainy. finisht washing, feel fatagued. home. 17 1 clear pleast bad walking. mr ballard meeting. mr grey sleeps preacht capt bangers. home. mr grey slept 18 2 clear part ye day. pareing cuting apples, workt till midnight. son ephm says wife wel could wish. home. 19 3 clear. stued apples done hous work. wilm cypher bankt hous. home. 20 4 clear. mrs cypher rosana bakt home. mr ballard [jonas] house work. home. 21 5 clear. mr ballard workt jona part day. home, feel unwell. home. 22 6 clear. washt done hous work. rosanna came bake. mr ballard workt jona part ye day. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 5-12, 1805 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 5 12, 1805 5 5 cloudy moderate. comfortable ys day, done hous work wound yarn balls double 4 skeins. mr ballard jonas, cyrus cuting wood. home. 6 6 raind hard ye night. mr huff brother slept mr ballard workt son jona. home. 7 7 raind till aftern. bakt bread mins pies done mending finisht doubling grey yarn. mr ballard workt jona till near night, went son ephms. finds wife poorly breast, broak yet. home. 8 1 cloudy high n wind. mr ballard meeting son ephms. wife better. cyrus home. revd mr stone discoarsed luke xvi 7. home. 9 2 windy day. severely afflicted pain teeth got rest ys night. home, unwell. 10 3 clear high wind. mrs wiman came foren spent day feel unwel yet severe pain would bless bestower every mercy. home, [unwel]. mrs [wiman] came tarried 11 4 clear cold windy. done washing. mr ballard slauter hous beef. son town came home sleeps famely well. ezra house. home. son town sleeps 12 5 clear, part day moderate. mr ballard cyrus coart. washt cloaths ys day. sist farewel calld informs yt pollys breast soar yet. home. mrs farewel source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, january 27 31, 1806 27 2 clear pleast. jason pierce, mr wickson wm cypher giting wood [us]. got 14 loads. mrs wiman took tea. sewing hous work. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 15-20, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 15 20, 1806 15 7 cloudy day. girls went home 10h morn. mended 4 pair hoes son cyrus, legins drawers mr ballard done hous work. mr ballard son lambds, got waistcoat; stores, bot cod fish, wd 5_, _ gn rhum, 1 qut ginn &c. home. childn went home. 16 1 clear, windy cold. mr ballard meeting, wore new coat waist coat. mr georg brown wife came home tarrie night. home. georg brown wife 17 2 clear cold. mr brown wife left 10h ys morn go farmington. mrs heartwel made visit, informd yt jason pierces wife [deld] son last night ys morn. finisht cottne hoes evng. home. mr mrs brown left mrs heartwl 18 3 snowd. mrs heartwel herbs, one childn unwell. capt puringtons little sons marm, shee unwel. altering green coat, took 1 breadth made mr ballard took care ye barn wrote letters sent boston. home. 19 4 cloudy moderate. brewd done sewing. mr ballard carrie letters post office. meriah heartwel pan warm marms bed, sais shee unwel. allin lambard ephm ye 3d, cut wood. gave rice eat. lamb cum. home, hear mrs hartwl unwell. 20 5 clear aftern, rain evn. allin ephm sleep see mrs hartwl soar breast. mr ballard ye settlement. ys day seen 71 years. [toil] ye years thine hand maid mr heartw unwell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 21-28, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 21 28, 1806 21 6 clear. calld son jonas see wife babe unwel. comfortable yesterday. mrs burington came came home. rhoda pollard sally ballard came home allin ephm sleep son jonas, wife babe unwel. 22 7 clear. rhoda washt cloaths bakt brown flower bread. son jonas wife sent 4_ lb pork. mrs cypher calld flax comb. mr ballard shaved son lambds, brot allins shirt. sally went home, shee sick last night. home. hear [mrs] gillard son born yesterdy. 23 1 cloudy part day. home. cyrus came home, father meeting. revd mr stone discoarsed james 1st c foren, fm psalm c 47th 1 v aftern. fine singing. rhoda h. ballard sleep home. 24 2 clear part ye day. washt. snowd evng. rhoda son jonas. home. 25 3 clear cold. ironed cloaths finisht samls hoes. cyrus returnd watervil went son lambds. dolly l. ys day, shee went home, rhoda went 2_ lb fish son lambd. home. cyrus bot 1 qt [ginn]. 26 4 clear pleast. mr ballard son lambds ephms. mrs coal came husband paid 5 dollars owd work shee done us. shee sleeps done work, mendd cloaths &c. home. mrs coal sleeps 27 5 clear part day, snod mrs cool left colo howards. made flanel sheet done hous work. home. mrs coal left 28 6 clear part ye day. unwel. mrs heartwel came made bed, kind. home, unwell. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 1-7, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 1 7, 1806 1 7 clear cold. mr ballard went son lambds brot new great coat home. dagt pollard, rhoda thomas came tarrie night. weler yesterday mercy wish treuly thankful. home. dagt pollard 2 childn sleep 2 1 clear cold. cyrus came home, cold go meeting. father went. son jona sent us go dine mr trask wife mrs gill allso. son jonas. 3 2 clear cold. done washing. mr smith hauld us 2 loads wood. lefaet 2, ephm hors slead. wm cypher chopt woods. washt kitchen husband went bed. calld see capt stone ys aftern, sick. home. wood hauld. washt 4 3 cloudy part ye day. mr ballard went saml cumings mill, bot _ bsl rie 1 qt milk; _ busl indien ground. calld capt stones, finds better. mrs andrews sent herbs. bracket sick. home. 5 4 clear part ye day cold. bakt brown bread, 16 lb indien 9 rie meal. betsy andrews 2 qts soap, paid 4d _. sent go see brother, could go. mr ballard went, finds easier. home, bakt brown bread. 6 5 clear cold. washt done work, brot 7 pails water. feel wel evng could wish. hear mr wiman son jona calld capt stones ys morn day, thought expireing. hear aftern alive. home, washt mrs heartwel st [1 lb buller]. 7 6 clear cold. mendind husbands mits sewing. hear capt stone better. mrs heartwel little girl allso. mr ballard bot _ gln rhum, 1 qt ginn, 1 galn molases. [home]. mrs htwl source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 8-12, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 8 12, 1806 8 7 clear cold. mrs farewel came see shee slept son jonas last night. mrs heartwel jonas boys others killd dear day. mending hoes mr ballard cyrus. hear capt slone low. mr ballard son lambds, willm better. allin gone bath school. home. mr ballard bot cod fish. 9 1 clear cold. mr ballard meeting. cyrus came home. son lambard conducted wife babe rachel capin, left sleep informd capt stone expired ys day. mrs heartwel home. dagt lambd rachel capin sleep death capt stone. 10 2 clear cold. dagt lambd rachel capin left breakfast go son pollards. mr ballard town meeting. home alone, began mitn husband ys aftern, knit thumb 11h evng. home. dagt lambd left 11 3 clear foren, cloudy aftern. mrs heartwel return things shee borrowed. finisht kniting husbands mitts. mr stones desire attend funeral capt stone tomorrow, son lambds. brot home _ bushel wheat, rie, elijah barton left present us. home. recvd _ bsl wheat, rie, prest sist bartons sons. 12 4 snowd ye morn, raind evng. le faett ballard came conductd funeral capt stone. revd mr stone made able prayer ocation. larg number attended pay last tribute kindnes. hous ye remains ofcapn stone conveyed interment. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 13-20, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 13 20, 1806 13 5 cloudy, snowd raind. home. son jon sent us 4_ lb venison. cookt part supper. mr ballard bot _ lb hyson tea, 2 lb sugar, butter _ gn spirit. home. son jon evng. 14 6 clear. washt. mrs heartwel mr ballard workt barn fixing place sheep lambs. home. 15 7 clear part day, squalls snow. son jonas wife 3 youngest childn made visit. mr heartwel took tea us. ironed mended. home. jonas wife 3 childn 16 1 clear. mr ballard meeting, cyrus allso. mrs heartwel herbs, 2 childn unwel. home. text forenn romans 8th 28, aftern, proverbs 22nt c 24th vers. home. cyrus came home returnd. 17 2 clear. home. mr ballard hallowell. son jona wife calld return son lambards. brot us 45 hering, 1 lb chees, [butr] oinions, present son lambd. home. jona wife calld 18 3 clear. home. mr ballard surveying squir lyon. ephm wilm sleep mrs hlwl, dagt, betsy wiman hanh ballard mitk. home. 19 4 clear. home. 8th lamb, alive yet. mr ballard son lambards, william unwel. mrs heartwel paid ye flower borrowed. twisted 28 knots hoes yarn. home. 20 5 clear. dagt lambard sent go see william unwel. wilm cypher cut wood. got breakfast walkt son lambds, le faell acompanied tarrie night, seen ye river sinc closd. son lambds. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 21-27, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 21 27, 1806 21 6 snowd. son lambard 2 swine buschered. helpt packing glass croccry. wilm unwell plays son load goods carried varsalboro going remove tomorrow, 2 loads carried yesterdy. wrode home sleigh ys aftern. gave 5 lb pork 51 herring crackers pickeles. son lambards. mr ballard found cow calf morning. 22 7 clear part ye day cool. mr ballard went son l. livid, taken departure reacht may great parent ye univers bless prosper giv grace walk wais godliness. mr kidder fm penopscott sartifacate. home. son lambard removd famely varsalboro day. 23 1 clear except little snow morn. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarsed foren fm luke xix c 14th v, aftern fm john 1st c 46th vers. mr heartwel meeting. home, wrote bror collins moore. 24 2 snowd day cold march. washt. mr ballard tended ye barn brot water. 25 3 clear part ye day. home, done hous work &c. mr ballard hollowell. home. 26 4 clear. mr ballard [mr] catons, bot 1 busl wheat. son pollards, dagt sent 2 mins pies _ lb butter. brewd done hous work. mrs heartwel mitk creem, shee sent nut cakes. home, brewd. mr ballard mr catons. infmd ye death mrss paterson. 27 5 clear cold. mr ballard went mr cumingss mill, caried 1_ bushl wheat, _ rie _ indien. went old mr s. cumingss, bot chees, wd 16_ lb. finisht brewing done matters. heard ye death mrs paterson. home. mr balld mill. death. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, april 3 10, 1806 3 5 clear cold. mr ballard meeting, fast day. cyrus came home went meeting. sons jona lambd came evng. latter sleeps informs famely wel except barny misfortune hurt one eyes fall. home. son lambd sleeps mrs hartwl calld ys day. 4 6 clear moderate. jason pierce, wm cypher john pierce workt us ys foren giting wood. mrs wiman made visit aftern. felt well could wish. home. mrs wiman see 5 7 clear. home. mr ballard settlement shaved. home. 6 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting, revd mr stone discoarsed fm john 5 c 9th vers. mrs heartwel babe. home. 7 2 cloudy ye ys day. mr ballard town meeting. twisted 11 knots hoes yarn mended 3 pair hoes husband, done matters. mr ballard bot 2 lb sugar. home. mr ballard town meeting. 8 3 raind day. mr heartwel mend hoes husband cyrus. home. 9 4 snowd day. done hous work knit mittin cyrus, except thumb. betsy wiman brot 6 knots [wik] yn marm spun meriah says marm unwell. hannah ballard tanzy saml, says unwel, pukt worm. home. mr ballard made new [tennanls] bed stead. 10 5 clear part day cold. mr ballard went son jonas, made head bord beadsted fixt yesterdy. took bed room put altered. finisht mitt began yesterday knit part another. polly purington herbs marm unwell. meriah says marm better. home. hannah says samuel unwell yet. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 11-16, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 11 16, 1806 11 6 clear foren, cloudy aftern, cold. mr ballard ye settlement, bot 1 bushel corn sheep, price 6s. went see mrs heartwel, shee unwel. funeral mr childs youngest child. mr heartwels, wife unwel. 12 7 clear part ye day cold. done washing matters. mr ballard ye settlement, brot home _ gn spirit, 1 qt ginn, 4 lb pork, 2 doe butter 1 skein black silk. home, washing. 13 1 clear cold. mr ballard cyrus went meeting. revd mr stone deliverd discoarsl forenn ye death mr childss youngest child 2nd samuel 12 c 23 v. home. mr heartwel says wife better. home. 14 2 clear cold. washt fixt old gownd [waist]. mr ballard took care ye barn cut wood. mrs smith wanted herbs. babe ye canker. home. 15 3 clear till near night. ironing mended mr ballards black small cloaths mrs farewels. dagt ballard mta saml tea. mr son came carried marta home. mrs f. sleeps home. sister farewel sleeps 16 4 clear pleast morn. mrs farewel left breakfast go mr benits. finisht mending green coat mending, began stockin son cyrus. mr ballard mr patridges, says mary rockwood yet alive. bot 2 lb sugar 20 rows pins. home. raind snowd aftern. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 17-25, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 17 25, 1806 17 5 clear morn. raind, snowd haild aftern. mrs farewel, son jona wife took tea mrs f. sleeps mending cloaths. home. mrs farewl sleeps 18 6 clear pleast morn. mrs farewel self went son jonas. mr balld ye settlement. came took dinner mrs wiman smith tea us mrss f. came home sleeps son jon 19 7 snowd. mrs farewel went son jonas noone. son cyrus came home aftern butchered calf. part cleand ye head feet. finisht makeing coat self. saml ballard one year old ys day. home. mrs farewel went sons. 20 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting. cookt ye head harslet ye veal. son jona, wife 3 childn partook us, luke barton allso. came loin veal son ephm. revd mr stone discoarst foren proverbs 16 c 3 v, aftern fm daniel 3d c 12 vers. home. son jona wife dind receivd letter march 7 fm bror collins moore. 21 2 clear warmer. home, cleand buttery. mr ballard parish meeting. much falagued ys night. home. 22 3 cloudy, raind made small chees, finisht banding coat done matters. feel wel usual. mr wiman got timber. home, unwel. 23 4 clear. unwel ys day night. mrs heartwel came see home, unwel. 24 5 recvd letter bror collins [9th inst]. clear. sick indead. mrs h see mrs wiman came, spent day night easier ys night mercy wish prais auther thal ye mercies receiv. home, sick exercised much pain. 25 6 clear. feel comfortable. mrs wiman left noon. mrs smith gilbard aftern, made tea. drank 2 cups, first food taken 48 hours. home, unwel easier source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 26-May 4, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 26 may 4, 1806 26 7 clear forn, cloudy aftn. well bake bn flower bread, churnd 2 pounds butter bt cheese, great defuculty. betsy andrus came aftern, shee kindly assisted shee could got thro work. 2 lb butter. son jonas youngest child sick. dagt see le faett martha day. home, feel much better thro gods goodness. son ephm funeral james savages wife. 27 1 snowd ye day. mr ballard cyrus meeting. fix things husband, expects go winslow tomorrow. revd mr parker performd day, discoarsed foren entry], aftn fm entry]. home. mr parker preacht [place] worship. 28 2 clear. mr ballard went winslow. home. betsy andrews came help brot child, washt. home. nr balld winslow. 29 3 clear. home makeing soap. home. 30 4 clear. home boiling soap. home. 1 5 clear part ye day. betsy went 10h morn go meeting hallowell. mr ballard returnd, well son towns lambards. old mr spring like liv, living came fm towns. home. mr ballard returnd. brewd. 2 6 clear cool. home. betsy came help mr ballard lecture. home. 3 7 clear. betsy washt n. room kitchen. mr ballard settlement, bot 3 lb pork, _ gn spirit, pint brandy, _ snuff. wilm cypher evning, mr ballard paid one dollar. betsy went home. peter wiman james purington bm giliad, apple trees curent bushes. home. 4 1 clear. mr ballard meeting, communion day. able attend. went see mrs heartwels child unwel. elijah luke barton, allin lambd, jona ephm ballard supt sally, marla hannah dind mr heartwels see [sick] child. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 5-10, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 5 10, 1806 5 2 clear. mr ballard town meeting. capt joshua gage chosen represent ys town genl coart ye present year. makeing soap. removd banking fron ye south end ye hous south ye west door. set part cabbage slumps &c. churnd 2 lb _ buller. home, set cabage stumps. elijah left dinner. 6 3 clear. finisht makeing soap, barril full. finisht seting cabbage slumps beets &c. home. 7 4 cloudy rain. remove banking ye west door round ye east door matters. mrs purington aftern, took tea us. home. 8 5 clear morn, cloudy afler wards, raind night evng. done work ye hous. cleand hogg pen, sett english goos bery bushes west side house. mrs nason forenn, mrs heartwel aftern cammomile. let home, workt hard doors 9 6 x. birth benn chases daugt. xx. rainy part ye day. removd plumb tree gardin sett ye corn field. sett curent shoots washing. calld 4h 30m pm go see mrs chace labour. shee safe deld 6 daugt. left infant cleverly reacht home 8h 30m evng. conducted home capt purington. mr chaces. birth 1st year. decr 17nth receivd 9/ chaces work. 10 7 clear part ye day cold. mrss farewel came took breakfast dind us. shee came last evng returnd son jon shee found home. informd jon ballard junr unwell. finisht washing made chees. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 11-18, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 11 18, 1806 11 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting. heman burr young man took tea us. revd mr stone discoarst fm luke 8c, 8v. home. 12 2 clear. unwell day. mrs heartwel spent aftern mr ballard surveying saml cumings. leut wm stones childn gardin seeds. home, unwel. 13 3 clear warm. comfortable, done hous work, churned made chees, gardin. husband dug ye gardin. mr smith faett home. mrs htwl twice. churnd 2_ lb butter. 14 4 clear part ye day, shower aftern. workt gardin done hous work. mrs wiman seeds, took tea jona ballard junr, hannah, martha saml dind peter wiman 20 apple trees pay gave saml smaller ones curent shoots. home. mrs wiman 15 5 clear. sett sage roots done matters gardin, brot manure behind ye hous. mrs heartwel informd quilting son jonas ys day. home. 16 6 clear warm. pruda snow washt dagt ballard. little wash self. field ploughd ys foren. mr ballard ye settlement, bot _ gn spirit, 2 lb sugar, _ boke tea. home. 17 7 clear. mended waislcoat son cyrus, made chees done hous work. mr ballard barbers store, bot 5lb[_] pork. home. husband seen 81 years day. 18 1 clear. mr ballard meeting, cyrus son lambds. cookt pork, patience, cabage sprouts, yerrow sheperds sprouts. mrs heartwel h. s. m. hannah trask jack james purington. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 19-25, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 19 25, 1806 19 2 clear. home, workt gardin done hous work. home. 20 3 clear. home, done hous work ye gardin. home. 21 4 clear. churnd 3_ lb butter, bakt done matters. calld isaac beals 5h pm go see wife labour, tarrie night. mr isaac beals. 26th recd 22 5 x. birth isaac bealss 3d son 5th child. xxx. clear, frost ys morn. patient safe deld 1h ys morn son, 5th child 3d son. shee cleverly, ye babe atact distrese 2h birth. thought dead revivd. mr beals went rhed field brot nurs. tarried till returnd came home hors back, hous sett order. slept sence left home. mr bealss. birth 2nt. receivd 6/ part 26th. recd 3/ husband receivd mr beals. 23 6 clear. mr ballard coart. done hous work, planted corn, pumpkins, squash, water mellons got weads part curent bushes. feel falagued. home, workt gardin. 24 7 clear. workt gardin, planted watermellions, corn, beens pumpkins done washing. feel falagued. mr ballard coart, finisht planting corn returnd. home, workt garding washt. 25 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr parker performd, discoarst psalm 73 forn, fm 1st timothy aftern. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 1-8, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 1 8, 1806 1 1 cloudy. mr ballard cyrus meting. home. son jon wife, jona junr saml made chees. revd mr stone discoarst foren fm luke 23 c 28th v, aftern fm psalms x c vers 12th. home. mrs pickford expired. 2 2 clear. home, workt gardin hous work. home. 3 3 clear. workt gardin, done hous work churnd 2_ lb butter. old lady stone calld see shee unwel. son jona wife forenn. soal cypher washt wool 20 fleases. mr ballard cyrus coart. home. mrs stone remains mrs pickfordinterd ys day. 4 4 clear. bakt done washing. mr ballard coart. son town mrs farewel sleep home, bakt washt. 5 5 clear till near noon. finisht washing, workt gardin. mrs farewel, dagts pollard ballard, sally saml took tea us. mrs farewel sleeps raind evng. home, finisht wash. 6 6 clear part ys day. mrs farewel left son ephms foren. mr ballard ye coart hous. washt rest wool &c. home. mrs farewel went fm 7 7 cloudy ye day, misty evng. mr ballard ye settlement, bot 3 lb pork, _ gn spirit. lues hamtin gave fine lemmon. done hous work, churnd 2_ lb butter. home. churnd &c 2_ lb butter. thad snelss son killd sudenly. 8 1 clear part day. mr ballard cyrus meeting. attended aftern. revd mr stone discoarst foren fm psalm 16th 8 vers, aftn john 6 chap 68 vers. son jona evng, unwell. meeting aftern. mrs wiman greens foren. receivd letter fm bror elijah [mch 31]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 9-16, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 9 16, 1806 9 2 clear part ye day warm. home, workt gardin. twisted 9 knots thread hous wk. home. 10 3 cloudy misty. transplanted cucumbers done matters gardin. mr ballard finisht planting potatoes. great noise [gilbd]. home. 11 4 cloudy rain. husband unwel worrie ye sheep get ym ye corn. ye field 8 times self pickt wood &c. jona b. junr came slept mr wiman kind, brot burthen wood proposed seeking cow thought le faett would bring home. mr ballard sick. 12 5 clear part ye day. mr ballard comfortable mercy wish greatful. mrs wiman came betsy saml, washt wool. ye old lady took tea us. churnd 2_ lb butter day. home. mrs wiman churnd 20_ lb butter since killd ye calf. 13 6 clear. made chees 11th since killd calf. home. 14 7 clear. churnd 1_ lb butter makes 22 lb ye last 8 weaks. made chees, finisht washing [mallers]. mr ballard ye settlement. home. made 22 lb butter 12 cheess since w kild calf. 15 1 clear. mr ballard son cyrus meeting. able attend. revd mr stone discoarst fm acts 9th c 39 vers. home. 16 2 clear. done work gardin observed eclips, total dark. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 17-21, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 17 21, 1806 17 3 clear part ye day. mrs gillbd came calld go see mrs heartwel pain stomach. walkt home three times, feel fatagued. shee seemd easier last mrs wiman son jonas wife cookt pork beens dinner. mr ballard houghing corn giting wood. mr heartwels, wife unwel. 18 4 clear part ye day. done hous work see mrs heartwel. ditoes. 19 5 clear pt ye day. home except goin drive ye sheep ye field stept mr heartwels. wife says shee better. sally church washing. paid 1 6 shee ditoes. 20 6 clear. day sally washing. mrs heartwel unwel yet. ditoes. 20 6 cloudy rain. removd plants, done ironing went see mrs heartwel. shee says shee better. mr ballard shaved ye barber wel returnd unshaven. mrs ands getchel mr heartwels. ditoes. 21 7 rained hear mrs heartwel better. meriah aftern, informs marm better. may shee greatful heart gods mercys may speak goodness great ye evil unthankful. churnd 3_ lb buter. home. mr ballard hallowell, bt 11 lb cod fish. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 22-28, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 22 28, 1806 22 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus attended public worship day, went aftern. revd mr parker performd titus 3 c 2nd vers. went son ephms meeting see mrs heartwell, find better. meetng son ephms mr heartwels. 23 2 clear warm. done hous wk, houghd beens &c. felt feeble. mr ballard workt ye road mr wimans son jonas. went see mrs heartwel, find better. mr heartwels. 24 3 clear part ye day. workt gardin, piqut wool, done hous work &c. mr ballard put ashes corn went settlement. shower near night ought thank ye author mercies. home, done various kinds work. 25 4 clear. piqt wool done hous work. wido gilchel mrs heartwels washing mr ballard puting ashes corn. home. 26 5 clear. mr ballard went hamlins slore, bot 1 busl corn, _ rie. went mr cumingss mill ground, bot _ busl wheat sister barton came famely well. home. sister barton came 27 6 clear cool. sister barton went son ephms breakfast. sist went son jonas went old lady hamlin came spent ye aftern us ephms. son ephms. 28 7 clear. betsy andrews came mend cloaths, sally church wash. mr ballard went see vesel launched. returnd, informd yt son timoy page taken river harmon barton alive. saml, son esqr titcomb hand brot life. home. drowned, saml titcomb. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 29-Jul. 2, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 29 july 2, 1806 29 1 clear. mr ballard meeting, cyrus son lambards. home. mrss heartwel glad shee far recovered. son lambard came tarried little says famely well usual. home. mrs htwl son lambd 30 2 clear warmer hase lately. mrs wiman greens, hannah ballard allso. mrs gilbard paid soap shee mr ballard went attend ye funeral master saml titcomb drouned saterday last. wife esqr runels expired satterday night last. remains interd day. may frequent instances mortallity excite us allso ready last change. son ephms, well mr soal presided ye funeral, delivered descoars adapted ocation lemantations 3d chap 39 vers, ye words, wherefore doth living man complain &c. funeral oldest son saml titcomss esqr. funeral old lady runels ys day. 1 3 cloudy misty. done hous work, sett plants. mr ballard attended meeting aflern. association minesters, revd mr winship, mr parker mr jenks bath. delivered discoarse 2nd timy 1st ch 7th vrs. informd jon drowned last satterday, remains found yet. meeting mr thwings, unwell. mrs edess 2 4 fine rain ys day, may thankfull. elijah gidion barton took breakfast marm got home safe. sett beats, turnips cabages rain done hous work. mr ballard got bark wood. home. sister bartons sons source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 3 7, 1806 3 5 clear warm. home, done hous wk gardin. allin lambd took breakfast supt ephm ballard supt, sleep mr ballard complaining pain back. home. allin ephm sleep 4 6 clear. mrs farewel dind mr ballard went hear oration delivd meeting hous mr jones. dind son ephms. mr heartwel took supper done hous work, knit workt gardin. mrs heartwel ague face. home. allin ephm breakfast. mrs fareweldind. mr hartwel supt 5 7 clear. done hous work, washt, churnd 4 lb buller. washt ye shelvs floor ye bullery, feel fatagued. mr ballard shavd, bot 4 oz snuff. brot glovs son ephms wife bot hallowell, price 7s. mrs heartwel wel twice, shee says son jona gone jail returnd home evng. home, washt &c, ironed &c. 6 1 clear warmer. mr ballard, self son cyrus meeting, communion. revd mr stone discoarst fore n fm romans 9 c last v, aftern fm luke xviii c 22 vers. mr heartwel son jona evng. meeting son ephms. 7 2 shoury. done hous wk, houghd gardin &c. mr ballard settle amos partridg. ye settlement mr ballards favour, 8 dols. home. informd yt jon howse remains found last sallerday. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 8-9, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 8 9, 1806 8 3 fine showers ought thankfull. done hous work, sett plants, houghd beens ye rain. mr ballard houghd corn foren. pickt wool. h., s. mt ballard curents old mrs dunpha, grand childn ye hooping cough. home. mrs heartwel son jona load hay brot barn. 9 4 clear warm. husband awake 3h ys morn mrss heartwel gillbard brot us ye horrible tydings capt purington murdered famely except son james must shared fate fortunate make escape attempt made take life. wounded ax, fled shirt alarmd mr wiman ye horrid scein, immediately ran son jonas. two went hous horrid scein perpetrated. son went found candle lit great surprise purington, wife six childn corpss martha, perceived life remaining, removd house. surgical aid immediately calld shee remains alive yet. husband went returnd sun rise, takeing little food went hous, behold ye shocking scein thal ever seen part ye world. may infinitely good god grant may take sutable notis horrid deed, tearn wisdom corps removd barn ware washt laid side side. horrid spectakle many hundred persons came behold. till near night son jona conducted hous gave refreshment. coffins brot ye corps carried waggon deposited augusta meeting hous. hous capt purington behold dreadful scean indead. silf wife six childn dead corps. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
