title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 10-12, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 10 12, 1806 10 5 cloudy, raind aftern. husband attended sollom funeral james purington famely murdered. prayer made revd mr stone, discoarse delivd mr taylor prov 25 c 28 v, hath rule spirit like city broken walls. vast number people attended, performance stage erected meeting hs. houses near crouded, streat crouded ye tops buildings covered people. puringtons remains lodged porch ax raisor made use deprive famely silf life coffin. dear wife 6 childns remains laid ally boddy pews. sollam specttacle behold. may learn profitable lesson dreadful scein may pleas god rules sanctify affliction surviving retalives us funeral proseeded meeting hous, went kenebeck bridg turnd went hill south second street, turnd jail went ye grave yard. intered without [walls]. meeting hous attend funeral purington famely. 11 6 clear. mr purington, 2 daugts james p. took breakfast, james dind, james supt sleep mr ballard houghing corn. bakt wheat bn bread done matters. old mr babcock mrs wiman home. 12 7 clear. done hous work, got dinner mr parington, daught, james 3 aprisers. allmost rather quite giving time. recovered little requested go sons receivd pair sheets 2 2 shifts carried lay ye [dead]. son jonas. martha p. low. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, july 13 18, 1806 13 1 clear. home. mr balld cyrus meeting. son jona, luke barton le faett supt us. mr purington supt james sleep ephm leighton, wife another man woman calld mrs evans allso. revd mr stone descoarst aftrd, 2 kings viii c 13th v. foren mr purington james supt slept home, feel feeble. 14 2 clear. mr purington james took breakfast left bound bodinham. sally church came wash paid 3s, demand 2 6d. churnd shee went made chees, 3_ lb butter. home. sally ch washt 15 3 clear except shower towards night. done hous work gardin, went son jonas. find martha purington low situation. old mr clefford feel feeble put barril water plants. son jonas see m. purington find low. 16 4 clear. felt feeble hous work ironing. mrs wiman greens, meriah lettuce, lucy shaw spearment &c. ephm, h. s. m. mr ballard eat something. mrs clifford water, says martha much shee home. mr balld secure boards. 17 5 clear. workt gdn done hous work. mr ballard see boards fens corn field. home. 18 6 clear warm. done hous work, bakt bn flower bread. mr ballard boards hauld. mr soal brot [1] load jason pierces, dind mr heartwel butcherd lamb. home. dagt b., mrs cleark [paringt] source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

[calld mr stilson go see wife labour. shee safe deld midnight daughtr, first born. went old lady hamlin 2h 30m theops hamlins, slept till morn. mr stilsons. birth 3d.patty town came evng. 23 4 clear. took breakfast mr hamlins. calld see patient, find well could expected. conducted home shais, arivd 8h 30m. pally town went son jonas saw m. [puringtons] wounds dresst. sally farewel, mr mrss eadses fruit. ditoes mr hamlins son jonas. james p. cousin sleep prev. page july 19 23, 1806 next page home interests martha? martha's diary book film history archive browse search stories themes lens decoding transcribing diary online diary

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 24-29, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 24 29, 1806 24 5 clear. patty town washt mrss heartwel calld one run, gilbd allmost killd wife. went find one killd hurt thing spirit oftne ye case son jona, wife, mr pollard luke barton came got cherrys curents. patty went watch marta purington. gilbards hear quariling. 25 6 clear. patty finisht wash. felt feeble. old mr hamlin, wife mrs dilingham took tea mrs howards made mr fullers cherrys curenls. home, compy. old mrs hamlin gave cap. 26 7 clear warm. home. old lady dilingham 2 grand sons, epm leighton wife, amos partridg wife cherrys. patty town went son ephms. oliv fletcher shee took 1_ facktory filling yn carry dagt pollard. home, compy 27 1 clear part ye day, raind meeting. augustus ballard, wife 2nd daugt took tea. son daugt lambd hemon bur took tea sleep son l. son pollards, dolly unwell. home. mr parker performed. son lambd wife sleep 28 2 raind ys day. son lambd sleeps wife mended cloaths fixl bonet &c. hear yt martha better. home. son dagt lambd sleep 29 3 rainy. son dt lambd sett breakfast home. mrs wiman tea. hear m. purington near ye close life. home. childn left mrs wiman came aftn. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 30-Aug. 2, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 30 august 2, 1806 30 4 cloudy rain. martha purington expired 3h ys morn. unwel bake work. danl savage, wife, mrs swanton william mrss webber cherrys curents. gave 2s 3d. mrs savage brot [3-2/1]lb salmon. home. people fruit. 31 5 cloudy rain. felt unwel went son jonas see ye corps mata purington. patty town went helpt dagt sew. mr purington son took supper lodging patty slept chambr. son jonas. 1 6 clear part ye day. mr purington took breakfast. mr cleford, getchel, young man livs mr getchel, dind. dagt pollard patty jona b. junr dind also. attended ye funeral martha purington. mr merrit discoarsed job 1st c 20-21 verss, job arose rent mantle shaved head fell upon ground worshiped naked caim mothers womb naked shall return thither. lord gave lord hath taken away blessed name lord. attended funeral martha puringtn came end wounds father gave oh dreadful scien d]. 2 7 cloudy rain. patty town washing home feel feeble. allin lambd came ephm b.ye 3d sleep home. allin lambad came ephm sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 3-7, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 3 7, 1806 3 1 clear part ye day. mr ballard son cyrus meeting. son ephm conducted patty town son pollards. allin lambd, ephm wm ballard sleep felt unwel work home. revd mr stone discoarst colotions 3rd c 12 13 v. 4 2 clear. mr ballard went mr cumings mill bot 1 busl corn, 2/1 rie. began hill corn. allin lambd sett home. sally cleark rhoda pollard came aftern. felt feeble day. home. sally cleark rhoda p. came 5 3 clear. done hous work ye help rhoda. sally mending shirts. sommons left husband oficer know. shubald pitts plantive. could wish remembered kindness husband self shew former wife. o evngs walkt ye. howard farn know whether stump person god knows. home. husband sued j. heartwel. 6 4 clear ye ye day. taken bed stead cleand buggs. scalt room, put ye bed done matters. rhoda helpt [sally] mending cloaths. mr wiman took breakfast butchered lamb. son jona 2 quarters, wd 10 lb. home. sally rhoda work son jona went jail ys day. 7 5 clear warm. mr ballard went p. voces got lyning blue coat, sally turning wido butterfield dagt cleark took tea. sally rhoda went son jonas evng. home, compy. churnd [3] lb butter. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 8-13, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 8 13, 1806 8 6 clear part ye day. done hous work, washt &c. sally rhoda work mr ballards coat. feel falagued. mr ballard carried 7 quarts curents theops hamlins. home. 9 7 clear. home, hous wk, houghing [gardin] calld mr [wimans] see sally ballard fallen hurt neck. sent hannah hous cracker curents. shee revivd went [home], returnd home bakt brown bread curent tarts. son cyrus came home informd mrs cumings delivered daught yesterday. mr ballard ye settlement, bot 7 lb sugar, _ lb tea, _ gn spirit _ lb tea mr wimans see sally ballard fall hurt self much. cyrus came ys night. 10 1 clear. home. mr ballard son cyrus attended worship day. revd mr slone descoarst foren mathew 5 c 19 v, aftn fn provbs. son ephn, wife, jonas wife, hannah, sally, martha, ephn, saml, patty town, allin lambd took supr us. [allin] ephn sleep mr heartwel came [water] 9h ys evng. helpt light draw home. childn grand childn 11 2 clear. home. home. 12 3 clear. home. home. 13 4 cloudy. home. mr wiman carted hay ye garden barn. mr gilbd took tea us. gilbad hous put bed. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 14-21, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 14 21, 1806 14 5 cloudy. home, washing. mrs heartwel cutt herbs, catnip, mint, feverfew &c. home, workt gardin. 15 6 cloudy. mr ballard went son pollard, carried 4 lb wool combd box curents. mrs wiman hir marm ye name emry dind patty town took tea. done hous work gardin. mr gilbd brot cyruss waiskt home. churnd 3 lb butter. home. patty town took tea 16 7 clear. home. patty town dind shee mended pair hoes son cyrus. mrs heartwel cutt herbs. mr wiman helpt mr ballard cart hay. home. patty town left 17 1 clar. mr ballard cyrus [meeting]. home. revd mr stone descoarst foren fm psalm 84th [11th vs], aftern fm ye shower aftr meeting. home. 18 2 clear. home, washt part cloaths. home. 19 3 clear. washing workt gardin went mr gillbards. mr ballard taken note gave shubal pitts. mrs young sleeps gilbds. mrs young sleeps eat supper breakfast. 20 4 clear. home, workt gardin hous work. receivd letter ys day july 27 sister waters. home. 21 5 clear. son jonas tell swine field. done hous work gardin. cut apples &c. mr ballard work son jona. son jonas. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 22-27, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 22 27, 1806 22 6 raind till near noon. mr ballard went ye settlement. james purington jona ballard junr done hous work matters ye gardin. home. 23 7 clear except shower. home, done hous work, ironed cloaths &c. mr ballard went shaved. home. 24 1 clear part ye day. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr parker discoarst foren mark vi c 12 vers. gentleman whose name know performed aftern fm 1st corintns part ye th] carity sufereth long pt ye 8th, charity never faileth. home. cucumbers green corn. 25 2 clear, cool morn, warmer aftern. home, workt gardin hous work. feel wel could wish. mrs heartwel home. 26 3 clear. informd son lambard removes famely augusta day ye place went varsalboro. jona wilm ballard luke barton took breakfast workt [gad]. home. 27 4 cloudy foren. mr ballard went son lambds, carried currents squash. harvested string peas done various kinds work. mr ballard says soffia came [yester] day. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 28-Sep. 3, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 28 september 3, 1806 28 5 clear warmer. done hous work gardin. mr ballard poleing fence. son jonas help yr hoggs. home. 29 6 clear warm. done hous work, little mending went lecture son ephms. mr ballard bt pair shoes voses, price 7s=6d. son jonas wife 3 youngest childn returnd. lecture. text john 14c 6th vers. 30 7 clear. various kinds work ye hous gardin gathering sees &c. mr ballard fixing fence round field, went ye barber shaved &c. home. mrs heartwel brot tub home shee borrowd. 31 1 birth lues hamlins daugt. clear. calld 0h 30m ys morn lues hamlin go see wife labour. shee safe delivd 3h 45m daught, 3d dt 5th child. left inft well could expected reacht home 7. prepared breakfast hous work went meeting, communion. stranger performd foren luke 14 c 20th v, afn isaiah 33 chap 15 16th verses. polly town came eving. lues hamlins meeting. birth 4th. receivd 12s reward. son ephms evng intermition, saw jona wife lhey meeting afternoon. 1 2 clear. home. polly mends cloaths ys son lambds birthday. home. polly town sleeps 2 3 raind ye day. mr ballard went mr hamlins, bot 1 bushl corn, carried mr cumings mill. polly sewing home. jona ballard junr took breakfast home. dagt lambd berthday. 3 4 rainy day. home, brewed. polly town mending grand dadys cloaths. windy, blew apples much. home. polly town source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 10 14, 1806 10 4 clear cool. home, polly town till near noon. two men hamdin took breakfast wido savage dind, shee dagt pollard took tea. mr miller philbrooks paid mr ballard 4 dols 2s busines gentleman ye name devenport came information land, gave crown. home. mrs savage, dagt pollad, mr miller, philbrook mr devenport day. 11 5 clear. mrs savage day. happy circumstance mr ballard wenl see ye menuvers came home dusk, informd accident hapned. mercy indead. dind son lambards. son cyrus seen 50 [yrs] day. home. mr ballard ye review. mrs savage 12 6 clear foren, cloudy aftern. got part hopps ye past wind ingured &c. mrs savage left noon went son jon mr ballard giting wood &c. home. mrs savage went fm son jonas. 13 7 raind ys morn. home, got part beet carrot seed. mr ballard mr swantons business son jona. learn came home famely ys evng. home, various kinds service. 14 1 x. birth mr perkins son first born. xx. clear. calld 2h ys morn go see mrss perkins labour. shee safe delivd son, first born, 4h morn, returnd home 7h morn. left patienls cleverly. cyrus came went meeting. mr pratt performd ezekiel 7 chap ye last claws ye 10 vers, pride buded. son jona wife 3 childn, jasn pierce wife 1 child tea. cyrus sleeps h. pold, h. sally ballard allso. mr perkinss. birth 5th. recvd 9s/ rewd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 19-26, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 19 26, 1806 19 6 rainy day except minits 10h morn sun shone clear [minitus]. experienced heavy clap thunder, broak near mr wimans. mr ballards hors ye lane, thought shee struck shee home. 20 7 rainy part ye day, lightning struck tree little mr wimans. home. 21 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting. husband went funeral mr james springers wife aftern. son lambard came conducted mrs evins home. funeral james springers wife. 22 2 x. birth reubin branads [9th] child 3d dagt. xx. clear. calld 2hm go see ye wife rheubin branad. shee safe deld [6] 3d daught 9th child. left wel could expected reacht home noon. mr ballard gone varsalboro surveying. calld son jonas, wife [sic]. mr branards. birth 6th. receivd 9s reward. 23 3 clear. polly washt hous scourd. hous work. mr ballard returnd [varsalboro]. home. 24 4 clear part day. allin came conducted mrs evins barny home. mr ballard surveying stepn page. home, ironed cloaths. 25 5 clear. hous work went see le faett ballard unwell. son jonas. 26 6 clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus ye review. went aftern help mrs gillbard quill. harvisted beens. mr gillbards. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, september 27 october 4, 1806 27 7 raind part ye day. mr ballard cyrus ye settlement. done hous wk gardin matters. home. 28 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting. felt wel. mrs gilbard came fore n. mr prat discoarst ys forenn 2n timothy 3 c 16th, aftn john vic 68v. mr gill, wife polly town came meeting. mrs heartwel came fire. home. mr gill wife 29 2 clear. home, gatherd beens green peas &c. w. stones wife home. 30 3 clear part ye day. cuting apples day hous work. mr ballard brot home 5 lb roals ye meshien went ye coart hous. man hamdin evn business supt gave mr ballard 1 dollar service. home. 1 4 clear. mr ballard [g hous work cuting apples drie. home. 2 5 clear. went sister barton help quilt bed quilt. sister sally pierce dind mr ballard [coart]. son jonas. sist barton sleeps 3 6 clear. mr ballard coart. sister barton left walkt far bars returnd found daught pollard shee hoped seen aunt. shee dind went son jonas. got bed quilt detoes. dagt pollard dind 4 7 clear. home. mr ballard ye barbers. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 5-11, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 5 11, 1806 5 1 clear pleast. mr ballard son cyrus went meeting. calld see [mr] heartwels youngest [child] sick. revd mr stone discoarst 10c 37v foren aftern. mr heartwels see sick [child]. 6 2 clear pleast. mr ballard sumoned coart. mrs gilbard made visit, little girls took tea home. mrs gilbard see 7 3 clear pleast. mr ballard sumoned coart. done hous work, gathered ye last beens gardin, scolt pickeles &c. got apples mr ballard came fm coart went son lambds. sent qt plumbs. wel. dagt sent sugar. home. churnd 3 lb _ butter. 8 4 clear pleast. washt, cut apples &c. mr ballard coart. home. josh heaths child expired 9 5 clear pleast. done hous work cut apples drie. mrs farewel came tarries night. mr ballard coart. home. mrs farewel 10 6 clear. mr ballard coart. mrs farewel left dinner. two men hamden business mr ballard, sleep ye name snow. home cuting apples drie. joshua heaths oldest child interd, expired 8th inst. 11 7 clear, great frost ice tubs water back door. ye mr snows took breakfast sett home. bakt done matters. son jonas wife tea. home. mr ballard son pollads ye barbers. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Oct. 12-18, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, october 12 18, 1806 12 1 raind aftern. mr ballard cyrus meeting. mr stone discoarst foren mark x, 49; aftern fm romans xiii, 12v. silas wiman, james purington jona ballard junr took tea us. home. gathered green shell beens, dinner. 13 2 rainy day. done hous work, regulated chests drawers, cutt pumkin drie. mrs gilbard came took black cloak home. shee mended accepttance brot home. demand 1 s, gave 1-6. esqr tylor mr [hirick] business sertificates. gave mr ballard 9s service. home. esqr tulor mr [herric] hamden. 14 3 clear. hous work went son lambards order go see sister barton tomorrow. son lambards. 15 4 clear. old lady hamlin, dagt pollard jona ballard junr came son lambds. self dagt lambd took departure fm 10h morn, arived sisters 3 aft. find comfortable circumstances. ditoes, benn browns sister bartons. 16 5 clear. sett home, came son lambds. mrs hamlin jona went home. dagt pollard tarried night. feel much fatagued. ditoes. 17 6 clear. dagt pollard left son lambds. came home, find mrs farewel sister williams took dinner. son pollard came conducted wife home. seesed collic night. sister w. attended son lambds came home. sist williams 18 7 clear. sister willms left breakfast. sick. mrs farewel tarried work. mr ballard got box andersons pills. took 2 night. home, sick. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 2-8, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 2 8, 1806 2 1 x. birth mr bodwels son 12th child. xx. clear pleast. went meeting foren, calld directly ye service communion go see mrs badwil. son cyrus took jonas hors shais conducted patiend delivd 9h evn fine son, 12th child. tarrie night. revd mr stone discoarsed ephesians 2nt chap, 8th vers. meeting mr bodwels. birth 7th, receivd9/ reward. 3 2 clear. left mrs badwel infant cleverly returnd home. mr ballard cyrus town meeting. done hous work, feel fatagued. mr badwls son jonas. 4 3 clear. informd early morn mr james springer found lifeles mr pains orchard. mr ballard went ye jury. capt robinson foreman. son jonas wife, wm cornelus smith supt home. dagt balld evng. mrjames springer found dead ys morn. 5 4 clear. done hous work dug beets carrots. mrs heartwel calld foren, mrs wiman aftern. [thurnd] 2 lb butter. home, got beets carrots. 6 5 clear. mr ballard attended funeral mr james springer. mr car presideed, discoarsed amos 4th, 12th. funeral mr james springer. 7 6 cloudy rain. done washing, cut apples, cleand hogg pen, cleand sellar &c. home, done various kinds work. 8 7 rain. home. hannah pollard came son lambds. allin, wm swanton edwd savage conducted shee helpt work went son jonas sleep. bakt breud ys day. home, bakt breud. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, november 24 29, 1806 24 2 cloudy. mr ballard went son pollards see giting cloaths made. matters hous. home. 25 3 clear. done various kinds work. mr ballard son pollards carry cloaths made, mr bonds linings &c. wilm ballard sleeps home. mr soal brot us load wood. 26 4 cloudy chilly. got feuel, done hous work mending son cyrus &c. mr ballard son jonas part ye day. home. 27 5 saml 19 months, 8 days 3 hours old expired. clear beautiful weather. son cyrus came home, took breakfast. father went meeting, day thanksgiving. allin lambd came informd marm unwel wisht go see wilm ballard came safron, says saml sick. mr ballard dind son [lambds]. son lambards. daugt unwel. mr swanton wife supt spent ye evning. 28 6 clear. son lambds. daugt severe pain side limbs ys morn. luke barton came informd us saml ballard expired 5h ys morn. left son lbds came son jonas tarried till near sun sett. may god mercy sanctyfy chastisements ever lasting good. detoes son jonas. dear little sammuel expired 5h ys morn. hannah unwel. 29 7 death jason pierces son. cloudy rain. washt done hous work. son ephm cyrus came home. mr ballard went mr slones request attend funral son jonas [child] tomorrow. home. sons cyrus ephm source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 30-Dec. 3, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 30 december 3, 1806 30 1 rainy. mr ballard meeting. funeral saml ballard attended afternoon service. revd mr stone came made prayer think excilent. jason pierce son expire last night ys morn, aged 3 years. son jonas attend ye funeral ofhis son saml. 1 2 clear cold. w. stones wf brot 2 skeins hoes yn, 2 backbanded. done various kinds wk. mrs heartwel twice, informs saml cleark [youngest] child sick. mr ballard sett son pollards, met sally cleark cloaths returnd. shee went brors. home. jason pierce came home. mr balld workt son jona forenn. death emaly cleark, dagt saml cleark. 2 3 clear. mr ballard attended funeral child jason pierce. revd mr stone attended. corps brot son jonas interd child. mr walker hamden sleeps funeral jason pierces son isiah. 3 4 clear day, cloudy evng. mr walker took breakfast, hors kept mr ballard ye business came gave 2 dols made prest 20 cents. mr pumroy came ys morn, business done certificate. allin l. w. swanton dind. mrss gilbard, jona b. junr wilm supt. got ready attend funeral saml clearks child. husband complained unwel go. ye boys sleep home. funeral saml [clearks] child. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 4-10, 1806 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 4 10, 1806 4 5 hail snow. home, bakt brown bread mins pies, feel fatagued. jona b. junr wilm sleep supt allso. home. 5 6 clear pleast. sally cleark came finish mr ballards cloaths. shee jona sleep calld 10h evng mr nason go see wife labour. calld women midnight. mrs smith 2 childn son ephm supt mr nasons night. warin stone receivd mrs farewels cow last year. 6 7 x. birth abm nasons 4th daugt. xx. clear pleast. mrs nason safe delivd 3h 50m 4th daugt 6th child. left infant wel could expected reacht home 9. done work, washt little, mended hoes mr ballard, ironed &c. wilm sleeps mrs cleak went brothers. mrs gillbard made present oring, cakes chees, husband returnd boston yesterday. mr nasons. birth 11th. receivd 9/ reward. 7 1 clear. mr ballard went meeting aftern, unwel foren. cyrus cut us wood. sons jona, ephm lambd wives spent evning us. cyrus sleeps home. part childn 8 2 clear ye day. done hous work knit jona wilm sleep interment remains mr joshua davis sydna day. home. funeral joshua davis sydna. 9 3 clear part day. home, hous work, mended hoes began foot pair. jona wilm sleep home. 10 4 cloudy morn. mr ballard carried 1 busl corn mr cumingss. ye mill left snowd aftern. betsy andrus brot home shirt shee made son cyrus took make. informd henry pierce sick. home. betsy ands snowd aftern. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, december 19 24, 1806 19 6 foggy last night ys day. wilm cypher cut wood foren, finisht cuting ye door dinner left mr tarbil dind done hous work knit day ye anaversary marriage, 52 years since. o scins past sinc yt time. lay museing thereon slept little. home, anaversary marriage. 20 7 clear part day. knit bakt done matters. mr kidder hamden came business mr ballard 2h pm receivd 20 dollars. dind son jona took supper home. mr kidder business mr ballard. 21 1 clear pleast decemr. mr ballard cyrus meeting, self girls home. meriah heartwel brot llb _ meet home, 1 lb still due. revd mr stone discoarst foren fm numbers 23 c, 10 vers; aftern fm psalms 62nt, 8th vers. home. 22 2 clear till aftern, snowd evng. son lambard came go hous, conducted daugt lucy daugt wel shee cutt gound skirt part made ["ys night" implied]. son lambards. capt haman expired ys night. 23 3 cloudy. son l. went magr grants business, returnd evng. night, dagt finished cloaths. ditoes. 24 4 clear. left son lambds diner returned home. allin magr grands conducted home. [diloes] came home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 5-11, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 5 11, 1807 5 3 clear till 2 pm cloudy. ill uncommon pain right side. mr ballard judg [norths] busines. alone, bring chips keep fire. mrs nason calld get dock root ye itch. home, unwel day night. 6 4 clear till 1h pm cloudy. still visited pain right side, taken senna feel little easier. began rain 9h evn, raind night. home, unwel day. son jona see mr soal [brot] twitch wood. 7 5 rainy day night. hannah ballard dolly lambard came morn, tarried day night. william sleeps windy night. home, unwel. hannah dolly 8 6 clear part ys day, shours. mrs parker calld betsy andrus came, spent aftern; cookt food made bed. feel little easier wish bless god. home, feel easier. hannah dolly went away forenn. 9 7 clear part ys day. done hous work feel unfit. home. 10 1 clear part ye day. mr ballard son cyrus meeting, sacrament administred. mrs gilbard came foren tarried till near night. sons jona ephm wife came see us. home. son ephm wife funeral capt john gage ys day. 11 2 clear part ys day. done washing. mr ballard cyrus town meeting. old mrs parker seeds. mrs wiman, smith rachel tea. mrs w. finisht washing. home, compy. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 17-23, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 17 23, 1807 17 1 clear. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarst psalms 73c 25 vers. son lambd meeting foren, wife went son jonas. came noon, brot lucy left took wife babe went son pollards. came home cookt pork greens. sally, martha lucy came home took tea. son jonas, son dagt lambds, son pollards. mr ballard 82 years old ys day. 18 2 raind cold. mr soal parker sett 80 apple trees field east ys hous. done hous wk mended stockins, little ye gardin. mr ballard rakt wheat rocks. mr hearlwel movd famely ys evng. home. apple trees sett ye nusery 19 3 rainy part ye day. mrs farewel came forenn, sleeps home, knit home, mrs farewel sleeps 20 4 clear cool. mrs farewel left breakfast, shee hannah ballard went hous, found 3 men viz daniel woodward, wm stone son georg rheeds, takeing boards barn. home, knit tending leatch boiling soap. ephm wm sleep home. mrs farewel left 21 5 clear part ye day. home, workt soap. went see babe. home, jonas. 22 6 raind. home, knit mrs wiman betsy roots. cyrus came [mr] cumings dismist. home. 23 7 clear part day. home. leut john shaw expired. home. death leut john shaw. funeral revd mrstones inft. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 18 23, 1807 18 5 clear day. mr ballard workt rode. felt unwel done hous work. mrs parker came warmd water soak feet seemd giv relief. feel greatful favour. home. 19 6 clear. home, feel unwel. mrs smith parker calld bakt done hous work. home. mrs smith parker 20 7 clear except light shower 3h pm. done hous work washt, sett 22 cabbage plants. mr parker calld mr ballard surveying piece land north son jona setting mr haws. home. mr ballad surveying. 21 1 clear cool. home. mr ballard meeting, revd mr stone discoart fm luke 10 c 41 42 [v]. mrs farewel came dind, son cyrus allso. returned watervil. son jona calld home. [mrs farewel son cyrus dind 22 2 clear except light shower. unwel. mrs gill dagt ballard came aftern, [took tea.[mrs g] sleeps. home unwel. dagt bald mrs gill 23 3 clear. feel comfortable wish bless great author mercies. mrs gill kind asist ys morn left breakfast go sidney. made 4 coats fm old cotton shifts workt gardin. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 24 30, 1807 24 4 clear part ye day. workt gardin, hauled wollin raggs, cut flock carpet filling. mr ballard settlement. rachel smith paid 1 dollar part due asisting child [bed]. home. rachel smith paid 6/.] 25 5 raind. sett cabage plants, squash cucumbers. mrs nason turnip cabbag plants. wed 2 beds gardin, kild many worms. mr ballard sett cabbage plants east 26 6 clear. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 1-6, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 1 6, 1807 1 4 clear. workt gardin, killd great many worms buggs. dagt ballard mrs gill, sally martha tea. home. dagt ballard mrs gill 2 5 clear part ye day. done larg washing washt buttery kitchen floors. home, washt. 3 6 clear part ye day. workt gardin, planted transplanted cucumbers; done ironing cutt grass. mr ballard settlement, bot 4 oz snuff. feel falagued. home. 4 7 clear part day. mr ballard meeting hous hear oration deliverd revd mr cushman. mowd grass round hous knife sowd carrot seed. hannah sally pollard sally bald sleep wm cypher came water. raind go went hous could persuad cum went bed little mid night, husband rose [sic] endevour get could came afterwards slept thee floor. home, sowd carrots. 5 1 clear cool. mr ballard self attended worship. son lambard sent son allin shais conducted fathers. wrode hors back. revd mr stone discoarsd malhew x c, 32 33 v. wife, esqr brooks wife admited church. w partook communion sacrament. meeting, son lamds ephms. 6 2 clear cool. mrs gill mended cloaths uncle. jonas wife tea. done hous work, swept seller gardin. mrs smith plants. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 7-12, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 7 12, 1807 7 3 clear warmer. mrs gill mending cloaths husband self. done hous work. mrs heath hannah bald dind. sally, martha loisa gilbard eat mr ballard, mrs [gil] self took tea son jonas. john town, allin barny lambard supt sleep john informs mr freeman dead remains interd. home. john [town] allin barny sleep 8 4 clear. done hous work cut puld grass, houghd [red] corn, wed oinions sett plants. felt feeble day fatagued night. home. 9 5 clear. done hous wk houghd cucumbers, potatoes, puld weads gardin. john town calld ys morn. mr ballard ye settlement, brot home _ gn spirit, _ lb tea, 2 lb sugar. home. aneversary ye purington scein. 10 6 clear. home, hous wk workt gardin, cutt grass &c. ebenz farewel esqr varsalboro expired ys morn. home. death esqr farewel. 11 7 clear. cutt grass knife, sett plants done hous work. mr ballard sons lambds ephms, carried currents. informs sally farewel wen cutt neck yesterday. son cyrus came home. home. 12 1 foggy morn, clear afterwards. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarst hebrews 4 c 1st 2 verses. remains ebenz farewel interd day. ebenz moore junr supt us. home. funeral esqr farewel. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 13-18, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 13 18, 1807 13 2 x. birth john wals 2nd dagt. xx. clear. calld john wall 6h ys morn go see wife labour. shee safe delivd 8h morn 2nd daugt 2nd child. left cleverly arivd home 12 o clock [percisly]. got dinner matters. daugts ballard pollard took tea, sally, martha ephm allso. mr john wals. birth 11th. receivd 9/ reward. 14 3 clear. mr ballard cyrus went hear prayers raising meeting hous. came home took breakfast went see ye raising. matters gardin &c. home. mr bald cyrus raising meeting hous. 15 4 clear except light shower. done hous work gardin. mr ballard cyrus raising. mrs parker took tea [home]. mr bald cyrus raising meeting hous. 16 5 clear. home. mr ballard cyrus raising. home. 17 6 clear ye day. cutt grass tansy. mr ballard cyrus raising. home. 18 7 clear except light shower. mr ballard cyrus raising. brewd done wk tho felt feeble. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 19-23, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 19 23, 1807 19 1 fine rain ought thankful. mr ballard cyrus meeting. daugts ballard lambd, allin, ephm, sally, martha, laiza gillbard aftern. feeble. home, childn 20 2 clear part day. mr ballard parish meeting. dagt l scolt bead stead ye bedroom, made beds swept hous went son jonas conducted home. mrss kiddar thwing 3 mrs t. childn. workt gardin home. dagt lambd left mrs kidder thwing 21 3 clear warm ye day. bakt. dolly lambd came ys morn, shee helpt pick wool. allin came got cherries currents son ephm. betsy wiman got cherries curents. home. dolly lamd 22 4 clear warm. felt feeble done hous work wed gardin &c. mrs wiman 5 pecks ashes. shee came got curents tansey. dagt bald, mrs pratt saunders allin barney brot 6_ yds callico 2/3d chang 2 dols daught purchase home. mrs parker vinegar. compy. 23 5 clear. began washing done hous work &c. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 24-29, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 24 29, 1807 24 6 clear except showers. persued washing feel unable. mr parker wife home, dolly lambd 25 7 clear warm. finisht wash done matters feel allmost cum. dolly sally left breakfast. cyrus gone settlement. roasted pound coffee brot home, company 26 1 clear. sons jona, ephm lheir wives yr childn mr ballard cyrus went meeting. calld mr mc farlin go see sister bates unwel hous. mr [mcfarlns] see mrs bates, receivd 1/6. 27 2 clear warm. slipt ye east door, left [side] fel ye sill ye doore hurt much scolt bead stead mopt floor. home. mrs babcock asa pierces wife 28 3 cloudy raind aftern. son jonas wife came took care work. sister barton mrs gill came foren. dagt ballard went home dinner, ye others sleep mr sister made prest chees butter. home, great distress ys morn. jonas wife came nurst 29 4 clear. mr hamlin, wife, josh burtun 2 mrs dellinghams fruit. made prests crackers, sugar, ginger. home, [distrest] night company. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 30-Aug. 3, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 30 august 3, 1807 30 5 clear. dagt ballard jason pierces wife sister barton left mrs gill went son jonas aftern. lucy smith came sleeps son cyrus sett watervil tend capt pullins mill home, feel easier. sister b left 31 6 clear. lucy left breakfast. sally cypher came larg wash scoured puter. mrs smith tibbets came curents. mr robd fletcher, son jona wives mrs gill came see us, tarrie tea. home, company. distrest night. 1 7 clear. home. mr ballard pain back keeps hous. sally finisht scouring, washt floors, ironing &c. demand 4/, paid 3/. shee went home. jona wilm sleep home. sally went home. 2 1 clear. mr ballard pain back din attend public worship. sons jona lambd yr wives came see us aftern, tarry tea. joanna lucy smith home, childn 3 2 cloudy. feel feeble, husband complains allso. seem feeble couple. may lhe great parent support us lhro life may conformd desire undeserving hand maid. great distress side night got resl. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 4-8, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 4 8, 1807 4 3 rainy day. done hous work, hauld raggs cutt flocks. hannah currents. mr ballard sons, got pint _ spirril. home. 5 4 clear. gatherd currents preserve. mr ballard went son jonas git men haul us load wood. allin currents carrie marm. home, allin dind 6 5 clear. old lady shaw dind 2 qts currents carrie home. mrs wiman took tea got carrie home stript put sugar 11 qts currents day. home. mrs shaw made visit. mrs wiman gatherd ripe peas. 7 6 clear sun rose soon shut cloudy ye day. mr ballard went son lambds ephms, carried curenl bushes. roasted piece lamb, pees cucumbers. mrs smith, betsy wiman cousin took tea, mrs smiths daugt allso. home, company. 8 7 clear part ye day. mr ballard went meddow. mrs bennet cleark currents. mrs c brol l lb 10 oz chees. mrs b 4 qts. [took roals spin 1-2/1 lb] brewd matters. home, company. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 21-26, 1807 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 21 26, 1807 21 6 rainy day. finisht washing felt unwel. gatherd string beens towards night. lucy shaw informs mrs getchels child sick, mother came hous saml parker yesterday. home. 22 7 rainy. work went see mrs getchels child sick. went shoes water git hous mr parker shee resides. saml parkers see mrss getchels child. 23 1 rainy day. mr ballard worship aftern. revd mr parker performd, discoarst jude 7th c. daugt ballard informs mrs gitchels child better. home. mr balld [meeting]. 24 2 clear cooler windy. mr ballard surveying john davis esqr luis hamlin, came home 9h evng. gathered last currents, sheld mustard, ironed &c. home. gathered last currints. mr ballard surveying. 25 3 clear. dagt ballard, martha james husband survey lewes hamlin, farm isaac hardin formerly lived. done hous work wed gardin. home. dagt ballard childn took tea. 26 4 clear. wheat finisht reaping got ye barn; part hay n ye gardin. done various kinds work. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 12-20, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 12 20, 1808 12 3 snowd last night ys morn, cloudy moderate. kniting. home. 13 4 clear pleast. willm cypher hauld wood, 3 load us ye eastwd ye hous. removd banking knit home. 14 5 clear. workt door yard knit finisht stockin began another. home. 15 6 clear. workt gardin, sett cabbage stumps turnips knit cyrus mr cumingss, brot us _ lb indien meal, rie wheat. bakt flower bread. mr ballard fencing ye gardin. home. sett cabage stumps turnips. mr lambd came home 9h evng. [16] 7 raind thro ye day, faster evng. dagt ballard tea. mr l ye settlement, cyrus allso; brot us home 6 lb pork. men removed ye hen hous sett necessary. allin erected place hens lay home. son jonas wife 17 1 rainy. mr ballard son cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarst forenn fm hebrews 2 c 3v, aflern fm 139 [plalm] 7th v, whither shall go &c. home. mr ballard cyrus meeting, allin barny allso. 18 2 raind part day. sick. mrs farewel son jonas wife home, sick. 19 3 cloudy. still remain ill. mrs farewel left home. pain abated. home, ill yet. 20 4 clear pleast. much better done work. hope shall true sence gods goodness. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 21-26, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 21 26, 1808 21 5 clear foren part ye aflern. well hous work knit daugt lambd childn son jonas, wife james unwell. hannah sally harriet little night. home, sett ye day. 22 6 clear. bakt pumkin pies, done door yard. son lambards cow calvd morn. daught went barn milking time, grant astistance. son jonas daugts mr lambds went got aulderbuds. home, felt comfortable, bakt pies. 23 7 clear cool. bakt bn bread. brewd, pild wood, removd door dirt hous work. daugt ballard lambd, marta lucy went son ephms aftn. allin hallowell, son cyrus mr cumings mill tend home. feel fatauged ys night blessed god giving strength. 24 1 clear cool. mr ballard cyrus meeting. home. daugt lambds son pollards. mr l luke came home evng. home. [revd mr] stone discoarst fm geneses 45, 3 v. 25 2 cloudy little rain. home, hous work. workt door yd knit mr ballard parrish meeting. cyrus helping son jona plough. hannah, martha james home. hear capt stackpols wife expired ys morn 2 o clock. 26 3 rainy. workt door yd knit washt room, stairs entry &c. mr ballard capt osgoods. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 27-May 1, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 27 may 1, 1808 27 4 clear. mr ballard sett capt osgoods yesterday returnd. went ys day, gone night. washt room ys day yesterday. home. funeral mrs stackpole. 28 5 clear. removd current bushes, cleard ye door yd, knit &c. old mrs kenny dind cyrus son pollards, dagt sent us beef. mr ballard returnd fm capt osgoods. home, mrs kenny 29 6 clear pleasant. went lecture, calld mr thwings, slept son ephms. sopha meeting. meeting since sabbath thanksgiving till mr thwings lecture son ephms. 30 7 clear pleasant. son ephms till dinner mrs hannah crage came conducted fathers shais spent ye aftern agreeably. mrss burtun thwing walkt sons, slept son ephms mr crages. 1 1 clear pleast. came fm sons meeting, mr ballard dind mr thwings. returnd home meeting, find son lambard sick. son jona wife sent allin docter tole gatherer would let cross ye bridg, [returnd] without put blister arm feverfue temples. sons [meeting], communion day. mr thwings, dind source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 2-10, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 2 10, 1808 2 2 clear pleast. mr ballard cyrus town meeting. son lambd comfortable able attend ye meeting. mr amos partridg bot 4 balm giliad trees, giv 6s home, workt gardin mr partridg trees. 3 3 clear warm ye season. removd current bushes done matters gardin. home. 4 4 clear warm. workt gardin knit, finisht stockins lucys. dagt ballard sent rice, milk veal, 5 lb. home. 5 5 clear pleast. workt gardin. mr ballard dind son jonas, beautiful rice puding calvs head harslett. sett current bushes came home. son jonas. mrs gilbd 6 6 raind, wind easterly. hauld linning raggs prest dish cloaths &c. home, rainy day. 7 7 rainy day, w n. mended pair trousers cyrus &c. home. 8 1 raind snowd. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr slone discoarst fm ecleasties 12c 1st vers. took dinner son jonas, son lambd wife 2 childn, son ephm allso. son jonas, lefaett james unwell. 9 2 cloudy cold. hannah ballard double twist yarn, father remains unwel. home. 10 3 clear, ye moon totally eclipsed. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 11-17, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 11 17, 1808 11 4 clear. pain stomack. trouble see ways know endure god able giv strength forlitude. home, unwel. 12 5 rainy day. unwel sett little. husband wel could wish, threats ye cramp. home, unwel. 13 6 cloudy. mr ballard fixing beds ye gardin. done hous work, gatherd greens knit lukes sock. home. 14 7 cloudy day, raind hard night. done hous work knit daugt lambd brot spirit milk, jonas wife sent us milk allso. home. cyrus came evng. 15 1 cloudy rain. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr slone discoarst fm ephesions vi c 4th v. son daugt ballard, sons, jona, epm, wilm, jamess sally martha mrs gillbard supt home. son jona part famely 16 2 raind part ye day, sun shone till noon. mr ballard sett son ephms wives share hond fathers farm disceast. sally farewel sophia came tarrie night. son epm dind took tea us. home, hous work knit finisht lukes socks. 17 3 clear, ground frose depth ys morn. brewd, sowd parsley sett sage roots. daugt lambard sally farewel went wido hous father left. went son jonas dinner. home. [husbad] seen 83 years day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 18-25, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 18 25, 1808 [18] 4 clear, washt cloaths floar, sowd sage pepper grass. sowd string peas. mr ballard helping ploughing. home, washt &c. 19 5 clear. sorting beens day. ebenz hoveys wife friend david foster allso. home. mrs hovey herbs. 20 6 clear. planted cucumbers, w. squash, sowd sugar string peas oinions. mr stedman wife calld melolott. daught ballard mrs gillbart tea. luke sawd limbs balm giliad trees cutt one home. mr stedman daugt ballard mrs gilbart 21 7 clear. planted beens, bush squash, sowd f. turnips, sowd peas done matters hous. daught lambard son jonas. home. son cyrus came home evng. 22 1 rainy day. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr parker performd. discoarst fm mark 2nt c 27 28 verses isaiah 43d 25. home. 23 2 rainy foren. home. done work gardin, finisht sorting beens. luke returnd mothers. home. 24 3 clear pleast. home, little aboud gardin matters. daugt lambd washt brewd. men planted corn, beens pumkins. daugt ballard aftern. mr ballard planted [bonnebis] beens. home. dagt ballard part childn. 25 4 raind mr ballard, lambd, cypher soal finisht ploughing new ground corn field. sorted [bonnybiss] beens, 2 qts fit [planting]. home, election day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 20-25, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 20 25, 1808 20 2 clear cool, frost ys morn. bakt pumkin pies. daughts ballard, lambd self went see mrs wiman. mr ballard tea. mr wimans. 21 3 clear. workt hard gardin, houghd corn, cucumbers, wed part oinions. mr austin brot us 6 lb wool use six sheep took us jany 7th one year. daugt ballard sent 1 lb butter. ephms wife sent 10 lb rice. son pollard tea, famely well. home. mr austin brot us 6 lb wool. son pollard [hasil] petingl] 22 4 clear till near night. done hous wk wed gardin. mr ballard, lambard, [rhines] luke houghing corn. dagt lamd dolly strikeing harnes. home, workt gardin. 23 5 clear warm till near night sea turn came done hous wk, wed 1 bed ye gardin. daugts ballards, mrs gill, hannah sally pollard tea.. ye 2 latter sleep sopha, wm, martha james home. childn grand childn dagt lamb finisht hernes. 24 6 raind ye ye day. home, transplanted 13 cucumber plants. hannah sally pold, hanh martha ballad ephm 3d, carroline gill took tea home, [mended] mrs brown short goun skirt, sett cucumbrs. 25 7 clear. rose early, searcht plants, killd many bugs. larg wash, washt room [dugt] lambd left home ye 11th hour son pollards. sally [wit dolly helping home. dagt lambd son pollards. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 26-Jul. 1, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 26 july 1, 1808 26 1 clear wrm. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarst foren fm isiaah 57 c 21st vers, romans hebrw [6th] c 16 c 17 verse 17th vers. son lambd son pollards wife. sally p tarried dolly, hannah p, hh, s, m ballard. harriet caroline gill jona took tea us. home. henry seen 18 [mon ys day. marm came home. 27 2 clear warm. men finisht fencing ye field houghing. mr lambd luke sett capt ballards 6h pm. mended 3 pr trousers mr ballard houghd gardn. home. 28 3 clear foren, cloudy aftn, raind night. home, wed part ye oinion bed, ironing &c, felt feeble. home, ironed. 29 4 cloudy morn, clear aftern. houghd purple corn, hous wk. mr ballard went hallowell, brot home 6 mackeril, _ lb snuf, _ lb shusn tea, 2 lb sugar. dagt lambd went son jonas, mr ballard took tea allso. son jonas. shee gave 2_ lb chees. mrs gill sleeps 30 5 clear. mrs wiman git jacoat cut daugt lambd. mrs gill went son jonas. workt gardin, sett [35] plants done matters. jonas boys took plants sett ye barn. mr ballard ye settlement, 1 gln molases, 2 qts spirit, 1 bushl corn mr dickman tobacko. home. mrs wiman feel falagued. 1 6 clear part ye day, high wind rain night. mr ballard lecture son ephms. mr stones text 1st timothy 1st c 15 [v]. sister moore son ["sleep implied]. lecture son ephms. elijah wife sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 2-7, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 2 7, 1808 2 7 cloudy. sett son ephms little sun rise, find sister moore, watervil, son elijah wife fm portland took breakfast sett home 8h morn. brewd bakt workt gardin. mr ballard ye field. son ephms. came early morn. mrs waitt [look] harriet fm jonas. 3 1 clear. mr ballard, self cyrus meeting, communion. revd mr stone discoarst foren fm 1st corinthng 11 c 26 vers, aftern hebrews 12th c 25 vers. rhoda sally pollard, h, s m ballard took tea son ephm allso. son jona, wife mrs gill calld meeting son ephms. seen 12 grand childn ys day. 4 2 rainy part day. transplanted young sage root, 200 sett cabbage plants &c. mr ballard mr hamlins see ye select gentlemen, jedy prebbles taxes abaled receivd order p. t. voce 2d 92 cents. home. 5 3 clear warm. done fort nits wash. dagt lambd washt went son jonas. crying murder brookses. mr ballard allin houghing corn. home. 6 4 clear warm. mr ballard allin houghing corn. done ye hous work. dagt lambd puting web loome. dolly bary lucy school. home. mrs kenny 7 5 clear. done ironing wk gardin. mr ballard allin houghing corn. sister barton came shee mrs gill sleep son jonas wife evng. dagt lambd ironed wove 4 yards. home. sister barton mrs gill sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 8-15, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 8 15, 1808 8 6 clear. sister barton, mr ballard self dagt lambd dind son jonas. sister took tea sist sett son pollards acompanied daugt hannah. gidion barton sleeps son jonas sist barton. 9 7 raind ye day. done cooking matters. gidion went sons breakfast. home. 10 1 clear part ye day, raind evng. son jonas wife mrs gill calld mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr cushman performd, text foren mat 12 c last vers, aftern prov 22nt 9th vers. home, feel [bet feeble. son jona sent us chees, [bu fish. 11 2 raind ye day. sett plants, houghd squash cucumbers. son jona sent us 5 [lb] lamb. lost good hors yesterday woond, warrin stone cow; one home, mended hoes sett plants. 12 3 clear, part ye day showers. mr ballard houghing ye field. took bed stead scolt sealing; washt ye floor. informd yt man stranger drowned hallowell ys day. gidion barton james purington home, scolt bed stead washt rooms. 13 4 clear warm. washt cutt herbs drie. feel sick night. home. 14 5 clear. sick sett little ys day. betsy andrus web warpt. home. 15 6 clear hott. houghd gardin sett cabbage plants. mrs smith warp web. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 16-22, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 16 22, 1808 16 7 clear hott. houghd part purple corn cabbages. mr nathl saml cumings wives calld daugt pollard sons saml sleeps shee thoms son jonas, wife unwel. dagt lambd see mr lambd barl flour brot home. mended pair cottne hoes mr ballard. home. 2 mrs cumingss dagt pollard gave us 4_ lb pork. 17 1 clear except shower noon. mr ballard son cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarst fm matthu 6th c 33 vers. daugts pollard, ballard mrs gill childn others together fameties amount [25]. home. dagt pollard set home 6h pm. 18 2 clear windy, thee air much cooler. done washing feeble oblidged lay number times. home, washt. 19 3 clear cool. felt feeble. mr ballard houghing corn. daugt lambd put web loome. rhoda dolly pollard sleep home. rhoda dolly pollard sleep 20 4 clear warm. dagt ballard mrs trask, mrs gordin, swanton nancy wm stones wife, h, s m bld ys day, mrs parker allso. unwel. mr ballard hallowell hear oration ye free masons, perfm mr pierley. home, unwell. mr balld brot pint cherry. 21 5 clear warm. finisht houghing corn ye gardin. widdo savage came see us. shee charls swanton dind shee went son jonas. son jonas. 22 6 allin [lambd 18 years old ys day]. clear warm foren. mr savage went mr andruss aflern. cloud arose. sett got mr wimans heavy shours. ceast raining reacht home candle light. [shubal] thos hinkleys wivs mr ands. mr andruses mr wimans. mr ands easier. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 23-29, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 23 29, 1808 23 7 clear part ys day. mrs savage left dinner. mr balld capt osgoods, brot home 5 lb pork, _gn cherry _ lb snuff. knit mended shirt houghd beens, cabbages &c south side ye gardin. [home]. mrs savage went home. letter fm bror elisah. 24 1 cloudy part ye day. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarst fm 2nt peter chap 3d vers 9th. string peas beens supper. home. receivd letter 9th [inst fm elisa] yeslerday. 25 2 clear warm. pickt wool. dagt lambd washing. old mrs kenny currents. mrs wiman took tea us. home. 26 3 cloudy morn. mr ballard went help cyrus pick mill brot home entry]. son lambd sett bellfast. picking wool. son jonas dagts jason pierces dolly l went mr wimans wh lhem. home. mr bald help cyrus. 27 4 clear warm. old lady gill charls dind took tea dagt ballard, sally, mata, wm james mr ballard helpt jona hay. shower 10h evng. home, old lady gill 28 5 clear warm. bakt brown bread, puding brued. mr balld workt son jona foren. betsy wiman took tea us. home, bakt brued. 29 6 x. birth son ephms 3d dagt. xx. clear. calld 3h m son ephms, wife labour. son jonas wife went dagt deld 7h 30m 3d dagt. case alarming shee revivd seems comfortable. dagt b went esq titcombs ephms wife fainting fit. old lady hamlin attended day son ephms]. birth 1st. receivd 18 s reward. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

[detoes]. 31 1 clear. son ephms, dagt wel could expected. ditoes.. 1 2 clear. son ephms. sally cumings washt, shee complains pain head. ditoes. 2 3 clear. sons, sally c able much work. daugt unwel night. slept little. ditoes. 3 4 clear. sally farewel conducted home dagt lambd went son ephms wife seems comfortable. mrs gill sleeps ditoes. 4 5 clear warm except lite shower near night. gathered beens pees, sent son ephms, wife cleverly. mr ballard hallooell surveying. saml gill came came [sic] sister. home. old mrs parker 5 6 raind. mr ballard went settlement, bot 2 lb sugar, _ tea 1 butter, _gn spirrit, _ bsl corn. spent ye day fixing herbs drie make ointment mrs brooks john browns wife home. mrs brooks brown allin sett bath. 6 7 clear. done hous work got herbs parsnip seeds. son jonas wife tea. bakt brown bread &c. home. daught pollard 39 years old ys day. 7 1 clear. dagt lambd went meeting. got ready go aftn [news] came mr andrus dead. mr [lambard] went returnd. went, prayer deld revd mr stone, discoarst entry]. mrs andrus, husband expird [sudingly] source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 22-29, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 22 29, 1808 22 2 clear. sister barton went son ephms, calld old mr hamlins, shee home. tarried sons. son ephms, slept funeral mr robinsn. 23 3 clear. sister lefe son ephms 10h morn. calld mr carters proseeded capt shubal pittss. dind took tea. went stores pins found none. sett home, walk far rewel williamss met barny hors wrode home. son ephms, mr carters capt shubal pittss. 24 4 clear. home hous work gathering parsnip seed. home. 25 5 clear warm. done hous wk mend shirt son cyrus. son jonas wife took tea. informd child mr hussey died woond receivd ye bowels accident; bror struck ax bowels entrails fell home, jonas wife 26 6 cloudy foren, shower 1h pm. wed oinions removd parsley roots, felt wel. home, bakt. 27 7 clear. washt washt floor. sister barton, mrss crage 3 childn took tea mr sister sleeps son jonas wife martha allso. home, mrs crage 28 1 clear part ye day, showers. luke barton conducted mother uncles flints. sons lambd ephm, wives jonas wife son pollards. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discoarst foren fm psalm 37th 5th vers, aftern fm prov 19c 27th vers. home. sister barton left dolly lambd son pollard. 29 2 clear warm. finisht galhering pees gardin done hous work. dagt lambard washt went son jonas. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 30-Sep. 3, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 30 september 3, 1808 30 3 clear. finisht harvesting peas field done ye hous work. dagt lambd weaving. informd capt toby woonded badly bull. home. capt toby much hurt bull ys day. 31 4 clear. morning work sett wool git spun. saml braleys, isaace savages asa masons. mrs savage took spin 3 pounds roals. took dinner son jonas. daugt lambd got web out,30 yds. saml braleys, isaac savages asa masons.son towns youngest child named [salem] expired. 1 5 x. birth joel savages 2nt daugt. xx. calld joel savage mid night go see wife labour. found ill. went onto bed rested sleep. raind day break. illness came women calld shee safe deld daught 3d child 6h 30m ys morn comfortable. good breakfast receivd 9s reward. sett home, reacht 10. informd son towns youngest child dead. joel savages. birth 2nd, receivd 9 s reward. 2 6 clear. finisht wash feel feeble. gathered mustard, cut purple corn stalks &c. son jonas wife tea dagt lambard. mr ballard lecture. revd mr stone discoarst fm 2nd corint ix c 15th vers. home. mr ballard lecture. funeral son towns son [salem]. 3 7 clear. calld son ephm go see infant found sick. high feaver much oprest breath. gave little caster oil seemd easier. sett till near 4h morn put bed mother slept little. mr son calld thought expireing revived little. sent son jonas wife, shee came. son ephms, infant sick. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 4-9, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 4 9, 1808 4 1 son ephms 3d daugt expired, aged 5 weaks, 2 days 12 hours. clear. sons, child better. dagt ballard came assisted takeing care doct cony calld, left sinna elixir salutus past reach medisin. continued till 7h 30m evng gave ye ghost. mr howard tarried night. ditoes. babe expired 7h 30m evng. mrs hamlin titcomb laid 5 2 clear. son ephms, neighbours granted assistance makeing preperation interment. slept chamber alone ye corps lay. ditoes, dagt ballard went home. 6 3 clear part ye day. remains ye deceased infant intered 4 pm. revd mr stone made able prayer ye ocation. mr isaac farewel lady ye funeral. shower thunder returnd ye grave. mr ballard tarried night. ditoes. funeral child attended. 7 4 clear. left sons 2h pm, conducted home mrs sally farewel shais. sopha came [us]. gathered cucumbers, [mustard], safron, merigoulds came home. detoes returnd home. 8 5 clear. scolt pickeles put dye purple corn stalks makeing various kinds wk. home. 9 6 clear. brewd, gathered mustard done many kinds work. jona stephen porter took tea. mr ballard mill son jona went capt youngs hors shod. home. informd mr dellinghams youngest child expird] ys day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 10-17, 1808 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 10 17, 1808 10 7 clear. felt feeble bakt done matters. mr ballard capt ozgoods hallowell. cyrus came home. 11 1 clear. mr ballard, self cyrus meeting. revd mr parker discoarsts fm st john 6 ch 68:69th verss. son ephms intermition, attended prayer hous mr dillingham whose infant child interd divine service son jona wife meeting. meeting. son cyrus seene 52 years ys day. funeral mr dillinghams infant. 12 2 clear. put coat corn stalk die, scolt pickeles done matters. dagt lambard went son pollards. pray god may forgiv every misstep shee taken towards thro whole life enable walk wisdoms waye future. home. daugt lambd son pollards. 13 3 clear, sutherly wind. washt, feel much fatagued, allmost sick. mr ballard cuting stalks. beniamin pains hors killd mrs andruss mr wimans going stump pain badly hurt. home. mr [lambd] trooping. pains hors killd, much hurt 14 4 clear. washt goun self done ironing &c. home, hear mrss lithgo sick. 15 5 clear. home, done various sorts work. mr ballard settlemt. home. 16 6 clear. old mr lambard, luke shaw sister eunis ys day. old gentleman sleeps dagt lambd hallowell. home. compy fm bath 17 7 raind part day. mr lambd son jonas wife martha dind washt ironed. home. son jonas wife source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 9-18, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 9 18, 1809 9 2 clear cold. mr ballard cutt wood, 20 loggs &c. cyrus sett mr beens tend mill. polly conducted son jonas spend evng. finisht kniting mr ballard pair mitts done matters. home]. polly went son jonas evng. 10 3 snowd. done hous work ript [old] garments, cut ye fragments flocke coverlid filling. jona junr young littlefield sleep home. 11 4 clear part ye day. polly town returnd son jonas, mending shirts mr ballard. washt ript garments, bakt flower bread &c. home. polly came fm son jonas. 12 5 clear part day cold. polly washt &c. home. 13 6 clear cold. home. home. 14 7 clear cold. polly left dinner go gardiner. doubled hoes yarn done things. mr ballard brot _ lb tea, 2 sugar, pint brandy, 2 qts w e rhum yesterday. home. mrs kenny 15 1 clear part ye day cold. husband self home. lilllefield ephm sleep [home]. 16 2 [clear], snowd ys morn. hous work mended shirt. home. 17 3 clear. brewd knit garter. son jona sent us load wood. home, brewd. 18 4 clear part day. sick. son jona wife came tarried us night. home, unwel. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 19-26, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 19 26, 1809 19 5 snowd day. son dagt went home afler breakfast hannah came tarried day night. thro gods goodnes feel much comfortable. sally martha came dind. went home tho little track. home, much [freeer] fm pain. childn went home hannah came 20 6 clear cloudy turns, snowd little. hannah tarried till sun sett went home. ephm wm came sleep. able part hous wk knit home. hannah went home sun sett. 21 7 clear cold. done hous work, bakt knit feel falagued. epm ballard sleeps home, bakt &c. 22 1 cloudy ye day. mr ballard meeting. revd mr stone spake fm luke 9 c 61 vers. hannah came ys morn, part wk, shee went meeting aftern. jona wm spent ye day home, feel feeble. 23 2 clear. home. son jona, gidion barton wives supt home. 24 3 clear. washt. sent go son jonas met two dagts, son pollard, jason pierces wife 4 childn. jona junr conducted grand father home 8h evng. good supper son cyrus came rhedfield supt allso. son jonas, daugts 25 4 clear cold. done hous wk knit mrs kenny ephm brot us load wood, cyrus went help [load]. home. mrs kenny 26 5 clear cold. warrin stones wife mr emry came 2 pm, revd mr stone lady 4; spent evng us, cyrus son ephms. made us prest pice beef, 12 lb. home. mr stones wife others source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 27-Feb. 1, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 27 february 1, 1809 27 6 clear till near night, snowd evng. mr ballard went son jonas, brot home 10 lb butter, cost 1 dol. cyrus mr locks rome. done hous wk finisht kniting self pair garters. home. 28 7 clear day cold. wife mr georg crosby expired 1h ys morn. cyrus son lambds, dagt gone son ephms. done hous work, sorted apples pard cut yt spect rott. home. death mrss crosby. 29 1 clear ye day cold. home. mr ballard cyrus meeting. revd mr stone discst fm timoy 3 ch 19 vers. evng r. h. pollard, h. m. ballard, doly lambd, betsy smith jona porter calld see us. home. grand childn evng. 30 2 cloudy forenn, began snow 12 o clock. done washing mended mitts stockins mr balld cyrus. home. 31 3 clear part ye day cold. mr ballard cyrus attended funeral georg crosbys wife. revd mr harskal deliverd discoars ecleasts 8 c 8 vers. bakt brown bread apple pies knit evng. lefaett supt home. funeral mrss crosby. revd mr harskal performd. 1 4 clear part ye day, snowd lillle. infmd old mr isaac savage expired last night. hannah m. ballard sally pollard sleep ys night. done hous work knitt home. hannah ballard 14 [yrs] day. death mr isaac savage. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 2-11, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 2 11, 1809 [2] [5] cloudy cold. hous wk kniting. sally tarried till sun sett went son jonas. cyrus mr beans, brot home 2 bsl indien meal, 3 pecks wheat remains old mr isaac savage interd 1h pm, wife novr 12, 1808. home. cyrus rheedfield. funeral mr savage. 3 6 clear part ye day, windy evng. done washing knit. polly town came fm son lambeds hous. sally polld went home. home. p. town came 4 7 clear cold. bakt bn white bd. hannah b. dind polly went home home, heard fm son lambd. 5 1 snowd day. tarried home. jona b. junr jona porter cold indead. home, severe storm snow. 6 2 clear cold. done hous work knit. cyrus went helpt git wood home. mr ballard wrode ye nud colt son jonas home home. 7 3 cloudy part ye day. done hous wk, roasted piece beef son ephm sent us, finisht futing cyruss hoes &c. select men caused wood brot brookss. polly came home yesterday. home. 8 4 clear cold. cyrus set tend mill esq lock rome. washing, knit evng. home. cyrus esqr locks. 9 5 cloudy cold. mended cloaths, done hous wk knit home. 10 6 clear part ye day, cloudy evng. done common hs wk, washt ye bedroom kitchen, knit cyruss stockin. jona b. junr sleeps home. j. balld sleeps 11 7 clear part ye day cold. done hous wk knit. mr ballard went see dagt lambd, find well, wel usual. home. saml wilm sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 12-18, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 12 18, 1809 12 1 clear cold. mr ballard meeting aftern. revd mr stone discst foren fm 1 saml 3 c 18 vers, aftn fm matt 8th c 11-12 verss. old mrs kenny sally marta. jona junr sleeps home. mr bald meeting. luke bart d. savage calld mrs kenny 13 2 snowd till 10h morn, clear rest ye day. mending cloaths, hous wk kniting. le faett william sleep school master calld home see sick sister, school dismist. home. young squagh funeral saml ward sidney. 14 3 cloudy till 11h m, cold. mrss emry came see brot flower. mrs wiman sent present informs mrs w feeble indeed, allso saml ward sidney buried yesterday. done hs wk knit. home. mrs emry see 15 4 clear pleast day, cold night. bakt white bn bread, finisht one cyruss stockins knit ye ephm 3d 12 years old y day. home. le faett wm sleep here.death mr [norris]. 16 5 clear. done hous wk knit. son jonas wife luke jona junr sleep home, dagt ballard 17 6 cloudy, snowd little. son pollard brot wife, babe polly town dagt lambd, barny, wilm henry came, sleep knit dn hs wk. home, childn 18 7 snowd ys morn, raind aftern. son jona conducted sisters childn polly hous. tibbits le faett brot little wood cut supt sleep raind fast evng. bakt wheat bread knit. home. mr dagts son jonas. mr tibbts lefaett sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 19-26, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 19 26, 1809 [19] 1 clear windy, snowd last last night blowd much. lefaett ephm slept go meeting. home. 20 2 clear. dagts pollard ballard polly town dind son pold came conducted wife babe home. seen 74 years day, may ye remainder life spent becometh christian close [peice]. home. dagls balld polld aniversary birth, 74th. 21 3 clear part ye day. done hs wk knit, finisht cyruss hoes began mittin mended gown. home. 22 4 snowd forenn, clear aftern. mended mr battard pair breeches knit mitt. polly helpt hous work &c. home. funeral mr churchel. 23 5 clear part ye day, snowd little aftern. see mrss wiman, find low. james purington took tea us. polly done washing washt north room. mr wimans. polly washt. 24 6 clear. polly ironing. allin lambd came conducted polly town house. mrs farewel came finisht cyruss mitts. home. polly left mrs [farewel] came. 25 7 snowd. mrs farewl began [net] hous wk. home. 26 1 clear pleast. mr balld meeting. son ephm brot home. revd mr stone discst fm acts 26th 18th vers, aftn romans 14th c 18 vers. elisabeth home. mrs [farewel] went son jonas. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 27-Mar. 5, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 27 march 5, 1809 27 2 clear pleast. bakt, knit done matters. little indien girl gave baskett. mr tibbets le faett sleept 1 lamb come. dagt ballard gave _ snuff. home.] 28 3 clear part ye day, snowd brewd, knit done matters. another lamb. luke jona junr brot wood home. brwd. 1 4 clear, thaud till near sun sett. high wind nw night. done hous wk, knit mended b. hoes &c. luke jona sleep infm us wm hallowells child burnt dead james bonny hous consumed fire, two childn. home, heard james bonnys hous 2 childn burnt last monday. 2 5 cloudy part ye day. done mending, knit done hous wk. son jona calld le faett brot tea kettle fm brookss. wm sleep dagt lambd sent us piggs harslet. home, snowd night. 3 6 clear windy. done washing, mending, kniting hous wk. le faett wm sleep home. 4 7 cloudy ye ye day, snowd evng. le faett wm sleep done hs wk mended cloaths. mr ballard brot home _ lb tea, 2 sugar, butter; josiah voce. home. son jona seine 46 years ys day. 5 1 clear pleast. mr ballard meeting aftern, text john 16 c 33 vrs. son jona, wife, marta, james, polly town, sally farewel sopha ballard took tea elisabeth sleeps home. friends evng. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 6-12, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 6 12, 1809 6 2 clear colder. mr ballard town meeting. done various sorts wk. dolly lucy lambd came aftern, sleep home. dolly lucy sleep 7 3 clear cold. bakt brown bread, mins, apple pumpkin pies. doly lucy went breakfast son jonas. lucy relurnd, sally martha sleep le faett brot us wood, took tea. home. 3 grand dagts sleep 8 4 snowd raind mr bullin wife dind son town, polly, patty ephm supt sleep jona balld junr brot wood. done hous wk knitt home. sally, [mta], lucy lefthere breakfast, friends came 9 5 clear windy. son town childn left breakfast go son ephms. judg cony capt seth williams calld see us. sally, m lucy l brot 3 lb _ drie fish. bakt pumpkin pies knit, finisht footing mr ballards stockins. home. judg cony capt williams le faett saml getchel sleep 10 6 clear, cold windy. done washing, hous work &c, feel falagued. esqr tods hous barn burnt 1 o clock. home, washt. tibbits sleeps 11 7 clear cold. done hous wk mending. pally town rhoda pollard calld john arnold ashes son ephm. lefaett ranus pierce sleep home, heard esqr tods buildings burnt. 12 1 clear cold. mr balld [mt], text fm deut 32,[48]; aft psm 84, 12. son epm, wife dagt evng. elisabeth home. son epm wife sopha meeting. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 13-19, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 13 19, 1809 13 2 clear cold, cloudy evng. hanah b. trask h. m. sally ballard james allso. done hous wk mending. le faett wm sleep home. 14 3 clear cold. done hous wk, mend shirt, sewd raggs fr coverled. mr ballard went mr wimans, returnd fm schooduck; saw son lambard 6th inst, well. mrs wiman low. home. epm sleeps warrin slone daugt born. 15 4 snowd. done mending. son jon wife evng, infm yt [m] james cowen sydna fitt, fell fire burnt badly. jona b. junr sleeps home. son jona wife spent evng 16 5 clear cold. mended drawers cyrus done wk. mr bald sent wm josh voces 2 lb sugar. home. 17 6 clear day, cloudy evng. mr benjamin porter wife babe dind took tea. dagts ballard lambard tea. mr porter conducted dagts home, expect tarrie dt lambds. ephm william sleep elisabth ye indn let potatoes. son john babcocks record birth sept 11, 1791. home. benn porter, son [jona], their[wives] dagt lambd 18 7 cloudy, raind done washing matters. jona junr sleeps home. 19 1 raind. son jona sent father dine moos meet stakes. raind hard wisht tarrie night. jona junr came slept son jonas, tarried [night]. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 20-25, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 20 25, 1809 20 2 x. clear part ye day. mr ballard dind son jonas. wife went see mrs wiman aftern, find low, confind bed. returnd home, find bror ebenz moore wife sleep william ballard sleeps son jonas mr wimans. bror moore wife 21 3 clear part ye day. bror sister left homewd bound 10h 30m mr ballard went amos bonds, bt 1 bsl corn, 1 lb butter, 2 lard. mr brookss famely removd fm old house near night. death james cowen sidney. lefaett wm sleep home. bror sister moore left brooks removd. 22 4 snowd ys morn, clear part ye day. dagt lambard, son ephms wife allin sopha la faett wm sleep mrs smith calld son epms wife brot us 5 lb cod fish, 1 butter 5 flower. home. dagts lambd ballard 23 5 clear part ye day. washt, scolt pickles, knit &c. le faett wm sleep home. funeral. 24 6 snowd till near night raind evng. bakt, knit done matters. informd mr chace expired last night ys morn mrs kidder watervill came fathers yesterday 2 weaks since expired morning. child allso mr p. hamlins. le faett wm sleep home. two deaths town. 25 7 clear cold. mended hoes, knit done wk, hear yt mr james cowen expired last tuesday, interd thursday last. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 6-11, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 6 11, 1809 6 5 cloudy ye day. mr ballard meeting, fast day. revd mr stone discoarst fm psm 80, 9-10-11-12th verses. hear mrss wiman little easier. left ephm sleep [home]. son jonas james better. 7 6 snowd foren, clear aftn even. done hous wk. epm wm sleep [home]. mrs wimn better. 8 7 clear foren, cloudy aftn. pally town came washing mending mr ballard ye settllement, bot 10 lb tallow, 2_ pork. done hous wk knit. le fat ephm sleep [home]. hear yt mrs wiman better. 9 1 clear cold. mr ballard meeting. patty town son jonas. hannah james, says mrss wiman easier. revd mr stones text foren psalms 58 vers 11, aftern 1st corenth 10 c 31st vers. left wm sleep home. [hannah] james marta 10 2 clear cool. done hous wk. pally town came mended cloaths husband cyrus. le faett ephm sleep home, pally 11 3 cloudy ye day. patty went son jonas breakfast. brot potatoes fron ye cellar washt le faett, ephm wm sleep infm mrss wiman thought near close life. patty gone watch may great supporter soul boddy support may famely friends resigned home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 12-17, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 12 17, 1809 [12] 4 raind. sett see mrss wiman 1h pm, find low. watcht shee got little rest. mrs emry rose day went onto ye bed slept mr wimans, watcht wife. 13 5 raind day evng. returnd home 9h removing ye patient changing lining, left sleeping little easier. found sally farewel hannah ballard slept pally town last night. sally ys night allso. ditoes, wife law. sally farewel 14 6 cloudy rain. made candles, 13_ dzn. sally farewel left breakfast. patty went son jonas, infant unwell. shee informd mrs wiman little delarious. home, made candles. wm sally sleep 15 7 clear. felt unwel bakt done part hous wk. pally washing. shee calld watch mrss wiman, shee better. left wm sleep home, bakt. pally washt went watch wh mrss wiman. 16 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. revd mr stone spake fn fm 1 corinh 15 c 34 v, aftn fm matu c 7th 2nt v. patty came evn, says mrss wiman weak. home. pally sleeps mrss wiman low. 17 2 cloudy part ye day. pally washt went mr wimans, tarries. mr ballard parrish meeting. son cyrus came home. [dolly] lambd sleeps done hous wk knit. home. cyrus came home. dolly lambard source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 18-25, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 18 25, 1809 18 3 clear pleast. pally came fm mr wimans 6h morn, left wife low indead. mr ballard hallowell son jonas. pally left aftern aunt lambards. dolly son jonas, returnd; sleeps sally martha removd part chips ye doore. home, bakt flour bread. patty dagt lambds. 19 4 clear. calld mr wimans 8h wife near ye close life. returnd home 11, removd ye banking fm s end west side house. went back watcht mrss wiman, mrss smith mr wimans, watcht. dolly, sally martha slept 20 5 clear pleast. mrss wiman expired 3h ys morn, aged 51. mrss smith put grave cloaths son jona calld assist us removeing corps west room. famely filld sorrow berievment. shall feel loss. may sanctifyed us left returnd home son jonas. wel could expected. slept 2 hours, rose performd wk. mr ballard son pollards. sent 3 lb fine pork. dolly lambd went home, cyrus mr coneys. home. mr wimans, wife expired 3h ys morn. shee [told] us shee felt resigned leav [world]. death. 21 6 clear. done various kinds wk, went mr wimans aftern. cyrus went mr wimans set mr wimans. 22 7 clear foren, cloudy aftn, raind night. washing forn, attended mr wimans hous, wives remains interd. discrs deliverd mr low, last prayer mr smith. words ot ye text must work ye day lasts &c. saml wiman seen 14 years day. dagt lambd, lucy, wm patty town took tea. dt childn sleep mr wimans, remains wife intered. funeral. saml wima 14 years ys day. 23 1 cloudy rain. mr ballard meeting. text timo 6 c 6 vers. dagt lambd childn went son jonas. went came home prepare supper. son jonas, wife gave sauser butter. 24 2 clear part ye day, showers thunder. cyrus went hallowl. boiling soap dagt lambd. washt hous, cleard ye manure hen roost done hous wk. cyrus bot 2 oz snuff 6 nots cors thread. home, makeing soap dt lambd. 25 3 clear cool. washt mended cloaths cyrus, went son epms. boiting dagt lambds soape. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 7-10, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 7 10, 1809 7 1 x. birth mr pipers son 5th child. xx. clear part day. calld son ephms mr pipers early ys morn, wife labour. deld son, 5th child 12 o clock. took dinner left went daugt lambds; tarri night. henry sick night. undres slept sophia gill slept dagt see mrss mosier, finds sick. son ephms. mr pipers dagt lambards. birth 3d. receivd 9s babcock24 inst. 8 2 rainy. dagt lambds forin, hors brot went home. calldd son jonas, took tea, mr ballard allso. epm wm slept jack came bed, slept dagt lambds, son jonas mr pipers. 9 3 clear part ye day. sett turnips cabbage stumps. dagt ballard son jona came informd shipt liverpoole, setts morrow. sophia gill dolly lambard sleep home, workt gardin. sophia dolly sleep 10 4 cloudy ye day. done hous wk, planted cucumbers three kinds squash. removd banking fm hous &c, knit mrs emry see girls left ys morn. mrs emry, two wilm stones dts, gardin seeds mr ballard workt son jonas, jack sett sea. home. mrs emry girls went home breakfast. jona ballard sett go sea. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.
