title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 11-15, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 11 15, 1809 11 5 cloudy. done hous work, brewd. mr ballard workt son jonas forenn, went sett hoops dagt lambd aftern. informs patty lambe hand. home, brewd. 12 6 cloudy ye day. done hous wk, bakt brown bread; felt well. mr ballard mending fence round ye gardin. ephm wm sleep home, bakt planted squash cucumbers. 13 7 cloudy ye ys day. fixt bed, planted squash seeds removd part banking east side ye hous. mr bullin infmd yt son jessy bured youngest child yesterday. rhoda pollard sleeps infmd yt old mr bisbee dead. patty town lambe. hannah balld wm sleeps home. mr [balld] hallowell, mr lad_ lb tea, 2 lb sugar 6 [elwives]. deaths. 14 1 cloudy part ye day, raind mr ballard meeting. revd mr stone discoarst fm romans 1st c 28th vers. hannahs ballard getchel calld epm wm sleep home. rhoda left afler dinner. 15 2 clear part ye day, showers aftern. dug ground west ye hous planted squash, cucumbers, musk water mellons east side house. began finisht large wash 3 o clock, feel falagued. son jona ploughing field, husband workt home. jona junr returnd, could get chance go sea. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 16-20, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 16 20, 1809 16 3 clear part ye day. washt wkt gardin. planted watermellons cucumbers greene kind. mr ballard mod bushes. mrs bennet seeds. son town sleeps famely wel usual. home. son town sleeps 17 4 clear, warm spring like. workt gardin, planted long squash ye hogg pen, sowd pepper grass, sett sage roots. mr ballard mode bush dugg gardin. washt cyruss old coats, gound things. son jona 6 oxen taken execution drove way. feel able help hin. ephm wm sleep home. son town left ys morn. mr ballard 84 years ys day. death mr hains. 18 5 clear. workt gardin, sett parsley 3 quins trees pigg pen, knit &c. mr ballard diging gardin setting hop poles. ephm sleeps home, hear yr mrs mosier better. 19 6 clear warm. workt ye gardin, knit boiling soap. jona junr sleeps mr [wi made us presen 12 fish. home. [compy jonas wife gave us butter. 20 7 clear. ironed wkt gardin. dagt lambd sent 3 lb pork. mrs farewel, dagt ballard 3 childn, pally town took tea home, compy jonas wife gave butter. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 21-25, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 21 25, 1809 21 1 clear warm. mr ballard went meeting, walkt. son ephms wife came noone. shee pally town took supper us. informd mrss mosier comfortable. pallys hand better. text fn hebrs 12 3 vers, aftn psalm 62nt 8 vs. home. son ephms wife pally tn 22 2 cloudy rain. washt wkt gardin, sett 2 quins trees 1 apple tre. planted lukes potatoes, set leutis plants strauberies. squash cucumbers come bed east side ye hous. home, washt workt gardin. showers night. 23 3 cloudy morn, sun shine ye day. done hous wk gardin. mrss jones foren. sowd string peas n end gardin. mr ballard _ lb butr son jonas. jona junr sleeps home, sowd string peas. 24 4 clear. done hous wk dug gardin, sowd pees &c. mr ballard went son ephms, sent 7_ lb fresh pork. son jona sent piece green chees rice. ephm sleeps home, workt gardin. 25 5 x. james catons. birth 11 child 5 son. xxx. clear. calld mr caton 2h 30m ys morn go see wife. arivd sun rise, found delivard son. 11th child, safe. performd necessary left comfortable could expected. arivd home ten sent herbs matters. james calons. birth 4th. fell fm hors way home. receivd 9s wilm babcock. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, may 26 30, 1809 26 6 clear, cool windy. done hous wk workt gardin. planted crambury, brown hundred one beens south ye hous. jona ballard junr sleeps home, planted beens. 27 7 clear windy. transplanted cucumbers done work gardin. mr ballard hallowell. calld dagt lambards, brot 6 lb _ veal fm le faett ploughd ye s end field. home, brewd workt gardn. 28 1 birth son pollards 9 child, daugt ye 6th. clear part day. calld son pollard 2h 30m ys morn go see wife. reacht 5 dagt deld 6 fine daught, ninth child, comfortable. babe wd 11 pounds. sally cleark preuda snow came evng, night. son pollards. birth 5th. 29 2 raind. daugt inft comfortable. pruda helpt wash, sally assisted. shee tarried night, cleverly. son pollard went watervill. [ditoes]. 30 3 clear part ye day. got dagt chand lining &c left 8. reacht home 11 find hous person dagt pollard gave cake 2_ lb pork. went son jonas, carried herbs matters pally town carrie daugt pollard. sett squash plants east side ye gardin. ditoes son jonas. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 31-Jun. 4, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 31 june 4, 1809 31 4 clear. done hous wk sett squash plants cucumbers. capt smith lefaett ploughing field. cyrus shearing sheep. allin lambard potatoes beens. dagt ballard sent us 13 oz butter. home, workt ye gardin. mrs mosier better. 1 5 clear warmer. cyrus sett rome ys morn. mr ballard hallowell, receivd mr lads acount tea 1 lb, coffee _ dug gardin, sett mellons &c. daugt ballard see us aftern, sally, james elisabeth home. son jonas wife part childn, inform mrs mosier sick. 2 6 clear part ye day. done hous wk, washt wool, sett plants n ye great rock, planted beens &c. mr ballard planted hundred one beens field. le faett ephm furrowed planting. sowd beets, carrots oinions. home, workt ye gardin. 3 7 raind. workt doors mr ballard began plant corn, ephm ballard allin lambard helpt dagt bald sent flower. hear 6 men sentanced go state prison coart. home. 4 1 clear part ye day, showers aftern. mr ballard meeting, went aftern. text fn 1 cor x c 12 v, aftn john 7th c 7 vers. calld dagt lambds. calld see mrss mosier, find sick. son ephm calld gave 1 lb 3 oz butter. meeting, dagt lambds mr mosiers; shee yet living. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 5-9, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 5 9, 1809 5 2 clear part ye day. mr ballard planting corn day. dugg ground west side ye hous transptanted squash &c. mrss mosier expired 1h pm. home, workt gardin. death mrss mosier. 6 3 clear part ye day. workt gardin, sett squash, millon cucumbers plants, done washing. remains mrss mosier carried sidney interd afternoon. home. funeral mrss mosier, wife elisha. 7 4 clear ye ye day. dugg place planted cucumbers ye south end ye gardin. finisht washing, put water plants &c. left knee sweld painfl. hannah ballard brot spirrit baith applied black wool allso. home, done various kinds work. lambe left knee. 8 5 clear part day. lambe wrode isaac savages hopeing receiv due receiv cent. calld jack shaws, receivd nothing bathed lame knee vinagar, went bed could rest. got lay fire night. jona junr sleeps isaac savages jack shaws. 9 6 cloudy misty. still lame workt gardin day except hous wk; planted potatoes beens. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jun. 10-13, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, june 10 13, 1809 10 7 cloudy. done hous wk feel feeble. mr katons oldest daugt dind mother cleverly. mr ballard son ephms, carried greens. gave us 12_ lb pork; leg, 5 lb beef; great favour. dagt lambd lent us 4_ lb rie 5 lb indien meal. 19th inst sent meal home. home. mr balld bot 1 oz snuff. great day ye settlement ye removal imbargo. 11 1 cloudy misty. mr ballard meeting. revd mr stone discoarst fm luke x c 41 42nt verses. son jona wife calld see barny lambd, wm, martha james meeting. son eph, wife dagt dagt lambd went son pollards. home. son jona wife calld sent 10 oz butter ys morn. 12 2 cloudy till 11h sun shone, clear aftern. allin lambd came work eleven. seemed unwel, went bed lay till 4 pm look dish tea. helpt grand father ye rest ye day. wm b. sleep cutt potatoes plant. home. allin helpt us part ys day. 13 3 clear. allin lambd workt foren. cut potatoes, done hous wk, killd bugs vines &c. mr ballard fixing ground potatoes. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 26 30, 1809 26 2 clear part ye day. done hous wk, houghd beens potatoes. sett f. turnips squash plants. mr ballard swine son jona wd 135 lb. houghd corn forenn, went parrish meeting aftern. calld see dagt lambd, finds comfortable. home. mr ballard parish meeting. 27 3 cloudy till 11 clear aftern. washt workt gardin &c. john walls wife sist lason currents, took tea james wall expired last thursday, left wife 2 childn moarn. home. thunder rain night. 28 4 birth mr burdens 6th son 12th child. clear warm. calld mr burden 7h morn, wife labour. shee [fe] deld 6h 30m pm 6th son 12th child. left comfortable returnd home, work took till eleven o clock evng. quite falagued. mr burdens. birth 7th. wm sleeps 29 5 cloudy foren, thunder rain aftern. wed bed beets sett cabage turnip [plants]. home. wm sleeps 30 6 clear part ye day. mr ballard attended lecture. revd mr stone discoarst fm acts 26th c 28 vers. magr coneys wife reuel williamss [ond] ye covenant childn baptised. judg north cony presented 2 brooks mrs hannah cox admited full communion church. leclure dagt lambds. babe well. dolly, lucy wm sleep m. b. allso. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 6-10, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 6 10, 1809 6 5 clear ye ye day. wkt hous, houghd pees cucums. allin helpt gn sir put plaster ye corn. jonas boys houghd potatoes little home. saml pollard came fr sally, shee went home. 7 6 clear, cool morn, warm aftn. washt houghd cucumbers beens n ye hous. dolly went fm son jonas. hannah shee son pollards. martha sohpa aftern. capt jason cony infms son lambd wel. home. mr ballard houghd beens, put poles gardin. 8 7 clear warm. finisht washing matters, felt feeble. mr ballard went mr lads, 11 lb indien meel _ lb tea. dagt ballard, marta wm took tea us. home. son jonas wife mr purington james ys morn. 9 1 cleare foren hot, shower 6h pm. mr ballard meeting. revd mr stones text foren entry], aftern psalm 16th vers, home, churnd evng. home. 10 2 clear foren, shower 6h pm. mr ballard parrish meeting. warrin stone workt foren. wm b. went carred 6 dzn eggs, sold ym fr 9d/ [dan] got _ lb tea 2 lb sugr. joany smith martha tea. done hous wk little y gardin. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 16-21, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 16 21, 1809 [16] 1 clear warm. mr ballard meeting. revd mr stones text 2nd peter 3 c 14th vers. sons town, jona wives calld foren see hannah helpt part ye day. son town wife went son pollards aftern, go home tomorrow providence permit. home. son town wife [foren]. 17 2 sun rose clear immediately became cloudy remaind day. done little washing, wk gardin &c, feel feeble. son jonas wife came see took tea; james home. dagt balld calld little wm sleeps 18 3 raind night ye ye day. felt unwel day. mr ballard houghd corn held home, feeble. 19 4 cloudy, began rain 4h pm. mr ballard ploughd houghd corn till began rain. done little washing. allin lambd says babe sick. feel able help [ranus] wm sleep home, washt 20 5 cloudy day, raind part mr ballard went dagt lambds see ye babe, finds quite unwel. finisht ye wash began last weak. home. wm sleeps washt today. 21 6 cloudy rain. ironing, calld 6h pm go mr mc farlings, reacht sunsett. mr mc farlings. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 22-31, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 22 31, 1809 22 7 clear. mr mc farlings, patient comfortable. ditoes. 23 1 detoes. amos partridg buried youngest child. dos. funeral. 24 2 part rainy clear. mrs mc farling detaind 25 3 shee gave cotton yn knit pair hoes 26 4 ye heel. left hous returnd home, reacht 27 5 11h found many things find sist 28 6 barlon son cyrus absent. son jonas wife, martha elisabeth aftern. thunder rain. ditoes. returnd home 11h mr ballard bot 1 bsl rie, indian. 29 7 clear. bakt broun flower bread. dt lambd, mrss smart, pally town wm babe came foren. old lady dillingham grand son, mrs howard, sally farewel aftern. 4 girls 2 boys cherries. mr ballard ye settlement, brot home pork, herring, _ lb tea, 2 sugar. home, company. 30 1 clear warm. mr ballard meeting. revd mr stone discoarst fm ephe 4th c three last verss. dagt lambards inft baptised ye name sarah farewel. son jona, wife 4 childn rhoda pollard allso patty town. home. childn grand childn 31 2 clear warm. brewed cleaned cellar. old mrss hamlin son, epms wife, sopha martha infm amos patridg son dagt born last night. home. mrs hamlin source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 1-5, 1809 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 1 5, 1809 1 3 clear. done larg wash matters. mrs emry came took tea, dolly lucy lambard, sally martha bald also. jon junr wrode hors gn daddy plough corn. home. mrs emry 6 grand childn. 2 4 clear warm. mrs burbank sarah farewel currents. mrs b. gave 1/6d. son jona, wife, sally, marta lucy lambd took tea. sister barlon came, hors slipt bridle went away. shee went jonas. lefaett, linda hannah came us found home. son jona wife sist barton allso. informd ye death mrs robbins. 3 5 clear. sister barton went son jonas. mr ballard came took tea. nathaniel tytars wife fell hors broke thigh. son jonas. mrs tylar broke thigh. 4 6 clear. workt gardin done hous wk. mr ballard houghing. sist barton left 9h go dagt lambds. dagt ballard mrss saunders tea, sally james allso. home, company. lefaett took calf away. 5 7 clear part ye day, thunder rain aft 3h pm. done hous wk wed gardin. mr ballard finisht houghing corn ye 3d time. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, august 13 17, 1809 13 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. revd mr packard performd fm jobe 13th c 1 2nd verss, aftn fm john 9 4. home, galherd beens peas dinner. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 25-31, 1810 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 25 31, 1810 25 1 x. birth john pierces son, first born. xx. clear part ye day. calld 1h pm see wife john pierce labour. shee delivd 2 son, first born; husband absent. sister barton son jonas wife shee delivd arivd. sist got home dusk. capt smilh. birth 4th. jany 19 recvd [last] due. 26 2 cloudy foren. sist barton went son jonas 11 o clock. began snow 3h pm. wm bald sleeps [home]. 27 3 clear. done hous wk, began brew. calld son jonas, elisabeth sick. ebenz trask wife conducted sist barton home sleigh. son jonas, babe sick. 28 4 clear part ye day. james purington uncle sist sleeps home. 29 5 clear part day. done hous wk knit. calld son jonas 9h 30m evng see james elisabeth unwel. tarried night. son jonas. 30 6 x. birth b. shaws 2nd dagt. xx. clear. mr ballard came son jonas, took breakfast came home. left ye childn better. calld 3h 30m pm see b. shaws wife east ye bridg. shee deld dagt, second child, 11 evng. tarried till morn. ditoes b. shaws. birth 5th. recd 9/ cashas reward. 31 7 clear. left patients cleverly reacht home 11h 30m feel fatagued. son jona edmond warrin son epm 31 years old yesterday. mr shaws, fee recevd. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

content: martha ballard's diary, june 3 10, 1810 [3] 1 clear. mr ballard meeting. text foren mathu, aft romans. home. 4 2 clear part day. done hous wk, brewd. mr balld planted potatoes ye field. content: martha ballard's diary, july 4 11, 1810 4 4 clear part day. home, work gardin hs work. home.] 5 5 x. birth enoch rowels 3d dagt. xx. cloudy morn rain. mr rowel calld 6h 30m see wife labour. found child born arivd. finisht performance. hir 3d dagt 4th child. returnd son jonas, dind mr ballard allso. came home, removd beet plants matters. mr rowel. birth 11th. recd 9/ reward. 6 6 birth asa pierces son. clear. calld asa pierce 8h morn go see wife safe delivd 5h pm son. left comforlable reacht home 9h evng, felt fatagud. asa pierces. birth 12th. receivd 6/. 7 7 clear ys day. jason pierce wife calld done hous work, ironing &c. mr ballard went mill. brot 2/1 bushl rie meal son ephms, got 2/1 bsl potatoes; store, got 2/1 lb tea, 2 lb sugar spirit. cost /5 shilings 3d. home. jason pierce calld 8 1 cloudy foren, raind aftern night. jona ballard junr calld see us, wel clinton. man found dead hallowell. home. jona junr death. 9 2 raind morn, sun shone 9h aneversary purington scean 4 years since. jona sett clinton home, hear jonah crosby dead. 10 3 clear. done washing. old lady stone chang eggs. home, mrs stone 11 4 clear part ye day. done ironing. dagt ballard, sarah marta james boys mowd grass ye gardin yesterday, houghing corn today. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 18-23, 1810 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 18 23, 1810 18 4 clear. mr ballard left home 9h go clinton. wish may return safe. hannah pollard dolly lambard washt washt kitchen. went son jonas dinner. wed gardin hannah b. sleep [home]. mr [ballard] clinton winslow]. 19 5 clear warm. done hous wk pickt wool. sophia wiman betsy hanh pollard d. lambd went son epms. h., s., mta sleep [home]. 20 6 clear part day, little rain aftn. went son jonas see elisabeth, shee unwel. sally pollard p. lambd sleep scolt [bed stead]. son jonas. 21 7 clear. done hous wk, made pair pillow cases. son cyrus came dind went hallowell. husband returnd clinton, wel cyrus, s. pollard d. lambd sleep home. mr ballard returnd fm clinton. 22 1 clear warm. sally pollard d. lambard took leav expected sett clinton breakfast. son cyrus rome. may arive homes safty ardent wish. hannah pollard calld took liev [sett] home. may blest prosper life. content: martha ballard's diary, july 24 31, 1810 [24] 3 clear. mrs farewel dagt ballard elisabeth tea. dagt brot chees. mr ballard son ephms, got potatoes. dagt sent 18 candles. finisht picking white [wool]. home. mrs farewel dagt [sally] ballard 25 4 clear. jona, wife dagt pollard came shee took part wool yarn home. father went son jonas tea, came home sun sett. son jonas, childn 26 5 clear foren, heavy thunder rain aftern. picking black wool. home. 27 6 clear. picking refues wool. dagt ballard sent us chees 1 lb butr. home, houghd cucumbers. 28 7 clear. done mending, went son jonas; doubled cottne yarn &c. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Aug. 14-18, 1810 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, august 14 18, 1810 14 3 cloudy rain. sett little. hannah ballard came made tea, drank 2 cups. shee h. getchel sleep [home], unwel. 15 4 x. birth martins 5th dagt, 6th child. xx. clear. calld 30m mid night mr martin hallowell go see wife labour. went, shee linguring litt 11h 30m shee safe deld 6 child 5th daugt. went see mother apears near ye close life. god grant change may happy. returnd home 10h evng. left patients comfortable. mr martin hallowell isaac clearks. birth 13. receivd 12/ reward. 16 5 clear. felt feeble day done hous work. mr ballard surveying mgr livermore hallowell yesterday receivd 1d _ home. 17 6 clear. feeble ys day. dagt ballard came see aftern, marta, james elisa [home]. dagt ballard 18 7 clear. bakt, done hous wk, gatherd sage burnit &c. mr ballard got 2/1 busl indien peck rie meal. went doct coneys, made present 1-2/1 oz senna, camphr 12 pills feel gratefull. bell told death ys aftern. home. mrs smith death old mr crosby. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 18-28, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 18 28, 1811 18 6 clear cold. felt feeble done hous wk washing. epm brot wood. home, wm sally sleep 19 7 clear cold. mr orrock busines. wm b. brot 3 pints john pierce. home. 20 1 clear. mrs bond expired 8h aged 53. mr dean wiman wido lucy pierce joind mariage evng son jonas. home. death mrs bond. mariage mr wiman mrs pierce. 21 2 clear pleast. went capt shubal pittss, spent night capt pittss. 22 3 clear pleast. sist barton went see old mrs mosier attended prayers mr bonds, wives remains interd evng. sist calld see mrss young thwing. came capt ps dusk, wrode home hannahs gelchel ballard. mr mosiers others. funeral mrs bond. 23 4 clear cold. son jona wm sett clinton. home. home. 24 5 clear cold. finisht footing husbands hoes pair mits wm. dgt balld home. 25 6 clear cold. dome washing sewing. 3d night yt hannah marta slept home. 26 7 clear cold. fineas pain sent 1 blsl wheat part due assist ing wife august 11th, 1810. jona wm ballard sleep inform wm lambd better. let us bless god mercies. home. jona b. wm sleep 27 1 clear till noon. jona junr sleeps mr [lankester] spent evning. home, jona sleeps. 28 2 clear part day. dagt pollard martha took tea, sent go son jonas. shee hir husband sleep epm b. sleeps home. dagt pollard source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 5-May 14, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 5 may 14, 1811 5 6 clear cool. dagt wel expected. mrs gill, sons, luke harnon left son lambds, went farm belonging mr rice. wish prosperity. hannah getchel sally ballard came 11h evng. drove carriage fm kenebeck bridg 2h pm. [ditoes]. h. [getchel] came night. 6 7 clear. yet. mrs emry came see us. son jona arivd stores. hannah keep hous ditoes. 7 1 clear pleast foren. left son lambds 10h sally came carriage wrode calld mr capins rest hors, reacht son jonas dark. took tea came home. feel fatagued. allin came home went see mrs philbk set home. 8 2 raind foren. judg cony calld see us. dagt ballard childn aftern. feel fatagued journey. home. judg cony dgt ballard allso. 9 3 clear part day. mrs smith supt home. 10 4 clear part ye day. georg bolton another man dind brewd, removd banking done matters. home. 11 5 clear cool. fast day meeting meeting hous. home. 12 6 clear cold. washt, feel feeble. home. 13 7 clear cold. done hous work. home. 14 1 clear cold. mr ballard meeting. mrs smith, charlot, dagt ballard part childn, son ephm ezra town coars day. home. mr balld meeting. 15 2 clear pleast. allin lambd says fathers famely cleverly. harnon barton marm famely wel. home, bakt. allin 16 3 clear. done hous work. home. 17 4 cloudy foren, clear aftern. sister barton came calld 10h evn mr pipers, wife labour. childn sleep home till 10h evng. sist barton 18 5 x. birth mr pipers 3d dagt. xx. clear. mrs piper safe deld 4h 3d dagt. receivd 1 qt spt, 1 lb candles, _ lb sugar. arivd home early. fire raged ye east fortunately stopt. mr pipers. birth 5th. fee receivd, 12/. 19 6 clear. sister went jonas, mr ballard allso. jonas wife took tea us yesterday. son jonas. 20 7 clear part ye day. sist went ye settlement. feel feeble. home. sist went away. 21 1 cloudy, raind night. mr ballard pain bowels attend public worship. home. mr ballard unwel. 22 2 clear cold. part done washing matters. home. 23 3 clear cold. persued washing, washt n roome &c. mr balld makeing harrow son jonas. home. 24 4 clear cold. finisht wash done things. home. 25 5 clear cold. done ironing matters. le faett butcherd calf. ephm carried hind quarter, head harslett feet judg north. home. kild calf. jonas gt red cow calvd. 26 6 clear cold. done hous work &c. epm wm sleep home. 27 7 clear day. done hous wk. 28 1 clear part ye day, raind night. son ephm meeting. jonas wife part childn dind died, w. w. kindrick town, aged 14 years. home. ephm death. 29 2 raind morn, clear ye day. son jona, wife, james elisa dind mrs carter calld aflern. mr greanlief calld took breakfast, says cast away sea long since, home 7 mile brook. sally martha sleep home. part childn dind 30 3 clear part ye day, rain night. mrs farewel sophia ballard sleep hanh, marta elisabeth aftern. done houn wk mended cloaths. home. mrs farewel, sophia sleep 1 4 clear. mrs farewel sophia went breakfast. done hous work, sorted beens planting &c. remains kendrick interd aftern. home. mrs farewel left funeral. 2 5 clear cool. removd bed bedroome, sorted beens feel feeble. mr ballard mended kitchen chimney harth yesterday, oven day. jonas men plowing field day. home. 3 6 clear cold. done washing, churnd made chees, sorted beens &c. home. 4 7 clear pleast. done hous wk, ironed. mrs smith beet parsnip seed carrot squash; let thread. wm ballard sleeps home. mrs smith 5 1 clear pleast. home, made chees. dagt ballard gone sydney. home. 6 2 clear part ye day, raind night. mr piper sent tea le faett. home. 7 3 clear pleast. sett trees current bushes done matters gardin. esq titcomb, s. cumings lat hamlin calld training ye common wealth ys day. home. 8 4 clear morn, thunder rain aftern evng. mrs carter gardin seeds various kinds. shee brot 11 oz chees. allin lambd, epm sally ballard sleep home. allin l. epm b. sally sleep 9 5 raind day. planted cucumbers, scrapt mors 5 apple trees gardin, churnd 1 lb _ butter. allin, epm, sally martha sleep home. allin, epm, sally martha sleep 10 6 clear cool. went son jonas early ys morn, wife, epm, martha, james elisabeth took departure clinton 11h allin may god prosper every lawful takeing wish aged mother. son jonas. removed part famely clinton. 11 7 clear fore n, cloudy night. sett leatch run lee, title: Martha Ballard's Diary, May 19-26, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, may 19 26, 1811 19 1 clear. mr ballard meeting day. went aftern, wrode mr church williams house. calld mr carters aft meeting, took tea. mr wms conducted home shais house. hannah glidon sally balld sleep went son jonas milk. hanh getchel came clinton, well meeting, text john. 20 2 clear. workt gardin done hous wk. son ephms wife informs young man livs hurt work gardin. shee mended fathers coat. staid alone ys night. home. son epms wife 21 3 cloudy, raind aftern. gatherd fuel lane swept chambers work. wilm sally sleep becky fletcher left son jonas went mr bennets. mr ballard burnt bushes west ye house. home. 22 4 rainy. makeing short gound hous work. hannahs getchel h. ballard vasit. mr ballard planted cucumbers beens. home. alone ys night. 23 5 raind till 11h cleard churnd made chees. mr ballard went see vessel launched, started slopt go wm sleeps home, wm sleeps 24 6 clear cool. washt kitchen. saml wiman lefaett b. inform h. gelchel sally b. sett clinton noone. mr ballard see ye ship launched, got water afleet left home. 25 7 clear. done hous work, feel unwel night pain head. home. 26 1 clear. son ephm sent carriage us go meeting, went. tarrie hous ys night. agustus calvin balld see us. sister barton meetng son ephms. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 8-25, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 8 25, 1811 8 2 clear warm. bakt, churnd workt gardin. jona b. junr came clinton, al well home. 9 3 clear warm. jona junr took breakfast made chees wkt gardin yet. jona junr sett clinton aftern. son lambard jail debt allso. may wise disposer things point way releas. went son jonas, [jail]. 10 4 cloudy, thunder rain aftern. done hous work gardin, made mellolott ointment self son jonas wife. home. 11 5 cloudy day, raind part wed carrotts, mended husbands trousers &c. home. 12 6 raind shours. workt gardin made chees, 3 curds made sett shift pair sleevs. home. 13 7 raind day. swept chambers lower rooms, feel feeble indeed. mr hawl alterd piggs. home. son jona came night. 14 1 clear day. dagt ballard, hannah elisa, hannah pollard, becky fletcher, son epm son luke barton hanh glidon allso. son jona went clinton. home, [friends] funeral clearks [child]. 15 2 clear day. washt made chees, mended shirt &c. allin lambard came marm childn wel. home. allin lambard 16 3 clear. went son jonas. mrs farewel, sist barton sopha came home sleep son jonas. 17 4 clear part day. sist washt n roome. mrs farewel went mr bennets. calld mr mc fartin 5h pm go see wife near hour labour. larried house till 25th. mc farlins. 25 5 birth mc farlins 2nd son, 4th child present wife. son jona wife went clinton 23 inst. sister barton set boston packet morn. birth 10th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jul. 26-Aug. 5, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, july 26 august 5, 1811 [26] 6 clear. done hous work feel wel could wish. home. 27 7 clear. done hous wk, washt kitchen. warrin stones wife came gathered cherries gardin, 22 quarts. shee half, sold 6 cents pr qt. home. luke b. jona junr sleep 28 1 clear. home. mrs smith number others. luke jona took breakfast home. 29 2 cloudy foren, raind aftern. felt feeble. hanh ballard sally pollard sleep son epms wife took tea home, friends 30 3 clear. sally pollard scoured puter washing. dagt pollard, dolly, marta catharine came sally went home, hannah ballard 2 little girls lhem. home, childn 31 4 clear. ye day dagt pollard came stead yesterday. home, dagt polld came 1 5 rainy day. dagt p., dt dolly marta ballard ys day. dagt sewing home. 2 6 clear. dagt pollard left 10h morn go son ephms. done hous work, cut herbs drie; cat mint tansey. home. dagt p. went son epms. 3 7 clear. brewd done work. dagt pollard dgt dolly came evng, h. getchel ballard went home. son cyrus came 11h evng. home, brewd. dagt pold son cyrus sleep 4 1 clear. dagt pollard dolly left us 9 cyrus 11h. ye hous work. le faett carting hay barn. home. 5 2 clear forenn, rain high wind aftern. hannah getchel done hous work gardin. home. h. getchel part ys day. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Sep. 31-Oct. 8, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, september 31 october 8, 1811 [1] 3 clear, hard frost last night. dagt pollard jonas wife foren. hav husking. home. son jona jail [2] 4 clear cool. dagt pollard tarried till noon went jonas. mrs ballard shee came night dt p. sett ouf home. felt better wish greatful sence. home, feel comfortable thro gods goodnes. dagt p. went home. [3] 5 clear. hannah dolly pollard came help feel feeble thro gods goodnes free pain. home. h. dolly pollard came [4] 6 cloudy cool. hannah scolt pickles part washing. mrs stone brot 12 cents fm mrss carter plumbs. mrs burlun sent present tamrinds, tea 4 lb beef. jona calld see home, felt better thro gods mercie. son lambard sleeps 5 7 clear part day. done chores, paird cutt apples drie. hannah finisht washing, washt kitchen buttery bakt bread pies. martha, elisa james spent aftern home. son l. left early attend coart. gave 25 cents. 6 1 clear part day. felt better. h. ballard, le faett, luke barton, ranus pierce mariage mr heath sally farewel. home, friends 7 2 cloudy. feel feeble done work. son ephms wife sent meat prepared mins pies yesterday. bakeing today. home. 8 3 cloudy. home, made pair pillow cases, feel fatagued. home. h. ballard sleeps source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 3-13, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 3 13, 1811 3 1 clear. barny lambard dind wilm b. got twich wood. dagt ballard, marta, james elisa aftern. epm came calld home. dagt b.s childn 4 2 clear. hous wk went son jonas. dagt seting go settlement. mrss carter stone came son jonas. funeral mrss mason sydny. 5 3 clear pleasant. went son jonas early. dagt epm, marta, james elisa sett clinton 10h morn. old mrs stone came home soon sett matters house. son jonas. shee 4 childn sett clinton. churnd 3-4/1 lb butter. 6 4 raind. bakt bread, pumpkin pies, apple puding 1 apl pie &c. home. 7 5 raind cold. done hous work, spent ye evng cuting raggs bed. home. 8 6 raind cloudy day. done hous wk. ye aneversary death dear dagt town, 13 years since. funeral lucy [maxee] town ys aftern. home. funeral. 9 7 raind. done various kinds work. sabery getchel sleeps home. 10 1 clear. luke barton came see us, informd sacrament adminestred. h. glidon, h. ballard, l. gitchel came sabery sleeps home. 11 2 clear. bakt brown flour bread apple puding done matters. sabery left breakfast. staid alone. home. 12 3 clear. washt done mending. abm field calld see us. home. 13 4 rainy. done hous work, sorted part apples ye sellar, pared cut rot hannah glidon went malta, mr fields home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Nov. 14-27, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, november 14 27, 1811 14 5 clear part day. takeing care apples, paired cut drie. mr ballard thrashing beens. home. death ezra town. 15 6 clear part day. churnd 2 lb butter. home. 16 7 clear foren, raind night. son ephm calld evng, gave us quarter lamb wd 10 lb. informd us told ezra town killd fall tree last thursday. may god grant us take seutable notis dealings us, may husband weddo father ye childn. home. 17 1 clear. heavy tidings confirmd dear grand sons remains interd afternoone. may strive allso ready. receivd letter sist barton august 28th, friends well. home. funeral ezra town 18 2 clear part day. done hous work &c. raind night. home. 19 3 clear part day. mr ballard settlement, got 2 oz snuff. washt &c. isaac farewel calld evng apples. home. 20 4 cloudy cold. ironed. mrs donison another young woman calld. home. 21 5 snowd raind. son epm sent carriage father went. mr husband went meeting, thanks giving day. son ephms. 22 6 clear part day raind part, ditoes. 23 7 clear butt son could bring us home. ditoes. 24 1 cloudy rain. isaac farewel brot home shais. son gave 7 lb beef, wife lb god soape. ditoes. mr ballard walkt home, wrode. 25 2 clear day, cloudy evng. washt. le faett butchered spotted pigg. epm calld came fm clinton satter day, well abner wilm sleep son jona came raft. home, washt. 26 3 clear cold. washt kitchen buttery began stockin son pollard. husband faint turn aftern. home. indiens son jonas fout. 27 4 cloudy, snow rain. fixing remove son jonas hous, calld ys morn, gone jail aftern. wm sleeps home. son jona gone jail debt. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Dec. 18-26, 1811 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, december 18 26, 1811 18 4 cloudy, raind aftern. ephm came home 9h evn, sally left mother, james elisa mr wimans. jona junr came first evng. home, work hous. 19 5 raind day, snowd evng. dagt ballard childn came, tarried till aftern; went hous mr moody liv keep hous till husband liberated jail. son jona sett norridgwalk. 57 years day since joind wedlock husband. [home]. ye anneversary marriage 57 years since. 20 6 clear cold. done washing knit evng. home. 21 7 clear till near night, snowd evng. ironed done mending. informd jessy lock hallowell expired 16th inst. home. 22 1 clear pleasant. son jonas wife came brot james elisa mr partridg came see pain stomach till near night. mrs ballard 4 gees killd, pickt gutted. shee left 10h evng. [home]. jonas wife jona [forgeson][sleep] 23 2 clear foren, cloudy aftn, raind little 10h evn. luke came brot 8 cabbage heads son epm sent us. informs sons wife unwel. sally ballard unwell. made sage tea. [home]. 24 3 severe snow storm. jack carried sally james fathers sleigh. returnd forgison allso. home kniting. 25 4 cloudy, snowd done hous wk knit jona sett clinton, forgison 26 5 clear. son epm calld hanh pollard going help wife unwel. mr ballard sent 3s epm, got 4/1 tea, 2-4/1 lb sugar. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 1-8, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 1 8, 1812 1 4 cloudy rain. epm conducted grand pah capt pitss, found famely allmost sick colds. charls coxes wife went judg norths evng lecture. revd mr tappin performd. text romans xiii c vers 11th. returnd home 9h evn. judg norths lecture. mr deans new sharon. 2 5 cloudy rain. dagt ballard, james elisa came went home evng. jona iunr came clinton, well home, jona junr sleeps 3 6 snowd cloudy day. twisted yarn knit slocken mr ballard. mr hudson sleeps jona allso. home. 4 7 snowd, cleard way evng. calld see mr firbeshes infant, bad cold costive. administred clistar gave relief. returnd home sun set. washt husband shirt mr firbishes. [5] 1 clear. home. jonas wife 2 childn evng. shee informd mr tappins text eclesiasts 11 c 1st vers, contribution relief poore sick. home. son jonas wife evng. [6] 2 clear morn, cloudy aftn. done larg wash put linning drie, knit evng. linda filld sausages. home. 7 3 cloudy part day. epm cutt ancle. mr ballard went son epms. mrs farewel came went wm stones; returnd sleeps cut frosen apples stue. home. mrs farewel sleeps 8 4 cloudy snow. mrs farewel went hanh trask mrs bennet mrs smith allso. sally came evng. home. mrs farewl left source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 9-19, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 9 19, 1812 9 5 clear. son jonas wife 2 childn came done hous work knit home, jonas wife 10 6 clear. home, knit hous work. linda went see sist sands, 3 girls slept fields allso. home, 11 7 clear. mended shirt part coat husband. stephen lathrop home. 12 1 cloudy day, snowd night. mr lankester wife evng. shee gave flower tea. becky fletcher georg andrus allso meeting. home. mr lankester wife evng. 13 2 clear part day. beck day. abm fields hanh glidon came evng. rans pierce, jona ballard wilm sleep home, company 14 3 clear part day cloudy part. fields hannah left afler breakfast, becky fletcher dinner. jona ranus sleep home. 15 4 clear part day, snowd done hous work knit home. death old mrss shaw. 16 5 clear day. old mrs stone informd old mrs shaw departed life last night. mr hammond mrs mason evng. home. funeral mr pipers son. 17 6 clear. funeral old mrss shaw. betsy wiman calld revd mr tappin gave mr ballard 8 dolars money contributed relief poore. calld mr livermore go see wife labour, women calld 9h evn. old mrss hamlin, nichols 2 mrss heartfords. home till evng. revd mr tappin funeral old mrss shaw. went mr livermores evng. 18 7 birth mr livermores dagt. clear cold. mrs livermore deld 10h dagt dangerous labour. returnd home 2h pm much come cold. found dagt ballard mr field conducted bride home hous keeping. mr livermores. birth 1 st. funeral mrs baxter. 19 1 [x]. birth mrss wilms son, first born. xx. clear part day, snowd cold. luke barton isaac [farewel], h. pollard sopha ballard calld calld see mrs williams, shee safe deld son, first born 9h [20]m pm. tarried night, slept little. birth 2nd. receivd 1 dolr jobe springers. receivd 1 dolr march 20th. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 20-30, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 20 30, 1812 20 2 snowd cold. returnd home night, knit evng. linda slept roome. ditoes. 21 3 clear, cold windy. home, knit mr bennet workt le faett forenn. home. 22 4 clear cold. son jonas wife calld left sally, james eliza. shee gone clinton, ephm home. son jonas wife gone clinton. 23 5 clear cold. son dagt pollard catherene arronds us. informd wido lovjoy expired 19th inst. jona junr sleeps home. son dagt pollard death mrs lovjoy 19th inst. 24 6 snowd. unwel night forenn. ame niles came tarried little rose afternn, feel better. home, unwel. 25 7 clear day, clouded evn. son pollard calld brot us 2 bushl corn 4s pr bushel. took monney got us 1 lb candles 2_ butter. brot meal mill. dagt hannah went home son epms wife better. mr ebenz trask wife spent evn. son wilm ranus pierce becky fletcher abner trask sleep home, washing. mr trask wife b. fletcher olhers. 26 1 snowd. jona junr sett clinton. ranus pierce took treat husband unbecomingly. may god forgiv misconduct sinceer prayer. son ephm, wife son, mr heath wife spent evng alfred sprague, linda keziah haul went lecture mr rowels. home. son epm, wife son, mr heath wife 27 2 clear cold. dagt ballard 2 childn mr bennet, wife childn evng. done washing knit home. linda makeing soap. 28 3 clear cold. mr ballard pain neck, able work. done hous work knit jonas wife james shee finisht hir soape took care matters. home. dagt ballard finisht makeing soape. 29 4 clear forenn, cloudy aft; snowd evng. revd mr tappin deld discoarse matthew 11 c 28 vers. considerable number people collected sons pollard epm, wives samuel p. sopha, son jonas wife, sally, james elisabeth. home, evng lecture preacht 30 5 cloudy. mended legins hoes. linda went mr [colitus], bot pint half new rm, 2 lb sugar [_ pepper pins, cost 6s home. death david smilys wife. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Jan. 31-Feb. 8, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, january 31 february 8, 1812 31 6 clear part day, cloudy evng. calld betsy andrews go see marm pain side, mrs firbish weak situation. informd mrss smyles death took place yeslerday. mr andrewss. 1 7 clear. home. epm, hannah nabby hudson came clinton. wilm trask ranus pierce malta. hannah ballard 17 years old day. home. funeral mrs smyle sydney. 2 1 birth levy cowens son, [6th] child. cloudy, raind evng. calld levy cowen go see wife labour. shee safe deld 4h son expired 5. shee fall long since probably cause. hannah nabby wint hear mr tappin day evng. levy cowens. birth 3d. death ofthe infant. death [lydae] springer sidney. 3 2 clear part day. mr james gore new sharon brot us corn, rie flower part owed us. paid 5 dolls money. home, head soar. h. n. sally sleep began rain 10h evn. mrss davis rhoda pollard calld took tea; left near sun sett. home. rhoda pollard mrss davis 4 3 raind till 10h clear aflerwards. done hous work, knit &c. hannah gone fathers. finisht futing wms hoes. home. 5 4 sun shone till twelve o clock, snode afterwds. hannah epm sett clinton. done washing mending. home. hannah sett clinton. 6 5 clear, cold windy. done hous work mending. mrs burdin calld shee going new [vinyard], mother sick. ephm returnd clinton, wel home. 7 6 clear part day. son mr flint bartons, mr robards took tea. luke barton evng. hous, ephm conducted sleigh. brot cyruss bed things jason pierce sleeps home. 8 7 rainy day. ironed mended coat &c. ranus jason pierce sleep sally ballard allso. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 9-18, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 9 18, 1812 9 1 raind last night sun rise, snowd till noone, clear rest day evng. young men boys went lecture. revd mr jenks performd 1st john 1 c 3 vers. john jason p. junr spent ye day reading book mr tappins bible. home. 10 2 cloudy till 10h clear afterwards. son dagt pollard, jonas wife childn wido moore mrss broadstreet calld. done hous wk, mended coat knit. home. childn cousins. death j. north esq. 11 3 snowd. mr fuller wido town calld going judg conys. calld return, took tea went home. home. connections well winslow. informd death esq james north. home, wido town 12 4 clear, cold windy. cow calvd lost ague fit night. home. 13 5 clear pleasant. unwel kept bed till 2h pm. mrs smith dagt brooks james north esq interd day, infant mr welses augusta. home. funeral james north esq ofclinton, infant mr welss augusta. 14 6 clear morn, snowd aftrn. mr bowls wife came see us. dagt ballard 2 youngest childn luthar pierce, jona b. junr mr hudson sleep raind ye night. home. mr bowls wife, dagt ballard 15 7 clear pleast foren, windy aftn evng. charls dingly wife calld see us. bakt washt knit home. charls dingly wife 16 1 clear pleast foren, cloudy evng. dagt ballard, childn, betsy saml wiman l. barton evng. revd mr t tappins text foren mat 8 11th, aft revela 15-16-17 verss. home, childn 17 2 cloudy, snowd evng. bror ebenzs wife john calld left ebenz junrs child alive dangerously ill. home. sist moor 18 3 cloudy ye day. mrs partrage foren. calld see mrs butterfield difacult circumstanss. gave advice returnd home, performd business various kinds. young men boys cards till near mid night. mr butterfields. mrss partridg source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Feb. 19-29, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, february 19 29, 1812 19 4 clear except squall snow noone. home. jona sleeps [home]. 20 5 x. clear cold. mr linsa foss, mr millet wife calld went hous brot plan livermore. mr ballard lent mr foss. willian ballard unwell night, gave medisin cough, slept jona. seen 77 years day. may render prais great author mercies goodness past life, obtain forgivness sins committed. home hous. people leads seen 77 years day. 21 6 clear cold. hannah pollard saml, betsy town calld see us. old mrs wickson gave broom. wilm better, yet. home. h. polld b. town hir. 22 7 clear. mr isaac savage, wife, isaac junr wife dind. revd mr stone lady, son jonas wife childn took tea us. finisht kniting le faetts stockins washt home. revd mr stone wife 23 1 clear foren n, cloudy aftn, snowd evng. luke b. jona junr went son pollards. luke sleeps home. 24 2 snowd windy. home, feel unwel churnd, 2_ butter. martha day night, wilm fathers. home. 25 3 clear forin, snowd little evng. luke barton jona balld junr gone son pollards ball. grand fatther lent jona 2 dollars, returnd 3s. home. 26 4 birth anthony bracketts 7th son, 9th child. cloudy snow. calld 2h pm see wife anthony bracket labour safe deld 5h 30m 7th son 9th child. illness dificult severe left mother infant comfortable reacht home 10 evng. mr bracketts. birth 4th. receivd 1 dollar. 27 5 clear, cold windy; cloudy evng. le faett gone work team wm babcock. bakt wheat brown bread ys day. home. 28 6 cloudy snow. mr snell sydna calld wife 2 childn warm, informd timy runelss dagt syntha dead; jona junr wido north clinton dead, remains interd day. allso ebenz moores child scolt dead. home. 29 7 birth john shaws 2nt son, 4th child. snowd. calld john shaws, wife deld second son, 4th child 9h evn. shee child cleverly. self women tarried night. 29, john shaws. bth 5th. recd 9 s funeral mrs north, clinton. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 1-9, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 1 9, 1812 1 1 clear pleasant. returnd home morn, left patients cleverly. done hous work read betsy town martha ballard walkt son jonas fatagued. john shaws. betsy town martaballard came 2 2 clear. sun shone pleasant aire cold. dagt ballard, james eliza came jona junr sett clinton. gidion luke barton came evn, took tea conducted dagt childn home. linda went o. wimans, brot wife home. betsy made cap, shee sleeps home. dagt balld gidion luke bartn allso. 3 3 clear cold. ephm hannah came clinton, shee went fathers. mrss sands came abner came back. severe ague fitt night. home. hannah came clinton. 4 4 birth s babcocks first dagt 5 th child. clear, wind south. unwel day. selvanas hatch wife, old mrs butterfield betsy andrews calld evng see wife saml babcock 3d, found put bed 1st dagt 5th child prest husband. tarried night. saml babcocks. birth 6th. son jona 49 yearsold ys day. 5 5 clear pleasant. returnd home 11 12 find dagts mr pollard, wife, dolly catharine calld evng. mr gower brot us 42_ lb pork 9d, 13_ chese 9d, 14_ butter 1s took note gave mr ballard last june 27th. ditoes. childn calld mr hatch& wife left james gower paid owed us. 6 6 birth masons 5th son. clear. went lecture son ephms. calld asa masons soon reacht home. wife deld son, 9 child 5th son 11h evng. leclure, son ephms masons. birth 7th. 7 7 clear. returnd fm masons, felt fatagued. son jonas famely came last night, came night. masons. 8 1 clear. went meeting, communion day. mr heath wife evng, betsy wiman allso. meeting son ephms. mr heath son cyrus allso. 9 2 clear. done houswork. son cyrus settlement. sent 2/1 gln spirit. hannah epm sett clinton. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 10-17, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 10 17, 1812 10 3 clear pleast. old mrs stone mrs bennet unwel. jona junr came clinton. home, unwel. 11 4 snowd morn. mr livermore came conducted see sally foy unwel. cleard away aftern. foys. son cyrus left son lambd 12 5 clear cold. mr livermore came foys conducted home, wife came went doct howards. left sally better shee got bed. lhe boys brot apples house, cutt stued parl frozen. dittoes mr livermores, wife came home 13 6 clear cold. washt roome, cutt stued apples, feel fatagued. dagt ballard better shee mrss partridg informd uncle jeremy learneds wife dead. home. son jona came clinton. 14 7 clear cold. felt unwel. sister pollard calld see luke barton sopha ballard dind john pierce wife sleep lefaett came home [teeme]. home. sist pollard son pollard jail. 15 1 clear part day. unwel. mrs smith others home, unwel. 16 2 cloudy cold. dagt ballard company. rhoda saml pollard calld evng, father came jail. home. son pollard came jail. 17 3 birth son jonas 7th 8th sons. snowd day. dagt ballard labour, women calld noone. shee safe deld 2 3 pm sone aboul 3 pm another son. labour severe shee infants seeme likely wel. first born wd 5 _ lb, last 6 _ lb. shee mother 8 sons 4 dagts. home. births son jonas twins, 8th 9th year. abm fields wife sleep source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 18-26, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 18 26, 1812 18 4 clear, cold windy. mrs barden takeing care jonas wife babes, helpt field wife left molta. wm ballard sett clinton conduct hannah sally home. thos norcross. 19 5 x. birth thos norcross 1 child. xx. clear cold. mrs norcros deld 5h son, first born. left child comfortable arivd home 10 morn, receivd two dollars sugar, tea spirit. son jonas youngest inft feeble. hannah sally came clinton. son dagt lambd evng. ditoes. birth 10th. receivd 12/. 20 6 clear. dagt pollard came son jonas youngest inft expired 2h 30m pm. felt home. death son jonas infant. 21 7 clear. able sett little, great number people day. jonas wife wel expected. home. 22 1 clear pleasant. feel better wish bless author. funeral son jonas infant aftern. former minester, dear mr stone, made apropriate prayer ocation. home. funeral son jonas [infant]. 23 2 clear pleasant. felt feeble. son jona brot wife east chamber west roome, shee seems comfortable. home, feel feeble. churnd 1-2/1 lb butter. 24 3 clear, cold wind. sons jona lambd, linda getchel, jona junr ephm sett clinton 10h washt fue things. home, feeble. jona went clinton. 25 4 cloudy part day. done washing feel feeble yet. sopha lankester helpt hannah. mrs farewel sleeps home. 26 5 cloudy foren. finisht little washing began tuesday. home. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Mar. 27-Apr. 5, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, march 27 april 5, 1812 27 6 [birth edwd savages son]. cloudy part day. calld 10h edwd savage go see wife labour. fall way much hurt. found patiend calld 2 mid wives doct ellis shee saw found mind doct cony. calld providence would shee calld assist performd case. shee deld 8h 30m pm son wel expected. slept mr jery babcocks, aguish turn night. edwd savages. birth 11th. 28 7 cloudy. returnd home noon, feel fatagud. doct cony gave hira picra camphr. went bed slept aftern. ditoes. 29 1 tedious snow storm. felt unwel day night. home, unwel. 30 2 sun shine cold windy. anaversary son ephms birth 33 years since. home, feeble. 31 3 clear warm. felt feeble. wilm sprague brot 1 bushel corn, carried mill; got ground, brot mill home. wm sprague brot 1 bushl corn. 1 4 clear pleast. felt feeble. mrs burd spin linning dagt ballards wheal. 1-4/1 lb butter churnd ys day. home. 2 5 clear warm. mrs stone went home. mrs bennet anna see mrs ballard. felt feeble. home. mrs stone went home. 3 6 clear. felt feeble. asa pierce came mid night go jery tolmans go home. 4 7 [x birth joel clearks 5th son xx]. clear. calld 1h morn mr cleark see wife labour. wrode hors back pillion, felt much fatagued. patient safe deld 3h pm fifth son. tarried night. [joel] clearks. birth 12. recd 6/ 4 lb snuff, sugar [cash] full. 5 1 cloudy. came home sleigh early ys morn, fatagued. went onto bed soon got home, sett little day. ditoes. came home fatagued. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 6-16, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 6 16, 1812 6 2 cloudy morn, cleard away 8h mr johnston came shais husband go attend town meeting. went tarried night capt pittss. home, feel feeble. 7 3 clear pleast. capt pitts procured hors husband ride home. son jona led back. felt better feeble yett. mrs partridg, smith brooks see son jonas wife. done hous work knitt. home. 8 4 clear. unwel sett little. betsy wiman came see shee made bed made hasty pudding. home, unwel. 9 5 clear part day. mr lankester calld going forenn meeting, informd text daniel ix c 6 7 verss. moses partridg le faett makeing hogg pen. mitchel swingling flax home. 10 6 raind. sick bed aftern. home. 11 7 cloudy part day. felt unwel. mrs smith milk. able work. home. 12 1 clear. old mrss stone 1 burdens dagts. le faett sett go meeting, found mill brook bridg upsett ice, men work secure home. old mrs stone 13 2 cloudy till pm, began snow. washt cuboard east roome, door bed roome, feel feeble. churnd 1-2/1 lb butter. snowd day cold. home. 14 3 cloudy y morn, clear aflern. felt feeble, home. home. 15 4 clear part day. unwel. mr burden evng, says wife sick. rested night. home. death [fo dagt ae 2 years 6 mo. 16 5 clear part day. removd son jonas house. hannah came helpt hours favour feel greatful. title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 17-24, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 17 24, 1812 17 6 [birth sally foys son 3rd child]. raind. foys. sally deld [1]h morn son wd 10 lb. john foys dagt child expired 15th inst. slackt raining came home 7h much fatagued. mrs smith tea. sally ballard sleps [f birth 13th. recd 12 18 7 cloudy. warrin stones wife came washt two ague fitts, felt sick indeed. funeral foys child. sally martha sleep night. home. mrs stone washt funeral. 19 1 [birth wilm saunders 3d dagt 4th child]. cloudy morn, raind aftern. felt feeble. mrs stone came see shee brot wood doore. shee informd william brookss wife fell scaffold fathers barn yesterday hurt life expected. nancy smith says shee better. calld wilm saunders 4h pm, wife deld 10 evn 3d dagt 4th child comfortable. laid slept wm saunders. birth 14. 20 2 clear. took breakfast saunderss went see mrs heath, shee wel. conducted home, reacht 10h jonas childn ironing mending feele feeble. ditoes mr heaths. sally slept 21 3 clear, hard frost morn. mrs stone came washt bed cloaths north roome, made brown bread. sally sifted meal. felt feeble ye day. home. mrs stone washt 22 4 cloudy, raind night. sally helpt day. sick day. martha came slept home, unwel. sally 23 5 cleard 9h high wind w. girls went home breakfast. done hous wk brewd beer. james ballard 5 years old day. home. 24 6 clear cold wind. calld 9h morn see mrs heath labour. marm sister mrs jones day night. mr heats. source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Martha Ballard's Diary, Apr. 25-May 4, 1812 (P)
content: martha ballard's diary, april 25 may 4, 1812 25 7 clear cold. mrs farewel mr heaths night. shee went home breakfast. mrs heath ill day. slept little. ague fitts yesterday today. mr heaths. mrs [bridg] came 9h evng. 26 1 [josiah heath birth, dagt, first born]. clear cold season. mrs heaths illness increast mid night shee deld 4h 30m dagt, first born. left noone, marm came. illness severe. felt feeble day. mrith 15th. receivd 12/s. left patienls comfortable. 27 2 clear. ill. sally came towards night. betsy andrews came, staid night. home. 28 3 clear. sick day. betsy home. 29 4 clear. feel comfortable wish praise great author. son ephm came hors father ride lecture. turn pain led think could go sett noone. home, sick. betsy 30 5 clear cold, snowd ys morn. ill. betsy calld home night. home, ill. betsy left 1 6 clear cold. dagt lambd went home. quite ill. mr ballard went settlement, bot tobacko, rode home. home. dagt lambard went home. 2 7 clear. dolly lambard came take care sick day. home, [unweal]. 3 1 cloudy. mr ballard gone meeting. son lambd calld see sons jona epm came meeting, luke lefaell also. sally sleeps feeble ys day. sacrament day, lhere number persons admited. home, feeble. childn calld see 4 2 clear. mr ballard town meeting. dolly lambd came help home, source: www.dohistory.org. transcription courtesy robert cynthia mccausland.

title: Courtship and Marriage, entries #1-10 February 25, 1788, Monday
content: two three marriages ballard household 1792 show us differences expected expect today. marriage process, series events, single, special day. courting took place within confines work community. interspersed daily work, young people saw school, corn huskings, dances quiltings barn raisings, sunday meeting, local tavern, riding visit neighbors. (mr. pollard's mr. thomas's entries two taverns town.) young people also went households work, might found friends companions law, marriage banns posted public place fourteen days announced three public religious meetings three different days. called "published." marriage lacked pomp circumstance. honeymoon, one, probably consisted visiting friends relatives, often group travelled newlyweds. even wedding day, bride necessarily leave parents' house immediately. first couple gather make goods set household. 1792 weddings, ballard family engaged making buying essential household items. meanwhile grooms came went, sometimes meals, sometimes stay overnight. see ballard diary finally, made enough preparations, married couple could "go housekeeping." thus rituals courtship marriage, control community, confirmed family ties led new economic relationship two people. information, see film midwife's tale chapter four book midwife's tale. 68 entries theme:1-10 11-20 21-30 31-40 41-50 51-60 61-68 next 10 february 25, 1788, monday view full diary page 25 2 clear. mr ballard theophs went varsalboro. revd mr foster came see infant; coald. came home eleven o clok; walkd; much fatagud. jono girls gone ride sleigh. came home half aft 12. may 8, 1788, thursday view full diary page 8 5 clear. mr josh foster brot wife shee feaver fitt home. hannah wove three yds wail cloath. polly cool theophelus publisht mrs sally rockit oxford. may 25, 1788, sunday view full diary page 25 e clear till 1/o clok pm, thunder rain. famely went meeting except epm self. went see mr wilms famely, unwell. mrs pollard mrs porter went bed 10, calld 11h evinn mr moses whites wife travil. walkt string piece ye bridg mr hoveys. ephm cowen publisht hannah savage.at wilmss. june 15, 1788, sunday view full diary page 15 e clear cool. attended public worship; title: Scarlet Fever Epidemic, entries #1-10 June 3, 1787, Sunday
content: summer 1787 hallowell, maine, martha ballard found busy two major duties midwife: delivering babies tending sick. entries diary months june, july, august, september show evidence group hemolytic streptococci attacking populace scarlet fever, puerperal fever, infected wounds. working germ theory explained connection, martha way knowing "strep," call responsible three manifestations patients. symptoms scarlet fever sore throat, rash, possible death. martha contemporaries called canker rash. puerpural fever occurred childbirth could kill mother child. antibiotics available help scarlet fever, puerpural fever, infected wounds. people even know cleanth antiseptic conditions could stem spread disease patient patient. look following entries evidence epidemic. subplot one entry involved martha august 13 noted death little willy mcmaster, whose mother pregnant another child. martha wrote, "poor mother, distressing case..." perhaps case brought back memory summer 1769 martha lost three young children diptheria epidemic oxford, massachusetts. like mrs. mcmaster, martha birthed daughter hannah august 6, 1769) epidemic took another child's life. check august 6, 1787 entry, martha noted hannah's birthday. see film midwife's tale chapter one book midwife's tale. 88 entries theme:1-10 11-20 21-30 31-40 41-50 51-60 61-70 71-80 81-88 next 10 june 3, 1787, sunday view full title: Martha Ballard and Money, entries #1-10 April 14, 1785, Thursday

however. written using virgule six pence written /6. six shillings written 6/. shillings pence together virgule written five shillings six pence (5/6), look diary entries kind notation. martha ballard title: Timeline: 1813-1999, post-Martha years
content: 1810 1815 1820 1825 1830 1835 1840 1845 1850 1855 1860 1865 1870 1875 1880 1885 1890 1895 1900 1905 1910 1915 1920 1925 1930 1935 1940 1945 1950 1955 1960 1965 1970 1975 1980 1985 1990 1995 jan. 7, 1821: ephraim ballard dies. martha moore ephraim ballard leave large extended family, many stay maine. descendants still found area today. 1861: sarah hannah lambard inherit grandmother's diary. 1862: clara barton, grandniece martha ballard, carries healing tradition bringing medical supplies civil war soldiers founding american red cross. 1870: james north quotes passages martha ballard history augusta. 1884: mary hobart graduates women's medical college new york infirmary inherits great-great grandmother martha ballard's diary. 1904: charles everton nash abridges martha ballard's diary history augusta 1930: dr. mary hobart donates martha's original diary maine state library. 1982: laurel thatcher ulrich's book good wives published. laurel ulrich "discovers" martha ballard's diary. 1990: midwife's tale published. producer laurie kahn-leavitt contacts laurel ulrich making film diary. 1991: midwife'stale wins pulitzer prize. 1992: transcription martha ballard's diary, robert cynthia mccausland, published. 1997: film midwife's tale released. 1819: rene-theophile-hyacinth laennec, french physician, invents stethoscope, averting need physician place ear breast female patient. 1822: john stearns espouses use ergot induce labor, practice new york physician learned german midwife. 1828: british physician suggests moniker "obstetrician" describe male specialists childbirth, replacing traditional terms "man-midwife." 1847: ether chloroform use childbirth america first time. 1850: female medical college philadelphia opens. 1865: joseph lister develops antiseptic surgery. 1879: louis pasteur identifies streptococcus cause puerperal fever. jun. 10, 1884: massachusetts medical society admits women. 1935: researchers discover antibiotic properties sulphonamides. 1939: penicillin isolated antibiotic. 1814: treaty ghent ends war 1812, british troops sack washington august 24. 1815: andrew jackson defeats larger british force new textile mills built lowell, massachusetts. 1823: monroe doctrine incorporated u.s. foreign policy. 1825: john quincy adams elected sixth u.s. president.

title: Matthew 25 of The Holy Bible, King James version
content: holy bible, king james version 1772 view image view frames version title page matthew 25 matthew 25 matthew 25 [annotations cross-references ommitted] watchfulness recommended. chap. xxv. parable ten virgins. stars shall fall heaven, powers heavens shall shaken: 30 shall appear sign son man heaven: shall tribes earth mourn, shall see son man coming clouds heaven power great glory. 31 shall send angels great sound trumpet, shall gather together elect four winds, one end heaven 32 learn parable fig tree; branch yet tender, putteth forth leaves, ye know summer nigh: 33 likewise ye, ye shall see things, know near, even doors. 34 verily say unto generation shall pass, till things fulfilled. 35 heaven earth shall pass away, words shall pass away. 36 day hour knoweth man, angels heaven, father 37 days noe shall also coming son man 38 days flood eating drinking, marrying giving marriage, day noe entered ark, 39 knew flood came, took away; shall also coming son man 40 shall two field; one shall taken, left. 41 two women shall grinding mill; one shall taken, left. 42 watch therefore: ye know hour lord doth come. 43 know goodman house known watch thief would come, would watched, would suffered house broken 44 therefore ye also ready: hour ye think son man cometh. 45 faithful wise servant, lord hath made ruler household, give meat due season? 46 blessed servant, lord cometh shall find 47 verily say unto shall make ruler goods. 48 evil servant shall say heart, lord delayeth coming; 49 shall begin smite fellowservants, eat drink drunken; 50 lord servant shall come day looketh hour aware 51 shall cut asunder, appoint portion hypocrites: shall weeping gnashing teeth. chap. xxv parable ten virgins; 14 talents, king distributed among servants, improved 31 description last judgment 1 shall kingdom heaven likened unto ten virgins, took lamps, went forth meet bridegroom. 2 five wise, five foolish. 3 foolish took lamps, took oil 4 wise took oil vessels lamps. 5 bridegroom tarried, slumbered slept. 6 midnight cry made, behold, bridegroom cometh; go ye meet 7 virgins arose, trimmed lamps. 8 foolish unto wise, give us oil; lamps gone 9 wise answered, saying, lest enough us go ye rather sell, buy 10 went buy, bridegroom came; ready went marriage: door shut. 11 afterward came also virgins, saying, lord, lord, open us. 12 answered verily say unto know 13 watch therefore, ye know neither day hour wherein son man cometh. 14 kingdom heaven man travelling far country, called servants, delivered unto goods. 15 unto one gave five talents, another two, another one; every man according several ability; straightway took journey. 16 received five talents went traded made five talents. jump see document 'archive'

title: Matthew 25 of The Holy Bible, King James version
content: holy bible, king james version 1772 view image view frames version title page matthew 25 matthew 25 matthew 25 [annotations cross-references ommitted] parable talents 8. matthew description last judgment 17 likewise received two, also gained two. 18 received one went digged earth, hid lord's money. 19 long time lord servants cometh, reckoneth 20 received five talents came brought five talents, saying, lord, thou deliveredst unto five talents: behold, gained beside five talents 21 lord unto well done, thou good faithful servant: thou hast faithful things, make thee ruler many things: enter thou joy thy lord. 22 also received two talents came lord, thou deliveredst unto two talents: behold, gained two talents beside 23 lord unto well done, good faithful servant; thou hast faithful things, make thee ruler many things: enter thou joy thy lord. 24 received one talent came lord, knew thee thou art hard man, reaping thou hast sown, gathering thou hast strowed: 25 afraid, went hid thy talent earth: lo, thou hast thine. 26 lord answered unto thou wicked slothful servant, thou knewest reap sowed gather strowed: 27 thou oughtest therefore put money exchangers, coming received mine usury. 28 take therefore talent give unto hath ten talents. 29 unto every one hath shall given, shall abundance: hath shall taken away even hath. 30 cast ye unprofitable servant outer darkness: shall weeping gnashing teeth. 31 son man shall come glory, holy angels shall sit upon throne glory: 32 shall gathered nations: shall separate one another, shepherd divideth sheep goats: 33 shall set sheep right hand, goats left. 34 shall king say unto right hand, come, ye blessed father, inherit kingdom prepared foundation world: 35 hungered, ye gave meat: thirsty, ye gave drink: stranger, ye took 36 naked, ye clothed sick, ye visited prison, ye came unto 37 shall righteous answer saying, lord, saw thee hungered, fed thee? thirsty, gave thee drink? 38 saw thee stranger, took thee naked, clothed thee? 39 saw thee sick, prison, came unto thee? 40 king shall answer say unto verily say unto inasmuch ye done unto one least brethren, ye done unto 41 shall say also unto left hand, depart ye cursed, everlasting fire, prepared devil angels: 42 hungered, ye gave meat: thirsty, ye gave drink: 43 stranger, ye took naked, ye clothed sick, prison, ye visited 44 shall also answer saying, lord, saw thee hungered, athirst, stranger, naked, sick, prison, minister unto thee? 45 shall answer saying, verily say unto inasmuch ye one least ye 46 shall go away everlasting punishment: righteous life eternal. chap. xxvi christ foretelleth death. 3 rulers conspire 6 woman poureth precious ointment head. 14 judas bargaineth betray 17 christ eateth passover, pointeth traitor: 26 instituteth last supper: 30 foretelleth desertion discipiles, peter's denial 36 agony prayer garden. 47 betrayed apprehended. 51 one servants high priest hath ear cut jesus forbiddeth opposition: 57 carried caiaphas, falsely accused, examined, pronounced guilty, treated indignity. 69 peter's denial repentance. came pass, jesus finished sayings, unto disciples, jump see document 'archive'

title: Martha Ballard's Story - Chapter 2
content: martha ballard's story chapter 2 martha likes foster's sermons martha approved sermons delivered young new minister, isaac foster, brother john foster. woman measured life others, might expected enjoy foster's july 23 sermon matthew 25, chapter jesus distinguished right left hand, sheep goats, according whether fed hungry, clothed naked, comforted afflicted. faction town, led town clerk captain henry sewall, alarmed beliefs fosters. henry sewall say foster's july 23 sermon? martha heard isaac foster's brother john preach october 8th, reported "agreeably entertaind" "discoarce." henry sewall say october 8th sermon? find sewall block isaac foster's ordination. john foster town ordination vote brother isaac. three days later, october 11, martha reported weather "clear pleasant." also noted, revd isaac foster ordaind town." although skies clear, storm brewing. henry sewall continued criticize young minister. previous new minister next isaac foster replied suing henry sewall cousin, thomas sewall, slander. table contents

"counsel" referring church council empowered judge isaac foster's fate. link october 30 town record appointing church council church council met pollards tavern november, martha diary contains evidence grievances presented. went mr pollards heare laid revd. counsil examined evidences revd mr foster," recorded november 20. next day, attended counsil hear evidences examind. margarett fox gave contirary evidence concerning working sabath shee calld cause capt sewalls defameing revd mr foster." apparently one charges laid rev. foster sabbath-breaking, rebecca's servant margaret fox testified differently council foster/sewall slander case. two-day hearing, council recommended town dismiss foster. one month later, find martha's record foster officially dismissed town meeting: "clear cold. mr ballard attended town meeting. vote passt revd mr foster preach meeting hous anymore." link december 18 town records, find vote foster conditions dismissal. previous martha looks fosters next town meeting gave special directions church sexton: forbid foster ever setting foot meeting house. table contents martha ballard's diary view image view frames version september 9, 1788 (tuesday) 9 3 clear day. thee town mett hear revd mr fosters proposals axcept dolly parthena went see mrs hamlin. mrs savage shee spun 40 double skeins since april 15th, 2 bushl ashess physic james, dolly wove 7 yds diapor. let 1 skein lining warp. whole 6/5 x. town meeting. home. mrs savage jump sep 9 entry appears 'textile production' theme martha's diary see sep. 9 entry martha ballard's diary online

content: martha ballard's story chapter 5 foster's dismissal debated september 9, 1788, martha noted, "thee town mett hear revd mr fosters proposals axcept fall 1788, foster's relations town deteriorated badly offered sever connections town would pay 200 pounds. refused. martha seemed rally rev. foster, commenting vocally usual quality sermons. take look entry martha wrote five days town refused foster's proposal. martha declared "revd mr foster deliverd two exelent discorases psalm 90 12 vers." psalm reads: teach us number days, may apply hearts unto wisdom..." pointed reference rev. mr. foster precarious situation? one can't help think martha's entry following sunday? enthusiastically endorses rev. foster: revd mr foster delivd 2 fine discoarses romans 10." town decided take action october 30, martha wrote, "mr balard town meeting. apointed counsel." "counsel" referring church council empowered judge isaac foster's fate. link october 30 town record appointing church council church council met pollards tavern november, martha diary contains evidence grievances presented. went mr pollards heare laid revd. counsil examined evidences revd mr foster," recorded november 20. next day, attended counsil hear evidences examind. margarett fox gave contirary evidence concerning working sabath shee calld cause capt sewalls defameing revd mr foster." apparently one charges laid rev. foster sabbath-breaking, rebecca's servant margaret fox testified differently council foster/sewall slander case. two-day hearing, council recommended town dismiss foster. one month later, find martha's record foster officially dismissed town meeting: "clear cold. mr ballard attended town meeting. vote passt revd mr foster preach meeting hous anymore." link december 18 town records, find vote foster conditions dismissal. previous martha looks fosters next town meeting gave special directions church sexton: forbid foster ever setting foot meeting house. table contents martha ballard's diary view text view frames version september 9, 1788 (tuesday) jump sep 9 entry appears 'textile production' theme martha's diary see sep. 9 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: February 15, 1789 (Sunday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version february 15, 1789 (sunday) 15 d clear cold. revd fosters. mr ballard better, soar nose broke. dagt town dolly mr hamlins. polly savage parthena home. revd fosters nr savages. march 6, 1789 (friday) 6 6 clear cold. mr town mrss stackpool left 9 ysm. went revd fosters, childs soar broke good way. broth moore raind ye 9th hour ys evn, stormy night. revd fosters. march 9, 1789 (monday) 9 2 clear pleasant. home. mr ballard pitts town lining triming jona coat. bougt 18 sewing needles pair silver sleave buttuns wd 5 penny wt 47 gs. cost 3/4. revd foster ys morn. robert fletcher daft born ys morn. home. birth robert fletchers 3d dagtr 6th h morn. march 27, 1789 (friday) 27 6 clear pleast. mr ballard capt enoch pages. jona halling loggs ye mill. robbins workt combing flax. revd mr foster bn home. july 2, 1789 (thursday) 2 5 clear hott till evn, began rain 10. agustus ballard mamy ys day, mr foster lady allso. home. jesse bullin debe black sleep august 10, 1789 (monday) 10 2 clear except sprineling rain noon. went mrs emerson far mr crages, drank tea calld james moore see mrs shearborn unwell. tarried night, gave lady medisin. shee seemd mutch comfortable. left 2 h pm returnd home, find call go elswhere. mr crages mr sherborns. calld revd mr fosters. levy moore wife jump see feb. 15 entry martha ballard's diary onlinesee mar. 6 entry martha ballard's diary onlinesee mar. 9 entry martha ballard's diary onlinesee mar. 27 entry martha ballard's diary onlinesee apr. 6 entry martha ballard's diary onlinesee jul. 2 entry martha ballard's diary onlinesee aug. 10 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: December 21, 1788 (Sunday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version december 21, 1788 (sunday) 21 e clear cold. mr ballard others went house worship suferd enter. went revd mr fosters, liberty mr thwing mr foster preach house; text geneses 3d chap 8th vers, mr ballard mr livermores evn. polly whealor low infant sick also. home. wido wilms sleeps mr crage married. wido wilms sleeps jump see dec. 21 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: December 22, 1788 (Monday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version december 22, 1788 (monday) 22 2 clear cold. mr ballard gentlemen meeting house committee mett colo norths settle business. went mr livermores. polly decaying; infant unwell. wido williams came eving. girls washt washt room. mr page supt mr ballard wrote note eliphelet robbins daniel 10 dollars. went mr livermores. jump see dec. 22 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: January 10, 1789 (Saturday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version january 10, 1789 (saturday) 10 7 clear cold. mr ballard colo norths setling meeting hous committee. home part ye day. calld see nancy savage aftn, left tinct alloes, 1-1/2 oz, prs 1/x. hannah fletcher deld son 8 inst. jump see jan. 10 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: March 2, 1789 (Monday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version march 2, 1789 (monday) 2 2 clear pleast. calld revd fosters see isaac, put cattaplasm made honey, flower ye yolk egg, soar. calld mrs cumings travil ill thro night. revd fosters neigrs. mrs chandler expird 2 o clok pm. jump see mar. 2 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: April 6, 1789 (Monday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version april 6, 1789 (monday) 6 2 cloudy. mr ballard went town meeting. went colo norths. calld revd mr fosters. isaac recoverd soar. daniel robbins came welch drest 9 lb 3 oz flax. revd mr fosters colo norths. mr curtis jump see apr. 6 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: June 9, 1789 (Tuesday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version june 9, 1789 (tuesday) 9 3 clear morn. mrs eunice hodskins mr learned doct whiteaker sleep home. revd mr foster removd mr thwings house joseph williams formerly livd. friend taber takeing spruce boards mill sherebah towns acount, ys eving. wrote dagt hannah mr learned deliverd 24/ carrie purchace things bostn. home, wrote dagt hannah. ephraim went school. benn porters wife jump see jun. 9 entry martha ballard's diary online

title: October 30, 1789 (Friday)
content: martha ballard's diary view image view frames version october 30, 1789 (friday) 30 6 clear. manly dicky ephm gathering corn. seth juet foster returnd eving. rule chosen determen town hallowell giv revd mr isaac foster reported day, 112=10 colo howard treasurer given note demand interest till paid. mr foster gentlemen calld return home. futed ephm pair hoes. home. jump see oct. 30 entry martha ballard's diary online
